sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Bosch first started its operations in Vietnam in 1994 and registered a wholly-owned subsidiary in 2008. According to the business strategy of Bosch in Vietnam, from 1st July 2014 on all business entities were merged into Bosch Vietnam Co. Ltd. with its head office at Ho Chi Minh City plant (HcP) in Dong Nai Province.
HcP has started its belt assembly in a rented building on 1st August 2008 as the assembly plant of Tilburg Plant (TbP). On 14th April 2011, HcP celebrated the inauguration of the new plant (Lth101 with 17,000 sqm), which did not only allow to increase the production depth, but also to facilitate the push belt assembly of this high-tech product. On 3rd July 2012 HcP marked a big milestone by starting to produce the second component (loop-set) for its push belt. Since November 2012, HcP doubled the production floor space and increase the net total floor space up to 56.000 m², and have successfully increased its production capacity and realized a lot of new line SOP’s.
For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn

sections.text:
🎁 Quarter 4 JOINING BONUS
Candidates with 4+ years of relevant experience who join BGSV by the end of 31 December 2026 can receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month’s gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.
Main Roles and Responsibilities
Work as part of Bosch’s global ADAS teams to develop and integrate AUTOSAR Classic BSW and diagnostics software for next‑generation driver assistance ECUs (radar, camera, sensor fusion, domain controllers).
Roles & Responsibilities
Develop and maintain embedded AUTOSAR Classic software (BSW and low‑level SW) for ADAS ECUs using C/C++.
Configure, integrate, and debug AUTOSAR BSW modules, with focus on: Diagnostics, CAN Communication, Failure management and PDM.
Collaborate closely with global system, hardware, and application teams to ensure end‑to‑end integration of BSW with ADAS applications (e.g., radar, camera, sensor fusion).
Participate in the complete software development lifecycle: requirements analysis, architecture & design, implementation, unit/integration testing, debug, and maintenance.
Optimize software performance and memory usage for resource-constrained embedded systems.
Conduct code reviews, ensure adherence to Bosch coding guidelines, MISRA rules (if applicable), and best practices.
Develop and execute unit tests and integration tests; support SIL/HIL testing and vehicle testing as needed.
Ensure compliance with ISO 26262 (functional safety) and Automotive SPICE processes contribute to work products and assessments.
Create and maintain software architecture, design, and interface documentation for global stakeholders.
Use tools such as CANoe, CANalyzer, debuggers, emulators, and simulators for development, analysis, and issue resolution.
Stay updated with the latest AUTOSAR specifications and implement compliant software solutions.
Contribute to the development of software architecture and design documents.
Collaborate with hardware engineers to ensure optimal software-hardware integration.
Participate in technical discussions in an international, distributed team; and actively provide innovative solutions to complex engineering challenges.
Work, design reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Mandatory Qualifications
Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or related field.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; comfortable collaborating in global teams.
Technical Skills
Have 1-10 years of experience in embedded software development
Strong Technical skills preferably in automotive domain & Good experience in programming in C, C++ for embedded systems.
Experience with AUTOSAR Classic architecture and BSW and ASPICE know-how.
Good understanding of microcontrollers, low‑level drivers, and embedded RTOS concepts.
Experience / Familiarity in: Vehicle diagnostics and fault management SW
AUTOSAR modules: Diagnostic Error Management (DEM), Diagnostic Communication Management (DCM), Communication Stack (CAN\Ethernet\LIN protocol)
Automotive protocols and standards: ISO 14229, ISO 15765, ISO 14230, ISO 26262.
Familiarity with CANoe, CANalyzer, and issue/requirement tracking tools (e.g., Jira, DOORS/ or similar).
Prior Experience with ADAS‑related ECUs (radar, camera, sensor fusion, braking/steering controllers) is a strong plus.
Soft Skills
Self‑driven, proactive, and able to take ownership of modules/features end‑to‑end.
Strong teamwork, interpersonal skills, and problem‑solving ability.
High degree of self-discipline, quality focus, and willingness to learn new technologies in ADAS and autonomous driving.

sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Since the beginning of 2013, its operations have been divided into four business sectors: Automotive Technology, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
🎁 Quarter 4 JOINING BONUS
Candidates with 4+ years of relevant experience who join BGSV by the end of 31 December 2026 can receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month’s gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.
Bosch Engineering Process, Methods & Tools (MS/EPM-XC) is a key enabler of engineering excellence and AI transformation within Bosch Cross-Domain Computing Solutions (XC). Our mission is to improve engineering productivity through innovative processes, tools, automation, data analytics, and AI-driven solutions.
Together with global XC organizations, we develop and operate engineering platforms, automation frameworks, DevOps solutions, data analytics systems, and Generative AI applications that help engineers deliver high-quality software faster and more efficiently.
As part of our AI Transformation journey, we leverage GenAI, intelligent agents, and advanced software engineering practices to drive the future of AI-assisted engineering across Bosch XC.
As an AI Engineer, your typical work activities include:
Developing AI-powered tools and applications for engineering use cases.
Building and integrating GenAI and AI agent solutions.
Working with data pipelines, analytics, and machine learning workflows.
Supporting AI model deployment and evaluation.
Collaborating with global teams to improve engineering productivity.
Contributing to software development, testing, and automation activities.
Learning and applying the latest AI, cloud, and DevOps technologies.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
The job might be fit for you if you have:
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field.
Strong programming skills in Python and a solid foundation in software engineering principles.
Familiarity with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or modern AI application development.
Experience with the use of Agents, Skills and Knowledge-bases setup
Familiarity with AI development frameworks and tools such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, OpenAI-compatible APIs, or similar ecosystems.
Knowledge of cloud platforms, APIs, container technologies, and modern development practices.
Understanding of data processing, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI application lifecycle.
Experience with Git, CI/CD, testing, and collaborative software development workflows.
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities, with a proactive and growth-oriented mindset.
Passion for learning emerging technologies and applying AI to solve real-world engineering challenges.
Good English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with global stakeholders.
Nice to have
Hands-on experience building AI copilots, AI agents, chatbots, or workflow automation solutions.
Familiarity with any of cloud platform like Azure AI, AWS, Google Cloud, or enterprise AI platforms.
Exposure to DevOps, MLOps, LLMOps, or software quality engineering practices.
Contributions to personal projects, open-source initiatives, hackathons, or AI communities.

Logical and analytical thinking.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Execute the classification of products and technologies according to national and international customs tariff schedules.
Collect and analyzing technical product information, including specifications and bills of materials, to determine correct tariff codes.
Maintain and updating a database of classified products with their corresponding Harmonized System (HS) codes and related documentation.
Apply the General Rules for the Interpretation (GRI) of the Harmonized System to ensure consistent and defensible classification decisions.
Research customs rulings, explanatory notes, and legal precedents to resolve complex classification issues under supervision.
Prepare documentation to support classification decisions for internal reviews and customs audits.
Collaborate with team members to process classification requests and ensure alignment with established procedures.
Contribute to the team's knowledge base by documenting classification rationales and research findings for future reference.
Ensure compliance with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, company policies, and quality frameworks applicable to the role and assigned projects.
Perform other tasks as assigned by Managers.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as product engineeing background (mechanical, electrical, Software,...)
Advanced proficiency in English, specifically reading comprehension skill and the ability to understand international regulations, technical description of product e.g.
1 - 3 years of experience in international trade compliance or product engineering field.
Having knowledge of export control regulations or Tariff Code classification is an advance.
Excellent analytical and research skills, with the ability to interpret complex technical information.
Detail-oriented with a high level of accuracy in classification decisions.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with other international trade compliance areas, such as sanctions and customs regulations, is a plus.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Role Overview
Lead a technical team of around 5 members focusing on Digitalization and cross-service technical enablement.
The role combines hands-on technical contribution, team coordination, people development, and collaboration with WebApp, AI, Data, and other technical teams.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and coordinate a key technical team
Provide technical guidance for Digitalization, Automation, Integration, and related solution topics based on Digitalization Strategies of Department
Contribute hands-on to technical implementation, PoCs, and complex project topics when needed.
Plan team workload, assign tasks, and follow up progress, risks, and technical issues.
Coach and support team members in technical growth and competence development.
Work closely with WebApp, AI, Data, DevOps, and other teams to support cross-functional solutions.
Support knowledge sharing, reusable solutions, technical standards, and good engineering practices across teams.
Support requirement clarification, estimation, solution discussion, and technical workshops with project teams or customers.
Provide technical and competence-related input to management when discussing future capability needs or new technology topics.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Expected Profile
Strong technical background in IT Software Development, Digitalization, Automation, or related areas.
Experience with Web Applications, APIs, system integration, databases, or automation solutions.
Good understanding of modern software architecture and cloud-based applications.
Basic to good understanding of AI and Data-related solutions is an advantage.
Experience mentoring, coordinating, or leading a small technical team.
Good communication, planning, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work across different technical teams and collaborate in a matrix organization.
Willingness to remain hands-on in technical work.
Main Focus
Technical contribution and solution support
Team coordination and people development
Competence build-up and Innovation
Customer Engagement
Team Engagement
Cross-team collaboration and technical enablement

sections.text:
🎁 Quarter 4 JOINING BONUS
Candidates with 4+ years of relevant experience who join BGSV by the end of 31 December 2026 can receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month’s gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.
About the Role
We are looking for 10 Senior Embedded Security Engineers to design, implement, and validate end-to-end security solutions on modern embedded platforms.
This role is open to candidates from multiple domains , including Automotive, IoT, Mobile Devices, and Embedded Systems.
If you have hands-on experience securing Linux / Android-based systems, SoCs, or connected devices, and are interested in working on automotive-grade platforms such as Infotainment (IVI) and ADAS , we strongly encourage you to apply.
You will work on modern SoC platforms (e.g. Qualcomm, Renesas, TI, Marvell) running Android Automotive, Linux, QNX, or AUTOSAR-based systems , contributing to secure, scalable, and production-ready embedded solutions.
Main Responsibilities
1. Security Architecture & Engineering
Design and implement end-to-end security features for embedded platforms, including: Secure Boot, Trusted Execution Environments (TEE), Secure storage, Secure update mechanisms, Secure communication, etc...
Contribute to security architecture definition for embedded and connected systems.
2. Threat Modeling & Reviews
Perform security architecture reviews and threat modeling for infotainment, ADAS, IoT, or connected device platforms.
Identify risks, define mitigation strategies, and drive security improvements early in the development lifecycle.
3. Security Implementation & Hardening
Implement security hardening for Linux / Android / QNX systems.
Conduct secure code reviews and collaborate with development teams to address vulnerabilities.
Support integration of access control and system hardening mechanisms (e.g. SELinux, AppArmor).
4. Testing & Validation
Perform security testing and validation , including: Static and dynamic analysis, Fuzzing, Penetration testing
Validate security features on real hardware and production-like environments.
5. Process & Compliance
Develop and maintain security requirements and security engineering processes (SEP) .
Support compliance with relevant security standards and best practices .

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Mandatory Qualifications
Educational background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Cryptography , or a related technical field
7-15 years of overall experience, with at least 2-5 years of experience in embedded software development, system software, or security engineering (backgrounds from Automotive, IoT, Mobile Devices, Consumer Electronics are all welcome)
Practical experience with Linux and/or Android platforms , particularly in BSP, middleware, system services, or other low-level system components .
Solid understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals , including cryptography, secure communication protocols, secure coding practices, and security testing principles .
Hands-on experience implementing or supporting embedded system security features , such as secure boot, system trust mechanisms, secure storage, secure update/OTA, and secure communication between components or devices .
Nice-to-Have (Any of the following will be a strong advantage, but are not mandatory )
Good knowledge or hands-on experience in development with modern SoC architectures, such as: Qualcomm, Renesas (RCAR), TI, etc.
Experience in QNX development
Relevant certifications (CEH, CISSP, OSCP, SANS GIAC, etc.)
Good knowledge or hands-on experience in following areas: Secure Boot.
Hardware-back security such as Trustzone (Arm TrustZone, OP-TEE, etc.), HSM , etc.
Storage security (disk encryption, dm-verity, etc.).
Secure communication protocols (TLS/DTLS, SSH, IPsec, MACsec, etc.).
Access control & hardening (SELinux, AppArmor, etc.).
Signing tools (Android signing, secure boot signing, etc.).
Linux / Android / QNX security development/hardening.
Network security, firewall.
Security testing & validation (fuzzing, static/dynamic analysis, penetration testing, etc.).

Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. With technology that is “Invented for life,” Bosch wants to help improve quality of life and conserve natural resources.
The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 490 subsidiary and regional companies in over 60 countries. Including sales and service partners, Bosch’s global manufacturing, engineering, and sales network covers nearly every country in the world. Bosch’s innovative strength is key to the company’s further development.
Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.
Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region. With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.
BGSV currently operates from three offices located at the following addresses:
1. Etown Building – 364 Cong Hoa Street, Ward 13, Tan Binh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
2. OfficeHaus Building – 32 Tan Thang Street, Son Ky Ward, Tan Phu District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
3. Capital Place Building – 29 Lieu Giai Street, Ngoc Khanh Ward, Ba Dinh District, Hanoi, Vietnam

🎁 Quarter 4 JOINING BONUS
Candidates with 4+ years of relevant experience who join BGSV by the end of 31 December 2026 can receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month’s gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.
About the Role
We are looking for 10 Senior Embedded Security Engineers to design, implement, and validate end-to-end security solutions on modern embedded platforms.
This role is open to candidates from multiple domains , including Automotive, IoT, Mobile Devices, and Embedded Systems.
If you have hands-on experience securing Linux / Android-based systems, SoCs, or connected devices, and are interested in working on automotive-grade platforms such as Infotainment (IVI) and ADAS , we strongly encourage you to apply.
You will work on modern SoC platforms (e.g. Qualcomm, Renesas, TI, Marvell) running Android Automotive, Linux, QNX, or AUTOSAR-based systems , contributing to secure, scalable, and production-ready embedded solutions.
Main Responsibilities
1. Security Architecture & Engineering
Design and implement end-to-end security features for embedded platforms, including: Secure Boot, Trusted Execution Environments (TEE), Secure storage, Secure update mechanisms, Secure communication, etc...
Contribute to security architecture definition for embedded and connected systems.
2. Threat Modeling & Reviews
Perform security architecture reviews and threat modeling for infotainment, ADAS, IoT, or connected device platforms.
Identify risks, define mitigation strategies, and drive security improvements early in the development lifecycle.
3. Security Implementation & Hardening
Implement security hardening for Linux / Android / QNX systems.
Conduct secure code reviews and collaborate with development teams to address vulnerabilities.
Support integration of access control and system hardening mechanisms (e.g. SELinux, AppArmor).
4. Testing & Validation
Perform security testing and validation , including: Static and dynamic analysis, Fuzzing, Penetration testing
Validate security features on real hardware and production-like environments.
5. Process & Compliance
Develop and maintain security requirements and security engineering processes (SEP) .
Support compliance with relevant security standards and best practices .

Mandatory Qualifications
Educational background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Cryptography , or a related technical field
7-15 years of overall experience, with at least 2-5 years of experience in embedded software development, system software, or security engineering (backgrounds from Automotive, IoT, Mobile Devices, Consumer Electronics are all welcome)
Practical experience with Linux and/or Android platforms , particularly in BSP, middleware, system services, or other low-level system components .
Solid understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals , including cryptography, secure communication protocols, secure coding practices, and security testing principles .
Hands-on experience implementing or supporting embedded system security features , such as secure boot, system trust mechanisms, secure storage, secure update/OTA, and secure communication between components or devices .
Nice-to-Have (Any of the following will be a strong advantage, but are not mandatory )
Good knowledge or hands-on experience in development with modern SoC architectures, such as: Qualcomm, Renesas (RCAR), TI, etc.
Experience in QNX development
Relevant certifications (CEH, CISSP, OSCP, SANS GIAC, etc.)
Good knowledge or hands-on experience in following areas: Secure Boot.
Hardware-back security such as Trustzone (Arm TrustZone, OP-TEE, etc.), HSM , etc.
Storage security (disk encryption, dm-verity, etc.).
Secure communication protocols (TLS/DTLS, SSH, IPsec, MACsec, etc.).
Access control & hardening (SELinux, AppArmor, etc.).
Signing tools (Android signing, secure boot signing, etc.).
Linux / Android / QNX security development/hardening.
Network security, firewall.
Security testing & validation (fuzzing, static/dynamic analysis, penetration testing, etc.).

sections.text:
🎁 Quarter 4 JOINING BONUS
Candidates with 4+ years of relevant experience who join BGSV by the end of 31 December 2026 can receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month’s gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.
We are looking for an 5 Automotive Diagnostic Software Engineer (1-8 Years of Experience) to join our automotive engineering team. The candidate will be involved in the development of diagnostic software solutions for modern vehicles, working with standard automotive diagnostic protocols and performing validation directly on test vehicles.
This role requires a solid foundation in automotive engineering, hands-on testing capabilities, and flexibility to travel internationally.
Main responsibilities
Mapping of ESI standard texts to OEM texts for the Automotive Aftersales & Aftermarket diagnostic tester software.
Requirement specification for Automotive Aftersales & Aftermarket diagnostic tester software.
End to end diagnostic content creation for all automotive systems e.g., engine management, electric & hybrid systems, brake control, infotainment, ADAS, transmission, HVAC, airbags etc.
Analysis of vehicle communication bus logs using various analyzers.
Simulation of automotive systems using simulator solutions and in conjunction with OE testers.
Design & creation of workflow or test sequences in Bosch standard tools
Evaluation of OE diagnostic data, derivation of useful insights and implementing the same in target tester.
On-vehicle validation of implemented diagnostic content and creation of test reports.
Benchmarking and reverse engineering of aftersales & aftermarket diagnostic testers.
Coverage evaluation of aftermarket tester by performing tests on various vehicle brands and systems, in various markets & create test reports.
Thorough review the deliverables and provide recommendations.
Continuous learning and self-development.
Closely interact with software engineering team and technical experts from global teams.
Travel to Workshops/OE dealerships on need basis for on the vehicle coverage, tracing, and release testing.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Mandatory Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Automotive Engineering
Strong vehicle system knowledge, including the sub-systems and components.
Must have proven ability to diagnose and troubleshoot vehicle and make it roadworthy.
Ability to understand OE system description, service & repair manuals.
Ability to handle diagnostic testers like VIDA, Xentry, GDS, ADT, SDT-II, DiagBox, HDS, Launch, Autel, G-Scan, Zenith etc.
Good knowledge on wiring diagrams and conventions.
Good knowledge of Bosch Aftermarket Diagnostic Tool - ESI [tronic].
Sound knowledge on CAN, CAN FD, DoIP, UDS, J1939.
Experience with analyzer & simulation tools from Vector or Samtec e.g., HSX, HS+ etc.
Handling of various OEM testers
Nice to have:
Automotive Mechatronics Certification (Chứng chỉ Cơ điện tử Ô tô)

sections.text:
🎁 Quarter 4 JOINING BONUS
Candidates with 4+ years of relevant experience who join BGSV by the end of 31 December 2026 can receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month’s gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.
The EPM department focuses on software tooling development to support embedded products across the XC domains, including Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS), Car Multimedia (XC-CM), and Cross-Domain Computing & Software-Defined Vehicle platforms (XC-CE/SDV) . We develop tools and engineering solutions that streamline software and system development for technologies such as radar, video, HMI, ultrasonic sensors, vehicle compute platforms, middleware, software integration, CI/CD, and cloud-connected SDV ecosystems.
Serving global teams across Japan, China, Europe, and Vietnam, we contribute to the advancement of secure, safe, intelligent, and software-defined mobility solutions by enabling efficient development, integration, validation, and deployment of next-generation automotive software.
Your contribution to something big
Perform requirement analysis, design and technical documentation
Take in charge of planning (task estimation)
Develop quality code (readability, maintainability, performance consideration) and handle / support Code Review in project to ensure high quality SW deliveries

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Technical Skills (Must Have)
4+ years of hands-on experience designing, implementing, and operating solutions on AWS.
4+ years of professional software development experience using Python, Java, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, or another modern programming language.
Strong Python or scripting skills for automation, cloud operations, API integration, and tooling.
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture, microservices, distributed systems, scalability, and reliability .

ABOUT THE ROLE
The EPM department focuses on software tooling development to support embedded products in the XC which including Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS), Car Multimedia domain. We develop tools that streamline software and system development for technologies such as radar, video, HMI and ultrasonic sensors. Serving global teams across Japan, China, Europe, and Vietnam, we contribute to the advancement of secure, safe, and intelligent mobility solutions.
The SiL Integration Engineer/Expert is responsible for configuring, deploying, integrating, and maintaining ADAS SiL reference implementations in project-specific environments. The role ensures that customer project SiL variants are enabled efficiently, with maximum reuse from the platform, while supporting stakeholders with technical integration, issue resolution, and operational excellence.
Key Responsibilities
Configure, deploy, and integrate ADAS SiL reference implementations from the platform into project-specific ADAS SiL instances based on stakeholder requirements.
Maintain and continuously improve ADAS SiL instances to ensure quality, stability, and alignment with stakeholder needs.
Execute quality assurance measures for SiL environments and implementations.
Update and adapt SiL implementations according to project and customer requirements.
Provide training and user support for project teams using the ADAS SiL setup.
Act as the first-level support contact for issue analysis and resolution.
Collect and propagate requirements, feedback, and technical demands to relevant development teams.
Collaborate directly and on a daily basis with project developers and stakeholders.
Execute the defined ADAS SiL TDP integration and deployment processes.
Replicate SiL platform integrations into customer project variants and implement project-specific extensions where needed.
Maximize reuse of implementations from the platform integration approach, avoiding copy-paste solutions and ensuring that only project-specific interface differences are added on top.
Support the SiL takeover of TRIM / Parking platform capabilities into customer projects in a self-organized and solution-oriented manner.
Contribute to scalable and efficient workflows for parallel project execution together with platform and customer project teams.

sections.text:

Strong knowledge in SiL product deployment, configuration, and integration.

Basic to junior-level knowledge of relevant scenario and map formats, such as: OpenSCENARIO XML
OpenSCENARIO DSL
OpenDRIVE
Lanelet2
Basic to junior-level programming skills in:
C++
Python
Basic to junior-level experience with:
Bazel, CMake, Conan
Git
Docker
Hands-on mindset for troubleshooting, integration adaptation, and project-specific technical support.
Preferred Competencies
Customer-oriented attitude with focus on successful integration and adoption.
Strong problem-solving mindset with practical implementation capability.
Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and parallel project setups.
Good communication skills to support users and clarify technical topics with stakeholders.
Structured and self-organized working style.
Expected Outcome
The role ensures that ADAS SiL solutions are technically integrated into customer projects, maintained with high quality, and extended in a scalable way with strong reuse from the platform baseline.

sections.text:
🎁 Quarter 4 JOINING BONUS
Candidates with 4+ years of relevant experience who join BGSV by the end of 31 December 2026 can receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month’s gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.
Department Introduction
MS/EAE-XC
MS/EAE-XC is responsible for engineering and validation activities within Bosch, focusing on control units and system-level solutions & Sensortec.
The department delivers verification & validation (VnV), software/hardware integration, and project execution for automotive customers, supporting global and ASEAN projects.
With strong growth from a small testing team to a large-scale engineering unit, MS/EAE-XC plays a key role in driving system quality, scalability, and cross-domain collaboration.
Bosch Sensortec
Bosch Sensortec is the technology leader in sensing solutions based on microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) and dedicated to the consumer electronics world. Our success in MEMS sensors and solutions is built on a remarkable team driven by passion, innovation and flexibility.
Find out more about the applications we make possible for smartphones, tablets, wearables, AR/VR, smart homes and the IoT in our website https://www.bosch-sensortec.com/
Bosch Sensortec Products: Motion Sensors, Environmental Sensors, Smart Sensor Systems
Key Responsibilities:
Develop and Maintain Global Deployments : Collaborate closely with global stakeholders to gather requirements and ensure seamless production operations. Deliver the end-to-end CI/CD lifecycle—from repository management, automated image building, and containerization to seamless Kubernetes deployment.
Cross-Regional Support & Collaboration : Act as the primary point of contact for deployments, working with experts across various time zones (including Europe and Asia-Pacific). Assist in writing infrastructure/application code and provide full-lifecycle support for running applications.
Continuous Innovation & Acceleration : Drive infrastructure modernization by keeping applications running on the latest technology stack. Participate in regular code/infrastructure reviews to continuously improve and simplify our current system landscape.
Future-Orientation & Tech Evaluation : Research, benchmark, and test emerging platforms and architectures (cloud-native, hybrid cloud, or alternative software solutions) to support scalable business growth.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Mandatory Qualifications
Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, specializing in Kubernetes ecosystem management.
Technical Skills:
Containerization & Orchestration: Strong expertise in Kubernetes (K8s) and container technologies (Docker, Podman).
CI/CD & Git: Solid experience with Git and CI/CD tools/pipelines optimized for Kubernetes (Bitbucket, Jenkins, GitHub Actions).
Networking: Strong understanding of IT Networking (including K8s CNI, Ingress/Egress, DNS, and integration with external enterprise systems).
Programming & IaC: Proficiency in Python (FastAPI is a strong plus) and familiarity with declarative configuration (YAML).
Soft Skills: Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken) with the ability to collaborate effectively in a multicultural environment.
Preferred Qualification (Big Plus):
Hands-on experience with workflow automation tools (specifically Apache Airflow).
Experience with cloud platforms (preferably Microsoft Azure).

Department Information
Bosch Cross-Domain Compute Enhance (XC-CE ) Team is looking for full-time System Architect working at Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. The XC-CE Team develops high-quality, state-of-the-art Vehicle Compute-ECU, Body-domain and Zone ECU, Perfectly Keyless, Vehicle Integration Platform and Central Gateway.
Job Description
The System Architect is responsible for defining, developing, and maintaining complex automotive embedded systems and system-of-systems throughout the product lifecycle.
The role requires deep understanding of customer use cases, stakeholder needs, system behavior, internal and external interfaces, and functional architectures. The System Architect acts as the technical owner of the system concept and ensures that requirements, architecture, interfaces, and verification strategies are complete, consistent, traceable, and aligned with customer expectations and industry standards.
Beyond individual contributions, the System Architect provides technical leadership across multiple engineering disciplines, including System, Software, Hardware, Integration, Verification & Validation, Security, and Functional Safety teams. The role drives technical decisions, supports customer discussions, and ensures successful execution of system engineering activities in compliance with ASPICE and Bosch development processes.
Main responsibilities
System Requirements Engineering Elicit, analyze, negotiate, document, and manage stakeholder requirements.
Translate customer and stakeholder needs into clear, complete, and testable system requirements.
Ensure consistency, completeness, feasibility, and verifiability of requirements.
Define acceptance criteria and verification strategies for system requirements.
Establish and maintain end-to-end traceability between stakeholder requirements, system requirements, architecture elements, and verification artifacts.
Conduct impact analysis for requirement changes and coordinate implementation across affected domains.
Review, approve, baseline, and release system requirements.
System Architecture & Design Define and maintain system architecture for complex embedded systems and system-of-systems.
Analyze functional, logical, and technical interactions between software, hardware, communication networks, cloud services, mobile applications, and vehicle systems.
Identify, specify, and maintain system interfaces and interaction models.
Lead architectural trade-off studies considering performance, safety, security, cost, maintainability, and customer expectations.
Ensure architectural consistency across all engineering disciplines.
Support architectural decomposition into hardware, software, and verification work products.
Technical Leadership & Coordination
Serve as technical lead for system engineering topics within projects.
Coordinate system engineering activities across multiple teams and disciplines.
Guide and mentor System Engineers and junior team members.
Drive technical alignment between stakeholders, project management, customers, and engineering teams.
Facilitate technical reviews, workshops, architecture reviews, and requirement clarification sessions.
Lead root-cause analysis and complex debugging activities involving Software, Hardware, V&V, Security, and System Integration teams
Verification & Validation Support Define system-level verification approaches and success criteria.
Ensure system requirements are fully testable and traceable to verification activities.
Support creation and review of test strategies, test specifications, and validation plans.
Analyze system verification results and drive corrective actions when deviations occur
Process Compliance & Quality Assurance Take ownership of ASPICE SYS.1, SYS.2, SYS.3, and relevant lifecycle work products.
Ensure compliance with Bosch development processes, customer-specific processes, and quality standards.
Support project assessments, audits, and process improvement initiatives.
Drive continuous improvement of system engineering methodologies, templates, and best practices
Customer Technical Interface Coordinate team on System Engineering tasks.
Lead and participate into debug session with other domains (Software, Test, Hardware, etc Act as a primary technical contact for system-level discussions with customers.
Lead requirement clarification and technical alignment meetings.
Support effort estimation, risk assessment, and change request evaluations.
Present system concepts, technical solutions, and engineering decisions to customers and management.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Analyse and break down customer and system requirements for ADAS vehicle motion features, including lateral and longitudinal control functions.
Design, implement, and maintain real-time automotive software for vehicle motion control, driver assistance, and active safety features.
Collaborate with system, software, testing, calibration, and project stakeholders to clarify technical topics, resolve blockers, and ensure timely delivery.
Develop and support software verification activities such as unit testing, simulation-based testing, SIL/HIL validation, debugging, and defect analysis.
Participate in code reviews, design reviews, technical discussions, and continuous improvement activities to ensure robust software quality.

Commit to delivery timeline, software quality targets, and reliable performance of ADAS vehicle motion functions.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
ADAS and vehicle motion: Good understanding of vehicle dynamics, sensors, driver assistance functions, and lateral / longitudinal motion control.
Software engineering: Strong C++ programming skills with solid knowledge of SDLC, requirement engineering, debugging, and code quality practices.
Testing and validation: Experience with unit testing, software test methodology, gTest, defect analysis, and issue resolution.
Tools and process: Experience with Git, GitHub / Bitbucket, Visual Studio Code, configuration management, defect tracking, ASPICE, and Functional Safety practices.
Collaboration: Strong communication skills with the ability to work independently, handle multiple stakeholders, and contribute effectively in a project team.
Preferred skills: CAN / FlexRay, MATLAB, Python scripting, vehicle-specific physics, and XC-AS PMT know-how.

sections.text:
Why EDA?
The EDA department specializes in Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS) , in advanced products such as radar, front/rear/surround video, and ultrasonic sensors, supporting software & system development and project management roles. Utilizing cutting-edge technologies like ADAS Level 2++, Sensor Fusion, and AI, the team serves global clients including Japan, China, Europe, and Vietnam, with a strong focus on security, safety, and smart mobility solutions.
Check out department portfolio at following link .
What You'll Gain by joining this team:
Innovative Products : gain a comprehensive understanding of ADAS system .
Onsite Opportunities : Participate in close communication with customers and Bosch counterparts, gaining valuable insights into use cases and user experience.
Global Collaboration : Work with teams from diverse cultures, including Europe (Germany, Hungary), Japan, China, and India.
Client Interaction : Directly engage with Japanese and Chinese Customers.

Candidates with 4+ years of relevant experience who join BGSV by the end of 31 December 2026 can receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month’s gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.
Analyse and break down customer and system requirements for ADAS vehicle motion features, including lateral and longitudinal control functions.
Design, implement, and maintain real-time automotive software for vehicle motion control, driver assistance, and active safety features.
Collaborate with system, software, testing, calibration, and project stakeholders to clarify technical topics, resolve blockers, and ensure timely delivery.
Develop and support software verification activities such as unit testing, simulation-based testing, SIL/HIL validation, debugging, and defect analysis.
Participate in code reviews, design reviews, technical discussions, and continuous improvement activities to ensure robust software quality.
Provide effort estimation, technical input, and risk feedback for project planning and release preparation.
Ensure compliance with automotive development processes, coding standards, ASPICE expectations, and applicable functional safety practices.
Commit to delivery timeline, software quality targets, and reliable performance of ADAS vehicle motion functions.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
ADAS and vehicle motion: Good understanding of vehicle dynamics, sensors, driver assistance functions, and lateral / longitudinal motion control.
Software engineering: Strong C++ programming skills with solid knowledge of SDLC, requirement engineering, debugging, and code quality practices.
Testing and validation: Experience with unit testing, software test methodology, gTest, defect analysis, and issue resolution.
Tools and process: Experience with Git, GitHub / Bitbucket, Visual Studio Code, configuration management, defect tracking, ASPICE, and Functional Safety practices.
Collaboration: Strong communication skills with the ability to work independently, handle multiple stakeholders, and contribute effectively in a project team.
Preferred skills: CAN / FlexRay, MATLAB, Python scripting, vehicle-specific physics, and XC-AS PMT know-how.

The Senior Engineer - AI is responsible for developing and implementing machine learning models to address business and technical requirements across product portfolios. This role involves analyzing complex datasets, building predictive models, and preparing AI solutions for deployment into engineering applications.
Main Roles and Responsibilities
Design and build scalable AI/ML solutions based on project requirements as per communication and alignment with customer or customer interface.
Process and analyze large-scale datasets to extract features and identify patterns for model training.
Integrate and deploy AI/ML models into existing software systems and platforms.
Apply statistical analysis and data validation techniques to ensure the quality and reliability of training data.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements, sharing technical insights, and contributing to solution design to drive continuous improvement and innovation within own domain.
Perform model evaluation, validation, and tuning to optimize performance and ensure alignment with business objectives.
Mentor junior engineers by providing guidance on machine learning concepts, coding practices, and data analysis techniques.
Utilize modern machine learning frameworks including TensorFlow or PyTorch for model development and experimentation.
Ensure compliance with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, company policies, and quality frameworks applicable to the role and assigned projects.
Perform other tasks as assigned by Managers.

sections.text:

At least 3–4 years of experience.
Proven hands-on experience in developing and deploying machine learning models.
Proven experience with modern ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch) and programming languages such as Python.
Experience working with l arge datasets and production AI systems.
Ability to implement solutions from scratch and build products across the full product lifecycle based on the following requirements: Generative AI & LLM Engineering: Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), LangChain/LlamaIndex, Vector DB
AI Agents & Intelligent Systems: AI Agents/Frameworks, NLP, Model Based Development
Machine Learning & Deep Learning: Machine Learning, Neural Network Architectures, PyTorch, OpenCV / Image Processing
MLOps & Model Lifecycle: MLOps / ML Lifecycle Management, Model Validation & Evaluation, Data Annotation Basics
AI Software & Data Engineering: Python, Data Modelling & Design
Proficient in English Communication.
Proficient in Office Applications (e.g., MS Word, Excel, PPT).
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Master’s degree is a plus

Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. With technology that is “Invented for life,” Bosch wants to help improve quality of life and conserve natural resources.
The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 490 subsidiary and regional companies in over 60 countries. Including sales and service partners, Bosch’s global manufacturing, engineering, and sales network covers nearly every country in the world. Bosch’s innovative strength is key to the company’s further development.
Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.
Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region. With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.
BGSV currently operates from three offices located at the following addresses:
1. Etown Building – 364 Cong Hoa Street, Ward 13, Tan Binh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
2. OfficeHaus Building – 32 Tan Thang Street, Son Ky Ward, Tan Phu District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
3. Capital Place Building – 29 Lieu Giai Street, Ngoc Khanh Ward, Ba Dinh District, Hanoi, Vietnam

The Lead Engineer - AI is responsible for designing and developing artificial intelligence and machine learning models to address business and technical requirements. Design and develop AI/ML solutions, including computer vision, GenAI, natural language processing, and predictive analytics, to meet project specifications as per communication and alignment with customer or customer interface.

At least 4–6 years of experience .
Proven professional experience in developing and deploying machine learning models and AI systems .
Proven experience with modern ML frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn) and MLOps practices .

Data & Software Engineering: Python, Data Modelling & Design, Code Review, Solution Design
Professional & Communication Skills: Problem Solving, English Communication , Office Applications (Word, Excel, PPT).
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, or a related field.

Relevant certifications in Machine Learning or Cloud Platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) are a plus.

sections.text:
🎁 Q4 JOINING BONUS
Join BGSV by 31 December 2026 and receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Telematics Software Engineer with strong embedded Android experience to drive the migration of our Telematics Control Unit (TCU) software framework from Embedded Linux to Android (AOSP / Android Automotive), across both Commercial Vehicle / Off-Highway and Passenger Car programs. This is a foundational platform migration, not a feature port: you will re-architect vehicle-network interfaces, connectivity, diagnostics, and OTA mechanisms to run natively within the Android framework — HALs, system services, SELinux policy — while preserving the functional behavior, performance, and cybersecurity posture already proven on the current Linux platform. You will own the technical plan end-to-end and work directly with platform, cloud, and OEM customer teams to sequence it without disrupting shipping programs.
Key Responsibilities
Own the technical strategy and execution plan for porting the existing embedded Linux telematics framework to Android (AOSP / Android Automotive), including a gap analysis of what changes at the HAL, native service, and application layers.
Re-architect vehicle-network interfaces (CAN / CAN-FD, J1939, ISOBUS, UDS, DoIP) as Vehicle HAL (VHAL) extensions or native AIDL/HIDL services, preserving existing signal processing and diagnostics behavior.
Port connectivity and cloud communication — 4G/5G modem integration via the RIL/Telephony framework, GNSS, MQTT/HTTPS telemetry — to Android system services.
Migrate OTA (FOTA/SOTA) update mechanisms, remote diagnostics, and fleet-management data services to Android's update framework (A/B seamless updates or equivalent), maintaining feature parity with the current implementation.
Adapt regulatory and safety-related features (eCall / ERA-GLONASS, tachograph and driver-data interfaces, emissions/usage reporting) to run correctly within Android's process and permission model.
Define and enforce SELinux policies, Android permission boundaries, and secure/verified-boot equivalents to preserve or improve the platform's cybersecurity posture (ISO/SAE 21434, UNECE R155/R156) through the migration.
Build and maintain the Android build system (AOSP repo/manifest, device tree, BSP integration) for the target TCU hardware.
Define a test strategy that validates functional and performance parity between the Linux and Android implementations before cutover — regression suite, bench testing, and vehicle-level validation.
Collaborate with platform/BSP, cloud/backend, and OEM customer teams to sequence the migration against shipping programs; define a phased or parallel-run rollout plan.
Document architecture decisions and migration learnings, and mentor engineers ramping up on embedded Android.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or a related field.
7+ years of embedded software development in automotive, telematics, or IoT, with strong C/C++ (C++14 or later) and Java/Kotlin for Android-layer work.
Direct, hands-on experience with embedded Android / AOSP: HAL development (VHAL or custom HALs), AIDL/HIDL, system services, SELinux policy, and the Android build system (Soong/Make, repo/manifest).
Experience with cellular connectivity (LTE/5G modems, RIL integration on Android), GNSS, and cloud protocols (MQTT, TLS, REST).
Experience with Android OTA update mechanisms (A/B seamless updates or equivalent) and secure boot / verified boot concepts.
Proven experience carrying a non-trivial embedded system through a platform/OS migration — able to speak concretely to gap analysis, phased cutover, and regression risk.
Proficiency with automotive tooling: Vector CANoe/CANalyzer, bus analyzers, debuggers (JTAG/Lauterbach), Git, CI/CD.
Solid experience with Embedded Linux (Yocto/Buildroot) telematics platforms — you need to understand what you're migrating from as well as to.
Solid knowledge of vehicle networks and protocols: CAN / CAN-FD, J1939, UDS, DoIP; experience with at least one of ISOBUS, FMS, or Automotive Ethernet / SOME-IP.
Preferred Qualifications
Prior production experience specifically with Android Automotive OS (AAOS) and its Vehicle HAL.
AUTOSAR Classic or Adaptive experience alongside Android.
Knowledge of ISO/SAE 21434, UNECE R155/R156 (cybersecurity), and ISO 26262 (functional safety) as applied to an Android-based platform.
Experience with eCall / ERA-GLONASS, digital tachograph (EU 165/2014), or emissions telematics (e.g., OBD-over-telematics, China GB17691).
Familiarity with Automotive SPICE or comparable structured development processes.
Experience working with global OEM customers and multi-site development teams.

sections.text:
🎁 Q4 JOINING BONUS
Join BGSV by 31 December 2026 and receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.
About the Role
We are looking for a Penetration Tester to join our AI Safety & Security team, working hands-on across Bosch's growing portfolio of AI-enabled products and internal tooling — LLM deployments, agentic AI systems, and Model Context Protocol – style tool-calling integrations. Under the direction of the team's Lead AI Safety & Security Engineer, you will execute structured test plans against real systems, covering both whether an AI system behaves safely (does it refuse harmful requests, stay within its intended scope) and whether it is secure (can it be manipulated via prompt injection or tricked into misusing its tools). This is an individual-contributor role on a newly forming team — you'll be running real engagements from day one, not just shadowing them.
Key Responsibilities
Execute penetration tests and safety evaluations against LLM-based features and AI agents, following test plans and specifications defined by the team lead.
Run red-teaming and jailbreak testing to surface harmful, biased, or unsafe model outputs, and document reproducible findings.
Test for prompt injection (direct and indirect), excessive agency, and tool/plugin abuse in agentic and MCP-style tool-calling systems.
Verify human-in-the-loop and guardrail controls hold up under adversarial conditions, not just in normal use.
Write clear, reproducible findings reports — evidence, severity, and a specific recommended fix — that both engineers and governance stakeholders can act on.
Help build and maintain test tooling: adversarial-prompt scripts, jailbreak test cases, and MCP/tool-schema fuzzing scripts.
Track published AI security research (OWASP LLM and Agentic Top 10s, MITRE ATLAS) and bring new attack techniques into the team's test suite.
Work directly with AI/ML engineering teams to reproduce, triage, and confirm fixes for reported findings.
Support the team lead in scoping and coordinating external red-teaming/pentest vendor engagements when work is outsourced.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
2–5 years in penetration testing, security testing, or applied AI/ML security work.
Hands-on experience testing LLM or agentic AI systems — prompt injection, jailbreaks, or tool/plugin abuse; coursework, CTFs, or independent projects count given how new this field is.
Working familiarity with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications and/or OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications.
Comfortable scripting in Python and/or JavaScript/Node to automate test cases.
Clear, precise technical writing for findings reports.
Preferred Qualifications
Exposure to the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable agent tool-calling frameworks.
Traditional penetration testing experience across web, API, or network targets.
Familiarity with AI governance concepts (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act).
Open-source security tooling contributions, CTF results, or a public research/write-up portfolio.
Relevant Certifications (any of the following a plus)
Offensive security / penetration testing — OSCP, GPEN, GWAPT, or CEH.
AI-specific security — ISC2 AI Security Certificate or Certified AI Security Professional (CAISP).

🎁 Q4 JOINING BONUS
Join BGSV by 31 December 2026 and receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Telematics Software Engineer to design, develop, and deliver connected-vehicle software across two vehicle domains: Commercial Vehicle / Off-Highway (trucks, buses, construction, and agricultural machinery) and Passenger Car. You will own features end-to-end on the Telematics Control Unit (TCU) — from vehicle-network data acquisition through edge processing to cloud connectivity — and adapt platform software to the distinct protocols, duty cycles, and regulatory requirements of each segment.
Key Responsibilities
Design, implement, and maintain embedded telematics software on TCU platforms (Embedded Linux / RTOS) for both CV/OHW and Passenger Car programs.
Develop vehicle-network interfaces: CAN / CAN-FD, J1939 and FMS (CV), ISOBUS / ISO 11783 (OHW), and OEM-specific signal matrices, UDS (ISO 14229) and DoIP diagnostics (Passenger Car).
Implement connectivity and cloud communication: 4G/5G modem integration, GNSS, MQTT/HTTPS telemetry pipelines, and device management with AWS IoT / Azure IoT or equivalent.
Build and maintain OTA (FOTA/SOTA) update mechanisms, remote diagnostics, and fleet-management data services.
Implement regulatory and safety-related features: eCall / ERA-GLONASS, tachograph and driver-data interfaces (CV), and emissions/usage monitoring data reporting.
Apply automotive cybersecurity (ISO/SAE 21434, UNECE R155/R156) and support functional safety activities (ISO 26262) where applicable.
Own features end-to-end: requirements analysis, architecture, implementation, unit/integration testing, vehicle-level validation, and issue resolution in the field.
Collaborate with OEM customers, cloud/backend teams, hardware engineers, and suppliers; support SOP milestones and field escalations.
Mentor junior engineers and drive code quality through reviews, CI/CD, and static analysis.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or related field.
5–8 years of embedded software development in automotive, telematics, or IoT, with strong C/C++ (C++14 or later); Python for tooling and test automation.
Proficiency with automotive tooling: Vector CANoe/CANalyzer, bus analyzers, debuggers (JTAG/Lauterbach), Git, CI/CD.
Hands-on experience with Embedded Linux (Yocto/Buildroot) and/or RTOS on ARM-based platforms.
Experience with cellular connectivity (LTE/5G modems, AT command / RIL integration), GNSS, and cloud protocols (MQTT, TLS, REST).
Experience with OTA update frameworks and secure boot / secure communication concepts.
Strong debugging skills across embedded, network, and cloud boundaries; able to work directly with vehicles and test benches.
Solid knowledge of vehicle networks and protocols: CAN / CAN-FD, J1939, UDS, DoIP; experience with at least one of ISOBUS, FMS, or Automotive Ethernet / SOME-IP.
Familiarity with Automotive SPICE or comparable structured development processes.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience delivering telematics features in both commercial vehicle/off-highway and passenger car programs.
Experience working with global OEM customers and multi-site development teams.
Experience with eCall / ERA-GLONASS, digital tachograph (EU 165/2014), or emissions telematics (e.g., OBD-over-telematics, China GB17691).
AUTOSAR Classic or Adaptive experience; Android Automotive or QNX exposure.
Knowledge of ISO/SAE 21434, UNECE R155/R156 (cybersecurity) and ISO 26262 (functional safety).
V2X (DSRC / C-V2X), edge analytics, or vehicle data platforms (e.g., COVESA VSS).

sections.text:
🎁 Q4 JOINING BONUS
Join BGSV by 31 December 2026 and receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.
About the Role
We are looking for a Lead AI Safety & Security Engineer to own safety evaluation and security testing across Bosch's growing portfolio of AI-enabled products and internal tooling — large language model deployments and agentic AI systems (including Model Context Protocol – style tool-calling integrations), and the enterprise services they connect to. You will lead both sides of the same coin: whether an AI system behaves safely (does it refuse harmful requests, avoid unsafe recommendations, stay within its intended scope) and whether it is secure (can it be manipulated via prompt injection, tricked into misusing its tools, or made to leak data it shouldn't). This is a cross-business-unit mandate, not a single product line — you will build the practice largely from the ground up.
Key Responsibilities
Design and run safety evaluations for LLM-based features and AI agents: red-teaming for harmful, biased, or unsafe outputs; jailbreak and guardrail-bypass testing; systematic benchmarking against known safety failure modes.
Design and run security testing for the same systems: prompt injection (direct and indirect), excessive agency, tool/plugin abuse, and confused-deputy risks in agentic and MCP-style tool-calling architectures.
Build and maintain a threat model covering the full path from user input through model reasoning to tool execution — identifying where a safety failure and a security failure are really the same underlying gap.
Verify human-in-the-loop and guardrail controls are architecturally sound wherever an AI agent can take a consequential action (a write to a business system, an automated communication, a code change) — not just present in a UI that can be talked around.
Scope, brief, and review the output of external red-teaming/pentest vendors; write test specifications and acceptance criteria for AI-specific engagements.
Track and apply emerging frameworks — OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act — translating new research into concrete internal test requirements before it becomes an incident.
Partner with AI/ML engineering teams across business units to get safety and security reviewed into system design, not only tested after the fact.
Produce evidence and documentation supporting AI governance and compliance needs (ISO/IEC 42001 AI management system, EU AI Act risk assessments, internal responsible-AI review processes).
Build test tooling as needed: adversarial-prompt harnesses, automated jailbreak/red-team pipelines, and MCP/tool-schema fuzzers.
Mentor engineers on safe and secure AI system design, and grow the practice as it scales across more teams and products.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
6+ years in security testing, AI/ML safety research, or a closely related discipline, with a track record of finding real issues in real systems.
Practical experience testing or red-teaming LLM/agentic AI systems — prompt injection, jailbreaks, excessive agency, tool/plugin abuse — independent research or open-source contributions are acceptable given how new this specialty is.
Working knowledge of at least one AI safety/governance framework (NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act) and how it translates into concrete engineering requirements.
Enough coding ability (Python and/or JavaScript/Node) to build evaluation harnesses and test tooling rather than rely solely on manual testing.
Strong technical writing — comfortable producing findings and specifications that both engineers and governance/compliance stakeholders can act on directly.
Preferred Qualifications
Direct experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable agent tool-calling frameworks.
Traditional penetration testing background (web/API/network), OSCP or equivalent.
Experience contributing to a formal AI governance or compliance program.
Publications, CTF/red-team competition results, or open-source security tooling in the AI safety/security space.
Experience mentoring or building out a small safety/security testing team.
Relevant Certifications (any of the following a plus)
Offensive security / penetration testing — OSCP, OSWE, OSEP, GPEN, GWAPT, or CEH.
AI-specific security — ISC2 AI Security Certificate, EC-Council Certified Offensive AI Security Professional, or Certified AI Security Professional (CAISP).
AI governance / compliance — ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Auditor or Lead Implementer, or IAPP AI Governance Professional (AIGP).

Developing AI-powered tools and applications for engineering use cases.

Supporting AI model deployment and evaluation.
Collaborating with global teams to improve engineering productivity.

Learning and applying the latest AI, cloud, and DevOps technologies.

🎁 Q4 JOINING BONUS
Join BGSV by 31 December 2026 and receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Technical Key Account Engineer to support automotive component projects for Japanese OEM customers across Passenger Car (PC) and Commercial Vehicle (CV) applications.
In this role, you will act as a key technical interface between customers and Bosch engineering teams , supporting projects from acquisition and technical clarification through project execution and engineering changes.
A key opportunity of this position is a long-term onsite assignment at Bosch Japan for at least 2.5 years, expected to start by March 2027 or earlier . The assignment comes with an attractive benefits package, and family accompaniment to Japan can be supported .
You will also have the opportunity to build specialized technical expertise in DNOX and exhaust aftertreatment systems while collaborating with Bosch platform and engineering teams in Europe.
What You’ll Do
Act as the first-level Technical Key Account (TKA) for assigned automotive component projects.
Serve as the main technical interface with Japanese OEM customers , handling technical questions, requirements, and clarifications.
Support the execution of customer projects for Passenger Car and Commercial Vehicle applications , ensuring alignment with project requirements and milestones.
Support new project acquisition activities for Japanese OEM customers, particularly technical documentation and project-related inputs.
Coordinate and track Engineering Change Requests (ECRs) for Passenger Car customer projects.
Take ownership of relevant Quality Gate (QG) activities and support timely achievement of project milestones.
Investigate and support continuous improvement activities related to component and field quality issues .
Prepare, maintain, and coordinate technical customer documentation according to project and customer requirements.
Support engineering activities such as technical drawings, experiments, and validation when required.
Develop strong technical expertise in DNOX products and systems through close collaboration with Bosch platform teams in Europe, particularly Hungary.

Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering , or a related engineering discipline.

Strong Japanese communication skills for direct interaction with Japanese customers; JLPT N2 or equivalent business-level Japanese proficiency is preferred.
Good English communication skills for collaboration with international engineering teams and overseas stakeholders.
Basic knowledge of mechanical design, product engineering, automotive components, or product development .
Strong problem-solving skills with a customer-oriented mindset .
Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively across different cultures, functions, and locations.
Proactive learning mindset and willingness to develop specialized technical and product knowledge.
Willingness to undertake a long-term onsite assignment at Bosch Japan for at least 2.5 years, starting by March 2027 or earlier .
It'd be a strong advantage if you have:
Knowledge or experience in DNOX, exhaust aftertreatment systems, or emission-control technologies.
Previous experience working with Japanese automotive OEMs.
Experience in project coordination, customer-facing engineering, or Technical Key Account (TKA) responsibilities.
Experience working in an international or cross-functional engineering environment.

sections.text:
🎁 Q4 JOINING BONUS
Join BGSV by 31 December 2026 and receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.
About the Role
As an Expert for High-Performance SoC BSP Integration , you will play a key role in building and integrating the foundational software stack for next-generation high-performance System-on-Chip (SoC) and Chiplet platforms . You will work deep within BSP, POSIX/Linux/QNX environments , developing and optimizing kernel modules and device drivers, porting low-level software across platforms, and enabling reliable integration with high-speed interfaces such as PCIe and UCIe . With hands-on expertise spanning bootloaders, Linux kernel, device drivers, and SoC architecture , you will contribute to the performance, scalability, and technical excellence of Bosch’s Automotive Chiplet Systems (ACS) project.
Learn more about Bosch’s Automotive Chiplet technology: https://www.bosch-semiconductors.com/stories-and-events/chiplet-revolution/
Your main responsibilities
You will develop advanced software modules and drivers specifically for the POSIX operating system (e.g. QNX).
You will design and develop robust Linux kernel modules.
You will port existing Linux drivers (kernel and user Space) to specific Linux distribution environment to ensure seamless integration and functionality.
You will develop and contribute to multi-layer Continuous Integration (CI) environments.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What We’re Looking For
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software/Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related fields.
8+ years of embedded software development experience , particularly in BSP, kernel, and device-driver development.
Strong C/C++ programming skills.
Strong hands-on experience with Embedded Linux, Linux Kernel, device drivers, BSP, ARM Cortex-A, and bootloaders .
Experience with Linux, QNX, or other POSIX-based operating systems .
Good understanding of high-performance SoC architectures, memory hierarchies, and high-speed interfaces such as PCIe .
Strong debugging skills using GDB, Lauterbach , or similar tools.
Good knowledge of Git .

As a Software-Hardware Integration Verification and Validation Engineer , you will play a key role in ensuring the seamless integration, verification, and validation of hardware and low-level software for next-generation System-on-Chip (SoC) and Chiplet platforms . Main Responsibilities
Low-Level Software Development: Develop board support packages ( BSPs ) and register-level programming for chiplets; microcontrollers, PMICs, … Implement and debug device drivers and configure and initialize peripherals .
Configure Realtime Processor Units (RPU) & Application Processor Units (APUs) of Chiplets
Bootloader Customization: Customize and configures Bootloader for RPUs and U-Boot for APUs,
Implementation of secure boot
Configur e Linux kernel (integration of driver, optimization of performances)
Interface Implementation & debugging: Integrate and troubleshoot communication interfaces (e.g. I2C, SPI, CAN, PCI, UCIe, USB, LPDDR, Camera, Display Port)
Implement and debug communication protocols at hardware and software levels.
Hardware-Software Integration: Perform board bring-up and validation for hardware platforms; Debug hardware interfaces using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers.
Develop test tool for Hardware-specific test also covering system test level

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Department Information
' EPC ' is a department of BGSV company, belongs to Automotive Powertrain Solution domain. We develop embedded SW for 'Engine / Vehicle control unit ' which controls key vehicle engine functions (e.g., power performance, energy consumption efficiency, emissions, diagnosis, communication) and additional drive-ability features.
We are looking for 3 Embedded Software Engineer (1-3 YoE) for Platform Projects (Base Software Platform, Diagnosis, Device Encapsulation Library, Software-in-the-Loop (SiL)) who involve engineering, design, coding, debugging and ensuring quality through CI/CT and automotive development processes.
Your Main Roles and Responsibilities
Analyze customer requirements, design and develop embedded software/test suites in automotive power-train domain
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and deliver new features.
Develop clean, efficient, and well-documented code following coding standards.
Answer customer queries, propose technical solutions for customer issues and integration support.
Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated build, integration, and testing.
Participate in Problem identification & resolution (e.g., record anomaly found during testing, analyze, troubleshoot)
Perform static & dynamic testing from System level down-to SW component level using HiL / SiL environment, e.g., System / System integration testing
SW / SW integration testing
SW component static analysis

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Mandatory Qualifications
Bachelor's or master's degree in electrical engineering, Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical field.
From 1 to 3 years of experience is required.
Have knowledge of Micro controller/Embedded System and other hardware related topics: GPIO, SPI, memory, actuator, sensor, Schematic/Layout reading
Programming Languages: good in Embedded C language
SW development process: Familiarity and practical experience with V-Model or Agile / Kanban methodologies in the context of Embedded development.
Version Control & CI/CD: Proven experience with Git, Git Actions, and Jenkins.
Good written and verbal communication skills in English.
Additional Opportunities : Software-in-the-Loop (SiL)
We are also open to candidates with limited experience in embedded systems but have relevant skills and experience in Software-in-the-Loop (SiL) / Virtual ECU (vECU) development, particularly in the following areas:
Strong interest in developer tooling, internal tools, and engineering application development.
Experience designing, developing, integrating, and debugging developer tools and engineering applications.
Proficiency in technologies such as Rust, TypeScript, Python, and C#.
Experience with development workflow automatio
Nice to Have
Experience in Real Time Operating System (RTOS)
Experience in using Emulators, Simulators, debugging and Test Equipment
Experience in scripting language (e.g., Java (referable), Python, Perl, C++, C#, TypeScript or workflow automation platforms)
Experience developing desktop applications or engineering tools.
Automotive Standards: Experience with AUTOSAR / ASPICE
Practical experience to use AI effectively for research and self-study
