sections.text:
🎁 Q4 JOINING BONUS
Join BGSV by 31 December 2026 and receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.
About the Role
As a Senior IP Design Verification Engineer , you will play a key role in ensuring the functional correctness, interoperability, and quality of advanced Silicon IPs for next-generation System-on-Chip (SoC) platforms. You will own pre-silicon verification from planning through sign-off , developing robust UVM/SystemVerilog verification environments and driving complex debugging across IP and system boundaries. You will work with advanced interfaces and protocols, including UCIe and AXI , while contributing to the technical excellence of Bosch’s Automotive Chiplet Systems (ACS) project.
Learn more about Bosch’s Automotive Chiplet technology: https://www.bosch-semiconductors.com/stories-and-events/chiplet-revolution/
Responsibilities
Own and execute Silicon IP based pre-silicon verifications (verify e.g. UCIe Interoperability) from planning through verification sign-off.
Develop, enhance, and maintain verification environments, testbenches, test cases, checkers, and coverage models.
Run simulations and regressions, analyze failures, debug issues, and drive root-cause resolution with IP, integration, and system teams.
Track verification progress, report status clearly, highlight risks early, and propose mitigation actions.
Review verification results, ensure process compliance, and contribute to technical reviews and design-verification discussions.
Guide junior engineers on verification methodology, debugging approach, and efficient execution of assigned tasks.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Technical expertise
Have 5-10 years of experience working as a Design Verification
Solid knowledge of the ASIC/SoC development lifecycle.
Hands-on experience with OVM/UVM methodologies using System Verilog.
Experience in testbench development or enhancement, test case creation, coding, execution, bug investigation, regression runs, coverage analysis, and verification sign-off.
Experience with AXI VIP and AXI protocol verification.
Hands-on experience with UCIe is highly preferred.
Familiarity with widely used standards and protocols such as PCIe Gen3/4/5, USB3, DDR4/5, Ethernet, CSI2, I3C,...
Experience performing gate-level simulations and timing constraint simulations
Strong root cause analysis and debugging skills with the ability to isolate issues across testbench, integration, and IP boundaries.
Fluent in written and spoken English
Personality and Working Practice:
You thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced work environment , embracing challenges and change.
You work proactively, self-organized and you are keenly interested in taking over responsibility.
You are highly collaborative and eager to contribute to team success, with a strong willingness to continuously learn and improve.
Your "out-of-the-box thinking" helps to achieve creative and effective solutions to complex problems.
You exhibit a hands-on mentality, eager to delve into technical details and provide direct support to developers and team members.
You are highly motivated in tailoring and optimizing processes to enhance efficiency and overall project outcomes.
Education
Bachelor’s degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, or a comparable discipline.

🎁 Q4 JOINING BONUS
Join BGSV by 31 December 2026 and receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.
As a Embedded Senior System Test Engineer for Safety System ( such as: ABS/ESP/iBooster ), you will:
Run test cases and regression tests
Analyze defect and report defects
Clarify open points
Analyze requirements, design and develop test cases
Set up test environment: SIL (Software in Loop) & HIL (Hardware in Loop)
Coordinate team activities, and handle day-to-day work efficiently and independently
Running & Develop automation scripts
Set up, configure, and maintain LabCar test bench hardware and associated equipment
Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, wiring, communication, and integration issues on LabCar/HIL systems to ensure test bench availability
Support debugging activities involving ECU connections, CAN/LIN/Ethernet communication, measurement devices, and test automation infrastructure

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Major in Computer Engineering/ Information Technology/ Electrical-Electronics/ Electronics-Telecommunication/ Mechatronics Engineering/ Automotive or related fields
Have 4+ years of experience in Software Testing
Have knowledge about software life cycle
Strong in 1 of following programming language: C/C++/Python/VBA/Perl scripting language, API programming
Have basic knowledge of micro-controller and embedded system
Hands-on understanding of electronic hardware, circuit fundamentals, sensors, actuators, and automotive ECU architecture
Able to read wiring diagrams, hardware schematics, pinouts, and technical documentation
Knowledge of automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, FlexRay, and/or Automotive Ethernet
Ability to diagnose and resolve hardware-related issues using debugging and measurement tools such as oscilloscopes, CAN analyzers, multimeters, and logic analyzers
Good English communication skills
It would be BIG advantage if you have: Automotive domain knowledge
Exposure to emulators, simulators, debugging
Knowledge of UML and design techniques
ISTQB Foundation certificate
Chinese language

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer for Automotive Brake Systems (e.g. ABS, ESP, Automatic Emergency Brake (AEB), Electronic Parking Brake (EPB), Sensor Signal Processing, and vehicle dynamics control functions), you will participate in the development of embedded software functions throughout the software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and design to implementation, verification, and system validation.
Your main responsibilities include:
Analyze customer and system requirements; develop software requirements, designs, and technical documentation.
Design, implement, verify, and debug embedded software functions using model-based and/or code-based development approaches.
Develop test specifications, evaluate test results, and support software integration, calibration, and vehicle validation activities.
Investigate and resolve technical issues reported by project teams, customers, and other stakeholders.
Collaborate with global engineering teams to ensure successful project delivery, software quality, and continuous improvement.
More details will be discussed during interviews.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Automotive Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or related fields.
Have experience in embedded software development.
Good programming skills in C/C++ and good understanding of embedded systems and microcontroller-based software development.
Experience in software development activities including design, implementation, debugging, verification, and technical documentation.
Familiarity with software development lifecycle, software engineering processes, and requirement-based development.
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
Good English communication skills.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience in automotive software development, especially brake, chassis, or vehicle dynamics systems.
Experience with ASCET, MATLAB/Simulink, or similar development tools.
Knowledge of CAN communication protocols and related tools (CANoe, CANalyzer, CAPL).
Familiarity with AUTOSAR, Functional Safety (ISO 26262), ASPICE, V-Model, Agile development, or software review processes.
Experience in software integration, calibration, and vehicle testing activities.
Japanese language skills are a plus.

ABOUT THE ROLE
The world faces enormous challenges when it comes to energy and climate change. Energy-efficient powertrain systems are a key solution for mastering these challenges. Optimized internal combustion engines and electric drive systems also have a role to play. That’s why Bosch continues to develop and improve both types of powertrain. Using state-of-the-art injection systems as well as hybrid and all-electric drives, mobility becomes more efficient, economical, and dynamic – and more fun.
Due to business expanding, we are welcome Senior Embedded Software Developers (4-7 YoE) to join our Powertrain team in Ho Chi Minh office.

Analyze customer requirement, design and develop embedded software/test suites in automotive power-train domain
Propose technical solution for customer demand or to resolve technical issue in automotive domain
Document design, design changes following customer requirement changes
Develop and execute unit and functional tests
Research new technology, new method to enhance performance of automotive system.
Integration of SW components into SW
Analyze and making configuration for SW and HW
Make integration test plan and execute the test

Good English language skills (Reading, Writing, Speaking and Listening)

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
🎁 Q4 JOINING BONUS
Join BGSV by 31 December 2026 and receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.
ABOUT THE DEPARTMENT & THE ROLE
'EPC' is a department of BGSV company, belongs to Automotive Powertrain Solution domain. We develop embedded SW for ' Engine / Vehicle control unit ' which controls key vehicle engine functions (e.g., power performance, energy consumption efficiency, emissions, diagnosis, communication) and additional drive-ability features.
We are looking for 'Senior Embedded Software Engineer' who involves in requirements engineering, design, coding, debugging and ensuring quality through CI/CT and automotive development processes, in detail:
Handle or Support requirement engineering: Elicit Stakeholders' requirements
Decompose & Allocate to lower-level requirements
Perform impact analysis
Specify interfaces, resource, constraints
Ensure compliance (e.g., Emission norms, Safety / Security standard)
Align priority with project manager
Handle or Support design (static & dynamic) from System level down-to SW component level
Develop (using Model-Based development) / Configure / Integrate SW .
Perform static & dynamic testing from System level down-to SW component level using HiL / SiL environment, e.g., System / System integration testing
SW / SW integration testing
SW component static analysis
Implement & maintain CI/CD pipelines
Baseline & Variant management to ensure trace-ability between requirements, work products and test reports.
Participate in Problem identification & resolution (e.g., record anomaly found during testing, analyze, troubleshoot)
Report working status and escalate for barriers (to project manager)

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor degree in Electrical Electronics, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering or Relevant fields
4-7 years of relevant experience with strong understanding of Embedded SW / System development & technologies: HW-SW interface know-how
System / SW configuration
Programming Languages & Tools, proficiency in: Embedded C language
Write clean, structured, efficient and well-documented code.
Python / Perl (e.g., data processing libraries like Pandas & frameworks like Django)
Testing in HiL environment & Automation test tools.
SW development process: Familiarity and practical experience with V-Model or Agile / Kanban methodologies in the context of Embedded development.
Version Control & CI/CT: Proven experience with Git, Git Actions, and Jenkins.
Automotive standards awareness: AUTOSAR
ISO26262, CyberSecurity
CAN, LIN
UDS, OBD
ASPICE
Practical experience to use AI effectively for research and self-study
(Nice to have) Experience using SiL, Model-Based development.
(Nice to have) Communication & Presentation skill
(Nice to have) Additional Languages & Platforms: Experience with C#, .NET

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
We are looking for 3 Junior Java Developers with hands-on experience working with structured databases and JSON files to join our software development team.
The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in system development including design, implementation, and testing, with at least 1 year of relevant experience preferable in diagnostic data content creation, database/data modelling, or customer/vendor communication related to IT projects. A problem-solving mindset and ability to work with diagnostic protocols and tools are highly valued. Fluency in Japanese and a willingness to improve English communication skills are essential.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and maintain Java-based web applications .
Participate in full software development lifecycle activities including requirements analysis, design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
Create and manage automobile diagnostic data content or develop and optimize database schemas and data models (SQL, XML, JSON).
Collaborate with customers and overseas vendors for SW development projects, ensuring clear communication and delivery.
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues with a problem resolution-oriented approach.
Work with diagnostic protocols such as UDS, KWP, DOIP where applicable.
Utilize or contribute to standards and tools related to ODX (Open Diagnostic data eXchange) and OTX (Open Test sequence eXchange).
Communicate effectively in Japanese (native-level speaking, listening, and writing, including technical specifications).
Engage in English communication and training programs to improve daily and technical English skills.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technologies, Electrical/Electronic Engineering or related fields
Have 1-3 years of experience in software development involving design, implementation, and testing in Java full-stack web development
Strong proficiency in Java programming and working with databases.
Solid understanding of JSON file handling and data manipulation.
Problem resolution-oriented mindset with attention to detail.
Good English communication skills , confident in communicating and working with foreign colleagues
It'd be great advantage if you have (not mandatory): Combined experience in one or more of the following: automobile diagnostic data content creation, database/data model practice (SQL, XML, JSON), or customer/vendor communication for IT development.
Japanese communication skills

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Bosch Cross-Domain Computing & ADAS (XC-CP) Team develops high-quality, state-of-the-art Automotive Head Unit and Home Appliance Linux/Android-based systems.
Together with other Bosch locations worldwide, we provide software solutions for navigation, vehicle functions, autonomous driving, camera, and IoT features to the car marker. Our team also contributes to Bosch smart home & IoT solutions through SW delivery to Home Appliance products.
Bosch XC is seeking a Software System Architect to drive the design and development of cutting-edge software solutions for our next-generation automotive technology portfolio. In this role, you will collaborate with Global and Regional Architecture teams to define scalable, high-performance software architectures that align with Bosch’s innovation goals in ADAS, Driver Assistance, and Cockpit Domains (IDC).
Responsibilities / Main Tasks of SW Architect:
Design Software Architecture
Define software architecture that fulfils the software requirements
Make architectural decisions, document and communicate architecture

sections.text:

Education: Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
At least 05 years of experience at Software Architect role
Good communication skills and English both in oral and written
Preferred Skills (Advantageous):
Experience in ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) or Driver Assistance domains.
Knowledge of In-Vehicle Infotainment (IVI) or Cockpit Domain (IDC) systems.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Welcome to the ETA Department
The ETA team specializes in the AUTOSAR Basic Software (BSW) platform, working closely with ETAS the global leader in automotive embedded systems tools. This collaboration gives us a strong edge in delivering high-quality, scalable software solutions.
As part of ETA regional teams, you’ll have the opportunity to implement platform components and work directly with clients, gaining hands-on experience in both development and communication.
Learn more about our work here .
Responsibilities:
Be able to integrate MCAL, BSW, RTE and SWCs in projects which are based on AUTOSAR Classic Platform /or develop Flash Bootloader on specific targets
Work directly with German/ Chinese / Korean/ Japanese customers
Understand and analyze customer's requirements
Software development, integration and testing based on requirements
Execute software development tasks, document user guides, test results and report problems
Handling tickets of new features, issues and change requests for the software platform
Debug and maintain the software running on target devices (Real ECU and Virtual ECU) via network TCP/IP or Automotive protocols
Provide effort estimation and other inputs for project planning
Have several chances to travel to customer sites for business purpose
Mentoring junior team members
Technologies used: AUTOSAR (Com, Mem, Diag, Sys...), CAN/LIN/ETH, OSEK, RTOS, Cyber Security SW/HW w/ HSM, FBL, OTA, SOTA, Rollback, Self-Update SW Software Signature and SecureBoot.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Educational background
Major in Computer Engineering/ Electrical-Electronics/ Telecommunication/ Mechatronics Engineering or equivalent.
Technical skills
2-3 years of experience in embedded software development
Good knowledge of micro-controller, processor and embedded system
Have experience in bare metal programming in embedded systems (C programming skills)
Have experience in Embedded software development (C/C++ programming skills).
Design methodology using OOAD, UML and design patterns
Automotive communication protocols know-how, e.g. Ethernet /SOMEIP/CAN/ LIN/ Flexray and Classic AUTOSAR architecture & methodology should be advantages.
Experience in Software Development Life-cycle
Exposure to emulators, simulators, debugging and test equipment
Exposure to Real Time Operating System (RTOS)
It'd be a big advantage if you have experience in Flash bootloader development
Soft-skills and language skills
Good communication skills, able to interact professionally with a diverse group of clients and staffs
Good analytical skills
Be able to work independently or with minimum supervision
Good English communication skills.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
We are looking for AUTOSAR Software Developers to join our automotive software development team. Depending on the candidate's experience and technical background, the role will focus on either AUTOSAR Classic or AUTOSAR Adaptive .
We are looking for candidates with a strong foundation in C/C++, embedded software development and automotive software engineering . Experience in either AUTOSAR Classic or Adaptive AUTOSAR is required; experience with both platforms is an advantage.
Roles & Responsibilities
Develop, integrate and maintain automotive software based on AUTOSAR platforms .
Analyze software requirements and translate them into software design and implementation.
Develop and integrate software components, interfaces and services.
Perform software integration, debugging and troubleshooting.
Develop unit and integration tests.
Support software verification, validation and release activities.
Collaborate with system, software, test and customer teams.
Participate in technical discussions, code reviews and knowledge transfer.
Work according to automotive software development processes such as ASPICE and functional-safety requirements.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or related field.
3+ years of experience in automotive embedded software development .
Strong programming skills in C and/or C++ .
Hands-on experience with AUTOSAR Classic or Adaptive AUTOSAR .
Good understanding of embedded software architecture and development processes.
Experience with automotive communication technologies such as CAN and/or Ethernet .
Experience with software development tools such as Git and debugging tools.
Good English communication skills.
Self‑driven, proactive, and able to take ownership of modules/features end‑to‑end.
Strong teamwork, interpersonal skills, and problem‑solving ability.
High degree of self-discipline, quality focus, and willingness to learn new technologies.

sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. It employs roughly 394,500 associates worldwide (as of December 31, 2020). Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility Solutions, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Lead the Future of Intelligent Workflow Platforms
Join Bosch Vietnam’s Global Product & Service organization to help shape next-generation workflow platforms used by 500,000+ users worldwide. Built on advanced Low-Code / No-Code technologies and evolving with AI and GenAI capabilities, our platform powers mission-critical enterprise workflows at global scale.
We are looking for a Senior IT Product Manager who combines strong product leadership, technical expertise, operational excellence, and strategic execution mindset to drive platform transformation, modernization, and long-term product success. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, UX, Operations, and Business stakeholders to deliver scalable, AI-driven enterprise solutions with high reliability, usability, and business impact.
Main Responsibilities
Product Strategy & Leadership Define and drive product vision, roadmap, and strategic direction for enterprise workflow platforms
Lead prioritization and investment decisions balancing business value, scalability, risk, and operational efficiency
Drive continuous improvement, innovation, and AI-native product transformation initiatives
Monitor market trends, emerging technologies, and enterprise workflow best practices
Platform Modernization & Product Delivery Lead migration and modernization initiatives from legacy platforms to next-generation workflow solutions
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, UX, and Architecture teams to deliver scalable enterprise capabilities
Ensure high-quality product delivery through Agile product management and execution practices
Drive operational excellence, standardization, and platform optimization
Service Management & Operational Governance Ensure service reliability, platform performance, SLA alignment, and operational stability
Implement data-driven monitoring, analytics, and KPI tracking to support decision-making
Support governance, security, compliance, and risk management activities
Collaborate with stakeholders to ensure smooth adoption and change management
Technical & Stakeholder Management Translate business needs into clear and scalable technical and product requirements
Provide leadership on software architecture, cloud technologies, workflow platforms, and AI-driven capabilities
Manage communication, alignment, and engagement across global business and technology stakeholders
Collaborate with strategic vendors and technology partners to ensure long-term product and service quality
Agile Leadership & Team Enablement Promote Agile mindset, collaboration, and iterative product delivery practices
Empower cross-functional teams to deliver value, improve continuously, and operate effectively
Mentor teams and contribute to product management and operational best practices

Proven ability to lead and inspire cross-functional teams.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to convey technical concepts to varied audiences.

Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
A proactive and creative problem-solving approach.
Strong organizational and time-management skills.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Build the Future of Enterprise User Experiences
Join Bosch Vietnam’s Global Product & Service organization to shape next-generation workflow platforms used by 500,000+ users worldwide.
We are looking for a Lead Front-End Developer who combines strong technical leadership, front-end architecture expertise, and UX engineering mindset to deliver scalable, high-performance, and intuitive enterprise applications. You will lead front-end strategy and engineering excellence for complex workflow automation platforms — including real-time dashboards, workflow builders, and data-intensive enterprise applications used globally across regions and business functions.
Key Responsibilities
Technical strategy and architecture: Define the front-end architecture (React + TypeScript primary) including state management patterns, choosing frameworks and patterns that ensure scalability and maintainability. Drive API contract discipline with backend and define caching/streaming strategies for real-time data.
Design System Management: Own and scale the Bosch Digital Design System and component library, ensuring pixel-perfect consistency across all regions and product modules. You will ensure Bosch Corporate Design is applied correctly.
Workflow Automation UX: Design and implement intuitive interfaces for complex logic, such as drag-and-drop workflow builders, real-time data dashboards, and integration of wizards.
Design system leadership: Own and evolve the component library and design tokens (theming, dark/HC modes); govern adoption via Storybook, documentation, and CI gates (lint, a11y, visual regression). Ensure consistency and scalability across modules and international variants.
Global readiness (i18n, a11y, performance): Ensure high performance across varying network conditions and localized support for multiple languages and regional data standards.
Engineering excellence and security: Build a testing strategy and implement CI/CD quality gates, bundle analysis, and static checks.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with UX/UI designers to bridge the gap between high-fidelity designs and technical feasibility, and with backend teams to define robust API contracts.
Team Mentorship: Mentor engineers, lead code reviews, establish engineering standards and playbooks, and contribute to hiring and onboarding

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Must-Have:
Education: Bachelor’s or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
Experience: 7+ years of professional front-end experience, including 3+ years leading teams or major initiatives on large-scale web apps.
Core Languages: Expert in modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3 (Sass/CSS Modules) and modern layout.
Frameworks: Extensive experience with React, Angular, or Vue.js, including state management (e.g., Redux, MobX). React proficiency building reusable, stateful components and hooks; strong command of state management.
Design system adoption across 2+ product modules with documented components and usage guidelines.
Build & Deployment: Proficiency with Git-based workflows, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Jenkins) with quality gates.
Testing: Strong background in automated testing frameworks like Jest, Cypress, or Playwright.
Deep understanding of Web Accessibility (WCAG) and SEO best practices.
Localized experiences delivered in multiple languages, including at least one RTL locale.
Security awareness (OWASP front-end risks, XSS/CSP, secure handling of untrusted content).
Agile Mindset: Proven track record of delivering in fast-paced, sprint-based global environments.
Global Mindset: Experience delivering software that accounts for regional cultural nuances and varied internet speeds.
Nice-to-Have:
Workflow Expertise : Experience building tools for IT operations, project management, or SaaS automation is highly desirable.
Project Management: Ability to manage timelines, define technical roadmaps, and communicate progress to senior stakeholders.
Design token pipelines (Style Dictionary), Storybook, Chromatic/visual regression testing.
Observability (Sentry, Datadog), feature flagging, A/B testing.
Experience with distributed teams and varying network conditions across regions.
Measurable improvements in Core Web Vitals and interaction latency on at least one high-traffic workflow

Monitor test execution, defects, automation health, release risks, and production quality
Build clear dashboards and executive-ready reports
Convert quality data into concrete insights, actions, ownership, and recommendations

Lead Quality Engineering for a platform serving nearly 500,000 users worldwide
Shape the automation and AI-enabled testing strategy of a long-term global product
Gain hands-on experience with OutSystems, GenAI, and Agentic AI
Transform a QA team into a modern Quality Engineering capability
Deliver measurable improvements in reliability, efficiency, release speed, and customer trust
Build a significant career achievement in a global AI product transformation

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
As a Senior Test Engineer , you will play a key role in defining, implementing and improving testing solutions for automotive embedded software products. The position combines technical leadership, test strategy development, automation enablement and cross-functional coordination to ensure delivery quality for complex vehicle communication and embedded system projects.
You will work closely with SWSD, Function Developers, Architects, Project Managers and global stakeholders to establish efficient testing approaches across SIL, HIL and Continuous Testing environments while driving competency growth and quality excellence within the team. Inspired by current EPC ComTest and SIL transformation initiatives. (VW & STLA Account)
Key Responsibilities
Test Strategy & Quality Leadership
Define and maintain project test strategy aligned with project requirements and organizational quality standards.
Plan and coordinate testing activities across System Test, Software Qualification Test, SIL and HIL environments.
Ensure requirement-to-test traceability and coverage throughout the development lifecycle.
Review test specifications, test designs and test reports to ensure completeness and effectiveness.
Drive quality improvement initiatives, defect prevention and lesson-learned activities.
Test Design & Execution
Analyze requirements and clarify ambiguities with stakeholders.
Develop test cases, test specifications and test data for embedded software systems.
Automation & Continuous Testing
Develop and enhance automated testing solutions using Python or similar scripting languages.
Contribute to Continuous Testing (CT) and CI/CD integration for test execution.
Improve testing efficiency through automation, reusable test assets and tooling.
Support SIL-based validation and early defect detection strategies.
Drive test environment optimization and automation initiatives.
Technical Leadership
Mentor junior engineers and support competency development within the team.
Provide technical guidance on test methodologies, automotive communication and debugging.
Support onboarding, knowledge sharing and test process improvement initiatives.
Act as technical focal point for testing-related topics within projects.
Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with global teams, project managers, architects and customers.
Report test progress, risks and quality status to internal and external stakeholders.
Support audits, assessments and compliance activities (ASPICE, Functional Safety, Quality Gate Reviews).
Execute and monitor system-level and software-level validation activities.
Investigate defects, perform root-cause analysis and support issue resolution.
Generate test summary reports and communicate project quality status.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
5+ years' experience in Embedded Software Testing or System Testing.
CI/CT or DevOps experience.
Knowledge of CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet communication protocols.
Experience with Vector tools (CANoe, CANalyzer, VT System).
Solid experience with Automotive Embedded Systems.
Experience in project-level testing coordination or technical leadership roles.
Hands-on experience with test automation development.
Nice to have
Python programming for automation framework development.
Automotive communication stack and gateway validation experience.
Knowledge of AUTOSAR architecture.
ASPICE process knowledge.
Functional Safety (ISO26262) awareness.
Experience establishing testing concepts for SIL Continuous Testing environments.
ISTQB Foundation or Advanced Certification.

sections.text:
Development opportunity for individual perform this role:
Opportunity 1 : Shape the Future of Automotive Testing
Be part of a team driving the transformation from traditional testing approaches toward:
Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) validation
Test automation and reusable testing assets
Continuous Testing (CT) and CI/CD integration
Data-driven test strategy and quality engineering
Opportunity 2 : Work on Complex Embedded Systems
Gain hands-on experience with: Automotive communication systems, CAN, LIN, Ethernet and AUTOSAR technologies, Embedded software architecture, Vehicle network management and diagnostics, SIL and HIL test environments, Advanced debugging and validation methodologies
Opportunity 3 : Drive Innovation and Engineering Excellence
We encourage engineers to:
Propose innovative testing solutions
Develop automation frameworks and tools
Improve engineering processes and test efficiency
Share technical knowledge within the organization
Your ideas can directly influence project productivity, product quality and future testing practices.
If you have any further questions regarding this position, feel free to reach out to Mr. Pham Dinh Phuc, Talent Acquisition Partner for EPC, for clarification.

discovery:smartrecruiters:BoschGroup:744.description:
As a Senior Test Engineer , you will play a key role in defining, implementing and improving testing solutions for automotive embedded software products. The position combines technical leadership, test strategy development, automation enablement and cross-functional coordination to ensure delivery quality for complex vehicle communication and embedded system projects.
You will work closely with SWSD, Function Developers, Architects, Project Managers and global stakeholders to establish efficient testing approaches across SIL, HIL and Continuous Testing environments while driving competency growth and quality excellence within the team. Inspired by current EPC ComTest and SIL transformation initiatives. (VW & STLA Account)
Key Responsibilities
Test Strategy & Quality Leadership
Define and maintain project test strategy aligned with project requirements and organizational quality standards.
Plan and coordinate testing activities across System Test, Software Qualification Test, SIL and HIL environments.
Ensure requirement-to-test traceability and coverage throughout the development lifecycle.
Review test specifications, test designs and test reports to ensure completeness and effectiveness.
Drive quality improvement initiatives, defect prevention and lesson-learned activities.
Test Design & Execution
Analyze requirements and clarify ambiguities with stakeholders.
Develop test cases, test specifications and test data for embedded software systems.
Automation & Continuous Testing
Develop and enhance automated testing solutions using Python or similar scripting languages.
Contribute to Continuous Testing (CT) and CI/CD integration for test execution.
Improve testing efficiency through automation, reusable test assets and tooling.
Support SIL-based validation and early defect detection strategies.
Drive test environment optimization and automation initiatives.
Technical Leadership
Mentor junior engineers and support competency development within the team.
Provide technical guidance on test methodologies, automotive communication and debugging.
Support onboarding, knowledge sharing and test process improvement initiatives.
Act as technical focal point for testing-related topics within projects.
Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with global teams, project managers, architects and customers.
Report test progress, risks and quality status to internal and external stakeholders.
Support audits, assessments and compliance activities (ASPICE, Functional Safety, Quality Gate Reviews).
Execute and monitor system-level and software-level validation activities.
Investigate defects, perform root-cause analysis and support issue resolution.
Generate test summary reports and communicate project quality status.

5+ years' experience in Embedded Software Testing or System Testing.
CI/CT or DevOps experience.
Knowledge of CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet communication protocols.
Experience with Vector tools (CANoe, CANalyzer, VT System).
Solid experience with Automotive Embedded Systems.
Experience in project-level testing coordination or technical leadership roles.
Hands-on experience with test automation development.
Nice to have
Python programming for automation framework development.
Automotive communication stack and gateway validation experience.
Knowledge of AUTOSAR architecture.
ASPICE process knowledge.
Functional Safety (ISO26262) awareness.
Experience establishing testing concepts for SIL Continuous Testing environments.
ISTQB Foundation or Advanced Certification.

Development opportunity for individual perform this role:
Opportunity 1 : Shape the Future of Automotive Testing
Be part of a team driving the transformation from traditional testing approaches toward:
Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) validation
Test automation and reusable testing assets
Continuous Testing (CT) and CI/CD integration
Data-driven test strategy and quality engineering
Opportunity 2 : Work on Complex Embedded Systems
Gain hands-on experience with: Automotive communication systems, CAN, LIN, Ethernet and AUTOSAR technologies, Embedded software architecture, Vehicle network management and diagnostics, SIL and HIL test environments, Advanced debugging and validation methodologies
Opportunity 3 : Drive Innovation and Engineering Excellence
We encourage engineers to:
Propose innovative testing solutions
Develop automation frameworks and tools
Improve engineering processes and test efficiency
Share technical knowledge within the organization
Your ideas can directly influence project productivity, product quality and future testing practices.
If you have any further questions regarding this position, feel free to reach out to Mr. Pham Dinh Phuc, Talent Acquisition Partner for EPC, for clarification.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Bosch Cross-Domain Computing & ADAS (XC-CP) Team develops high-quality, state-of-the-art Automotive Head Unit and Home Appliance Linux/Android-based systems.
Together with other Bosch locations worldwide, we provide software solutions for navigation, vehicle functions, autonomous driving, camera, and IoT features to the car marker. Our team also contributes to Bosch smart home & IoT solutions through SW delivery to Home Appliance products.
We are looking for talented SoC1 Embedded SW Engineers in Central Computer, In-Vehicle Infotainment, ADAS and Driver Monitoring with 2 to 5 years of experience to join our development team.
Key Responsible:
Core QNX Development : You will develop, implement, and maintain robust system services, libraries, and resource managers for the QNX Neutrino RTOS, focusing on real-time performance and system stability.
System Bring-Up & Bootloader : You will contribute to the development and adaptation of bootloaders (e.g., U-Boot) and support initial board bring-up activities using hardware debuggers.
Platform Integration & Verification : You will be responsible for integrating software components, debugging system-level issues, and helping to maintain our CI/CD build and test pipelines.
Performance Analysis : You will participate in optimizing system performance by analyzing boot time and runtime resource usage within the QNX OS.
Team Collaboration : You will work closely with senior developers and architects, actively participating in technical discussions and contributing to a culture of quality and continuous improvement.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Personality : You are a motivated and accountable team player with a strong desire to learn and contribute to complex projects.
Working Style : You have an analytical and goal-oriented approach, with an eagerness to solve technical challenges both independently and as part of the team.
Experience and Know-how: Professional experience in embedded C/C++ development for POSIX operating systems, preferably including QNX.
Familiarity with bootloader concepts and the role they play in hardware initialization.
Experience with developing or integrating software for embedded hardware, ideally including exposure to Board Support Packages (BSPs).
A foundational understanding of low-level debugging on hardware (e.g., using JTAG) is a plus.
Experience with modern software development workflows, including version control (e.g., Git) and the basics of CI/CD pipelines.
An interest in system performance optimization and analysis.
Knowledge of functional safety standards (ISO 26262) is an advantage.
Language Skills : Very good English skills.
Education : A completed degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a comparable field.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services, in the areas of automotive and industrial technology, consumer goods as well as building technology.
Bosch established its first representative office in Ho Chi Minh City in 1994. Since 2007, Bosch has expanded its footprint in Vietnam where it has branch offices in Hanoi and Da Nang, as well as a Powertrain Solutions plant in the Dong Nai province to manufacture pushbelts for continuously variable transmissions (CVT) in automobiles. In addition, Bosch operates Bosch Global Software Technologies Vietnam (BGSV) as well as an automotive R&D center for mobility solutions in Ho Chi Minh City. As of December 31 2023, Bosch employed approximately 6,300 associates in Vietnam. Bosch has diversified businesses in Vietnam. Today, all four Bosch business sectors, namely Mobility Solutions, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology have operations in the country. Bosch Vietnam is currently active with many business divisions: Mobility Aftermarket, Drive and Control Technology, Power Tools, Building Technology, Two-Wheeler and Powersports and Sales Original Equipment, AquaEasy, Home Appliances and Supply Chain Consulting.
Additional information is available online at: https://www.bosch.com.vn/ , https://www.linkedin.com/company/bosch-vietnam and https://www.facebook.com/OfficialBoschVietnam

sections.text:
Drive Adoption for Global AI Workflow Platforms
Join Bosch Vietnam’s Global Product & Service organization to help shape the future of intelligent workflow platforms used by nearly 500,000 users worldwide. Built on modern Low-Code / No-Code technologies and evolving with AI and GenAI capabilities, our platform powers mission-critical enterprise processes at global scale.
We are looking for a Senior IT Product Marketing Specialist who combines strong product storytelling, adoption strategy, stakeholder engagement, and execution excellence to drive platform awareness, trust, and user adoption globally. This role goes beyond communication — you will help influence product adoption, enable transformation, and build long-term engagement across global stakeholders and internal customers.
What You Will Do
Product Marketing & Communication
Own product messaging, positioning, and internal branding for global workflow platforms
Translate complex AI, automation, and workflow concepts into clear business value and user-focused communication
Develop executive presentations, newsletters, launch materials, playbooks, demos, and enablement content
Create persona-based communication for Executives, IT teams, Process Owners, Citizen Developers, and End Users
Adoption & Change Enablement
Drive product adoption, engagement, and migration initiatives across global stakeholders
Support onboarding, training, UAT enablement, and user adoption programs
Gather feedback and continuously improve communication effectiveness and adoption strategies
Support Citizen Development enablement with clear governance and operational communication
Stakeholder & Community Engagement:
Engage with global stakeholders, leadership teams, and internal customers across regions
Support webinars, workshops, product showcases, and transformation initiatives
Build and grow user communities, champion networks, and engagement programs
Ensure consistent, professional, and proactive communication across channels
Performance & Optimization
Define and monitor adoption, engagement, and satisfaction KPIs
Use data and insights to improve communication strategies and campaign effectiveness
Contribute to AI product positioning with practical, credible, and user-centric messaging

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Must-Have
7+ years of experience in Product Marketing, Platform Adoption, Enterprise Communication, or Change Enablement
Strong storytelling, presentation, and executive communication capability
Experience driving adoption programs, transformation initiatives, or enterprise platform rollouts
Ability to simplify complex technical concepts into clear and actionable messaging
Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills in global environments
High ownership, execution discipline, and proactive mindset
Fluent English communication skills
Nice-to-Have
Experience with workflow, automation, SaaS, or enterprise platforms
Exposure to Low-Code / No-Code platforms or Citizen Development governance
Experience with AI/GenAI-related products or transformation initiatives
Knowledge of analytics, reporting, or data-driven marketing approaches
Experience in change management, internal community building, or engagement programs
Selection Process
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to prepare a short presentation on a sample Product Marketing & Adoption Plan as part of the interview process.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
About the Role
We are looking for a Junior Telematics Software Engineer to join the team driving the migration of our Telematics Control Unit (TCU) software framework from Embedded Linux to Android (AOSP / Android Automotive). Working under the guidance of our senior engineers, you will help build, test, and validate individual pieces of the new Android-based platform — vehicle-network interfaces, connectivity services, and OTA mechanisms — while learning embedded Android development on a real, shipping-bound migration. This is a strong entry point into embedded Android for someone with a solid C/C++ or Linux foundation who wants to grow into platform-level automotive software work.
Key Responsibilities
Implement and unit-test defined pieces of the Linux-to-Android migration under the direction of senior engineers — HAL glue code, native services, or application-layer components.
Support porting of vehicle-network interfaces (CAN / CAN-FD, UDS, DoIP) to Vehicle HAL (VHAL) extensions or AIDL/HIDL services, following the architecture the senior engineer defines.
Help build and maintain the Android build system (AOSP repo/manifest, device tree) for the target TCU hardware, and keep local build/test environments working.
Run and extend the regression test suite comparing Linux and Android implementations; log and help triage discrepancies.
Reproduce and debug issues found during bench or vehicle-level testing, and document root cause and fix.
Assist with basic SELinux policy changes and Android permission configuration under review from senior engineers.
Keep clear records of what was ported, tested, and verified, to support the team's cutover and audit trail.
Learn the existing embedded Linux telematics stack well enough to explain what a given piece of functionality needs to preserve when ported.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, or a related field (recent graduates welcome).
0–2 years of software development experience, with solid fundamentals in C/C++ and Linux (coursework, internships, or personal/academic projects count).
Basic understanding of Android development concepts (Java/Kotlin, the Android build system) — through coursework, personal projects, or prior internship experience.
Comfortable reading and debugging someone else's code, and asking for help when stuck rather than guessing.
Familiarity with Git and basic command-line tooling.
Clear written communication for bug reports, test notes, and status updates.
Preferred Qualifications
Exposure to AOSP, HAL/VHAL, or AIDL/HIDL through coursework, an internship, or personal projects.
Familiarity with vehicle network protocols (CAN, UDS) or embedded Linux (Yocto/Buildroot).
Experience with unit testing frameworks and debugging tools (GDB, JTAG).
General interest in automotive or embedded systems.

sections.text:
Bosch first started its operations in Vietnam in 1994 and registered a wholly-owned subsidiary in 2008. Ltd. with its head office at Ho Chi Minh City plant (HcP) in Dong Nai Province.

For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Bosch first started its operations in Vietnam in 1994 and registered a wholly-owned subsidiary in 2008. According to the business strategy of Bosch in Vietnam, from 1st July 2014 on all business entities were merged into Bosch Vietnam Co. Ltd. with its head office at Ho Chi Minh City plant (HcP) in Dong Nai Province.
HcP has started its belt assembly in a rented building on 1st August 2008 as the assembly plant of Tilburg Plant (TbP). On 14th April 2011, HcP celebrated the inauguration of the new plant (Lth101 with 17,000 sqm), which did not only allow to increase the production depth, but also to facilitate the push belt assembly of this high-tech product. On 3rd July 2012 HcP marked a big milestone by starting to produce the second component (loop-set) for its push belt. Since November 2012, HcP doubled the production floor space and increase the net total floor space up to 56.000 m², and have successfully increased its production capacity and realized a lot of new line SOP’s.
For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn.

sections.text:
The SAP Project Manager is responsible for managing and implementing SAP projects with quality while managing the defined scope diligently and to ensure deliverables are on time and conform to processes and standards meeting the customer’s requirement.
Responsibilities
Project Delivery
Establish and prepare project plans, risk management plans, project milestones and deliverables in consultation with business users and architect/designer
Manage the implementation of the project on a daily basis with regard to schedules, budget, manpower and quality
Manage the scope definition and change control mechanism
Analyse and document requirements by liaising with a range of people including users and managers, drawing together information needs across a distributed organization
Escalate and discuss project overrun issues, scope creep, integration issues, resource requirements with Project Director (PD)/Service Delivery Director (SDD)
Manage integration of various components of the project including hardware, software installation, testing, business process review, redesign, application development, migration and data conversion etc.
Manage project activities to ensure timely delivery, including identification of critical path, monitoring and driving completion of interdependent activities and adjustment to project schedules to achieve overall completion deadline
Manage resources including hardware, software, human resource facilities and logistics required for project so as to ensure completion within budget.
Review project documentation to ensure that it meets customers requirement and conforms to quality management process, standards and procedures to minimize rework and system failures
Define project resources, performance reviews and post implementation evaluations
Business Development
Proactively identify opportunities for further expansion or improvement of services delivered to the customer and liaise with the Account Manager(s) for development of that opportunity
Be involved in pre-sale activities as the need arises during the project
Customer/Vendor Management
Effectively engaged stakeholders in project decisions and execution
Build long-term customer relationships by anticipating and exceeding customer’s expectation
Negotiate with customers on change control mechanism to meet schedules and prioritize changes based on business needs
Manage contracts and subcontractors
Negotiate with vendors and across teams to ensure adequate resources are available during various phases of the project
Build relationships with users, technical staff and management to determine and resolve issues associated with systems implementation
Manage contracts and subcontractors
Negotiate with customers on change request effort, schedules and prioritize changes based on business needs
Clear and open communication with customers on project issues or clarifications
Team Management
Liaise with team members to ensure that all tasks and deliverables are proceeding according to schedule
Plan, track and monitor the tasks assigned to the team leader/ members
Delegate tasks effectively by providing clear and specific instructions and goals
Provide leadership to the project team to ensure that proposals/enhancements are fully analysed and evaluated for their benefits and costs
Provide the project team with accurate information about business needs and priorities as well as details about existing business systems
Participate in leadership activities and providing performance feedback and developmental coaching
Monitor and improve team performance, providing leadership, coaching, and performance management

Self-motivated with a positive “can-do” attitude, creative with excellent presentation, communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills including strong persuasive techniques.

Position Overview:
The Vehicle Data & Analytics Specialist plays a key role in building, enriching, maintaining, and improving automotive aftermarket data across East Asia, including vehicle data, OE (Original Equipment) application data, and Bosch product application data. Acting as a regional focal point for vehicle-related data activities, the role works closely with country teams, external data providers, and internal stakeholders to improve data coverage, quality, consistency, and related processes.
Based on department priorities and internal customer needs, the role applies data analysis tools and methods, including Power BI, Python, and SQL, to identify data gaps and business needs, and translate findings into executable data actions such as data collection, research, supplier follow-up, and joint actions with relevant stakeholders.
The position is a hands-on data role supporting Product Management, Marketing, Sales, and Management with reliable automotive aftermarket data, analysis, and reporting, while continuously improving regional data processes and usability.
Key Responsibilities
1. Vehicle Data development and Management
Develop and maintain centralized automotive aftermarket data for East Asia, with primary focus on Japan and Korea, ensuring data accuracy, coverage, and accessibility.
Build and enrich datasets including vehicle, OE, VIO, material, product application data.
Work with external data providers and internal stakeholders to collect, validate, integrate, and continuously improve data coverage.
Identify data gaps through analysis and research, use relevant intelligence sources and methods to enrich missing or incomplete information, and drive follow-up actions.
2. Data Analytics
Translate department priorities and internal customer needs into structured data analysis using Power BI, Python, SQL, and other relevant tools.
Analyze Automotive Aftermarket and related business data to identify gaps, trends, patterns, and improvement opportunities.
Provide data-based insights and recommendations to support Product Management, Marketing, Sales, and Management.
Turn analytical findings into executable data action plans and work schedules, to follow through with relevant stakeholders.
3. Data Quality & Reporting
Monitor and improve data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and coverage through regular validation and quality checks.
Identify data-quality issues and root causes, and coordinate corrective actions with internal stakeholders and external data providers.
Apply established data standards and support continuous improvement.
4. Process & Continuous Improvement
Prepare and maintain regular and ad-hoc reports, Power BI dashboards, and analytical outputs based on department and internal customer requirements.
Support regular & add-hoc data operations and delivery requirements, including catalogue, application, and other internal or external data outputs.
Improve data workflows, quality, and efficiency through standardization, automation, and appropriate analytical tools.
Maintain clear documentation of key data sources, definitions, processes, and working procedures to support consistent and scalable data operations.

Able to cooperate in data research, automation and digital projects.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
We are building the next generation of production AI agent systems — systems that reason, plan, call tools, delegate across specialized sub-agents, and deliver real business outcomes end to end. We are looking for a senior engineer who has gone deep on modern machine learning, transformers and agents, and who wants to build at the frontier of what language models and multimodal systems can actually do in production today.
This is not a "wrap an API around an LLM" role. We expect candidates who understand why things work — the mechanics of attention, the failure modes of autoregressive decoding, the cost/latency trade-offs of caching and tool routing, the pitfalls of context engineering at scale. And who can turn that understanding into systems that ship, hold up under load, and keep improving.
Key Responsibilities:
Architect agentic systems — plan, memory, tool use, multi-agent delegation, evaluation loops, guardrails. Pick the right abstraction for the problem, not the one on the hype curve.
Push model capability into production. Design prompt and context strategies, tool interfaces, retrieval and reranking, structured output, streaming, and evaluation — across text and multimodal inputs (vision, documents, audio).
Own the evaluation story. Build offline eval sets, online LLM-as-judge loops, regression harnesses. Know the difference between a metric that moves your users and a metric that moves only your dashboard.
Squeeze the system. Prompt caching, batching, speculative decoding, model routing, token budget management, latency targets. Know your P50/P99 and why they look the way they do.
Contribute upstream. Read SDK source when docs are thin, open PRs against open-source agent frameworks, write crisp bug reports when a vendor's orchestration service returns a weird 500.
Mentor and set the bar. Your design reviews, code reviews and technical writing shape how the rest of the team thinks about agents.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor’s degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or a related field.
3+ years of experience as an AI/AI Agent Engineer.
Solid ML fundamentals. You can explain transformers — attention, positional encoding, KV cache, tokenisation, sampling — without hand-waving. You've read at least a few core papers in full, not just the abstracts.
Deep LLM application experience. Multiple production systems built on top of frontier models (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, open-weight). You know the practical edge cases: tool-use stability, structured-output failure modes, long-context degradation, prompt-injection defence, cost control.
Agent systems depth. You've built something with real agent behaviour — planning, memory, tool orchestration, multi-step execution, error recovery — not a single prompt in a loop. Experience with multi-agent coordination (delegation, sub-agent protocols, MCP-style tool servers) is a strong plus.
Multimodal experience. Hands-on work with vision-language models, document AI (OCR, layout, tables), or audio — end-to-end from ingest to grounded output.
Strong engineering craft. Python at a senior level — async, typing, testing, packaging, observability. Able to read and navigate a large codebase. Git hygiene that makes reviewers' lives easier.
Production AI engineering. You can take ML, LLM, embedding, vision, or multimodal models from prototype to production — designing APIs and inference services, building RAG/embedding pipelines, containerizing workloads, handling CPU/GPU deployment, and optimizing latency, throughput, reliability, and cost.
AI platform & MLOps experience. Hands-on experience operating AI workloads in production with model/version management, CI/CD, evaluation gates, observability, autoscaling, rollback, and failure handling. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, Azure AI services, GPU inference, or model-serving frameworks such as vLLM or NVIDIA Triton is a strong plus.
Fluent with modern coding agents. You use Claude Code / Cursor / Copilot / equivalents daily as a force multiplier. You understand where they shine and where they fail, and you can design prompts, context and tool boundaries to get the most out of them.
Communication. Writes and speaks clearly in English.
Strongly preferred
Published ML work (papers, workshop submissions, open-source projects, technical deep-dive blog posts) that shows original thinking.
AI-native engineering mindset. Daily use of tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot, with strong technical judgment
Experience fine-tuning, distilling, or post-training open-weight LLMs — SFT, DPO, RLHF, LoRA — even at small scale.
Experience with vector search, retrieval-augmented generation, reranking at scale.
Experience shipping production evaluation infrastructure (eval sets, online judges, A/B for LLM systems).

We expect candidates who understand why things work — the mechanics of attention, the failure modes of autoregressive decoding, the cost/latency trade-offs of caching and tool routing, the pitfalls of context engineering at scale. And who can turn that understanding into systems that ship, hold up under load, and keep improving.
Key Responsibilities:
Architect agentic systems — plan, memory, tool use, multi-agent delegation, evaluation loops, guardrails. Pick the right abstraction for the problem, not the one on the hype curve.
Push model capability into production. Design prompt and context strategies, tool interfaces, retrieval and reranking, structured output, streaming, and evaluation — across text and multimodal inputs (vision, documents, audio).
Own the evaluation story. Build offline eval sets, online LLM-as-judge loops, regression harnesses. Know the difference between a metric that moves your users and a metric that moves only your dashboard.
Squeeze the system. Prompt caching, batching, speculative decoding, model routing, token budget management, latency targets. Know your P50/P99 and why they look the way they do.
Contribute upstream. Read SDK source when docs are thin, open PRs against open-source agent frameworks, write crisp bug reports when a vendor's orchestration service returns a weird 500.
Mentor and set the bar. Your design reviews, code reviews and technical writing shape how the rest of the team thinks about agents.

Bachelor’s degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or a related field.
3+ years of experience as an AI/AI Agent Engineer.
Solid ML fundamentals. You can explain transformers — attention, positional encoding, KV cache, tokenisation, sampling — without hand-waving. You've read at least a few core papers in full, not just the abstracts.
Deep LLM application experience. Multiple production systems built on top of frontier models (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, open-weight). You know the practical edge cases: tool-use stability, structured-output failure modes, long-context degradation, prompt-injection defence, cost control.
Agent systems depth. You've built something with real agent behaviour — planning, memory, tool orchestration, multi-step execution, error recovery — not a single prompt in a loop. Experience with multi-agent coordination (delegation, sub-agent protocols, MCP-style tool servers) is a strong plus.
Multimodal experience. Hands-on work with vision-language models, document AI (OCR, layout, tables), or audio — end-to-end from ingest to grounded output.
Strong engineering craft. Python at a senior level — async, typing, testing, packaging, observability. Able to read and navigate a large codebase. Git hygiene that makes reviewers' lives easier.
Production AI engineering. You can take ML, LLM, embedding, vision, or multimodal models from prototype to production — designing APIs and inference services, building RAG/embedding pipelines, containerizing workloads, handling CPU/GPU deployment, and optimizing latency, throughput, reliability, and cost.
AI platform & MLOps experience. Hands-on experience operating AI workloads in production with model/version management, CI/CD, evaluation gates, observability, autoscaling, rollback, and failure handling. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, Azure AI services, GPU inference, or model-serving frameworks such as vLLM or NVIDIA Triton is a strong plus.
Fluent with modern coding agents. You use Claude Code / Cursor / Copilot / equivalents daily as a force multiplier. You understand where they shine and where they fail, and you can design prompts, context and tool boundaries to get the most out of them.
Communication. Writes and speaks clearly in English.
Strongly preferred
Published ML work (papers, workshop submissions, open-source projects, technical deep-dive blog posts) that shows original thinking.
AI-native engineering mindset. Daily use of tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or Copilot, with strong technical judgment
Experience fine-tuning, distilling, or post-training open-weight LLMs — SFT, DPO, RLHF, LoRA — even at small scale.
Experience with vector search, retrieval-augmented generation, reranking at scale.
Experience shipping production evaluation infrastructure (eval sets, online judges, A/B for LLM systems).

WHY BOSCH?
Because we don't just follow trends, we create them.
Because together we turn ideas into reality, working every day to make the world of tomorrow a better place.
Do you have high standards when it comes to your job? So do we. At Bosch, you will discover more than just work.

Working in one of the Best Places to Work in Vietnam and Top 30 of the Most Innovative Companies all over the world

sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services, in the areas of automotive and industrial technology, consumer goods as well as building technology.
Bosch established its first representative office in Ho Chi Minh City in 1994. Since 2007, Bosch has expanded its footprint in Vietnam where it has branch offices in Hanoi and Da Nang, as well as a Powertrain Solutions plant in the Dong Nai province to manufacture pushbelts for continuously variable transmissions (CVT) in automobiles. As of December 31 2023, Bosch employed approximately 6,300 associates in Vietnam. Bosch has diversified businesses in Vietnam. Today, all four Bosch business sectors, namely Mobility Solutions, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology have operations in the country. Bosch Vietnam is currently active with many business divisions: Mobility Aftermarket, Drive and Control Technology, Power Tools, Building Technology, Two-Wheeler and Powersports and Sales Original Equipment, AquaEasy, Home Appliances and Supply Chain Consulting.
Additional information is available online at: https://www.bosch.com.vn/ , https://www.linkedin.com/company/bosch-vietnam and https://www.facebook.com/OfficialBoschVietnam

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
We are seeking an experienced Hardware Engineer to design, develop, and validate electronic hardware systems. The role involves schematic design, prototype development, hardware bring-up, component library management, and technical documentation creation. The successful candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality hardware solutions.
Key Responsibilities:
Design electronic circuits and create schematics using Cadence OrCAD/Allegro
Develop, maintain, and continuously improve electronic component libraries.
Collaborate with PCB Layout Engineers to define design constraints, review PCB layouts, optimize component placement and routing, and ensure compliance with signal integrity, power integrity, EMC, manufacturability, and reliability requirements.
Build up and validate hardware prototypes.
Perform hardware bring-up, debugging, root cause analysis, and troubleshooting.
Conduct hardware verification and validation testing using laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and multimeters.
Create and maintain hardware design documentation, reference designs, test reports, and technical specifications.
Collaborate with software, system, and mechanical engineers during integration and validation activities.
Support product maintenance and continuous improvement activities throughout the development lifecycle.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Qualifications
Bachelor’s in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field.
5-10 years of experience in electronic hardware design and development.
Knowledge of EE CAD design tools: OrCAD Capture, Allegro, Altium Designer, A365, etc.
Solid understanding of analog and digital circuit design principles.
Hands-on experience in prototype bring-up, debugging, and hardware validation.
Experience in component selection, library management, and design documentation.
Familiarity with laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and power supplies.
Soft skills
Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken.
Strong presentation and technical discussion skills.
Ability to clearly explain technical concepts and ideas to different stakeholders.
Good teamwork and collaboration skills in a multicultural environment.
Self-motivated, proactive, and result-oriented

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Technical Key Account Engineer to support automotive component projects for Japanese OEM customers across Passenger Car (PC) and Commercial Vehicle (CV) applications.
In this role, you will act as a key technical interface between customers and Bosch engineering teams , supporting projects from acquisition and technical clarification through project execution and engineering changes.
A key opportunity of this position is a long-term onsite assignment at Bosch Japan for at least 2.5 years, expected to start by March 2027 or earlier . The assignment comes with an attractive benefits package, and family accompaniment to Japan can be supported .
You will also have the opportunity to build specialized technical expertise in DNOX and exhaust aftertreatment systems while collaborating with Bosch platform and engineering teams in Europe.
What You’ll Do
Act as the first-level Technical Key Account (TKA) for assigned automotive component projects.
Serve as the main technical interface with Japanese OEM customers , handling technical questions, requirements, and clarifications.
Support the execution of customer projects for Passenger Car and Commercial Vehicle applications , ensuring alignment with project requirements and milestones.
Support new project acquisition activities for Japanese OEM customers, particularly technical documentation and project-related inputs.
Coordinate and track Engineering Change Requests (ECRs) for Passenger Car customer projects.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Bosch first started its operations in Vietnam in 1994 and registered a wholly-owned subsidiary in 2008. According to the business strategy of Bosch in Vietnam, from 1st July 2014 on all business entities were merged into Bosch Vietnam Co. Ltd. with its head office at Ho Chi Minh City plant (HcP) in Dong Nai Province.
HcP has started its belt assembly in a rented building on 1st August 2008 as the assembly plant of Tilburg Plant (TbP). On 14th April 2011, HcP celebrated the inauguration of the new plant (Lth101 with 17,000 sqm), which did not only allow to increase the production depth, but also to facilitate the push belt assembly of this high-tech product. On 3rd July 2012 HcP marked a big milestone by starting to produce the second component (loop-set) for its push belt. Since November 2012, HcP doubled the production floor space and increase the net total floor space up to 56.000 m², and have successfully increased its production capacity and realized a lot of new line SOP’s.
For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn

With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Architect agentic systems — plan, memory, tool use, multi-agent delegation, evaluation loops, guardrails. Pick the right abstraction for the problem, not the one on the hype curve.
Push model capability into production. Design prompt and context strategies, tool interfaces, retrieval and reranking, structured output, streaming, and evaluation — across text and multimodal inputs (vision, documents, audio).
Own the evaluation story. Build offline eval sets, online LLM-as-judge loops, regression harnesses. Know the difference between a metric that moves your users and a metric that moves only your dashboard.
Squeeze the system. Prompt caching, batching, speculative decoding, model routing, token budget management, latency targets. Know your P50/P99 and why they look the way they do.
Contribute upstream. Read SDK source when docs are thin, open PRs against open-source agent frameworks, write crisp bug reports when a vendor's orchestration service returns a weird 500.
Mentor and set the bar. Your design reviews, code reviews and technical writing shape how the rest of the team thinks about agents.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor’s degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, or a related field.
1+ years of experience as an AI/AI Agent Engineer.
Solid ML fundamentals. You can explain transformers — attention, positional encoding, KV cache, tokenisation, sampling — without hand-waving. You've read at least a few core papers in full, not just the abstracts.
Deep LLM application experience. Multiple production systems built on top of frontier models (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, open-weight). You know the practical edge cases: tool-use stability, structured-output failure modes, long-context degradation, prompt-injection defence, cost control.
Agent systems depth. You've built something with real agent behaviour — planning, memory, tool orchestration, multi-step execution, error recovery — not a single prompt in a loop. Experience with multi-agent coordination (delegation, sub-agent protocols, MCP-style tool servers) is a strong plus.
Multimodal experience. Hands-on work with vision-language models, document AI (OCR, layout, tables), or audio — end-to-end from ingest to grounded output.
Strong engineering craft. Python at a senior level — async, typing, testing, packaging, observability. Able to read and navigate a large codebase. Git hygiene that makes reviewers' lives easier.
Production AI engineering. You can take ML, LLM, embedding, vision, or multimodal models from prototype to production — designing APIs and inference services, building RAG/embedding pipelines, containerizing workloads, handling CPU/GPU deployment, and optimizing latency, throughput, reliability, and cost.
AI platform & MLOps experience. Hands-on experience operating AI workloads in production with model/version management, CI/CD, evaluation gates, observability, autoscaling, rollback, and failure handling. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes/AKS, Azure AI services, GPU inference, or model-serving frameworks such as vLLM or NVIDIA Triton is a strong plus.
Fluent with modern coding agents. You use Claude Code / Cursor / Copilot / equivalents daily as a force multiplier. You understand where they shine and where they fail, and you can design prompts, context and tool boundaries to get the most out of them.
Communication. Writes and speaks clearly in English.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
We are building the next generation of production AI agent systems — systems that reason, plan, call tools, delegate across specialized sub-agents, and deliver real business outcomes end to end. We are looking for a senior engineer who has gone deep on modern machine learning, transformers and agents, and who wants to build at the frontier of what language models and multimodal systems can actually do in production today.
This is not a "wrap an API around an LLM" role. We expect candidates who understand why things work — the mechanics of attention, the failure modes of autoregressive decoding, the cost/latency trade-offs of caching and tool routing, the pitfalls of context engineering at scale. And who can turn that understanding into systems that ship, hold up under load, and keep improving.

Architect agentic systems — plan, memory, tool use, multi-agent delegation, evaluation loops, guardrails. Pick the right abstraction for the problem, not the one on the hype curve.
