sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
As a Embedded Senior System Test Engineer for Safety System ( such as: ABS/ESP/iBooster ), you will:
Run test cases and regression tests
Analyze defect and report defects
Clarify open points
Analyze requirements, design and develop test cases
Set up test environment: SIL (Software in Loop) & HIL (Hardware in Loop)
Coordinate team activities, and handle day-to-day work efficiently and independently
Running & Develop automation scripts
Set up, configure, and maintain LabCar test bench hardware and associated equipment
Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, wiring, communication, and integration issues on LabCar/HIL systems to ensure test bench availability
Support debugging activities involving ECU connections, CAN/LIN/Ethernet communication, measurement devices, and test automation infrastructure

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Major in Computer Engineering/ Information Technology/ Electrical-Electronics/ Electronics-Telecommunication/ Mechatronics Engineering/ Automotive or related fields
Have 0.5 + years of experience in Software Testing
Have knowledge about software life cycle
Strong in 1 of following programming language: C/C++/Python/VBA/Perl scripting language, API programming
Have basic knowledge of micro-controller and embedded system
Hands-on understanding of electronic hardware, circuit fundamentals, sensors, actuators, and automotive ECU architecture
Able to read wiring diagrams, hardware schematics, pinouts, and technical documentation
Knowledge of automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, FlexRay, and/or Automotive Ethernet
Ability to diagnose and resolve hardware-related issues using debugging and measurement tools such as oscilloscopes, CAN analyzers, multimeters, and logic analyzers
Good English communication skills
It would be BIG advantage if you have: Automotive domain knowledge
Exposure to emulators, simulators, debugging
Knowledge of UML and design techniques
ISTQB Foundation certificate
Chinese language

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Bosch first started its operations in Vietnam in 1994 and registered a wholly-owned subsidiary in 2008. According to the business strategy of Bosch in Vietnam, from 1st July 2014 on all business entities were merged into Bosch Vietnam Co. Ltd. with its head office at Ho Chi Minh City plant (HcP) in Dong Nai Province.
HcP has started its belt assembly in a rented building on 1st August 2008 as the assembly plant of Tilburg Plant (TbP). On 14th April 2011, HcP celebrated the inauguration of the new plant (Lth101 with 17,000 sqm), which did not only allow to increase the production depth, but also to facilitate the push belt assembly of this high-tech product. On 3rd July 2012 HcP marked a big milestone by starting to produce the second component (loop-set) for its push belt. Since November 2012, HcP doubled the production floor space and increase the net total floor space up to 56.000 m², and have successfully increased its production capacity and realized a lot of new line SOP’s.
For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn

sections.text:
The Role
As a Business Analyst, you will collaborate with our clients and delivery teams to discover and define requirements, form a vision, and successfully delivery solutions to end users.
Key Responsibilities
Work closely with stakeholders and users to acquire insights of the business regarding to objectives, risks with complete understanding of their expectation and demands
Evaluate business processes, anticipate requirements, uncover areas for prospective improvements, and consult the most possible solutions
Consolidate, analyze, elaborate, translate requirements into user stories and acceptance criteria. Then ensure the team understand the product requirements and the product is delivered at high quality
Compose and maintain requirement documents such as Business Requirement Document, Functional Requirement Specification, Flow chart data model...
Write user manuals, conducting user training sessions and tracking feedbacks
Use prototyping tool to design mockup/wireframe for application.
Prepare test cases and do a UAT
Developing wireframing, system UI/UX (Figma, Adobe Xd,…)
Clarify, update, prioritize and manage the product backlog
Lead ongoing reviews of business processes and developing optimization strategies by continuously being up-to-date on the latest methodologies and IT advancements to automate and modernize systems
Supporting product owners through Scrum activities or playing the role of product owner when required

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor's Degree in IT, Computer Science, Information System, or relevant majors
Good at English communication in both written and verbal skills
Hands-on at least 3 years of experience in SW/IT project as Business Analyst role
Advanced proficiency in using suitable tools for business modeling, drawing business flows/diagrams
Team player, able to work independently and cooperatively with other BA, developers, testers and PM.
Experience in owning product and working cross-functionally with development teams to manage the day to day activities
Strong problem-solving, logical thinking, critical thinking, attention to details
Strong analytical and problem solving abilities Strong communication and client facing skills. Ability to influence stakeholders and work closely with them to determine best solutions
Solid understanding and knowledge about technical, system architecture, coding languages or database is plus

Assist continuous improvement in the team, for example, working process, team’s knowledge sharing and documentation, work quality, and harmonization among sub-teams.

sections.text:
Bosch first started in Vietnam with a representative office in 1994. Bosch has its main office in Ho Chi Minh City, with branch offices in Hanoi and Da Nang, and a Powertrain Solutions plant in the Dong Nai province to manufacture pushbelt for continuously variable transmissions (CVT) in automobiles. In addition, Bosch operates a software and engineering R&D center (Robert Bosch Engineering and Business Solutions Vietnam Co., Ltd).
In July 2014, Bosch set up a new Automotive R&D Center, located in Ho Chi Minh City. sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Role Purpose
The Senior Demand Planner is responsible for developing and maintaining a robust, accurate, and commercially aligned demand plan across ASEAN markets. The role translates market intelligence, customer requirements, commercial strategies, historical demand, and statistical analysis into a reliable demand signal that supports optimal inventory, service levels, and business performance.
As a senior individual contributor, the role acts as a regional demand planning subject matter expert and key business partner to Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Planning, and country organizations.
Key Responsibilities
Demand Planning
Own the end-to-end demand planning process for an assigned portfolio across ASEAN markets.
Develop and maintain accurate statistical and consensus forecasts across multiple products, markets, customers, and channels.
Analyze historical demand, trends, seasonality, promotions, new product introductions, and market dynamics to identify demand patterns and risks.
Incorporate commercial intelligence and market insights into the statistical baseline to create a robust consensus forecast.
Identify significant forecast deviations, demand risks, and opportunities and proactively recommend corrective actions.
Ensure timely and accurate maintenance of demand plans within the planning system.
S&OP
Actively participate in and prepare the regional S&OP process.
Prepare demand reviews, forecast analysis, and scenario assessments for cross-functional and management discussions.
Challenge market assumptions and facilitate alignment between commercial teams and supply chain.
Highlight gaps between demand, supply, inventory, and financial plans.
Support scenario modelling to assess the potential impact of market changes, promotions, product launches, and other business events.
Business Partnering
Build strong working relationships with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Planning, Customer Service, and country stakeholders.
Act as the key demand planning contact for assigned ASEAN markets and/or product portfolios.
Translate commercial plans and market developments into quantified demand requirements.
Constructively challenge stakeholder forecasts using data and fact-based analysis.
Provide clear recommendations and insights rather than simply reporting forecast numbers.
Provide monthly turnover projection to markets and engage logistics to ensure timely fulfillment
Forecast Performance & Analytics
Monitor and improve key demand planning KPIs, including forecast accuracy, forecast bias and forecast value-add.
Conduct root-cause analysis of forecast errors and develop corrective actions.
Use data analytics to identify trends, anomalies, demand shifts, and potential supply chain risks.
Leverage statistical forecasting, automation, and digital tools to improve planning efficiency and quality.
Key Performance Indicators
Forecast Accuracy
Service Level + Customer Backlog
Inventory
Turnover achievement
Scope
Geography: ASEAN
Key Interfaces: Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Planning, Logistics, Customer Service and Country Management
Leadership: Functional leadership and stakeholder influence without direct people-management responsibility

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Economics, or a related discipline.
5–8+ years of experience in demand planning, supply planning, S&OP/IBP, or a related supply chain function.
Proven experience managing demand planning across multiple markets, preferably within ASEAN.
Strong understanding of forecasting methodologies, statistical forecasting, and demand planning processes.
Strong analytical skills and ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.
Experience working with SAP and Maestro is a plus.
Strong understanding of the end-to-end supply chain and the relationship between demand, supply, inventory, and customer service.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
Comfortable challenging commercial assumptions and influencing stakeholders without formal authority.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
This position will be contracted through Bosch’s external vendor under a one-year agreement.
We are looking for an Automotive Diagnostic Software Engineer (2-3 Years of Experience) to join our automotive engineering team. The candidate will be involved in the development of diagnostic software solutions for modern vehicles, working with standard automotive diagnostic protocols and performing validation directly on test vehicles.
This role requires a solid foundation in automotive engineering, hands-on testing capabilities, and flexibility to travel internationally.
Main responsibilities
Mapping of ESI standard texts to OEM texts for the Automotive Aftersales & Aftermarket diagnostic tester software.
Requirement specification for Automotive Aftersales & Aftermarket diagnostic tester software.
End to end diagnostic content creation for all automotive systems e.g., engine management, electric & hybrid systems, brake control, infotainment, ADAS, transmission, HVAC, airbags etc.
Analysis of vehicle communication bus logs using various analyzers.
Simulation of automotive systems using simulator solutions and in conjunction with OE testers.
Design & creation of workflow or test sequences in Bosch standard tools
Evaluation of OE diagnostic data, derivation of useful insights and implementing the same in target tester.
On-vehicle validation of implemented diagnostic content and creation of test reports.
Benchmarking and reverse engineering of aftersales & aftermarket diagnostic testers.
Coverage evaluation of aftermarket tester by performing tests on various vehicle brands and systems, in various markets & create test reports.
Thorough review the deliverables and provide recommendations.
Continuous learning and self-development.
Closely interact with software engineering team and technical experts from global teams.
Travel to Workshops/OE dealerships on need basis for on the vehicle coverage, tracing, and release testing.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Mandatory Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Automotive Engineering
Automotive Mechatronics Certification (Chứng chỉ Cơ điện tử Ô tô)
Strong vehicle system knowledge, including the sub-systems and components.
Must have proven ability to diagnose and troubleshoot vehicle and make it roadworthy.
Ability to understand OE system description, service & repair manuals.
Ability to handle diagnostic testers like VIDA, Xentry, GDS, ADT, SDT-II, DiagBox, HDS, Launch, Autel, G-Scan, Zenith etc.
Good knowledge on wiring diagrams and conventions.
Good knowledge of Bosch Aftermarket Diagnostic Tool - ESI [tronic].
Sound knowledge on CAN, CAN FD, DoIP, UDS, J1939.
Experience with analyzer & simulation tools from Vector or Samtec e.g., HSX, HS+ etc.
Handling of various OEM testers

sections.text:
Build the Future of Enterprise User Experiences
Join Bosch Vietnam’s Global Product & Service organization to shape next-generation workflow platforms used by 500,000+ users worldwide.
We are looking for a Lead Front-End Developer who combines strong technical leadership, front-end architecture expertise, and UX engineering mindset to deliver scalable, high-performance, and intuitive enterprise applications. You will lead front-end strategy and engineering excellence for complex workflow automation platforms — including real-time dashboards, workflow builders, and data-intensive enterprise applications used globally across regions and business functions.
Key Responsibilities
Technical strategy and architecture: Define the front-end architecture (React + TypeScript primary) including state management patterns, choosing frameworks and patterns that ensure scalability and maintainability. Drive API contract discipline with backend and define caching/streaming strategies for real-time data.
Design System Management: Own and scale the Bosch Digital Design System and component library, ensuring pixel-perfect consistency across all regions and product modules. You will ensure Bosch Corporate Design is applied correctly.
Workflow Automation UX: Design and implement intuitive interfaces for complex logic, such as drag-and-drop workflow builders, real-time data dashboards, and integration of wizards.
Design system leadership: Own and evolve the component library and design tokens (theming, dark/HC modes); govern adoption via Storybook, documentation, and CI gates (lint, a11y, visual regression). Ensure consistency and scalability across modules and international variants.
Global readiness (i18n, a11y, performance): Ensure high performance across varying network conditions and localized support for multiple languages and regional data standards.
Engineering excellence and security: Build a testing strategy and implement CI/CD quality gates, bundle analysis, and static checks.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with UX/UI designers to bridge the gap between high-fidelity designs and technical feasibility, and with backend teams to define robust API contracts.
Team Mentorship: Mentor engineers, lead code reviews, establish engineering standards and playbooks, and contribute to hiring and onboarding

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Must-Have:
Education: Bachelor’s or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
Experience: 7+ years of professional front-end experience, including 3+ years leading teams or major initiatives on large-scale web apps.
Core Languages: Expert in modern JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3 (Sass/CSS Modules) and modern layout.
Frameworks: Extensive experience with React, Angular, or Vue.js, including state management (e.g., Redux, MobX). React proficiency building reusable, stateful components and hooks; strong command of state management.
Design system adoption across 2+ product modules with documented components and usage guidelines.
Build & Deployment: Proficiency with Git-based workflows, and CI/CD (GitHub Actions/GitLab CI/Jenkins) with quality gates.
Testing: Strong background in automated testing frameworks like Jest, Cypress, or Playwright.
Deep understanding of Web Accessibility (WCAG) and SEO best practices.
Localized experiences delivered in multiple languages, including at least one RTL locale.
Security awareness (OWASP front-end risks, XSS/CSP, secure handling of untrusted content).
Agile Mindset: Proven track record of delivering in fast-paced, sprint-based global environments.
Global Mindset: Experience delivering software that accounts for regional cultural nuances and varied internet speeds.
Nice-to-Have:
Workflow Expertise : Experience building tools for IT operations, project management, or SaaS automation is highly desirable.
Project Management: Ability to manage timelines, define technical roadmaps, and communicate progress to senior stakeholders.
Design token pipelines (Style Dictionary), Storybook, Chromatic/visual regression testing.
Observability (Sentry, Datadog), feature flagging, A/B testing.
Experience with distributed teams and varying network conditions across regions.
Measurable improvements in Core Web Vitals and interaction latency on at least one high-traffic workflow.

Job Description
Responsible for all aspects of project management related to project initiation, planning, executing, monitoring and controlling and closing for mid-level projects (stretching to high-level projects). Building and managing project teams, acting as Agile Coachers or Scrum Masters, communicating status to the Project Sponsors, customer and other key stakeholders. Ensures quality control and keeps project within budget throughout project life cycles. Is the caretaker for all issues coming up during project run-time. Manages all aspects of the project to reach project success based upon the project goal.
Your role will include, but will not be limited to, the following:
Leads mid-size projects (stretching to high-size projects ) consulting the customer to identify the fastest and most efficient way to implement customer requirements.
Understands the customer's business requirements and creates the respective project plan to achieve success.
Plans, manages, oversees and controls multiple project teams ensuring successful delivery of all key project outcomes which includes developing work plans, gathering relevant data, leading analytical efforts, and developing final recommendations.
Defines and monitors key performance indicators/metrics to measure initiative successes and initiates corrective action as necessary.
Is aware of the strategic direction of the customer (and internal operating units), knows the existing IT architecture and is able to set up the necessary steps to achieve the project goals that fit into the overall strategy.
Ensures that the scope of the project is defined, complete, communicated and agreed upon and that it supports the objectives of the business strategy and addresses the specific business need.
Follows Bosch procedures and guidelines for Project Excellence and complies with IT ISO Bosch requirements.
Monitors progress against the plan and initiates corrective action as necessary.
In agile projects, is able to fosters the agile mindset, leads agile teams and supports all agile ceremonies
Works diligently to remove project team impediments and coaches the teams to deliver project objectives
Resolves issues and solves problems throughout the project life cycle.
Creates high-quality, actionable recommendations, ensuring timely completion of project deliverables and buy-in of stakeholders
Provides senior level presentations on status which may include milestone achievement, financials, resource needs; and progress on deliverables, risks and issues.
Leads, coaches, mentors and motivates project team members on a proactive basis.
Participates in the coordination and delivery of project management training for junior-level project managers.

Ltd. with its head office at Ho Chi Minh City plant (HcP) in Dong Nai Province.

sections.text:
Are you ready to launch your career at the forefront of software innovation?
At Bosch Vietnam, our Global Product & Service team builds best-in-class digital products using the latest technologies—from Low-Code/No-Code platforms to GenAI solutions. We are seeking passionate and high potential talents for our OutSystems Developer Internship Program , where you will gain real-world experience shaping software that serves haft million users across the globe.
As an intern, you will be immersed in a world-class product environment where you will:
Receive structured, in-depth training on complex enterprise systems and modern technology frameworks.
Collaborate with talented engineers and product experts in a global team, mastering professional software development practices, agile delivery, and CI/CD workflows.
Work on high-impact features that directly contribute to our global platforms.
Grow with us through continuous coaching and hands-on learning, with a clear opportunity to transition into a full-time role reserved for top-performing and high potential interns.
If you’re eager to challenge yourself, sharpen your skills every day, and be part of a team that driving innovation, excellence, and global collaboration—we believe you will thrive at Bosch Vietnam.
Key responsibilities:
Design, develop, and implement solutions using OutSystems
Customize entities, workflows, business rules, and forms in OutSystems.
Develop plugins, custom workflow activities, and client-side scripts.
Integrate OutSystems with external systems using APIs and other tools.
Collaborate with functional consultants, business analysts, and end-users from partner Business Units to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Provide ongoing support and enhancements to existing solutions.
Ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices.

sections.text:
The Bosch Training Center East Asia ( C/BTC-EA) is a newly established regional learning organization formed through the integration of the Bosch Training Center ASEAN (C/BTC-AS) and Bosch Training Center Japan (C/BTC-JP), effective 1 September 2026.
C/BTC-EA is responsible for driving learning and capability development across East Asia, covering ASEAN, Japan, and Korea, while collaborating closely with global Bosch learning networks and stakeholders.
C/BTC-EA is looking for a Learning & Development Specialist to lead their Learning & Development strategy advocating a learning culture across East Asia. As it is currently in the integration journey, this position offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the development of a new regional organization, shape future ways of working, and gain firsthand experience in organizational integration and transformation within a multinational environment.
Reporting directly to the Regional Head of Learning and Development, East Asia, you will work with diverse stakeholders across countries and functions, supporting learning initiatives in an increasingly regional and global context.
This role is ideal for learning professionals who are passionate about people development, enjoy working across cultures, and aspire to broaden their exposure in a dynamic international environment.
In this role, you will work as:
Manage assigned learning portfolios and support the implementation of learning and development initiatives across East Asia (ASEAN, Japan, and Korea).
Act as a learning consultant to identify capability development needs and recommend appropriate learning solutions.
Design, coordinate, and deliver learning programs, workshops, and learning events in various learning formats.
Collaborate with business leaders, HR, trainers, vendors, and other stakeholders to ensure effective learning delivery and learner engagement.
Support C/BTC-EA communication, promotion, learning analytics, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Lead and manage regional/global projects if assigned.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Education, Psychology, or a related field.
Minimum 3 years of experience in Learning & Development, Human Resources, Talent Development, Organizational Development, or related areas.
Good understanding of learning methodologies and adult learning principles.
Strong project coordination, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work effectively in a multicultural and regional environment.
Proficiency in English and Vietnamese.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (experience with learning platforms or LMS is an advantage).

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services, in the areas of automotive and industrial technology, consumer goods as well as building technology.
Bosch established its first representative office in Ho Chi Minh City in 1994. Since 2007, Bosch has expanded its footprint in Vietnam where it has branch offices in Hanoi and Da Nang, as well as a Powertrain Solutions plant in the Dong Nai province to manufacture pushbelts for continuously variable transmissions (CVT) in automobiles. In addition, Bosch operates Bosch Global Software Technologies Vietnam (BGSV) as well as an automotive R&D center for mobility solutions in Ho Chi Minh City. As of December 31 2023, Bosch employed approximately 6,300 associates in Vietnam. Bosch has diversified businesses in Vietnam. Today, all four Bosch business sectors, namely Mobility Solutions, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology have operations in the country. Bosch Vietnam is currently active with many business divisions: Mobility Aftermarket, Drive and Control Technology, Power Tools, Building Technology, Two-Wheeler and Powersports and Sales Original Equipment, AquaEasy, Home Appliances and Supply Chain Consulting.
Additional information is available online at: https://www.bosch.com.vn/ , https://www.linkedin.com/company/bosch-vietnam and https://www.facebook.com/OfficialBoschVietnam

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Join a high-performing, global team building internal IT solutions for a 500,000-user organization. You will consult directly with business stakeholders to co-create new workflow applications end-to-end, translate complex needs into clear requirements, and steer Agile delivery with UX and engineering—so solutions land on time, intuitive, and enterprise-grade. Your mix of consulting finesse, technical fluency, and product mindset will shape our next-gen workflow platform and amplify business impact.
Key Responsibilities:
Consult & discover : engage customers, map processes, and translate business needs into epics, user stories, SRS, and acceptance criteria that guide delivery.
Own requirements end-to-end : drive elicitation, refinement, traceability, and scope control; capture non-functional requirements (security, performance, availability, usability).
Design best-in-class applications : co-create solution options, wireframes/prototypes, and service flows with UX and engineering to ensure cohesive, intuitive experiences.
Modernize & migrate : analyze legacy workflows, identify gaps, and lead migration to target platforms with minimal disruption.
Lead Agile execution : orchestrate backlog grooming, sprint planning, reviews/demos, and stakeholder alignment on priorities and trade-offs.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
About the Role
We are recruiting motivated interns to design, build, and integrate AI-Agents and automation tools that enhance engineering efficiency across AUTOSAR, embedded firmware, and cybersecurity workflows. You will work closely with our project teams to prototype agents, automate developer tasks, and integrate with existing toolchains (e.g., Jira, Git/GitHub, CI/CD, Confluence).
This role is ideal for students or fresh graduates who enjoy solving practical engineering problems with AI and automation, and who want hands-on experience in automotive software development.
Responsibilities
• Design and implement AI-Agents to streamline tasks such as code review, requirements mapping, test generation and log analysis.
• Build automation scripts and services that integrate with engineering tools (Jira, Git/GitHub, CI/CD, Confluence) and project workflows.
• Develop utilities for embedded firmware, AUTOSAR and cybersecurity
• Collaborate with engineers to define user requirements, success criteria, and evaluation metrics (effort/time savings, adoption readiness, scalability).
• Document solutions (quick-start guides, examples, contribution templates) to enable cross-team adoption.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Required Qualifications
• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
• Programming skills in Python or C/C++.
• Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to write clear documentation.
• Good communication and teamwork skills; ability to gather requirements and iterate on feedback.
What You Will Learn
• How to design AI-Agents that scale across teams.
• Best practices for integrating agents with enterprise engineering toolchains.
• Practical AUTOSAR and embedded development workflows.
• Cybersecurity automation in an automotive context.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services, in the areas of automotive and industrial technology, consumer goods as well as building technology.
Bosch established its first representative office in Ho Chi Minh City in 1994. Since 2007, Bosch has expanded its footprint in Vietnam where it has branch offices in Hanoi and Da Nang, as well as a Powertrain Solutions plant in the Dong Nai province to manufacture pushbelts for continuously variable transmissions (CVT) in automobiles. In addition, Bosch operates Bosch Global Software Technologies Vietnam (BGSV) as well as an automotive R&D center for mobility solutions in Ho Chi Minh City. As of December 31 2023, Bosch employed approximately 6,300 associates in Vietnam. Bosch has diversified businesses in Vietnam. Today, all four Bosch business sectors, namely Mobility Solutions, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology have operations in the country. Bosch Vietnam is currently active with many business divisions: Mobility Aftermarket, Drive and Control Technology, Power Tools, Building Technology, Two-Wheeler and Powersports and Sales Original Equipment, AquaEasy, Home Appliances and Supply Chain Consulting.
Additional information is available online at: https://www.bosch.com.vn/ , https://www.linkedin.com/company/bosch-vietnam and https://www.facebook.com/OfficialBoschVietnam

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Bosch first started its operations in Vietnam in 1994 and registered a wholly-owned subsidiary in 2008. According to the business strategy of Bosch in Vietnam, from 1st July 2014 on all business entities were merged into Bosch Vietnam Co. Ltd. with its head office at Ho Chi Minh City plant (HcP) in Dong Nai Province.
HcP has started its belt assembly in a rented building on 1st August 2008 as the assembly plant of Tilburg Plant (TbP). On 14th April 2011, HcP celebrated the inauguration of the new plant (Lth101 with 17,000 sqm), which did not only allow to increase the production depth, but also to facilitate the push belt assembly of this high-tech product. On 3rd July 2012 HcP marked a big milestone by starting to produce the second component (loop-set) for its push belt. Since November 2012, HcP doubled the production floor space and increase the net total floor space up to 56.000 m², and have successfully increased its production capacity and realized a lot of new line SOP’s.
For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn

Since 2007, Bosch has expanded its footprint in Vietnam where it has branch offices in Hanoi and Da Nang, as well as a Powertrain Solutions plant in the Dong Nai province to manufacture pushbelts for continuously variable transmissions (CVT) in automobiles. In addition, Bosch operates Bosch Global Software Technologies Vietnam (BGSV) as well as an automotive R&D center for mobility solutions in Ho Chi Minh City. As of December 31 2023, Bosch employed approximately 6,300 associates in Vietnam. Bosch has diversified businesses in Vietnam. Today, all four Bosch business sectors, namely Mobility Solutions, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology have operations in the country. Bosch Vietnam is currently active with many business divisions: Mobility Aftermarket, Drive and Control Technology, Power Tools, Building Technology, Two-Wheeler and Powersports and Sales Original Equipment, AquaEasy, Home Appliances and Supply Chain Consulting.
Additional information is available online at: https://www.bosch.com.vn/ , https://www.linkedin.com/company/bosch-vietnam and https://www.facebook.com/OfficialBoschVietnam

sections.text:

Ltd. with its head office at Ho Chi Minh City plant (HcP) in Dong Nai Province.

sections.text:
Why BOSCH?
Because we do not just follow trends, we create them. Together we turn ideas into reality, working every day to make the world of tomorrow a better place. Do you have high standards when it comes to your job? So do we. At Bosch, you will discover more than just work.

Monthly Internship allowance + Meal & Parking allowance

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Since the beginning of 2013, its operations have been divided into four business sectors: Automotive Technology, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology.
The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 360 subsidiaries and regional companies in some 50 countries. If its sales and service partners are included, then Bosch is represented in roughly 150 countries. This worldwide development, manufacturing, and sales network is the foundation for further growth.
Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) i s 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH - one of the world’s leading global suppliers of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.
Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region.
With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
About the Role
We are looking for an experienced Sales Manager or Senior Sales Executive to drive business growth for our Industrial Software and IT/Engineering Services portfolio in the Vietnamese market.
This is a customer-facing business development role with ownership across the end-to-end sales cycle — from identifying new opportunities and engaging key decision-makers to developing solutions, negotiating, and closing deals .
You will work closely with our Delivery and Technical Expert teams to translate customer business challenges into relevant technology and engineering solutions, while building long-term strategic relationships with customers.
The ideal candidate brings a strong track record in B2B technology or engineering services sales , particularly in areas such as MES, Industrial IoT, ESG solutions, software development, software validation, or related digital/engineering services .
Your Key Responsibilities
Lead Generation: Develop and execute effective lead generation strategies to identify and qualify potential customers
Sales Pipeline Management: Manage and nurture a robust sales pipeline to drive revenue growth.
Customer Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and decision-makers.
Thought Leadership: Develop and deliver thought leadership content (e.g., presentations, articles, webinars) to position the company as an industry expert and attract potential customers.
Team Collaboration: Work closely with the Delivery and Expert teams to ensure smooth project execution, address customer needs, and provide exceptional service.
Market Analysis: Conduct market research and identify new business opportunities.
Sales Process Improvement: Continuously refining sales processes and methodologies to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
Competitive Analysis: Stay informed about industry trends, competitors, and market dynamics.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Information Technology , or a related field.
8+ years of experience in B2B sales, business development, or account management within the software, IT, engineering, or technology industry.
Proven track record in selling Industrial Software and/or IT & Engineering Services , such as: Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES)
Industrial IoT / Industry 4.0 solutions
ESG or sustainability-related digital solutions
Software development services
Software testing and validation services
Other industrial digitalization or engineering services
Demonstrated ability to develop new accounts and close complex B2B deals .
Strong skills in prospecting, consultative/solution selling, negotiation, and stakeholder management.
Good understanding of the Vietnamese B2B technology and industrial market .
Strong business communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively with technical, engineering, and delivery teams.
Fluent communication skills in Vietnamese and English .
It'd be great advantage (not mandatory) if you have Experience selling Industrial Software, IT, or Engineering Services to large enterprises or multinational corporations .

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Job Summary
We are looking for a UX/UI Designer with Business Analysis capabilities to design intuitive, user-centered digital experiences. This role is primarily focused on UX/UI design , while also bridging business needs and user expectations through structured analysis.
The ideal candidate excels at understanding user behavior, translating business requirements into design solutions , and delivering visually engaging, functional interfaces.
Main Roles and Responsibilities
UX/UI Design (Primary Focus)
Design user-centered interfaces for web and/or mobile applications.
Create wireframes, mockups, prototypes, and design specifications .
Define and improve user journeys, flows, and interaction models .
Ensure consistency across UI components and design systems .
Conduct usability testing and iterate designs based on feedback.
Collaborate with developers to ensure accurate implementation of designs .
Business Analysis (Supporting Role)
Gather and clarify business and user requirements from stakeholders.
Translate requirements into user stories, use cases, and functional specs .
Align design solutions with business goals and product strategy .
Facilitate discussions between business, technical teams, and users .
Support backlog refinement and prioritization .
Collaboration & Continuous Improvement
Work closely with Product Owners, Developers, and stakeholders .
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies .
Advocate for user experience best practices across the team.
Continuously improve design processes, tools, and standards.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Mandatory Qualifications
Bachelor’s degree in Design, HCI, Business, IT, or related field .
2–5 years of experience in UX/UI design (with some BA exposure).
Strong portfolio demonstrating UX/UI design process and outcomes .
Proficiency in design tools (Figma, Adobe XD, Sketch, or similar) .
Preferred Qualifications
Experience conducting user research and usability testing .
Familiarity with design systems and accessibility standards .
Basic understanding of front-end technologies (HTML/CSS/JS) .
Experience working in Agile environments .
Ability to use data/analytics to inform design decisions .
Personal Qualities
Strong empathy for users and attention to detail.
Creative thinking with a structured, analytical mindset.
Ability to balance business needs and user experience .
Proactive, collaborative, and solution-oriented.
Solid understanding of user-centered design principles .
Ability to create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs .
Experience in requirements gathering and documentation .
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

sections.text:
Job Purpose
We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Key User Manager to drive sales, profit, and strategic relationships with large professional users in the Construction, Infrastructure, and Energy sectors in Southern Vietnam. The role focuses on developing long-term partnerships with major construction contractors, waterproofing & civil contractors, power & energy plants, electrical panel manufacturers, and utility companies.
Core Responsibilities
Full ownership of sales turnover and profit targets for assigned Key Professional Users (KPUs) in the Construction & Energy segment in Southern Vietnam.
Identify, acquire, and develop new key professional users while expanding and deepening the existing customer portfolio.
Build and maintain strong, long-term strategic relationships with decision-makers (C-level, Project Directors, Technical Managers, Procurement Heads) at large construction companies, EPC contractors, and energy/utility firms.
Implement central user-marketing strategies and develop customer-specific solutions to increase Bosch Power Tools market share.
Ensure the optimal product and service mix tailored to each key user’s specific applications and requirements (construction sites, infrastructure projects, power plants, electrical systems).

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Bosch first started its operations in Vietnam in 1994 and registered a wholly-owned subsidiary in 2008. According to the business strategy of Bosch in Vietnam, from 1st July 2014 on all business entities were merged into Bosch Vietnam Co. Ltd. with its head office at Ho Chi Minh City plant (HcP) in Dong Nai Province.
HcP has started its belt assembly in a rented building on 1st August 2008 as the assembly plant of Tilburg Plant (TbP). Since November 2012, HcP doubled the production floor space and increase the net total floor space up to 56.000 m², and have successfully increased its production capacity and realized a lot of new line SOP’s.
For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn

sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services, in the areas of automotive and industrial technology, consumer goods as well as building technology.
Bosch established its first representative office in Ho Chi Minh City in 1994. Since 2007, Bosch has expanded its footprint in Vietnam where it has branch offices in Hanoi and Da Nang, as well as a Powertrain Solutions plant in the Dong Nai province to manufacture pushbelts for continuously variable transmissions (CVT) in automobiles. In addition, Bosch operates Bosch Global Software Technologies Vietnam (BGSV) as well as an automotive R&D center for mobility solutions in Ho Chi Minh City. As of December 31 2023, Bosch employed approximately 6,300 associates in Vietnam. Bosch has diversified businesses in Vietnam. Today, all four Bosch business sectors, namely Mobility Solutions, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology have operations in the country. Bosch Vietnam is currently active with many business divisions: Mobility Aftermarket, Drive and Control Technology, Power Tools, Building Technology, Two-Wheeler and Powersports and Sales Original Equipment, AquaEasy, Home Appliances and Supply Chain Consulting.
Additional information is available online at: https://www.bosch.com.vn/ , https://www.linkedin.com/company/bosch-vietnam and https://www.facebook.com/OfficialBoschVietnam

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
🚀 Senior Automation Test Engineer
AI Global Product | AI-Native Workflow Platform | NCLC + Agentic AI | 500,000 Users Worldwide
🌍 Engineer Quality for Intelligent Workflows
Our Global Product & Service Team is building a next-generation workflow and approval platform serving nearly 500,000 users .
Built on NCLC and evolving through automation, and Agentic AI, the platform supports mission-critical processes across a global corporation.
This is not a short-term testing assignment. It is a long-term AI product transformation where quality, automation, reliability, and customer trust are critical.
We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Automation Test Engineer with deep hands-on expertise, strong product thinking, and the ambition to modernize testing through AI.
This is not only about finding defects. It is about engineering quality into a global AI product from requirements to production
✨ Why This Opportunity
You will help build the quality foundation of an AI-native enterprise product used by nearly half a million people.
Your work will directly influence:
Product reliability and production stability
Automation coverage and regression efficiency
Release confidence and delivery speed
Customer satisfaction and platform trust
AI adoption across the testing lifecycle.
If you want to move beyond traditional testing and build intelligent, scalable automation at global scale, this role is for you.
🎯 Your Mission
Design, build, and continuously improve automation solutions using Playwright and Python .
Working with Product, Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, and Operations, you will embed quality throughout the product lifecycle and enable faster, more reliable releases.
🧠 Key Responsibilities
1. Requirements and Test Design
Analyze requirements, designs, user stories, and acceptance criteria
Identify ambiguity, risks, dependencies, edge cases, and negative scenarios early
Design and review test scenarios, test cases, and automation scripts
Apply risk-based and shift-left testing to critical business journeys
Ensure traceability between requirements, tests, defects, and releases
2. Automation Engineering
Design and maintain scalable frameworks using Playwright with Python
Automate web applications, APIs, integrations, workflows, permissions, and approvals
Build reusable components and effective test-data solutions
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Improve test stability, maintainability, reporting, and execution speed
Eliminate flaky tests and automation bottlenecks
Perform exploratory and manual testing where it provides greater value
3. Integration and Performance Quality
Validate complex end-to-end workflows across multiple systems
Execute API, integration, performance, load, scalability, and resilience testing
Collaborate with Architecture, DevOps, Security, and Operations to validate non-functional requirements
Ensure platform reliability for mission-critical global operations
4. AI-Driven Quality Engineering
Apply AI to requirement analysis, test generation, test data, automation, defect analysis, and regression optimization
Explore Agentic AI for intelligent test execution, monitoring, and continuous improvement
Ensure human review, traceability, security, and governance for AI-generated assets
Measure AI impact through coverage, defect detection, productivity, and cycle-time improvements
5. Quality Reporting and Collaboration
Monitor test execution, defects, automation health, and release risks
Create clear dashboards and evidence-based quality reports
Convert findings into concrete recommendations and improvement actions
Support root-cause analysis and preventive measures
Share automation best practices and mentor other QA Engineers
Promote quality as a shared product responsibility
🌟 What You Will Gain
Engineer quality for a product serving nearly 500,000 users worldwide
Shape automation and AI-enabled testing for a long-term global transformation
Gain hands-on experience with NCLC, and Agentic AI
Solve complex enterprise challenges across workflows and integrations
Create measurable achievements in reliability, automation, and delivery efficiency
Grow into a future-ready AI-enabled Quality Engineer
🤝 Who Will Thrive Here
You will succeed if you:
Want to build scalable automation, not only execute tests
Challenge risks and unclear requirements early
Balance automation with exploratory and risk-based testing
Use data to improve quality decisions
Apply AI responsibly to real engineering challenges
Take long-term ownership and remain accountable through complexity
“I helped build the intelligent quality foundation of a global AI-native product used by nearly half a million people.”
🧩 Selection Challenge
Shortlisted candidates may complete a practical assignment covering:
Test strategy for a critical workflow
Playwright and Python automation design
API and integration testing
CI/CD execution and reporting
Flaky-test prevention and framework maintainability
Practical AI use cases in testing
We evaluate technical quality, test design, maintainability, product thinking, AI maturity, and communication.
📩 Ready to Engineer Quality at Global Scale?
If you want to go beyond traditional testing, apply AI to real engineering challenges, and influence a product serving nearly half a million users, this is your opportunity.
Join us and build the intelligent quality foundation for the future of global workflows.

sections.text:
The Senior Engineer - Data Science & Analytics is responsible for developing and implementing data-driven solutions to address complex business and technical requirements. This role involves analyzing large datasets, building predictive models, and creating visualizations to generate actionable insights for stakeholders across the organization.
Main Roles and Responsibilities
Develop statistical models and machine learning algorithms to identify trends, patterns, and correlations in large-scale datasets as per communication and alignment with customer or customer interface .
Design and build data visualizations, dashboards, and reports to communicate analytical findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Perform exploratory data analysis and feature engineering to prepare and enrich datasets for modelling and analysis
Apply advanced statistical techniques to solve classification, regression, and clustering problems.
Utilize programming languages and data manipulation libraries to clean, transform, and analyze data efficiently.
Validate model performance and ensure the reliability and accuracy of analytical solutions through rigorous testing and evaluation methodologies.
Contribute to technical design reviews by providing data-driven perspectives and collaborating with team members on solution improvements.
Support team members by sharing knowledge of data science techniques, troubleshooting complex analytical problems, and participating in peer code reviews.
Ensure compliance with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, company policies, and quality frameworks applicable to the role and assigned projects.
Perform other tasks as assigned by Managers.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Job Requirements
At least 3–4 years of experience .
Proven professional experience in data science or analytics, with demonstrated experience in building and deploying machine learning models.
Proven experience with modern data science frameworks and libraries (e.g., Scikit-learn, Pandas, TensorFlow, PyTorch) is required.
Experience with Data Warehouse (Vault Design) .
Ability to implement solutions from scratch and build products across the full product lifecycle based on the following requirements: Data Science & Statistical Modeling: Statistical Inference, Machine Learning, Model Validation & Evaluation, NLP
Data Engineering & Data Pipeline: Data Management, Data Modelling & Design, Python, R
ML Deployment & MLOps: Machine Learning Model Deployment, MLOps / ML Lifecycle Management
AI / Deep Learning Technologies: PyTorch, Keras, Large Language Models (LLMs), Vector DB
Proficient in English Communication.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.
Nice to Have
A Master’s degree is preferred.
Proficiency in Excel / Office Applications, data presentation, and business-facing analytics.

sections.text:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Packaging Data & Material Compliance Associate to support packaging data management, material compliance activities, and master data optimization. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining packaging-related data accuracy, coordinating with suppliers, and ensuring compliance documentation is properly collected, analyzed, and archived.
Key Responsibilities
Receive, review, and validate Packaging Bills of Materials (BOMs) and breakdown BOM structures from manufacturing plants.
Research, analyze, and identify material substances in articles using available technical and regulatory information.
Collect, review, and maintain REACH and other material compliance declarations from suppliers.
Coordinate with suppliers to obtain required compliance information, supporting statements, and regulatory documentation.
Upload compliance documentation and maintain case records in Jira and other designated systems.
Maintain and optimize packaging master data to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Correct inaccurate special dimensions for packing units within packaging BOMs using PackIT.
Identify and correct non-plausible packaging weights and other master data inconsistencies.
Review and update stacking factors for inbound packaging BOMs to ensure operational accuracy.
Organize, archive, and maintain supporting documentation, including supplier communications, compliance statements, and audit evidence.
Monitor task progress and provide regular status updates to internal stakeholders.
Participate in regular alignment meetings and support continuous process improvement initiatives.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, Environmental Science, Chemistry, Business Administration, or a related field.
1-3 years of experience in supply chain management, packaging engineering, master data management, material compliance, or a related operational support function.
Experience working with packaging BOMs, material master data, or product compliance processes is advantageous.
Experience coordinating with suppliers and international stakeholders is preferred.
Good understanding of Bills of Materials (BOM), packaging structures, and master data management.
Familiarity with material compliance regulations such as REACH, SCIP, RoHS, or similar regulatory frameworks.
Experience with SAP, Jira or comparable enterprise systems is an advantage.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and other Microsoft Office applications.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
Strong communication skills and ability to coordinate effectively with suppliers and global stakeholders.
Good written and spoken English.
Additional German language skills are considered an advantage.

discovery:smartrecruiters:BoschGroup:744.description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Packaging Data & Material Compliance Associate to support packaging data management, material compliance activities, and master data optimization. The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining packaging-related data accuracy, coordinating with suppliers, and ensuring compliance documentation is properly collected, analyzed, and archived.
Key Responsibilities
Receive, review, and validate Packaging Bills of Materials (BOMs) and breakdown BOM structures from manufacturing plants.
Research, analyze, and identify material substances in articles using available technical and regulatory information.
Collect, review, and maintain REACH and other material compliance declarations from suppliers.
Coordinate with suppliers to obtain required compliance information, supporting statements, and regulatory documentation.
Upload compliance documentation and maintain case records in Jira and other designated systems.
Maintain and optimize packaging master data to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Correct inaccurate special dimensions for packing units within packaging BOMs using PackIT.
Identify and correct non-plausible packaging weights and other master data inconsistencies.
Review and update stacking factors for inbound packaging BOMs to ensure operational accuracy.
Organize, archive, and maintain supporting documentation, including supplier communications, compliance statements, and audit evidence.
Monitor task progress and provide regular status updates to internal stakeholders.
Participate in regular alignment meetings and support continuous process improvement initiatives.

Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, Environmental Science, Chemistry, Business Administration, or a related field.
1-3 years of experience in supply chain management, packaging engineering, master data management, material compliance, or a related operational support function.
Experience working with packaging BOMs, material master data, or product compliance processes is advantageous.
Experience coordinating with suppliers and international stakeholders is preferred.
Good understanding of Bills of Materials (BOM), packaging structures, and master data management.
Familiarity with material compliance regulations such as REACH, SCIP, RoHS, or similar regulatory frameworks.
Experience with SAP, Jira or comparable enterprise systems is an advantage.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and other Microsoft Office applications.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
Strong communication skills and ability to coordinate effectively with suppliers and global stakeholders.
Good written and spoken English.
Additional German language skills are considered an advantage.

sections.text:
A joining bonus will be offered to candidates who join between 1 July 2026 and 31 October 2026
Main responsibilities
Lead end-to-end SAP O2C S4 HANA module implementations & Roll Out Projects.
Responsible to gain competency in process template Gather and document business requirements from users. Analyze business processes and propose improvements.
Rollouts:
Identify the gaps compared to the template by assessing the system & connecting with the Business Users.
Conduct workshops and training sessions for Business-users on SAP O2C functionalities and Bosch practices Integrate SAP O2C with other modules such as MM, FI, and WM/EWM to ensure data consistency and process efficiency.
Coordinate with Design and build and BD teams to implement the requirement. Identify the scope for the rollout for the respective plant .
Responsible to explain the plant how to adopt the template process and deploy the custom requirements. Collaborate with plant and design build team to finalize the migration requirement ( Define field mapping and transformation rule etc ) for each plant .
Verify sample & mass upload of migrated data such as Sales Order, Pricing Condition, Invoices along with the Master Data like Business partner & Material Master Understand template test cases and localize where necessary for each plant .
Support Business Users in executing test cases during test cycles like Integration testing & UAT Create/Support in creating test defects and follow until defect resolution Understand the existing cutover list and task execute as per cutover schedule and provide inputs if any.
Support during hyper care Train Key-users, setup training data, prepare demo and create/publish supporting documents for project reusable repository.
Develop user manuals, training materials, and process documentation as per Bosch quality standards.
Process improvement activities (PIA):
Understand business request & Support the PIA Lead to implement improvement activities ( Validate/finalize the scope /coordinate with technical team to complete unit testing and implementation Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business processes and requirements and translate them into functional specifications in support with Lead Consultant.
Mentor Junior & Senior Functional consultants to develop competency required for project deliverables Responsible for the assigned Business Requirement (BR)

Must have independently contributed to at least two end-to-end SAP implementation projects in SAP S/4 HANA
Excellent communication skills
Fluent English skill

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
This position will be contracted through Bosch’s external vendor under a one-year agreement.
Job Description
The VnV Engineer creates high quality Software/SiL test specifications considering various relevant test scenarios, ensuring early defect detection in the Software Development Life-Cycle.
VnV Engineer ensures test automation by writing test scripts based on the test specifications and within the defined automated test environment, ensures test execution as per test plan, documentation of defects/issues and reporting in a timely manner.
Main tasks and Responsibilities:
Test Specification
Analyses Software design / Software architecture / Software requirements / Software Interfaces including security, legal, safety to check testability.
Creates test specification (Test implementation – Test Cases) according to VnV Strategy.
Establishes bidirectional traceability & consistency between Software requirements / Software architecture / Software Interface and Software test specification (test cases).
Applies the appropriate test design techniques and guidelines to implement the required test specifications.
Considers and apply proper boundaries of test environment (SIL, HIL, etc.)
Initiates and participate into required review: Requirement review, Test specification review, Test report review, etc.
Baselines the test specification as per the configuration management strategy and tool
Test Automation
Automate the test cases (test scripts) based on the test specifications
Ensures that automated test scripts are reusable (e.g., creation of libraries etc.), understandable and maintainable by other users
Ensures that all automated testing related activities are carried out as per the process defined in test strategy
Establish the bi-directional traceability and consistency between test implementation and test specification
Participate and support debug sessions (as per need) and ensures the test automation is successfully running in the test environment
Ensure the test scripts are reviewed and review findings are addressed
Baselines the test scripts as per the configuration management strategy and tool
Test Execution
Performs the test execution (manual or automated) as per the defined procedures or steps in the test specification
Analyze and evaluate the test results, report the defects and prepare reports related to the testing performed
Ensure that all testing related tasks are carried out as per the defined standards and process
Ensures bidirectional traceability and consistency between test cases included in the test specification and test results
Ensures bi-directional traceability and consistency between the change request (tasks) and the work products (testcases and test reports) affected by the change request
Supports V&V Architect for creating the Test summary report and assess the remaining the risk due to unsolved defects

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Mandatory Qualifications
Bachelor / Master degree, major in electronics or mechatronics or computer science.
Experience in Automotive SW development
Good understanding of Microcontroller & embedded system.
Good hold on reading customer specifications.
Good knowledge about AUTOSAR.
Self-discipline, self-motivation and strong teamwork spirit.
Good communication skills and English both in oral and written.
Competence/Skills
Technical experience in system and/or software testing, aligned with the scope of the Feature/Function Team.
Experience with Embedded C, C-programming, Python-programming and AUTOSAR Architecture.
Experience with CAN/LIN/UWB/NFC/BLE protocols.
Experience with JTAG & CAN-Flash, as well as Flashing sequence.
Hands-on experience with test tools and facilities such as ETAS CoSym / Vector vVirtualTarget (or equivalent), CANoe, ARXML, DBC-format and debuggers.
Experience with Software Development Life-Cycle as well as vECU standard: FMU, FMI, DLL or equivalent.
Experience with V-model and ASPICE is preferred.
Experience with Automation – Automated test & AI-powered automation test is preferred.
Knowledge of security and safety concepts is an advantage.

Job Description
The VnV Engineer creates high quality SW test specifications considering various relevant test scenarios, ensuring early defect detection in the SW development life cycle.

Test Specification

supports software engineer in defining the Verification Criteria for software requirements

baselines the test specification as per the configuration management strategy and tool

baselines the test scripts as per the configuration management strategy and tool

analyse and evaluate the test results, report the defects and prepare reports related to the testing performed
ensures that all testing related tasks are carried out as per the defined standards and process
ensures bidirectional traceability and consistency between test cases included in the test specification and test results

supports SW V&V Architect for creating the SW Test summary report and assess the remaining the risk due to unsolved defects

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Role Overview
We are looking for a hands-on Data & Power Platform Engineer with strong experience in Microsoft Fabric and Microsoft Power Platform.
The role will build and operate modern data solutions while transforming business requirements and manual processes into scalable digital solutions using Power Apps, Power Automate Cloud, Power Automate Desktop (RPA), and Power BI.
Key Responsibilities
Microsoft Fabric & Data Engineering/Lead
Design, build, and maintain scalable data solutions using Microsoft Fabric.
Develop ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest, clean, transform, and synchronize data from multiple sources.
Work with Fabric Lakehouse, Data Warehouse, OneLake, Notebooks, Pipelines, and Dataflows Gen2.
Build and optimize data models supporting analytics, applications, and business requirements.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve data platform performance, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.
Power Apps
Design and develop business applications using Microsoft Power Apps, especially Canvas Apps.
Translate business requirements and manual processes into user-friendly digital applications.
Integrate Power Apps with Dataverse, SharePoint, SQL, Microsoft 365, APIs, and enterprise data sources.
Manage the application lifecycle from requirements and PoC through development, testing, deployment, and support.
Power Automate Cloud
Design and implement automated workflows using Power Automate Cloud.
Build approval workflows, notifications, data synchronization, scheduled processes, and system integrations.
Integrate with Power Apps, SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Dataverse, SQL, Power BI, and APIs.
Implement proper monitoring, error handling, logging, and recovery mechanisms.
Power Automate Desktop / RPA
Develop and maintain Power Automate Desktop (PAD) solutions for RPA.
Automate repetitive desktop, browser, Excel, file-processing, and legacy application activities.
Design reliable attended and unattended automation with appropriate exception handling and security.
Assess when to use Cloud Flow, Desktop Flow/RPA, API integration, or a combination.
Power BI & Analytics
Design and develop Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models.
Strong working knowledge of Power Query/M and DAX.
Optimize data models and report performance and implement Row-Level Security (RLS).
Integrate Power BI with Fabric, SQL, SharePoint, Dataverse, APIs, and other enterprise sources.
Translate business KPIs into meaningful dashboards and actionable insights.
Business Solution & Consulting
Work directly with business stakeholders to understand pain points, processes, and requirements.
Identify digitalization and automation opportunities and recommend suitable solutions.
Convert requirements into solution concepts, architecture, PoCs, and production-ready solutions.
Collaborate with Business Analysts, Data Analysts, Solution Architects, IT teams, and business users.
Provide technical consultation, documentation, user enablement, and continuous solution improvement.

Customer and solution-oriented mindset.

Continuous learning mindset with strong interest in Power Platform, Fabric, Automation, Analytics, and AI.

sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services, in the areas of automotive and industrial technology, consumer goods as well as building technology.
Bosch established its first representative office in Ho Chi Minh City in 1994. Today, all four Bosch business sectors, namely Mobility Solutions, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology have operations in the country. Bosch Vietnam is currently active with many business divisions: Mobility Aftermarket, Drive and Control Technology, Power Tools, Building Technology, Two-Wheeler and Powersports and Sales Original Equipment, AquaEasy, Home Appliances and Supply Chain Consulting.
Additional information is available online at: https://www.bosch.com.vn/ , https://www.linkedin.com/company/bosch-vietnam and https://www.facebook.com/OfficialBoschVietnam

sections.text:
About the Opportunity:
Are you 3rd year or final-year student excited about enterprise software development, full-stack technologies, and SAP innovations? Join Bosch as an SAP Developer Intern and launch your career in one of the world's leading enterprise platforms! You will receive hands-on training and close mentorship from experienced SAP experts to build modern, scalable applications using SAP Fiori, SAPUI5, ABAP, Java, and the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).
What You'll Do:
Learn and contribute to the development of SAP applications, including both frontend (SAP Fiori / SAPUI5) and backend components (ABAP, Java, cloud services)
Assist in creating responsive, user-centric UIs with SAP Fiori design guidelines and SAPUI5 / JavaScript frameworks
Support backend development tasks such as ABAP programming, OData services, Java-based extensions, or cloud-native logic on SAP BTP
Collaborate closely with SAP functional consultants, frontend/backend developers, and cross-functional teams
Gain practical exposure to SAP S/4HANA, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), cloud integration, and extension scenarios
Participate in code reviews, unit/integration testing, debugging, and deployment processes under mentor supervision
What You’ll Gain:
Real-world, hands-on experience contributing to live SAP projects and enterprise solutions
Structured technical training and one-on-one professional mentorship from senior SAP developers
Broad exposure to full-stack SAP development across frontend, backend, and cloud platforms
Opportunity to build a strong foundation for a future career in SAP consulting or development
Potential fast-track pathway to full-time roles at Bosch
International, collaborative working environment rooted in Bosch’s culture and values

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
3rd year or final-year student in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field
Good academic records
Available for a 6-month full-time internship (Monday to Friday) or at least 4 working days per week .
Able to provide a university recommendation or introduction letter for the internship
Solid foundation in programming with at least one of: JavaScript (including modern ES6+), Java, or basic understanding of ABAP
Strong enthusiasm to learn SAP-specific technologies including SAP Fiori, SAPUI5, ABAP, Java extensions, and SAP BTP
Basic knowledge of web technologies (HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript)
Analytical mindset with good problem-solving skills and attention to detail
Effective communication skills and a collaborative, team-oriented approach
Good English communication skills
Nice to Have (But Not Required):
Any prior exposure to SAP technologies (e.g., SAPUI5, Fiori, ABAP, S/4HANA, BTP, CAP, or RAP)
Familiarity with RESTful APIs, OData protocol, MVC/MV* patterns, or cloud concepts
Experience with version control (e.g., Git), basic testing frameworks, or agile methodologies
Knowledge of Java frameworks (Spring Boot) or Node.js basics

sections.text:
We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong hands-on experience in Databricks and modern data platforms to design, build, and maintain scalable data solutions for analytics and BI.
The ideal candidate combines strong Data Engineering, SQL, data modeling, cloud, and system optimization skills, with the ability to take technical ownership and work closely with business and technical stakeholders.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop scalable data pipelines and data platforms using Databricks , SQL, Python, and PySpark .
Build and optimize ETL/ELT processes for structured and semi-structured data.
Optimize performance (including: monitor data injections, monitor queries,...)
Work with Databricks, Delta Lake, Azure and/or Microsoft Fabric to build modern cloud data solutions.
Ensure data quality, reliability, governance, and security across data solutions.
Support integration between on-premise and cloud data sources.

sections.text:
Bosch first started its operations in Vietnam in 1994 and registered a wholly-owned subsidiary in 2008. For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
A Junior AI Engineer in this specific context focuses on the foundational "heavy lifting" of the AI lifecycle. Your role is to assist in the validation of legacy data—cleaning and labeling "dark data"—and helping integrate modern AI models into our global workflow product to automate IT operations.
You will support the Senior AI Engineers in bridging the gap between legacy systems and next-generation product features. This is a highly technical, hands-on role where you will learn to build data pipelines that feed into real-world, global AI applications.
Key Responsibilities
Data Archeology & Cleaning: Assist in extracting and preprocessing unstructured data from legacy logs, tickets, and databases to create high-quality training sets.
Model Implementation: Support the deployment and fine-tuning of machine learning models (e.g., NLP for ticket classification or time-series for predictive maintenance).
Testing & Validation: Conduct rigorous testing of AI outputs to ensure accuracy and fairness across different global regions and user languages.
API & Integration: Build and maintain the "plumbing" (APIs) that connects AI model outputs to the front-end IT workflow product.
Documentation: Maintain detailed records of data lineage and model versions to ensure compliance with global data standards like GDPR.
Continuous Learning: Stay current on emerging Generative AI trends and suggest ways to apply them to legacy data challenges

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Technical Skills
At least 2 years of software engineering experience, including strong hands-on AI agent system development experience
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, or Mathematics. Relevant AI Certifications are a plus.
Programming: Strong proficiency in Python (specifically libraries like Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn).
Data Handling: Solid understanding of SQL and experience with data extraction from relational databases.
Foundational ML: Basic knowledge of Supervised/Unsupervised learning and experience with GitHub for version control.
Tooling: Familiarity with Jupyter Notebooks and basic exposure to cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Soft Skills
Persistence: A high tolerance for "messy" data and the patience required for data mining legacy systems.
Global Collaboration: Ability to work effectively in an Agile/Scrum environment with teammates across multiple time zones.
Analytical Curiosity: A desire to understand the "why" behind IT workflow patterns, not just the "how" of the code.
