sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Key Responsibilities
Support the design of electrical schematics and control panels using EPLAN or equivalent electrical CAD tools.
Assist in reading and reviewing electrical diagrams, block diagrams, and fieldbus network diagrams.
Support electrical component selection and basic calculations.
Assist in defining PLC hardware configurations and I/O architecture.
Prepare and update technical documents, BOMs, and equipment specifications.
Work with engineers to ensure designs follow relevant industrial and safety standards.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Requirements
Final-year student or fresh graduate in Electrical, Electronics, Automation, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related field.
Available for a 6-month full-time internship (Monday to Friday)
Able to provide a university recommendation or introduction letter for the internship
Good English communication skills
Basic knowledge of electrical design, control systems, and industrial automation.
Familiarity with EPLAN Electric P8 or other electrical CAD software is an advantage.
Basic understanding of PLC hardware and electrical components.
Preferred
Good learning attitude, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
Academic projects related to electrical design, PLC, control panels, or machine automation.
Basic knowledge of Siemens, ABB, Schneider, or Rockwell automation systems.
Interest in working with global engineering teams.

sections.title: Quyền lợi & thông tin bổ sung
sections.text:
Monthly Internship Allowance, plus Meal and Parking support.
1 paid leave day + 1 sick leave day for each internship month.
1 birthday leave day if your birthday falls during the internship period.
Accident insurance provided throughout the internship.
Opportunity to observe and engage in international projects and innovation.
Access to our diverse training programs which surely help strengthen both your personal and professionalism.
Participation in various company activities such as football, yoga, badminton, and team building.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. It employs roughly 394,500 associates worldwide (as of December 31, 2020). According to preliminary figures, the company generated sales of 71.6 billion euros in 2020. Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility Solutions, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology.
The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 440 subsidiaries and regional companies in some 60 countries. If its sales and service partners are included, then Bosch is represented in roughly 126 locations. This worldwide development, manufacturing, and sales network is the foundation for further growth.
BGSV – Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (Previous name: RBVH - Robert Bosch Engineering and Business Solutions Vietnam Company Limited) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH.
BGSV has started its operations from 19th October, 2010 at E-Town2 in HCMC. This engineering development center will be engaged in developing embedded systems and software, mechanical design and simulation, and will provide IT (SAP Consulting, JAVA Development….) and Business Services (Finance and accounting, Economics, Purchasing, Logistics, Translations Japanese-English-Japanese, Information Security ) solutions to the Bosch group of companies globally.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
We are seeking a Senior Embedded Software Developer to build and integrate Software Components (SWCs) and Basic Software (BSW) stacks on production ECUs . You will design high-quality embedded software in C/C++, configure AUTOSAR platforms (RTE/BSW), and ensure reliable, performant delivery aligned with MISRA, ASPICE, and OEM standards.
Responsibilities
Design, implement, and maintain AUTOSAR SWCs (ports/interfaces, runnable, events, …), author and manage ARXML.
Configure and generate RTE, integrate SWCs with BSW modules (e.g., DCM/DEM, NvM, SecOC, CSM, …).
Perform ECU integration: configure BSW stacks, communication, and diagnostics.
Write, debug, and optimize embedded C/C++ for constrained, real-time ECUs, conduct static analysis and code reviews.
Plan and execute unit, integration, and system tests.
Establish CI/CD pipelines for build, analysis, and automated testing; manage configuration baselines and releases.
Collaborate with cross-development teams and test teams, drive requirements analysis, traceability, and quality gates.
Ensure compliance with AUTOSAR, MISRA C, ASPICE , and applicable safety/security standards

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or related field.
Minimum 3 years of experience in a relevant field
Proven experience with C lassic AUTOSAR SWC development and ECU integration.
Strong proficiency in embedded C/C++ programming.
Hands-on with AUTOSAR tools (Vector DaVinci, ETAS ISOLAR) and RTE/BSW configuration.
Practical knowledge of CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet (SOME/IP, DoIP); diagnostics (UDS), DCM/DEM, NvM.
Experience with testing levels and hardware debugging ; familiarity with Git and CI tools (Jenkins/GitLab).
Excellent communication and documentation skills.
Nice to have
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and DevOps practices in embedded software
Exposure to service-oriented architectures and SOME/IP service design.
Knowledge of ISO 26262 (functional safety), ASPICE implementation, and ISO/SAE 21434 (cybersecurity)

You will design high-quality embedded software in C/C++, configure AUTOSAR platforms (RTE/BSW), and ensure reliable, performant delivery aligned with MISRA, ASPICE, and OEM standards.
Responsibilities
Design, implement, and maintain AUTOSAR SWCs (ports/interfaces, runnable, events, …), author and manage ARXML.
Configure and generate RTE, integrate SWCs with BSW modules (e.g., DCM/DEM, NvM, SecOC, CSM, …).

Write, debug, and optimize embedded C/C++ for constrained, real-time ECUs, conduct static analysis and code reviews.
Plan and execute unit, integration, and system tests.
Establish CI/CD pipelines for build, analysis, and automated testing; manage configuration baselines and releases.

Hands-on with AUTOSAR tools (Vector DaVinci, ETAS ISOLAR) and RTE/BSW configuration.
Practical knowledge of CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet (SOME/IP, DoIP); diagnostics (UDS), DCM/DEM, NvM.
Experience with testing levels and hardware debugging ; familiarity with Git and CI tools (Jenkins/GitLab).
Excellent communication and documentation skills.

Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and DevOps practices in embedded software

Knowledge of ISO 26262 (functional safety), ASPICE implementation, and ISO/SAE 21434 (cybersecurity)

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
This position will be contracted through Bosch’s external vendor under a one-year agreement.
About the Role
We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Agile Scrum Master to join our Audio team , which develops core audio components for state-of-the-art Automotive Infotainment systems.
In this role, you will act as a servant leader , coach, and mentor, helping the team build a great product that is highly valued by our customers. Since this project operates within the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) , you will play a key role in coordinating cross-team dependencies, driving continuous improvement, and facilitating target-oriented collaboration across international borders—including regular communication with our teams in Germany.
Main Responsibilities
1. Agile Facilitation & Process Ownership
Ceremony Management : Organize, schedule, and facilitate crucial Scrum events, including Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
Method Champion : Guide and coach the team in adopting Scrum, SAFe, and Kanban practices effectively, ensuring agile values and principles are deeply embedded in daily operations.
Metrics and Transparency : Define and utilize agile metrics (e.g., team velocity, burndown/burnup charts) to make progress transparent and drive reliable sprint planning.
2. Servant Leadership & Team Coaching
Empower & Mentor : Act as a servant leader to foster a self-organizing, autonomous, and high-performing team culture.
Protect the Team : Shield the team from external disruptions, manage top-down pressure, and establish a high degree of psychological safety.
Impediment Removal : Proactively identify, track, and facilitate the resolution of technical or process-related roadblocks that hinder team productivity.
3. SAFe Coordination & Dependency Management
Cross-Team Alignment : Coordinate non-technical dependencies and align with other Scrum teams within the Agile Release Train (ART).
ART Participation : Active participation in scaled agile ceremonies such as Scrum of Scrums, Product Owner/Scrum Master Syncs, and Program Increment (PI) Planning.
4. Collaboration & Quality
Product Owner Collaboration : Support the Product Owner in maintaining a refined, well-estimated, and prioritized Product Backlog.
Quality Assurance Support : Assist the team in maintaining high development and testing quality standards, ensuring adherence to the Definition of Done (DoD).

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Mandatory Qualifications
Education : Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
Agile Expertise : Strong foundational knowledge of Agile Methodologies , Kanban Principles , and Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) .

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
This position will be contracted through Bosch’s external vendor under a one-year agreement.
Bosch Cross-Domain Computing & ADAS (XC-CP) Team develops high-quality, state-of-the-art Automotive Head Unit and Home Appliance Linux/Android-based systems.
Together with other Bosch locations worldwide, we provide software solutions for navigation, vehicle functions, autonomous driving, camera, and IoT features to the car marker. Our team also contributes to Bosch smart home & IoT solutions through SW delivery to Home Appliance products.
We are looking for talented SoC1 Embedded SW Engineers (Linux, Android) in Central Computer, In-Vehicle Infotainment, ADAS and Driver Monitoring with 2 to 5 years of experience to join our development team.
Key Responsible:
Core Base Software Development : You will develop, integrate, and maintain low-level software for our Linux and Android Automotive OS (AAOS) platforms, focusing strictly on kernel-level components and Hardware Abstraction Layers (HALs).
System Bring-Up & Bootloader : You will contribute to the development and adaptation of bootloaders (e.g., U-Boot) and perform initial board bring-up and hardware validation.
Platform Integration & Security : You will be responsible for integrating low-level software components, debugging kernel and driver issues, and helping to identify and mitigate software vulnerabilities close to the hardware.
Performance Analysis : You will participate in optimizing system performance, focusing on boot time and the efficiency of low-level resource management within the Linux kernel and AAOS.
Team Collaboration : You will work closely with senior developers and architects, actively participating in technical discussions centered on base software and contributing to a culture of quality.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Personality : You are a motivated and accountable team player with a strong desire to learn and contribute to complex, hardware-close projects.
Working Style : You have an analytical and goal-oriented approach, with an eagerness to solve technical challenges both independently and as part of the team.
Experience and Know-how: Professional experience in embedded C/C++ development for Linux, with knowledge of the kernel, its user-space API (UAPI), and filesystems.
Familiarity with Android Automotive OS (AAOS) low-level concepts (e.g., HALs, GKI, VTS) is a strong advantage.
Experience with developing or integrating software within Linux Board Support Packages (BSPs), including peripheral driver configuration.
Familiarity with bootloader concepts and their role in hardware initialization.
An understanding of vulnerability management as it applies to base software.
Experience with modern software development workflows, including version control (e.g., Git) and the basics of CI/CD pipelines.
Knowledge of functional safety standards (ISO 26262) is an advantage.
Language Skills : Very good English skills.
Education : A completed degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a comparable field.

Bosch Cross-Domain Computing & ADAS (XC-CP) Team develops high-quality, state-of-the-art Automotive Head Unit and Home Appliance Linux/Android-based systems.

We are looking for talented Python Software Engineers with 2 to 5 years of experience to join our development team.

Build the Future of Intelligent Workflows
Join Bosch Vietnam’s Global Product & Service team to help build next-generation workflow platforms used by 500,000+ users worldwide. Built on modern Low-Code / No-Code technologies and evolving with AI and GenAI capabilities, our platform powers critical enterprise business processes at global scale.
We are looking for proactive and high-potential interns passionate about Product Development, Business Analysis, and innovation. This is not a passive internship — you will gain hands-on experience in real product environments and collaborate with global teams.

Support requirement gathering, analysis, and product documentation
Translate business needs into user stories and backlog items
Support workflow analysis, UAT, and Agile delivery activities
Explore user behaviors and product usage data to identify improvement opportunities
Participate in product discovery, design thinking, and innovation workshops
Collaborate with Product Managers, developers, and global stakeholders
Contribute ideas for workflow automation and AI-driven capabilities

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Build the Future of Intelligent Workflows Platform
We are building a next-generation enterprise workflow platform used by 500,000+ users globally. Built on modern Low-Code / No-Code technologies and evolving toward AI-native workflows powered by automation and GenAI, this platform supports critical business operations at global scale.
We are looking for a Senior Product Business Analyst (PO Assistant) who combines product thinking, business analysis capability, customer-centric mindset, and execution excellence to help shape scalable enterprise solutions. This role goes beyond traditional requirement documentation — you will help drive product direction, execution, and real business impact.
What You Will Do
Product Analysis & Delivery
Collaborate with Product Managers and Engineering teams to translate product vision into execution-ready requirements
Define user stories, acceptance criteria, and workflow/process designs
Manage backlog quality, prioritization, and requirement clarity
Ensure requirements are scalable, testable, and outcome-focused
Product Discovery & Improvement
Analyze existing platform features, workflows, usage data, and user behaviors
Identify opportunities to simplify, improve, optimize, or retire legacy workflows
Support design thinking workshops and product discovery activities
Translate business insights into next-generation product capabilities
Customer & Stakeholder Engagement
Work closely with global stakeholders to understand business needs, user pain points, and operational challenges
Partner with Product Managers, Engineering, UX/UI, and Operations teams across delivery lifecycle
Facilitate requirement reviews, validation sessions, and UAT activities
Technical & AI Product Collaboration
Collaborate with engineering teams on APIs, integrations, enterprise applications, and workflow automation
Support AI-driven workflow initiatives including intelligent automation, AI-assisted workflows, and GenAI-enabled user experiences
Contribute to scalable, secure, and maintainable product design

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Experience & Product Mindset
10+ years of experience in IT Business Analysis, Product Analysis, or product-focused roles
Strong experience with enterprise platforms, workflow/process automation, and complex system design
Proven ability to work in large-scale, global product environments
Product-oriented mindset with the ability to turn ambiguity into clear, scalable solutions
Strong analytical thinking, execution discipline, and customer-centric approach
Proactive, ownership-driven, and solution-oriented
Technical & AI Readiness
Good understanding of system architecture, APIs, integrations, and enterprise applications
Experience with Low-Code / No-Code platforms is a strong advantage
Exposure to AI/ML or strong interest in AI-driven product transformation
Comfortable working in AI-assisted product delivery environments
Collaboration & Communication
Excellent communication in both English & Vietnamese, stakeholder management, and facilitation skills
Proven experience working in global, cross-functional teams
Strong alignment, collaboration, and storytelling capability
Comfortable working in Agile environments with high ownership
Nice to Have
Experience with workflow or approval platforms
Exposure to large-scale platform migration initiatives
Certifications such as CBAP, PMI-PBA, Agile, or Scrum methodologies

sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. sections.text:
Bosch first started in Vietnam with a representative office in 1994. Bosch has its main office in Ho Chi Minh City, with branch offices in Hanoi and Da Nang, and a Powertrain Solutions plant in the Dong Nai province to manufacture push belt for continuously variable transmissions (CVT) in automobiles. In addition, Bosch operates a software and engineering solutions from product engineering, tool development & automation as well as testing & validation solutions (Bosch Global Software Technologies Vietnam).
In July 2014, Bosch set up a new Automotive R&D Center, located in Ho Chi Minh City. The continuous growth of this Centre is in line with Bosch’s strategy in Vietnam, which aims at becoming a manufacturing and R&D hub in the Southeast Asian region. Currently four products are available: connectors, push belt, fuel supply, and diagnosis module (tank leakage).
For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn

sections.text:
Join a Global Mission to Transform How Bosch Works
Are you ready to lead change that touches half a million lives across the globe?
Bosch Digital is on a bold journey to transform our internal IT landscape and we’re looking for a Senior Business Analyst Lead to help us shape the future of digital workflows. This is a rare opportunity to work on a flagship global product , serving Bosch associates worldwide , and collaborate with some of the brightest minds across continents .
You’ll lead a talented team of Business Analysts and IT Consultants, driving the modernization and migration of complex workflow platforms. Your work will directly impact how Bosch operates, from Europe to Asia, the Americas to Africa.
Why This Role Is Unique
🌐 Global Reach : Your work will support over 500,000 users across Bosch’s international ecosystem.
🤝 Customer-Centric Leadership : You’ll build strong relationships with global stakeholders, negotiate timelines and pricing, and guide them through the adoption of cutting-edge technologies.
🚀 Transformational Impact : Lead the migration of legacy systems to modern platforms, enabling smarter, faster, and more intuitive workflows.
💡 Innovation at Scale : Co-create new products with customers, involve them in the development process, and secure their buy-in for successful UAT and rollout.
🌟 World-Class Team : Collaborate with a diverse, multinational team of experts who bring passion, creativity, and excellence to everything they do.
Your Key Responsibilities
Lead & Mentor : Inspire and guide a team of BAs and IT consultants, fostering a culture of growth, agility, and collaboration.
Modernize Workflows : Analyze and migrate complex platforms, ensuring seamless transitions and business alignment.
Customer Engagement : Manage relationships with global customers, negotiate project scope, timelines, and pricing, and champion their involvement in product development.
Strategic Analysis : Translate business needs into actionable insights, user stories, and dashboards that drive decision-making.
Agile Delivery : Champion Agile practices, ensuring iterative value delivery and continuous improvement.
Change Management : Lead UAT, training, and adoption efforts to ensure smooth transitions and lasting impact.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
We are looking for an experienced Embedded Software Engineer (1-year contractor) to contribute immediately to our ongoing projects. This role involves comprehensive responsibilities, including embedded software development & validation, and leading initiatives for continuous improvement in embedded product programming.
As part of the Bosch group, you will join a global team dedicated to developing cutting-edge Embedded Software for Engine Control Units (ECUs) , supplying world-class OEMs across Europe/ Korea.
If you are passionate about the automotive domain and thrive in a challenging, fast-paced environment, we encourage you to apply.
Key Responsibilities
Ability to partner with the software project team to understand needs from a project and customer perspective, ensuring proper requirement alignment and priority setting.
Design, develop, and maintain software components and systems for automotive applications.
Implement continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code.
Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical decision-making.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Mandatory requirements
Bachelor degree in Electrical Electronics, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering or relevant fields
2-5 years of relevant experience
Version Control & CI/CD: Proven experience with Git, Git Actions, and Jenkins.
Programming Languages & Tools: Proficiency in: Embedded C language
Python/Perl (including data processing libraries like Pandas and frameworks like Django)
Strong understanding of the principles of embedded systems development.
Software development process: Familiarity and practical experience with V-Model or Agile/Kanban methodologies in the context of embedded development.
Ability to use AI effectively for research and self-study
Nice-to-have:
Automotive Standards: Experience with AUTOSAR integration/ ASPICE
Additional Languages & Platforms: Experience with C#, .NET

sections.text:
About department: SO
As an in-house service provider, SO department supports the Bosch Group in areas including Supply Chain Management , Project Management , Data Security , L1/L2 IT Support , Human Resources Shared Services , Web Content Management , Quality Management as well as Translation/Interpreter services.
We pool administrative tasks and ensure efficient processes and improve the entire service chain using automation solutions such as RPA and AI .
Through the various sections and topics listed here, we aim to introduce to the customers from all around the world to get to know about our Overview , Services , our Competencies , Tools & Process and Expertise as we deliver excellence together as one team.
Key Responsibilities:
We are seeking a highly skilled AI Engineer with Full-Stack Development capabilities who has hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) to join our dynamic team. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying AI-driven applications that combine advanced machine learning with robust front-end and back-end architectures
Full-Stack Development
Develop and maintain scalable web applications using modern front-end frameworks (React, Vue, etc.) and back-end technologies (Node.js, Python/FastAPI, etc.).
Design APIs and services to interface with ML models and data pipelines.
Integrate cloud services and manage infrastructure using AWS/GCP/Azure.
Ensure performance, responsiveness, and security across platforms
AI/ML Engineering
Design, fine-tune, and optimize LLM for specific use cases (e.g., chatbots, summarization, document processing).
Work with vector databases and embedding models for semantic search and retrieval.
Build RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines and LLMOps workflows.
Implement AI safety, prompt engineering, and performance monitoring.

3+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering and full-stack development.

Programming: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript
LLMs (OpenAI GPT, Hugging Face Transformers, LangChain/LlamaIndex)
ML Frameworks: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face…
Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, and vector databases (e.g., FAISS, Pinecone)

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Bosch first started its operations in Vietnam in 1994 and registered a wholly-owned subsidiary in 2008. According to the business strategy of Bosch in Vietnam, from 1st July 2014 on all business entities were merged into Bosch Vietnam Co. Ltd. with its head office at Ho Chi Minh City plant (HcP) in Dong Nai Province.
HcP has started its belt assembly in a rented building on 1st August 2008 as the assembly plant of Tilburg Plant (TbP). On 14th April 2011, HcP celebrated the inauguration of the new plant (Lth101 with 17,000 sqm), which did not only allow to increase the production depth, but also to facilitate the push belt assembly of this high-tech product. On 3rd July 2012 HcP marked a big milestone by starting to produce the second component (loop-set) for its push belt. Since November 2012, HcP doubled the production floor space and increase the net total floor space up to 56.000 m², and have successfully increased its production capacity and realized a lot of new line SOP’s.
For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn

About the role:
This is a once-in-a-career opportunity to join Bosch Digital’s Global Product Team at a defining moment. We are leading the transformation and migration of global digital products , including the launch of a new core business workflow platform - and we’re looking for passionate, driven leaders to help shape the future.
As a Senior Software Project Manager cum Agile Team Coach , you will be at the heart of this transformation, working alongside a talented, cross-functional global team. You’ll drive complex, high-impact projects from concept to delivery, using Agile methodologies and AI-powered solutions to bring innovation to life.
If you’re looking for a role where your work truly matters—where you can influence global platforms, collaborate with top-tier talent, and grow in a culture of innovation—this is your moment.
Your main roles & responsibilities:
Lead the Migration of a New Core Workflow Platform Oversee the migration of 250+ applications, ensuring timelines are met and aligned with business priorities
Integrate new application requests and change requirements into the migration roadmap with precision and agility.
Apply AI-driven planning and automation to streamline delivery and enhance decision-making.
Ensure High-Quality, On-Time Delivery Implement a robust quality management framework to ensure all deliverables meet Bosch’s global standards.
Apply technical risk management strategies to proactively identify and resolve issues.
Maintain a clear focus on timeline management , balancing migration efforts with new development needs.
Stakeholder Engagement & Team Collaboration Facilitate and moderate cross-functional meetings across global teams, ensuring alignment and transparency.
Resolve conflicts constructively and foster a harmonious team spirit to drive on-time delivery.
Coach teams in Agile practices and continuous improvement.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Bosch first started in Vietnam with a representative office in 1994. Bosch has its main office in Ho Chi Minh City, with branch offices in Hanoi and Da Nang, and a Powertrain Solutions plant in the Dong Nai province to manufacture pushbelt for continuously variable transmissions (CVT) in automobiles. In addition, Bosch operates a software and engineering R&D center (Robert Bosch Engineering and Business Solutions Vietnam Co., Ltd).
In July 2014, Bosch set up a new Automotive R&D Center, located in Ho Chi Minh City. The continuous growth of this Centre is in line with Bosch’s strategy in Vietnam, which aims at becoming a manufacturing and R&D hub in the Southeast Asian region. Currently four products are available: connectors, pushbelt, fuel supply, and diagnosis module (tank leakage).
For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn

Apply established software development processes and coding standards to produce reliable and maintainable code for embedded systems.

Mentor junior engineers by providing guidance on technical tasks, coding practices, and problem-solving techniques.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Telecommunications, Control and Automation Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field.
Experience: 3+ years of proven professional experience in embedded software development. Hands-on experience with microcontroller architecture, device drivers, and real-time operating systems (RTOS).
Programming Expertise: Strong programming skills in C/C++ , with experience in scripting languages like Python or others such as C# .
Technical Knowledge: Solid foundation in Control Systems, Automation, Embedded Systems, and familiarity with automotive communication protocols (e.g., CAN, LIN, Ethernet). Experience in areas such as Automotive Ethernet, Base Software (BSW), Bootloader, COM Stack, Cyber Security, Device Drivers, Diagnostics, and Real-Time Operating Systems.
Language Skills: Proficient in English Communication.
Advanced Chinese Proficiency: Must be able to communicate fluently in technical and business contexts and read/understand technical documents in Chinese (HSK4 or above).
Professional Attributes: Results-driven with a quality-focused, structured, and disciplined engineering approach. Possesses a safety-critical mindset and an architecture-first approach.
Demonstrated leadership, people management, and strong interpersonal skills. A patient, team-oriented collaborator comfortable facilitating discussions across teams and dealing with conflicts.
Systematic thinker, detail-oriented, self-driven, proactive, self-learning.
Good teamwork, collaboration communication skills, supportive mindset.
Tools & Certifications: Proficient in using Source Control, Test Frameworks, and Software Lifecycle Management tools.
Certifications in embedded systems or relevant software development methodologies are a plus.

sections.text:
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer (Azure) with strong experience in cloud infrastructure, CI/CD automation, and Kubernetes-based platform operations. You will be responsible for building, automating, and maintaining scalable and secure cloud-native systems, enabling fast and reliable software delivery.
The ideal candidate has at least 3+ years of experience in DevOps and strong English communication skills to collaborate with international teams.
Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Git, and automation scripting (Python, Bash).
Develop and maintain infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Bosch first started its operations in Vietnam in 1994 and registered a wholly-owned subsidiary in 2008. According to the business strategy of Bosch in Vietnam, from 1st July 2014 on all business entities were merged into Bosch Vietnam Co. Ltd. with its head office at Ho Chi Minh City plant (HcP) in Dong Nai Province.
HcP has started its belt assembly in a rented building on 1st August 2008 as the assembly plant of Tilburg Plant (TbP). On 14th April 2011, HcP celebrated the inauguration of the new plant (Lth101 with 17,000 sqm), which did not only allow to increase the production depth, but also to facilitate the push belt assembly of this high-tech product. On 3rd July 2012 HcP marked a big milestone by starting to produce the second component (loop-set) for its push belt. Since November 2012, HcP doubled the production floor space and increase the net total floor space up to 56.000 m², and have successfully increased its production capacity and realized a lot of new line SOP’s.
For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn

Serve as the first point of contact for internal customers and suppliers, providing support in Japanese and English through ticketing tools, email, and phone channels.

Meet or exceed individual and team performance targets, including productivity, quality, customer satisfaction, response time, and resolution time metrics.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve processes, reduce recurring issues, enhance operational efficiency, and deliver an excellent customer experience.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
The Quality Specialist for Quality Management System (QMS) & Quality Methods is responsible for the development, implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the QMS in alignment with international standards (ISO 9001, IATF 16949) and internal guidelines.
The role ensures robust quality governance, effective process control, and continuous optimization, applying advanced quality methods, supporting cross-functions, and driving innovation to meet customer, regulatory, and business requirements.
1/ QMS Strategic Development & Maintenance
Interpret, implement, and continuously improve QMS according to ISO 9001, IATF 16949, and internal requirements
Develop, update, and control QMS documentation
Coordinate complex cross-functional processes and ensure effective deployment of QMS requirements
Drive innovation and optimization within QMS structure and processes
Participate in introduction of new quality strategies and governance frameworks
2/ Application & Improvement of Quality Methods
Drive the application of advanced quality tools and methodologies to optimize processes and product quality, e.g. Q-Basic, Quality Hero
Conduct training and provide expert guidance to third parties (e.g., engineering, production, project) on quality methods, focusing on support functions and detailing of solutions, using standards to do so
Lead or actively participate in continuous improvement projects, identifying opportunities and implementing solutions to enhance quality performance in line with QMM TAC, e.g. Quality Mindset, Preventive Quality, LEAN
Contribute to the introduction of new quality methodologies and best practices aligned with strategic objectives
3/ Internal & External Audits
Establish and manage the internal audit program in alignment with QMS requirements and company objectives
Plan, conduct, and report audits to ensure QMS compliance and effectiveness
Support development and qualification of internal auditors
Coordinate external audits (certification bodies/division audits) as main interface
Monitor implementation and effectiveness of corrective actions (CA) and Preventive Actions (PA) resulting from audits
4/ Quality Data Analysis & Reporting
Collect, analyze, and present quality data (KPIs, audit results, Q issues)
Perform target vs. actual comparison and initiate corrective actions
Provide data-driven recommendations and support management decision-making
Represent quality performance in management reviews and stakeholder meetings
5/ Other Assignments: Participate in ad-hoc projects, corporate initiatives, and other assignments

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Education: Bachelor's degree in engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Industrial, Chemical), Quality Management, or a related technical field
Work experience:
Minimum of 3-5 years of progressive experience in Quality Management, specifically with QMS development and quality methodologies, preferably within the automotive industry
Strong knowledge and hands-on experience in QMS standards, especially ISO 9001 are mandatory. Experience with IATF 16949 and VDA standards is a significant advantage.
Proficiency in core quality tools & methodologies: SPC, FMEA, MSA, PPAP, APQP, 8D, 5 Whys
Certified Internal Auditor for ISO 9001 and/or VDA6.3, IATF 16949
Traits and Skills:
Communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills (both written and verbal) in English and Chinese
Problem-solving, continuous improvement and critical thinking abilities
Detail-oriented with a high degree of accuracy and precision
Ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment and influence stakeholders at all levels
Proactive, self-motivated, and capable of working independently with minimal supervision

sections.text:

16 days of annual leaves

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Bosch first started its operations in Vietnam in 1994 and registered a wholly-owned subsidiary in 2008. According to the business strategy of Bosch in Vietnam, from 1st July 2014 on all business entities were merged into Bosch Vietnam Co. Ltd. with its head office at Ho Chi Minh City plant (HcP) in Dong Nai Province.
HcP has started its belt assembly in a rented building on 1st August 2008 as the assembly plant of Tilburg Plant (TbP). On 14th April 2011, HcP celebrated the inauguration of the new plant (Lth101 with 17,000 sqm), which did not only allow to increase the production depth, but also to facilitate the push belt assembly of this high-tech product. On 3rd July 2012 HcP marked a big milestone by starting to produce the second component (loop-set) for its push belt. Since November 2012, HcP doubled the production floor space and increase the net total floor space up to 56.000 m², and have successfully increased its production capacity and realized a lot of new line SOP’s.
For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. With technology that is “Invented for life,” Bosch wants to help improve quality of life and conserve natural resources.
The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 490 subsidiary and regional companies in over 60 countries. Including sales and service partners, Bosch’s global manufacturing, engineering, and sales network covers nearly every country in the world. Bosch’s innovative strength is key to the company’s further development.
Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.
Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region. With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.
BGSV currently operates from three offices located at the following addresses:
1. Etown Building – 364 Cong Hoa Street, Ward 13, Tan Binh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
2. OfficeHaus Building – 32 Tan Thang Street, Son Ky Ward, Tan Phu District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
3. Capital Place Building – 29 Lieu Giai Street, Ngoc Khanh Ward, Ba Dinh District, Hanoi, Vietnam

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
We are looking for a motivated Software Development Intern to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to real-world projects, focusing on building and maintaining stable data pipelines and software solutions. The ideal candidate is a proactive learner with a strong foundation in programming, a passion for technology, and a desire to develop their skills in a collaborative, professional environment.
Key Responsibilities:
Contribute to the development and maintenance of data pipelines using Python and SQL, focusing on writing clean, efficient, and reliable code.
Collaborate with the team to design, develop, test, and document new software features and solutions with guidance from senior engineers.
Utilize Git for version control, following best practices for branching, merging, and pull requests in a team-based project environment.
Understand CI/CD pipeline stages (build/test/deploy) and assist in the automation of build, test, and deployment processes.
Engage in project meetings, communicate progress effectively, participate in code reviews, and support the team in delivering high-quality solutions.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Technical Skills
Python: Proficiency in writing clean, maintainable data scripts with robust error handling and logging.
SQL: Ability to write correct and optimized queries to interact with databases.
API / RESTful Services: Foundational knowledge of HTTP methods (GET, POST), JSON data format, and authentication concepts.
Git & Version Control: Proficiency with Git for version control, including branching, merging, and command-line usage.
CI/CD & Scripting: Basic understanding of CI/CD concepts and scripting skills for automation (e.g., Bash, PowerShell).
Communication and Problem-Solving Skills
Problem-Solving: Strong problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to debug issues in pipelines and identify root causes.
Communication: Excellent communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical notes, ask clarifying questions, and present findings to the team.
Teamwork Skills
Collaboration: A collaborative mindset with a strong desire to work as part of a team.
Feedback: Eagerness to participate in code reviews (both giving and receiving feedback) and contribute to team goals.
Educational Background
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
University requirements (meet any ONE of the following): A top-ranked overseas university of equivalent standing (e.g., within the QS or Times Higher Education Top 200).
For candidates educated in Vietnam, graduation from a leading Vietnamese university such as: Vietnam National University, Hanoi (VNU-Hanoi)
Vietnam National University, Ho Chi Minh City (VNU-HCMC)

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Bosch first started in Vietnam with a representative office in 1994. Bosch has its main office in Ho Chi Minh City, with branch offices in Hanoi and Da Nang, and a Powertrain Solutions plant in the Dong Nai province to manufacture push belt for continuously variable transmissions (CVT) in automobiles. In addition, Bosch operates a software and engineering solutions from product engineering, tool development & automation as well as testing & validation solutions (Bosch Global Software Technologies Vietnam).
In July 2014, Bosch set up a new Automotive R&D Center, located in Ho Chi Minh City. The continuous growth of this Centre is in line with Bosch’s strategy in Vietnam, which aims at becoming a manufacturing and R&D hub in the Southeast Asian region. Currently four products are available: connectors, push belt, fuel supply, and diagnosis module (tank leakage).
For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Build Real-World Agentic AI at Enterprise Scale
Join Bosch Vietnam’s Global Product & Service organization to help build next-generation AI-native workflow platforms used by 500,000+ users worldwide. We are transforming enterprise workflow systems into intelligent AI-driven platforms capable of understanding requirements, generating applications and workflows, validating outputs, and continuously improving through feedback and learning.
We are looking for a Senior AI Developer who combines strong AI engineering expertise, full-stack engineering capability, and product-oriented mindset to build scalable, production-grade AI systems for real enterprise environments. This is not a proof-of-concept role — you will work on real AI systems deployed at enterprise scale with measurable business impact.
What You Will Do
AI Engineering & Agentic AI Development
Design, develop, and deploy AI-powered capabilities for enterprise workflow platforms
Build and improve Agentic AI systems for workflow generation, application generation, and intelligent automation
Develop AI solutions using LLMs, RAG pipelines, agent orchestration frameworks, and structured AI workflows
Improve AI reliability, accuracy, scalability, and operational quality
AI Platform & Data Engineering
Build pipelines to extract, structure, and transform enterprise and legacy system data into AI-ready datasets
Work with ETL/ELT pipelines, vector databases, graph databases, search, and indexing systems
Support AI lifecycle management including training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and optimization
Contribute to AI observability, evaluation frameworks, and quality monitoring systems
Full-Stack & Enterprise System Integration
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, QA, and Architecture teams to integrate AI capabilities into enterprise platforms
Support AI-driven workflow automation, intelligent routing, predictive insights, and modernization initiatives
Work with cloud-native architectures, microservices, APIs, and scalable enterprise systems
Contribute to security, governance, and operational best practices for AI systems
Technical Leadership & Collaboration
Mentor engineers and contribute to AI engineering standards and best practices
Drive problem-solving and technical discussions across global teams
Help translate complex business workflows into scalable AI-powered solutions

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Must-Have
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, AI, Data Science, or related fields
7+ years of software engineering experience, including strong hands-on AI/ML system development experience
Expert-level Python programming skills
Hands-on experience with LLMs, Generative AI, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, and AI agent orchestration frameworks
Strong experience building scalable, production-grade enterprise systems
Experience with APIs, microservices, cloud platforms, and distributed systems
Strong understanding of data engineering, ETL pipelines, and large-scale data processing
Experience with MLOps/LLMOps practices, CI/CD, containers, and cloud environments
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills
Nice-to-Have
Experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent AI orchestration frameworks
Experience modernizing legacy systems or enterprise workflow platforms
Exposure to Low-Code / No-Code or business process automation platforms
Experience with vector databases, graph databases, or AI observability tools
Knowledge of AI performance optimization, inference optimization, or model efficiency techniques
Application Requirement
Please include a short written: describe the most impactful AI system or AI-related solution you have built or contributed to. What problem did it solve, what was your role, and what business or technical outcome did it achieve?
Optional: GitHub, portfolio, demos, technical blogs, or AI-related project references.

Collaborate with global Product, Engineering, and AI teams

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
We are looking for a Senior Front-End Developer specializing in UX Engineering to help shape the next generation of global enterprise workflow platforms used by 500,000+ users worldwide.
This role sits at the intersection of UX design and software engineering — transforming complex enterprise workflows, automation systems, and data-heavy applications into intuitive, scalable, and high-performance user experiences.
You will collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, and Backend Engineers to deliver modern, accessible, and globally scalable enterprise applications.
Key Responsibilities
Interaction Engineering: Develop sophisticated UI components for complex workflows, such as visual logic builders, real-time status monitors, and multi-step configuration wizards.
Design System Stewardship: Own and scale the global design system and component library, ensuring pixel-perfect consistency across all regions and product modules.
High-Fidelity Prototyping: Create interactive, code-based prototypes to test and validate complex user journeys before full production development.
Localization & Accessibility (a11y): Implement internationalization (i18n) and localization (l10n) strategies to support global users, alongside strict adherence to WCAG 2.1 accessibility standards.
UX Performance Optimization: Monitor and optimize "Core Web Vitals" and interaction latency to ensure the product remains responsive under heavy enterprise workloads.
Stakeholder Collaboration: Act as a "translator" between UX designers and backend engineers to ensure design visions are technically feasible and performance-compliant.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Must-Have
Education: Bachelor’s or master's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
Experience: 5+ years in front-end development with a portfolio highlighting complex enterprise UX (SaaS, IT management, or similar).
UX Principles: Strong understanding of information architecture, user psychology, and usability testing methodologies.
Front-end Expertise: Expert knowledge of HTML5, CSS3 (Sass or CSS Modules), modern layout (Flexbox/Grid), and TypeScript.
Framework Expertise: Deep proficiency in React, Angular, or Vue.js, with a focus on building reusable, stateful components.
React proficiency building reusable, stateful components and hooks; experience with state management.
Design Tools: Practical experience with Figma, Adobe XD, or Sketch, including the ability to extract assets and understand design tokens.
Data integration: REST APIs, WebSocket for real-time data; robust error handling and retry/backoff strategies.
Workflow Technologies: Familiarity with data visualization libraries (e.g., D3.js, Chart.js) and state management for complex data flows (e.g., Redux, Recoil).
Nice to Have
Design token pipelines (Style Dictionary), Storybook, Chromatic/visual regression testing.
Security awareness (OWASP front-end risks, XSS/CSP, secure handling of untrusted content).
Observability (Sentry, Datadog), feature flagging, A/B testing.
Experience with distributed teams and varying network conditions across regions.
Localized experiences delivered in multiple languages, including at least one RTL locale.
Design system adoption across 2+ product modules with documented components and usage guidelines.
Measurable improvements in Core Web Vitals and interaction latency on at least one high-traffic workflow.
Global Mindset: Experience delivering software that accounts for regional cultural nuances and varied internet speeds.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
We are looking for a skilled SAP Data Migration Consultant to join our SAP team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for the extraction and upload of master and transactional data in the SAP ECC system. The role requires solid experience in ABAP development for data extraction and hands-on experience with various data migration tools and techniques for uploading, such as LSMW, BDC, BAPI, and IDoc. The consultant will primarily handle complex datasets related to Materials Management (MM), Production Planning (PP), and Logistics Execution (LE) processes. The role demands strong technical capability, the ability to work under high pressure, and a positive, solution-oriented attitude.
Key Responsibilities:
Perform data extraction from SAP systems using custom ABAP programs and ALV reports.
Enable business users to extract and validate data via Excel-compatible formats.
Execute data upload to SAP ECC system using LSMW, BDC programs, BAPI, or IDoc depending on the data object and scenario.
Design, develop, test, and execute data migration programs ensuring completeness and accuracy of uploaded data.
Ensure data transformation rules are followed during upload to meet business and SAP requirements.
Collaborate with functional consultants and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and resolve data issues.
Work within tight deadlines while maintaining data accuracy and performance

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
4+ years of experience in SAP data migration projects.
Strong communication skills to collaborate with business users, technical teams, and stakeholders.
Ability to work independently and manage time across multiple parallel data objects.
Detail-oriented and proactive in identifying data quality issues.
Strong ABAP development skills, especially for creating ALV reports and custom extraction tools.
Expertise in SAP data migration tools: LSMW (Legacy System Migration Workbench)
BDC (Batch Data Communication)
BAPI (Business Application Programming Interface)
IDoc (Intermediate Document)
Proven debugging skills to analyze and resolve data load or program errors efficiently.
Experience working with large datasets and ensuring performance optimization.
Solid understanding of WM (Warehouse Management) modules and SAP MM (Materials Management).

sections.text:
This position will be contracted through Bosch’s external vendor under a one-year agreement.
MS/ESC XC Horizontal ENE
Horizontal NE is a cross‑domain engineering organization within XC, responsible for developing and scaling reusable software and platform assets across ADAS, Radar, Video, and integrated vehicle computing platforms. The organization owns horizontal topics such as base software, middleware, safety, security, compute, and engineering methods, supporting XC‑CP, XC‑CE, XC‑AC, and XC‑AS products. Horizontal NE works closely with product teams to enable standardization, reuse, and technical alignment across projects. It plays a key role in building future‑ready platforms for software‑defined vehicles, ensuring high quality, efficiency, and scalability across XC portfolios.
Main Roles and Responsibilities
Work as part of Bosch’s global ADAS teams to develop and integrate AUTOSAR Classic BSW and diagnostics software for next‑generation driver assistance ECUs (radar, camera, sensor fusion, domain controllers).
Roles & Responsibilities
Develop and maintain embedded AUTOSAR Classic software (BSW and low‑level SW) for ADAS ECUs using C/C++.
Configure, integrate, and debug AUTOSAR BSW modules, with focus on: Diagnostics, CAN Communication, Failure management and PDM.
Collaborate closely with global system, hardware, and application teams to ensure end‑to‑end integration of BSW with ADAS applications (e.g., radar, camera, sensor fusion).
Participate in the complete software development lifecycle: requirements analysis, architecture & design, implementation, unit/integration testing, debug, and maintenance.
Optimize software performance and memory usage for resource-constrained embedded systems.
Conduct code reviews, ensure adherence to Bosch coding guidelines, MISRA rules (if applicable), and best practices.
Develop and execute unit tests and integration tests; support SIL/HIL testing and vehicle testing as needed.
Ensure compliance with ISO 26262 (functional safety) and Automotive SPICE processes contribute to work products and assessments.
Create and maintain software architecture, design, and interface documentation for global stakeholders.
Use tools such as CANoe, CANalyzer, debuggers, emulators, and simulators for development, analysis, and issue resolution.
Stay updated with the latest AUTOSAR specifications and implement compliant software solutions.
Contribute to the development of software architecture and design documents.
Collaborate with hardware engineers to ensure optimal software-hardware integration.
Participate in technical discussions in an international, distributed team; and actively provide innovative solutions to complex engineering challenges.
Work, design reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Mandatory Qualifications
Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechatronics, Computer Science, or related field.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; comfortable collaborating in global teams.
Technical Skills
1-5 years of experience in embedded software development
Strong Technical skills preferably in automotive domain & Good experience in programming in C, C++ for embedded systems.
Experience with AUTOSAR Classic architecture and BSW and ASPICE know-how.
Good understanding of microcontrollers, low‑level drivers, and embedded RTOS concepts.
Experience / Familiarity in: Vehicle diagnostics and fault management SW
AUTOSAR modules: Diagnostic Error Management (DEM), Diagnostic Communication Management (DCM), Communication Stack (CAN\Ethernet\LIN protocol)
Automotive protocols and standards: ISO 14229, ISO 15765, ISO 14230, ISO 26262.
Familiarity with CANoe, CANalyzer, and issue/requirement tracking tools (e.g., Jira, DOORS/ or similar).
Prior Experience with ADAS‑related ECUs (radar, camera, sensor fusion, braking/steering controllers) is a strong plus.
Soft Skills
Self‑driven, proactive, and able to take ownership of modules/features end‑to‑end.
Strong teamwork, interpersonal skills, and problem‑solving ability.
High degree of self-discipline, quality focus, and willingness to learn new technologies in ADAS and autonomous driving.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Build the future of intelligent workflows on OutSystems + GenAI – at global scale.
🌍 The Mission
We are transforming how a global technology corporation works – by building a next-generation workflow platform that powers nearly half a million users worldwide and enables thousands of workflow applications across the enterprise.
This is not a short-term project. It’s a long-term global product & service journey with real impact, real scale, and real ownership.
✅ ~60% of core functions already delivered
🚀 A strategic roadmap ahead to expand platform capabilities – deeply leveraging OutSystems No Code/Low Code (NCLC) and AI
🎯 By 2027, we are evolving into a truly AI-native Global Product & Service team
We’re looking for a highly talented OutSystems Expert who wants to join a global product team, build core platform capabilities, and grow into a future-ready AI product engineering leader.
💡 Why This Opportunity Is Rare
✅ Global Scale, Real Impact
Your work will directly influence how work gets done across a worldwide organization – supporting critical workflows used by hundreds of thousands of people.
✅ A Platform, Not applications
You’ll help build a core workflow platform (not just applications) that becomes the backbone for enterprise-wide process automation, governance, security, and reliability.
✅ AI + OutSystems – From Adoption to AI-Native
We’re not only using OutSystems – we’re investing seriously in NCLC and AI to transform how we build, test, operate, and continuously improve the platform.
✅ Career Journey with Long-Term Commitment
We want people who are serious about building something meaningful – and staying to complete the mission. If you’re looking for a place to create big achievements, grow fast, and become part of a global AI product team, this is your moment.
🧩 Role Summary
Title: Senior OutSystems Developer / OutSystems Expert (Workflow Platform)
Team: Global Product & Service Team – Workflow Platform
Focus: Build and evolve the core platform backend + scalable services enabling thousands of workflow applications on OutSystems, accelerated by AI.
As a Senior OutSystems Developer, you will lead the development and maintenance of enterprise-grade web/mobile solutions and core platform services. You’ll work with Product, Architecture, DevOps, and Design to deliver high-quality releases with strong reliability, security, and performance.
🎯 What You Will Own (Key Responsibilities)
Platform & Full-Stack Engineering
Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using OutSystems, leveraging prior experience in .NET where needed.
Lead architecture and development for web + mobile, ensuring clean, efficient, maintainable solutions across the stack.
Build reusable components and shared services that strengthen platform capability and speed up delivery.
Business Logic, Data & Performance
Implement complex business logic, custom UI components, and robust database layers.
Design and optimize data models across SQL and NoSQL (e.g., SQL Server/Oracle, MongoDB, Elasticsearch).
Drive performance tuning (queries, caching, pagination, asynchronous processing, monitoring).
Integrations & Enterprise Connectivity
Implement and maintain REST/SOAP APIs and third-party integrations.
Ensure resiliency through strong patterns: authentication, error handling, retries, and observability.
Delivery Excellence (Agile + DevOps)
Actively contribute to Agile rituals: refinement, planning, sprint execution, and continuous improvement.
Support release pipelines via LifeTime, environment management, deployments, versioning, and basic CI/CD.
Reliability, Security & Operational Readiness
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues efficiently – protecting platform stability and user trust.
Apply security best practices: RBAC, SSO, secure integrations, OWASP, data protection, audit readiness.
Team Growth & Mentoring
Guide junior developers, raise engineering standards, and build a strong culture of quality and ownership.
Promote best practices in coding, reviews, testing, and platform governance.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Must-Have Qualifications:
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Software Engineering/IT (or equivalent practical experience).
7+ years hands-on OutSystems development experience.
OutSystems certifications: Professional/Expert Web (Traditional/Reactive), Architecture certs.
Strong backend capabilities: data modeling, advanced SQL (MSSQL/Oracle), performance tuning.
Workflow/process experience: BPT, case/process management, async processing, timers/queues.
Front-end proficiency with UX/UI best practices; strong HTML/CSS/JS.
Integrations expertise: REST/SOAP, API design, authentication, error handling, resiliency.
Strong OutSystems architecture practices: layered modular design, dependency management, code quality.
DevOps fundamentals in OutSystems: LifeTime, deployments, environment management, release versioning, basic CI/CD.
Security mindset: RBAC, SSO, secure integrations, OWASP, data protection.
Strong troubleshooting skills: caching, aggregates, pagination, logging/monitoring.
Strong communication & stakeholder collaboration; mentoring; Agile/Scrum experience.
Fluent English (spoken and written).
Nice-to-Have (Strong Plus):
Platform tools: AI Mentor, Service Center, LifeTime Analytics/APM.
Advanced architecture: DDD, microservices/SOA, lean principles.
CI/CD beyond LifeTime: Azure DevOps / GitHub Actions / Jenkins / GitLab CI.
Cloud & enterprise integration: Azure/AWS/GCP, Entra ID (Azure AD), API Management.
Integration Studio extensions: C#/.NET; building/exposing services.
Event & messaging: Kafka, RabbitMQ; enterprise integration patterns.
ODC experience: migration from OS11 (Reactive to ODC).
Mobile deep expertise: offline sync, plugins, push notifications, store releases.
Observability: App Insights, ELK, alerting, incident response.
What You’ll Gain:
Massive Career Growth
Build a platform serving nearly half a million global users
Create achievements that are visible, measurable, and enterprise-wide
Expand from “developer” to platform engineer + product mindset builder
AI Transformation Journey (2026–2027)
Work in a team that is actively transforming into an AI Global Product & Service team
Learn AI-accelerated delivery practices (AI-assisted engineering, testing, operations, continuous improvement)
Global Product Team Experience
Collaborate with international stakeholders, product leaders, architects, and engineering teams
Learn enterprise-grade quality, reliability, governance, and platform thinking
🤝 Who Will Thrive Here
You’ll love this role if you:
Want to build a platform, not just single applications
Take ownership and enjoy solving complex engineering challenges
Are motivated by large-scale impact and long-term achievement
Want to grow into the next era of AI-native product engineering
Are ready to commit seriously and stay through a meaningful transformation journey
📩 Ready to Build the Future?
If you’re a strong OutSystems expert and want a rare chance to join a long-term global platform mission – this is your opportunity to create something big, learn fast, and transform your career.
Apply now or send your profile with:
OutSystems certifications
Key platform/architecture projects you led
This is a long‑term global product journey, not a short engagement.
Please share your thoughts on the following in your motivation letter:
What specifically motivates you to join and stay dedicated to a long‑term global product & service platform like ours, and how does this role fit into your personal 3–5 year career vision?

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Software Engineering/IT (or equivalent practical experience).

Strong backend capabilities: data modeling, advanced SQL (MSSQL/Oracle), performance tuning.
Workflow/process experience: BPT, case/process management, async processing, timers/queues.
Front-end proficiency with UX/UI best practices; strong HTML/CSS/JS.
Integrations expertise: REST/SOAP, API design, authentication, error handling, resiliency.
Strong OutSystems architecture practices: layered modular design, dependency management, code quality.

Strong communication & stakeholder collaboration; mentoring; Agile/Scrum experience.
Fluent English (spoken and written).

Platform tools: AI Mentor, Service Center, LifeTime Analytics/APM.

Massive Career Growth

Want to build a platform, not just single applications

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Bosch first started its operations in Vietnam in 1994 and registered a wholly-owned subsidiary in 2008. According to the business strategy of Bosch in Vietnam, from 1st July 2014 on all business entities were merged into Bosch Vietnam Co. Ltd. with its head office at Ho Chi Minh City plant (HcP) in Dong Nai Province.
HcP has started its belt assembly in a rented building on 1st August 2008 as the assembly plant of Tilburg Plant (TbP). On 14th April 2011, HcP celebrated the inauguration of the new plant (Lth101 with 17,000 sqm), which did not only allow to increase the production depth, but also to facilitate the push belt assembly of this high-tech product. On 3rd July 2012 HcP marked a big milestone by starting to produce the second component (loop-set) for its push belt. Since November 2012, HcP doubled the production floor space and increase the net total floor space up to 56.000 m², and have successfully increased its production capacity and realized a lot of new line SOP’s.
For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Bosch is undergoing a transformation by migrating legacy workflow platforms to a modern low-code solution. We are seeking a Workflow Developer with strong JavaScript expertise and experience in business workflow development to join our team. The primary responsibility will be migrating existing workflows from the legacy system to the new platform while ensuring seamless functionality . Additionally, the candidate will have the opportunity to upskill in OutSystems for future application development.
Key Responsibilities
Identify the pros and cons of the current workflow to enhance it based on the new platform’s features and advantages.
Develop custom actions and logic in JavaScript for advanced features, logic, or validation needs.
Work with business analysts and stakeholders to ensure workflows align with business requirements.
Document migration processes, configurations, and customizations for future reference.
Learn and use OutSystems to develop and improve applications as needed.
Troubleshoot and fix issues related to workflow migration and functionality.
Ensure compliance with Bosch’s security and architecture standards.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Mandatory requirements:
Educational background: Bachelor degree in Information Technology, Computer Sciences or relevant majors.
3+ years of experience in JavaScript (ES6+ ) for custom logic implementation.
Hands-on experience in business workflow development (e.g., BPMN, workflow automation).
Familiarity with REST APIs, JSON, and integration patterns .
Knowledge of SQL and database concepts.
Design thinking for logic, flow enhancement to deliver good UX instead of strictly follow original requirement.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a global team .
Good communication and fluent English skills to interact with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Nice-to-Have:
Basic understanding of low-code platforms (OutSystems, Power Apps, etc.) is a plus.
Prior experience with OutSystems is a strong advantage.
Exposure to legacy system migration projects.
Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies.

sections.text:
Position Overview:
We are seeking an expert in Android Automotive development to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of In-Vehicle Infotainment (IVI) systems and Cockpit Domain Controllers. The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Android Automotive, AOSP (Android Open-Source Project), and integrating multimedia, navigation, connectivity, and vehicle control features in a real-time automotive environment. This role requires experience in driving the technical architecture, coding, and hands-on system integration to deliver innovative automotive solutions. A key part of your responsibilities will include leading the development of high-performance, low-latency Android Automotive systems and collaborating across multi-OS platforms, including QNX Hypervisor integration.
Key Responsibilities:
Android Automotive Systems Development
Lead the development of Android Automotive solutions, customizing AOSP for In-Vehicle Infotainment (IVI) platforms, and integrating multimedia, navigation, and vehicle control features.
Optimize HMI (Human-Machine Interface) for seamless transitions between infotainment and vehicle systems, enhancing the driver experience.
Hands-On Development & Debugging
Platform Architecture & Integration
Client Engagement & Business Development
Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Extensive Experience in Android Automotive Development: At least 8 years of hands-on experience in developing Android Automotive solutions, including deep customization of AOSP for IVI systems and infotainment platforms.
Real-Time Systems Expertise: Proven experience in optimizing Android for real-time applications, including the integration of safety-critical systems and the implementation of multi-layered solutions with low-latency performance.
Hands-On Embedded Systems Development: Expertise in writing low-level code, device drivers, and firmware for automotive platforms running Android, with experience in BSP development and hardware integration.
Client-Facing & Proposal Skills: Experience in client-facing roles, delivering technical presentations, and managing proposals and project bids related to Android Automotive solutions.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Department Information
ETA portfolio
We are seeking an experienced Senior/Technical Lead Software Engineer to take a leading role in developing the core embedded software platform for the Automotive Chiplet System (ACS) - a next-generation modular computing architecture for Software-Defined Vehicles (SDV).
This role places you at the forefront of shaping the software ecosystem for multi-die chiplet architectures, enabling seamless development, integration, and performance optimization for in-vehicle applications.
Your contributions will directly impact system bring-up reliability, real-time performance, inter-chiplet communication, developer experience, and the overall innovation roadmap for our automotive computing platform.
Main Roles and Responsibilities
Design and implement core ACS embedded platform components across MCAL, memory services, RTOS-based control layers, communication interfaces, intra-die IPC, and bootloader functionality, ensuring scalability, quality, and maintainability.
Design, develop and integrate communication mechanisms to enable efficient and reliable interaction between units: Intra-die IPC
External low-speed interfaces
Implement and optimize real-time system behavior on RTOS platforms , including task scheduling, synchronization, and timing-critical execution.
Develop bootloader solutions to support reliable system startup, secure firmware update, and recovery mechanisms.
Support system bring-up and validation on the ACS reference board , working closely with hardware teams on chiplet interconnects, power management, and board system state control.
Explore and validate new ideas through proof-of-concept (POC) development to assess emerging technologies, software approaches, and chiplet capabilities.
Collaborate cross-functionally with hardware engineers, system architects, and product managers to define detailed software and hardware interaction requirements.
Debug and resolve complex issues across multi-die, and multi-layer embedded systems.
Develop and maintain detailed documentation , including architectural specifications, API definitions, integration guides.
Participate in and conduct design reviews , ensuring adherence to automotive safety and security standards such as ISO 26262, ASPICE, and other relevant industry guidelines.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Mandatory Qualifications
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering , or a related engineering discipline.
Proven experience (5+ Years experienced) in embedded software development or system architecture , ideally in automotive or other safety-critical industries.
Strong C/C++ programming skills for embedded Linux systems.
Experience with Python, Ruby, Shell Script .
Strong hands-on experience with RTOS , Linux , and QNX platforms.
Solid understanding of chiplet-based architectures, and SoC design principles .
Practical experience working with MCAL, hardware drivers, BSPs , and low-level hardware/software integration.
Practical experience with embedded communication protocols (CAN, LIN, SPI, I2C) .
Practical experience with low-level debugging tools .
Ability to produce high-quality architectural and technical documentation.
Strong collaboration skills and experience working in multi-disciplinary engineering teams.
Preferred Skills
Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities, especially when dealing with complex hardware–software interactions.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with cross-functional teams.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
Ability to think innovatively, conduct exploratory POCs, and translate new concepts into working solutions.
Proactive mindset with a strong drive for improving performance, scalability, and developer usability.
