sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
About the Role
We are looking for 10 Senior Embedded Security Engineers to design, implement, and validate end-to-end security solutions on modern embedded platforms.
This role is open to candidates from multiple domains , including Automotive, IoT, Mobile Devices, and Embedded Systems.
If you have hands-on experience securing Linux / Android-based systems, SoCs, or connected devices, and are interested in working on automotive-grade platforms such as Infotainment (IVI) and ADAS , we strongly encourage you to apply.
You will work on modern SoC platforms (e.g. Qualcomm, Renesas, TI, Marvell) running Android Automotive, Linux, QNX, or AUTOSAR-based systems , contributing to secure, scalable, and production-ready embedded solutions.
Main Responsibilities
1. Security Architecture & Engineering
Design and implement end-to-end security features for embedded platforms, including: Secure Boot, Trusted Execution Environments (TEE), Secure storage, Secure update mechanisms, Secure communication, etc...
Contribute to security architecture definition for embedded and connected systems.
2. Threat Modeling & Reviews
Perform security architecture reviews and threat modeling for infotainment, ADAS, IoT, or connected device platforms.
Identify risks, define mitigation strategies, and drive security improvements early in the development lifecycle.
3. Security Implementation & Hardening
Implement security hardening for Linux / Android / QNX systems.
Conduct secure code reviews and collaborate with development teams to address vulnerabilities.
Support integration of access control and system hardening mechanisms (e.g. SELinux, AppArmor).
4. Testing & Validation
Perform security testing and validation , including: Static and dynamic analysis, Fuzzing, Penetration testing
Validate security features on real hardware and production-like environments.
5. Process & Compliance
Develop and maintain security requirements and security engineering processes (SEP) .
Support compliance with relevant security standards and best practices .

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Mandatory Qualifications
Educational background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Cryptography , or a related technical field
7-15 years of overall experience, with at least 2-5 years of experience in embedded software development, system software, or security engineering (backgrounds from Automotive, IoT, Mobile Devices, Consumer Electronics are all welcome)
Practical experience with Linux and/or Android platforms , particularly in BSP, middleware, system services, or other low-level system components .
Solid understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals , including cryptography, secure communication protocols, secure coding practices, and security testing principles .
Hands-on experience implementing or supporting embedded system security features , such as secure boot, system trust mechanisms, secure storage, secure update/OTA, and secure communication between components or devices .
Nice-to-Have (Any of the following will be a strong advantage, but are not mandatory )
Good knowledge or hands-on experience in development with modern SoC architectures, such as: Qualcomm, Renesas (RCAR), TI, etc.
Experience in QNX development
Relevant certifications (CEH, CISSP, OSCP, SANS GIAC, etc.)
Good knowledge or hands-on experience in following areas: Secure Boot.
Hardware-back security such as Trustzone (Arm TrustZone, OP-TEE, etc.), HSM , etc.
Storage security (disk encryption, dm-verity, etc.).
Secure communication protocols (TLS/DTLS, SSH, IPsec, MACsec, etc.).
Access control & hardening (SELinux, AppArmor, etc.).
Signing tools (Android signing, secure boot signing, etc.).
Linux / Android / QNX security development/hardening.
Network security, firewall.
Security testing & validation (fuzzing, static/dynamic analysis, penetration testing, etc.).

Relevant certifications (CEH, CISSP, OSCP, SANS GIAC, etc.)

Linux / Android / QNX security development/hardening.

sections.text:
To be a part of the Project Team to deliver a custom-built software application on a low-code platform by following Agile Frameworks and DevOps practices
Your Key Responsibilities
Working as an Agile Team Member, managing and executing a variety of tasks
Lead development projects using the OutSystems platform, ensure projects meet business requirements and goals, fulfill end-user requirements, and identify and resolve systems issues.
Optimize the OutSystems applications for maximum speed and scalability.
Attain a detailed understanding of the customer’s business needs and apply the OutSystems technology to meet those needs.
Interacting with Business Users as necessary to clarify requirements
Taking responsibility for the quality of the software developed and delivered
User Story Effort Estimation
Software Development including meeting the Definition of Done
Software Testing including fulfilling the Acceptance Criteria
Creating Software Documents as require
Skills And Attributes For Success
Contributing to setting-up, and execution of DevOps practices
Software Deployment
Software Maintenance and Support

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
To qualify for the role, you must have
At least 3-5 years of experience working with OutSystems platform
At least a degree or diploma in a relevant technical field
Familiarity with the whole web stack, including protocols and web server optimization techniques.
Experienced in Agile Software Development
Experienced in Web Applications, HTML, CSS and JavaScript
Experienced in Software Integration using APIs and Web Services
Experienced in Database Systems
Advanced knowledge of the OutSystems platform, with the ability to code and debug issues.
Ideally, you’ll also have
OutSystems experience is a distinct advantage
Scrum Ceremonies and Artefacts experience is a distinct advantage
.NET Framework experience is an advantage
Additional Business Education is a distinct advantage
Low-code platform certification is a distinct advantage
Scrum Certification is an advantage
What We Look For
Highly motivated individuals with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to prioritize shifting workloads in a rapidly changing industry. An effective communicator, you’ll be a confident team player that collaborates with people from various teams while looking to develop your career in a dynamic organization.

sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services, in the areas of automotive and industrial technology, consumer goods as well as building technology.
Bosch established its first representative office in Ho Chi Minh City in 1994. Since 2007, Bosch has expanded its footprint in Vietnam where it has branch offices in Hanoi and Da Nang, as well as a Powertrain Solutions plant in the Dong Nai province to manufacture pushbelts for continuously variable transmissions (CVT) in automobiles. Additional information is available online at: https://www.bosch.com.vn/ , https://www.linkedin.com/company/bosch-vietnam and https://www.facebook.com/OfficialBoschVietnam

Perform quality service covering service request fulfillment, technical consultancy, incident & problem management, change management, CIP, IT compliance, emergency concept, customer satisfaction, etc.

Ensure quality project deliveries in term of SoW, progress against schedule and within resource allocation (time, budget, capacity, etc)

Validate and support PIA (Process Improvement Activities)

Training: Perform quality knowledge transfer towards end users, key users, proxy or at assignments to enable services, secure operation, sustain/ improve service quality
Learning: continuously develop knowledge on responsible areas or where organization has demand to perform effective services

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Bosch first started its operations in Vietnam in 1994 and registered a wholly-owned subsidiary in 2008. According to the business strategy of Bosch in Vietnam, from 1st July 2014 on all business entities were merged into Bosch Vietnam Co. Ltd. with its head office at Ho Chi Minh City plant (HcP) in Dong Nai Province.
HcP has started its belt assembly in a rented building on 1st August 2008 as the assembly plant of Tilburg Plant (TbP). On 14th April 2011, HcP celebrated the inauguration of the new plant (Lth101 with 17,000 sqm), which did not only allow to increase the production depth, but also to facilitate the push belt assembly of this high-tech product. On 3rd July 2012 HcP marked a big milestone by starting to produce the second component (loop-set) for its push belt. Since November 2012, HcP doubled the production floor space and increase the net total floor space up to 56.000 m², and have successfully increased its production capacity and realized a lot of new line SOP’s.
For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn

Carry out other duties as reasonably assigned by the Department Head or Management, including providing support to other positions/departments when required, in alignment with professional competencies and the hotel's policies and regulations.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Situated on one of the most charming beaches of Phu Quoc island, only 10 minutes from the airport, Novotel Phu Quoc Resort is a natural paradise overlooking the Gulf of Thailand.
The Resort provides multiple choices of rooms for family, couples, groups, and individual travellers with 246 spacious and comfortable rooms set in the main building, perfect for those chasing the contemporary design, whilst natural beauty seekers can opt to stay at our beautiful 120 bungalows located in the tropical garden or with ocean view and access to the beach.
Cuisine means discovering new tastes, and our Ex-Chef proposes a mix of traditional and modern with dedicated cooking methods. Seafood restaurant lets you explore the island’s speciality; our Seafood platter is a signature dish known for its umami flavour, ideal for sharing with family or friends.
From dawn to nightfall, discover moments and experiences to entice and delight, whether savouring a delicious cocktail at Ocean Bar while watching the sunset, lying down by the Infinity Pool steps from the beach or kayaking to immerse yourself in the beauty of sunrise.
Novotel Phu Quoc Resort loves families and has an exclusive children’s policy, complimentary for up to 16 years old if sharing the rooms with parents. We also propose various activities and services that satisfy all ages and make every moment matter for the family.
“Children Activities Program” delivers various choices to attract and retain children based on the four essential fundamentals: Discovery, Artistic, Connection and fun, and Event. Furthermore, with the unique “Kid’s Care” service, the parents will have more opportunities to enjoy their “me time” as it welcomes all the children from 5 to 11 years old during specific times of the day. Our propaganda is Happy children, happy holiday.
Like a hidden pearl, In Balance Spa is where guests will find their sense of rejuvenation through various treatments and massages. Besides that, there are well-equipped fitness centres and tennis courts for those who want to stay in shape.
Set a mission of providing a complete holiday; the All-Inclusive concept is created to give credit full right to enjoy an authentic vacation free of stress. With this package, guests can eat and drink anywhere, any time, starting from 06:30 AM until 11:00 PM. Free wide range of activities for adults, kid and family. Not to mention, more benefits are included, starting from a minimum of 07 nights. We invite you to explore our special offer section to discover our All-Inclisive.
The Resort is also perfect for MICE as our ballroom can accommodate hundreds of people, and the wide sandy shore is ideal for team building. For those couples who wish for a dream wedding, whether it is a stylish wedding in the ballroom, a barefoot wedding on the beach, or a fabulous reception under the stars, we’re delighted to be a part of your event.

sections.text:
1. Position Summary:
Rixos Phu Quoc is seeking a highly organized and people-focused Assistant Manager, People & Culture to support the daily operations of the People & Culture department. The Assistant Manager will be responsible for assisting in compensation & benefits, expatriate documentations, employee engagement, and HR administration, ensuring a seamless and positive experience for all team members. This role plays a key part in supporting a collaborative and high-performing workplace culture in alignment with Rixos standards.
2. Key Responsibilities:
• HR Administration: Maintain accurate employee records, manage HR documentation, and ensure timely data entry in HR systems. Prepare letters, reports, and other HR-related documents.
• Compensation & Benefits: Serve as the primary point of contact for employee C&B inquiries. Manage and resolve issues regarding housing, allowances, insurance, and other welfare schemes to ensure seamless administration and employee satisfaction.
• Expatriate Management: Lead and manage all procedures for foreign employees, including work permits, temporary residence cards (TRC), and visas. Ensure full compliance with local regulations and support international team members efficiently.
• Onboarding & Orientation: Coordinate new hire orientation sessions, prepare induction materials, and ensure a positive and efficient onboarding experience for new team members.
• Employee Engagement: Support and participate in organizing employee engagement activities, events, and recognition programs to enhance workplace morale and satisfaction.
• Payroll Support: Compile and verify attendance, leave, and overtime records. Submit payroll-related data accurately and on time to the payroll team.
• Policy Compliance: Ensure that HR activities comply with company policies and local labor laws. Communicate policies effectively to employees and support their understanding.
• Employee Relations: Serve as a first point of contact for employee inquiries and concerns. Provide support in resolving minor issues and escalate where appropriate.
• Data Reporting: Generate HR reports, track KPIs such as turnover and absenteeism, and assist with HR audits or compliance checks.
• Collaboration: Work closely with the Manager, People & Culture and other departments to ensure the effective implementation of HR initiatives.
3. Working Conditions: Full-time position
• Standard office hours, Monday through Friday
• Occasional need for overtime depending on workload or special events
• On-site role with regular interaction with employees and various departments

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Qualifications & Skills: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, Law, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
Experience: Minimum of 3–5 years of progressive HR experience, preferably in a hospitality environment or luxury resort. Prior experience in handling C&B operations and expatriate management (Work Permits/TRC) is highly preferred.
Legal & Policy Knowledge: Strong understanding of local labor laws, social insurance regulations, HR practices and expatriate employment procedures in Vietnam.
Skills:
• Employee Relations & Communication: Strong interpersonal skills with an empathetic and service-oriented mindset to handle employee inquiries and build positive workplace culture.
• Organizational & Detail-Oriented: High level of accuracy in data management, C&B tracking, and compliance documentation.
• Adaptability: Ability to manage multiple operational priorities, handle sensitive situations with high confidentiality, and work efficiently under pressure.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook) and familiarity with HR information systems. • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
• High level of confidentiality, professionalism, and integrity.
• Initiative and problem-solving skills with a team-oriented mindset.

sections.text:
We are looking for an experienced leader in Food and Beverage to join the opening team at Rixos Phu Quoc. This role requires a hands-on leader who can instil the Rixos brand and bring it to life for our guests and colleagues.
Other key responsibilities for this role include:
Develops a food and beverage operating strategy that is aligned with the brand’s business strategy and leads its execution.
Ensure integration of departmental goals
Create an atmosphere in all food and beverage areas that meets or exceeds guest expectations
Ensures new hires participate in the department’s orientation program and receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job
Control the food and beverage operations according to the principles determined by Rixos Hotels
Monitor the food and beverage operations in line with the procedures determined by the hotel management, set targets and communicate and ensure adoption of these targets.
Maximize the department’s profitability through operations.
Manage operations to ensure the highest quality delivery of food and beverage products and service.
Conduct activities to increase customer satisfaction and enhance service quality.
Prepare and offer new menus and beverage lists, taking into account the purchasing power of guests and the region.
Attend departmental meetings and the Management meeting according to the hotel management calendar.
Ensure protection, maintenance and replacement of materials and utensils.
Prepare and monitor monthly and annual F&B departmental budget.
Contribute to preparing the hotel’s income plans and marketing programmed.
Deliver the income and expenses of the F&B Department in line with the facility’s budget discipline. Develop plans based on data of previous years.
Create the necessary motivational environment to ensure and increase productivity and success of current staff and develop necessary arguments to ensure F&B Department employees’ commitment to the facilities.
Review the departmental reports, income statements, guest relations reports, technical service reports, and departmental communication logs on a daily basis.
Conduct promotional activities to increase sales and conduct meetings for banquet organizations

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Education/Experience: 4-year bachelor's degree with a minimum of 6 years of related work experience or 2 years work experience in the same position and experience with applying the main principles and/or different methods.
Languages: Fluency in English, proficiency in Vietnamese an advantage

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Primary Responsibilities
Security Operation
Train Security Officers in the operation of surveillance equipment, written reports, record keeping, patrol and first aid procedures
Disseminate all information by the Management to team members
Conduct patrols and regular checks on all Security Officers to assure that they are alert and discharging their duties efficiently and effectively
Conduct all criminal investigations, put up accompanying investigation papers and reports cases which occur within the Hotel
Conduct surveillance on hotel staff to ensure that they abide by the House Rules; Keep tag on movements of staff who are classified as suspects under investigations
Control and direct all emergency personnel traffic in response to fire, bomb threat, police assistance, injury or illness
Inspect all Security equipment to ensure that they are in working order and that all cameras are correctly focused
Conduct routine day-to-day checks of the following items to ensure that they are properly maintained, issued and accounted for;
Pocket books;
Security Desk Occurrence Book;
Gate Passes and Security Passes;
Keys and Key Registers;
Post allocation for hotel and External Security
Cultivate Informers with the intention of obtaining information of security interest that may be of immediate or future use to the Department for prevention and detection purposes
Record all activities involving the Department in the Daily Security Report
Provide security coverage for VIP guests
Update Director of Security constantly on all matters of security interest affecting the Hotel and the Department
Always be on-call, including off-duty hours, for any emergency that may arise
Team Management
Conduct performance review with the team
Identify and develop team members with potential
Constantly monitor team members’ appearance, attitude and degree of professionalism
Conduct detailed induction programs for new employees
Develop, conduct maintain all staff training programs for team members, focusing on their development needs, providing them with new skills to meet the changing needs of the business
Prepare weekly staff schedules keeping in mind anticipated business, operating budgets and standards of service
Other Responsibilities
Be fully conversant with hotel fire & life safety/emergency procedures
Comply with hotel and department policies and procedures at all times
Attend all briefings, meetings and trainings as assigned by management
Report for duty on time wearing clean and complete uniform at all times
Maintain a high standard of personal appearance and hygiene at all times
Perform other reasonable duties assigned by the Management of the Hotel
Main Complexity/Critical issues in the Job
Maintain highest standards of security within the hotel premises. Be vigilant and react fast when situations arise.

sections.text:
Knowledge and Experience
Diploma education
Certificates in National Skills Recognition System, CPR, First Aid Management and Basic Fire Fighting
Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in a similar capacity
Good reading, writing and oral proficiency in English language
No criminal record
Competencies
Strong leadership, interpersonal and training skills
Good communication skills
Honest with a high level of integrity
Ability to remain calm and react fast to situations
Results and service oriented with an eye for details
Ability to multi-task, work well in stressful & high-pressure situations
A team player & builder
Well-presented and professionally groomed at all times

Conduct competitor analysis to benchmark content performance and identify opportunities

Maintain strong relationships with local, national and international media (print and digital)
Support maximising media coverage for events and promotional activities

Content Strategy & Planning
Develop and implement a content strategy aligned with marketing objectives

Generate creative campaign concepts including written messaging and visual direction

Write and optimise SEO-driven copy using targeted keywords while maintaining engaging storytelling
Rewrite and refine copy to ensure clarity, accessibility and impact
Continuously generate fresh ideas to attract and retain audience attention

Ensure all content complies with copyright, data protection and relevant regulations
Stay up to date with industry trends and digital best practices
Conduct competitor analysis to benchmark content performance and identify opportunities
Media, Sponsorship & External Relations
Draft professional correspondence related to sponsorship proposals, negotiations and appreciation letters
Maintain strong relationships with local, national and international media (print and digital)
Support maximising media coverage for events and promotional activities
Guest Engagement & Communication
Respond to guest inquiries regarding property facilities and services with clarity and professionalism
Record and relay communications accurately and efficiently

What We’re Looking For
Proven experience in content management, digital marketing or communications
Exceptional writing and editing skills in English (additional languages are an advantage)
Strong understanding of SEO and search-driven content strategies
Creative thinker with strong campaign ideation capability
Confident communicator, comfortable networking with media and partners
Highly organised, detail-oriented and deadline-driven
Commercial awareness — understands how content supports revenue growth

The opportunity to join an international and innovative and fast-growing group, committed not only to building new hotels, but to creating a global brand.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Role Overview
We are looking for an energetic and guest-focused Fitness / Gym Instructor to join our wellness and recreation team. This role is responsible for delivering exceptional fitness services, maintaining gym and sports facilities, and ensuring guests enjoy a safe, motivating, and high-quality fitness experience throughout their stay.
You will play a key role in promoting a healthy lifestyle, providing personalized training programs, and upholding Rixos service and safety standards.
Key Responsibilities
Deliver outstanding service to all guests using the fitness center and sports facilities
Develop and conduct personalized exercise programs and one-on-one personal training sessions upon request
Provide fitness consultations for arriving and in-house guests
Lead and support indoor and outdoor leisure and fitness activities
Ensure gym, sports, and fitness equipment is well maintained and in excellent working condition
Maintain up-to-date equipment maintenance records and support preventive maintenance programs
Ensure high standards of cleanliness, hygiene, and safety within all fitness and leisure areas
Monitor guest health and wellbeing, including administering medical questionnaires where required
Manage fitness center retail operations, including stock control, inventory, and sales
Assist guests with retail purchases and provide product recommendations
Cover gym reception and retail areas when required
Handle guest feedback or complaints professionally and escalate when necessary
Maintain regular follow-up with guests to monitor progress and enhance their fitness experience
Stay informed about current and emerging health, fitness, and wellness trends
Compliance & Standards
Follow all Rixos policies, procedures, and operational standards
Comply with ISO Integrated Management System requirements related to quality, health, safety, environment, and guest satisfaction
Actively contribute to risk management, sustainability initiatives, and continuous improvement programs
Be fully familiar with emergency procedures and prepared to respond effectively

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Qualifications & Experience
Internationally recognized Personal Training or Group Fitness Certification (ACE, NASM, ACSM, AFAA, or equivalent)
Minimum 1 year of experience in a similar role, preferably within the hospitality or resort environment
CPR/AED certification (mandatory)
High school diploma or equivalent required; degree in Sports Science, Physical Education, or related field is an advantage
Strong communication skills with a friendly and professional guest-focused approach

sections.text:
Role Overview
We are looking for a skilled and passionate AV Technician to join our Audio-Visual team at Rixos Phú Quốc Vietnam . In this role, you will be responsible for the setup, operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of audio-visual equipment, ensuring flawless technical delivery for events, shows, and daily operations.
You will work closely with internal teams, performers, and event organizers to deliver exceptional guest experiences through high-quality sound, visuals, and lighting.
Key Responsibilities
Install, set up, test, and operate audio-visual equipment including projectors, microphones, sound systems, lighting, video monitors, cameras, and video conferencing systems
Operate AV systems during live events, shows, meetings, and presentations
Manage live audio mixing, video switching, and lighting control
Perform routine maintenance and inspections to ensure all equipment is in excellent working condition
Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues efficiently and professionally
Repair faulty equipment or coordinate external repairs when required
Support event organizers, presenters, performers, bands, and singers, including sound checks and stage setup in line with technical riders
Maintain accurate records of AV inventory, maintenance schedules, and repair logs
Document setup configurations, operating procedures, and troubleshooting solutions
Collaborate closely with event coordinators, IT teams, and other departments
Be fully aware of recreation facilities, evening programs, show concepts, and schedules
Ensure all AV areas and equipment are clean, safe, and well-organized
Compliance & Standards
Adhere to Rixos Hotels & Resorts policies, operational standards, and ISO Integrated Management System requirements
Actively participate in quality improvement, risk management, health & safety, environmental protection, and energy-saving initiatives
Contribute to continuous improvement and guest satisfaction programs

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Education & Experience
Diploma or Certificate in Electrical Engineering or Audio-Visual Technology
Minimum 2–3 years of experience in a similar AV role
Hospitality or event environment experience is an advantage
Skills & Competencies
Strong technical knowledge of professional AV systems
Good communication skills in English
Team-oriented with a positive and professional attitude
Ability to work independently and under pressure during live events
Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills
Our Values – How You Succeed in This Role
Act with integrity, sincerity, and transparency
Take ownership, be reliable, and follow through on commitments
Maintain confidentiality and professionalism at all times
Continuously seek improvement and strive to exceed expectations
Deliver excellence in hospitality and service quality

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Situated on one of the most charming beaches of Phu Quoc island, only 10 minutes from the airport, Novotel Phu Quoc Resort is a natural paradise overlooking the Gulf of Thailand.
The Resort provides multiple choices of rooms for family, couples, groups, and individual travellers with 246 spacious and comfortable rooms set in the main building, perfect for those chasing the contemporary design, whilst natural beauty seekers can opt to stay at our beautiful 120 bungalows located in the tropical garden or with ocean view and access to the beach.
Cuisine means discovering new tastes, and our Ex-Chef proposes a mix of traditional and modern with dedicated cooking methods. Seafood restaurant lets you explore the island’s speciality; our Seafood platter is a signature dish known for its umami flavour, ideal for sharing with family or friends.
From dawn to nightfall, discover moments and experiences to entice and delight, whether savouring a delicious cocktail at Ocean Bar while watching the sunset, lying down by the Infinity Pool steps from the beach or kayaking to immerse yourself in the beauty of sunrise.
Novotel Phu Quoc Resort loves families and has an exclusive children’s policy, complimentary for up to 16 years old if sharing the rooms with parents. We also propose various activities and services that satisfy all ages and make every moment matter for the family.
“Children Activities Program” delivers various choices to attract and retain children based on the four essential fundamentals: Discovery, Artistic, Connection and fun, and Event. Furthermore, with the unique “Kid’s Care” service, the parents will have more opportunities to enjoy their “me time” as it welcomes all the children from 5 to 11 years old during specific times of the day. Our propaganda is Happy children, happy holiday.
Like a hidden pearl, In Balance Spa is where guests will find their sense of rejuvenation through various treatments and massages. Besides that, there are well-equipped fitness centres and tennis courts for those who want to stay in shape.
Set a mission of providing a complete holiday; the All-Inclusive concept is created to give credit full right to enjoy an authentic vacation free of stress. With this package, guests can eat and drink anywhere, any time, starting from 06:30 AM until 11:00 PM. Free wide range of activities for adults, kid and family. Not to mention, more benefits are included, starting from a minimum of 07 nights. We invite you to explore our special offer section to discover our All-Inclisive.
The Resort is also perfect for MICE as our ballroom can accommodate hundreds of people, and the wide sandy shore is ideal for team building. For those couples who wish for a dream wedding, whether it is a stylish wedding in the ballroom, a barefoot wedding on the beach, or a fabulous reception under the stars, we’re delighted to be a part of your event.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
JOB PURPOSE
The Night Manager is responsible for ensuring the smooth, safe and efficient operation of the hotel during the overnight shift, while maintaining Pullman brand standards, guest satisfaction and operational excellence. The position reports to the Front Office Manager and acts as the Manager on Duty (MOD) during the night, with overall responsibility for coordinating hotel operations and handling operational, guest, security and emergency situations.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Overnight Hotel Operations
Ensure the smooth and efficient operation of the hotel throughout the night, coordinating with Front Office, Housekeeping, Security, Engineering, F&B and other relevant departments as required.
Monitor the overall hotel operation during the night and take immediate corrective action when operational issues arise.
Conduct regular hotel inspections during the night to ensure cleanliness, safety, security, service standards and operational readiness.
Ensure all overnight operations comply with hotel policies, SOPs, brand standards and applicable legal requirements.
2. Manager on Duty (MOD)
Act as the Manager on Duty during the overnight shift and assume overall managerial responsibility for the hotel in the absence of the General Manager, Executive Committee members and relevant Department Heads.
Take appropriate decisions within the delegated authority to ensure business continuity, guest satisfaction and operational safety.
Handle and resolve guest complaints, service recovery cases, VIP/VVIP matters and other sensitive situations professionally and in accordance with hotel guidelines.
Escalate critical matters to the FOM, General Manager or relevant Executive Committee member when required.
3. Front Office Operations & Night Audit
Supervise all overnight Front Office activities, including arrivals, departures, room assignments, guest requests, cashiering and telephone operations.
Ensure accurate and timely completion of the Night Audit and all financial end-of-day procedures.
Review Opera PMS transactions, room status, revenue postings, discrepancies, payment settlements and relevant financial reports.
Follow up on discrepancies and ensure appropriate corrective action is taken and properly documented.
Ensure accurate handover of operational and financial information to the morning team.
4. Guest Experience & Service Excellence
Ensure all guests receive professional, personalized and efficient service in line with Pullman brand standards and LQA expectations.
Monitor guest satisfaction during the night and proactively identify opportunities to enhance the guest experience.
Ensure appropriate service recovery and follow-up for guest complaints and incidents.
Maintain professional communication and diplomacy when dealing with challenging or sensitive guest situations.
5. Crisis, Emergency & Security Management
Take immediate leadership during emergencies, incidents and crisis situations occurring during the night.
Coordinate with Security, Engineering and relevant departments in handling fire alarms, fire safety incidents, medical emergencies, security incidents, power failures, water supply issues and other operational emergencies.
Ensure that emergency procedures and evacuation protocols are properly implemented when required.
Document incidents accurately and submit incident reports to the appropriate management team.
6. Team Leadership & Cross-Department Coordination
Lead, supervise and support overnight colleagues across Front Office, Security, Engineering, Housekeeping and other operational areas as required.
Ensure adequate staffing, proper task allocation and effective communication throughout the night.
Coach and guide team members to ensure compliance with hotel SOPs, service standards and safety requirements
Maintain a positive, professional and collaborative working environment during the overnight shift.
7. Communication & Handover
Maintain effective communication with the FOM, Executive Committee, Department Heads and relevant stakeholders regarding overnight operations.
Prepare and provide a comprehensive night report and handover covering operational issues, guest matters, incidents, VIP/VVIP information, financial discrepancies and outstanding actions.
Ensure all important information is communicated clearly and accurately to the incoming management team.
8. Reporting & Administration
• Prepare and submit all required operational, financial, and shift reports in a timely and accurate manner.
• Ensure all reports are accurate, complete, timely, and properly communicated to relevant departments.
• Review and consolidate relevant overnight operational information, incidents, guest feedback, and financial data for management follow-up.
• Maintain proper records and documentation related to overnight operations and ensure all required reports are completed and filed appropriately.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:

JOB PURPOSE
The Night Manager is responsible for ensuring the smooth, safe and efficient operation of the hotel during the overnight shift, while maintaining Pullman brand standards, guest satisfaction and operational excellence. The position reports to the Front Office Manager and acts as the Manager on Duty (MOD) during the night, with overall responsibility for coordinating hotel operations and handling operational, guest, security and emergency situations.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Overnight Hotel Operations
Ensure the smooth and efficient operation of the hotel throughout the night, coordinating with Front Office, Housekeeping, Security, Engineering, F&B and other relevant departments as required.
Monitor the overall hotel operation during the night and take immediate corrective action when operational issues arise.
Conduct regular hotel inspections during the night to ensure cleanliness, safety, security, service standards and operational readiness.
Ensure all overnight operations comply with hotel policies, SOPs, brand standards and applicable legal requirements.
2. Manager on Duty (MOD)
Act as the Manager on Duty during the overnight shift and assume overall managerial responsibility for the hotel in the absence of the General Manager, Executive Committee members and relevant Department Heads.
Take appropriate decisions within the delegated authority to ensure business continuity, guest satisfaction and operational safety.
Handle and resolve guest complaints, service recovery cases, VIP/VVIP matters and other sensitive situations professionally and in accordance with hotel guidelines.
Escalate critical matters to the FOM, General Manager or relevant Executive Committee member when required.
3. Front Office Operations & Night Audit
Supervise all overnight Front Office activities, including arrivals, departures, room assignments, guest requests, cashiering and telephone operations.
Ensure accurate and timely completion of the Night Audit and all financial end-of-day procedures.
Review Opera PMS transactions, room status, revenue postings, discrepancies, payment settlements and relevant financial reports.
Follow up on discrepancies and ensure appropriate corrective action is taken and properly documented.
Ensure accurate handover of operational and financial information to the morning team.
4. Guest Experience & Service Excellence
Ensure all guests receive professional, personalized and efficient service in line with Pullman brand standards and LQA expectations.
Monitor guest satisfaction during the night and proactively identify opportunities to enhance the guest experience.
Ensure appropriate service recovery and follow-up for guest complaints and incidents.
Maintain professional communication and diplomacy when dealing with challenging or sensitive guest situations.
5. Crisis, Emergency & Security Management
Take immediate leadership during emergencies, incidents and crisis situations occurring during the night.
Coordinate with Security, Engineering and relevant departments in handling fire alarms, fire safety incidents, medical emergencies, security incidents, power failures, water supply issues and other operational emergencies.
Ensure that emergency procedures and evacuation protocols are properly implemented when required.
Document incidents accurately and submit incident reports to the appropriate management team.
6. Team Leadership & Cross-Department Coordination
Lead, supervise and support overnight colleagues across Front Office, Security, Engineering, Housekeeping and other operational areas as required.
Ensure adequate staffing, proper task allocation and effective communication throughout the night.
Coach and guide team members to ensure compliance with hotel SOPs, service standards and safety requirements
Maintain a positive, professional and collaborative working environment during the overnight shift.
7. Communication & Handover
Maintain effective communication with the FOM, Executive Committee, Department Heads and relevant stakeholders regarding overnight operations.
Prepare and provide a comprehensive night report and handover covering operational issues, guest matters, incidents, VIP/VVIP information, financial discrepancies and outstanding actions.
Ensure all important information is communicated clearly and accurately to the incoming management team.
8. Reporting & Administration
• Prepare and submit all required operational, financial, and shift reports in a timely and accurate manner.
• Ensure all reports are accurate, complete, timely, and properly communicated to relevant departments.
• Review and consolidate relevant overnight operational information, incidents, guest feedback, and financial data for management follow-up.
• Maintain proper records and documentation related to overnight operations and ensure all required reports are completed and filed appropriately.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Primary Responsibilities
Supervises and trains all Housekeeping staff reporting to him/her.
Conducts regular inspection of all areas of responsibility to make sure instructions are carried out, comes up with expected results and ensures accepted standard of cleanliness, maintenance and sanitation.
Maintains discipline and high morale among staff. Corrects mistakes or inadequacies of the same and recommend disciplinary action to the Executive Housekeeper.
Monitors the staff performance and reflects comments in the performance track sheet. Evaluates staff on a yearly basis.
Provides friendly and helpful assistance to all personnel assigned to him/her and sees to it that they carry out their duties and responsibilities properly.
Promptly reports to the Linen Room or Engineering Department any problems or defects in his/ her area for proper action.
Attends to complaints and requests concerning area of responsibility and takes corrective action.
Immediately reports any loss or damage to hotel property, as well as unusual incidents occurring during his/ her shift to the Executive Housekeeper.
Trains staff on the proper use of all cleaning solutions and machines.
Ensures the cleanliness and maintenance of all cleaning tools/ machines and records defects/ breakdown of the same.
Monitors usage of all cleaning supplies to avoid wastage and cut on unnecessary expenses.
Ensures that staff follows correct safety procedures.
Checks staff for proper grooming, clean uniforms and use of nametags while on duty. Sees to it that they abide by the rules and regulations of the hotel and following implementation of emergency procedures as the need arises.
Records daily activities and events, complaints/problems encountered, unfinished assignments for follow- up and other abnormal activities during his/ her shift.
Submits monthly reports.
Performs duties common to all supervisors and other related duties that may be assigned.
Identifies and receives agreement on how to maintain various methods and/or processes to achieve constructive communications:
Weekly meeting with the Executive Housekeeper and Supervisors
Regularly schedules supervisors/team leader meetings.
Attractive and up-to-date posting area for memos, announcements, etc.
Preparation, approval by Executive Housekeeper and posting of weekly schedule
Implements and maintains controls and procedures to ensure that the highest standards of cleanliness and maintenance are achieved.
Daily walk around, documented inspections of guest rooms, public areas and support facilities with the Executive Housekeeper.
Thorough supervisor/ housekeeper training and review process.
Comprehensive work order program to ensure that: Work orders are written
Catalogued and followed up
Follow up with Engineering pending maintenance/defects, or for reasons for lack of completion
Builds and maintains an employee relations program that will both meet the employees’ needs and the company’s goals.
Establishes and maintains a daily “morning meeting” to greet and update the staff and to inspect uniform cleanliness and compliance.
Develops and implements an incentive program to acknowledge a positive guest comment for a specific employee.
Implements and maintains a system to recognize individuals’ birthdays.
Identifies and uses an approved system for “on call” status, requested time off and other special requests.
Ensures that all personnel appraisal forms are completed presented and returned to HR at least two weeks prior to the review date.
Ensures that coaching and counseling (warning letters) are completed on a timely and consistent basis, especially when the policies of the hotel have been violated.
Participate in periodic inventories, annual budgeting process
Ensures that assigned areas are properly cleaned daily Works closely with and gain a working knowledge of Front Office, Accounting and necessary aspects of F&B and Engineering departments.
Consistently inspects assigned areas and turns in inspection reports.
Ensures that all reports are prepared completely and promptly.
Ensures that an effective and complete training program is in use that all employees are well trained and retrained, as needed.
Ensures that SOP are available, current and in effect.
Ensures that proper key controls are in effect.
Controls overtime through proper scheduling and immediate response to problems.
Review operating statements and critique overages and shortages. All efforts must be made to meet budgeted goals.
Audits schedules
Ensures that all associates are hygienically clean with clean, complete uniforms.
Reviews out of order rooms daily.
Provides up-to-date job rooms daily.
Immediate response to all problems and despondence
Ensures that lost and found articles properly and that the correct logs are maintained.
Maintains division goals in relation to accident prevention, safety and fire prevention and associate awareness.
Works closely with Engineering department to insure that the rooms and equipment preventive maintenance procedure is in effect and consistently carried out.
Must be flexible to work third shift from 23:00 pm to 07:00 am, wherever necessary, or as scheduled.
Responsible for supervising the activities of Housekeeping staff assigned to him/her to ensure smooth and efficient flow of work in their respective areas. The Asst. Housekeeping Manager is a key individual in achieving the goals and quality standards of the Housekeeping department and must impact all elements of the department from standards of cleanliness and employees morale to budgetary goals and inter- departmental relations.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Knowledge and Experience / Kiến thức và Kinh nghiệm
Education: Bachelor's degree, College diploma, or Intermediate vocational certificate in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
Experience: 1–3 years of experience in a similar role within the Housekeeping department at 4 or 5-star international hotels/resorts.
Operations: Deep knowledge of Housekeeping operations, laundry procedures, chemical usage, and room/public area inspection standards.
Systems: Proficient in property management systems ( Opera PMS/Cloud ) and inventory management tools.
Regulations: Strong understanding of workplace safety, hygiene regulations, and chemical handling standards (MSDS).
Competencies / Kỹ năng khác
Leadership: Strong leadership, mentoring, and team-building skills to manage and motivate a large, diverse team.
Problem-Solving: Excellent problem-solving and decision-making skills, especially when handling guest complaints or operational emergencies.
Communication: Good command of English (both verbal and written) to interact with international guests and coordinate with other departments.
Attention to Detail: High attention to detail and commitment to maintaining the resort's premium luxury standards.
Time Management: Outstanding organizational and multi-tasking skills, with the ability to work under high pressure and tight timelines.
Financial Acumen: Basic skills in cost control, budget monitoring, and inventory management.

sections.text:

Special employee discounts on services at Novotel Phu Quoc Resort and all Accor hotels worldwide.
Professional training programs from AccorHotels Academy.
International, professional, and dynamic working environment.
Engaging team activities: Birthdays, Year-End Party, Football/Volleyball clubs, etc.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Situated on one of the most charming beaches of Phu Quoc island, only 10 minutes from the airport, Novotel Phu Quoc Resort is a natural paradise overlooking the Gulf of Thailand.
The Resort provides multiple choices of rooms for family, couples, groups, and individual travellers with 246 spacious and comfortable rooms set in the main building, perfect for those chasing the contemporary design, whilst natural beauty seekers can opt to stay at our beautiful 120 bungalows located in the tropical garden or with ocean view and access to the beach.
Cuisine means discovering new tastes, and our Ex-Chef proposes a mix of traditional and modern with dedicated cooking methods. Seafood restaurant lets you explore the island’s speciality; our Seafood platter is a signature dish known for its umami flavour, ideal for sharing with family or friends.
From dawn to nightfall, discover moments and experiences to entice and delight, whether savouring a delicious cocktail at Ocean Bar while watching the sunset, lying down by the Infinity Pool steps from the beach or kayaking to immerse yourself in the beauty of sunrise.
Novotel Phu Quoc Resort loves families and has an exclusive children’s policy, complimentary for up to 16 years old if sharing the rooms with parents. We also propose various activities and services that satisfy all ages and make every moment matter for the family.
“Children Activities Program” delivers various choices to attract and retain children based on the four essential fundamentals: Discovery, Artistic, Connection and fun, and Event. Furthermore, with the unique “Kid’s Care” service, the parents will have more opportunities to enjoy their “me time” as it welcomes all the children from 5 to 11 years old during specific times of the day. Our propaganda is Happy children, happy holiday.
Like a hidden pearl, In Balance Spa is where guests will find their sense of rejuvenation through various treatments and massages. Besides that, there are well-equipped fitness centres and tennis courts for those who want to stay in shape.
Set a mission of providing a complete holiday; the All-Inclusive concept is created to give credit full right to enjoy an authentic vacation free of stress. With this package, guests can eat and drink anywhere, any time, starting from 06:30 AM until 11:00 PM. Free wide range of activities for adults, kid and family. Not to mention, more benefits are included, starting from a minimum of 07 nights. We invite you to explore our special offer section to discover our All-Inclisive.
The Resort is also perfect for MICE as our ballroom can accommodate hundreds of people, and the wide sandy shore is ideal for team building. For those couples who wish for a dream wedding, whether it is a stylish wedding in the ballroom, a barefoot wedding on the beach, or a fabulous reception under the stars, we’re delighted to be a part of your event.

sections.text:
Primary Responsibilities
Revenue Management & Strategic Pricing
Market Analysis: Perform continuous analysis of changing channel distribution models and their direct impact on consumer booking trends.
Pricing Strategy: Optimize hotel and corporate pricing strategies by defining and managing BAR (Best Available Rate) levels, stay restrictions, and other tactical yield management measures congruent with demand factors.
Rate Integrity: Maintain rates that promote brand integrity and protect long-term customer relationships.
Offer Development: Collaborate with the Revenue Management and Sales & Marketing teams to determine effective, engaging, and targeted rate offers (packages) delivered to the right customer via the right channel.
Distribution Control: Monitor transient, group, and tour booking pace to determine pricing and availability controls for all reservation distribution sources, implementing timely changes to the distribution plan.
Forecasting & Data: Complete all rooms and revenue forecasting to accurately project unconstrained demand. Maintain future and historical data within the Demand Analysis strategies.
System Integrity: Ensure appropriate system overrides are in place and special events or promotions are accurately loaded into the property systems (PMS/CRS/Channel Manager).
Business Selection: Partner with the Director of Sales & Marketing and Sales team members to encourage strategic selection of group/corporate business in alignment with brand guidelines.
Competitor Tracking: Track and analyze competitive set (comp set) pricing and yield strategies to accurately predict marketplace reactions.
Meetings & Reports: Chair and prepare comprehensive materials for the weekly Revenue Management Meetings and prepare regular revenue updates for Executive Management.
Reservation Operations & Guest Relations
Daily Operation: Responsible for the daily organization, workflow allocation, and operational efficiency of the reservation section.
Quality Standards: Monitor guest service personnel constantly, ensuring maximum guest satisfaction is achieved through personalized guest recognition and prompt, cordial attention.
Public Relations: Establish and maintain excellent public relations with all guests and visitors, safeguarding a top-tier reputation for the Hotel.
Information Accuracy: Maintain complete and updated knowledge of all the hotel's latest features, services, and promotions. Ensure guests are provided with the most accurate, meaningful, and up-to-date information at all times.
Team Management & Leadership
Recruitment & Reviews: Interview, select, and recruit direct reports. Conduct objective, periodic performance reviews with the team.
Talent Development: Identify and develop team members with high potential. Plan, conduct, and maintain training programs that address development needs and equip staff with new skills to meet changing business demands.
Professionalism: Constantly monitor team members’ appearance, hygiene, attitude, and overall degree of professionalism.
Leadership Example: Maintain a positive attitude towards work, stay self-disciplined, self-motivated, and set an exemplary working standard for all subordinates. Be understanding, supportive, encouraging, and helpful to the entire team.
General Responsibilities
Collaboration: Maintain an excellent working relationship with all colleagues and hotel departments (Finance, Front Office, F&B, Sales & Marketing, IT, People & Culture, Engineering).
Safety & Compliance: Stay fully aware of and compliant with the hotel’s fire, life safety, and emergency procedures.
Administrative Duties: Attend all briefings, meetings, and corporate trainings as assigned by management. Perform any other reasonable duties assigned by the Management team.
Other Responsibilities
Be aware of the hotel fire & life safety/emergency procedures.
Attend all briefings, meetings and trainings as assigned by management.
Maintain a high standard of personal appearance and hygiene at all times.
Perform other reasonable duties assigned by the assigned by the Management.
Responsible for recruiting and organizing training for personnel within the department, ensuring that staffing needs are met and team capabilities are developed.
Prepare monthly/quarterly reports on the department's asset management in compliance with regulations, ensuring transparency and accuracy.
Other Duties: Carry out other duties as reasonably assigned by the Department Head or Management, including providing support to other positions/departments when required, in alignment with professional competencies and the hotel's policies and regulations.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
As Assistant Front Office Manager at Fairmont, you will play a pivotal leadership role in delivering exceptional service and creating memorable guest experiences. You will support the management of daily Front Office operations, inspire and develop the team, and ensure the consistent delivery of Fairmont brand standards across all guest touchpoints.
You will be instrumental in driving operational excellence in line with LQA and Forbes service standards, with particular focus on Guest Relations and the Fairmont Gold Lounge. Through strong leadership, attention to detail, and a guest-centric approach, you will enhance the overall guest journey, foster colleague engagement, and ensure seamless and efficient Front Office operations from arrival through departure.
Responsibilities
Guest Experience & Service Excellence
Ensure seamless arrival and departure experiences for all guests
Handle VIP arrivals, guest complaints, and service recovery professionally
Monitor guest satisfaction scores and implement improvement strategies
Lead by example with a presence at the front desk during peak hours
Ensure consistent delivery of personalized, anticipatory service in the lounge and guest rooms
Proactively anticipate guest needs and coordinate personalized touches with the relevant teams
Team Leadership & Management
Supervise, coach, and train front office colleagues, including Guest Relations, Fairmont Gold Lounge, Front Desk and Concierge
Assist with team recruitment, roster scheduling, and performance reviews
Foster a positive and collaborative team environment aligned with Fairmont’s values
Operations & Financials
Ensure compliance with company policies, SOPs, and brand standards
Manage room inventory and coordinate with Reservations and Housekeeping
Support Front Office Manager in budget preparation and cost control for the department
Monitor upselling efforts and maximize revenue opportunities
Administrative & Reporting
Act as Front Office Manager as required, taking charge of the property in the absence of senior leadership
Respond promptly to guest incidents, emergencies, and service disruptions
Coordinate effectively with other departments to resolve issues and optimize operations
Maintain accurate records and report all significant events to management

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Knowledge and Experience
Degree or diploma in Hospitality Management or related field
Minimum 2 years of experience in a similar Front Office management role in a luxury hotel
Proficient in Opera PMS and Microsoft Office
Fluent in English, both verbal and written
Flexible working shifts, weekends, and holidays as required
Competency
Guest-oriented and customer focus service minded
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Strong attention to detail and ability to handle multiple priorities
Courteous and helpful
Comfortable working in a dynamic and multicultural environment

As a Guest Relations Agent at Fairmont Hanoi, you will be the face of the hotel for our most discerning guests. Uphold Fairmont standards in appearance, language, and behavior
Maintain confidentiality of all guest information
Participate in regular training, briefings, and service audits

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Rixos Phu Quoc is seeking a dynamic and commercially minded Executive Pastry Chef to lead our Bakery and Pastry operations across all Food & Beverage outlets. Reporting directly to the Executive Chef, this role is responsible for delivering exceptional quality, creativity, and consistency while driving financial performance and operational excellence.
The Executive Pastry Chef will oversee the full spectrum of pastry and bakery production, ensuring that all products meet the highest standards of presentation, taste, and innovation. Working closely with the Executive Chef, you will contribute to monitoring costs, review forecasts, plan resources accordingly, and ensure that operational budgets are adhered to.
Operational leadership will be at the heart of your role. You will assign responsibilities, monitor performance, prepare weekly schedules aligned with business needs, and ensure smooth day-to-day operations of the Bakery & Pastry Department.
Quality, hygiene, and compliance are non-negotiable. You will ensure that all pastry preparation and presentation meet hotel standards and local regulations, with full adherence to HACCP requirements. Working closely with the Hygiene Officer, Stewarding Manager, and F&B leadership team, you will conduct regular inspections and maintain the highest sanitation practices.
As a leader, you will cultivate a professional, warm, and guest-focused culture within the brigade. You will build strong relationships with guests, respond proactively to feedback, and ensure your team consistently reflects the brand’s luxury positioning. You will conduct performance appraisals, provide regular coaching, and actively identify and develop emerging talent for future growth within the group.
This is a leadership opportunity for a passionate pastry professional who combines creativity with commercial discipline, operational rigour with guest connection, and technical mastery with mentorship.
If you are ready to lead one of Vietnam’s most exciting luxury pastry operations and elevate the Rixos culinary experience to the next level, we invite you to apply.

Rixos Phu Quoc is seeking a dynamic and commercially minded Executive Pastry Chef to lead our Bakery and Pastry operations across all Food & Beverage outlets. Reporting directly to the Executive Chef, this role is responsible for delivering exceptional quality, creativity, and consistency while driving financial performance and operational excellence.
The Executive Pastry Chef will oversee the full spectrum of pastry and bakery production, ensuring that all products meet the highest standards of presentation, taste, and innovation. Working closely with the Executive Chef, you will contribute to monitoring costs, review forecasts, plan resources accordingly, and ensure that operational budgets are adhered to.
Operational leadership will be at the heart of your role. You will assign responsibilities, monitor performance, prepare weekly schedules aligned with business needs, and ensure smooth day-to-day operations of the Bakery & Pastry Department.
Quality, hygiene, and compliance are non-negotiable. You will ensure that all pastry preparation and presentation meet hotel standards and local regulations, with full adherence to HACCP requirements. Working closely with the Hygiene Officer, Stewarding Manager, and F&B leadership team, you will conduct regular inspections and maintain the highest sanitation practices.
As a leader, you will cultivate a professional, warm, and guest-focused culture within the brigade. You will build strong relationships with guests, respond proactively to feedback, and ensure your team consistently reflects the brand’s luxury positioning. You will conduct performance appraisals, provide regular coaching, and actively identify and develop emerging talent for future growth within the group.
This is a leadership opportunity for a passionate pastry professional who combines creativity with commercial discipline, operational rigour with guest connection, and technical mastery with mentorship.
If you are ready to lead one of Vietnam’s most exciting luxury pastry operations and elevate the Rixos culinary experience to the next level, we invite you to apply.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
We're looking for a Quality & Sustainability Manager to join our dynamic team in Phu Quoc, Vietnam. In this pivotal role, you will champion our commitment to operational excellence and environmental stewardship by developing and implementing comprehensive quality and sustainability programs. The ideal candidate will combine analytical rigor with innovative thinking to drive measurable improvements across our operations while ensuring compliance with Vietnamese and international standards. You'll work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to embed quality and sustainability practices into the heart of our organization, making a tangible difference in how we operate.
Develop, implement, and maintain quality management systems (ISO 9001, ISO 14001) and ensure organizational compliance with relevant Vietnamese and international standards
Design and execute sustainability initiatives that reduce environmental impact, including waste reduction, energy efficiency, and resource optimization programs tailored to our Phu Quoc operations
Conduct regular audits, inspections, and assessments to identify areas for improvement and document findings with actionable, transparent recommendations
Analyze operational data and performance metrics to identify trends, root causes, and opportunities for process optimization using statistical tools and data analysis techniques
Lead continuous improvement projects using methodologies such as Lean and Six Sigma to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and drive organizational resilience
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate quality and sustainability practices into daily operations and strategic decision-making processes
Develop and deliver engaging training programs to ensure staff understanding of quality standards, sustainability practices, and regulatory requirements specific to Vietnam
Prepare comprehensive reports and presentations for management on quality performance, sustainability metrics, and compliance status, communicating complex information clearly
Manage relationships with regulatory bodies and external auditors to ensure adherence to environmental and quality regulations specific to Vietnam
Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and monitor progress toward quality and sustainability goals, adjusting strategies as needed
Identify and assess risks related to quality and environmental compliance, implementing proactive mitigation strategies and demonstrating decisive problem-solving
Support vendor and supplier management practices to ensure sustainability standards are met throughout our supply chain

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
**Required Qualifications:**
Proven experience of 5+ years in quality management, sustainability, or related field within a manufacturing or operations environment
Strong knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and other relevant quality and environmental management systems
Proficiency in process improvement methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or similar continuous improvement frameworks
Demonstrated expertise in data analysis, statistical tools, and performance measurement
Solid understanding of environmental regulations, sustainability best practices, and carbon footprint analysis
Experience conducting internal and external audits and managing corrective and preventive actions
Excellent project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously
Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to influence stakeholders at all organizational levels
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and experience with quality management software or ERP systems
Knowledge of supply chain sustainability and vendor management practices
Familiarity with Vietnamese environmental regulations and compliance requirements
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to work independently and collaboratively
Proficiency in English (written and verbal); Vietnamese language skills are a plus
**Preferred Qualifications:**
Environmental certifications such as ISO 14001 Lead Auditor or equivalent
Experience in sustainability reporting and carbon accounting methodologies
Background in change management and organizational development
Experience leading cross-functional teams in a multicultural environment
Knowledge of risk assessment and mitigation strategies specific to manufacturing operations
Previous experience working in Southeast Asian operations or similar emerging markets

sections.text:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Marketing Strategy & Brand Management
Develop and implement the annual Marketing & Communications strategy aligned with hotel business objectives.
Prepare and manage the annual marketing budget, forecasts, and ROI measurement.
Ensure consistent application of Rixos, Ennismore, and Accor brand standards across all communication channels.
Position Rixos Phu Quoc Vietnam as a leading luxury all-inclusive resort through integrated marketing campaigns.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, guest insights, and consumer behavior to identify new business opportunities.
Digital Marketing & Content
Develop and execute digital marketing campaigns across owned, earned, and paid media.
Manage the hotel's website content and digital assets to ensure accuracy and brand consistency.
Oversee social media strategy, content calendars, community engagement, and online storytelling.
Coordinate photo shoots, video productions, lifestyle campaigns, and creative content creation.
Monitor digital performance using analytics tools and optimize campaigns accordingly.
Support SEO, SEM, email marketing, CRM campaigns, and online advertising initiatives.
Public Relations & Media Relations
Develop and implement annual PR strategies and media engagement plans.
Build and maintain strong relationships with journalists, editors, influencers, KOLs, tourism organizations, airlines, travel partners, and government agencies.
Prepare press releases, media kits, fact sheets, executive biographies, speeches, and official statements.
Coordinate media interviews, familiarization trips (FAM trips), press visits, influencer stays, and media events.
Monitor media coverage and maintain an organized archive of press clippings and publicity reports.
Protect and enhance the hotel's reputation through proactive reputation management and crisis communication support.
Campaigns, Events & Partnerships
Plan and execute marketing campaigns supporting: Rooms
Food & Beverage
Wellness & Spa
Entertainment
Weddings
Meetings & Events
Seasonal Promotions
Resort Experiences
Coordinate product launches, brand activations, PR events, and promotional campaigns.
Develop strategic partnerships with tourism boards, airlines, luxury brands, shopping malls, event organizers, and local businesses.
Support destination marketing initiatives that promote Phu Quoc as a luxury leisure destination.
Internal Communications
Develop internal communication initiatives to enhance employee engagement and brand culture.
Keep employees informed of company news, campaigns, achievements, and events.
Coordinate internal newsletters, announcements, celebrations, and recognition programs.
Support employer branding initiatives in collaboration with the People & Culture Department.
Brand Standards & Creative Management
Ensure all marketing collateral complies with brand identity guidelines.
Maintain an up-to-date image library, video library, brand assets, and creative materials.
Oversee production of brochures, promotional materials, presentations, signage, digital screens, and advertising creatives.
Review all marketing materials before publication to ensure consistency and quality.
Budget & Performance Management
Prepare annual marketing budgets and monitor expenditure.
Measure campaign effectiveness through KPIs and ROI analysis.
Produce regular marketing performance reports for Hotel Management and Regional Marketing.
Recommend improvements based on campaign performance and market trends.
Leadership & Team Development
Lead, motivate, coach, and develop the Marketing & PR team.
Establish departmental objectives and performance standards.
Conduct regular coaching, performance reviews, and development planning.
Foster creativity, innovation, teamwork, and continuous learning.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Education
Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, Digital Marketing, Hospitality Management, or related discipline.
Master's Degree is an advantage.
Experience
Minimum 5 years of marketing and public relations experience within an international luxury hotel, resort, or lifestyle hospitality brand.
At least 2 years in a management position.
Experience with luxury, lifestyle, or all-inclusive resorts is highly desirable.
Pre-opening experience is a strong advantage.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
The Chief Steward is responsible for overseeing the overall stewarding operations of the hotel, ensuring the highest standards of cleanliness, hygiene, storage, and equipment management across 10 diverse Food & Beverage outlets, extensive banquet operations, and large-scale kitchens totaling over 800 sqm. This role is pivotal in supporting the culinary and service teams to achieve excellence in food safety, efficiency, guest satisfaction, and asset care.
Operations Management
Lead and manage stewarding operations across all F&B venues, including restaurants, bars, banquet kitchens, in-room dining, and central production kitchens
Ensure the highest level of cleanliness, hygiene, and sanitation in compliance with HACCP and food safety standards
Implement effective stock rotation and control for chemicals, cleaning supplies, and equipment to avoid waste, ensure safety, and maintain quality
Organize storage areas between kitchen spaces and stewarding storerooms to ensure accessibility, logical organization, and operational efficiency
Monitor daily cleaning standards and task completion, conducting hands-on quality checks and immediate feedback
Analyze potential breakage risks in daily operations and implement preventative measures to minimize equipment loss and costs
Oversee banquet and event setups, ensuring accurate equipment handling and smooth execution.
Collaborate with Engineering on maintenance and repairs of stewarding machinery and kitchen equipment.
Team Leadership
Lead, train, and develop the stewarding team, including supervisors and operational staff, to foster safety, efficiency, and excellence
Conduct regular performance reviews and create personalized development plans
Plan and manage staffing according to business levels, events, and operational demands
Reinforce daily task quality by setting clear expectations, providing on-the-job coaching, and maintaining visible leadership.
Cost Control and Sustainability
Implement strict breakage control and regularly analyze breakage patterns to proactively prevent future incidents
Manage equipment inventory, minimize losses, and ensure adherence to budgetary goals
Lead sustainability efforts through waste reduction, chemical management, and resource conservation.
Health, Hygiene and Safety
Apply necessary precautions with regards to hotel food safety and hygiene standards (HACCP)
Be well versed in hotel fire, life safety, and emergency procedures
Report and take appropriate action to correct any health or safety hazards
Liaise with Engineering regarding maintenance and repairs of equipment
Instruct staff on emergency measures in case of accidents and ensure the first aid kit is stocked and available in kitchens in collaboration with the hotel’s clinic
Ensure all work areas in the kitchen are kept tidy and clean
Conduct regular hygiene audits, safety training, and emergency preparedness exercises
Lead safe handling and storage of chemicals and cleaning products, ensuring proper labeling and usage.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Knowledge and Experience
Diploma or certification in Hospitality, Food Safety, or Environmental Services preferred
Minimum 3–5 years’ experience as Chief Steward or Assistant Chief Steward in a luxury hotel or high-volume environment
Experience in inventory management, logistics, and cross-outlet support for large-scale operations.
Competencies
Strong leadership and team development abilities
Exceptional organizational skills and eye for operational detail
Ability to drive quality, consistency, and efficiency under pressure
Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a focus on guest and team satisfaction
High personal and professional grooming standards
Computer Literacy
Reading/Writing/Speaking English skills

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text: Fairmont Hanoi officially opened in March 2026, becoming the first Fairmont hotel in Vietnam. The 241-room luxury urban resort is inspired by traditional Vietnamese lacquer art, Indochinese design, and motifs from Vietnam’s dynasties. Guests can enjoy eight dining and bar venues including a rooftop terrace, indoor and outdoor swimming pools, a state-of-the-art gym, and a full-floor wellness spa and bathhouse.
