The Chief Steward is responsible for overseeing the overall stewarding operations of the hotel, ensuring the highest standards of cleanliness, hygiene, storage, and equipment management across 10 diverse Food & Beverage outlets, extensive banquet operations, and large-scale kitchens totaling over 800 sqm. This role is pivotal in supporting the culinary and service teams to achieve excellence in food safety, efficiency, guest satisfaction, and asset care.
Operations Management
Lead and manage stewarding operations across all F&B venues, including restaurants, bars, banquet kitchens, in-room dining, and central production kitchens
Ensure the highest level of cleanliness, hygiene, and sanitation in compliance with HACCP and food safety standards
Implement effective stock rotation and control for chemicals, cleaning supplies, and equipment to avoid waste, ensure safety, and maintain quality
Organize storage areas between kitchen spaces and stewarding storerooms to ensure accessibility, logical organization, and operational efficiency
Monitor daily cleaning standards and task completion, conducting hands-on quality checks and immediate feedback
Analyze potential breakage risks in daily operations and implement preventative measures to minimize equipment loss and costs
Oversee banquet and event setups, ensuring accurate equipment handling and smooth execution.
Collaborate with Engineering on maintenance and repairs of stewarding machinery and kitchen equipment.
Team Leadership
Lead, train, and develop the stewarding team, including supervisors and operational staff, to foster safety, efficiency, and excellence
Conduct regular performance reviews and create personalized development plans
Plan and manage staffing according to business levels, events, and operational demands
Reinforce daily task quality by setting clear expectations, providing on-the-job coaching, and maintaining visible leadership.
Cost Control and Sustainability
Implement strict breakage control and regularly analyze breakage patterns to proactively prevent future incidents
Manage equipment inventory, minimize losses, and ensure adherence to budgetary goals
Lead sustainability efforts through waste reduction, chemical management, and resource conservation.
Health, Hygiene and Safety
Apply necessary precautions with regards to hotel food safety and hygiene standards (HACCP)
Be well versed in hotel fire, life safety, and emergency procedures
Report and take appropriate action to correct any health or safety hazards
Liaise with Engineering regarding maintenance and repairs of equipment
Instruct staff on emergency measures in case of accidents and ensure the first aid kit is stocked and available in kitchens in collaboration with the hotel’s clinic
Ensure all work areas in the kitchen are kept tidy and clean
Conduct regular hygiene audits, safety training, and emergency preparedness exercises
Lead safe handling and storage of chemicals and cleaning products, ensuring proper labeling and usage.

Knowledge and Experience
Diploma or certification in Hospitality, Food Safety, or Environmental Services preferred
Minimum 3–5 years’ experience as Chief Steward or Assistant Chief Steward in a luxury hotel or high-volume environment
Experience in inventory management, logistics, and cross-outlet support for large-scale operations.
Competencies
Strong leadership and team development abilities
Exceptional organizational skills and eye for operational detail
Ability to drive quality, consistency, and efficiency under pressure
Proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a focus on guest and team satisfaction
High personal and professional grooming standards
Computer Literacy
Reading/Writing/Speaking English skills

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Leads service teams during operations, protecting the guest experience through visible leadership, real-time coaching, and confident decision making. This role ensures colleagues remain focused on guests by removing obstacles and reinforcing service standards in the moment.
Responsibilities
Guest Experience Leadership
Maintain a strong and visible presence on the floor throughout service
Anticipate guest needs and guide colleagues to respond confidently and consistently
Take ownership of guest concerns and ensure timely and thoughtful resolution
Set the tone for calm, professional, and guest-focused service
Operational Oversight and Service Standards
Ensure opening and closing procedures are completed and service areas are fully prepared prior to service
Monitor table settings, cleanliness, and service readiness throughout operations
Oversee service pacing and coordination to protect the guest experience
Ensure food and beverage service is delivered according to established standards
Support adherence to food safety and hygiene standards in accordance with HACCP requirements
Use of Systems and Tools
Guide and support the accurate use of approved hotel systems, including the Oracle Simphony Point-of-Sale system, SevenRooms Table Management System, and Oracle OPERA Cloud Property Management System, to enable confident service execution and personalized guest experiences
Working Together
Work closely with colleagues across Food and Beverage, Culinary, Front Office, Housekeeping, and other hotel teams to anticipate needs and protect the guest experience during service
Professional Standards
Maintain a consistent and visible presence on the floor during service, prioritizing guests and team support
Arrive punctually for every shift, prepared to lead, coach, and make operational decisions in the moment
Participate actively in daily briefings and training to reinforce standards and confidence
Actively participate in fire and life safety training and drills to ensure the safety and wellbeing of guests and colleagues
Other Responsibilities
Attend all briefings, meetings, and trainings as assigned
Ensure colleagues are prepared, on time, and correctly presented for service
Maintain a high standard of professionalism and conduct at all times
Perform other reasonable duties assigned by the Management of the Hotel

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Knowledge and Experience
University, college, or vocational education preferred
Previous supervisory experience in Food and Beverage is an advantage
English is used daily in the workplace to support communication with an international and diverse five-star hotel clientele; proficiency is considered an asset
Familiarity with hospitality systems such as the Oracle Simphony Point-of-Sale system, SevenRooms Table Management System, and Oracle OPERA Cloud Property Management System is an advantage; training will be provided
Competencies
Strong guest focus with the ability to lead calmly during service
Confidence in coaching colleagues in real time
Sound judgment and decision-making during operations
Collaborative mindset and ownership of the guest experience
Professional presence and credibility on the floor

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
The Bar Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operation of all assigned bars, ensuring exceptional guest experiences through operational excellence, outstanding cocktail execution, team development, and strict compliance with health, safety, and hygiene standards.
Responsibilities
Leadership and Guest Experience
· Lead guest-focused bar culture and service standards
· Ensure teams are trained, confident, and guest-focused
· Oversee guest satisfaction and service quality
Operational Management
· Lead the daily operation of all assigned bars, ensuring smooth, efficient, and professional service.
· Maintain a strong presence on the floor throughout service periods to support the team and engage with guests.
· Ensure all beverage service follows Fairmont brand standards and departmental SOPs.
· Monitor staffing levels, shift organization, opening and closing procedures, and operational readiness.
· Ensure all bars remain fully prepared, clean, organized, and properly always stocked.
Cocktail Quality & Beverage Standards
· Maintain the highest standards of cocktail preparation, presentation, consistency, and speed of service.
· Conduct daily quality checks on cocktails, garnishes, syrups, juices, ice, glassware, and mise en place.
· Ensure all beverage recipes are followed precisely using approved specifications.
· Support the implementation of new beverage menus, seasonal promotions, and product launches.
· Monitor beverage quality continuously and implement immediate corrective actions when required.
Team Training & Development
· Lead ongoing bartender training to develop technical skills, cocktail craftsmanship, product knowledge, and luxury service standards.
· Conduct regular practical assessments, coaching sessions, and performance feedback.
· Mentor bartenders and supervisors to build a high-performing and motivated team.
· Promote continuous learning and professional development across the department.
Health, Safety & Compliance
· Ensure full compliance with HACCP, food safety, hygiene, sanitation, and responsible alcohol service standards.
· Conduct routine health and safety inspections across all bars.
· Ensure equipment is operated safely and maintained correctly.
· Maintain accurate records of cleaning schedules, temperature logs, and operational checklists.
Guest Experience
· Lead by example in delivering intuitive, personalized, and luxury guest service.
· Resolve guest concerns professionally and efficiently.
· Build relationships with regular guests and recognize guest preferences whenever possible.
· Support the delivery of memorable beverage experiences and special occasions.
Inventory & Cost Control
· Maintain accurate beverage inventories and stock rotation.
· Minimize waste through effective controls and operational discipline.
· Ensure bars are adequately stocked while avoiding unnecessary overstocking.
· Support monthly inventory counts and beverage audits.
· Report breakages, losses, and operational discrepancies promptly.
Collaboration
· Work closely with Culinary, Restaurants, Stewarding, Purchasing, Engineering, Housekeeping, and Front Office to ensure seamless service delivery.
· Support hotel events, promotions, VIP functions, and beverage activations.
Professional Standards
· Maintain exemplary grooming, professionalism, and leadership presence.
· Lead by example in punctuality, accountability, and operational discipline.
· Attend all meetings, briefings, trainings, and departmental communications.
· Perform any additional duties assigned by Hotel Management.

sections.text:
We are seeking an experienced and professional Captain Waiter/ess to join our esteemed restaurant team in the beautiful island of Phu Quoc, Vietnam. As a Captain Waiter/ess, you will play a crucial role in ensuring exceptional dining experiences for our guests whilst leading and mentoring our service team.
Oversee and coordinate the daily operations of the restaurant's dining area
Lead, train, and motivate the waiting staff to maintain high service standards
Greet and seat guests, ensuring a warm and professional welcome
Manage reservations and handle special requests or dietary requirements
Provide detailed menu information, including daily specials and wine recommendations
Resolve guest complaints promptly and professionally
Ensure compliance with food safety regulations and hygiene standards
Assist in inventory management and stock control
Collaborate with the kitchen team to ensure smooth service flow
Maintain a clean and organised dining area at all times

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Minimum 3-5 years of experience in fine dining or luxury hospitality
Previous experience in a supervisory role within food service
Excellent customer service skills with a strong focus on guest satisfaction
Demonstrated leadership abilities and team management skills
Proficiency in restaurant management software
Fluent in English; additional languages are advantageous
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to work under pressure and multitask effectively
High school diploma or equivalent (required)
Hospitality management degree or relevant certification (preferred)
Valid food safety certification
In-depth knowledge of food and beverage pairing
Thorough understanding of fine dining etiquette and service standards
Familiarity with Vietnamese cuisine and culture (preferred)
Willingness to work in Phu Quoc, Vietnam

We're looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Bakery Chef de partie to join our culinary team in Phu Quoc, Vietnam. In this role, you will oversee the bakery and pastry section of our kitchen, managing daily production, maintaining quality standards, and leading a team of bakers and pastry assistants. You will be responsible for creating exceptional baked goods and pastries while ensuring efficient operations and adherence to food safety protocols in our fast-paced hospitality environment.
Oversee all bakery and pastry production, including bread, pastries, desserts, and specialty items
Manage inventory, ordering, and cost control for bakery section supplies and ingredients
Develop and execute daily production schedules to meet service demands and quality standards

Maintain strict food safety and sanitation standards in compliance with local and international regulations

Document production records, portion costs, and daily reports for management review

Proven experience working as a Chef de partie or equivalent supervisory role in a kitchen brigade

Proficiency with bakery equipment including commercial ovens, mixers, proofing boxes, and pastry tools
Excellent organizational and time management skills with ability to manage multiple production priorities
Demonstrated leadership ability with experience training and managing kitchen staff

Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining high quality standards
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

sections.text:
POSITION SUMMARY
Under the supervision of the Security Management team, the Life Guard is responsible for ensuring the safety, security, and wellbeing of all guests and colleagues within the pool and beach areas. The role requires constant vigilance, strong swimming ability, excellent guest service skills, and full compliance with Rixos standards, health & safety regulations, and emergency procedures.
KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Safety & Pool/Beach Operations
Ensure safe daily operations at all pool and beach areas in compliance with hotel safety, health, and fire prevention policies.
Monitor guest activities at all times and enforce pool and beach rules and regulations.
Respond immediately and effectively to emergencies, accidents, or swimming difficulties.
Follow Emergency & Rescue Procedures and provide first aid and lifesaving support when required.
Conduct daily checks of all lifesaving equipment and ensure correct placement and readiness.
2. Water Quality & Area Maintenance
Maintain and record daily chlorine and pH levels according to schedule.
Report any irregularities in water clarity, chemical levels, or pool temperature immediately.
Ensure pool, beach, and surrounding guest areas are clean, safe, and well-maintained.
Identify and report maintenance issues promptly to the relevant department.
3. Guest Service Excellence
Greet guests politely and provide friendly, professional, and attentive service at all times.
Assist guests with inquiries related to pool, beach, and recreational facilities.
Handle guest complaints, concerns, and feedback promptly and professionally.
Support recreation and entertainment activities when required.
4. Compliance & Standards
Fully comply with all hotel policies, procedures, and local legal requirements.
Adhere to ISO Integrated Management Systems including Quality, Environment, Health & Safety, Food Safety, and Customer Complaint Handling.
Maintain proper grooming, hygiene, and uniform standards at all times.
Follow Lost & Found procedures and report any suspicious behavior or unsafe conditions immediately.
5. Teamwork & Training
Attend all required training sessions, departmental meetings, and drills.
Work closely with Security, Housekeeping, Engineering, Recreation, and other departments.
Report training needs and actively participate in continuous improvement initiatives.
Perform any other reasonable duties as assigned by management.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Recognized Lifeguard Certification.
Valid First Aid, CPR, AED, and Spine Board certification.
Minimum 2 years of experience in a similar role within a hotel or resort environment.
Strong swimming skills and physical fitness.
Good communication skills and strong customer service orientation.

sections.text:
Job Description
Rixos Hotels is seeking a dynamic and commercially driven Sales Manager to join the team supporting the launch and ongoing commercial success of Rixos Phu Quoc , a landmark luxury all-inclusive resort in Vietnam.
Based in Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi or Cam Ranh , the Sales Manager will be responsible for developing business opportunities within the assigned market, strengthening relationships with key travel partners, corporate accounts, MICE partners and distribution channels, and driving room nights and revenue to Rixos Phu Quoc.
The role will be highly market-facing, requiring regular engagement with clients and partners across Vietnam and the ability to translate market opportunities into measurable commercial results.
Key Responsibilities
Sales & Business Development
Develop and execute sales activities to drive room nights, revenue and market share for Rixos Phu Quoc.
Identify and develop new business opportunities across leisure, corporate, MICE, wholesale, travel trade and other relevant segments.
Manage and grow a portfolio of key accounts and strategic partners.
Develop strong relationships with travel agencies, tour operators, DMCs, corporate accounts and other industry partners.
Conduct regular sales calls, client visits, presentations and business reviews.
Proactively identify new accounts and revenue opportunities within the assigned market.
Market Development
Develop strong knowledge of the Vietnam market, including key feeder cities, customer segments, travel trends and competitive activity.
Support the development and execution of market-specific sales plans.
Build awareness of Rixos Phu Quoc within the assigned market and position the resort as a leading luxury all-inclusive destination.
Identify opportunities to increase Rixos Phu Quoc's visibility through partnerships, sales missions, events and industry activities.
Monitor competitor activity and market developments and provide relevant feedback to the commercial leadership team.
Pre-Opening & Launch
Support the pre-opening sales strategy and commercial launch of Rixos Phu Quoc.
Establish relationships with key accounts and travel partners ahead of opening.
Build a strong pipeline of business and future bookings.
Support sales blitzes, roadshows, trade events, exhibitions and client engagement activities.
Work closely with the resort's Sales, Marketing and Revenue teams to ensure alignment of market strategies.
Account Management & Revenue Generation
Achieve agreed individual and team sales targets.
Maintain an accurate and active sales pipeline.
Monitor account production and identify opportunities to grow existing business.
Negotiate commercial agreements within approved guidelines.
Ensure effective follow-up on all leads, enquiries and opportunities.
Prepare regular sales activity reports, forecasts and market updates.
Brand Representation
Represent Rixos Phu Quoc professionally within the assigned market.
Communicate the unique “All-Inclusive, All-Exclusive” proposition to clients and partners.
Attend relevant industry events, networking functions, trade shows and sales missions.
Build strong relationships with both local and international stakeholders.
Collaboration
Work closely with the Director of Sales and wider commercial team to deliver the resort's business objectives.
Collaborate with Revenue Management, Marketing, Reservations and Operations teams to maximise commercial opportunities.
Share market intelligence, customer feedback and competitor insights with the resort leadership team.

Strong understanding of the Vietnam leisure and hospitality market .

Strong commercial acumen with a proven ability to generate business and achieve sales targets.
Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
Strong networking skills and confidence representing the brand externally.
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a regional and property-based commercial team.
Willingness to travel regularly within the assigned market and, where required, internationally.
Fluency in Vietnamese and English is preferred.

sections.text:
POSITION SUMMARY
Under the general direction of the Engineering Manager / Chief Engineer and within the limits of established Rixos Hotel policies and procedures, the Ken Fix Supervisor is responsible for supervising and coordinating the day-to-day Ken Fix / General Maintenance operations across guest rooms, public areas, back-of-house facilities, and other hotel areas.
The position ensures that all maintenance requests are attended to promptly and effectively, that repair works are completed to Rixos luxury standards, and that all facilities, fixtures, fittings, and equipment remain safe, functional, well-maintained, and guest-ready.
The Ken Fix Supervisor leads and supports the Ken Fix team in carrying out multi-skilled maintenance works including basic electrical, plumbing, carpentry, painting, masonry, furniture, fixtures, and general repair works. The position also coordinates with other Engineering sections and operational departments to ensure timely resolution of maintenance issues and minimize guest disruption.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Daily Operations & Supervision
Supervise the daily activities of the Ken Fix team and ensure effective deployment of manpower according to operational priorities.
Allocate daily work orders, maintenance requests, preventive maintenance tasks, and emergency calls to technicians.
Monitor the progress and completion of all assigned jobs and ensure work orders are properly updated and closed.
Prioritize guest room and guest-impacting maintenance requests and ensure timely response and resolution.
Conduct daily briefings with the Ken Fix team regarding workload, priorities, safety, guest requests, and operational concerns.
Ensure sufficient manpower coverage during all operational periods, including weekends, holidays, and peak occupancy periods.
Coordinate with other Engineering sections when specialized technical support is required.
2. Guest Room & Public Area Maintenance
Supervise the inspection, troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of guest rooms, suites, villas, public areas, back-of-house areas, and staff facilities.
Ensure all guest room maintenance issues are rectified promptly and to Rixos luxury standards.
Monitor the condition of room fixtures, fittings, furniture, doors, locks, sanitary fixtures, lighting, and other guest-facing facilities.
Conduct follow-up inspections to ensure completed repairs meet required quality standards.
Coordinate with Housekeeping, Front Office, F&B, and other departments regarding room defects and maintenance requirements.
Respond promptly to urgent guest-related maintenance issues and ensure appropriate communication with the concerned department.
3. General Maintenance & Technical Works
Supervise and, where necessary, perform multi-skilled maintenance works including:
Electrical
Replacement of lamps, light fixtures, switches, sockets, controls, and electrical accessories.
Troubleshooting of basic electrical faults.
Inspection and repair of minor electrical defects.
Ensure all electrical works are carried out safely and within authorized limits.
Plumbing
Repair leaking faucets, valves, pipes, traps, hoses, and fittings.
Clear minor drain blockages.
Repair flushing systems and sanitary fixtures.
Identify water leakage and escalate major plumbing issues appropriately.
Carpentry & Furniture
Repair doors, frames, cabinets, furniture, shelving, and other wooden fixtures.
Carry out minor adjustments and repairs to guest room and public area furniture.
Ensure furniture and fixtures remain safe, functional, and presentable.
Painting & Finishing
Carry out and supervise minor painting, touch-up, plastering, grouting, and finishing works.
Ensure repaired surfaces are properly finished and match the surrounding area as closely as possible.
Masonry & General Repair
Supervise minor tile replacement, grouting repairs, concrete and plaster repairs.
Carry out general repair and maintenance works within the team's technical capability.
Identify defects requiring specialist contractors or other Engineering sections and report them accordingly.
4. Preventive Maintenance
Support the Engineering Manager / Chief Engineer in implementing the preventive maintenance program.
Ensure assigned preventive maintenance tasks are completed according to schedule.
Monitor recurring defects and identify opportunities for corrective or preventive action.
Maintain proper records of completed preventive maintenance and repair activities.
Recommend improvements to reduce recurring breakdowns and maintenance complaints.
5. Quality Control & Standards
Inspect completed maintenance works to ensure quality, functionality, safety, and appearance meet Rixos standards.
Ensure all guest-facing repairs are completed with minimal disruption to guests.
Maintain a high standard of cleanliness and housekeeping after completion of maintenance works.
Ensure tools, equipment, spare parts, and work areas are properly maintained and organized.
Report recurring defects, major equipment issues, and potential risks to the Engineering Manager / Chief Engineer.
6. Team Leadership & Development
Lead, coach, and motivate Ken Fix Technicians to achieve high standards of technical performance and service.
Monitor individual team member performance and provide on-the-job coaching where required.
Identify technical training needs and recommend appropriate development programs.
Ensure technicians follow approved SOPs, work instructions, and safety procedures.
Promote teamwork, accountability, discipline, and a guest-focused service culture.
Support performance evaluations and provide feedback regarding team members' performance.
7. Safety, Compliance & Sustainability
Ensure all maintenance activities comply with Rixos policies, Engineering SOPs, occupational health and safety requirements, and applicable Vietnamese regulations.
Ensure technicians use appropriate PPE and follow safe working practices.
Immediately report unsafe conditions, hazards, accidents, and equipment defects.
Ensure proper use, storage, and control of tools, chemicals, materials, and spare parts.
Support the hotel's environmental and sustainability initiatives, including energy and water conservation.
Comply with applicable Rixos Integrated Management System requirements, including relevant ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 22000, and ISO 10002 requirements where applicable to the position.
8. Coordination & Communication
Maintain effective communication with Front Office, Housekeeping, F&B, Security, and other operational departments.
Coordinate maintenance activities with department supervisors to minimize operational disruption.
Communicate clearly with the Engineering Manager / Chief Engineer regarding major defects, urgent repairs, recurring issues, manpower requirements, and operational risks.
Assist in coordinating external contractors and specialist technicians when required.
Ensure proper handover of outstanding maintenance issues between shifts.
KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS
Timely completion of guest room and public area maintenance requests.
Work order response and completion time.
Preventive maintenance completion rate.
Reduction of recurring maintenance defects.
Guest complaints related to maintenance.
Quality and first-time-right repair rate.
Team productivity and manpower utilization.
Compliance with safety and Engineering SOPs.
Proper control and use of tools, spare parts, and maintenance materials.
Overall condition and presentation of guest-facing facilities.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Technical Certificate, Vocational Diploma, or equivalent technical/trade qualification.
Training or certification in building maintenance, electrical, plumbing, mechanical, carpentry, or related technical fields preferred.
Additional supervisory or technical certifications are an advantage.
EXPERIENCE
Minimum 3–5 years of relevant maintenance experience , preferably including supervisory or team-leading experience.
Previous experience in: Luxury hotels or resorts
Five-star hospitality environments
Commercial buildings
Residential high-rise properties
Large-scale integrated facilities
Strong hospitality engineering experience is highly preferred.
Experience in guest room maintenance and multi-skilled general maintenance is essential.
SKILLS & COMPETENCIES
Strong practical knowledge of general building maintenance.
Multi-skilled capability in basic electrical, plumbing, carpentry, painting, masonry, and general repairs.
Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Ability to prioritize multiple maintenance requests in a fast-paced resort environment.
Good team leadership and manpower coordination skills.
Strong attention to detail and quality.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Guest-oriented mindset with a strong sense of urgency.
Ability to work independently and make sound operational decisions within assigned authority.
Good knowledge of workplace health, safety, and environmental requirements.
Ability to work shifts, weekends, public holidays, and during emergency situations when required.
BEHAVIOURAL COMPETENCIES
Serve with Heart – Demonstrates genuine care for guests, colleagues, and the resort.
Notice Everything – Pays close attention to defects, safety risks, and maintenance details.
Stay Curious – Continuously develops technical knowledge and seeks better solutions.
Own It – Takes ownership of maintenance issues from assignment through completion.
Work Together – Collaborates effectively with Engineering and other hotel departments.
Be Bold – Takes initiative in identifying and resolving problems before they impact guests.
Deliver Excellence – Maintains high standards of workmanship consistent with the Rixos luxury experience.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
We are seeking a professional and friendly Front Desk Agent to join our team at our luxurious hotel in Phu Quoc, Vietnam. As the first point of contact for our guests, you will play a crucial role in ensuring exceptional customer service and creating memorable experiences.
Warmly greet and welcome guests upon arrival, providing a positive first impression
Efficiently manage the check-in and check-out processes, ensuring all procedures are followed accurately
Handle guest enquiries and requests promptly and professionally, anticipating needs when possible
Maintain up-to-date knowledge of hotel services, local attractions, and ongoing promotions
Process payments and manage cash transactions with precision
Collaborate with other departments to ensure seamless guest experiences
Assist with administrative tasks, including data entry and correspondence management
Address and resolve guest complaints effectively, escalating to management when necessary
Maintain the highest standards of personal presentation and hygiene
Uphold the hotel's policies and procedures, ensuring guest privacy and confidentiality

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Minimum of 2 years' experience as a Front Desk Agent in a high volume luxury hotel or resort environment
High School Diploma or equivalent; higher education in Hospitality Management is desirable
Exceptional customer service skills with a friendly and enthusiastic demeanour
Strong organisational abilities and attention to detail
Proficiency in hotel management software and booking systems
Excellent communication skills in English; fluency in Vietnamese is essential
Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays
Demonstrated problem-solving skills and the ability to remain calm under pressure
Strong multitasking abilities in a fast-paced environment
Empathetic approach to guest needs and concerns
Familiarity with the Phu Quoc area and its attractions is advantageous

sections.text:

The opportunity to join an international and innovative and fast-growing group, committed not only to building new hotels, but to creating a global brand.
The ability to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.

A competitive package and plenty of development opportunities.

Each Rixos property presents a unique experience inspired by local culture, global influences, and our Turkish heritage, all within a setting of unparalleled luxury.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
At Rixos Phu Quoc , we don’t just serve drinks — we create experiences. We’re looking for a passionate, guest facing Mixologist who knows their cocktails, loves a busy bar, and understands that great service is the secret ingredient.
What you’ll be doing
Prepare and serve beverages in line with established recipes, brand standards, and service excellence.
Demonstrate full knowledge of bar products, premium liquors, and cocktail recipes (yes, guests will ask).
Confidently upsell with every guest interaction — value, not pressure.
Deliver a high standard of personalised, friendly, and efficient service at all times.
Prepare mise en place, garnishes, and ensure the bar is fully set before opening.
Maintain impeccable cleanliness and organisation of the bar counter and surrounding areas.
Monitor stock levels, minimise wastage, and manage operating supplies responsibly.
Handle guest enquiries professionally and build strong guest rapport.
Perform cashiering duties accurately, following outlet procedures.
Ensure premium liquor displays meet brand presentation standards.
Adhere strictly to opening and closing procedures, including stock checks.
Support banqueting and other outlets when required.
Assist with inventories (monthly, quarterly, bi-annual, and annual).
Coach and train new team members through on-the-job training.
Attend required trainings and departmental meetings.
What we’re looking for
Previous experience as a Mixologist in a luxury hotel or high-end restaurant environment.
Strong knowledge of cocktails, spirits, and beverage service.
A natural host with excellent communication and guest engagement skills.
Detail-oriented, organised, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment.
Team player with a positive, professional attitude.
Flexibility to support operational needs across departments when required.
Commitment to hygiene, health & safety, and local legislation compliance.
Well-groomed, punctual, and proud to represent the Rixos brand.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Minimum 1 year of experience as a Mixologist in a hotel, resort, or professional bar environment.
Vocational training or certification in Food & Beverage / Hospitality is an advantage.
Good knowledge of classic cocktails, basic mixology techniques , spirits, wines, and beers.
Strong focus on guest service and service standards , with a polite and professional manner.
Ability to recommend and upsell beverages confidently to guests.
Basic knowledge of cash handling and POS systems .
Good understanding of hygiene, food safety, and cleanliness standards .
Ability to work well under pressure in a high-volume resort environment .
Team-oriented, cooperative, and respectful of hierarchy and procedures.
Willingness to learn, follow standard operating procedures, and attend training sessions.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
The Assistant Restaurant Manager supports daily restaurant operations by leading teams on the floor, coaching supervisors, and ensuring service standards are executed consistently. This role focuses on preparing teams to deliver exceptional guest experiences while supporting operational and business objectives.
Leadership and Guest Experience
Support and protect the guest experience through visible floor leadership
Coach supervisors and colleagues in real time during service
Ensure guests receive timely, attentive, and personalized service
Operational Management
Support daily operational planning and execution
Ensure opening and closing procedures are completed correctly
Monitor service standards, cleanliness, and readiness throughout operations
Support compliance with food safety and hygiene standards
Business and Performance Management
Assist in managing labor, productivity, and operating costs
Support inventory controls and cost awareness
Contribute to achieving outlet performance targets
Use of Systems and Tools
Ensure effective use of approved hotel systems, including the Oracle Simphony Point-of-Sale system, SevenRooms Table Management System, and Oracle OPERA Cloud Property Management System, to support accurate reporting, guest recognition, and service consistency
Working Together
Work closely with colleagues across Food and Beverage, Culinary, Front Office, Housekeeping, and other hotel teams to align operations and protect the guest experience
Professional Standards
Maintain strong floor presence during service periods to support teams and guests
Arrive prepared and on time, setting the tone for professionalism and accountability
Actively participate in fire and life safety training and drills to ensure the safety and wellbeing of guests and colleagues
Other Responsibilities
Attend all meetings, briefings, and trainings as assigned
Ensure teams are scheduled, prepared, and supported for service
Maintain a high standard of professionalism and conduct at all times
Perform other reasonable duties assigned by the Management of the Hotel

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Knowledge and Experience
University, college, or vocational education preferred
Previous management experience in Food and Beverage is an advantage
English is used daily in the workplace to support communication with an international and diverse five-star hotel clientele; proficiency is considered an asset
Strong working knowledge of hospitality systems such as Oracle Simphony, SevenRooms, and Oracle OPERA Cloud is an advantage
Competencies
Strong leadership presence and guest focus
Ability to coach and develop leaders and colleagues
Sound judgment and operational decision making
Collaborative mindset and ownership of performance outcomes
Professional presence and credibility

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Receiving Operations
Receive all goods delivered to the hotel in accordance with approved Purchase Orders and delivery schedules.
Verify delivered items against Purchase Orders, Delivery Notes and supplier invoices.
Inspect all received goods for quantity, quality, specifications, expiry dates, packaging condition and compliance with hotel standards.
Reject or report any damaged, incorrect or non-compliant goods and coordinate returns or replacements with Purchasing and suppliers.
Ensure all receiving documentation is completed accurately and processed promptly.
Record all receiving transactions in the hotel's inventory and procurement systems.
Coordinate receiving schedules with the Purchasing and Store teams to ensure smooth operations.
Ensure all goods are transferred promptly to the appropriate storage locations or requesting departments.
Maintain proper receiving records for audit and inventory control purposes.
Inventory & Cost Control
Support the Cost Controller in maintaining inventory accuracy.
Participate in monthly, quarterly and ad-hoc stock counts.
Assist in investigating inventory discrepancies and receiving variances.
Ensure proper segregation and identification of received goods.
Monitor compliance with receiving procedures to minimize loss, waste and fraud.
Assist in maintaining receiving reports and inventory documentation.
Quality & Compliance
Ensure all deliveries comply with hotel purchasing specifications and food safety standards.
Verify supplier documentation and certifications where required.
Maintain high standards of hygiene, cleanliness and organization in the receiving area.
Follow hotel procedures regarding temperature control and handling of perishable goods.
Ensure compliance with HACCP, hygiene regulations and food safety requirements.
Communication & Coordination
Work closely with Purchasing, Stores, Kitchen, Engineering, Housekeeping and other departments regarding deliveries and receiving requirements.
Communicate discrepancies promptly to the Purchasing Manager and Cost Controller.
Build professional working relationships with suppliers while protecting the interests of the hotel.
GENERAL RESPONSIBILITIES
Comply with all Rixos Hotels, Ennismore and Accor policies, procedures and brand standards.
Maintain confidentiality of hotel information.
Demonstrate professionalism, integrity and ethical business practices.
Participate in departmental meetings and training programs.
Maintain a clean, safe and organized working environment.
Be familiar with hotel emergency procedures and health & safety requirements.
Support pre-opening activities, inventory setup and operational readiness.
Perform any other duties assigned by the Cost Controller, Director of Finance or Hotel Management.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Education
Diploma or Degree in Hospitality Management, Accounting, Finance, Supply Chain Management or a related discipline.
Experience
Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Receiving, Cost Control, Stores or Purchasing within an international four- or five-star hotel.
Pre-opening experience is an advantage.
Experience using hotel ERP or inventory management systems (such as SUN System, MC, Materials Control or similar) is preferred.
KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & COMPETENCIES
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Good understanding of inventory control and receiving procedures.
Basic knowledge of procurement and warehouse operations.
Good numerical and analytical skills.
Ability to identify quality issues and discrepancies.
Strong organizational and time management skills.
Good communication and interpersonal abilities.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Good command of spoken and written English is preferred.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
The management of engineering and facilities services and processes that support the core business of the hotel. Generally focusing on using best business practice to improve efficiency by reducing operating costs whilst increasing productivity. To maintain Mövenpick standards of quality and service and facilities in all departments over which he/she has responsibility and authority. He/she is responsible for the overall smooth, efficient and economical running of the entire Engineering department. Assisting the management in planning for investments, project and replacement budget on a yearly basis.
Must be thoroughly familiar with all Mövenpick corporate and local Operational Standards and ensure they are followed. He/she must accomplish responsibilities and goals as outlined below:
Organization of engineering administration
Facilities Management
Preventive Maintenance & Repair
Co-ordination with corp. Engineering MHR
Handling and management and sufficient storing of spare parts.
Safety & Fire
Key Deliverables and Responsibilities
Planning & Organizing:
Coordinating purchasing for the Engineering departments with the finance team as per the hotel procedures
Manage sufficient par level stock of spare parts and ensures all incoming and outgoing items are registered.
Implements all necessary work procedures for preventive maintenance, initiate respective scheduled procedures and monitors carrying out of work as well as recording the results within appropriate filing system
Prioritizes department workload and efficiently repairs breakdowns.
Plan and execute the annual Preventative Maintenance program for the hotel.
Plan training programs in the Engineering division in conjunction with the Director of HR & the L & D Manager.
Initiates Fire Fighting Training in co-ordination with the Director of Security on a regular basis for all employees
To review the employee schedule and annual leave plan to ensure the correct allocation of resources in order to improve owner/guest satisfaction level as well as employee productivity and satisfaction.
To be familiar with all related company documentation, especially with the relevant Operational Standards Manual for Engineering.
Operations:
To have a complete understanding of and to adhere to Mövenpick Hotels & Resorts policy relating to Fire, Hygiene, Health and Safety.
To oversee all technical installations on hotel plant, Sewage system, Fresh water, Emergency Generator, Air Condition System, Technical building Services, Kitchen equipment, Cooling systems, Swimming pools, hotel lightening, in-house Music & TV system and Paging system.
To ensure a consistently high standard of grooming is followed and by self and team
Have full knowledge of all products and services provided by the property and in the local area
Provides solutions for emergency situations and problems of a larger nature.
To lead and support employees in the achievement of financial, operational and service delivery targets via effective organizational policy and procedural development and appropriate colleague training activities
Plan and execute regular technical skills training for the team
Takes the responsibility for all work executed, by employees or external contractors on the building, plants or technical installations to ensure the quality of craftsmanship of all work carried out by team and contractors meets the Mövenpick standards.
Fully investigates any internal disputes or guest complaints.
Plan and allocate duties for all Engineering Staff in line with the operational requirements
Supervise the completion departmental works to ensure they are completed according to MH&R standards.
To lead daily Engineering briefings and monthly employee meetings
Manage any necessary modifications and improvements of the plant room equipment.
To carry out any other reasonable duties and responsibilities as assigned.
Administration:
To be fully proficient with DynaWin system to maximise its use to streamline and up-to-date information
Approve invoices for payment when the execution of the work is done as initially agreed
Design and implement a monthly report of works carried out, machines maintained, special events, DynaWin report, consumption of energy and water, to be presented to the General Manager.
Monitors all maintenance contracts and consults the General Manager as needed.
Is aware of all agreements/laws with local authorities, insurance companies, external firms, contractors and suppliers, to control their work and invoices.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Facilities Management, or a related field.
Minimum 5–8 years of experience in Engineering or Facilities Management, including at least 3 years in a senior leadership position within an international hotel or resort.
Strong technical knowledge of electrical systems, HVAC, plumbing, water treatment, sewage systems, generators, kitchen and laundry equipment, swimming pools, fire safety systems, and building maintenance.
Proven experience in preventive maintenance planning, energy and water management, project management, budgeting, cost control, and contractor management.
Strong leadership, team management, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to handle emergencies effectively.
Good knowledge of local safety, fire prevention, environmental, and building regulations.
Proficiency in maintenance management systems, Microsoft Office, technical reporting, and administrative documentation.
Good command of English, both written and spoken.
Service-minded, results-oriented, well-organized, and able to work effectively with hotel management, department heads, contractors, and local authorities.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Mövenpick Resort Cam Ranh is a premier beachfront resort located on a 17km stretch of white sandy beach, surrounded by lush tropical gardens. The resort features 500 sea-view accommodations, including 132 Studio Rooms, 250 contemporary hotel rooms, and 118 private pool villas. All rooms offer direct sea views and spacious private balconies, while the villas provide additional privacy and space for families and groups.
With 4 dining outlets, a 1,100 sqm Serenity Spa, Swiss Village entertainment complex, Cam Ranh Rope Park, water park, Little Birds Club, and various leisure facilities, the resort offers a complete destination for families, leisure travelers, and business groups.
Mövenpick Resort Cam Ranh | 5-Star Beachfront Resort Vietnam

Position Summary
Rixos Phu Quoc Viet Nam is seeking a results-driven and experienced Food & Beverage Manager to oversee and manage the day-to-day operations of all F&B outlets across the resort. Reporting directly to the F&B Director , this role is responsible for operational excellence, service quality, people leadership, and financial performance, ensuring all F&B experiences consistently reflect Rixos’ luxury all-inclusive standards.
The Food & Beverage Manager will play a critical role in translating F&B strategy into daily execution, driving guest satisfaction, optimizing costs and revenues, and developing strong, capable teams.
Key Responsibilities
F&B Operations Management
Manage daily operations of all Food & Beverage outlets, including restaurants, bars, banquets, events, and in-room dining.
Ensure smooth, efficient, and consistent service delivery in line with Rixos brand standards and operating procedures.
Implement and maintain service quality, hygiene, and operational controls across all outlets.
Leadership & Team Management
Lead, train, coach, and motivate F&B outlet managers, supervisors, and frontline teams.
Support the F&B Director in manpower planning, scheduling, performance management, and talent development.
Foster a strong service culture focused on accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement.
Menu, Beverage & Guest Experience
Oversee execution of food and beverage menus, beverage programs, promotions, and signature concepts.
Ensure product quality, presentation, and service standards meet luxury resort expectations.
Actively manage guest feedback and service recovery to enhance overall dining experiences.
Financial & Cost Control
Support the F&B Director in managing budgets, forecasts, and financial targets.
Monitor daily revenues, costs, and outlet performance; identify opportunities to improve profitability.
Ensure effective inventory management, stock control, and waste minimization.
Compliance, Safety & Quality Assurance
Ensure full compliance with local laws, licensing requirements, health and safety regulations, and company policies.
Oversee food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards across all F&B operations.
Ensure alignment with ISO standards and internal audit requirements.
Sustainability & Responsible Operations
Implement sustainable F&B practices focused on resource efficiency, waste reduction, and responsible sourcing.
Support ESG and CSR initiatives in alignment with the resort’s sustainability strategy.
Events & Special Functions
Oversee operational readiness and service execution for banquets, events, and special promotions.
Coordinate closely with Sales, Culinary, and Events teams to ensure seamless delivery.
Reporting & Coordination
Prepare and submit operational and performance reports to the F&B Director, including sales analysis, guest feedback, and team performance.
Act as a key operational liaison between F&B outlets, Culinary, and other hotel departments.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Qualifications & Skills
Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management or related field preferred.
Minimum 5–8 years of progressive experience in Food & Beverage operations , with at least 2–3 years in a managerial role within luxury hotels or upscale resorts.
Strong operational knowledge of restaurants, bars, and banqueting.
Solid understanding of food, beverage, wine, and service standards.
Proven leadership and people management capabilities.
Good financial awareness, including cost control and revenue tracking.
Strong communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
Proficient in POS systems, inventory management, and reporting tools.
Fluent in English; additional languages are an advantage.
Flexible to work varied schedules, including weekends and holidays.
Additional Information
What We’re Looking For
A proactive leader with strong integrity and professionalism
Someone who thrives in a fast-paced hospitality environment
A team player who values collaboration and guest satisfaction
A professional committed to continuous improvement and service excellence

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Sales Manager – Europe & UK to join our team on the beautiful island of Phu Quoc, Vietnam. As the Sales Manager responsible for the European and UK markets, you will play a key role in driving revenue growth, expanding market presence, and strengthening relationships with travel partners and clients across the region.
You will be responsible for developing and implementing sales strategies that position Rixos Phu Quoc as a preferred destination for leisure, luxury, and group travellers from Europe and the United Kingdom.
The Sales Manager – Europe & UK will develop and execute comprehensive sales strategies to achieve and exceed revenue targets across the region. The role includes identifying new business opportunities, expanding market share, and strengthening the resort’s presence within key travel and hospitality networks.
You will establish and maintain strong relationships with tour operators, travel agencies, wholesalers, corporate partners, and key industry stakeholders across the European and UK markets. Working closely with internal teams, including marketing, revenue management, and operations, you will help ensure that sales initiatives align with the resort’s overall commercial strategy and deliver exceptional guest experiences.
The role involves analysing market trends and competitor activity to identify growth opportunities and adapt sales strategies accordingly. You will also forecast sales performance, prepare regular reports for senior management, and support the development of new packages or offerings based on customer feedback and market demand.
Regular travel within Europe and the UK will be required to support sales initiatives, attend trade shows and industry events, conduct sales calls, and strengthen relationships with key partners.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of 5–7 years of sales management experience within the European and UK travel markets , consistently achieving and exceeding revenue targets.
A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Hospitality, or a related field is required, with an MBA or relevant advanced degree considered an advantage. Strong analytical skills and experience in financial analysis, forecasting, and performance metrics are essential.
Candidates should demonstrate the ability to develop successful sales strategies in international markets and build strong relationships with clients, partners, and internal stakeholders. Proficiency in customer relationship management (CRM) systems and business intelligence tools is expected.
Excellent presentation, negotiation, and communication skills are required, along with fluency in English. Knowledge of additional European languages would be considered a strong advantage. The role requires flexibility and willingness to travel regularly within Europe and the United Kingdom.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
We're looking for an experienced Turkish Baklava Specialty Chef to join our culinary team in Phu Quoc, Vietnam. In this role, you will be the creative force behind our authentic Turkish baklava offerings, bringing traditional techniques and innovative flair to our pastry program. You will oversee the preparation, presentation, and quality of all baklava products while maintaining the highest standards of culinary excellence and food safety. This position offers the opportunity to showcase your expertise in Turkish pastry arts while contributing to a dynamic kitchen environment in a vibrant island destination.
Prepare and execute traditional Turkish baklava recipes with precision, ensuring consistency in flavor, texture, and presentation across all products
Develop and customize baklava recipes and flavor profiles, incorporating seasonal ingredients and creating signature variations that reflect both tradition and innovation
Manage phyllo dough preparation and handling, maintaining proper techniques to achieve optimal texture and quality in finished products
Source and evaluate high-quality ingredients, including nuts, honey, spices, and specialty items, while adapting to local Southeast Asian suppliers and market availability
Train and mentor kitchen staff on baklava preparation techniques, food safety protocols, and quality standards
Organize and maintain the pastry station, ensuring efficient workflow, proper equipment maintenance, and adherence to food safety regulations
Collaborate with front-of-house staff and management to understand customer preferences and gather feedback for continuous improvement
Monitor inventory levels and manage food costs while minimizing waste through efficient production planning
Maintain detailed records of recipes, production processes, and ingredient specifications to ensure consistency and traceability
Uphold all health, safety, and sanitation standards in compliance with local regulations and organizational policies

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Minimum 5 years of professional experience in baklava preparation and Turkish pastry production
Advanced expertise in traditional Turkish baklava recipes and techniques, including phyllo dough handling and layering
Demonstrated knowledge of Turkish culinary traditions, ingredient selection, and flavor combinations
Proficiency in pastry kitchen equipment operation and maintenance
Strong understanding of food safety, hygiene standards, and kitchen sanitation protocols
Excellent organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple production orders simultaneously
Proven ability to work collaboratively with kitchen teams and communicate effectively with diverse staff members
Experience in recipe development and menu customization
Familiarity with inventory management and food cost control
Ability to adapt to local ingredient availability and sourcing in international markets
Detail-oriented approach to quality control and consistency in product execution
Passion for culinary excellence and commitment to preserving authentic Turkish pastry traditions
Preferred: Experience training and mentoring culinary staff
Preferred: Knowledge of Middle Eastern and Mediterranean cuisines
Preferred: Experience working in international or multicultural kitchen environments

sections.title: Quyền lợi & thông tin bổ sung
sections.text:
The opportunity to join an international and innovative and fast-growing group, committed not only to building new hotels, but to creating a global brand.
The ability to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.
Be part of a team that is very passionate about creating great hospitality experiences and exploring new locations with every opportunity.
A competitive package and plenty of development opportunities.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text: Established in 2000 in Turkey, Rixos pioneers the ‘ALL Inclusive, ALL Exclusive’ concept, inviting guests to discover a world of possibilities, with luxurious stays, inclusive of culinary delights from around the globe, live entertainment, daily sports, and fitness activities, sensorial spa and wellness journeys and fun-filled kids and teens activities. Each Rixos property presents a unique experience inspired by local culture, global influences, and our Turkish heritage, all within a setting of unparalleled luxury.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Position Summary:
Rixos Phu Quoc, Vietnam is seeking a motivated and results-driven Sales Manager to generate new business, maintain client relationships, and contribute to the overall sales goals of the property. The Sales Manager will be responsible for managing a portfolio of accounts, identifying market opportunities, and ensuring high levels of client satisfaction. This role plays a vital part in driving revenue and enhancing the market position of the property.
Key Responsibilities:
• Account Management: Manage and grow a portfolio of key accounts across assigned market segments, ensuring regular engagement and retention.
• Business Development: Identify and pursue new business opportunities through proactive sales calls, networking, and participation in industry events.
• Sales Execution: Develop and present proposals, negotiate contracts, and close deals in line with company objectives and client needs.
• Market Analysis: Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and client needs to develop tailored sales strategies.
• Reporting: Maintain accurate records of sales activities and prepare regular reports on sales performance, forecasts, and achievements.
• Collaboration: Work closely with Revenue, Marketing, and Event teams to ensure alignment on pricing, promotions, and service delivery.
• Client Visits & Inspections: Organize and conduct site inspections and property tours for prospective clients.
• CRM Management: Update and manage client information using the company’s CRM system, ensuring data accuracy and timely follow-up.
• Event Representation: Represent the property at trade shows, exhibitions, and sales missions to promote brand visibility and business growth.
• Compliance: Adhere to company policies, sales procedures, and legal requirements in all client interactions and transactions.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Sustainability: Commit to and maintain sustainable practices by enhancing resource efficiency, minimizing waste, and promoting eco-friendly, social, and ethical initiatives. Align with the hotel's broader ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) and CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility) objectives to drive positive impact across all pillars of Meeting, Incentive, Conference and Events.
Compliance and Standards: Ensure full compliance with local legal requirements, international standards, health and safety regulations, company policies, ISO standards, and industry best practices. Continuously review and update operational processes to ensure alignment with evolving legal and regulatory requirements.
Food Safety & Hygiene: Ensure full compliance with food safety and hygiene regulations by overseeing proper purchasing, storage, handling, maintenance, communication, and preparation practices across all departments.
Skills:
• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Hospitality Management, or a related field.
• Proven experience in sales within the hospitality or related industry min 2 years.
• Strong interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook); experience with CRM tools is a plus.
• Goal-oriented and self-motivated with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets.
• Strong organizational and time management skills.
• Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage multiple client needs.
• Demonstrates a professional demeanour with a strong commitment to delivering customer service excellence.
• English is a must, Local & Multi Language is preferred.

sections.title: Quyền lợi & thông tin bổ sung
sections.text:
What We’re Looking For
A proactive leader with strong integrity and professionalism
Someone who thrives in a fast-paced hospitality environment
A team player who values collaboration and guest satisfaction
A professional committed to continuous improvement and service excellence

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Located on the pristine shores of Phu Quoc Island, Rixos Phu Quoc is a luxury beachfront resort that brings the renowned Rixos all-inclusive hospitality experience to one of Vietnam’s most beautiful destinations. Combining world-class service, refined design, and vibrant lifestyle experiences, the resort offers guests an exceptional escape with premium accommodations, diverse culinary concepts, wellness facilities, and immersive entertainment.
As part of the globally recognized Rixos Hotels & Resorts , our team is dedicated to delivering outstanding guest experiences while fostering a dynamic and inspiring work environment. At Rixos Phu Quoc, we value passion, professionalism, and collaboration, empowering our colleagues to grow and thrive in a culture built on excellence in hospitality.

Friendly, polite, and professional approach to guest service.
Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Prepare and manage pizza dough, including mixing, kneading, fermentation, and portioning according to established recipes and standards

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
At Rixos Phu Quoc, the first “hello” matters just as much as the last “see you soon.”
We’re looking for a Door Attendant who understands that luxury starts at the door — someone polished, attentive, and naturally welcoming with an eye for detail and a heart for service.
If you take pride in presentation, enjoy helping others, and know how to make guests feel instantly at ease, this role has your name on it.
What you’ll be doing
As a Door Attendant, you’ll be the first and last point of contact for our guests setting the tone for their entire stay.
Your responsibilities will include:
Warmly greeting all guests on arrival and departure and guiding them to the appropriate areas
Opening the main hotel doors and maintaining a welcoming, professional presence at all times
Handling guest luggage safely and efficiently during arrival, stay, departure, and storage
Ensuring all luggage is properly tagged and secured
Assisting guests with directions, requests, and general inquiries
Resolving guest concerns promptly and coordinating with relevant departments for follow-up
Maintaining a clean, safe, and organised Concierge and entrance area
Staying informed on hotel occupancy, VIPs, groups, and daily events
Maintaining clear communication with colleagues during shift handovers
Updating and reviewing the logbook to ensure smooth operations
Supporting daily front office operations and reporting updates to the Assistant Front Office Manager / Front Office Manager
Ensuring compliance with hotel safety, fire, and first aid procedures
Demonstrating excellent product knowledge of the location, hotel facilities and services

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Previous experience in a luxury hotel or high-end service environment is an advantage
Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Fluency in English and Vietnamese an advantage in this role
A professional, well-groomed appearance and positive attitude (always)
A calm, courteous, and solution-focused approach to guest interactions
Team spirit and respect for colleagues across all departments
Physical ability to assist with luggage and stand for extended periods

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Rixos Hotels is seeking an experienced and commercially driven Director of Sales to join the Executive Leadership Team at Rixos Phu Quoc , a landmark luxury all-inclusive resort in Vietnam.
Reporting directly to the General Manager, the Director of Sales will play a pivotal role in developing and executing the resort’s commercial strategy, driving revenue growth, market positioning, and long-term business success. This executive position will lead all sales activities across key market segments, establishing Rixos Phu Quoc as a leading luxury resort destination in Southeast Asia.
The successful candidate will be a strategic commercial leader with strong luxury hospitality experience, a deep understanding of international markets, and a proven ability to build high-performing sales strategies for large-scale resorts, pre-opening projects, and lifestyle hospitality concepts.
Key Responsibilities
Commercial Strategy & Revenue Growth
Develop and execute the resort’s sales strategy in alignment with business objectives, brand positioning, and ownership expectations.
Drive revenue generation across key segments including leisure, luxury travel, groups, MICE, corporate, wholesale, and strategic partnerships.
Identify new market opportunities, emerging trends, and growth channels to maximise business performance.
Establish sales targets, monitor performance, and implement strategies to achieve and exceed revenue goals.
Partner closely with Revenue Management, Marketing, and Operations teams to optimise commercial performance.
Pre-Opening Sales Strategy & Market Development
Lead the pre-opening sales strategy, ensuring strong market awareness and positioning ahead of launch.
Develop the resort’s sales infrastructure, including sales plans, account strategies, market segmentation, and commercial processes.
Build relationships with key travel partners, luxury agencies, corporate accounts, and international stakeholders.
Establish the resort’s presence within priority feeder markets and support brand awareness initiatives.
Develop a strong pipeline of business opportunities ahead of opening and throughout the operational phase.
Sales Leadership & Team Development
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing sales team capable of delivering exceptional commercial results.
Establish clear objectives, performance standards, and accountabilities within the sales function.
Coach and mentor team members to maximise individual and team performance.
Create a culture of collaboration, innovation, and commercial excellence.
Support talent development and succession planning within the Sales team.
Market Partnerships & Stakeholder Management
Develop and maintain strong relationships with key clients, travel partners, luxury agencies, and industry stakeholders.
Represent Rixos Phu Quoc at relevant industry events, sales missions, and networking opportunities.
Collaborate with Rixos corporate teams and regional commercial leaders to leverage global opportunities.
Support strategic partnerships that enhance brand visibility and revenue growth.
Sales Operations & Performance Management
Implement effective sales processes, reporting structures, and performance tracking tools.
Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer insights to identify opportunities.
Prepare regular sales reports, forecasts, and business updates for ownership and senior leadership.
Ensure accurate sales forecasting and pipeline management.
Drive account management excellence and long-term client relationships.
Brand Experience & Guest-Centric Selling
Champion the Rixos brand promise and communicate the unique “All-Inclusive, All-Exclusive” experience to global markets.
Collaborate with Marketing and F&B teams to create compelling sales narratives and luxury experiences.
Ensure all sales activities reflect the resort’s positioning, values, and commitment to exceptional guest experiences.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
Proven experience as a Director of Sales or senior commercial leader within an international luxury hotel, resort, or lifestyle hospitality environment.
Strong track record of driving revenue growth and building successful sales strategies.
Previous experience in large-scale resort openings, luxury hospitality, or international markets .
Strong understanding of luxury travel, leisure, MICE, wholesale, and international distribution channels.
Established network of relationships with key travel partners, luxury agencies, and corporate accounts.
Excellent leadership, negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong commercial mindset with the ability to translate market opportunities into business results.
Ability to operate strategically while maintaining strong attention to execution and detail.
Experience in Asia, ultra all-inclusive, or resort destinations would be highly advantageous.

Rixos Hotels is seeking an experienced and commercially driven Director of Finance to join the Executive Leadership Team at Rixos Phu Quoc , a landmark luxury all-inclusive resort in Vietnam.
Reporting directly to the General Manager, the Director of Finance will play a pivotal role in shaping the resort’s financial strategy, ensuring strong governance, operational excellence, and sustainable business performance. This executive position will lead all aspects of financial planning, reporting, compliance, and commercial decision support throughout the pre-opening and operational phases of the resort.
The successful candidate will be a strategic finance leader with strong hospitality expertise, capable of partnering with ownership, corporate teams, and operational leaders to drive profitability while ensuring alignment with Rixos brand standards, ownership expectations, and local regulatory requirements .
Key Responsibilities
Financial Strategy & Business Planning
Lead the development and management of the annual operating budget, financial forecasts, capital planning, and working capital requirements.
Develop and monitor cash flow projections, ensuring effective liquidity management and strong financial controls.
Analyse financial performance against budgets, identify trends, and provide strategic recommendations to optimise profitability.
Prepare and deliver accurate monthly financial reporting, forecasts, and performance analysis for Rixos corporate teams and ownership.
Support the General Manager and Executive Committee with commercial insights and data-driven decision-making.

sections.text:
Position Overview
The Technician – Plumber is responsible for the installation, maintenance, and repair of all plumbing systems across the resort. Working under the guidance of the Duty Engineer and Engineering leadership, this role ensures that guest rooms, public areas, and back-of-house facilities operate efficiently, safely, and in accordance with Rixos standards.
The position requires strong technical expertise, attention to detail, and a service-oriented mindset to support exceptional guest experiences in a luxury hospitality environment.
Key Responsibilities
Plumbing Operations & Maintenance
Install, inspect, maintain, and repair plumbing systems including water supply, drainage, sanitary systems, and related fixtures.
Diagnose plumbing faults, identify root causes, and implement effective corrective solutions promptly.
Ensure all plumbing systems in guest rooms, public areas, and operational facilities are functioning efficiently and safely.
Perform preventive maintenance according to the established maintenance schedule.
Respond promptly to maintenance requests and emergency plumbing issues to minimize guest disruption.
Safety, Standards & Compliance
Follow all Rixos Engineering Policies & Procedures and operational standards.
Ensure full compliance with ISO Integrated Management Systems , including: Quality Management (ISO 9001)
Environmental Management (ISO 14001)
Food Safety (ISO 22000)
Customer Complaint Handling (ISO 10002)
Health, Safety & Risk Management
Adhere strictly to safety guidelines, industry standards, and local regulations.
Support sustainability initiatives including water conservation, energy efficiency, and environmental protection.
Coordination & Reporting
Work collaboratively with other Engineering team members and departments to ensure timely completion of tasks.
Maintain accurate records of work performed, materials used, and time spent.
Communicate clearly with supervisors regarding job status, technical challenges, and required follow-ups.
Provide clear explanations when interacting with internal stakeholders regarding plumbing work carried out.
General Duties
Maintain tools, equipment, and work areas in clean and safe condition.
Stay updated on plumbing technologies, techniques, and regulations relevant to hospitality operations.
Participate in Task Force Teams for new openings or special projects as assigned.
Carry out any other reasonable duties as required by Engineering Management.

sections.text:

Experience: Minimum 3 years of experience in a similar role, preferably within a hotel, resort, or large commercial facility.

Ability to troubleshoot efficiently under pressure
Good communication skills in English
Team-oriented with a positive service attitude
Core Values & Competencies
Sincerity & Transparency
Act with integrity, professionalism, and accountability.
Take ownership of tasks and learn from mistakes.
Reliability & Teamwork
Deliver work consistently and support team objectives.
Maintain positive working relationships across departments.
Excellence in Hospitality
Commitment to quality workmanship and guest satisfaction.
Represent Rixos standards through appearance, behavior, and service mindset.
Quality Management & Continuous Improvement
Proactively identify improvement opportunities.
Support innovation and best practices in Engineering operations.
