sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
POSITION SUMMARY
Under the general direction of the Laundry Manager and in accordance with established Rixos Hotel Policies and Procedures, the Laundry Supervisor is responsible for supervising the daily operations of the Laundry Department. The role ensures the highest standards of cleanliness, efficiency, cost control, and linen care while fostering a positive, safe, and professional working environment.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Laundry Operations
Supervise daily laundry operations to ensure compliance with hotel standards, procedures, and service quality.
Monitor outsourced laundry services to ensure quality, timelines, and contractual standards are met.
Ensure proper setup, operation, and maintenance of all laundry equipment.
Oversee correct usage, storage, and cost-effective control of laundry chemicals in line with environmental and safety procedures.
Maintain linen, uniform, and laundry par stock levels to support smooth hotel operations.
Ensure consistent linen flow to guestrooms, outlets, and back-of-house areas.
Quality & Standards Control
Inspect linen and uniforms for cleanliness, damage, and defects; recommend repair or replacement when required.
Ensure laundry staff have full knowledge of textile types and proper handling procedures.
Maintain uncompromising levels of cleanliness, hygiene, and safety across all laundry areas.
Ensure proper handling of lost and found items related to laundry operations.
Reporting & Administration
Maintain accurate records of chemical consumption per wash cycle and prepare monthly productivity reports.
Participate in monthly inventories and follow up on daily operational checklists.
Maintain complete, accurate, and accessible documentation and operational files.
Assist in administrative tasks and operational monitoring as assigned.
People Management & Training
Supervise, motivate, and support laundry team members to achieve high performance and morale.
Conduct daily briefings to communicate tasks, priorities, and operational updates.
Assist in interviewing and onboarding new laundry team members in coordination with the People & Culture Department.
Ensure training programs and refresher courses are conducted and attended as scheduled.
Develop action plans to enhance team performance, engagement, and retention.
Guest Service & Interdepartmental Coordination
Handle guest complaints professionally, taking ownership and ensuring resolution to guest satisfaction.
Work closely with Housekeeping, F&B, Front Office, and other departments to ensure smooth hotel operations.
Act as an ambassador of the Laundry Department and the hotel at all times.
Health, Safety & Compliance
Ensure full compliance with hotel policies, local legislation, fire safety, hygiene, health, and safety regulations.
Identify and eliminate fire, safety, and operational hazards in all laundry areas.
Ensure proper discard procedures are followed for linen, involving all relevant stakeholders.
OTHER DUTIES
Report for duty punctually in the correct uniform and name tag, maintaining high standards of personal grooming and hygiene.
Provide friendly, courteous, and professional service at all times.
Maintain positive working relationships with colleagues across all departments.
Demonstrate flexibility to carry out other reasonable duties within job capability or redeployment as required by business needs.
Attend all required meetings and training sessions.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Diploma or Degree in Hospitality or a related field.
Minimum 4–5 years of experience in Laundry operations within a 4–5 star hotel or resort environment.
Strong knowledge of laundry processes, textile care, chemicals, and equipment.

sections.text:
Position Summary
Rixos Phu Quoc Viet Nam is seeking a dedicated and hands-on Stewarding Team Leader to support the day-to-day operations of the Stewarding Department. Reporting to the Chief Steward, this role ensures the highest standards of cleanliness, hygiene, safety, and operational efficiency across all kitchen and F&B back-of-house areas, while fostering a positive and professional working environment.
Key Responsibilities
Stewarding Operations
Supervise daily stewarding operations to ensure all kitchen and service areas are kept clean, organized, and hygienic at all times.
Ensure proper cleaning, washing, and storage of dishes, glassware, utensils, pots, pans, and kitchen equipment in accordance with established standards.
Oversee garbage disposal procedures and ensure waste areas are maintained according to hygiene and environmental standards.
Ensure opening and closing procedures for stewarding areas are strictly followed.
Equipment & Inventory Control
Ensure proper handling and care of all operating and kitchen equipment to minimize breakage and loss.
Assist in conducting monthly, quarterly, bi-annual, and annual inventories of operating equipment.
Monitor usage of cleaning chemicals and supplies to reduce wastage and spoilage.
Maintain full knowledge of dishwashing machines, cleaning procedures, and chemical usage.
Hygiene, Safety & Compliance
Ensure full compliance with HACCP standards, food safety regulations, and local legislation.
Work closely with the Hygiene Officer to implement and monitor hygiene and sanitation procedures.
Adhere to Rixos ISO Integrated Management Systems, including Quality, Environment, Health & Safety, Food Safety, and Guest Complaint Management (ISO 9001, 14001, 22000, 10002).
Ensure all stewarding team members follow hygiene, safety, and appearance standards at all times.
Team Leadership & Training
Supervise and guide stewarding team members during shifts, providing on-the-job coaching and support.
Ensure team members are properly trained and follow established SOPs and operational standards.
Attend and actively participate in departmental and hotel training sessions and meetings.
Maintain good working relationships with kitchen, F&B, housekeeping, and other hotel departments.
Service & Guest Support
Provide courteous, professional, and flexible service in support of all F&B operations.
Report guest complaints or operational issues promptly to supervisors and ensure proper follow-up.
Remain flexible to rotate within F&B or other departments when required by operational needs.
General Duties
Ensure punctual attendance, correct uniform, name tag, and high standards of personal hygiene.
Comply with hotel policies, employee handbook, and procedures related to Fire, Health & Safety.
Undertake any reasonable tasks or additional duties as assigned by the Chief Steward or Stewarding Management.
Be flexible to support redeployment or extended duties during peak business periods.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Previous experience in stewarding or back-of-house operations within hotels or resorts preferred.
Prior supervisory or team leader experience is an advantage.
Good understanding of hygiene, cleaning procedures, and safe use of chemicals.
Knowledge of HACCP and food safety standards is preferred.
Core Competencies & Values
Strong sense of responsibility, reliability, and teamwork.
Professional attitude with attention to detail and cleanliness.
Ability to work independently and under pressure.
Commitment to Rixos brand values, quality standards, and continuous improvement.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Job Purpose
The AV Manager is responsible for leading all audio-visual operations within the hotel, ensuring the seamless setup, operation, and maintenance of AV systems for events, shows, conferences, and daily operations. The role partners closely with Entertainment, Events, and operational teams to deliver high-quality, reliable, and innovative AV experiences in line with brand standards.
Key Responsibilities
AV Operations & Technical Delivery
Oversee the setup, configuration, operation, and maintenance of all AV equipment, including sound systems, microphones, projectors, LED screens, lighting systems, video conferencing tools, and control desks
Ensure all AV equipment is fully functional, properly stored, and maintained; coordinate repairs and replacements when required
Plan and manage AV setups for events, meetings, shows, and entertainment programs
Provide on-site technical support during events and troubleshoot issues in real time
Manage sound checks, stage setups, lighting programming, DMX addressing, wireless frequencies, and artist technical riders
Team Leadership & Scheduling
Lead, train, and supervise the AV Supervisor and Technicians
Schedule staff and assign tasks to ensure full coverage of operational and event requirements
Conduct performance reviews, coaching, and skills development
Inventory, Budget & Vendor Management
Manage AV inventory, usage records, and maintenance schedules
Prepare and control the AV department budget, including CAPEX and maintenance costs
Source, evaluate, and manage vendors and service providers; negotiate contracts to ensure quality and cost efficiency
Innovation & Continuous Improvement
Stay current with emerging AV technologies and industry best practices
Recommend and implement technical upgrades and workflow improvements to enhance efficiency and guest experience
Health, Safety & Compliance
Ensure compliance with hotel policies, Operational Standards Manual, and ISO Integrated Management Systems (Quality, LQA, Environment, Health, Safety & Risk Management)
Implement and monitor safety protocols for handling and operating AV equipment
Collaboration & Guest Experience
Work closely with Entertainment, Events, and Operations teams to align AV delivery with program objectives
Maintain strong awareness of hotel facilities, evening programs, and show schedules

Budgeting and vendor management

Strong communication and collaboration

Demonstrate reliability, teamwork, and accountability

Uphold all company policies, procedures, and brand standards

sections.text:
Operational & Service Standards
Deliver courteous, professional, efficient, and flexible service at all times in line with Rixos Standards.
Perform assigned duties within the stewarding area and related workstations.
Maintain cleanliness and organization of all work areas, kitchens, storage, and back-of-house spaces.
Strictly follow opening and closing procedures of the department.
Ensure proper use and care of equipment, dishwashing machines, and cleaning chemicals.
Monitor operating supplies and minimize breakage, spoilage, and wastage.
Cleaning & Hygiene
Clean and wash dishes, pots, pans, kitchen utensils, and equipment according to performance standards.
Carry out general cleaning duties as assigned by the Stewarding Supervisor or Assistant Chief Steward.
Empty garbage bins in accordance with waste management schedules.
Fully understand and comply with HACCP and food safety procedures at all times.
Teamwork & Flexibility
Work collaboratively within the team and provide lateral service to other departments.
Demonstrate flexibility by rotating across different areas within F&B or other departments when required.
Undertake additional reasonable tasks as assigned to meet operational and business needs.
Guest & Employee Interaction
Handle guest and employee inquiries in a courteous and professional manner.
Report guest complaints or operational issues to supervisors promptly and ensure proper follow-up.
Training & Administration
Attend departmental meetings, hotel trainings, and briefings as scheduled.
Assist in monthly, quarterly, and annual inventory counts of operating equipment.
Comply with local laws, hotel policies, and safety regulations.
Grooming & Conduct
Report to duty on time, wearing the correct uniform and name badge.
Maintain high standards of personal hygiene and professional appearance.
Foster positive working relationships with colleagues and other departments.

sections.text:

Planning & Organizing:
1. Review and update Logbook
2. Check equipment
3. Be Smart, well-groomed and maintain a friendly and cheerful disposition all the times
4. Oversee the day to day operations
5. Report regularly on happening to Supervisors / Night Manager (if on shift).
6. Monitor Employees performance/ Coaching
7. Fire Procedure
8. First Aid Procedures
9. Handle guest complaints and report to manager
10. Implement and coordinate the Front Office OSM
11. Perform as per OSM Standards and in line with the Company’s Values and Core Behaviour.
12. Be fully aware of the Talk of the Walk for the day
13. Proper grooming at all times
14. Attend training classes as per schedule
15. Show fullest cooperation and respect within the team and other departments
16. of all Is aware of the daily activities and has product knowledge the hotel facilities
17. Ensure panic report is printed during the shift at least twice.
Operations:
1. Prepare for daily arrivals in terms of room allocation, amenities and special requests of guests.
2. Announce VIP rooms to Housekeeping and F&B departments
3. Ensure VIP rooms are ready, checked and all in order prior arrival
4. Attend management morning briefing if needed/requested
5. Take responsibility of your shift & handle situations, ensure that reception team on shift is looked after and helped if needed
6. Register and process check in for all arrivals
7. Conduct daily briefing & ensure IQ standard is followed
8. Perform Check in & Check Out at the reception
9. Be part & lead in success of Circle M enrolment and assist to achieve the hotel target
10. Ensure Cherish program is mentioned in every briefing and collect daily comments from the team in order to achieve monthly target
11. Check online comments (Tripadvsior, Booking.com etc) and investigate issues then report to the manager
12. Ensure guest comments are investigated and reply back to guest accordingly
13. Assist in achieving TrustYou targets
14. Attend guest requests and take action accordingly
15. Handle guest complaints and take action immediately to ensure satisfaction is delivered
16. Assist Hotel Manager on Duty when/if required
17. Accountable for cashiering duties, foreign exchange transactions, night audits tasks and settlement upon guests’ departure.
18. Handle walk in counter reservation at all times and process call in reservation when room reservations section is closed.
19. Provide friendly smooth courteous service to guest and respond promptly to all requests and inquiries at all time.
20. Resolve guests complaints/ requests and liaise with the department concerned to ensure immediately follow up.
21. Handle issuance of guest room key cards and ensure effective control for guest security.
22. Check Paymaster daily and give feedback RDM with action taken
23. Encourage rooms & breakfast upselling daily to the team and share result and feedback
24. Check Hotel situation, occupancy, functions, groups, MIPs
25. File daily reception report and documents systematically.
26. Give a proper training & induction for all new reception joiners and ensure Opera V9 is the PMS used in training
27. Maintain daily courtesy call sheet and share feedback/action with the manager
28. Attend Credit meeting when requested
29. Attend Revenue meetings when requested.

Oversees and ensures the smooth running of all accounting functions in the hotel and in particular:
The timely preparation and release of accurate monthly financial statements and other related reports
All balance sheet accounts are fully reconciled on a monthly basic and discrepancies are immediately identified and corrected.

All account receivable balances are bona fide and appropriate actions taken to collect overdue amounts
Regularly organize credit meetings with the participation of the General Manager and all concerned Heads of Department where all debtors’ balances are analyzed
Oversees the maintenance of the Account Receivable sub-ledgers in creating new debtors’ code or updating credit limits
The safeguard of all hotel cash and bank assets to certify all monthly bank and credit card reconciliation, to ensure that all daily cash and cheque collection are duly verified and banked-in-intact on a daily basic.

sections.text:
Rixos Phu Quoc is seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Tailor to join our Housekeeping team. This role plays an important part in maintaining the high presentation standards expected in a luxury resort environment by ensuring all uniforms, linens, and guest garments are professionally maintained and repaired.
The Tailor is responsible for overseeing all hotel tailoring functions, supporting the Laundry and Linen Room operations, and assisting the Laundry & Linen Room Supervisor in completing daily departmental tasks. The role includes mending and repairing staff uniforms, room linen, and food and beverage linen, as well as handling guest laundry items that require alterations or repairs.
You will ensure that all work is completed to the highest quality standards and that garments and linen are returned promptly and in excellent condition. The role also involves repairing guest clothing upon request and ensuring items are delivered back to guests within the agreed timeframe, maintaining the level of service expected at Rixos Phu Quoc.
The Tailor is expected to attend daily briefings with the Linen Room team and remain informed about daily hotel activities while maintaining a strong understanding of the resort’s facilities and services. Maintaining sufficient stock levels of tailoring materials such as threads, buttons, and repair supplies is also an important part of the role.
A clean, organised workspace is essential, and the Tailor will be responsible for ensuring the sewing machine and related equipment are kept in good working condition and properly maintained. The successful candidate will also ensure personal grooming standards are consistently maintained in line with the hotel’s professional appearance guidelines.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text: We are looking for a candidate with tailoring experience, strong attention to detail, and the ability to deliver high-quality work in a fast-paced hospitality environment while supporting the wider Housekeeping and Laundry teams.

sections.text:
Rixos Phu Quoc is seeking a passionate and knowledgeable Sommelier to join our Food & Beverage team. This role is responsible for curating and managing the resort’s wine experience while supporting the delivery of exceptional dining moments for our guests. The Sommelier plays an important role in elevating the overall guest journey through expert wine recommendations, strong product knowledge, and attentive service.
The Sommelier is responsible for maintaining and developing the resort’s wine programme, ensuring the wine list reflects both international standards and the dining concepts within the resort. You will guide guests through the wine selection process, offering thoughtful recommendations that complement menu offerings and enhance the overall dining experience. Providing engaging wine service and sharing knowledge in an approachable and professional manner is a key part of the role.
Working closely with the Food & Beverage leadership team, the Sommelier will ensure proper storage, handling, and service of wines while maintaining the highest standards of presentation and quality. The role includes monitoring wine inventory, managing stock levels, and supporting purchasing decisions to ensure the wine cellar remains well balanced and aligned with guest preferences and dining concepts.
The Sommelier also supports the training and development of the restaurant team by sharing wine knowledge, service techniques, and pairing recommendations to help build confidence across the team. Staying informed about new wines, emerging regions, and industry trends is essential in maintaining a dynamic and engaging wine offering for guests.

Professional presentation, strong communication skills, and the ability to collaborate with the wider Food & Beverage team are essential for success in this role at Rixos Phu Quoc.

Perform hands-on full-stack development, architecture reviews, and peer code reviews.
Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services and APIs using Node.js and TypeScript.
Develop and maintain front-end applications using React and/or Next.js.
Understand customer and business requirements and translate them into appropriate technical solutions.
Independently own engineering work from solution design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production validation.
Critically review AI-generated architecture and code, identify incorrect assumptions or implementation risks, and validate the output before adoption.
Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, build processes, deployment workflows, and cloud infrastructure when required.
Participate in Agile/Scrum activities, including daily standups, demos, retrospectives, estimation, and planning.
Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance when needed.
Perform other responsibilities assigned by the Line Manager.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
General Requirements
At least 7+ years of professional software development experience.
Demonstrated senior-level ownership across solution design, implementation, code review, testing, debugging, and production support.
Ability to develop a deep understanding of project technologies and work independently with minimal guidance.
Ability to take ownership of ambiguous technical problems and drive them through investigation and resolution.
Strong self-learning capability and willingness to adapt quickly to new technologies.
Upper-intermediate or higher English proficiency, with the ability to communicate technical decisions clearly in a distributed team environment.
Technical Requirements
Strong production experience with JavaScript and TypeScript , including substantial backend development using Node.js
Hands-on front-end development experience with React and/or Next.js
Strong understanding of backend and distributed-system concepts, including APIs, microservices, asynchronous processing, concurrency, error handling, and performance.
Experience performing architecture and code reviews, including identifying design flaws, security risks, maintainability concerns, and incorrect technical assumptions.
Experience with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP .
Strong software testing and debugging skills, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing.
Demonstrated hands-on experience using Claude Code in real software-development work across design, implementation, testing, debugging, and code review.
Ability to critically review, challenge, and validate AI-generated architecture and code.
Experience using agentic workflows or AI-assisted development across the software development lifecycle.
Nice to have:
Experience integrating AI tools with external systems through MCP (Model Context Protocol) or equivalent approaches.
Experience designing reusable AI-assisted SDLC workflows for engineering teams.
Ability to decompose complex engineering tasks, provide effective context to AI tools, and apply structured multi-step prompting workflows.
Experience improving developer productivity through AI-assisted automation.
Awareness of emerging AI development tools and the ability to evaluate and adopt new capabilities when they provide practical value.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
KMS Technology is seeking a strategic, data-driven FP&A Manager — Pipeline to Revenue to serve as the FP&A business partner to Growth and Sales leadership, with a primary focus on sales performance, bookings analytics, pipeline, and revenue forecasting. This role owns the “Funnel” front end of KMS’s weekly Funnel-to-Cash (F2C) forecasting process and is the source of all revenue and pipeline inputs that flow into the company forecast.
The role combines strong financial modeling expertise with a commercial mindset. It works within the shared data standards and the cohesive linked financial model — supplying clean, standardized revenue and pipeline inputs to the single source of truth — rather than maintaining parallel, standalone tools, ensuring one consistent view across the global FP&A team.
While this position focuses on Pipeline to Revenue, FP&A operates as one team. We provide cross-functional training across our areas — Pipeline to Revenue, Cost of Services to Gross Margin, and Global Forecasting & Financial Data — to keep the work interesting, educational, and insightful, and to enable team members to confidently cover for one another during PTO and other absences.
Pipeline & Bookings Performance (the Funnel front end of F2C)
Own end-to-end financial planning and analysis for sales bookings, revenue pipeline, and growth metrics, as owner of the “Funnel” front end of the weekly F2C process.
Develop and maintain the revenue and bookings forecast content, tracking actuals vs. targets and identifying variances and trends.
Partner closely with the Chief Growth Officer, Sales, and Revenue Operations to manage pipeline and bookings data on the weekly F2C cadence, proactively driving revenue performance.
Track KPIs and ensure accountability to revenue and bookings goals across short- and long-term horizons.
Data Standards & Integration (feeding the single source of truth)
Supply revenue and pipeline data on the shared schema, format, and fixed cut-off cadence defined jointly with the Americas-based Senior Manager, FP&A — Global Forecasting & Financial Data, feeding the single source of truth and the consolidated model.
Oversee the Pipeline Data Analyst (Power BI), ensuring the Power BI pipeline database is maintained and that system data flows cleanly and consistently into the shared Excel databases.
Align to the cohesive linked financial model rather than building or maintaining parallel, standalone models or reporting tools.
Ensure revenue and pipeline inputs are timely, consistently formatted, and well documented, so the global forecast is built on reliable data.
FP&A & Business Partnering
Lead the annual budgeting exercise for the Growth business lines related to Revenue, Sales, and Marketing, including investment projects and performance evaluation.
Perform weekly and periodic forecasts and Latest Estimate (LE) updates for the revenue and pipeline domain, with comparative analysis (actual vs. forecast vs. budget) and clear interpretation of trends.
Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders on revenue optimization, combining financial insight with commercial understanding.
Partner with global business leaders across the US, Mexico, Poland, and Vietnam on revenue planning, forecasting, and scenario modeling.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Accounting, Marketing, HR, and Operations to ensure financial alignment.
Growth & Strategic Analysis
Build models to evaluate growth scenarios, market expansion opportunities, new customer segments, and investment trade-offs on the revenue side.
Analyze customer acquisition cost (CAC), lifetime value (LTV), churn, and net revenue retention (NRR) to support growth strategy.
Support M&A, partnership, and new market entry analysis as needed.
Collaborate with the Global Forecasting & Financial Data role to advance forecasting methods (e.g., regression, scenario analysis) within the revenue and pipeline domain.
Identify and drive process improvements across FP&A workflows, tools, and reporting cadences.
Support for Executive & Board Reporting
Provide revenue and pipeline analysis and reporting that feed executive and board materials, partnering with the Global Head of FP&A who owns those deliverables and the Americas role that consolidates them.
Translate complex pipeline and bookings data into clear, decision-ready analysis and visuals.
Ensure accuracy, consistency, and narrative coherence across all revenue and pipeline content used in executive-level communications.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Experience & Education
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA preferred, CFA a plus.

KMS Technology is seeking a strategic, data-driven FP&A Manager — Pipeline to Revenue to serve as the FP&A business partner to Growth and Sales leadership, with a primary focus on sales performance, bookings analytics, pipeline, and revenue forecasting. This role owns the “Funnel” front end of KMS’s weekly Funnel-to-Cash (F2C) forecasting process and is the source of all revenue and pipeline inputs that flow into the company forecast.
The role combines strong financial modeling expertise with a commercial mindset. It works within the shared data standards and the cohesive linked financial model — supplying clean, standardized revenue and pipeline inputs to the single source of truth — rather than maintaining parallel, standalone tools, ensuring one consistent view across the global FP&A team.
While this position focuses on Pipeline to Revenue, FP&A operates as one team. We provide cross-functional training across our areas — Pipeline to Revenue, Cost of Services to Gross Margin, and Global Forecasting & Financial Data — to keep the work interesting, educational, and insightful, and to enable team members to confidently cover for one another during PTO and other absences.
Pipeline & Bookings Performance (the Funnel front end of F2C)
Own end-to-end financial planning and analysis for sales bookings, revenue pipeline, and growth metrics, as owner of the “Funnel” front end of the weekly F2C process.
Develop and maintain the revenue and bookings forecast content, tracking actuals vs. targets and identifying variances and trends.
Partner closely with the Chief Growth Officer, Sales, and Revenue Operations to manage pipeline and bookings data on the weekly F2C cadence, proactively driving revenue performance.
Track KPIs and ensure accountability to revenue and bookings goals across short- and long-term horizons.
Data Standards & Integration (feeding the single source of truth)
Supply revenue and pipeline data on the shared schema, format, and fixed cut-off cadence defined jointly with the Americas-based Senior Manager, FP&A — Global Forecasting & Financial Data, feeding the single source of truth and the consolidated model.
Oversee the Pipeline Data Analyst (Power BI), ensuring the Power BI pipeline database is maintained and that system data flows cleanly and consistently into the shared Excel databases.
Align to the cohesive linked financial model rather than building or maintaining parallel, standalone models or reporting tools.
Ensure revenue and pipeline inputs are timely, consistently formatted, and well documented, so the global forecast is built on reliable data.
FP&A & Business Partnering
Lead the annual budgeting exercise for the Growth business lines related to Revenue, Sales, and Marketing, including investment projects and performance evaluation.
Perform weekly and periodic forecasts and Latest Estimate (LE) updates for the revenue and pipeline domain, with comparative analysis (actual vs. forecast vs. budget) and clear interpretation of trends.
Act as a trusted advisor to business leaders on revenue optimization, combining financial insight with commercial understanding.
Partner with global business leaders across the US, Mexico, Poland, and Vietnam on revenue planning, forecasting, and scenario modeling.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Accounting, Marketing, HR, and Operations to ensure financial alignment.
Growth & Strategic Analysis
Build models to evaluate growth scenarios, market expansion opportunities, new customer segments, and investment trade-offs on the revenue side.
Analyze customer acquisition cost (CAC), lifetime value (LTV), churn, and net revenue retention (NRR) to support growth strategy.
Support M&A, partnership, and new market entry analysis as needed.
Collaborate with the Global Forecasting & Financial Data role to advance forecasting methods (e.g., regression, scenario analysis) within the revenue and pipeline domain.
Identify and drive process improvements across FP&A workflows, tools, and reporting cadences.
Support for Executive & Board Reporting
Provide revenue and pipeline analysis and reporting that feed executive and board materials, partnering with the Global Head of FP&A who owns those deliverables and the Americas role that consolidates them.
Translate complex pipeline and bookings data into clear, decision-ready analysis and visuals.
Ensure accuracy, consistency, and narrative coherence across all revenue and pipeline content used in executive-level communications.

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA preferred, CFA a plus.
6–9 years of progressive finance experience, with at least 3 years in an FP&A role supporting Sales, Revenue, or Commercial functions.
Prior experience in a high-growth technology, SaaS, or services company strongly preferred.
Experience working with globally distributed teams across multiple time zones.

Deep expertise in sales and bookings forecasting, pipeline analysis, and GTM financial modeling.

Excellent communication and storytelling skills — able to present complex financial data clearly to non-finance audiences.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, weekly forecasting environment.
Collaborative, proactive, and culturally aware, with a willingness to work across different time zones.
Comfortable navigating ambiguity.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Role's Objectives:
Develop and execute strategic sales plans to promote and grow SGS’s Hardline Technical Testing services—particularly Furniture Services—in the Central Region, ensuring achievement of assigned sales targets.
Lead onsite technical sales activities by engaging directly with furniture manufacturers and suppliers to communicate standards, testing requirements, and compliance pathways.
Provide onsite technical guidance, preliminary assessments, and customized testing solutions to strengthen SGS’s role as a trusted technical partner and drive revenue growth.
Act as a vital liaison between clients and SGS technical teams by capturing onsite requirements, identifying risks, and translating them into accurate and actionable testing proposals.
Manage all sales-related tasks—including sales activities, marketing initiatives, client relationship building, and service quality oversight—to support business expansion and deliver best-in-class customer experiences.
Specific Responsibilities:
Conduct onsite visits to furniture factories and suppliers to assess production processes, technical capabilities, and compliance risks.
Provide onsite technical guidance on relevant furniture standards, testing methods, and regulatory requirements.
Act as the primary technical contact during onsite meetings, audits, and factory walkthroughs.
Build and maintain strong client relationships to ensure satisfaction and support repeat business, contributing to revenue growth.
Plan and execute client visits or outreach via phone/email, including delivering product presentations and demonstrations.
Prepare proposals, including pricing and discount suggestions, for Sales Manager approval.
Develop marketing strategies and activities to expand market penetration across different segments.
Collect and analyze market and competitor information; prepare sales reports, forecasts, and recommendations.
Collaborate with internal teams—technical, project management, customer service—to ensure accurate project updates and resolve issues.
Coordinate with Customer Service and Operation Managers to manage client complaints and support debt collection.
Represent the company at industry events to promote services and expand the client base; work with marketing to create supporting materials.
Perform other duties as assigned.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Furniture Technology, Quality Management, or a related field.
At least 2 years of experience in sales of testing services, QA/QC solutions, or technical products—preferably in the furniture, hardline, or consumer goods industries.
Strong technical background combined with excellent sales, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
Customer‑oriented mindset with strong relationship‑building abilities.
Good command of English (spoken and written).
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.
Male candidates are preferred.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
SGS has been providing quality, reputable, independent, international services in Vietnam since 1989.
These services assist Vietnamese businesses access world markets, increasing their reputation as a quality supplier to world markets and ensuring that products purchased by International Buyers meet their customers’ requirements.
In September 1997, SGS became the first international, independent inspection company to be granted a 100% foreign owned company license in Vietnam.
SGS Vietnam Ltd now employs over 600 long-serving, specialised professionals based from offices in strategic locations across Vietnam. They are able to offer a high level of expertise in Inspection, Certification and Testing using some of the most sophisticated laboratory equipment available in Vietnam.
Client satisfaction is the ultimate benchmark of the SGS Group's performance. This we achieve through the development of close relationships with clients, allowing us to anticipate and respond to rapidly changing needs in today’s ever-changing global marketplace.

Support the Calibration Manager in developing and executing business development strategies for calibration services and IoT environmental real-time monitoring solutions.
Identify and develop opportunities within target industries including:
• Semiconductor Manufacturing
• Pharmaceutical & Life Sciences
• Hospitals & Healthcare
• Automotive & Electric Vehicle Manufacturing
Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers, including Engineering Managers, Facility Managers, QA/QC Managers, Validation Managers, EHS Managers, Reliability Engineers, Metrology Engineers, and Procurement teams.
Promote SGS calibration capabilities, including dimensional, temperature, pressure, humidity, electrical, mass, analytical, and laboratory instrument calibration services.
Promote IoT-based environmental monitoring solutions for:
• Cleanrooms
• Warehouses
• Pharmaceutical storage areas
• Production facilities
• Laboratories
• Hospitals
• Data centers
Manage sales leads, customer visits, proposals, quotations, negotiations, and follow-up activities.
Act as the primary coordinator between customers, SGS Vietnam, and SGS affiliate laboratories for technical and commercial matters.
Support the development of strategic partnerships with equipment vendors, cleanroom solution providers, pharmaceutical consultants, and industrial associations.
MARKET DEVELOPMENT
• Conduct market mapping and identify prospective customers in assigned industries.
• Build and continuously update a target account database.
• Monitor industry trends, competitor activities, regulatory developments, and emerging customer requirements.
• Identify opportunities for recurring calibration contracts and environmental monitoring projects.
• Participate in exhibitions, workshops, conferences, and networking events to promote SGS services.
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT
• Generate qualified sales opportunities through direct prospecting, referrals, digital platforms, and industry events.
• Arrange customer meetings and technical presentations.
• Support preparation of technical-commercial proposals and quotations.
• Follow up quotations and sales opportunities until closure.
• Maintain an active sales pipeline sufficient to achieve assigned revenue targets.
• Coordinate project kickoff and ensure smooth handover to operations teams after award.
IOT (Internet of Thing) ENVIRONMENTAL MONITORING SOLUTION DEVELOPMENT
• Identify opportunities for real-time monitoring systems for:
o Temperature
o Humidity
o Differential Pressure
o CO₂
o VOC
o Particulate Matter
o Environmental Conditions
• Support customer demonstrations and presentations of IoT monitoring capabilities.
• Coordinate solution discussions with technical partners and SGS affiliate teams.
• Assist customers in understanding regulatory and compliance requirements related to environmental monitoring.
ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT
• Maintain close relationships with key customers.
• Develop customer retention plans and support recalibration cycle management.
• Identify account expansion opportunities and cross-selling initiatives.
• Ensure timely response to customer inquiries and complaints.
INTERNAL COORDINATION
• Coordinate with Calibration Manager on strategic accounts and sales plans.
• Work closely with Sales, Operations, Quality, CS teams in Industrial department, with Marketing, Finance team in SGS VN, and SGS affiliate teams which support these services.
• Prepare customer visit reports, sales forecasts, market intelligence reports, and pipeline updates.
• Maintain CRM records accurately and timely.

sections.text:

• Minimum 2 years of experience in B2B technical sales, business development, sales engineering, or account management.

• Calibration and metrology concepts.
• GMP and pharmaceutical compliance requirements.
• Cleanroom and controlled environment requirements.
• ISO/IEC 17025 awareness.
• Semiconductor manufacturing environment.
• IoT technology and environmental monitoring systems.

sections.text:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Country: Vietnam
1. POSITION INFORMATION
Position Title: Operations Supervisor
Function: Natural Resources (Forestry – Fumigation – PCO)
2. ROLE OBJECTIVE
The Operations Supervisor is responsible for managing and overseeing the daily operations of the Forest team to ensure services are delivered safely, efficiently, accurately, and in accordance with SGS procedures and client requirements.
The role is also responsible for maintaining and developing relationships with existing clients to ensure customer satisfaction, drive repeat business, and identify new inspection and testing opportunities.
3. RESPONSIBILITIES
Operations Management
Manage and oversee the daily operations of the Forest team.
Supervise the implementation of operational SOPs for assigned tasks and services.
Ensure inspection and related activities are carried out accurately, efficiently, and in compliance with SGS procedures and client requirements.
Coordinate manpower, resources, schedules, and operational activities to ensure timely service delivery.
Control job-related costs and resources to ensure operational efficiency.
Monitor work progress both on-site and at the office and take timely action when operational issues arise.
Client Management
Manage and develop relationships with existing clients to maintain a high level of customer satisfaction.
Communicate with clients on a daily basis to provide updates and follow up on job progress.
Understand clients' operational and technical requirements and coordinate internally to ensure appropriate service delivery.
Identify opportunities for repeat business and additional inspection or testing services.
Follow up and support corrective actions related to client complaints.
Quality & SOP Management
Collaborate with the Quality Assurance team to develop, review, and improve SOPs according to clients' specific requirements.
Ensure operational activities comply with SGS quality standards and applicable procedures.
Support corrective and preventive actions when non-conformities or customer complaints are identified.
Internal Coordination
Coordinate closely with Operations, Laboratory, Administration, Customer Service, Sales, and other relevant teams to ensure timely and accurate service delivery.
Work collaboratively with SGS branches, affiliates, other Business Units, and internal stakeholders when required.
Facilitate effective communication among relevant functions to resolve operational and client-related issues.
Sales & Business Support
Support the Sales team in maintaining relationships with existing customers and identifying potential business opportunities.
Participate in marketing and customer engagement activities when required.
Support the organization of seminars, workshops, customer meetings, and other promotional events.
Reporting
Prepare weekly highlights, monthly reports, revenue reports, commentary reports, and other reports required by the SBU Manager.
Ensure reports are consolidated and submitted accurately and within agreed timelines.
Monitor operational and commercial performance against agreed KPIs.
Other Responsibilities
Perform other duties and assignments as instructed by the SBU Manager.

sections.text:
EXPERIENCE REQUIRED
Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in woodchip inspection, woodchip production, forestry inspection, or a related field.
Experience in supervising operational activities or coordinating inspection teams is preferred.
Practical understanding of woodchip inspection and production processes.
Experience working directly with clients and coordinating with internal operational teams is an advantage.
Willing and able to travel as required by business operations.
EDUCATION
University degree or equivalent qualification.
LANGUAGE REQUIREMENTS
Chinese: Fluent in speaking, listening, and writing.
English: Basic working proficiency.

sections.text:
Operating as an independent Type‑A Inspector Engineer (ISO/IEC 17020), the E&I Inspector Engineer plans, executes, and reports inspection and test activities spanning manufacturing, installation, pre‑commissioning, and commissioning of electrical and instrumentation systems for Oil & Gas, Power, and Utilities projects.
1. TPI Governance, Planning & Risk
- Uphold ISO/IEC 17020 impartiality.
- Review PQP, ITPs, datasheets, C&E matrices, and vendor procedures.
- Conduct Pre-Inspection Meetings and verify readiness.
- Build risk-based inspection plans.
- Coordinate with Client/EPC, OEMs, and TPIs.
2. Electrical Engineering & Inspection
- Inspect LV/MV switchgear, MCCs, transformers, UPS, drives, lighting, earthing.
- Witness FAT/SAT: dielectric tests, DLRO, IR/PI, TTR, SFRA (as applicable).
- Perform relay testing (secondary/primary injection).
- Verify cable installation, terminations, glanding, earthing.
- Conduct hazardous area inspections (IEC 60079‑17).
3. Instrumentation, Control & Telecoms
- Inspect transmitters, analyzers, control valves, MOVs/AOVs, marshalling cabinets.
- Witness calibration, loop checks, and functional tests.
- Witness C&E testing (SIS/ESD/F&G).
- Verify digital comms: HART, FF, Profibus/Profinet.
- Verify Ex equipment compliance and entity parameters.
4. Documentation, Traceability & Release
- Verify certificates, Ex compliance, calibration records, FAT/SAT reports.
- Issue inspection reports, NCRs, and punch lists.
- Validate MDR/MRB/ITR.
- Recommend Release Notes.
5. HSE & Regulatory Compliance
- Enforce electrical safety, LOTO, arc‑flash boundaries.
- Verify compliance with local electrical standards and ATEX/IECEx.
- Stop work when required.
6. Stakeholder & Technical Leadership
- Interface impartially with Client/EPC/OEM.
- Support inspection readiness.
- Provide engineering-level insights in recurring issues.
7. DELIVERABLES
- Inspection plans, daily/weekly reports.
- NCR/CAR documentation.
- Release Notes.
- MDR/MRB/ITR deliverables.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Education/Experience
Required Qualifications (Must‑Have)
- Education: Diploma/Bachelor’s in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, or Control Engineering (or equivalent).
- Experience: 8+ years E&I inspection/commissioning, incl. 3+ years as TPI/Client‑Rep on EPC/EPCM projects (Oil & Gas, Power, Utilities).
- Test & Protection: OEM or industry training for relay test sets (Omicron/Doble), primary/secondary injection; evidence of LV/MV cable testing (IR/PI/VLF/hipot).
- Hands‑on Expertise: FAT/SAT witnessing, protection testing, transformer basic tests (TTR/WR/IR/PI), earthing tests, loop checks, C&E testing, SIS/F&G functional tests.
- Digital Skills: Inspection/reporting systems, and MS Office.
- Soft Skills: Impartial judgment, concise reporting, stakeholder management, and conflict resolution.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Grid interface experience (IEC 61850).
- Custody transfer metering and analyzer systems.
- AMPP/NACE CIP, thermography certification.
- SIL lifecycle experience.
- Supplier audit experience (ISO 9001/IECEx/ATEX) and root cause analysis
EXPERIENCE AND UNDERSTANDING APPLICABLE CODES & STANDARDS
- Quality & TPI: ISO/IEC 17020 (TPI), ISO 9001 (suppliers), ISO/IEC 17025 (labs)
- Electrical Installations: IEC 60364, IEC 61439 (switchgear), IEC 60204‑1 (machinery), IEC 60529 (IP), NEMA, IEEE guides
- Power Systems & Protection: IEC/IEEE relaying (e.g., IEEE C37 series), CT/VT IEC 61869, IEC 61850 (GOOSE/MMS) for substation comms
- Hazardous Areas: IEC 60079 series (incl. 60079‑14 design/selection & 60079‑17 inspection/maintenance), IECEx/ATEX conformity
- Instrumentation & SIS: IEC 61508/61511 (SIL), ISA symbology (ISA‑5.1), project/OEM standards

sections.text:
SGS Vietnam has been providing quality, reputable, independent, international services in Vietnam since 1989.
These services assist Vietnamese businesses access world markets, increasing their reputation as a quality supplier to world markets and ensuring that products purchased by International Buyers meet their customers’ requirements.
In September 1997, SGS became the first international, independent inspection company to be granted a 100% foreign owned company license in Vietnam.
SGS Vietnam Ltd now employs over 600 long-serving, specialised professionals based from offices in strategic locations across Vietnam. We are able to offer a high level of expertise in Inspection, Certification and Testing using some of the most sophisticated laboratory equipment available in Vietnam.
Client satisfaction is the ultimate benchmark of the SGS Group's performance. This we achieve through the development of close relationships with clients, allowing us to anticipate and respond to rapidly changing needs in today’s ever-changing global marketplace.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
1. Legal advisory services (75%)
• Advise daily and support business team and corporate function on operating current business of SGS, including advise on enterprise, commercial, civil, labor matters, intellectual property rights, changes in law, general corporate litigation, dispute management and resolution.
• Provide legal analysis for new services or new regulations that impact SGS' business.
• Localize, draft, review, and update, translate terms and conditions, form agreements, templates, all kinds of commercial contracts and various forms of agreements or legal documentations in both Vietnam and English.
• Liaise and correspond with Group Legal and external counsels in dealing with related legal matters.
2. Data Privacy (15%)
Supporting Legal Manager on data privacy strategy of SGS, including:
• Review agreements for the transfer and processing of personal data among various entities.
• Advise product and business groups across the company regarding privacy and security requirements.
• Localize and maintain internal practices/procedure to support SGS' privacy initiatives.
• Provide project support to business units and corporate function on privacy and data protection issues.
• Support regulatory investigations and responses.
3. Other assignments by Legal Manager (10%)
• Support Legal Manager to develop and deliver legal related training programs to business, corporate functions.
• Work on the review and develop legal related policies and guideline.
• Complete licensing for regulated services at local and ministerial licensing authorities.
• Other assignments by Legal Manager from time to time.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
• Five (5) years minimum experience in a paralegal, or legal team or law firm.
• Bachelor's degree in law.
• Knowledge of laws and regulations regarding inspection, testing, certification, data privacy and cybersecurity laws in Vietnam is an advantage.
• Negotiating, writing and effective communication in English & Vietnamese.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Serve as the first point of contact for clients, visitors, suppliers and employees, handling inquiries via phone, email and in person professionally and efficiently.
Manage incoming and outgoing mail, courier services and sample logistics, ensuring accurate tracking, distribution and documentation.
Support office administration, including document control, records management, archive and store administration, ensuring proper storage and traceability of company assets and records.
Coordinate facility and vendor services, including security, cleaning, maintenance, utilities, office supplies and contract administration.
Support purchasing and payment processes, including purchase requests, invoices, expense documentation, petty cash and cash collection activities in accordance with company procedures.
Assist with equipment logistics, meetings, company events, customer visits and other administrative activities to ensure smooth day-to-day operations.
Prepare and consolidate operational reports and administrative records while ensuring compliance with SGS policies, security requirements and internal procedures.
Provide cross-functional administrative support to Business Units and corporate functions, including Finance, Human Resources and Operations teams.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
College or University graduate.
Minimum 2 years of experience in administration, reception, office support, facilities coordination or related roles.
Strong communication and customer service skills with the ability to interact professionally with internal and external stakeholders.
Working proficiency in English for daily business communication.
Good command of Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook and PowerPoint).
Well-organized, detail-oriented and service-minded, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and maintain accurate records.
Location: Tan Binh Lab - Lot III/21, 19/5A Street, Tan Binh Industrial Zone, Ward Tay Thanh, Ho Chi Minh City.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
As a champion of "Digital Trust," this role is the face of the organization in the fast-evolving tech landscape. Beyond auditing ISMS/PIMS, the Senior Auditor must be a proactive learner who anticipates cyber trends, supports Sales in penetrating the tech market, and communicates security risks as business opportunities. This role demands a modern, agile, and highly communicative professional.
Advanced Digital Auditing: Conduct ISO 27001, 27701, and cloud security audits. Evaluate AI-related risks and data privacy controls in modern tech environments.
Sales Enablement: Accompany Sales to pre-sales meetings to build technical credibility. Help design tailored solutions for tech giants and startups alike.
Market Vision & Scheme Expansion: Proactively research and develop expertise in new areas like ISO 42001 (AI Management), Cybersecurity Act, or ESG in Digital. Always be "ahead of the curve."
Stakeholder Communication: Translate complex cyber risks into clear business language for C-level executives. Maintain a collaborative and helpful posture, even during difficult audit findings.
Agility & Proactivity : Actively contribute to internal process improvements using digital tools. Show high initiative in solving problems and supporting teammates.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Education: University degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Cyber Security.
Experience: Total work experience ≥ 5 years in IT security, IT risk management, or IT auditing.
Auditing: Experience in ISO 27001 or specialized IT audits ≥ 1.5 year.
Certification: Mandatory ISO 27001 Lead Auditor certificate. Preferred: CISA, CISSP, or CISM.
Good command of English (both written and verbal).
Technical Skills: Knowledge of cloud security (AWS/Azure/Google), data privacy laws (GDPR/Vietnam Decree 13), and penetration testing methodologies.
Attributes : Highly proactive, curiosity-driven, and adaptable to rapid technological changes.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Samples Handling & Weighing:
- Receive homogenized samples from the samples grinding staffs samples Weighing Leader
- Check and record samples status: sample code, date received, sample type,...
- Weigh samples into suitable containers following the specified analytical portion for each test.
- Label test portion containers clearly with sample IDs and analysis information.
- Record weights accurately in a weight records/worksheets or LIMS (Laboratory Information Management System)
- Store samples in the right place and control the storage conditions, and/or deliver to the respective Lab timely.
- Store sample tubes after weighing in the right location, under the specified storage conditions, and in the required order.
Support and Teamwork:
- Support the Lab technician in preparing samples for testing
- Coordinate with samples grinding staffs and lab teams to ensure smooth workflow
- Participate in continuous improvement activities for sample preparation efficiency and accuracy
- Report to his/her leaders if any errors or abnormalities are detected
- Perform other tasks assigned by the Lab Team Leader/Supervisor/Manager
Quality, Compliance, Safety and Housekeeping:
- Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure accuracy and avoid cross-contamination: use gloves, clamps, weighing paper,…
- Handle samples carefully to prevent contamination, loss, or mix-up.
- Ensure traceability of all sample preparation steps
- Calibrate and verify balances daily according to internal quality procedures.
- Clean the balances and the sample weighing area, ensure them are kept clean and organized
- Implement regulations on chemical safety, fire prevention and fighting and labor hygiene.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Minimum educational qualification: High school graduation or equivalent
Basic understanding of laboratory practices, weighing techniques
Attention to detail, accuracy, and responsibility in handling samples
Ability to work under time constraints and follow standard procedures strictly

Ensure the laboratory management system is established, maintained, controlled and continually improved in line with ISO/IEC 17025:2017; ensuring impartiality, confidentiality, personnel competence, document/record control, data integrity and validity of results.
Specific Responsibilities
Establish, maintain and continuously improve the laboratory Quality Management System (QMS) in compliance with ISO/IEC 17025:2017 , ensuring data integrity, confidentiality and validity of results.
Manage the full lifecycle of QMS documents and records, ensuring proper control, traceability, storage and availability at points of use.
Plan and conduct internal audits ; manage nonconformities, complaints and CAPA , ensuring root cause analysis and timely closure.
Oversee quality control (QC) of equipment and testing activities; ensure compliance with standards, policies and updated testing requirements.
Support new test method development and validation , and manage Proficiency Testing (PT) activities with corrective and improvement actions.
Provide training and coaching to staff, maintain quality awareness and manage laboratory risks (business, environmental and operational).
Drive innovation and continuous improvement of QMS through digitalization, automation and process optimization (e-document control, dashboards, KPI reporting, Lean/5S).

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Role's Objective
Implement, maintain and improve the Health, Safety and Environment system for SGS Vietnam Natural Resources Operations, covering Minerals and OGC laboratory, field and station activities. The position supports operational continuity and HSE performance by ensuring legal and SGS HSMS compliance, timely incident management, practical risk control, training, communication and effective follow-up of HSE objectives.
Specific Responsibilities
Coordinate monthly HSE meetings with Natural Resources managers and supervisors for both Minerals and OGC, including review of incidents, hazards, actions, training and operational HSE priorities.
Monitor HSE compliance in laboratories, field stations, client sites and sample handling/storage areas; address unsafe conditions with the responsible risk owners and track closure on time.
Plan and deliver HSE training, Safe Talk/toolbox talk, onboarding and refresher sessions for employees, supervisors and relevant contractors based on the training matrix and actual operational risks.
Manage HSE performance: (Lost time Injury Rate) reporting for Natural Resources, including incident status, training hours, leadership visits where applicable, hazards/near misses, corrective actions.
Drive SGS H&S campaigns and practical improvement programs aligned with current SGS direction: workplace presence, digitalization, contractor management, environmental/ESG initiatives and focused Impact Now activities.
Prepare Safe Talk topics and communication materials relevant to Minerals and OGC activities, including field travel, chemical/sample handling, PPE, fire prevention, environmental control and emergency response.
Work with operation managers and supervisors to maintain role-based HSE training requirements, legal training records, PPE requirements and competency evidence for lab and field employees.
Lead and facilitate risk assessments for high-risk activities, new/changed processes, contractor work and OGC/Minerals field operations; ensure safety controls are embedded into SOPs and work instructions.
Support technical teams in preparing and updating safetychecklists, site visit reports, emergency arrangements and legal compliance evidence for Natural Resources operations.
Lead or support incidents investigation in line with Vietnam regulations and SGS requirements; ensure lessons learned and corrective actions are communicated and closed.
Implement the HSE cycle using daily, weekly and monthly follow-up routines to identify risks, verify actions and improve HSE performance through the PDCA approach.
Implement safety improvement initiatives and internal communication programs in line with automation and digitalization strategies, environment as sustainability in collaboration with the H&S National Team and the Natural Resources business line.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
• University degree for Safety, Health, Environmental Engineering, or Degree from Engineering Majors
• Knowledge of Health, Safety & Environmental at least 3 years’ experience HSE Laboratory/Inspection.
• Qualification on and HSE Legal. • Strong computer skills, negotiation • Well-developed presentation and training skills.
• Proven ability to promote safety awareness and foster a safety culture• Good writing, reading, speaking and listening skills in English.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
1. Business Development & Sales:
Market research, identify potential projects/ Clients and develop project pipelines related to IND-inspection service in Energy & Utilities segment.
Prepare marketing material, sales kit for sales activities (Brochures, presentation, service capability, price list, gift initiative, etc…)
Proactively approach Owners, EPCs, Manufacturers, and Contractors to promote SGS' IND inspection capabilities.
Understand Client technical requirements and translate them into commercial proposals and scopes of work.
Prepare and submit quotations, proposals, and tenders in coordination with technical and operations teams.
Negotiate technical & commercial terms (pricing, scope, …) in compliance with SGS policies.
2. Client Relationship Management:
Act as the main contact point for assigned Clients and Projects.
Maintain long-term relationships with key accounts to secure repeat inspection business.
Coordinate with Regional and Global SGS for cross-border inspection projects.
Handle Client inquiries, Clarifications and change requests throughout the project lifecycle.
3. Project Coordination & Internal Liaison:
Coordinate internally with Operations, Technical, QA/QC, Legal and Finance teams before/ during/ after project execution to ensure clear scope alignment, selling price, discount level, smooth operation and effective project delivery.
Support pre-project activities including proposal clarification, scope finalization, Kick-off meetings (KOM), pre-inspection meetings (PIM) and Client alignment discussions when required.
Coordinate during project execution to monitor project progress, inspection schedules together with operations teams, interface with operations teams to address execution or commercial issues.
Support resolution of commercial issues related to scope changes, additional services, claims or variations.
Support post-project activities, including contract close-out, variation handling, invoicing coordination, and follow-up with client for feedback and repeat opportunities.
4. Market Intelligence & Strategy
Monitor market trends, competitors' activities, and pricing benchmarks in the Energy & Utilities segment.
Identify new service opportunities and sectors for SGS industrial services.
Contribute to annual sales plans, budget and pipeline forecasts.
5. Compliance & Reporting.
Ensure all Sales Activities comply with SGS code of Integrity policies.
Maintain accurate Sales records, Client visit records, project pipeline updates.
Prepare regular Sales reports and forecasts (weekly & monthly) for management review.
Manage bad-debt and coordinate with customer service team to collect outstanding debts.

sections.text:
Graduated College or above in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering disciplines (Mechanical, Civil, Electrical) with strong technical exposure.
Minimum 3 years of experience in a Sales or Business Development role, preferably in a B2B environment.
Mandarin Chinese proficiency from HSK3 level or equivalent is an advantage.
English proficiency at B1 level or equivalent, sufficient for daily communication and business documentation.
Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders, including customers, internal teams and partners, with flexibility to travel as required by the role.
Strong interpersonal, communication and influencing skills, with high social intelligence and customer‑oriented mindset.

sections.text:
SGS là công ty Thử nghiệm, Kiểm định và Chứng nhận hàng đầu thế giới.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
SGS is the world’s leading inspection, verification, testing and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for quality and integrity. With more than 90,000 employees, we operate a network of more than 2,000 offices and laboratories around the world.
Our core services can be divided into four categories:
Inspection: our comprehensive range of world-leading inspection and verification services, such as checking the condition and weight of traded goods at transshipment, help you to control quantity and quality, and meet all relevant regulatory requirements across different regions and markets
Testing: our global network of testing facilities, staffed by knowledgeable and experienced personnel, enable you to reduce risks, shorten time to market and test the quality, safety and performance of your products against relevant health, safety and regulatory standards
Certification: we enable you to demonstrate that your products, processes, systems or services are compliant with either national or international standards and regulations or customer defined standards, through certification
Verification: we ensure that products and services comply with global standards and local regulations. Combining global coverage with local knowledge, unrivalled experience and expertise in virtually every industry, SGS covers the entire supply chain from raw materials to final consumption.
* Inspection:
Agriculture & Food
Automotive
Aviation
Chemical
Construction
Consumer Goods & Retail
Energy
Finance
Industrial Manufacturing
Life Sciences
Logistics
Mining
Oil & Gas
Public Sector

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Overview of duties : Receive samples from the CS team, perform initial inspection and feedback, separate the samples as required, and assign test requests in the SGS system to the chemical lab, relevant internal departments, and overseas laboratories.
General duties:
1. Coordinate with CS on all information related to TRF.
2. Check TRF and order testing based on supplier/ buyer requirements.
3. Understand buyer/client's specifications, laboratory testing procedures.
4. Transfer internal checklist and samples for sampling.
5. Sample Breakdown and assign appropriate test item (s) of the sample component.
6. Prepare samples and send them to subcontractors in any. Send WO and sample to the Lab. Communicate with other teams (Lab, CS) to clarify test query or sample query and follow up.
7. Receive feedback and requests from the laboratory for testing (e.g additional samples for testing, checking information…)
8. Tracking order, control TAT, track contact results
9. Other tasks as assigned by the management

Contribute to continuous business growth through effective execution, strong performance and professional customer relationships.
Improve the quality, safety and scheduling efficiency of mechanical inspection services, including welding inspection activities.
Monitor and update changes in inspection technologies, methods and international standards impacting service quality.

Conduct mechanical and welding inspection works in a professional, independent and ethical manner.

sections.text:
Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or other relevant technical disciplines.
Minimum 8 years of experience in mechanical inspection or supervision roles.
Strong hands‑on experience with pressure vessels, piping systems, welding inspection and NDT activities.
Solid knowledge and practical application of international codes and standards such as ASME, AWS, ISO and API.
Valid CSWIP 3.1 or CWI certification for welding inspection is mandatory.
Hold Level II of UT, MT, PT, RT are prefered.
Strong work ethic with high integrity and reliability.
Excellent awareness of safety, quality and risk control requirements.
High level of attention to detail and accuracy in technical assessment and reporting.
Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
Strong ability to follow technical procedures, inspection methods and safety rules.
Flexibility to adapt to changing schedules and project requirements.
Willingness to travel to client sites and project locations.
Physical requirements:
Ability to stand, walk, sit, lift, carry, push, pull and handle inspection equipment.
Ability to climb and work at height on ladders, stairs and scaffolding exceeding 100 feet.
Ability to work extended hours and stand for long periods when required.
Ability to work in hot and cold environments and near industrial hazards.
Good visual acuity, including color vision, and effective communication ability.

SGS is the world’s leading inspection, verification, testing and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for quality and integrity. With more than 90,000 employees, we operate a network of more than 2,000 offices and laboratories around the world.

Inspection: our comprehensive range of world-leading inspection and verification services, such as checking the condition and weight of traded goods at transshipment, help you to control quantity and quality, and meet all relevant regulatory requirements across different regions and markets

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
SGS is the world’s leading inspection, verification, testing and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for quality and integrity. With more than 90,000 employees, we operate a network of more than 2,000 offices and laboratories around the world.
Our core services can be divided into four categories:
Inspection: our comprehensive range of world-leading inspection and verification services, such as checking the condition and weight of traded goods at transshipment, help you to control quantity and quality, and meet all relevant regulatory requirements across different regions and markets
Testing: our global network of testing facilities, staffed by knowledgeable and experienced personnel, enable you to reduce risks, shorten time to market and test the quality, safety and performance of your products against relevant health, safety and regulatory standards
Certification: we enable you to demonstrate that your products, processes, systems or services are compliant with either national or international standards and regulations or customer defined standards, through certification
Verification: we ensure that products and services comply with global standards and local regulations. Combining global coverage with local knowledge, unrivalled experience and expertise in virtually every industry, SGS covers the entire supply chain from raw materials to final consumption.

Business Development: Identify and pursue new business opportunities within the Electrical and Electronic industry. Develop and implement effective sales strategies to achieve revenue and growth targets. Foster relationships with key decision-makers and influencers in potential client organizations

Coordinating the activities of various sales personnel and also delegate duties in the absence of the sales manager.

Collaborate with technical, Lab team and Global teams to ensure accurate representation of testing capabilities.
Client Relationship Management: Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing clients. Act as a primary point of contact for client inquiries and concerns. Ensure customer satisfaction through effective communication and delivery of high-quality services.
Regular Report: Handling Monthly, Quarterly, Yearly Report in Sales performance, preparing the Market Study Report for new development
Proposal/Contract/Agreement Handling: Prepare comprehensive and competitive proposals for clients. Negotiate terms and conditions to achieve mutually beneficial agreements. Ensure accurate and timely submission of proposals and contracts.
Cross-functional Collaboration with other teams and take in-charge all key marketing activities

Testing the safety, durability, and functionality of electronic products.
Ensuring products meet the necessary certifications for market release.

sections.title: Quyền lợi & thông tin bổ sung
sections.text:
We have an opening for an experienced HSE Officer to join our HSE Team. The role is a full-time (Monday to Friday)
Role's Objective:
To the implement, maintain and improve of the health, safety and environment within SGS Vietnam Ltd. Natural Resources_ Minerals which is Business Unit with many inspectors are working in province stations (Ho Chi Minh; Vung Tau; Tay Ninh);
Mineral laboratory located at Tan Binh Industrial Zone (Ho Chi Minh). This position plays an important role in HSE works at HCM Branch where we put SGS Head Office.
Specific Responsibilities:
Hosting monthly HSE meeting with Heads of local operations (laboratory and field operation team).
Addressing safety issues within the lab manager and operation manager.
Be a trainer for branch/lab/site or provide the HSE training to management board, middle management/supervisors (who are the trainers for most of the operational staff).
Working on the country H&S Top Page and BU H&S Top Page (HSE leading indicator & lagging indicator).
Pushing the initiatives and campaigns as requested by Country H&S manager and Global/Regional BU and reporting the progress regularly.
Deciding and preparing the safe talk program for each position of staff within the branch / Site / BU.
Working with operational management on the training matrix for each position.
Identifying high risk operations, organizing the risk assessment program and driving technical team to inject safety elements into SOP.
Working together with technical competence (supervisor/manager) to prepare the site safety induction; safety handbook.
Leading investigation for RAM 2 or incidents as decree No.39/2016 and SGS guidelines.
Implement the safety actions according to HSE circle procedure (daily; weekly; monthly) to improve as PDCA model.
Conduct site H&S visits at the field stations according to the approved monthly plan by the BU Manager
Closely monitor safety operation at lab and at field to ensure comply with SGS's OMIS and SGS Rule for life.

SGS is the world’s leading inspection, verification, testing and certification company. We are recognized as the global benchmark for quality and integrity. With more than 90,000 employees, we operate a network of more than 2,000 offices and laboratories around the world.
Our core services can be divided into four categories:
Inspection: our comprehensive range of world-leading inspection and verification services, such as checking the condition and weight of traded goods at transshipment, help you to control quantity and quality, and meet all relevant regulatory requirements across different regions and markets

Certification: we enable you to demonstrate that your products, processes, systems or services are compliant with either national or international standards and regulations or customer defined standards, through certification
Verification: we ensure that products and services comply with global standards and local regulations. Combining global coverage with local knowledge, unrivalled experience and expertise in virtually every industry, SGS covers the entire supply chain from raw materials to final consumption.
