sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
EE Project Engineer Duties
- Project Planning and Management: Define project scopes, objectives, and deliverables in alignment with client needs, discuss with Senior Lab Expert, Lab Manager in Vietnam and SGS Affiliates to customize the test inquiry, create test plan, test schedules and train to Test Engineer to conduct the test ensure projects are executed on time.
'- Test Procedure Development: Design and develop testing procedures and methodologies for various electrical and electronic components or finished goods, ensure that testing procedures are comprehensive, accurate, and aligned with industry standards and regulations such as the proper US / Canada / EU / IEC / specific buyer standards and report format is complying with buyer requirement / IEC TRF format / US and Canada requirement.
'- Test Equipment Selection and Setup: Choose appropriate test equipment and tools required for specific testing procedures, set up and configure test equipment to perform accurate and reliable tests.
- Prepare test results, data worksheet, review test results and write the test report within the time schedule.
'- Create and maintain detailed documentation of testing procedures, processes, results, and findings and ensure these documentation is accurate, organized, and easily accessible for reference and audits.
'- Support to prepare documentation in ISO/IEC 17025 and 107 Decree, ensure lab operation quality comply with ISO/IEC 17025 and update SOP/lab technical documents according to Lab Capabilitty Development annually.
- Study new testing capabilities, participate in lab development project from purchasing step to install the new equipment/facilities.
'- Communicate effectively to explain technical concepts and solutions to non-technical departments.
EE Lab Technical Support Duties
'- Provides technical support to Sales, Customer Service and clients regarding testing, reporting or technical inquiries
'- Build up and lead a technical team on product testing (electrical & elctronical proudcts) to provide the technical solution to client.
- Support Lab tour for client visit.
'- Provide training sessions and orientations for new lab users/front line team, introducing them to lab equipment, safety procedures, and best practices.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Follow laboratory procedures as per written instructions.
Use an applied approach in performing moderate/complex technological functions within various laboratory operations.
Identify and sort allocated samples into an order which will eliminate contamination during processing and measuring procedures, i.e. samples with known low valued species are processed before those with known high values.
Operate equipment and systems according to standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Check primary measuring equipment for damage and cleanliness, rejecting sub-standard items. Calibrates equipment using standard procedures to ensure that tolerance specifications are achieved., e.g. analytical balances, pipettes and burettes.
Transfer each primary measure of material to clean equipment, numbered or identified in an identical sequence as recorded on the worksheet / logbook or Laboratory Information System (LIMS). Records the actual mass or volume transferred for each sample.
Use recorded information of primary measurements, dilutions and final measurements to calculate content of species in each sample and log this into the LIMS and / or Logbooks.
Prepare solutions of chemical reagents required in the method of determination by accurate weighing and dilution.
Add measured quantities of acids and reagents into the samples. Applies heating to dissociate chemical species from unwanted matrix components.
Dilute residual solution to a volume as specified in the correct sequence to condition specific chemical species for separation by precipitation and filtration or extraction into organic solvents.
Separate solids for measurements weighing, by preparation of media, careful filtration, washing and drying to a constant mass or ensures evolved gasses are dissolved in reagent solution.
Manually set switches and makes adjustments to measuring equipment to tune and optimise response for accuracy in determining each required chemical species.
Compiles calibration information by obtaining instrument measurements on reference materials of known value of species.
Use recorded information of primary measurements, dilutions and final measurements to calculate content of species in each sample.
Follow all company health, safety and environmental policies.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
A post secondary education (degree and/or diploma) in a Science related program (Chemistry, Geochemistry, Biochemistry etc.) is required.
Has to be able to write legibly and correct, understand numerical sequencing and sort numbers in sequence. Must be able to do calculations by adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing.
Must have a fair amount of manual dexterity (ease and skill in physical movement, especially in using the hands and manipulating objects).

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Eurofins Scientific through its subsidiaries is a world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences, and in agroscience Contract Research services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in genomics and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in BioPharma Contract Development and Manufacturing. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty esoteric and molecular clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA. With ca. 62,000 staff across a network of over 1,000 independent companies in 62 countries and operating over 900 laboratories, Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods for evaluating the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin and purity of biological substances and products, as well as for innovative clinical diagnostics. The objective of Eurofins companies is to provide their customers with high-quality services, accurate results on time and expert advice by their highly qualified staff.
Comprehensive services and unmatched expertise
Eurofins believes it is also a worldwide scientific leader in most of its fields of activity. Through research and development and acquisitions, the Group draws on the latest developments in the field of biotechnology and analytical chemistry to offer its clients unique analytical solutions and the most comprehensive range of testing methods.
A commitment to top quality
The Eurofins Group is committed to provide the highest quality services, accurate results in time and expert advice by its highly qualified staff. The reliability and accuracy of its data help customers make adequate decisions and meet their increasingly stringent quality and safety standards and the expanding demands of regulatory authorities around the world.
Permanent innovation and support by the market leader
Few testing laboratories can combine the level of expertise, technological leadership, attention to quality and customer service that have made Eurofins the global leader in many of the fields where it is active. Large investments in innovation, technology, IT and logistics and very large sample volumes ensure that customers enjoy high standards of quality at reasonable prices.
Eurofins started to provide the services in Vietnam since 2015. Our main services includes Food and Feed Testing, Consumer Product Testing, Environment Services, Agricultural sciences, Inspection and Audit, Certification, DNA testing, Genetic testing before prenancy, Covid test, HPV test, Decoding gen, etc. Current legal entities in Vietnam:
Eurofins Sac Ky Hai Dang
Eurofins Consumer Product Testing
Eurofins Assurance
Eurofins MTS
Eurofins Gentis
Eurofins ETM

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
We are seeking an experienced Cloud Security Analyst to join our Global Information Security team.
In this role, you will lead initiatives focused on strengthening Eurofins' cloud security posture across Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, and Google Cloud Platform. You will serve as a trusted advisor for cloud security, providing technical leadership, governance guidance, and strategic direction for cloud security operations and risk management.
You will play a key role in the operation and evolution of Eurofins' Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP), cloud governance framework, and security monitoring processes. The position requires close collaboration with Cloud Engineering Teams, Security Architects, Cloud Architects, and business stakeholders globally.
You will be responsible for:
CNAPP Platform Management
• Act as a (senior) SME for Eurofins' Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP).
• Drive onboarding and adoption of cloud tenants and subscriptions.
• Maintain and optimize detection coverage, policies, controls, and reporting capabilities.
Cloud Security Governance
• Define, maintain, and improve cloud security baselines, guardrails, and standards.
• Support the review and approval process for security exceptions and risk acceptance requests.
• Partner with Security Architects and Engineering Teams to implement enterprise cloud security controls.
Risk Management & Security Posture Improvement
• Prioritize remediation initiatives based on business risk and threat exposure.
• Track and drive closure of high-risk vulnerabilities and misconfigurations.
DevSecOps & Automation
• Drive security automation and infrastructure-as-code security controls.
• Identify opportunities to reduce operational effort through automation.
Leadership & Stakeholder Management
• Build trusted relationships with platform owners and technical leaders.
• Participate in technical workshops and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
• Mentor and support junior Cloud Security Analysts.
What You Will Drive
In this role you will influence and improve:
Enterprise Cloud Security Posture
Vulnerability and risk reduction programs
Cloud security automation initiatives
CNAPP platform maturity and adoption
Security awareness among Cloud Engineering Team

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Education
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
Experience
3+ years of experience in Information Security or Cybersecurity,
1+ years of hands-on cloud security experience,
Experience working with enterprise-scale cloud environments,
Proven experience managing or operating cloud security solutions,
Experience leading technical initiatives and collaborating across multiple teams.
Required Technical Skills
Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Azure security services.
Strong understanding of AWS security services.
Good knowledge of Google Cloud Platform security controls.
Experience securing Kubernetes and containerized environments.
Cloud Identity and Access Management (IAM).
Vulnerability management and threat remediation processes.
Understanding of Security Architecture and threat modelling concepts.
Familiar with risk management methodologies.
DevSecOps and CI/CD security practices.
Infrastructure-as-Code security controls.
Security monitoring and cloud compliance frameworks.
Advantageous Technical Skills
Experience with Wiz or other leading CNAPP platforms.
Microsoft Defender for Cloud.
M365 Desired State Configuration (M365 DSC).
Terraform, Bicep, or similar automation frameworks.
BMC Helix integration and workflow automation.
Multi-cloud governance and compliance programs.
Security automation and orchestration tooling.
Preferred Certifications
One or more of the following certifications are highly desirable:
CISSP
CCSP
Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500)
AWS Certified Security Specialty
Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer
Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS)
TOGAF (advantageous)
Professional Competencies
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
Engineering thinking
Technical leadership
Strong stakeholder management
Good communication skills
Continuous improvement mindset

sections.title: Quyền lợi & thông tin bổ sung
sections.text:
We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.
We embrace diversity! As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Eurofins network of companies believes in strength and innovation through diversity. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.
Sustainability matters to us! We are well on our way to achieving our objective of carbon neutrality by 2025, through a combination of emission reduction and compensation initiatives. We encourage our laboratory leaders to make sustainable changes at their local level, and in addition to their initiatives we count on our dedicated carbon reduction team to help us to achieve this goal!
Find out more on our Careers page: https://careers.eurofins.com/
Company description : Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.
The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.
In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to ca. 63,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 60 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.
In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.95 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused Principal Product Sustenance Engineer to drive product support, incident resolution, and continuous product improvements.
The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, collaborate effectively across multiple teams, and ensure timely resolution of production issues while maintaining high customer satisfaction.
Key Responsibilities
Lead investigation and resolution of complex production issues and customer-reported incidents.
Handle user access management and data management (importation, update, migration etc.) requests.
Lead troubleshooting and coordinate with Dev, Infra, and Network teams.
Working knowledge of ESB (Enterprise Service Bus) or Message Queuing (MSMQ) is an added advantage
Experience with an observability platform like Grafana for troubleshooting, monitoring and alerting is a must.
Analyse application logs, SQL data, and system behaviour to identify root causes.
Experience in writing SQL queries for troubleshooting, data validation, and issue analysis.
Coordinate with Development, QA, Product Management, Infrastructure, and Customer Support teams to drive issue resolution.
Track, follow up, and ensure timely closure of action items across cross-functional teams.
Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and recommend preventive and corrective actions.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to reduce incident volume and improve product stability.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
4-6 years of working experience in L2 production/application support.
Technical Skills:
Proficient in writing SQL queries for data analysis and issue investigation.
Ability to verify and validate data across multiple systems and databases.
Hands-on experience in converting Excel data into SQL scripts.
Experience in troubleshooting application errors using logs, SQL queries, and system diagnostics.
Good understanding of enterprise application architecture and business workflows.
Experience in integration troubleshooting (REST APIs, file-based, message-based and service integrations).
Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools such as Grafana, Kibana, Splunk, or similar tools is desirable.
Working knowledge of programming languages and software development lifecycle (SDLC), release management, and incident management processes.
Functional Skills:
Excellent business communication and stakeholder management skills.
Excellent domain knowledge - meaning a very good understanding of the business, applications, and functionalities.
Strong ownership with the ability to drive issues to closure.
Excellent follow-up and action tracking skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Ability to quickly understand business processes and product functionality.
Experience coordinating across multiple teams and managing competing priorities.
Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering high-quality support.

sections.text:
SUMMARY OF ROLE AND OBJECTIVES:
The Service Delivery Management crew actively participates in managing the delivery of the Security Services to internal service consumers.
The Information Security Analyst (Service Delivery Management is responsible for service management activities for assigned service consumer base, acting as the SPOC (Single Point of Contact) between the service consumers and the Eurofins Group Security, resulting in positive customer satisfaction.
From operational perspective, the Information Security Analyst is responsible for the health of security services for internal service consumers.
ROLE & OBJECTIVES :
Specific Assignments:
The main responsibilities of an Information Security Analyst (Service Delivery Management)
Role responsibilities:
Run all Service Delivery processes and ITSM processes in Security Operations as defined by the Group.
Manage and/or oversee the overall Security Services onboarding program for Zones and non-integrated ELEs, including but not limited to set deployment expectations, build project timeline, Onboarding resources management, stream communication across different stakeholders, monitor and report progress, and propose roadblock removal strategies so a compliance metric for a minimum of 99% of all Security Toolset coverage is achieved for all technologies in scope.
Ensure Security Services are fit for purpose, carrying out relevant reviews/propose modifications as necessary.
Conduct Monthly Security Service Review sessions with service consumers and stakeholders with special attention to Onboarding, Security Toolset compliance and Security Service Dashboards.
Cooperate with internal Security teams and other Security actors to further develop Security Operations.
Report SLA, KPI and performance metrics of Security Services, steer activities as per metrics defined in the Service card.
Make sure definition of improvement plans to meet SLA and KPI are in place.
Assess and report the level of compliance for each ELEs/ZONEs and ensure to have a defined plan to reach the target as defines in the TSFs.
Coordinate the work provided and service delivered by the security partners.
Prepare and publish the report to stakeholders including Local IT Management and Information Security Management.
Ensure that all Security documentation for Internal/External service consumers are available and updated.
Help in the development of processes and procedures required for the delivery of the Security Services.
Provide a clear and regular update to service consumers on action items, including proposed actions and dates to closure.
Receive and coordinate reporting requests, assisting with high level design of reports where required.
Provide Security Services expectations to align the stakeholders and service consumers.
Other Assignments:
Overall accountability for transition success building best practices for the service management community.
Build, manage and maintain a trusted relationship with all Security actors and service consumers both internally and externally.
Organizing and Leading Service Delivery sessions including incident review, problem resolution, etc.
Leverage the most effective and efficient service from the delivery teams for each assigned service consumer.
Receive and coordinate consumer reported bugs/issues with internal Security Team.
Support IT Directors and Security Managers in day-to-day activities.
Maintain/track service consumers contact and organization details.
Produce consistent, high-quality service reviews on a monthly basis that demonstrate quality and continuous improvement.
Escalation point for internal teams for unresponsive service consumers.
Provide feedback to the Service Owner
Supports the IT Security Coordinator and the associate Information Security Director in day-to-day activities.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Education and Certifications:
Bachelor’s degree in information security, Computer Science, IT, or a related field. (required)
Relevant certifications such as ITIL Foundation, CompTIA Security +, CISM, or similar credentials are preferred.
Professional Experience:
Minimum of 3+ years of experience in IT service delivery.
Demonstrated experience working in a security-focused organization or environment.
Proven track record in managing and improving service delivery processes, ensuring alignment with SLAs and business objectives.
Technical Skills:
Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, network security, and cybersecurity principles.
Proficiency in security frameworks such as ISO 27001, GPDR, HIPPA and other information security standards.
Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and their associated security services.
Communication:
Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to build relationships across teams and regions.
Strong conflict resolution ability.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey complex security concepts to non-technical audiences.
Problem-Solving and Strategic Thinking:
Expertise in identifying, analysing, and resolving complex service delivery issues in a timely manner.
Strong analytical and decision-making capabilities with the ability to plan and execute long-term strategies.
Other Requirements:
Ability to work in a high-pressure environment and manage multiple priorities.
Willingness to travel and support global teams when necessary.
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying updated on evolving security threats and technologies.
Languages: fluent English.

sections.text:
We are seeking a DevOps Engineer to support end-to-end software delivery and platform operations. The role covers infrastructure provisioning, request coordination with external teams, automated deployments, software instance setup, and cross-team delivery coordination. Key activities include applying Infrastructure as Code practices, using Terraform to provision and manage cloud infrastructure, maintaining deployment automation and configuration consistency, monitoring deployment outcomes, and supporting security, change, and release management controls.
Software instances are provisioned and maintained across development, test, and production environments. The engineer will collaborate with development, infrastructure, security, and operations teams to resolve delivery issues, improve deployment quality, and strengthen platform reliability.
This role requires strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, disciplined organisation, clear stakeholder communication, and a continuous-improvement mindset to reduce manual effort and error-prone activities.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Qualifications & Experience
We seek a professional with at least 3–4 years of experience in DevOps engineering, release and deployment management , infrastructure automation, or related fields , with exposure to:
Agile methodology
CI/CD pipelines
Platforms: Windows, Linux
Database: MSSQL
ITSM Tool: ServiceNow, BMC Helix, JIRA
Cloud: Microsoft Azure (Mandatory)
CI/CD Tools: Octopus Deploy
Version control and CI/CD platform : Azure DevOps
Monitoring: Grafana
Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (Mandatory)
Containerization: Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
*** Candidates are not expected to be fully proficient in every technology listed above. However, they must demonstrate broad technical awareness, strong learning agility, and the ability to accelerate technical implementation and troubleshooting activities.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
The Test Automation Engineer ensures quality and reliability for ComLIMS-Quotation, the Eurofins Information Systems (EurIS) regional web-based Customer Commercial Agreement Management application used across Eurofins laboratories worldwide. This role is embedded in the ComLIMS-Quotation Development Team based in Ho Chi Minh City, comprising five local members alongside offshore team members, and is accountable for building and maintaining automated test suites covering functional and non-functional requirements across acceptance and deployment stages. The team delivers software using Agile/DevOps practices and robust modelling techniques such as Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Unified Modelling Language (UML), on a stack including C#, .NET, MSSQL Server, Angular, and DevOps tooling such as Docker, Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, and Octopus.
Key Responsibilities
You serve as the dedicated Test Automation Engineer within a Scrum team of six collocated Software Engineers and Quality Assurance (QA), ensuring test automation is integrated at every stage of feature development.
You contribute to test execution (acceptance, deployment, and more), build automation, and troubleshooting of selected functional and non-functional requirements for target software applications and services, maintaining an automation ratio of80%.
You perform exploratory testing in addition to automated UI tests to uncover usability issues, visual glitches, hidden defects and functionality gaps.
You adhere to Agile values and practices (Scrum and Kanban), participating in team meetings (stand-ups, backlog refinement acceptance criteria refinement) and performing incremental testing of the application.
You follow continuous delivery practices by ensuring ComLIMS-Quotation test suites are automated and system atically executed as part of the Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipeline at acceptance and deployment stages.
You apply test strategies and test plans to ensure high-quality product delivery, refining them when necessary.
You collaborate with Software Engineers, architects, development managers, and business analysts to achieve comprehensive test coverage and quality.
You communicate proactively with product owners, business analysts, development, and testing teams to resolve ambiguity and maintain alignment on test coverage and quality.
Other Assignments
You ensure regular follow-up with the Team Manager, providing updates as needed or upon request.
You quickly acquire working knowledge of Eurofins EurIS systems, starting with ComLIMS-Quotation, its underlying concepts, models, and the processes and practices of the team.
You continuously deepen knowledge of ComLIMS-Quotation concepts, models, and team practices, guided by the priorities of assigned functions.
You build effective working relationships with IT and non-IT stakeholders across Eurofins.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Required Skills and Qualifications
You hold a bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or have equivalent practical experience.
You have at least three years of experience in software testing, with a strong focus on automation and proven manual testing skills.
You have a thorough understanding of various types of testing and their purposes, including acceptance, regression, sanity and exploratory testing.
You have a thorough understanding of software applications at both functional and technical levels, with the ability to extend and refine acceptance criteria, including consideration of corner, edge, and boundary cases.
You have working knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and DevOps practices for effective integration of testing into the development process.
You are proficient in test automation using object-oriented languages (such as Java or C#).
You understand web service patterns using Representational State Transfer (REST) and Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) queuing patterns, and can test them with automation.
You have experience with UI automation testing using tools like Selenium or JavaScript frameworks such as WebdriverIO.
You are proficient in debugging code and troubleshooting issues across various layers of the application stack.
You perform root cause analysis on defects and performance issues.
You collaborate effectively with distributed teams across multiple countries.
You have hands-on experience with exploratory testing techniques to complement automated test coverage.
You are fluent in English (written and spoken).
You have conversational proficiency in Vietnamese to facilitate local communication.
Preferred Skills and Experience
You have initial experience with Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD) tools such as SpecFlow/Reqnroll, JBehave, orCucumber.js for writing test cases in a given/when/then format.
You have working knowledge of scripting languages like PowerShell, Shell, or Bash for automating tasks and writing test scripts.
You have experience testing backend services developed with a DDD approach.
You are familiar with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps Pipelines and Jenkins.
You have experience in test automation with web frontend languages (JavaScript or TypeScript).
You have experience with tools like JMeter, LoadRunner, or Gatling for performance, load, and stress testing.
You can review and interpret performance test results and identify bottlenecks.
You have experience working with relational databases and working knowledge of Structured Query Language (SQL).
You have strong interpersonal communication skills to collaborate effectively with developers, product owners, and other stakeholders.
You have conversational proficiency in Mandarin or French to facilitate communication in a multilingual environment.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Eurofins Scientific through its subsidiaries is a world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences, and in agroscience Contract Research services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in genomics and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in BioPharma Contract Development and Manufacturing. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty esoteric and molecular clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA. With over 65,000 staff across a network of independent companies in 60 countries and operating over 950 laboratories, Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods for evaluating the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin and purity of biological substances and products, as well as for innovative clinical diagnostics. The objective of Eurofins companies is to provide their customers with high-quality services, accurate results on time and expert advice by their highly qualified staff.
Comprehensive services and unmatched expertise
Eurofins believes it is also a worldwide scientific leader in most of its fields of activity. Through research and development and acquisitions, the Group draws on the latest developments in the field of biotechnology and analytical chemistry to offer its clients unique analytical solutions and the most comprehensive range of testing methods.
A commitment to top quality
The Eurofins Group is committed to provide the highest quality services, accurate results in time and expert advice by its highly qualified staff. The reliability and accuracy of its data help customers make adequate decisions and meet their increasingly stringent quality and safety standards and the expanding demands of regulatory authorities around the world.
Permanent innovation and support by the market leader
Few testing laboratories can combine the level of expertise, technological leadership, attention to quality and customer service that have made Eurofins the global leader in many of the fields where it is active. Large investments in innovation, technology, IT and logistics and very large sample volumes ensure that customers enjoy high standards of quality at reasonable prices.

Check all information include test assignment, client’s requirement, protocol or manual, test result from lab, etc. to correct typed report before issuing to customer.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Fully in-charge of Purchasing and support operating managers in sourcing and cost controlling of Eurofins entities in countries under NSC Vietnam’s scope, including:
To manage all P2P activities (for lab consumables, CAPEX, and indirect services) ensuring in compliance with Eurofins Purchasing Key Guidance Documents (KGD) and PR/PO system (Coupa system).
To manage and develop suppliers to ensure continuous good performance in quality, price, payment term, delivery and service, and other commercial conditions.
To provide good internal customer services and value-added services to Operation teams.
General duties
P2P procurement:
Manage, optimize and implement group P2P process, including strategic procurement, supplier approval process and issue resolution (Purchase Orders, Contract).
Sourcing and categories management.
Working smoothly with Local Purchasers, Operation teams and other stakeholders to understand business requirements from the early stage of the sourcing.
Supplier Approval process management & Supplier Master data management.
Purchase agreement and Item Master Data Management.
Procurement in variety of category groups including consumables, equipment, indirect services, IT facilities and operation fees.
Liaises with Eurofins’ global teams to continuously update Group purchasing targets, strategies, project & practices.
Forecast and manage all the sourcing risks to advise for Business team.
Cost Management
Manage CAPEX budget in order to optimize high efficiency procurement.
Manage Total Cost of Ownerships to ensure cost optimization for Operation teams
Operational Purchasing
Manage all purchasing activities to ensure Eurofins policies and procedures are complied.
Develop and announce Service Level Agreement with all Eurofins Legal Entities.
Implement, monitor, and report on relevant key performance indicators to demonstrate improvements of purchasing activities for the whole Eurofins Group and to monitor the purchasing performance of each Legal Entity.
Coach, train and develop local purchasers among all Eurofins Legal Entities in his/her scope.
Research, develop and implement improved Coupa system and procurement procedures with documentation and training.
Maintain all purchasing report such as quarter spending report.
Other related tasks as assigned
Reporting
Timely submission of reports required by group and operating entities.
Periodical review with operating entities on project progress.
Financial integration into NSC
Support other growth project in Vietnam, Singapore: new internal / legal entities, acquisition integration, financial planning.

sections.text:
Eurofins Scientific through its subsidiaries is a world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences, and in agroscience Contract Research services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in genomics and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in BioPharma Contract Development and Manufacturing. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty esoteric and molecular clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA. With ca. 62,000 staff across a network of over 1,000 independent companies in 62 countries and operating over 900 laboratories, Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods for evaluating the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin and purity of biological substances and products, as well as for innovative clinical diagnostics. The objective of Eurofins companies is to provide their customers with high-quality services, accurate results on time and expert advice by their highly qualified staff.
Comprehensive services and unmatched expertise
Eurofins believes it is also a worldwide scientific leader in most of its fields of activity. Through research and development and acquisitions, the Group draws on the latest developments in the field of biotechnology and analytical chemistry to offer its clients unique analytical solutions and the most comprehensive range of testing methods.
A commitment to top quality
The Eurofins Group is committed to provide the highest quality services, accurate results in time and expert advice by its highly qualified staff. The reliability and accuracy of its data help customers make adequate decisions and meet their increasingly stringent quality and safety standards and the expanding demands of regulatory authorities around the world.
Permanent innovation and support by the market leader
Few testing laboratories can combine the level of expertise, technological leadership, attention to quality and customer service that have made Eurofins the global leader in many of the fields where it is active. Large investments in innovation, technology, IT and logistics and very large sample volumes ensure that customers enjoy high standards of quality at reasonable prices.
Eurofins started to provide the services in Vietnam since 2015. Comprehensive services and unmatched expertise

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
1. Quản lý đội nhóm
Phân công, giám sát và điều phối công việc của nhóm.
Đào tạo, hướng dẫn và phát triển năng lực nhân viên.
Đảm bảo tiến độ, chất lượng công việc và hiệu suất của nhóm.
2. Đánh giá kết quả kiểm nghiệm
Xem xét tính phù hợp của kết quả trước khi phát hành báo cáo.
Đánh giá các trường hợp đặc biệt và đưa ra quyết định chuyên môn.
Hướng dẫn nhóm áp dụng thống nhất các quyết định và quy định liên quan.
3. Xử lý vấn đề
Nội bộ
Là đầu mối trao đổi với các phòng ban liên quan.
Thống nhất quy định, cách xử lý và phổ biến đến các thành viên trong nhóm.
Bên ngoài
Trao đổi với khách hàng để làm rõ yêu cầu và giải quyết các vấn đề phát sinh.
Hỗ trợ xử lý khiếu nại và tư vấn chuyên môn cho khách hàng.
4. Tư vấn pháp luật và quy định
Cập nhật và áp dụng các quy định pháp luật liên quan.
Tư vấn danh mục chỉ tiêu kiểm nghiệm phù hợp.
Đánh giá sự phù hợp của kết quả theo quy định hiện hành và hỗ trợ giải đáp các vấn đề chuyên môn.
5. Hệ thống chất lượng (ISO 17025)
Am hiểu ISO/IEC 17025 hoặc các tiêu chuẩn tương đương.
Đảm bảo các hoạt động của nhóm tuân thủ yêu cầu chất lượng và quy trình công ty.
Tham gia duy trì, cải tiến hệ thống quản lý chất lượng.
6. Cải tiến
Phân tích nguyên nhân gốc rễ của các vấn đề phát sinh.
Đề xuất và triển khai các giải pháp cải tiến thông qua LEAN và các dự án cải tiến.
Nâng cao hiệu quả hoạt động, chất lượng dịch vụ và trải nghiệm khách hàng.
7. Công việc khác
Tham gia gặp gỡ khách hàng, đào tạo, hội thảo và các hoạt động chuyên môn theo phân công.
Thực hiện các nhiệm vụ khác theo yêu cầu của cấp trên.

Đánh giá sự phù hợp của kết quả theo quy định hiện hành và hỗ trợ giải đáp các vấn đề chuyên môn.
5. Hệ thống chất lượng (ISO 17025)
Am hiểu ISO/IEC 17025 hoặc các tiêu chuẩn tương đương.
Đảm bảo các hoạt động của nhóm tuân thủ yêu cầu chất lượng và quy trình công ty.
Tham gia duy trì, cải tiến hệ thống quản lý chất lượng.
6. Cải tiến
Phân tích nguyên nhân gốc rễ của các vấn đề phát sinh.
Đề xuất và triển khai các giải pháp cải tiến thông qua LEAN và các dự án cải tiến.
Nâng cao hiệu quả hoạt động, chất lượng dịch vụ và trải nghiệm khách hàng.
7. Công việc khác
Tham gia gặp gỡ khách hàng, đào tạo, hội thảo và các hoạt động chuyên môn theo phân công.
Thực hiện các nhiệm vụ khác theo yêu cầu của cấp trên.

- Tối thiểu 03 năm kinh nghiệm làm việc trong lĩnh vực tương đương, ưu tiên môi trường phòng thí nghiệm/bộ phận dịch vụ khách hàng ở các công ty kiểm nghiệm, công ty sản xuất thực phẩm.
- Tốt nghiệp Đại học trở lên các chuyên ngành liên quan đến Kiểm nghiệm thực phẩm, Hóa học, Công nghệ thực phẩm, Sinh học hoặc các ngành tương đương.
- Tiếng Anh tốt: kỹ năng nghe, nói, đọc, viết đáp ứng yêu cầu trao đổi với khách hàng nước ngoài; sử dụng tài liệu Quốc tế.
- Sử dụng tốt máy tính văn phòng , thành thạo Email, MS 365 và các công cụ Office .
- Có các kỹ năng mềm quan trọng :
Quản lý thời gian và lập kế hoạch công việc
Kỹ năng trình bày và báo cáo
Kỹ năng giao tiếp và phối hợp công việc
Kỹ năng phân tích, giải quyết vấn đề
- Có chứng chỉ hoặc kiến thức vững về ISO/IEC 17025 là lợi thế.

All your information will be kept confidential according to privacy policy.

Eurofins Scientific through its subsidiaries is a world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences, and in agroscience Contract Research services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in genomics and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in BioPharma Contract Development and Manufacturing. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty esoteric and molecular clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA. With over 65,000 staff across a network of independent companies in 57 countries and operating over 950 laboratories, Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods for evaluating the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin and purity of biological substances and products, as well as for innovative clinical diagnostics. The objective of Eurofins companies is to provide their customers with high-quality services, accurate results on time and expert advice by their highly qualified staff.
Comprehensive services and unmatched expertise
Eurofins believes it is also a worldwide scientific leader in most of its fields of activity. Through research and development and acquisitions, the Group draws on the latest developments in the field of biotechnology and analytical chemistry to offer its clients unique analytical solutions and the most comprehensive range of testing methods.
A commitment to top quality
The Eurofins Group is committed to provide the highest quality services, accurate results in time and expert advice by its highly qualified staff. The reliability and accuracy of its data help customers make adequate decisions and meet their increasingly stringent quality and safety standards and the expanding demands of regulatory authorities around the world.
Permanent innovation and support by the market leader
Few testing laboratories can combine the level of expertise, technological leadership, attention to quality and customer service that have made Eurofins the global leader in many of the fields where it is active. Large investments in innovation, technology, IT and logistics and very large sample volumes ensure that customers enjoy high standards of quality at reasonable prices.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
We are looking for a proactive and business-oriented Business Analyst to join Eurofins' Innovation team.
In this role, you will support digital transformation initiatives by working closely with Business, Laboratory Operations, and IT teams to analyze business processes, gather requirements, and implement solutions for internally developed laboratory systems.
You will contribute to global innovation projects such as chemST, chemIQ, and eLIMS , supporting Eurofins laboratories in Vietnam, Cambodia, Indonesia, and other assigned locations .
This role is ideal for experienced Eurofins Laboratory Technicians who are passionate about technology, process improvement, and digital transformation. You will leverage your laboratory expertise to bridge business needs with IT solutions, supporting the implementation and enhancement of Eurofins' internally developed laboratory systems.
Trách nhiệm chính (Main Responsibilities)
To bridge the gap between Business and IT by understanding operational needs, translating business requirements into functional specifications, and supporting the successful implementation of laboratory information system solutions.
Trách nhiệm chung (General Duties)
1. Business Analysis & Requirements Gathering
Work closely with Business, Laboratory Operations, and IT teams to understand business processes and operational requirements.
Gather, analyze, document, and validate business and functional requirements for innovation projects.
Prepare user requirements, functional specifications, and backlog items for development teams.
Ensure requirements are reviewed and approved by relevant stakeholders before implementation.
2. Solution Design & Project Coordination
Collaborate with IT teams and interfacing application owners to define system integration requirements.
Participate in solution discussions to ensure proposed designs meet business needs.
Support backlog refinement and clarify requirements throughout the development lifecycle.
Act as the primary contact between business users and development teams during project execution.
3. Testing & User Acceptance
Coordinate functional testing activities and verify that delivered solutions meet business requirements.
Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by working closely with business users and technical teams.
Ensure identified issues are properly documented, tracked, and resolved before Go-Live.
4. Change Request & Continuous Improvement
Serve as the first point of contact for change requests from key users.
Assess business impact, risks, and benefits of proposed changes.
Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to enhance business processes and system usability.
5. Documentation & User Support
Prepare functional documentation, user guides, and process documentation as required.
Support end users in understanding system functionality and business processes.
Contribute to knowledge sharing and documentation for innovation projects.
6. Other Responsibilities
Perform other duties assigned by the direct manager.

Minimum 3–5 years of experience as a Laboratory Technician within Eurofins is required.

Experience participating in system implementation, process improvement, or digital transformation initiatives is an advantage.
Previous experience working closely with cross-functional teams and supporting business process changes is preferred.

Polymer Science

Environmental Science
Other related Eurofins scientific or engineering disciplines

Excellent planning, organizational, and time management skills

Curiosity and open-mindedness

Working together with other team members to ensure high quality of delivered solutions
Ensuring good practices and high-quality standards are in place
Adaptable to work on new technologies and quick learnability

Knowledge of Agile process and principles is an advantage
Familiar with MS 365 applications (MS Office, PowerApps, SharePoint, etc.)

Power BI

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
1. Business Leadership & P&L Management
Own and drive P&L performance; achieve annual Net Sales and EBITA growth targets (Budget) and multi-year business plans.
Set and execute local business strategy aligned with Eurofins Asia Pacific direction; identify and develop new service lines, market segments, and revenue opportunities.
Prepare and propose annual budget and 3-year plan; report on any deviations to agreed results and work closely with financial controlling.
Increase profitability to meet best industry standards in all activities.
Lead cross-selling synergies with other Eurofins laboratories in the region.
2. Operations & Technical Oversight
Improve operational efficiency at laboratories; streamline operational processes and make good use of IT/LIMS to achieve high efficiency and productivity.
Support the development, implementation, and optimal use of the Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS); ensure its efficient usage at all levels to improve productivity, profitability, and quality.
Maintain high quality standards across all Eurofins ETM testing portfolio; maintain and expand annual quality accreditations (CAP/ISO 17025, VILAS, MoNRE and international standards as applicable).
Improve the technical and scientific aspects of the business units by ensuring the appropriate development and application of new techniques and business processes.
Oversee Health & Safety compliance and environmental regulatory requirements across all facilities.
3. Commercial Development & Client Relations
Support the sales process and ensure that relations with clients are good and efficient; attend meetings/audits with key clients at all levels and develop an in-depth knowledge of customer requirements through regular meetings.
Develop relationships with government bodies (MoNRE, DONRE, industrial zones), MNCs, and international organizations.
Develop the local strategy to grow the business and offer new services upon strategic opportunities; build brand awareness and market positioning for Eurofins ETM in Vietnam’s environmental services sector.
Monitor market trends, competitive landscape, and regulatory developments; maintain customer satisfaction, including internal customers.
4. People Leadership & Organization Building
Hire, motivate, develop, and retain excellent Leaders and employees; focus on developing and strengthening the next level of leaders.
Build and develop a high-performing leadership team aligned with Eurofins Leadership Charter; drive talent acquisition, retention, and succession planning.
Set up Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to monitor progress; follow up as appropriate and become hands-on if required to ensure achievement of goals.
Act as a role model for leadership and staff, aligned with Eurofins Leadership Charter; foster a positive work culture and ensure adoption of Eurofins core values throughout the organisation.
5. Group Integration & Governance
Guarantee and control that all relevant legal and Health & Safety requirements are abided by in the Business Unit(s) under direct or indirect responsibility; ensure accreditations are being maintained and regularly expanded.
Operate within Eurofins’ global governance framework: reporting, compliance, and ethical standards; actively participate in Eurofins Asia Pacific leadership network and group initiatives.
Ensure all legal, financial, and regulatory obligations in Vietnam are met.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Experience & Qualifications
Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Chemistry, Business Administration, Engineering, or other relevant disciplines.
10–15+ years of professional experience, including at least 5 years in senior leadership roles (e.g., General Manager, Managing Director, Country Head, Business Unit Head).
Proven experience leading organizations of 50+ employees within an MNC or international business environment.
Background in environmental testing, environmental consulting, compliance, industrial chemicals, water treatment, food safety testing, life sciences, industrial hygiene, technical consulting, or other related industries.
Strong understanding of business operations, P&L management, and working within a global matrix organization.
Knowledge of Vietnamese environmental regulations, testing standards, and experience working with government authorities (e.g., MoNRE, DONRE) is highly preferred. Candidates from adjacent industries with the ability to quickly develop environmental domain expertise are also encouraged to apply.
Vietnamese native with professional fluency in English (written and spoken).

sections.text:
Reporting / Accounting / Internal Controls:
Deliver monthly and quarterly reporting, intercompany reconciliation and supporting schedules/forms in time.
Finalize statutory audits latest by March. No material issues in reporting package.
Ensure invoices are paid in time, no backlog in handling invoices
Record expenses when incurred, ensure proper accruals; ensure proper revenue recognition with monthly WIP recording
Fixed Assets: prepare and initiate action plan to improve quality of information on fixed assets
Secure internal controls according to recommendations in KGD and maintain zero internal control incidents. Need to pay attention month closing procedures, make sure all steps are followed and documented.
Standardized accounting and reporting of costs within operating Business Unit (BU): ensure accounting and reporting in line with Group recommendations.
Implement group SCOA framework for acquisitions and adopt local management P&Ls to SCOA
Proactively support BU Managers (BUMA); quickly reply to questions / requests
Secure an adequate and timely reporting of quarterly overhead and support any further development of cost centers reporting
Cash management / Treasury
Manage the cash according to the Group recommendations as per KGD incl. no excess cash/deficits, not exceeding cash pool limits, no loans between operating companies, zero intercompany overdues, etc.
Secure adequate funding for each legal entity.
Organize / support the dunning/collection process to limit overdues.
Provide information/challenge BUMAs to improve NWC-management & achievement of target DSOs / NWC% as per budget.
Ensure DPO, DSO meet agreed targets.
Secure the payroll process, information and treatment is in line with the local requirements.
File all relevant documents for all legal entities in time.
Tax / Legal
File tax returns in time.
Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements.
Finance integration into NSC
Support other growth project in Vietnam, Singapore, Indonesia, Cambodia, Philippines: new internal / legal entities, acquisition integration, financial planning.

sections.text:
Quan trắc hiện trường: Nước, khí, đất, trầm tích, bùn, chất thải rắn,…
Phân tích môi trường các chỉ tiêu được phân công theo năng lực chuyên môn.
Tham gia các công việc khác được giao
Trách nhiệm chung (General duties) :
Soạn thảo hướng dẫn các công việc được phân công: phương pháp lấy mẫu hiện trường, hướng dẫn vận hành bảo trì, vệ sinh máy móc, thiết bị,…
Bảo trì, bảo quản và vệ sinh trang thiết bị hiện trường, dụng cụ phòng Phân tích được phân công hoặc có liên quan đến công việc thực hiện.
Thực hiện, duy trì và phát triển phòng Phân tích tuân thủ theo ISO/IEC 17025, VIMCERTS 052.
Giải trình và ghi chép các biểu mẫu quan trắc hiện trường và thiết bị theo quy định.
Đảm bảo an toàn và phòng cháy chữa cháy.
Trực tiếp nhận chỉ thị từ Ban Giám đốc, trưởng nhóm hiện trường, trưởng nhóm phân tích.
Báo cáo công việc thực hiện trực tiếp với trưởng nhóm hiện trường, trưởng nhóm phân tích.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Tư vấn lập các thủ tục môi trường cho các dự án như: / Consulting on establishing environmental procedures for projects such as:
Đánh giá tác động môi trường/ Environmental impact assessment
Giấy phép môi trường, đăng ký môi trường/ Environmental license, environmental registration
Báo cáo công tác bảo vệ môi trường/ Report on environmental protection work
Kế hoạch ứng phó sự cố môi trường/ Environmental incident response plan
Báo cáo kiểm kê khí nhà kính/ Greenhouse gas inventory report
Tư vấn lập báo cáo đầu tư, dự án đầu tư cho các dự án xử lý môi trường/ Consulting on preparing investment reports and investment projects for environmental treatment projects
Tư vấn lập thủ tục thẩm định công nghệ cho các dự án xử lý môi trường/ Consulting on establishing technology appraisal procedures for environmental treatment projects
Thực hiện các thủ tục môi trường và các thủ tục pháp lý khác liên quan cho khách hàng khi có yêu cầu/ Carry out environmental procedures and other related legal procedures for customers upon request
Thực hiện các công việc khác của Trung tâm theo sự phân công của Ban Giám đốc và người quản lý trực tiếp / Perform other Center tasks as assigned by the Board of Directors and direct managers
Trách nhiệm chung (General duties)
Tiến độ / Progress:
Hoàn thành công việc đúng tiến độ và kế hoạch đã cam kết với người quản lý/ Complete work on schedule and according to the plan committed to the manager;
Đảm bảo uy tín về chất lượng và tiến độ với khách hang/ Ensure reputation for quality and progress with customers.
Chất lượng công việc
Các thủ tục thực hiện theo đúng quy định của pháp luật hiện hành/ Procedures are carried out in accordance with current laws;
Khảo sát, thực địa, thu thập thông tin đầy đủ đáp ứng các yêu cầu thực hiện dự án/ Survey, fieldwork, and collect complete information to meet project implementation requirements;
Báo cáo, văn bản trình bày có cơ sở, logic, ngắn gọn, đầy đủ, chính xác, rõ ràng, mạch lạc theo mẫu quy định của nhà nước và theo đúng thông tin của khách hàng/ Reports and written presentations are well-founded, logical, concise, complete, accurate, clear, and coherent according to the state's prescribed form and according to the customer's information;
Cách thức trình bày báo cáo, powerpoint theo mẫu format chung của Trung tâm và phòng tư vấn/ Make reports and powerpoints according to the general format of the Center and consulting room;
Thông tin, số liệu sử dụng trung thực, đáng tin cậy/ Information and data used are honest and reliable
Không phạm sai lỗi chính tả, lỗi đánh máy/ Do not make any spelling or typing errors
Không phạm các lỗi do “Copy”/ Do not make mistakes due to “Copying”
Tư vấn thủ tục cho khách hàng theo đúng quy định, có cơ sở, dễ hiểu/ Advise customers on procedures according to regulations, well-founded, and easy to understand.
Trách nhiệm quản lý (nếu có) / Management duties (If any) : Quản lý dự án độc lập (khi được yêu cầu)/ Independent project management (when required)

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Kinh nghiệm (Experiences)
Ưu tiên có kinh nghiệm thực hiện tư vấn lập các thủ tục về môi trường tối thiểu 02 năm / A t least 02 year s of experience in consulting and establishing environmental procedures is a plus

Tốt nghiệp đại học trở lên, chuyên ngành công nghệ, kỹ thuật môi trường/ Graduated from university or higher, majoring in technology and environmental engineering.
Tốt nghiệp loại khá trở lên / Graduated with good grades or higher.
Trình độ ngoại ngữ (Foreign Languages Skills) : Có khả năng đọc, viết tiếng Anh, ưu tiên giao tiếp tốt/ Ability to read and write English, good communication is a plus
Khác (Others)
Kỹ năng giao tiếp tốt/ Good communication skills.
Có khả năng làm việc nhóm/ Teamwork skill
Sử dụng thành thạo vi tính văn phòng; Biết đọc bản vẽ, sử dụng thành thạo AutoCad; Kỹ năng sử dụng các phần mềm mô hình hoá cho lĩnh vực môi trường/ Proficient in using office computers; Know how to read drawings and use AutoCad fluently; Skills in using modeling software for the environmental field;
Cẩn thận, kiên nhẫn, siêng năng, ham học hỏi và trung thực trong công việc/ Careful, patient, diligent, eager to learn and honest in work.
Cập nhật, nắm bắt thông tin nhanh, chính xác các văn bản pháp luật mới/ Update and capture information quickly and accurately on new legal documents.
Khả năng xử lý tình huống nhanh nhẹn và hợp lý/ Ability to handle situations quickly and reasonably .
Yêu cầu sức khỏe tốt, sẵn sàng đi công tác khi có yêu cầu/ Requires good health, willing to go on business trips when required.

Eurofins Scientific through its subsidiaries is a world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences, and in agroscience Contract Research services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in genomics and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in BioPharma Contract Development and Manufacturing. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty esoteric and molecular clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA. With over 65,000 staff across a network of independent companies in 60 countries and operating over 950 laboratories, Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods for evaluating the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin and purity of biological substances and products, as well as for innovative clinical diagnostics. The objective of Eurofins companies is to provide their customers with high-quality services, accurate results on time and expert advice by their highly qualified staff.
Comprehensive services and unmatched expertise
Eurofins believes it is also a worldwide scientific leader in most of its fields of activity. Through research and development and acquisitions, the Group draws on the latest developments in the field of biotechnology and analytical chemistry to offer its clients unique analytical solutions and the most comprehensive range of testing methods.
A commitment to top quality
The Eurofins Group is committed to provide the highest quality services, accurate results in time and expert advice by its highly qualified staff. The reliability and accuracy of its data help customers make adequate decisions and meet their increasingly stringent quality and safety standards and the expanding demands of regulatory authorities around the world.
Permanent innovation and support by the market leader
Few testing laboratories can combine the level of expertise, technological leadership, attention to quality and customer service that have made Eurofins the global leader in many of the fields where it is active. Large investments in innovation, technology, IT and logistics and very large sample volumes ensure that customers enjoy high standards of quality at reasonable prices.

sections.text:
Hỗ trợ và điều phối các hoạt động kiểm định nhằm đảm bảo vận hành thông suốt và cung cấp dịch vụ đúng thời hạn cho khách hàng.
Trách nhiệm chung (General duties)
Thực hiện phát hành chứng thư kiểm định hằng ngày theo phân công.
Lập kế hoạch và đảm bảo chứng thư được phát hành đúng thời hạn theo yêu cầu của khách hàng.
Chịu trách nhiệm về tính chính xác và việc phát hành các chứng thư kiểm định.
Tham gia duy trì hệ thống quản lý chất lượng của bộ phận.
Tiếp nhận và xử lý các yêu cầu kiểm định từ khách hàng.
Phối hợp với các bộ phận liên quan (Kinh doanh, Phòng thí nghiệm, QA, v.v.) để xử lý các vấn đề phát sinh.
Trao đổi với khách hàng để xác nhận lịch trình và cập nhật thông tin khi cần thiết.
Nhận diện và đề xuất các cải tiến nhằm nâng cao hiệu quả vận hành.
Chuẩn bị báo cáo phân tích mẫu và gửi kết quả phân tích cho khách hàng.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Đảm bảo, vận hành phân tích vi sinh trong thực phẩm- thức ăn chăn nuôi và môi trường/ Microbiological analysis in food, feed and environment samples.
Trách nhiệm chung (General duties)
Hoàn thành tất cả công việc được giao trong ngày / Complete all of the routine tasks that have been allocated.
Đảm bảo chất lượng phân tích: chuẩn bị môi trường, hoá chất, thuốc thử, và mẫu thử nghiệm/ Ensure the production process: prepare media, chemical, reagents and samples
Phân tích mẫu theo quy trình và báo cáo kết quả/ Analyze samples according to the recorded protocols and record result

- Comply with safety regulations in the laboratory, such as lab coat, gloves, masks, goggles, safety
shoes.../ Tuân thủ các quy định về an toàn trong phòng thí nghiệm như áo khoác, găng tay, khẩu
trang, kính bảo hộ, giày bảo hộ...

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Ensure right-first-time test assignment for real samples per client protocols/manuals, coordinate sample login–logout on LIMS , maintain ironclad sample identification & custody, and collaborate across Lab/CS/Technical teams to deliver accurate, on-time testing—especially for Consumer Product Testing programs.
Responsibilities
1) Daily Operations
Receive real samples; assign tests per client request/protocol/manual and internal SOP.
Log-in / log-out samples in LIMS and maintain related trackers/files with full traceability.
Take sample photos , record details, code/label , and store samples per regulations to prevent confusion.
Conduct sampling/pick-up at HL/SL Divisions or external sites as assigned by supervisors.
Monitor lab capacity/TAT to propose feasible test plans and prioritization.
2) Technical Coordination & Clarification
Communicate with CS, Sales, Technical, and Laboratory sections to clarify test requests/programs (incl. FCM ), matrices, quantities, and special conditions.
Prepare assignment sheets/work orders; ensure completeness of information for execution.
Track job progress and support issue resolution to protect delivery commitments.
3) Quality, Data Integrity & Compliance
Maintain audit-ready records; comply with ISO/IEC 17025 and data integrity (ALCOA+).
Escalate deviations; support investigations and implement CAPA /preventive actions.
Contribute to continuous improvement (templates, checklists, system validations).
4) Safety & Housekeeping
Follow HSE rules, PPE usage, and safe handling/storage of samples & chemicals where applicable.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
2–4+ years in Test Assignment / Sample Login / Lab Coordination within TIC or testing labs.
Hands-on experience with Softline or Hardline test programs/workflows.
Proficiency with LIMS and Microsoft Excel ; strong attention to detail and organization.
English: at least basic reading/writing for SOPs, emails, and client documentation.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision; solid teamwork and communication.
Immediate availability or short notice is highly preferred .
Familiarity with Hardline/Softline/Toys standards and typical test programs;
Experience coordinating rush/priority jobs and balancing multi-lab capacities.
Experience with barcode/labeling systems or digital sample imaging.

14-16 leaves per year

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
1. GENERAL INFORMATION
Job Title: Environment, Health & Safety Supervisor / Team Leader
2. JOB PURPOSE
Responsible for developing, implementing, operating, and continuously improving the Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) management system, including chemical management, laboratory safety, fire prevention and protection, ESG, and legal compliance, to ensure safe, efficient, and sustainable operations across manufacturing, laboratories, and warehouse facilities.
3. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
3.1. EHS Management System
Develop the annual EHS strategy, objectives, and implementation plan.
Develop and update EHS policies, procedures, and standards.
Manage the EHS budget.
Prepare and report EHS KPIs to the Management Team.
3.2. Occupational Safety Management
Conduct hazard identification and risk assessments.
Manage Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), work at height, confined space entry, and hot work activities.
Ensure the safety management of machinery, robots, and thermal equipment.
Investigate occupational accidents and Near Miss incidents.
Implement Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) and Behavior-Based Safety (BBS) programs.
3.3. Chemical Management & Laboratory Safety
Manage the registration of new chemicals.
Conduct chemical risk assessments.
Control Safety Data Sheets (SDS), GHS classification, and chemical labeling.
Manage chemical inventory, usage, storage, and disposal.
Oversee Chemical Laboratory, Reliability Laboratory, Analytical Laboratory, and R&D Laboratory operations.
Monitor and maintain fume hoods, gas cabinets, and local exhaust ventilation systems.
Manage laboratory waste.
Develop Laboratory SOPs and conduct laboratory risk assessments.
3.4. Occupational Health Management
Coordinate pre-employment, periodic, and occupational disease health examinations.
Conduct workplace environmental monitoring.
Maintain employee health records.
Manage on-site medical clinic operations.
3.5. Environmental Management
Manage environmental permits and licenses.
Manage waste, wastewater treatment, and ensure compliance with environmental protection regulations.
Conduct periodic environmental monitoring.
Monitor wastewater, emissions, and noise levels.
3.6. Fire Safety & Emergency Response
Establish and manage the Emergency Response Team (ERT).
Develop fire prevention and firefighting plans.
Organize emergency drills.
Manage fire detection and firefighting systems.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
QUALIFICATION, REQUIREMENTS
Education
Bachelor's degree or above in Occupational Safety, Environmental Science, Chemistry, Engineering, or a related field.
Experience
Minimum 5 years of experience in Environment, Health & Safety (EHS).
Minimum 2 years of people management experience.
Experience in chemical management and laboratory safety.
Language
Good command of English.
KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)
Zero serious occupational accidents.
100% compliance with applicable legal and regulatory requirements.
100% compliance with chemical management requirements.
Completion of ≥95% of CAPA actions.
Customer audit/satisfaction score ≥95%.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
To in charge of technical daily operations and perform testing/ Chịu trách nhiệm về hoạt động kỹ thuật hàng ngày và thực hiện kiểm tra:
- Operate and maintain laboratory instruments in good working condition/ Vận hành và duy trì các thiết bị phòng thí nghiệm trong tình trạng hoạt động tốt.
- Conduct laboratory tests, experiments, and evaluate the data results as per project or research requirements/ Thực hiện các thí nghiệm, kiểm tra trong phòng thí nghiệm và đánh giá kết quả dữ liệu theo yêu cầu của dự án hoặc nghiên cứu.
- Willing to travel for business trips to the laboratory in Indonesia / Sẵn sàng đi công tác tại phòng lab tại Indonesia
Trách nhiệm chính (Main Responsibilities) – nêu chi tiết từng mục công việc (details of the job)
Trách nhiệm chung (General duties)
1. Daily Operation/ Vận hành hàng ngày:
· Chemical testing for textile and footwear industrial / Kiểm tra hóa học cho ngành dệt may và giày dép.
· Maintenance / calibration equipment such as GCMS, GCMS-HS, or LC-MS, LC-MSMS …/ Bảo trì / hiệu chuẩn thiết bị như GCMS, GCMS-HS, hay LC-MS, LC-MSMS, …
· Evaluate the data results/ Đánh giá kết quả dữ liệu.
· Maintain accurate records of laboratory activities, including experiment results and procedures/ Duy trì hồ sơ chính xác về các hoạt động phòng thí nghiệm, bao gồm kết quả thí nghiệm và quy trình thực hiện.
· Validation new test method for accreditation ISO 17025/ Xác nhận phương pháp thử nghiệm mới để đạt chứng nhận ISO 17025.
2. Technical Development/ Phát triển kỹ thuật:
· Develop new test method as management request/customers/ Phát triển phương pháp thử nghiệm mới theo yêu cầu của ban quản lý/khách hàng.
· Check the capacity of laboratories for new standards (standards, people, equipment). Update on new standards, new testing methods and new demands from customers/ Kiểm tra năng lực của các phòng thí nghiệm đối với các tiêu chuẩn mới (tiêu chuẩn, nhân lực, thiết bị). Cập nhật các tiêu chuẩn mới, phương pháp thử nghiệm mới và yêu cầu mới từ khách hàng.
· Any other duties assigned by Superior’s time to time/ Thực hiện các nhiệm vụ khác được cấp trên giao theo từng thời kỳ.
3. Collaboration/ Phối hợp hợp tác :
· Provide technical support to other team members and troubleshoot equipment or procedural issues/ Cung cấp hỗ trợ kỹ thuật cho các thành viên trong nhóm khác và khắc phục sự cố thiết bị hoặc vấn đề quy trình.
· Collaborate with other teams following sample login, test assignments, and issue report teams to ensure timely and accurate reporting of issues/ Hợp tác với các nhóm khác theo quy trình đăng nhập mẫu, phân công kiểm tra và nhóm báo cáo sự cố để đảm bảo việc báo cáo sự cố kịp thời và chính xác
4. Resource Management/ Quản lý nguồn lực:
· Assist with the preparation of technical reports and presentations for internal or external stakeholders/ Hỗ trợ chuẩn bị các báo cáo kỹ thuật và bài thuyết trình cho các bên liên quan nội bộ hoặc bên ngoài.
5. Quality Assurance/ Đảm bảo chất lượng:
· Ensure that all technical developments meet Eurofins' quality standards and regulatory requirements/ Đảm bảo tất cả các phát triển kỹ thuật đều đáp ứng tiêu chuẩn chất lượng và yêu cầu quy định của Eurofins.
· Implement and maintain robust quality control processes for technical innovations/ Triển khai và duy trì các quy trình kiểm soát chất lượng vững chắc cho các sáng kiến kỹ thuật.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Kinh nghiệm (Experiences)
· At least 3 year in testing lab, prefer in Oganic Chemical Lab technician position/ Ít nhất 3 năm kinh nghiệm mảng phòng thí nghiệm, ưu tiên ứng viên có kinh nghiệm ở vị trí tương đương.
· Strong knowledge of laboratory procedures, safety protocols, and equipment/ Kiến thức vững về quy trình phòng thí nghiệm, các giao thức an toàn và thiết bị.
· Familiarity with quality standards and regulatory requirements relevant to Eurofins' operations/ Quen thuộc với các tiêu chuẩn chất lượng và yêu cầu quy định liên quan đến hoạt động của Eurofins.
Trình độ học vấn, chuyên ngành (Education Background, Major)
· Bachelor’s degree in an analysis chemistry or in a relevant field/ Cử nhân ngành Hóa phân tích hoặc các ngành có liên quan
Trình độ ngoại ngữ (Foreign Languages Skills): English good in 4 skills/ Tiếng anh tốt 4 kĩ năng
Khác (Others)
· Ability to troubleshoot and maintain lab equipment/ Khả năng khắc phục sự cố và bảo trì thiết bị phòng thí nghiệm
· Ability to work independently with minimal supervision/ Khả năng làm việc độc lập với sự giám sát tối thiểu.
· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills/ Kỹ năng giao tiếp tốt.
· Strategic thinking and the ability to align technical development efforts with business objectives/ Tư duy chiến lược và khả năng điều chỉnh nỗ lực phát triển kỹ thuật với mục tiêu kinh doanh.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Eurofins Scientific through its subsidiaries is a world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences, and in agroscience Contract Research services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in genomics and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in BioPharma Contract Development and Manufacturing. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty esoteric and molecular clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA. With ca. 62,000 staff across a network of over 1,000 independent companies in 62 countries and operating over 900 laboratories, Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods for evaluating the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin and purity of biological substances and products, as well as for innovative clinical diagnostics. The objective of Eurofins companies is to provide their customers with high-quality services, accurate results on time and expert advice by their highly qualified staff.
Comprehensive services and unmatched expertise
Eurofins believes it is also a worldwide scientific leader in most of its fields of activity. Through research and development and acquisitions, the Group draws on the latest developments in the field of biotechnology and analytical chemistry to offer its clients unique analytical solutions and the most comprehensive range of testing methods.
A commitment to top quality
The Eurofins Group is committed to provide the highest quality services, accurate results in time and expert advice by its highly qualified staff. The reliability and accuracy of its data help customers make adequate decisions and meet their increasingly stringent quality and safety standards and the expanding demands of regulatory authorities around the world.
Permanent innovation and support by the market leader
Few testing laboratories can combine the level of expertise, technological leadership, attention to quality and customer service that have made Eurofins the global leader in many of the fields where it is active. Large investments in innovation, technology, IT and logistics and very large sample volumes ensure that customers enjoy high standards of quality at reasonable prices.
Eurofins started to provide the services in Vietnam since 2015. Our main services includes Food and Feed Testing, Consumer Product Testing, Environment Services, Agricultural sciences, Inspection and Audit, Certification, DNA testing, Genetic testing before prenancy, Covid test, HPV test, Decoding gen, etc. Current legal entities in Vietnam:
Eurofins Sac Ky Hai Dang
Eurofins Consumer Product Testing
Eurofins Assurance
Eurofins MTS
Eurofins Gentis
Eurofins ETM

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Thực hiện phát hành chứng thư kiểm định hằng ngày theo phân công.
Lập kế hoạch và đảm bảo chứng thư được phát hành đúng thời hạn theo yêu cầu của khách hàng.
Chịu trách nhiệm về tính chính xác và việc phát hành các chứng thư kiểm định.
Tham gia duy trì hệ thống quản lý chất lượng của bộ phận.
Tiếp nhận và xử lý các yêu cầu kiểm định từ khách hàng.
Phối hợp với các bộ phận liên quan (Kinh doanh, Phòng thí nghiệm, QA, v.v.) để xử lý các vấn đề phát sinh.
Trao đổi với khách hàng để xác nhận lịch trình và cập nhật thông tin khi cần thiết.
Nhận diện và đề xuất các cải tiến nhằm nâng cao hiệu quả vận hành.
Chuẩn bị báo cáo phân tích mẫu và gửi kết quả phân tích cho khách hàng.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Tốt nghiệp Cao đẳng hoặc Đại học chuyên ngành Công nghệ Thực phẩm, Kỹ thuật Hóa học, Công nghệ Sinh học hoặc các ngành liên quan.
Có ít nhất 01 năm kinh nghiệm ở vị trí Hành chính, Chăm sóc khách hàng hoặc Điều phối.
Kỹ năng tổ chức công việc và quản lý thời gian tốt.
Kỹ năng giao tiếp và phối hợp công việc hiệu quả.
Khả năng xử lý nhiều công việc cùng lúc và làm việc dưới áp lực cao.
Tỉ mỉ, cẩn thận và có tinh thần trách nhiệm cao.
Kỹ năng giải quyết vấn đề tốt.
Có khả năng sử dụng tiếng Anh tốt trong đọc hiểu và trao đổi qua email.
Thành thạo Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word).
Có khả năng làm việc với thời hạn gấp.

Lương thưởng & Ổn định tài chính

100% salary during probation

13th-month salary

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Eurofins Scientific through its subsidiaries is a world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences, and in agroscience Contract Research services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in genomics and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in BioPharma Contract Development and Manufacturing.
