With ca. 62,000 staff across a network of over 1,000 independent companies in 62 countries and operating over 900 laboratories, Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods for evaluating the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin and purity of biological substances and products, as well as for innovative clinical diagnostics. The objective of Eurofins companies is to provide their customers with high-quality services, accurate results on time and expert advice by their highly qualified staff.
Comprehensive services and unmatched expertise
Eurofins believes it is also a worldwide scientific leader in most of its fields of activity. Through research and development and acquisitions, the Group draws on the latest developments in the field of biotechnology and analytical chemistry to offer its clients unique analytical solutions and the most comprehensive range of testing methods.
A commitment to top quality
The Eurofins Group is committed to provide the highest quality services, accurate results in time and expert advice by its highly qualified staff. The reliability and accuracy of its data help customers make adequate decisions and meet their increasingly stringent quality and safety standards and the expanding demands of regulatory authorities around the world.
Permanent innovation and support by the market leader
Few testing laboratories can combine the level of expertise, technological leadership, attention to quality and customer service that have made Eurofins the global leader in many of the fields where it is active. Large investments in innovation, technology, IT and logistics and very large sample volumes ensure that customers enjoy high standards of quality at reasonable prices.
Eurofins started to provide the services in Vietnam since 2015. Our main services includes Food and Feed Testing, Consumer Product Testing, Environment Services, Agricultural sciences, Inspection and Audit, Certification, DNA testing, Genetic testing before prenancy, Covid test, HPV test, Decoding gen, etc. Current legal entities in Vietnam:

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Kỹ thuật viên phòng kiểm nghiệm sẽ chuẩn bị và/hoặc phân tích tất cả các mẫu môi trường theo hệ thống chất lượng, sử dụng các quy trình vận hành cụ thể, tôn trọng TAT (thời gian phân tích) và quyền riêng tư của khách hàng.
The laboratory technician will prepare and/or analyze all the environmental samples following quality system, using specific operational procedures, in the respect of TAT (time of analyses) and the privacy for customers.
Trách nhiệm chung (General duties):
Kiểm tra, giám sát và thúc đẩy quy trình kiểm nghiệm sản phẩm để đảm bảo kiểm nghiệm được thực hiện chính xác theo yêu cầu/ Testing, monitoring and urge product testing process to ensure the testing is done exactly as requested
Kiểm tra và giám sát tất cả các thiết bị trong phòng kiểm nghiệm Softlines/ Check and monitor of all instrument in Softlines lab
Đảm bảo phòng kiểm nghiệm cung cấp kết quả theo đúng lịch trình và theo thỏa thuận với khách hàng/ Ensures the laboratory delivers results as scheduled and as agreed with the client.
Chịu trách nhiệm về PT, các yêu cầu kiểm nghiệm tương quan nội bộ và bên ngoài/ Responsible for PT, internal and external correlation testing requirements.
Phát triển và xác nhận các phương pháp thử nghiệm, Quy trình vận hành tiêu chuẩn (SOP) và các tài liệu vận hành, an toàn và chất lượng khác khi cần/ Develops and validates test methods, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and other operating, safety and quality documents as needed.
Cập nhật các tiêu chuẩn mới, phương pháp kiểm nghiệm mới và nhu cầu mới từ khách hàng/ Update on new standards, new testing methods and new demands from customers
Cung cấp hỗ trợ kỹ thuật cho Marketing, Bán hàng, Dịch vụ khách hàng và khách hàng liên quan đến kiểm nghiệm, báo cáo hoặc các yêu cầu kỹ thuật/ Provides technical support to Marketing, Sales, Customer Service and clients regarding testing, reporting or technical inquiries.
Hỗ trợ duy trì hàng tồn kho vật tư tiêu hao và thiết bị phòng kiểm nghiệm cần thiết cho hoạt động hàng ngày của phòng kiểm nghiệm và lập danh sách vật tư cần đặt hàng khi cần/ Assists in keeping inventory of laboratory consumable and equipment necessary for the day to day functioning of the laboratory and in compiling list of supplies to be ordered when needed.
Trách nhiệm quản lý (nếu có) / Management duties (If any)

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Kinh nghiệm (Experiences): Có ít nhất 1 năm kinh nghiệm trong phòng kiểm nghiệm vải mềm về các chỉ tiêu Vật lý, Độ bền màu, Kích thước, Khả năng cháy, Hàm lượng sợi, Giày dép/At least 1 year experience in testing Softline lab as Physical, Colorfastness, Dimensional, Flammability, Fiber content, Footwear. Fresh graduate is acceptable.
Trình độ học vấn, chuyên ngành (Education Background, Major):
Bằng Cử nhân Hóa học /Bachelor’s Degree in Chemistry, Textile Engineering or any related degree
Quen thuộc với các yêu cầu của ISO 17025 /Familiar with ISO 17025 requirements
Trình độ ngoại ngữ (Foreign Languages Skills):
Tiếng Anh giao tiếp trình độ B hoặc tương đương /English Communication with B level or equivalent

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
The Technical Supervisor is part of the Technical & Quality Department and reports to the Technical Manager or relevant line manager.
The role is responsible for supervising the technical activities related to Hardline and reporting activities, ensuring alignment with internal procedures and applicable international standards.
The objectives of the Technical Supervisor are:
To ensure technical competency of inspectors and report reviewers
To Improve consistency and accuracy of inspection and reporting
To support compliance with international standards and client requirements
To strengthen training and knowledge sharing across teams
Mission
The mission of the Technical Supervisor is to ensure the technical competency, consistency, and quality of inspection and reporting activities across E&E products, DIY products, and hard goods, while supporting compliance with internal procedures and international standards.
1. Technical Competency Management
Monitor and assess the technical competency of QCs and report reviewers
Identify technical gaps and define improvement actions
Ensure inspection and reporting activities are aligned with internal SOPs and standards
Maintain and update technical guidelines and inspection protocols
Drive the standardization of inspection practices across teams
Support on-site trials for new customers and products as needed.
2. Training & Development
Develop and maintain training materials related to Hardline
Design and deliver training programs (on-site and remote)
Conduct regular technical training sessions and knowledge sharing
Evaluate training effectiveness and continuously improve training content
Support onboarding interview, training and qualification of new inspectors
3. Technical Support & Quality Assurance
Provide technical support and guidance on testing, inspection, and compliance issues
Ensure consistency and quality of inspection results and reports
Respond to internal technical inquiries from operational teams
Support investigation and resolution of technical issues or discrepancies
Participate in internal audits or cross-check activities as required
4. Inspection Booking Validation
Ensure proper validation of hardline inspection bookings, including the defining of necessary on-site tests.
Ensure inspectors understand and correctly apply inspection procedures and on-site testing methods., by co-operate with booking team.

Degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering or related discipline
Fluent in English Business

Experience in training, SOP development, or technical supervision is preferred

sections.text:
This job description file describes the mission, role, and responsibilities of the Technical Supervisor (E&E products, DIY products, and hard goods) in Eurofins CPA. The main purpose is to provide a clear understanding of the job scope for recruitment, performance management, and operational alignment.
A. Responsibility
This document is strictly confidential, and each recipient of one copy is responsible for maintaining its confidentiality. The Human Resources Manager oversees updates and external distribution of its content (e.g., recruitment partners).
B. Definition
The Technical Supervisor is part of the Technical & Quality Department and reports to the Technical Manager or relevant line manager.
The role is responsible for supervising the technical activities related to Electrical & Electronic (E&E) products, DIY products, and hard goods inspection and reporting activities, ensuring alignment with internal procedures and applicable international standards.
The objectives of the Technical Supervisor are:
· To ensure technical competency of inspectors and report reviewers
· To Improve consistency and accuracy of inspection and reporting
· To support compliance with international standards and client requirements
· To strengthen training and knowledge sharing across teams
C. Mission
The mission of the Technical Supervisor is to ensure the technical competency, consistency, and quality of inspection and reporting activities across E&E products, DIY products, and hard goods, while supporting compliance with internal procedures and international standards.
D. Mission scope
1. Technical Competency Management
The Technical Supervisor must:
Monitor and assess the technical competency of QCs and report reviewers
Identify technical gaps and define improvement actions
Ensure inspection and reporting activities are aligned with internal SOPs and standards
Maintain and update technical guidelines and inspection protocols
Drive the standardization of inspection practices across teams
Support on-site trials for new customers and products as needed.
2. Training & Development
The Technical Supervisor must:
Develop and maintain training materials related to E&E products, DIY products, and hard goods inspection.
Design and deliver training programs (on-site and remote)
Conduct regular technical training sessions and knowledge sharing
Evaluate training effectiveness and continuously improve training content
Support onboarding interview, training and qualification of new inspectors
3. Technical Support & Quality Assurance
The Technical Supervisor must:
Provide technical support and guidance on testing, inspection, and compliance issues
Ensure consistency and quality of inspection results and reports
Respond to internal technical inquiries from operational teams
Support investigation and resolution of technical issues or discrepancies
Participate in internal audits or cross-check activities as required
4. Inspection Booking Validation
The Technical Supervisor must:
· Ensure proper validation of hardline inspection bookings, including the defining of necessary on-site tests.
· Ensure inspectors understand and correctly apply inspection procedures and on-site testing methods., by co-operate with booking team.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering or related discipline
Fluent in English Business (4 skills Listent, speaking, reading, writing)
Minimum 5 years of experience in E&E testing, inspection, or certification
Familiarity with IEC/EN and/or UL/ANSI standards
Experience in training, SOP development, or technical supervision is preferred
Strong communication and problem-solving skills
Willingness to travel for on-site support

Chemical testing for textile and footwear industrial/ Kiểm tra hóa học cho ngành dệt may và giày dép.
Maintenance / calibration equipment such as ICP-OES, ICP-MS, UV-VIS, CIC …/ Bảo trì / hiệu chuẩn thiết bị như ICP-OES, ICP-MS, UV-VIS, CIC, …
Evaluate the data results/ Đánh giá kết quả dữ liệu.
Maintain accurate records of laboratory activities, including experiment results and procedures/ Duy trì hồ sơ chính xác về các hoạt động phòng thí nghiệm, bao gồm kết quả thí nghiệm và quy trình thực hiện.

Develop new test method as management request/customers/ Phát triển phương pháp thử nghiệm mới theo yêu cầu của ban quản lý/khách hàng.

Assist with the preparation of technical reports and presentations for internal or external stakeholders/ Hỗ trợ chuẩn bị các báo cáo kỹ thuật và bài thuyết trình cho các bên liên quan nội bộ hoặc bên ngoài.

Working location: Saigon Hitech Park, Thu Duc, HCMC
1. Reporting / Accounting / Internal Controls:
Prepare monthly, quarterly reporting, intercompany reconciliation and supporting schedules/forms in time.
Working with Finance Manager to finalize statutory audits latest by March.
Ensure invoices are paid in time, no backlog in handling invoices.
Ensure proper accruals; ensure proper revenue recognition with monthly WIP recording.
Fixed Assets: prepare and monitor information on fixed assets.
Prepare Month-end General ledger reconciliation, review Bank reconciliation prepared by Account Payable accountant.
Secure internal controls according to recommendations in KGD and maintain zero internal control incidents. Make sure all steps are followed and documented.
Standardized accounting and reporting of costs within operating Business Unit (BU): ensure accounting and reporting in line with Group recommendations.
Implement group SCOA framework for acquisitions and adopt local management P&Ls to SCOA
Proactively support BU Managers (BUMA); quickly reply to questions / requests
Prepare reporting of quarterly overhead and support any further development of cost centers reporting adequate and timely follow Group instruction.
2. Cash management / Treasury
Manage the cash according to the Group recommendations as per KGD incl. no excess cash/deficits, not exceeding cash pool limits, no loans between operating companies, zero intercompany overdue, etc.
Secure adequate funding for each legal entity. Prepare funding request to Group when necessary
3. Tax / Legal
File tax returns in time.
Ensure compliance with all regulatory requirements.
4. Budget
Working with Finance Manager prepare Budget for NWC/DSO/DPO and Cash flow preparation.
5. Integration process
Willingness attitude and support Finance Manager during integration process taking over new acquisition subsidiaries

Hỗ trợ duy trì hàng tồn kho vật tư tiêu hao và thiết bị phòng kiểm nghiệm cần thiết cho hoạt động hàng ngày của phòng kiểm nghiệm và lập danh sách vật tư cần đặt hàng khi cần.

Testing, monitoring and urge product testing process to ensure the testing is done exactly as requested
Check and monitor of all instrument in SL lab

Provides technical support to Marketing, Sales, Customer Service and clients regarding testing, reporting or technical inquiries.
Assists in keeping inventory of laboratory consumable and equipment necessary for the day to day functioning of the laboratory and in compiling list of supplies to be ordered when needed.

Kỹ thuật viên phòng kiểm nghiệm sẽ chuẩn bị và/hoặc phân tích tất cả các mẫu môi trường theo hệ thống chất lượng, sử dụng các quy trình vận hành cụ thể, tôn trọng TAT (thời gian phân tích) và quyền riêng tư của khách hàng.
The laboratory technician will prepare and/or analyze all the environmental samples following quality system, using specific operational procedures, in the respect of TAT (time of analyses) and the privacy for customers.
Trách nhiệm chung (General duties)
Kiểm tra, giám sát và thúc đẩy quy trình kiểm nghiệm sản phẩm để đảm bảo kiểm nghiệm được thực hiện chính xác theo yêu cầu
Kiểm tra và giám sát tất cả các thiết bị trong phòng thí nghiệm Softlines
Đảm bảo phòng kiểm nghiệm cung cấp kết quả theo đúng lịch trình và theo thỏa thuận với khách hàng.
Chịu trách nhiệm về PT, các yêu cầu kiểm nghiệm tương quan nội bộ và bên ngoài.
Phát triển và xác nhận các phương pháp kiểm nghiệm, Quy trình vận hành tiêu chuẩn (SOP) và các tài liệu vận hành, an toàn và chất lượng khác khi cần.
Cập nhật các tiêu chuẩn mới, phương pháp kiểm nghiệm mới và nhu cầu mới từ khách hàng
Cung cấp hỗ trợ kỹ thuật cho Marketing, Bán hàng, Dịch vụ khách hàng và khách hàng liên quan đến kiểm nghiệm, báo cáo hoặc các yêu cầu kỹ thuật.
Hỗ trợ duy trì hàng tồn kho vật tư tiêu hao và thiết bị phòng kiểm nghiệm cần thiết cho hoạt động hàng ngày của phòng kiểm nghiệm và lập danh sách vật tư cần đặt hàng khi cần.
General duties ( English version):
Testing, monitoring and urge product testing process to ensure the testing is done exactly as requested
Check and monitor of all instrument in SL lab
Ensures the laboratory delivers results as scheduled and as agreed with the client.
Responsible for PT, internal and external correlation testing requirements.
Develops and validates test methods, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and other operating, safety and quality documents as needed.
Update on new standards, new testing methods and new demands from customers
Provides technical support to Marketing, Sales, Customer Service and clients regarding testing, reporting or technical inquiries.
Assists in keeping inventory of laboratory consumable and equipment necessary for the day to day functioning of the laboratory and in compiling list of supplies to be ordered when needed.

Kinh nghiệm (Experiences)
Có ít nhất 3 năm kinh nghiệm trong phòng kiểm nghiệm Footwawre softline về các chỉ tiêu Vật lý, Độ bền màu, Kích thước, Khả năng cháy, Hàm lượng sợi, Giày dép . / At least 3-year experience in testing softline lab as Physical, Colorfastness, Dimensional, Flammability, Fiber content, Footwear.
Trình độ học vấn, chuyên ngành (Education Background, Major)
Bằng Cử nhân Hóa học/ Bachelor’s Degree in Chemistry
Quen thuộc với các yêu cầu của ISO 17025 / Familiar with ISO 17025 requirements
Trình độ ngoại ngữ (Foreign Languages Skills) Tiếng Anh giao tiếp tốt trình độ B hoặc tương đương / English Communication with B level or equivalent

Eurofins Scientific through its subsidiaries is a world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences, and in agroscience Contract Research services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in genomics and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in BioPharma Contract Development and Manufacturing. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty esoteric and molecular clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA. With over 65,000 staff across a network of independent companies in 60 countries and operating over 950 laboratories, Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods for evaluating the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin and purity of biological substances and products, as well as for innovative clinical diagnostics. The objective of Eurofins companies is to provide their customers with high-quality services, accurate results on time and expert advice by their highly qualified staff.
Comprehensive services and unmatched expertise
Eurofins believes it is also a worldwide scientific leader in most of its fields of activity. Through research and development and acquisitions, the Group draws on the latest developments in the field of biotechnology and analytical chemistry to offer its clients unique analytical solutions and the most comprehensive range of testing methods.
A commitment to top quality
The Eurofins Group is committed to provide the highest quality services, accurate results in time and expert advice by its highly qualified staff. The reliability and accuracy of its data help customers make adequate decisions and meet their increasingly stringent quality and safety standards and the expanding demands of regulatory authorities around the world.
Permanent innovation and support by the market leader
Few testing laboratories can combine the level of expertise, technological leadership, attention to quality and customer service that have made Eurofins the global leader in many of the fields where it is active. Large investments in innovation, technology, IT and logistics and very large sample volumes ensure that customers enjoy high standards of quality at reasonable prices.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
We are looking for a Lab Assistant to support sample preparation activities in the chemical testing laboratory.
This role is essential to ensure that samples are properly prepared, handled, and recorded before testing—directly contributing to the accuracy and reliability of test results .
Role Purpose
To perform sample preparation and handling tasks in compliance with laboratory procedures, ensuring all samples are processed accurately and ready for testing.
Key Responsibilities
1. Sample Preparation
Prepare samples for testing based on assigned methods, including: Cutting, scraping, weighing, and other preparation tasks
Ensure all sample preparation is performed accurately and in accordance with instructions
2. Sample Collection
Collect samples from: Hardlines (HL) and Softlines (SL) laboratories
Other locations as assigned by supervisors
3. Sample Management
Record, label, and code samples following laboratory procedures
Store samples properly to ensure traceability and avoid mix-ups
4. Laboratory Safety Compliance
Strictly follow all laboratory safety regulations, including: Wearing lab coat, gloves, mask, goggles, and safety shoes
Maintain a clean and safe working environment
5. Other Duties
Perform other tasks assigned by the direct supervisor

sections.text:
Experience
Minimum 6 months of experience in a similar role is preferred
Education
Diploma or Degree in Chemistry or related fields
Language
Basic English reading & writing skills (to follow instructions and documentation)
Other Requirements
Good physical health
Basic communication skills
Careful, responsible, and able to follow instructions precisely

Eurofins Scientific through its subsidiaries is a world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences, and in agroscience Contract Research services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in genomics and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in BioPharma Contract Development and Manufacturing. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty esoteric and molecular clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA. With ca. 62,000 staff across a network of over 1,000 independent companies in 62 countries and operating over 900 laboratories, Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods for evaluating the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin and purity of biological substances and products, as well as for innovative clinical diagnostics. The objective of Eurofins companies is to provide their customers with high-quality services, accurate results on time and expert advice by their highly qualified staff.
Comprehensive services and unmatched expertise
Eurofins believes it is also a worldwide scientific leader in most of its fields of activity. Through research and development and acquisitions, the Group draws on the latest developments in the field of biotechnology and analytical chemistry to offer its clients unique analytical solutions and the most comprehensive range of testing methods.
A commitment to top quality
The Eurofins Group is committed to provide the highest quality services, accurate results in time and expert advice by its highly qualified staff. The reliability and accuracy of its data help customers make adequate decisions and meet their increasingly stringent quality and safety standards and the expanding demands of regulatory authorities around the world.
Permanent innovation and support by the market leader
Few testing laboratories can combine the level of expertise, technological leadership, attention to quality and customer service that have made Eurofins the global leader in many of the fields where it is active. Large investments in innovation, technology, IT and logistics and very large sample volumes ensure that customers enjoy high standards of quality at reasonable prices.
Eurofins started to provide the services in Vietnam since 2015. Our main services includes Food and Feed Testing, Consumer Product Testing, Environment Services, Agricultural sciences, Inspection and Audit, Certification, DNA testing, Genetic testing before prenancy, Covid test, HPV test, Decoding gen, etc. Current legal entities in Vietnam:
Eurofins Sac Ky Hai Dang
Eurofins Consumer Product Testing
Eurofins Assurance
Eurofins MTS
Eurofins Gentis
Eurofins ETM

discovery:smartrecruiters:Eurofins:74400.description:
We are looking for a Lab Assistant to support sample preparation activities in the chemical testing laboratory.
This role is essential to ensure that samples are properly prepared, handled, and recorded before testing—directly contributing to the accuracy and reliability of test results .
Role Purpose
To perform sample preparation and handling tasks in compliance with laboratory procedures, ensuring all samples are processed accurately and ready for testing.
Key Responsibilities
1. Sample Preparation
Prepare samples for testing based on assigned methods, including: Cutting, scraping, weighing, and other preparation tasks
Ensure all sample preparation is performed accurately and in accordance with instructions
2. Sample Collection
Collect samples from: Hardlines (HL) and Softlines (SL) laboratories
Other locations as assigned by supervisors
3. Sample Management
Record, label, and code samples following laboratory procedures
Store samples properly to ensure traceability and avoid mix-ups
4. Laboratory Safety Compliance
Strictly follow all laboratory safety regulations, including: Wearing lab coat, gloves, mask, goggles, and safety shoes
Maintain a clean and safe working environment
5. Other Duties
Perform other tasks assigned by the direct supervisor

Experience
Minimum 6 months of experience in a similar role is preferred
Education
Diploma or Degree in Chemistry or related fields
Language
Basic English reading & writing skills (to follow instructions and documentation)
Other Requirements
Good physical health
Basic communication skills
Careful, responsible, and able to follow instructions precisely

Responsible for managing and supervising a team of typists to ensure accurate, timely, and high-quality preparation of laboratory reports, mainly for Chemistry and Softline departments. Plan and assign work to ensure reports are completed on time.
Chịu trách nhiệm quản lý và giám sát một nhóm nhân viên đánh máy để đảm bảo việc lập báo cáo thí nghiệm chính xác, kịp thời và chất lượng cao, chủ yếu cho các bộ phận Hóa học và May mặc. Lập kế hoạch và phân công công việc để đảm bảo báo cáo được hoàn thành đúng thời hạn.
Follow up the list of due date report with CS team/ Theo dõi danh sách báo cáo đến hạn phải trả cho khách hàng với các phòng ban liên quan.
Assign work to team members and manage deadlines. Phân công công việc cho các thành viên trong nhóm và quản lý thời hạn.
Oversee the typing and formatting of reports from raw data, and ELims system. Giám sát việc đánh máy và định dạng các báo cáo từ dữ liệu thô, và của hệ thống Elim.
Support complex or urgent report typing when required . Hỗ trợ soạn thảo các báo cáo phức tạp hoặc khẩn cấp khi cần thiết.
Supervise, train, and mentor a team of typists to maintain productivity and quality standards. Giám sát, đào tạo và hướng dẫn một nhóm nhân viên đánh máy để duy trì năng suất và tiêu chuẩn chất lượng.
Work with lab staff (SL/ AN) to confirm report details; Coordinate with QA and customer service teams regarding report corrections or client requests. Phối hợp với nhân viên phòng thí nghiệm (SL/ AN) để xác nhận chi tiết báo cáo; Phối hợp với nhóm QA và dịch vụ khách hàng về việc sửa lỗi báo cáo hoặc yêu cầu của khách hàng.

Báo cáo công việc thực hiện trực tiếp với trưởng nhóm hiện trường, trưởng nhóm phân tích.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Ensure right-first-time test assignment for real samples per client protocols/manuals, coordinate sample login–logout on LIMS , maintain ironclad sample identification & custody, and collaborate across Lab/CS/Technical teams to deliver accurate, on-time testing—especially for FCM (Food Contact Materials) programs.
Responsibilities
1) Daily Operations
Receive real samples; assign tests per client request/protocol/manual and internal SOP.
Log-in / log-out samples in LIMS and maintain related trackers/files with full traceability.
Take sample photos , record details, code/label , and store samples per regulations to prevent confusion.
Conduct sampling/pick-up at HL/SL Divisions or external sites as assigned by supervisors.
Monitor lab capacity/TAT to propose feasible test plans and prioritization.
2) Technical Coordination & Clarification
Communicate with CS, Sales, Technical, and Laboratory sections to clarify test requests/programs (incl. FCM ), matrices, quantities, and special conditions.
Prepare assignment sheets/work orders; ensure completeness of information for execution.
Track job progress and support issue resolution to protect delivery commitments.
3) Quality, Data Integrity & Compliance
Maintain audit-ready records; comply with ISO/IEC 17025 and data integrity (ALCOA+).
Escalate deviations; support investigations and implement CAPA /preventive actions.
Contribute to continuous improvement (templates, checklists, system validations).
4) Safety & Housekeeping
Follow HSE rules, PPE usage, and safe handling/storage of samples & chemicals where applicable.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
2–4+ years in Test Assignment / Sample Login / Lab Coordination within TIC or testing labs.
Hands-on experience with FCM ( Food Contact Materials ) test programs/workflows.
Proficiency with LIMS and Microsoft Excel ; strong attention to detail and organization.
English: at least basic reading/writing for SOPs, emails, and client documentation.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision; solid teamwork and communication.
Immediate availability or short notice is highly preferred .
Familiarity with Hardline/Softline/Toys standards and typical test programs;
Experience coordinating rush/priority jobs and balancing multi-lab capacities.
Experience with barcode/labeling systems or digital sample imaging.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
1. Daily operations
Testing, monitoring and urge product testing process to ensure the testing is done exactly as requested
Create Work Instruction, SOP, Form for new method, procedure of chemical lab
Ensures the laboratory delivers results as scheduled and as agreed with the client.
Responsible for PT, internal and external correlation testing requirements, ensure the result correctly
Trains Analysts on techniques and methods of analysis.
Develops and validates analytical methods, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and other operating, safety and quality documents as needed.
Update on new standards, new testing methods and new demands from customers
Provides technical support to Marketing, Sales, Customer Service and clients regarding testing, reporting or technical inquiries.
Assists in keeping inventory of laboratory chemicals and equipment necessary for the day to day functioning of the laboratory and in compiling list of supplies to be ordered when needed.
Yearly, prepare necessary documents, record, process for ISO 17025 audit and accreditation.
Check all information include test assignment, client’s requirement, protocol or manual, test result from lab, etc. to correct typed report before issuing to customer.
Communicate with relevant parties to clarify all information to show on report correctly.
Ensure to issue report on time.
2. Development new test method
Develop new test method as manager’s request.
3. Handling of equipment
Create Work Instruction for all instrument in Toys lab.
Properly monitoring the capacity of each equipment to ensure its not damaged
Check the status of all equipment to ensure its under maintenance and calibration schedule.
Monitoring the breakdown time of instrument and do corrective action.
4. Management duties
Manages the operations of Toys lab technicians
5. Others.
Any other duties assigned by the Lab Manager time to time.

Eurofins Scientific through its subsidiaries is a world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences, and in agroscience Contract Research services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in genomics and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in BioPharma Contract Development and Manufacturing. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty esoteric and molecular clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA. With over 65,000 staff across a network of independent companies in 60 countries and operating over 950 laboratories, Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods for evaluating the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin and purity of biological substances and products, as well as for innovative clinical diagnostics. The objective of Eurofins companies is to provide their customers with high-quality services, accurate results on time and expert advice by their highly qualified staff.
Comprehensive services and unmatched expertise
Eurofins believes it is also a worldwide scientific leader in most of its fields of activity. Through research and development and acquisitions, the Group draws on the latest developments in the field of biotechnology and analytical chemistry to offer its clients unique analytical solutions and the most comprehensive range of testing methods.
A commitment to top quality
The Eurofins Group is committed to provide the highest quality services, accurate results in time and expert advice by its highly qualified staff. The reliability and accuracy of its data help customers make adequate decisions and meet their increasingly stringent quality and safety standards and the expanding demands of regulatory authorities around the world.
Permanent innovation and support by the market leader
Few testing laboratories can combine the level of expertise, technological leadership, attention to quality and customer service that have made Eurofins the global leader in many of the fields where it is active. Large investments in innovation, technology, IT and logistics and very large sample volumes ensure that customers enjoy high standards of quality at reasonable prices.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
1. Support to CS team/ Hỗ trợ Bộ phận CS
Cross checking information between the received sample and TRF; taking samples’ photos and record information in internal system: Daily worksheet/ Elims/ Hỗ trợ CS team đối chiếu thông tin mãu nhận với phiếu đăng ký đính kèm, chụp hình mẫu và nhập các thông tin từ phiếu yêu cầu kiểm nghiệm hệ thống nội bộ (Daily Work sheet/ Elims).
Send daily report lists to all other department to ensure all reports are released to customer in time, avoid any missing report / Lập danh sách các báo cáo đến hạn phải gởi hàng ngày cho các bộ phận liên quan theo dõi, nhầm tránh thiếu xót
Create invoice template in Elims / Hổ trợ phát hành hóa đơn trên hệ thống Elims
Cooperate with CS team to support complete purchasing process from subcontractors/ suppliers in COUPA system / Hỗ trợ thực hiện các thao tác thanh toán liên quan đến nhà thầu phụ, nhà cung cấp trên hệ thống COUPA
2. Others/ Khác:
Receive and send final contract; returned sample by courier / Nhận và gởi hợp đồng, mẫu trả lại khách hàng.
Following up status of using stationery in CS team and arrange new purchasing when needed/ Theo dõi việc sử dụng và mua mới các loại văn phòng phẩm phục vụ cho công việc hàng ngày, hỗ trợ lưu trữ hồ sơ trong warehouse ngăn nắp, gọn gang.
3. Support others admin tasks related to LEAN/ 5S or Company’s general procedure.. when required/ Hỗ trợ các công việc admin khác liên quan đến LEAN/ 5S/ các qui trình chung của công ty nếu cần

sections.text:

Graduated from College / Tốt nghiệp Cao đẳng trở lên
English: Reading Document, Writing and Speaking – Basic level. / Tiếng Anh: Đọc hiểu tài liệu, viết và Nói – Cơ bản.
Work independent, team work and Microsoft office skill/ Làm việc độc lộc, làm việc nhóm và kỹ năng vi tính văn phòng
Good communication is in advantage/ Giao tiếp tốt là một lợi thế.

sections.text:
Hỗ trợ vận hành phòng thí nghiệm thông qua việc tiếp nhận và chuẩn bị mẫu thử, hỗ trợ kỹ thuật viên thực hiện các thử nghiệm cơ bản, quản lý thiết bị – vật tư tiêu hao, đảm bảo vệ sinh và an toàn phòng thí nghiệm. Thực hiện ghi chép, lưu trữ tài liệu, kiểm tra tình trạng máy móc và hỗ trợ đào tạo nhân viên mới nhằm duy trì hoạt động phòng thí nghiệm hiệu quả, chính xác và tuân thủ quy trình.
Trách nhiệm chung
Tiếp nhận mẫu thông qua hệ thống login và đảm bảo ghi nhận đầy đủ.
Chụp ảnh mẫu thử với chất lượng cao phục vụ báo cáo và lưu trữ.
Hỗ trợ Kỹ thuật viên trong việc thực hiện các thử nghiệm cơ bản.
Chuẩn bị mẫu thử, dụng cụ và thiết bị trước khi tiến hành thử nghiệm.
Đảm bảo vệ sinh, trật tự và tuân thủ các quy định an toàn trong phòng thí nghiệm.
Quản lý, vệ sinh và bảo dưỡng các dụng cụ, thiết bị thử nghiệm.
Theo dõi và quản lý vật tư tiêu hao trong phòng thí nghiệm.
Ghi chép, thu thập và sắp xếp tài liệu, hồ sơ thử nghiệm.
Kiểm tra tình trạng máy móc, thiết bị; phát hiện và báo cáo sự cố kịp thời.
Hướng dẫn và đào tạo nhân viên trợ lý phòng thí nghiệm mới.
Thực hiện các nhiệm vụ khác theo yêu cầu của quản lý.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Eurofins Scientific through its subsidiaries is a world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences, and in agroscience Contract Research services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in genomics and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in BioPharma Contract Development and Manufacturing. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty esoteric and molecular clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA. With over 65,000 staff across a network of independent companies in 60 countries and operating over 950 laboratories, Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods for evaluating the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin and purity of biological substances and products, as well as for innovative clinical diagnostics. The objective of Eurofins companies is to provide their customers with high-quality services, accurate results on time and expert advice by their highly qualified staff.
Comprehensive services and unmatched expertise
Eurofins believes it is also a worldwide scientific leader in most of its fields of activity. Through research and development and acquisitions, the Group draws on the latest developments in the field of biotechnology and analytical chemistry to offer its clients unique analytical solutions and the most comprehensive range of testing methods.
A commitment to top quality
The Eurofins Group is committed to provide the highest quality services, accurate results in time and expert advice by its highly qualified staff. The reliability and accuracy of its data help customers make adequate decisions and meet their increasingly stringent quality and safety standards and the expanding demands of regulatory authorities around the world.
Permanent innovation and support by the market leader
Few testing laboratories can combine the level of expertise, technological leadership, attention to quality and customer service that have made Eurofins the global leader in many of the fields where it is active. Large investments in innovation, technology, IT and logistics and very large sample volumes ensure that customers enjoy high standards of quality at reasonable prices.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
General duties
Receive and review inspection orders, SOPs, and instructions before conducting inspections.
Perform inspections, sample collection, container loading, and other services in accordance with SOPs, protocols, and client SOPs.
Keep the relevant Manager/Supervisor informed on a daily basis, or as required, regarding the progress of inspections, and report any issues identified during inspections.
Prepare accurate and detailed field inspection reports.
Train and coach new inspectors, if assigned.
Comply with the Eurofins CPA Code of Ethics, procedures, and related requirements as provided.
Perform other duties as assigned by the Manager/Supervisor.

Qualification: E&E University/College or related, knowing English or Chinese is an advantage.
Trình độ ngoại ngữ (English, Chinese) English level: Intermediate (Writing, Reading, Speaking)

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Work closely with stakeholders from different departments to gather, clarify, and manage business and functional requirements.
Translate business needs into clear functional specifications, user stories, process diagrams.
Evaluate business value, prioritize requirements and features based on business objectives.
Monitor, track, and validate new features after release; provide documentation and user training when necessary.
Support issue analysis, root cause investigation, and resolution related to the product ecosystem.
Define, track, and ensure the accuracy of business and operational metrics for stakeholders.
Aggregate data and create insightful reports and dashboards to support operational and strategic decision-making.
Perform additional tasks as assigned by management.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
2-4 years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role.
Solid problem-solving mindset with a holistic view of business operations.
Proven ability to analyze complex workflows and design scalable, efficient solutions.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
Knowledge in business process modeling using BPMN , flowchart diagrams , or equivalent standards.
Knowledge of system architecture and solution design; knowledge of SQL is a plus.
Proficiency in Excel and data analysis; experience with Power BI or other BI tools is a plus.
High adaptability with the ability to quickly learn new domains, products, and industries.

sections.text:
Trình độ học vấn, chuyên ngành (Education Background, Major): BA or above
Trình độ ngoại ngữ (Foreign Languages Skills): Proficiency in all four English skills is mandatory

The laboratory technician will prepare and/or analyze all the environmental samples following quality system, using specific operational procedures, in the respect of TAT (time of analyses) and the privacy for customers.
Key responsibilities:
Ensure the production process: prepare solutions, reagents and samples
Analyze samples according to the recorded protocols (use of complex equipment)
Perform first level maintenance actions on equipment
Study the results and enter them under the LIMS
Train, if necessary, trainees and other collaborators at technical or laboratory support positions
Report to the Team Leader any observed deficiencies in the equipment
Know and know how to use the system and the quality database as well as the documentation associated with its function
Participate (if possible) in the development and validation of analysis methods, in the quality approach (metrology for example) and in the evolution of the organization of work
Keep up to date the stocks of consumables, reagents and materials necessary for the proper functioning of the works
Observe the safety, hygiene and environment instructions
Maintain the confidentiality of tests / work as well as any customer data
Participate in collective storage and cleaning tasks
Ensure the respect of the wearing of individual protection equipment and the regulation of labor law

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Position Overview
We are seeking an experienced and visionary Senior Staff Engineer to join our General Purpose Microcontroller (MCU) Design and Architecture team. In this senior technical leadership role, you will lead the specification, RTL implementation, physical synthesis, and full-chip verification of next-generation MCU platforms integrating both RISC-V and ARM® Cortex®-M CPU cores.
You will drive the full lifecycle of the System Control Sub-system (SYSSS), CPU Sub-system (CPUSS), Peripheral IPs, IOTOP, and ChipTop design and verification, bridging architecture definitions with silicon implementation, advanced debugging, and technology verification.
Key Responsibilities
SYSSS, CPUSS, Peripheral IP, IOTOP & ChipTop Design & Verification (Full Flow):
Specification & Architecture: Translate high-level Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) into comprehensive Target & Detail Specifications for System Control Sub-system (SYSSS), CPU Sub-system (CPUSS), Peripheral IPs, IOTOP, and ChipTop modules.
RTL Implementation & Hand-off: Perform RTL coding (Verilog / SystemVerilog) for SYSSS, CPUSS, Peripheral IPs, IOTOP, and ChipTop. Author and deliver clear implementation instructions to MiddleEnd and BackEnd (Physical Design) teams.
Design Verification & Debugging: Create test plans and execute Unit-Level Verification (UT) and Chip-Level / Top-Level Verification (CT) using UVM and SystemVerilog environments. Lead root-cause debugging across IP, MCU, and SoC levels.
Physical Synthesis & Technology Verification: Run module-level physical synthesis and perform top-level technology checks, including High-Level DRC (HLDRC), Static Timing Analysis checks (STAchk), and Design-for-Testability checks (DFTchk) at SYSSS and ChipTop levels.
Architecture & Subsystem Integration:
Define and integrate MCU subsystems around RISC-V and ARM Cortex-M architectures.
Integrate key peripherals (WDT, INTC, IIC, SPI, ADC, etc.) and handle clock domain crossing (CDC) / asynchronous transfer designs across clock and reset boundaries.
Drive interconnect architecture based on AMBA bus protocols (AHB, APB, AXI).
Technical Expertise & Domain Knowledge
IP / MCU / SoC Debugging: Strong hands-on experience in IP, MCU, and SoC level development with expert-level debugging skills across front-end RTL, simulation, and post-synthesis environments.
Processor Cores & Peripherals: Deep understanding of RISC-V and ARM Cortex-M CPU architectures and common MCU peripherals (e.g., Watchdog Timers [WDT], Interrupt Controllers [INTC], I2C/IIC, SPI, ADC).
Bus Protocols & Interconnects: Thorough technical knowledge of AMBA protocols (AHB, APB, AXI, etc.).
Asynchronous Transfer & CDC: In-depth knowledge of Clock Domain Crossing (CDC) and Asynchronous Transfer Design techniques to prevent metastability in multi-clock MCU systems.
HDL & Programming Languages: High proficiency in industry-standard languages:
Hardware / Verification: Verilog, SVA, SystemVerilog, UVM
Embedded Software / Verification: C, C++
Scripting & Automation: Perl, Python
EDA Toolchains: Hands-on experience with industry-standard Cadence and Synopsys EDA tools, including:
Simulators & Debuggers: Xcellium, VCS, SimVision, Verdi
RTL Lint, CDC & Static Analysis: Spyglass, and related static check tools.
Synthesis and netlist check: Design compiler, Formality, STAcheck (PrimeTime), HLDRC, DFTcheck
Design & Verification Flow: Full-flow experience from PRD specification writing to RTL coding, UT/CT testbench creation, verification checklist, coverage.

Physical Synthesis & Technology Verification: Run module-level physical synthesis and perform top-level technology checks, including High-Level DRC (HLDRC), Static Timing Analysis checks (STAchk), and Design-for-Testability checks (DFTchk) at SYSSS and ChipTop levels.
Architecture & Subsystem Integration:
Define and integrate MCU subsystems around RISC-V and ARM Cortex-M architectures.
Integrate key peripherals (WDT, INTC, IIC, SPI, ADC, etc.) and handle clock domain crossing (CDC) / asynchronous transfer designs across clock and reset boundaries.
Drive interconnect architecture based on AMBA bus protocols (AHB, APB, AXI).
Technical Expertise & Domain Knowledge
IP / MCU / SoC Debugging: Strong hands-on experience in IP, MCU, and SoC level development with expert-level debugging skills across front-end RTL, simulation, and post-synthesis environments.
Processor Cores & Peripherals: Deep understanding of RISC-V and ARM Cortex-M CPU architectures and common MCU peripherals (e.g., Watchdog Timers [WDT], Interrupt Controllers [INTC], I2C/IIC, SPI, ADC).
Bus Protocols & Interconnects: Thorough technical knowledge of AMBA protocols (AHB, APB, AXI, etc.).
Asynchronous Transfer & CDC: In-depth knowledge of Clock Domain Crossing (CDC) and Asynchronous Transfer Design techniques to prevent metastability in multi-clock MCU systems.
HDL & Programming Languages: High proficiency in industry-standard languages:
Hardware / Verification: Verilog, SVA, SystemVerilog, UVM
Embedded Software / Verification: C, C++
Scripting & Automation: Perl, Python
EDA Toolchains: Hands-on experience with industry-standard Cadence and Synopsys EDA tools, including:
Simulators & Debuggers: Xcellium, VCS, SimVision, Verdi
RTL Lint, CDC & Static Analysis: Spyglass, and related static check tools.
Synthesis and netlist check: Design compiler, Formality, STAcheck (PrimeTime), HLDRC, DFTcheck
Design & Verification Flow: Full-flow experience from PRD specification writing to RTL coding, UT/CT testbench creation, verification checklist, coverage.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Role Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated Senior EDA Physical Design Engineer with 3 to 8 years of industry experience to develop, deploy, and support advanced physical implementation methodologies for semiconductor designs.
In this role, you will combine hands-on physical design expertise with EDA methodology development and customer-facing technical support. You will evaluate emerging EDA technologies, develop robust and scalable RTL-to-GDSII implementation flows, and help engineering teams achieve their performance, power, area, runtime, and quality objectives.
You will work in a collaborative, global environment with product engineering, EDA teams and EDA vendors. The position is suited to an engineer who enjoys solving challenging implementation problems, developing production-quality design flows, and helping engineering teams adopt effective physical design methodologies.
Key Responsibilities
Physical Design Implementation and Optimization
Perform and support physical implementation activities, including floorplanning, power planning, placement, clock tree synthesis, routing, post-route optimization, and signoff preparation.
Analyze and resolve complex issues related to timing closure, congestion, routing, power integrity, design-rule compliance, and implementation quality.
Evaluate quality-of-results trade-offs across timing, power, area, routability, runtime, and design robustness.
Support hierarchical and large-scale SoC implementation methodologies.
Collaborate with relevant teams to achieve physical signoff readiness.
Methodology Development and Deployment
Develop, validate, document, and deploy robust physical implementation methodologies and production-quality EDA flows.
Create reusable flow components, scripts, checks, reporting utilities, and automation infrastructure.
Standardize implementation procedures and reports to improve consistency across projects.
Validate methodology changes using representative designs, regression testing, and measurable quality-of-results criteria.
Support migration and adoption of new implementation platforms, including flow porting, validation, testing, and user onboarding.
Apply disciplined software engineering practices, including version control, modular design, testing, release management, and technical documentation.
Drive improvements in flow robustness, scalability, usability, runtime, and quality of results.
New Technology Evaluation and Proof of Concept
Research and evaluate new EDA tool functions, implementation technologies, and semiconductor design methodologies.
Define technical evaluation criteria and conduct proof-of-concept activities using representative designs.
Compare alternative tools and approaches based on quality of results, runtime, scalability, automation, usability, and integration requirements.
Identify technical limitations, deployment risks, and methodology improvement opportunities.
Document findings and present recommendations to engineering, product, and technical leadership teams.
Convert successful evaluations into repeatable, supportable, and production-ready methodologies.
Explore AI-assisted EDA capabilities and emerging automation technologies to improve engineering productivity and design outcomes.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Work closely with EDA R&D vendors, product engineering, and design teams to identify requirements and resolve implementation challenges.
Provide structured technical feedback to product and R&D teams based on project deployment and customer experience.
Collaborate across multiple sites and time zones to share best practices and maintain consistency across projects.
Participate in technical reviews, methodology planning, issue prioritization, and continuous-improvement initiatives.
Communicate technical risks, trade-offs, results, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Customer Engagement and Technical Support
Provide hands-on technical support to semiconductor customers and internal project teams adopting physical implementation methodologies and EDA flows.
Investigate, reproduce, debug, and resolve complex issues related to tools, scripts, constraints, implementation methodologies, and design quality.
Guide customers through flow setup, methodology adoption, optimization, and issue resolution.
Deliver technical presentations, demonstrations, training materials, and implementation recommendations.
Coordinate with product and R&D teams to escalate issues, communicate customer requirements, and track technical resolutions.
Build trusted technical relationships through responsiveness, ownership, sound engineering judgment, and clear communication.
Help ensure that deployed flows remain robust, scalable, and effective across multiple concurrent projects.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Education and Experience
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Microelectronics, Semiconductor Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
3 to 8 years of relevant industry experience in ASIC physical design, semiconductor implementation, EDA or CAD engineering, physical implementation methodology development, or EDA applications engineering.
Technical Expertise
Strong hands-on experience with synthesis, floorplanning, placement, clock tree synthesis, routing, timing closure, congestion mitigation, and power and area optimization.
Practical knowledge of RTL-to-GDSII implementation and physical signoff methodologies.
Experience with Synopsys Fusion Compiler, IC Compiler II, Cadence Innovus or equivalent physical design tools.
Strong understanding of static timing analysis, SDC constraints, clocking strategies, and setup and hold timing closure.
Experience optimizing performance, power, area, congestion, runtime, and overall quality of results.
Familiarity with hierarchical SoC implementation, low-power design concepts, physical verification, and EDA flow integration.
Debugging, Automation, and Problem Solving
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex tool, flow, constraint, and design issues.
Proficiency in scripting and automation using Tcl, Python, or shell scripting in a Linux or Unix environment.
Ability to develop maintainable, reusable, and well-documented flow infrastructure.
Experience interpreting implementation reports, log files, timing reports, congestion data, and quality-of-results metrics.
Ability to work independently, prioritize technical issues, and take ownership of deliverables through resolution.
Demonstrated ability to learn and apply new tools, technologies, and methodologies.
Communication and Collaboration
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
Ability to explain complex implementation issues, technical trade-offs, and recommendations clearly.
Experience working directly with customers, design teams, or EDA tool users.
Strong presentation skills and the ability to deliver technical demonstrations, training, and methodology guidance.
Ability to work effectively in a global, multi-site, and cross-functional engineering environment.
Collaborative working style, customer-support mindset, and commitment to high-quality technical delivery.
Preferred Skills
Advanced Tcl, Python, Perl, or shell scripting experience for EDA flow automation.
Hands-on experience with RTL-to-GDSII implementation and physically-aware synthesis.
Experience developing or optimizing integrated Synopsys Fusion Compiler flows covering synthesis, placement, clock tree synthesis, routing, and timing closure.
Knowledge of multi-mode, multi-corner analysis, advanced-node implementation challenges, and hierarchical SoC design.
Experience deploying or standardizing physical implementation methodologies across multiple projects.
Familiarity with AI-assisted EDA workflows, data-driven optimization, or emerging semiconductor design technologies.
Experience leading proof-of-concept activities or supporting globally distributed engineering teams.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Role Overview
The Sr. Staff Marketing Specialist the key driver of regional solution strategy, definition, and enablement for the Southeast Asia (SEA) and Australia & New Zealand (ANZ) regions. This role connects global solution strategies with regional market needs, ensuring differentiated, commercially compelling solutions that accelerate growth and maximize adoption of Renesas products across target industries.
The role requires strong cross‑functional leadership, market insight, and hands‑on execution across solution definition, Go‑to‑Market (GTM), competitive positioning, and performance measurement.
Key Responsibilities
Regional Solution Strategy & Portfolio Development
Own and drive regional solution strategy for SEA and ANZ, aligned with global solution direction.
Develop regionally differentiated solutions tailored to local market and customer requirements.
Identify high‑growth opportunities through TAM / SAM / SOM analysis and evaluate ROI for solution investments.
Solution Definition & Proposal Leadership
Lead regional solution proposal creation, working closely with Technology Application Architects (TAA) to define:
Solution block diagrams and system architectures
Technical specifications and feature sets
Clear unique selling points (USPs) aligned with customer value
Work with Renesas Sales (SAL) teams and TAA to create and own Solution Requirement Documents (SRD).
Ensure solutions maximize usage and value of Renesas products through collaboration with multiple Product Groups (PG).
Solution Development & Ecosystem Collaboration
Upon SRD approval, coordinate with System Solution Teams and/or external partners to execute solution development.
Ensure timely, high‑quality solution delivery aligned with both technical and commercial objectives.
Go‑to‑Market Execution & Channel Enablement
Drive regional GTM execution in alignment with global Solution Marketing strategies.
Develop compelling solution messaging, value propositions, application examples, and positioning.
Partner closely with Channel Marketing to support:
Mass‑market GTM initiatives
Distributor readiness programs (webinars, trainings, MARCOM campaigns, roadshows/caravans and incentives)
Competitive & Market Intelligence
Conduct competitive analysis for target Bills of Materials (BOMs) and competing system solutions.
Collect and synthesize customer feedback, competitor intelligence, and Product Group insights for continuous improvement of solution offerings.
Performance Measurement & Continuous Improvement
Track and measure solution impact, funnel progression, and direct/indirect influence (DI) using CRM and reporting tools.
Use data‑driven insights to refine solution strategies, GTM execution, and portfolio focus.
Key Stakeholders
Sales (SAL) Teams
Technology Application Architects (TAA)
Product Groups (PG)
System Solution Teams
Channel Marketing
External solution partners and distributors

sections.text:
Required
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field.
8+ years of experience in business development, marketing, solution marketing, or technical sales.
Strong understanding of Robotics, Industrial Automation, Building Automation, Energy, or broader embedded systems markets.
Proven ability to develop customer relationships and follow up leads in the field.
Demonstrated experience in solution positioning, GTM execution, and cross‑functional collaboration.
Strong strategic thinking, analytical, and communication skills.
Ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross‑functional, and multicultural environment.
Preferred
Experience working with channel partners and distributors in SEA and/or ANZ.
Exposure to semiconductor, system‑level, or solution‑based product portfolios.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Given the organic growth of our enterprise, we do have the need to establish a central pool of tools, with a standardized way of using them in development, to assure development excellence, a high standard of quality and reuse across our SW assets, and investment efficiency in SW Tools, particularly in the area of DevOps, for continuous integration & continuous delivery. - Work closely with SW development teams and manage the tooling that is part of our standard CI/CD fleet to be used in a managed fashion in order to maximize the business added value and the efficiency.
Principal Accountabilities:
_ Be the main point of contact regarding the DevOps tools.
- Administer and support the existing deployment of the DevOps tools: Bitbucket, Artifactory & Jenkins.
- Offer support to the user community with the DevOps tool usage, as well as organizing regular internal trainings.
- Maintain documentation related to the DevOps related processes and methods, and continuously improve it
- Monitor the usage, maintain, and continuously improve the tool deployment, the method to use it, and the tool architecture to maximize the performance of the tools and the added value.
_ Assess the DevOps tools usage by the teams, and actively pursue to onboard new teams in the tool, to take advantage of the existing opportunity
Key Performance Measures:
_ Tool uptime and performance of the service
- Scalable architecture of new tool, with a ‘state-of-the-art’ level of security
- Business needs are properly acknowledged, managed, and implemented.
- Regular training sessions for the new users of the service, and increased number of users of the tool.
- Ability and willingness to learn new skills over time which are required for the job.
- Integrate into the existing team and be a team player
Knowledge, Skills and Experience:
-Minimum 5 years of professional experience in tech. industry
- Expert knowledge in the SW Quality tools: Static Code Analysis tools, SW Composition Analysis tools.
- Processed Methods & Tools background would be an advantage.
- Experience with version control systems: GIT and SVN
- Scripting experience in Linux environments preferrable
- General experience in Linux administration
- Experience with Blackduck and/or Synopsys tools would be an advantage

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Qualifications
-Expert knowledge in the SW Quality toolchain.
- Deep understanding of the state-of-the-art SW development methodologies and best practices. - Bachelor’s or master’s degree with relevant background (Computer, IT, Science)
- Business fluent in English

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Job Summary:
Design and build Renesas's governed enterprise data platform on Azure Databricks, Unity Catalog, and Delta Lake.
A build-and-design role  work upstream with functional teams to shape how data is ingested, modelled, catalogued, and governed.
Blend hands-on data engineering with architecture thinking and SAP/manufacturing domain fluency.
Focus on long-term value: reusable data, consistent standards, and a catalog that scales cleanly
Responsibilities:
Design the data catalog with functional teams — domains, schemas, naming, and structure.
Align ingestion strategy per source (CDC vs. file-based; Fivetran / SAP Datasphere / ADF).
Model data to the platform's guiding principles and medallion flow (Landing → Bronze → Silver → Silver Final → Gold).
Build scalable ELT/ETL pipelines on Spark and Delta Lake.
Apply governance by design — Unity Catalog + Entra ID entitlements, group-based grants, standardization.
Handle PII correctly — tag at the edge, classify (Class A/B), mask downstream via ABAC.
Ensure data quality, performance, and security across pipelines.
Drive CI/CD and DevOps practices for pipelines and catalog objects.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to design reviews and architectural decisions.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Strong Spark, Delta Lake, and distributed processing skills.
Advanced SQL and Python.
Hands-on Databricks / Unity Catalog experience.
Solid ELT/ETL, data modelling, and orchestration background.
Working knowledge of catalog / medallion design, PII, and data governance.
Familiarity with SAP data (S/4HANA, Datasphere) and FI / CO / SD / MM / PP / GL domains.
Understanding of manufacturing / supply-chain business flow.
Experience with Oracle / SQL Server, CDC ingestion, and Git / Jira.
Awareness of data privacy regulation (GDPR, APPI).

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Design and implement PAD/PFC logic for SoC products, including pin multiplexing, boundary scan, test functions, and I/O control logic using in-house PAD design tools and methodologies.
Implement PAD logic based on design specifications, pinmux definitions, PAD-RTL/PAD-IO requirements, and integration guidelines.
Generate, integrate, and validate PAD logic using in-house tools (e.g., PGA, SCAAPII), ensuring consistency between specifications and generated design outputs.
Analyze and resolve design issues identified by RTL lint, CDC, synthesis, timing, and formal verification tools.
Develop automation scripts using Python and Tcl to improve design productivity and flow efficiency.
Review verification, formal verification, and signoff results to ensure design quality and completeness.
Collaborate with verification, DFT, STA, backend, and architecture teams throughout the design lifecycle.
Support PAD integration, signoff activities, and continuous improvement of PAD design methodologies and environments.
Job Requirement:
Strong RTL design experience using Verilog/SystemVerilog.
Understanding of digital design fundamentals, pin multiplexing, and I/O control logic.
Good Python scripting skills; Tcl knowledge is a plus.
Experience with SpyGlass Lint & CDC, synthesis (Genus/DC), and timing analysis tools (PrimeTime)
Knowledge of formal verification (JG-CONN/JG-CSV/JG-FPV) is an advantage.
Basic understanding of DFT, boundary scan, and backend implementation is a plus.
Strong self-learning capability and ability to work with in-house design tools.
Agile problem-solving, transparent communication, and strong collaboration skills.
Ownership mindset with a focus on design quality and continuous improvement.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Job Description
· Work as part of an established EDA team to maintain, support, and enhance a production RTL-to-Gates implementation, static verification, and signoff flow
· Provide hands-on support to global project teams (Europe, India, US) to ensure effective adoption and execution of the flow
· Develop, debug, and maintain flow infrastructure using industry-standard EDA tools (primarily Synopsys)
· Investigate and resolve user issues, ensuring robust, scalable, and production-quality flow operation across multiple concurrent projects
· Contribute to continuous improvement of flow capabilities, including:
o Automation enhancements
o Standardisation of reporting
o QoR, Power, and runtime optimisation
· Work closely with a highly experienced global team to deploy best practices and ensure consistency across projects
· Support flow migration activities to next-generation corporate implementation platform, including:
o Porting scripts and custom reporting
o Validation and testing of migrated flows
o Supporting user onboarding and transition
· Collaborate actively with EDA solution development, deployment, and support teams in Vietnam, contributing to a strong and growing Digital Backend capability
· Follow disciplined software engineering practices in flow development (version control, modularisation, documentation)
· Participate in cross-site coordination and continuous improvement initiatives to improve overall delivery quality and efficiency
Technical Experience:
• Practical experience with RTL-to-Gates implementation and signoff flows, including:
o Synthesis
o Static timing analysis
o Power Analysis
o Lint / CDC / RDC or related static checks
• Hands-on experience with Synopsys tools (preferred), or equivalent industry tools
• Strong scripting and automation skills (e.g., Tcl, Python, or Perl)
• Understanding of EDA flow integration, batch execution, and debugging methodologies
Methodology & Advanced Capability:
· Experience with constraint development and debugging, including:
o SDC creation and validation
o Timing constraint development
o Clock definition and clocking strategies
· Understanding of low-power design methodologies, including:
o UPF / CPF concepts
o Impact of power intent on implementation and signoff flows
· Familiarity with hierarchical and large-scale SoC design methodologies
· Experience analysing and optimising QoR trade-offs, including:
o Timing vs area vs power
o Trade-offs across implementation stages
General Skills:
• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to diagnose complex technical issues
• Comfortable working in a global, multi-site environment with cross-functional teams
• Good communication skills (written and verbal) and ability to support end users effectively
• Self-motivated with a “can-do” attitude and strong ownership of deliverables
• Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new tools, technologies, and methodologies

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science
• 3–8 years of experience in digital design, EDA/CAD, or implementation flow development

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Job Purpose & Dimensions
Given the organic growth of our enterprise, we do have the need to establish a central pool of tools, with a standardized way of using them in development, in order to assure development excellence, a high standard of quality and reuse across our SW assets, and investment efficiency in SW Tools, particularly in the area of open-source code security vulnerabilities, and code-quality risks derived from it.
Work closely with SW development teams who are using Polarion, 3DS, R4J and Jama tools, and manage the tool to be used in a managed fashion in order to provide business added value.
Principal Accountabilities
Maintain the requirements management tools in use (Polarion, 3DS, Jama, R4J) or other requirements management system on the existing infrastructure.
Understand business requirements for the usage of the requirements management tools in use, and be the referee regarding which tool fits better each use-case.
Design and develop custom-made solutions for traceability, implementation & test status reports in the requirements management tools in use, with respect to the business requirements from this category of tools.
Proactively advice & support the Renesas Engineers with usage of the requirements management tools and provide coaching regarding the best practices for requirements management.
Coach the reports creation and usage of the tools according best practices, tool performance and aSPICE compliance.
Offer online training for Engineering staff regarding the configuration & usage of the tools in target.
Understand & drive end-to-end architecture for optimal performance of the tools.
Be the gatekeeper for the requirements management tools with respect to corporate compliance to standard.
Explore technologies/solutions for continuous improvements; prime technical Interface for the vendor communication.
Integrate the requirements management tools with the rest of the development tools in order to implement the best DevOps practices and facilitate the data flow.
Key Performance Measures
Tool uptime and performance of the service
Scalable architecture of new tool, with a ‘state-of-the-art’ level of security
Business needs are properly acknowledged, managed and implemented.
Regular training sessions for the new users of the service, and increased number of users of the tool.
Ablility and willingness to learn new skills over time which are required for the job
Integrate into the existing team and be a team player

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering or related equivalent
Proven experience with Polarion, 3DS, Jama, DOORS, DOORS Next Gen, CodeBeamer, Requirements Yogy, R4J, TFS or other similar tools for requirements management or ALM / PLM systems – for both - usage and administration / configuration
Experience SQL, Javascript or similar technologies used in the landscape of tooling, used for building extension of the basic functionality of the tools in target.
Knowledge of aSPICE, ISO 26262, TISAX or similar standards can represent an advantage
Experience or knowledge in the following areas would be advantageous: automotive, tools and methods for software quality assurance, aSPICE, System test, development of safety critical systems, system or software architecture definition
Knowledge or experience with agile frameworks: Scrum, Kanban or XP.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Deep understanding of the state-of-the-art SW development methodologies and best practices.

Job Purpose & Dimensions:
We are looking for an engineer to maintain and enhance a design data management platform that supports product development, documentation, and engineering collaboration.
This role covers application development, platform operations, release support, user enablement, and integration with related engineering systems.
Principal Accountabilities:
Develop and maintain application features based on engineering and business requirements.
Support software releases, testing, deployment, and user communication.
Administer platform infrastructure, environments, and system performance.
Plan and execute system upgrades, migrations, and service improvements.
Implement monitoring, troubleshooting, and reliability practices.
Provide user support, training, and clear technical documentation.
Integrate the platform with other tools and services in the engineering environment.
Collaborate with stakeholders to prioritize improvements and support adoption.
Key Performance Measures:
Platform reliability, performance, and service availability.
Timely delivery of planned releases and improvements.
Successful execution of upgrades and migration activities.
Effective monitoring, issue resolution, and continuous improvement.
Positive user feedback and strong adoption of the platform.
Ability to learn new technologies and adapt to evolving needs.
Strong collaboration and contribution to team goals.
Knowledge, Skills and Experience:
Experience in full-stack application development on ASP.NET + IIS, C# & C++ programming languages and database-backed systems.
Strong database knowledge, including query development and performance tuning.
Experience with server administration and application hosting environments.
Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and deployment concepts.
Experience with monitoring, diagnostics, and incident response practices.
Proficiency in scripting and automation for operational tasks.
Understanding of release management, testing, and deployment workflows.
Knowledge of infrastructure, networking, and migration planning.
Familiarity with project tracking and Agile ways of working.
Comfortable working in cross-functional teams and iterative delivery models.
Interest in modern development tools and continuous improvement.
Knowledge of APIs and system integration patterns is a plus.
Experience in engineering, technical documentation, or data management domains is beneficial.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Solid understanding of modern software development practices and C#, C++ VB.NET or similar programming languages.
Bachelor or Master degree with relevant background (Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or related).
Minimum 3–5 years of professional experience in application development and/or infrastructure engineering.
Business fluent in English.
Key Relationships:
Partner with engineering users and stakeholders to gather needs and feedback.
Collaborate with product, infrastructure, and operations teams.
Work with technical specialists to support hosting and service reliability.
Engage with users to support adoption, training, and continuous improvement.
Coordinate across teams to balance service quality, priorities, and delivery.
Contribute to a collaborative and knowledge-sharing team culture.

This role is part of a Global Endpoint computing team, responsible for development, standardization, and management of the company’s global PC and mobile device infrastructure.
Manage and maintain a global co-managed Intune and Configuration Manager environment with of over 25,000 endpoints
Develop and perform software deployments and operating system configuration changes using various software development & automation techniques.
Provide direct 3rd line end user support for escalated PC and mobile device issues and needs.
Work with vendors as needed to resolve application or end user issues.
Identify improvements in existing functionality and recommend enhancements.
Manage and deliver project activities as part of the overall roadmap.
Be able to investigate issues under tight time constraints and be able prioritize work accordingly.
Be able to work with minimal supervision.
Write and maintain appropriate documentation
Key Performance Measures
The availability of the Microsoft Endpoint manager services to the business.
Delivering project goals to the required standard and on time.
Resolving personally assigned incident tickets promptly to the expected standard.

sections.text:

Bachelor or Master degree with relevant background (e/g Information Systems), or similar Proven track record of successful projects in the area of Microsoft Endpoint management
5 years’ experience supporting Windows client OS with minimum of 2 years supporting Windows 10/ 11
5 years’ experience developing, implementing, and administrating Microsoft Configuration Manager / MECM and Intune
Good understanding of where endpoint management fits into wider IT and reliant \ dependent technologies (AD, GPO, Entra, Networking etc…)
Endpoint management Certified preferred.
Proficiency in PowerShell scripting.
Problem solving skills coupled with a strong customer focus.
Excellent communication both written and verbal.
