sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Ninja Van is a tech-enabled logistics company on a mission to provide hassle-free delivery services for businesses of all sizes across Southeast Asia. Launched in 2014, we started operations in Singapore and have become the region's largest and fastest growing last-mile logistics company, partnering with over 35,000 merchants and delivering more than 1,000 parcels every minute across six countries.
At our core, we are a technology company that is disrupting a massive industry with cutting-edge software and operational concepts. Powered by algorithm-based optimisation, dynamic routing, end-to-end tracking and a data-driven approach, we provide best-of-class delivery services that delight both the shippers and end customers. But we are just getting started! We have much room for improvement and many ideas that will further shape the industry.

sections.title: Responsibilities:
sections.text:
• Recruitment :
Coordinate with hiring managers to identify staffing needs, determine selection criteria, plan interview and selection procedures, including screening calls, assessments and in-person interviews.
Prepares offer letters, probation contracts & prepare for on-boarding of employment for prospective candidates.
Support other departments to post & hire both blue-collar and white collar workers.
Perform full-life cycle of the recruitment process.
Obtain and assess reference checks of the candidates.
• Employer Branding:
Leading employer branding initiatives on social networks.
Expanding the source of candidates in the recruitment area through online and offline channels.
Connect and create close relationships with school units, mass organizations (Women's Union, youth union, ward agency, friend committee, police, ...), and job introduction centers, ... at the area in charge).
Collaborate with teams to develop online channels (Facebook, Zalo, Recruitment Website, ...).
Searching for new recruitment offline channels to develop regional candidate sources.

sections.title: Requirement:
sections.text:
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum 3 years of experience in Talent Acquisition or Recruitment.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and networking skills.
Proven experience in end-to-end recruitment, including sourcing, selection, and onboarding.
Familiarity with LinkedIn, ATS platforms (e.g., Lever), and recruitment channels.
Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and organizational skills.
Good understanding of recruitment compliance and employment practices.
Good command of English.

sections.title: Benefit:
sections.text:
• Working Location : Ninja Van Vietnam Office, Ho Chi Minh city.
• Salary and benefits:
Competitive salary package.
Tet bonus and performance review.
Full social insurance contribution based on gross salary.
12 days of annual leave and 5 days of paid sick leave.
Health insurance coverage.
Year-End Party.
Attractive team-building activities and regular employee engagement programs.
Company laptop provided.
• Training and developing:
Opportunities to participate in internal training programs (online and offline).
Clear career progression opportunities to Senior, Team Leader, Manager, and beyond.
• Work environment & colleagues:
Open-minded and supportive leaders who encourage personal and professional growth.
Young, dynamic, and collaborative working environment.

sections.title: Responsibilities:
sections.text:
• Pipeline Development & New Account Origination:
Personally prospect, qualify and develop new B2B contract logistics and contract transportation accounts, owning the full sales cycle through to signed contract.
Focus on South Vietnam, while pursuing cross-region, South-to-North and other nationwide opportunities as they arise.
Sell to operational decision-makers at brand owners and at the operators and 3PLs managing their distribution, while opening direct entry points to the brands behind operators we already serve.
Target segments where customers value operational capability, including industrial, building systems, HVAC, MRO, FMCG and consumer distribution.
• Commercial Proposition & Deal Structuring:
Diagnose customer operational requirements and translate them into commercially structured proposals.
Capture key operational and cost drivers, including delivery points, vehicle requirements and site conditions, before pricing.
Work with Operations and Vendor Management to scope feasible solutions and define SLA commitments before presenting to customers.
Lead formal tenders, RFQs and e-sourcing responses, including multi-country enterprise opportunities.
Build pricing from verified vendor costs and structure contracts to protect margin.
• Account Revenue Plan & Growth:
Develop monthly revenue plans for accounts and manage performance against plan.
Grow existing accounts through additional lanes, services, higher-value opportunities and warehousing where appropriate.
Ensure effective BD-to-Operations handover, including solution sign-off and complete workflow and SLA requirements.
Stay close to newly won accounts and address operational issues before they become commercial issues.
• Commercial Strategy & Market Intelligence:
Own segment and account prioritisation for the unit, including where to hunt, where to invest in solutions and when to walk away from opportunities.
Work with Finance and Operations on pricing guardrails and make commercial decisions within the approved mandate.
Report weekly on prospects, competitors, vendor-side capacity and demand signals.
Flag accounts where requirement complexity and process integration create material switching cost.
Define the repeatable deal archetype as the pipeline matures
• Team Leadership & BD Development:
Directly manage 2 Business Development Managers and support recruitment and ramp-up as the team grows.
Set weekly targets, review pipeline and coach the team on opportunity qualification, operational assessment and commercial structuring.
Ensure the team focuses on the right segments and buyer profiles, with accurate CRM, pipeline and forecast management.

sections.title: Requirements:
sections.text:
Experience & Skills Required:
7+ years of B2B sales experience in contract logistics, contract transportation, 3PL or related logistics solutions in Vietnam, with a proven track record of winning new business.
2+ years of experience managing and developing Business Development or Sales teams with revenue targets.
Proven experience selling to operational decision-makers across brand owners, operators and 3PLs, with hands-on experience in RFQs and tenders.
Experience in industrial, HVAC, MRO, FMCG or consumer distribution is highly preferred.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to understand cost structures, build pricing and protect margins.
Experience working with third-party vendors/carrier networks and assessing operational feasibility.
Bachelor's degree or higher in Business, Logistics, Supply Chain or a related field.
English – business proficiency required; Vietnamese – native.
Core Competencies:
Hunter mindset: Strong new-business development and pipeline-building capability.
Operational & commercial judgment: Able to translate customer requirements into viable solutions and make sound commercial decisions.
Leadership: Able to set targets, coach BDMs and drive accountability for pipeline and revenue.
Adaptability: Comfortable working in a growing business where processes and commercial playbooks continue to evolve.

sections.text: Lalamove Vietnam are hiring a Public Relations & Communications Associate in HCMC to drive our brand presence. If you have 2+ years of Content/PR experience and strong English skills, we’d love to connect!

sections.title: What you’ll do
sections.text:
Content (50%)
Conduct thorough keyword research and competitive analysis to enhance SEO performance. Optimize website content for on-page and off-page SEO factors to improve organic search rankings.
Develop and implement an effective content strategy to improve search engine rankings, and support overall business goals.
Weekly/ Monthly produce SEO-optimized content (including blog posts, articles, landing pages, etc.) to increase organic traffic and website performance.
Regularly monitor and analyze content performance using tools like Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and SEO software (e.g., SEMrush, Ahrefs).
Communication (50%)
Develop and edit media pitches, news releases, speeches, articles, interviews and other editorial collateral to garner positive media coverage.
Manage and handle sensitive public issues and prevent reputational risk to the company's brand and image.
Nurture current media relations as well as identify new potential media relations, including managing media interactions and follow-ups.
Plan and execute press conferences, media briefings, and other PR events to promote the company’s initiatives and products.
Execute Communication plans to maximize brand awareness, such as Seeding, KOL, KOC and social community.
Develop and implement PR & Communications plans, riding on various channels aligned with the overall marketing strategy.
Manage and monitor PR & Communications plans to report performance and propose enhancements.
Responsible for budgeting and planning in PR & Communications strategies.

sections.text:
About Lalamove
Lalamove is disrupting the logistics industry by connecting customers and drivers directly through our technology. We offer customers a lightning fast and convenient way to book delivery and moving services whether they are at their home, at work or on the go. People talk about O2O, we live it!
At Lalamove, we strongly believe in the power of community. Millions of drivers and customers use our technology every day to connect with one another and move things that matter. Delivery is what we do best and we ensure it is always fast and simple. Since 2013, we have tackled the logistics industry head on to find the most innovative solutions for the world’s delivery needs. Our vision is to bring communities closer and make city life easier by allowing fast and convenient circulation of goods. We realize this vision with a ‘glocal’ approach, building a robust operations team to adapt our product to local networks of businesses and delivery contractors. At the same time, we have ambition to build an international brand by establishing an even more global presence.

sections.title: What you’ll do
sections.text:
Employee Records, Documents and HR Documentation Management
Receive, verify, monitor, and follow up with employees to ensure all required personnel documents and records are fully provided for completion of employee files.
Manage, update, and maintain all employee records in both hard-copy and electronic (scanned) formats, including onboarding documents, dependent documents, insurance records, documents arising during employment, termination documents, and other relevant HR documents.
Ensure all records are properly categorized, organized, named, updated, and maintained in accordance with standardized requirements.
Ensure all records are securely and confidentially managed and maintained, and that access, use, and retrieval of records are carried out in accordance with authorized access rights and Company policies.
Employee Data Management
Receive and verify the completeness, accuracy, and validity of employee data before updating it in the HR system/ software.
Check, update, and adjust employee information upon any changes, ensuring all data modifications are strictly based on hard-copy documents, relevant records and required company approvals.
Conduct periodic audits and reconciliations of employee data between the HR system/ software and actual employee records to ensure that employee data is fully updated, accurate, consistent, and timely.
Execute data standardization projects within the assigned scope of responsibility.
Timekeeping:
Follow up and track employees' working hours, daily timekeeping, and annual leave applications.
Check, reconcile, and validate attendance data, work schedules, time off, and other relevant information to identify and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner before finalizing monthly attendance records.
Manage and control the periodic attendance finalization process, including monitoring deadlines, performing required checks, and coordinating with relevant stakeholders to ensure that attendance records are finalized accurately and on time.
Review and reconcile overtime records, ensuring that overtime hours are fully recorded and consistent with actual working time, registration/approval records, and Company policies.
Prepare and maintain relevant reports as required.
PIT (Personal Income Tax)
Collect and proceed documents for PIT tax code registration/adjustment and employee dependent registration/adjustment.
Prepare income confirmation documents and Certificate PIT Withholding.
Receive, review, and reconcile information and documentation related to employees’ tax finalization authorization.
Manage and maintain relevant records and documentation.
Labor Contracts and Appendix:
Track and follow up on labor contracts, including first sign, renewals, and appendix signing.
Notify departments of employees whose contracts are expiring and provide evaluation forms.
Provide guidance and follow up with employees and relevant departments to ensure that labor contract evaluation and renewal procedures are completed in a timely manner.
Collect evaluation forms, scan, and upload files to the C&B shared folders.
Cross-check labor contracts before distributing them to employees.
Manage, categorize, and maintain all labor contracts and annex labor contracts in both hard-copy and scanned electronic formats.
Prepare employment termination documents and appendix of settlement if necessary.
Employee Administrative Management
Manage consolidation payments such as SHUI (Social Health Insurance), Trade Union.
Print termination decisions and settlements, submit them for approval and company stamp.
Receive and store paper documents related to termination and settlement.
Receive and deliver forms and documents to HR, uploading scanned files to the shared services team.
Provide guidance to employees on the termination procedures, handover procedures, and relevant forms.
Draft and prepare notifications, memo, forms, and other relevant documents as required.
Insurance
Perform and proceed procedures related to Social Insurance, Health Insurance, Unemployment Insurance, and Occupational Accident and Occupational Disease Insurance for employees.
Proceed and handle employee insurance benefit claims and related documentation.
Ensure that insurance-related procedures and documentation for employees are completed within the required timelines and in accordance with applicable regulations.
Receive, maintain, and manage insurance records and data, ensuring completeness and accuracy.
Offer guidance and advise employees on relevant insurance policies and procedures.
Compare insurance schemes and programs.
Act as the key contact for benefits schemes and consulting.
Reports: Prepare monthly/periodic internal payroll reports, cost reports, PIT reports, and other statutory reports for relevant authorities.
Other Responsibilities
Support POPS Manager in implementing C&B policies, reward and recognition programs, loyalty schemes, healthcare packages, disciplinary actions, etc.
Assist POPS Managers in implementing team projects and initiatives, including salary surveys, annual salary reviews, performance evaluations, promotion programs, etc.
Others: Ad-hocs tasks/ works assigned by Line Manager.

sections.title: What we seek
sections.text:
Hardworking, flexible & organized skills. Interested in C&B Admin tasks .
Reliable, Independent, Considerate & Self-motivated personality.
Proactiveness and ability to handle potential people issues.
Strong communicator with the ability to be responsive and share feedback to employees when needed.
True warrior with hands-on experience and willing to create new milestones with our People Operations Team.
Ability to work independently and work as a team in some HR new initiatives' projects.
Excellent attention to detail, reliable and well organized.
Ability to exercise discretion at all times is essential.
Very energetic and passionate to engage everyone into company activities.

sections.title: What you’ll need
sections.text:
University graduate in any related fields
At least 1 year of experience working in Human Resources, C&B…, preferably in a logistics/e-commerce fulfillment environment
Hands-on experience in managing employee files/documents and executing core C&B tasks (Employment Contracts, Social Insurance, and Timekeeping/Attendance).
Good knowledge of labor law, PIT, SHUI practices and other related regulations
Expert user of MS Office (Word, Excel)
Good at communication, numerical reasoning & logical thinking
Careful, result-oriented. Calm under pressure.
High ability to work well under high pressure in meeting targets & deadlines

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Ataccama is the agentic data trust company. Organizations worldwide rely on Ataccama ONE, the agentic data trust platform, to ensure data is accurate, accessible, and trusted for every decision and system. Powered by the ONE AI Agent, Ataccama ONE brings autonomy to data quality and governance, continuously monitoring, improving, and explaining the reliability of data across complex enterprise and multi-agent environments. At the core of the platform is Ataccama’s market-leading data quality, with modules built around it to unify data quality monitoring, catalog, lineage, observability, and reference data management, ensuring data is consistent and explainable. This quality-first foundation makes data the engine of trust, powering AI, analytics, and operations with confidence.
Recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Augmented Data Quality and positioned furthest in Completeness of Vision , Ataccama continues to set the standard for enterprise-grade data trust.
Our people are located across the globe. They succeed by collaborating as a team and thrive in our company culture defined by these core values:
Challenging Fun
ONE Team
Customer Centric
Candid and Caring
Aim High

sections.title: Your Challenge
sections.text:
Develop a self-service, cloud-based enterprise web application that scales in every way imaginable.
Collaborate on improving the architecture of the current platform and streamlining the release process to ensure rapid time-to-value while maintaining the highest security standards.
Our clients, some of the world's most demanding enterprises, require releases that meet rigorous security standards and enterprise-grade SLAs.
Create user-friendly features that empower our clients in their Data Management transformation.
Assist in decoupling our predominantly monolithic application to enable feature teams to deliver updates swiftly and independently.
Take end-to-end ownership of the entire product, from feature development to achieving ambitious SLAs across hundreds of customer environments.

sections.title: What You Will Do
sections.text:
Attain a profound understanding of data management and design scalable systems capable of handling vast amounts of data within the cloud ecosystem and across various data sources.
Collaborate on software architecture with a strong focus on enabling feature teams to deliver high-quality enterprise software while enhancing the operability of our products.
Write clean, well-designed, documented, and testable code, adhering to industry standards and best practices, with a strong emphasis on quality, consistency, and speed of delivery.
Assume responsibility for your work, ensuring that your code is ready for deployment and operation in cloud environments.
Bring experience in developing fully multi-tenant systems, working with message queue services like RabbitMQ, and thriving in distributed systems environments.
Collaborate on implementation of AI-based features into our platform at scale

sections.title: The Tech We Expect
sections.text:
Our backend primarily employs the latest versions of Python using FastAPI, with a warm welcome to Java expertise. For communication we utilise REST API and GraphQL.
Our products are operated in AWS and Azure, so familiarity with these ecosystems and common managed services (e.g., Aurora Serverless, managed AKS, EKS..) is essential.
We orchestrate our services using Kubernetes, and your comfort with Kubernetes environments, Helm charts, and related technologies is critical.

sections.title: Our General Tech Stack
sections.text:
Backend : Java, Spring Boot, Kotlin, GraphQL, Python, FastAPI, jOOQ
Storage : Aurora, Postgres, Elastic, S3
Infrastructure : GitLab CI/CD, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure
Frontend : TypeScript, React/Vue, Apollo, Nx, MobX..
Big Data : Spark, Redshift, Snowflake

sections.title: Is This You?
sections.text:
You thrive on tackling complex applications and willingly dive into research when intricate algorithms and data structures are required for efficient solutions.
You have a passion for building secure Cloud applications.
Learning and sharing knowledge with others is something you genuinely enjoy.
You are unafraid to take ownership of end-to-end software engineering and operations competency.
You prefer iterating on the solution over spending an extensive amount of time crafting the perfect solution in the first iteration.

sections.title: Thông tin bổ sung
sections.text:
Perks & Benefits
• Full compensation during the probation period
• 13th salary
• 15 days of vacation
• Premium Healthcare
• Online company language courses
• Online courses & company access to Udemy to hone your skills
Work equipment
• Laptop
At Ataccama , our core values are Candid & Caring , so we are upfront about our process and details that are important to you. We sometimes use AI tools to help us with things like reviewing applications, taking notes from screening conversations, scheduling interviews, or supporting assessments. These tools make the process smoother and fairer — but don’t worry, they never make the final decision. Every hiring decision is made by our Talent Acquisition Partners and Hiring Managers, with AI only acting as a helpful assistant. We believe technology should support the process, not replace the human touch.
We currently use AI-assisted tools - Metaview for interview notes and Lever Talent Fit to help highlight key experience.
While we highly value cooperation with all our business partners, we don’t accept unsolicited resumes from any sources other than directly from a candidate. We reserve the right not to pay any fee for sending an unsolicited offer containing the details or resume of a job candidate, even if the relevant candidate is employed by our company.

sections.title: Mô tả & yêu cầu công việc
sections.text:
About Airwallex
Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.
We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.
About the team
The SME & Growth Business team at Airwallex is a passionate group of collaborators and business champions dedicated to empowering small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to thrive in the global economy. We combine deep financial expertise with a growth mindset, working closely with our clients to understand their unique needs and develop tailored solutions that streamline cross-border payments and unlock new revenue streams. As a team, we are driven by a desire to make a positive impact and are constantly innovating to find new ways to support the success of our SME customers.
What you’ll do
Airwallex aspires to serve the fastest growing businesses globally. The SME & Growth team focuses on bringing in new startups and small-to-mid-market businesses across Southeast Asia onto the Airwallex platform. You will leverage your skills in pitching, solutioning, and negotiating with customers to grow our business in Vietnam while helping business owners, finance teams, and e-commerce teams improve their financial operations. We are looking for someone who has a passion for building relationships, selling, and negotiating, and a desire to revolutionize the way companies transact globally.
If you have a customer-first mentality, are solution-focused, obsessively curious about everything, and have the desire to make an impact and grow yourself, our market, and our customers, then you have found your calling!
This role can be based in Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City.
Responsibilities:
Identify high-potential prospects in the Vietnam market and use effective strategies to generate leads that drive revenue growth
Develop and implement scalable sales strategies to drive new customer acquisition within Vietnam
Identify and understand prospects' pain points within the Vietnamese market to propose solutions, owning the full sales cycle from prospecting to close
Lead commercial negotiations to increase customer revenue
Develop strategies to maximize acquisition of new revenue and market share within the Vietnam market
Ensure the best onboarding process and customer experience for new customers, working cross-functionally to solve customer pain points and improve our product
Maintain a database of current and potential customers using our CRM
Who you are
We're looking for people who meet the minimum qualifications for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.
Minimum qualifications:
3+ years of sales experience, preferably selling a complex product with a track record of top performance
Passionate about sales with the ability to develop and execute strategies for the Vietnam market
Experience identifying and influencing key decision makers and stakeholders from finance managers to CEOs, with strong presentation and communication skills
Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving multiple products
Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment
Strong interest in technology/financial services and a deep understanding of the Vietnamese market and fintech landscape
Fluency in Vietnamese (both spoken and written) is essential to communicate effectively with key stakeholders and partners.
Success-oriented and are willing to "go the extra mile" in your work as needed to achieve results
Preferred qualifications:
Experience working in fast-paced start-up payments organization
Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters
To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @ airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.
Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.
Equal opportunity
Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

We work across acquisition, activation, retention and expansion to build a consistent, insight-led commercial engine for our customers. Our team operates in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment, partnering closely with Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations and Product. You will have the opportunity to take ownership early, solve complex commercial problems and grow your scope as the Vietnam business scales.
What you'll do
We are looking for a hands-on Sales Manager to lead and develop our sales representative team while strengthening commercial execution across the SME customer lifecycle. You will combine people leadership, sales management, commercial operations and performance analytics to improve funnel conversion, customer outcomes and revenue performance. You will work across the full funnel, from lead generation and qualification through conversion, onboarding, retention and expansion.
This is an Onsite role based in Hanoi or Ho Chi Minh City.
Responsibilities:
Lead and develop sales teams through regular coaching, one-to-ones, performance reviews, capability building and practical feedback.
Establish clear team targets, operating rhythms, KPIs and performance management processes across different sales activities.
Support pipeline generation, lead qualification, opportunity progression, renewals, cross-sell and upsell initiatives across the SME customer lifecycle.
Improve funnel conversion and customer outcomes by partnering closely with Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations and Product.
Build scalable processes, playbooks and best practices for lead management, account coverage, customer engagement, handoffs and sales execution.
Use performance data and commercial insights to identify gaps, improve productivity and recommend corrective actions.
Own sales performance analytics across the full funnel, covering productivity, conversion, revenue contribution, forecasting, retention, expansion and customer health.
Provide regular reporting and business reviews on team performance, funnel health, customer activity and revenue outcomes.
Drive continuous improvement in CRM hygiene, forecasting accuracy, reporting quality, sales process adherence and pipeline management.
Develop a comprehensive performance measurement framework and translate insights into commercial strategy, resource allocation and growth initiatives.
Act as a hands-on leader who balances people management, operational execution and strategic problem-solving.
Build a high-performing, insight-led commercial organisation with clear accountability across the customer lifecycle.
Minimum Requirements:
5+ years in fintech, banking, payments, or e-commerce, paired with a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or a related field.
Proven track record managing commercial teams (Sales, CS, AM, or RevOps), setting targets, and coaching for high performance.
Deep understanding of revenue drivers and the end-to-end customer funnel, from lead generation through retention and expansion.
Skilled in using CRMs (e.g., Salesforce) and reporting tools to optimize productivity, drive growth, and build frameworks from scratch.
Background in consulting or business ops with strong problem-solving skills to turn complex issues into actionable playbooks.
Exceptional stakeholder management and presentation skills, with a focus on thriving in fast-paced, high-growth environments.
Prior background in consulting, strategy, business operations, revenue operations or management consulting will be an added advantage.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Bosch first started in Vietnam with a representative office in 1994. Bosch has its main office in Ho Chi Minh City, with branch offices in Hanoi and Da Nang, and a Powertrain Solutions plant in the Dong Nai province to manufacture pushbelt for continuously variable transmissions (CVT) in automobiles. In addition, Bosch operates a software and engineering R&D center (Robert Bosch Engineering and Business Solutions Vietnam Co., Ltd).
In July 2014, Bosch set up a new Automotive R&D Center, located in Ho Chi Minh City. The continuous growth of this Centre is in line with Bosch’s strategy in Vietnam, which aims at becoming a manufacturing and R&D hub in the Southeast Asian region. Currently four products are available: connectors, pushbelt, fuel supply, and diagnosis module (tank leakage).
For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn

We are looking for talented team members with passion in developing safety products that save lives.
We offer a lot of training and practical hands-on in Automotive Embedded SW and Airbag system domain.
Opportunity to work in an international environment with stakeholders and global experts.
Join us: the Bosch AIRBAG global team which creates "EXPLOSIONS THAT SAVE LIFE".

Join in Embedded Software development for Airbag Control Unit.
Be responsible for software development, integration and unit testing based on requirements.
Estimate, plan and track tasks.
Document results, report problems and debug if required.
Work in collaboration with customers, co-ordinate team activities, handle day-to-day work efficiently and independently.

The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Since the beginning of 2013, its operations have been divided into four business sectors: Automotive Technology, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology.
The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 360 subsidiaries and regional companies in some 50 countries. If its sales and service partners are included, then Bosch is represented in roughly 150 countries. This worldwide development, manufacturing, and sales network is the foundation for further growth.
Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) i s 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH - one of the world’s leading global suppliers of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.
Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region.
With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Welcome to the ETA Department
The ETA team specializes in the AUTOSAR Basic Software (BSW) platform, working closely with ETAS the global leader in automotive embedded systems tools. This collaboration gives us a strong edge in delivering high-quality, scalable software solutions.
As part of ETA regional teams, you’ll have the opportunity to implement platform components and work directly with clients, gaining hands-on experience in both development and communication.
Learn more about our work here .
Responsibilities:
Be able to integrate MCAL, BSW, RTE and SWCs in projects which are based on AUTOSAR Classic Platform /or develop Flash Bootloader on specific targets
Work directly with German/ Chinese / Korean/ Japanese customers
Understand and analyze customer's requirements
Software development, integration and testing based on requirements
Execute software development tasks, document user guides, test results and report problems
Handling tickets of new features, issues and change requests for the software platform
Debug and maintain the software running on target devices (Real ECU and Virtual ECU) via network TCP/IP or Automotive protocols
Provide effort estimation and other inputs for project planning
Have several chances to travel to customer sites for business purpose
Mentoring junior team members
Technologies used: AUTOSAR (Com, Mem, Diag, Sys...), CAN/LIN/ETH, OSEK, RTOS, Cyber Security SW/HW w/ HSM, FBL, OTA, SOTA, Rollback, Self-Update SW Software Signature and SecureBoot.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Educational background
Major in Computer Engineering/ Electrical-Electronics/ Telecommunication/ Mechatronics Engineering or equivalent.
Technical skills
1-3 years of experience in embedded software development
Good knowledge of micro-controller, processor and embedded system
Have experience in bare metal programming in embedded systems (C programming skills)
Have experience in Embedded software development (C/C++ programming skills).
Design methodology using OOAD, UML and design patterns
Automotive communication protocols know-how, e.g. Ethernet /SOMEIP/CAN/ LIN/ Flexray and Classic AUTOSAR architecture & methodology should be advantages.
Experience in Software Development Life-cycle
Exposure to emulators, simulators, debugging and test equipment
Exposure to Real Time Operating System (RTOS)
It'd be a big advantage if you have experience in Flash bootloader development
Soft-skills and language skills
Good communication skills, able to interact professionally with a diverse group of clients and staffs
Good analytical skills
Be able to work independently or with minimum supervision
Good English communication skills.

About the propogram
Are you a fresh graduate passionate about C/C++ and embedded systems ?
Bosch Global Software Technologies Vietnam (BGSV) is looking for 30 Fresher Embedded Software Engineers to join our automotive software teams in Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi .
Through our One Day Offer hiring program, selected candidates can complete the interview process and receive the hiring result through an accelerated recruitment process.
Recruitment Timeline
Application: 26 Sep – 14 Oct 2026
One Day Offer / Interview: 05, 13 & 15 Oct 2026
Onboarding: 16 Oct or 02 Nov 2026
** Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so early application is encouraged **
What You’ll Do
As a Fresher Embedded Software Engineer, you will:
Develop, integrate, and test embedded software using C/C++ .
Analyze software requirements and support software design.
Perform software integration, testing, debugging, and issue analysis.
Document development and test results.
Work with experienced engineers and global development teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
Build your technical expertise in embedded systems and automotive software .

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Who can apply:
Fresh graduates with a background in Electronics, Telecommunications, Mechatronics, Automation, Computer Engineering , Automotive Engineering , or related fields.
Technical Skills:
Good knowledge of C/C++ programming .
Basic understanding of microcontrollers and embedded systems .
Knowledge of Python, Perl, or other scripting languages is a plus.
Basic knowledge of communication protocols and/or sensors is an advantage.
Other Skills:
Good problem-solving and analytical skills.
Willingness to learn and develop technical expertise in the automotive domain.
Able to communicate in English, both verbally and in writing.

sections.text:
Department Information
ETA portfolio
We are seeking for Flash Bootloader Developer who is fully responsible for Flash Bootloader Solution development for Completed Software on ECUs.
Main Roles and Responsibilities
Responsible for Flash Bootloader software development
Communication protocol, diagnostic service, flashing, security based on AUTOSAR .
Define and evaluate customer specific flashing sequence.
SW requirement analysis related to flashing and support customer problem solving

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Mandatory Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Electronic, Mechatronics, or related fields
Have 1-2 years of experience Automotive Embedded.
Good coding skills in C programing language and scripting languages (CAPL, Python,...)
Familiar with AUTOSAR architecture (COM, Diag and Security), especially familiar with UDS ISO144229, experience with FBL (Flash Bootloader) is much more preferred.
Vector CAN case usage for Communication debugging and Lauterbach debugging skill
Familiar with Infineon Tricore series and Renesas SOC is preferred.
Familiar with FlashEEPROM, has concept with memory layout for embedded system, CAN/CANFD/ETH and FlexRay communication protocol.
Good at data structures, and algorithms.
Good oral and written English , ability to daily communicate foreign colleagues and suppliers.
Familiar with software development process and toolchain, know about V model is preferred.
Independent development and goal-oriented teamwork.
Nice-to-Have (Optional)
Chinese/Japanese Language

sections.text:
ABOUT THE DEPARTMENT & THE ROLE
'EPC' is a department of BGSV company, belongs to Automotive Powertrain Solution domain. We develop embedded SW for ' Engine / Vehicle control unit ' which controls key vehicle engine functions (e.g., power performance, energy consumption efficiency, emissions, diagnosis, communication) and additional drive-ability features.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
The Leisure & Wholesale Manager is responsible for developing and maximizing leisure and wholesale business for the hotel. The role focuses on acquiring and retaining key travel trade partners, including wholesalers, tour operators, travel agencies, DMCs, and other leisure partners, while driving room nights, revenue, and long-term business growth.
The position takes ownership of the Leisure & Wholesale segment strategy, key account portfolio, proactive business development, segment performance, and long-term account growth.
Primary Responsibilities
Sales Management
Develop and implement sales strategies and the annual sales action plan for the Leisure & Wholesale segments to achieve room night, revenue, ADR, and profitability targets, while contributing to the segment budget and forecast process.
Identify, acquire, and develop new wholesalers, tour operators, travel agencies, DMCs, and other leisure business partners, with a focus on strategic source markets and long-term business potential.
Develop and manage an assigned portfolio of key Leisure & Wholesale accounts through account mapping, production analysis, account penetration, and long-term account development, including the acquisition of new accounts and reactivation of dormant or lost accounts.
Manage and strengthen relationships with key Leisure & Wholesale accounts, maintaining awareness of partners' business cycles, contracting periods, source-market trends, and future production opportunities.
Negotiate and manage commercial agreements, including contracted rates, allotments, release periods, promotions, blackout dates, and other business terms, while protecting the hotel's revenue and profitability objectives.
Conduct regular account and production reviews to identify opportunities to increase room nights, ADR, revenue, and market share from existing partners.
Participate in trade shows, sales missions, networking events, client meetings, and industry activities to promote the hotel, develop new partnerships, and strengthen existing business relationships.
Monitor Leisure & Wholesale market trends, source-market performance, competitor activities, and distribution developments, providing relevant market intelligence, account insights, and commercial recommendations to the Director of Sales & Marketing.
Work closely with Revenue Management to optimize contracted rates, availability, allotments, promotions, need periods, and overall commercial strategy for the Leisure & Wholesale segments.
Collaborate with Reservations, Front Office, Rooms, Food & Beverage, and other relevant departments to ensure smooth delivery of Leisure & Wholesale business and agreed partner requirements.
Ensure all contracted rates, account information, business opportunities, bookings, and sales activities are accurately and promptly updated in Delphi, Opera, and other relevant systems.
Maintain accurate segment pipelines, forecasts, account plans, and production analyses, monitoring room nights, ADR, revenue, booking pace, account performance, and lost business to identify risks and future commercial opportunities.
Handle qualified Leisure & Wholesale group enquiries within the established Long-Term Sales scope, including proposal preparation, site inspections, negotiation, contracting, and conversion into confirmed business.
Ensure a complete and timely handover of confirmed Leisure & Wholesale group business to the Event Management team, including signed contracts, agreed commercial and payment terms, draft Group Resume, client requirements, and other relevant documentation; maintain the strategic account relationship following handover and conduct post-stay/group follow-up to develop repeat and future business.
Other Responsibilities
Attend all briefings, meetings and trainings as assigned by management
Maintain a high standard of personal appearance and hygiene at all times
Perform other reasonable duties assigned by the assigned by the Management
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Leisure & Wholesale room revenue vs. budget/forecast
Room nights production
ADR performance
New account acquisition
Account retention and revenue growth
Key account penetration and production growth
Tour series / contracted business production
Source-market production and development
Contracted account performance / materialization
Pipeline and forecast accuracy
Account production and booking pace
Client and partner satisfaction
Repeat business and long-term account development

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Knowledge and Experience
Bachelor’s degree required
Minimum of 3 years of experience in a similar capacity with proven track records in hotel sales, preferably within Leisure, Wholesale, Travel Trade, or related segments.
Strong understanding of the Leisure & Wholesale business, including wholesalers, tour operators, travel agencies, DMCs, contracted rates, allotments, release periods, and relevant distribution practices.
Good understanding of key leisure source markets, market dynamics, and travel trade business patterns.
Demonstrated experience in account development, commercial negotiation, and driving room night and revenue production.
Excellent reading, writing and oral proficiency in English language.
Proficient in MS Excel, Word, & PowerPoint.
Experience with Delphi, Opera, or similar hotel sales and property management systems is preferred.
Competencies
Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
Service oriented with an eye for details.
Strong commercial mindset with good negotiation and business development skills.
Good analytical skills with a focus on account production, revenue, and business growth.
Proactive, results-driven and self-motivated.
Ability to work effectively under pressure and collaborate across departments.
Well-presented and professionally groomed at all times.

sections.text: Opened in March 2026 as the first Fairmont hotel in Vietnam, Fairmont Hanoi is a luxury urban resort that celebrates Vietnamese heritage through elegant design, exceptional dining, wellness, and world-class event facilities. With 241 guestrooms, eight dining venues, a 1,100m² Grand Ballroom, and a commitment to heartfelt hospitality, Fairmont Hanoi is set to become the social epicentre of the capital and an exciting place to build a career in luxury hospitality.

sections.text:
GENERAL MISSION
To ensure the efficient administration of the Executive Office.
To assist directly the General Manager in his responsibilities.
RESPONSIBILITIES AND MEANS
Ensures that the day to day administrative needs are fulfilled.
Be responsible for rendering secretarial and clerical services for the General Manager.
Keeps all information confidential.
TECHNICAL RESPONSIBILITIES
Inputs in the computer specific data when requested.
Handles telephone incoming/outgoing calls.
Arranges appointments for, and reminds of appointments and meetings.
Keep files in good order.
Handle different kind of bookings for owning companies
Be in charge of expatriate contract follow-up including IMS, renewal, local language translation.
Duty arrangements for department heads.
Operation smile donnation register.
Maintain proper communication including follow up with owning company, shareholders and Accor office.
Assisting AAPC office’s employees for entry visa to Vietnam.
Coordinate & arranging airline tickets & accomodation, visa for GM and department heads trips.
Be responsible for the good order/cleanliness of own work area and equipment.
Monitors the casual staff requisitions of departments.
Follows up with approval of casual staff orders submitted by department heads and sends these orders to the supplier in most proper ways.
Coordinates with the supplier in effective manner to make sure all casual staff fully attends the operations in terms of working schedule, quantity as required in the casual staff orders.
Ensures casual staff strictly follows grooming standards, working regulations and hotel rules.
Handles complaints and proposes solutions for problems concerning to employment of casual staff in daily operations.
Ensures the accuracy of casual staff attendance record. Prepares monthly payment report and other reports as required by hotel management.
COMMERCIAL RESPONSIBILITIES
Handles suppliers when requested.
ADMINISTRATIVE RESPONSIBILITIES
Records and transcribes minutes of meetings.
Drafts routine or simple correspondence as assigned.
Typing correspondence, memorandums, circulars, reports etc
Opens/dispatches mail relative to the division.
Maintains office supplies.
Performs special duties in relation with the division when requested.
HUMAN RESOURCE RESPONSIBILITIES
Handles human relation duties for employees.
Sees that employee’s complaints, needs are passed on to the General Manager.
Conducts oriented training programs of Accor Group for employees in a regular basis.
REPLACEMENT AND TEMPORARY MISSION
Performs other related duties and special projects as directed by the General Manager.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
The Self-Serve Business Regional Team (SSBU) is on a mission to build a sustainable and scalable ecosystem for B2B customers. We aim to maximize the Lifetime Value (LTV) of B2B customers, driving substantial, repeatable, and forecastable growth in Grab's revenue and profitability. We achieve this by leveraging technology and building business models across multiple products, including Grab for Business (GFB).
The SSBU Strategy & Planning team partners with Product, Marketing, Inside Sales, and country teams to design and scale the programs that turn high-intent businesses into active GFB accounts. We are builders who move from insight to action, balancing strategic program design with hands-on execution to unlock sustainable SMB growth without proportional headcount growth.
Get to Know the Role
As Assistant Manager on the SSBU Strategy & Planning team, you will lead the design and execution of strategic programs that drive GFB's SMB segment growth across Southeast Asia. You will oversee workstreams that span across different life stages of our client's journey, and partner with cross-functional teams to translate strategy into measurable results.
You will report to the Manager, Self-Serve Regional Business Strategy, and partner closely with peers across the team, and with cross-functional teams across the region. This role supports SMB growth across all markets from a base in Malaysia.
This is a role for someone who excels at the intersection of strategy and execution, enjoys building programs from zero to one, and wants to shape how Southeast Asian businesses experience Grab. If the challenge of turning strategic ambition into scalable, measurable outcomes excites you, we want to hear from you.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Design and execute strategic programs that drive GFB's SMB segment growth across Southeast Asia, from problem definition to delivery.
Structure ambiguous business problems, summarize insights from data and market research, and translate them into applicable program designs and recommendations.
Design and run structured experiments and lifecycle programs to improve client activation, engagement, and retention.
Partner with cross-functional teams to align on go-to-market motions, secure agreement, and meet multi-year SMB growth targets.
Prepare clear, strategic updates for senior stakeholders, including performance reports, business reviews, and recommendations.
Use AI tools and latest technologies to accelerate research, automate analysis, and build lightweight solutions that improve team productivity and program effectiveness.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
4+ years of experience in strategy or growth roles, with a track record of designing and executing programs that delivered measurable business outcomes.
Experience working cross-functionally to launch new initiatives, ideally in a tech, marketplace, or B2B SaaS environment.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, synthesize insights from data, and translate them into actionable program designs.
A builder mindset with demonstrated ability to take programs from zero to one, owning end-to-end execution.
Experience using AI tools and emerging technologies to boost productivity, improve workflows, and contribute new ideas.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
Join the FundsCore Platform team at Grab - a dynamic team building a reliable platform to address challenging problems in the Payments domain. We are a team of engineers, designers, product managers, and operations. We innovate and collaborate to solve one of the most challenging problems: ensuring accurate settlement to large numbers of merchants. This role prefers you have certain Payments domain expertise or demonstrate quick-learning skills.
Get to Know the Role
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Backend to join our growing engineering team. In this role, you'll design, build, and operate backend services that power critical business applications at scale. You'll work collaboratively with product managers, designers, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality features while driving operational excellence and mentoring fellow engineers. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact by architecting innovative solutions in a supportive environment.
You will report to the Engineering Manager II based in Singapore and work onsite and CMC Creative Space office, HCMC.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Design and implement scalable, reliable backend services using modern programming languages and frameworks, with a focus on performance, cost-efficiency, and maintainability
Own delivery of features and projects, including requirements clarification, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and post-launch monitoring
Lead and participate in technical discussions and design reviews, making thoughtful trade-offs between reliability, latency, throughput, and cost
Instrumenting services with comprehensive metrics, logs, and traces; define SLIs/SLOs; improve alerting strategies; and perform capacity planning and performance optimization
Collaborate with other teams to design end-to-end workflows that are secure, scalable, and user-centric
Contribute to engineering excellence by improving CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, documentation standards, and design practices within the team
Mentor other engineers through constructive code reviews, knowledge sharing, and best practice guidance in design, coding, and operational excellence
Participate in on-call rotations and handle production incidents
Support hiring initiatives by conducting technical interviews and helping refine interview processes and guidelines

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or an advanced degree. Good Computer Science fundamentals in algorithms and data structures.
5+ years of professional experience in backend software development.
Proficiency in Golang, with an understanding of its syntax, semantics, standard libraries, concurrency features, and experience optimizing applications.
Experience with RDBMS technologies like MySQL and PostgreSQL , including expertise in database performance, query tuning, and reliability.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP , with knowledge in designing scalable, internet-scale microservices.
Fluent in English both verbally and written.
Expertise in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform and AWS CloudFormation, along with experience automating infrastructure.
Skills in development practices such as TDD, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery, using tools like GIT, Jenkins, and unit testing frameworks.
Experience applying AI-assisted software development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools to improve engineering productivity across coding, debugging, testing, refactoring, and code review.
Experience leveraging AI tools to improve production engineering workflows, including incident investigation, root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and system design.

The Agent Experience PST owns and operates the internal platforms used by Grab's support agents to serve our entire ecosystem- across every vertical and use case. Because agents rely on these tools to resolve critical issues for users and partners, our systems are built for extremely high availability, reliability, and 100% data correctness.
When a user needs help with a transaction, they rely on our platform to ensure the agent has the right tools and data at the right time.
Get To Know The Role
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer in Vietnam to contribute to our internal tooling products used for our agents to serve Passengers, Drivers, and Merchants. You will report to the Engineering Manager, who is based in Singapore, and work in an on-site mode. This role is based in Vietnam.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Design and write with the cutting edge Go language to improve the availability, scalability, latency, and efficiency of Grab's range of services
Work with engineering team to explore and create new design / architectures geared towards scale and performance
Participate in code and design reviews to maintain our high development standards
Engage in service capacity and demand planning, software performance analysis, tuning and optimization
Collaborate with product and experience teams to define and prototype feature specifications
Work closely with infrastructure team in building and scaling back-end services as well as performing root cause analysis investigations
Design, build, analyze and fix large-scale systems
Pro-actively debug and solve production incidents during your oncall shift
Participate in interview loops to help Grab continue hiring top industry talent
Provide technical guidance, mentorship and knowledge sharing to peers.

sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
The Grab for Business team focuses on providing solutions tailored for corporate clients. We offer services like ride-hailing, logistics, food, and all designed to enhance employee productivity and improve business operations.
Get to Know the Role
We are looking for Key Accounts Associate to join our Grab for Business (GFB) team in Hanoi, Vietnam.
In this role, you will focus on building a strong sales pipeline and acquiring new GFB clients , identifying new business opportunities and driving the end-to-end sales cycle from prospecting to closing. You will play an important role in expanding GFB's client base and presence in Hanoi and Northern Vietnam.
You will report to the Head of GFB KAM, Vietnam and work onsite in Hanoi.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline by proactively identifying, prospecting, and qualifying potential Grab for Business (GFB) clients in Hanoi and Northern Vietnam.
Drive new client acquisition and own the end-to-end sales cycle , from lead generation and initial engagement to proposal, negotiation, and closing.
Identify and engage key decision-makers across target companies, understand their business needs, and position GFB solutions to deliver relevant value.
Develop and execute effective sales strategies to achieve and exceed individual acquisition, revenue, and sales targets.
Deliver compelling presentations, proposals, and product demonstrations tailored to prospective clients' business requirements.
Maintain disciplined pipeline management, including accurate tracking of opportunities, sales activities, conversion, and forecasts.
Analyze market trends, industry developments, and competitor activities to identify new segments, prospects, and growth opportunities.
Negotiate commercial terms and agreements while balancing client requirements, business objectives, and profitability.
Build strong relationships with newly acquired clients and key stakeholders to establish a solid foundation for long-term partnership before transitioning accounts to the relevant account management team.
Leverage industry events, networking opportunities, referrals, and other prospecting channels to expand GFB's presence and client base in Hanoi and Northern Vietnam.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Role
We are looking for a Manager, Category Management to drive category selection, assortment strategy, product sourcing and supplier management across regional markets.
This role reports to the Head of Category Management, based onsite at our office.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Category Strategy & Execution Develop both short-term (quarterly) and long-term (annual) plans for the assigned category, aligned with overall business priorities and customer needs.
Monitor market trends, competitor strategies, and consumer insights to refine category positioning and maintain competitiveness.
Set clear KPIs for category performance (GMV, contribution margin, fill rates, supplier participation) and take corrective actions when needed.
Define pricing and promotion frameworks in coordination with Strategy & Growth to drive both top-line and profitability.
Lead category reviews with internal stakeholders (supply chain, marketing, product, finance) to align on opportunities and risks.
Partner with Group Category Management to leverage regional supplier agreements and translate them into local execution.
Identify and incubate new sub-categories or niche opportunities to broaden assortment and capture emerging demand (e.g., specialty diets in Pets, organic products in FMCG).
Supplier & Partner Management Build and maintain strong relationships with local and regional suppliers.
Negotiate pricing, promotions, and service-level agreements to maximize category profitability.
Assortment & Merchandising Build a balanced assortment strategy that ensures availability of staples, introduces innovation (new brands/products), and differentiates our platform with exclusives.
Apply data-driven assortment planning: analyze customer behavior, sales velocity, and basket composition to decide which SKUs to expand, reduce, or rotate.
Ensure local relevance: adapt assortment to reflect cultural preferences, festive seasons, and country-specific regulations (e.g., Pharma or M&B categories).
Work with suppliers and marketing to design joint business plans, including seasonal campaigns, bundles, and new product launches.
Optimize online merchandising by improving product content (images, descriptions), shelf sequencing, and search visibility.
Partner with the Loyalty/Ads specialist to create category-led campaigns (e.g., repeat purchase programs, category sponsorships).
Continuously monitor stock health (slow movers, overstock) and partner with operations on clearance or alternative strategies.
Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with supply chain teams to ensure supply availability and fulfillment efficiency.
Collaborate with product and tech teams to enhance customer discovery and ordering experience.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
5 to 8+ years of experience in category management, merchandising, or procurement ( in eCommerce, retail, or FMCG).
Strong background in understanding of key levers such as assortment planning, pricing & promotions, supplier funding, and retail media monetization.
Proven track record in managing and negotiating with suppliers.
Strong analytical mindset, with experience applying AI-driven insights and tools to category strategy and operations.
Strong business acumen and P&L management experience.
Work cross-functionally in a high-growth environment.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Role
We're looking for an experienced Lead Product Manager to join our Technical Infrastructure team, specifically focusing on the Data Platform. In this role, you will own the strategic direction and execution of our data platform, collaborating with engineering, data science, analytics, and product teams to identify areas for improvement and develop impactful solutions. The Data Platform team empowers the underlying platform and infrastructure that supports all data applications across the organization, including data ingestion, data storage, data discovery, data query, data quality, and data activation. You will work with cross-functional leaders across the company to drive organization-wide changes and report to the Head of Product, Data & AI.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Define and execute the product strategy for the Data Platform, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and driving organization-wide adoption
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including engineering, data science, analytics, and product to identify opportunities for improvement and develop tailored solutions
Gather requirements, conduct user research with internal stakeholders, and prioritize the product backlog to ensure the team focuses on high-impact projects
Establish strong relationships with internal stakeholders and deeply understand their needs, challenges, and use cases across the organization
Drive the adoption and onboarding of internal tools and the Data Platform, ensuring user engagement and success across all teams
Oversee product launches and go-to-market activities for internal tools and data platforms, communicating value and driving organizational alignment
Communicate product vision, progress, and outcomes with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring the team's work is well-understood and well-supported
Develop and maintain detailed product roadmaps that balance short-term deliverables with long-term strategic initiatives
Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to measure product adoption, user success, and platform impact
Lead cross-functional teams and mentor junior product managers, fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

Experience in a fast-paced, startup, or scale-up environment
Background in data science, engineering, or related technical field

Experience with product management tools, data visualization platforms, and project management software

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
The Streaming Data team (aka "Coban") strives to enable seamless and secure real-time access to the events or "streams", serving as Grab's unified, common access pattern for real-time data. The functional areas this team covers are streaming (Kafka), stream processing (Flink, Flink SQL, Kafka Connect), Change Data Capture, near real-time lake ingestion , stream exploration ( Zeppelin , Flink SQL Gateway ), and an in-house control plane for tenancy and resource management.
Some examples of the team's work are shared publicly on the Grab Engineering blog:
Making Flink deployments safer through platform guardrails and production deployment patterns ( Safer deployment of streaming applications ).
Improving Flink release confidence with shadow testing ( Enhancing Flink deployment with shadow testing ).
Strengthening real-time Kafka data quality with syntactic and semantic stream contracts ( Real-time data quality monitoring ).
Using machine learning to make Flink autoscaling more predictable and reliable ( Machine-learning predictive autoscaling for Flink ).
These are examples of the platform thinking this role will contribute to: turning complex real-time infrastructure problems into reliable, self-service capabilities for Grab teams.
Get to Know the Role
Here at Grab, we expect our Senior Engineers to significantly and autonomously contribute to their team, designing, shipping, operating, and monitoring software systems in a high-quality manner. As a Senior DevOps Engineer, your role would involve working on the systems within your team's domain. You would need to consider the appropriate architectural patterns, code design, and infrastructure options. Your goal is to ensure that you deliver a system that is secure, reliable, testable, maintainable, extensible, and well-tested.
You will work onsite at Grab Vietnam office (CMC Creative Space) in HCMC and report to Senior Data Engineering Manager, who is based in Singapore.
Why This Role Matters
In an agentic world, high-quality real-time signals are becoming even more critical to drive automation, decision-making, and measurable business impact.
Apache Flink is a critical real-time infrastructure layer for Grab. By making stream processing easier, safer, and more self-serve, this role helps unlock more real-time signals and turn data into business value across Grab. As Grab embraces agentic engineering, we welcome builders with strong data infrastructure experience and a passion for stream processing to join us.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Work with a team of engineers to make Stream Processing easy, reliable, efficient and secure across Grab, via self-served capabilities baked in our platform.
Orchestrate and operate the Cloud infrastructure and Compute cluster that lays the foundation for the systems, maintaining the uptime for many critical services.
Improve the automation and self-served capabilities that enable our small team to support 1000+ Stream Processing applications in Grab.
Weigh in on design questions around platformization, infrastructure, observability and security.
Contribute to the use of Stream Processing across Grab, by evangelizing for our platform and products, and by directly helping our internal users design and build the next game-changing real-time application for Grab.
Create the abstractions, modules and libraries to lower the barrier of entry to Stream Processing in Grab and shift the maintenance and security toil away from our users.
Participate in and evolve on-call and incident response procedures for the team.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
4+ years of experience in Kubernetes, Docker and Cloud infrastructure at scale.
Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code like Terraform.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines design and implementation
Proficient with at least one programming language: Python, Golang, Java, Scala.
Experience with Observability and Monitoring stack (LGTM, ELK, Datadog, or similar)
Strong English communication skills , you will work together with peers and engineering teams across regional Tech offices.
Experience with big-data systems is a big plus (especially Kafka and Flink)
You are excited to learn and apply new technologies.
The nice-to-haves:
Experience with AWS, Gitlab.
Understanding of K8s networking concepts (service mesh, service discovery)
Understanding of security concept and practices, secret managements, encryption, OAuth, RBAC/ABAC

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
The Transaction Platform team powers Grab's multi-billion-dollar Deliveries business across Southeast Asia. We build the core platforms that orchestrate every order, payment, refund, dispute, and merchant transaction at massive scale. Our mission is to deliver a trusted, resilient, and efficient commerce platform that balances customer experience, merchant trust, and sustainable business growth.
Get to Know the Role
As a Lead Product Manager, you will own and advance key areas of Grab's merchant transaction platform. You'll lead the development of mission-critical capabilities that power millions of orders daily, working at the intersection of distributed systems, financial integrity, and large-scale operational workflows. You will translate broader platform strategy into clear product roadmaps, make thoughtful technical and business trade-offs, and work closely with engineering and cross-functional partners to deliver reliable, scalable solutions. This role requires strong product judgment, systems thinking, and the ability to drive complex initiatives across teams and markets.
Key responsibilities
Own Platform Roadmaps: Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for key areas of Grab's merchant transaction platform, balancing immediate business needs with long-term scalability and reliability.
Build High-Scale Platform Capabilities: Lead the design and delivery of platform services spanning order lifecycle management, merchant operations, dispute resolution, and transactional integrity.
Solve Complex Platform Problems: Break down complex, multi-party workflows and work with engineering and operational teams to deliver accurate, reliable, and resilient transaction-processing experiences.
Drive Operational Excellence : Develop platform capabilities that reduce merchant downtime, improve operational governance, and recover merchant demand through automation, permissions, auditing, and risk controls.
Make Data-Informed Decisions: Define success metrics, analyse platform performance and operational data, and use insights and experimentation to prioritise improvements and guide product decisions.
Lead Cross-Functional Execution: Partner with engineering, operations, finance, legal, and commercial teams to clarify requirements, resolve trade-offs, and deliver complex initiatives across the region.
Contribute to Platform Strategy: Bring customer, merchant, operational, and technical insights into the broader Transaction Platform strategy and identify opportunities to strengthen the platform over time.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Essential Skills
At least 6 years of Product Management experience, including ownership of platform products such as transaction processing, payments, commerce platforms, order management, financial systems, or backend infrastructure.
Strong technical and systems thinking, with the ability to understand complex architectures, work effectively with engineering teams, and make sound product and platform trade-offs.
Demonstrated experience taking complex platform capabilities from problem definition and discovery through launch, adoption, and ongoing optimisation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, using data, experimentation, customer insights, and technical understanding to identify opportunities and guide product decisions.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with a proven ability to align cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, finance, legal, and commercial organisations.
A track record of driving execution in complex environments, managing dependencies, resolving ambiguity, and delivering measurable customer, merchant, operational, or business outcomes.

Get to Know the Team
The Business Process Improvement & Automation team (BPI&A) is a regional team responsible for driving process streamlining, re-engineering, and automation, enabling sustainable growth for our organization. The Regional BPA – Automation Platform is part of this organization, where we build and operate automation capabilities that support critical business workflows across the region—turning business needs into dependable systems that are safe to run in production.
Our focus is on developing, integrating, and enhancing the automation platform with strong engineering rigor: reliability, observability, and thoughtful rollout decisions when production behavior is impacted.
Get to Know the Role
We are looking for a talented and innovative Senior Software Engineer, Fullstack to join the Regional BPA – Automation Platform team. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining automation tools and integrations that are safe, scalable, and reliable in production—supporting regional business workflows end to end. You will report to the Regional BPA – Automation Platform Manager and work onsite at Grab office, CMC Creative Space, D7, HCMC.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Design and implement efficient, scalable, and maintainable software solutions
Develop and integrate RESTful APIs to support various client applications
Architect and build microservices-based solutions for distributed systems
Optimize database queries and manage both SQL and NoSQL databases
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and implement new features
Participate in code reviews and mentor junior developers
Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize systems for maximum performance
Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for seamless deployment
Ensure the security and reliability of software infrastructure
Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry best practices
Contribute to the continuous improvement of our development processes and methodologies

You will develop quality and engagement strategies to increase overall supply size, productivity, efficiency, and engagement of Deliveries delivery-partners., You will provide an analytical approach to decision-making and execution.

You will improve scalable operational processes solving delivery-partner efficiency, delivery quality and retention programs.
You can "connect-the-dots", and understand both on-ground realities of the business and the narrative of data from multiple sources

You will work with different teams and departments to support goals and projects of Grab as a whole, when relevant to delivery-partners.
