sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
Join the FundsCore Platform team at Grab - a dynamic and fast-paced team building a reliable platform to address challenging problems in the Payments domain. We are a team of engineers, designers, product managers, and operations who innovate and collaborate to solve one of the most challenging problems - enabling accurate reconciliation with many financial partners. This role prefers you have certain Payments domain expertise or demonstrate quick-learning skills.
Get to Know the Role
You will be responsible for designing, building and maintaining one of our Payments Core ( FundsCore ) platforms which includes complex backend systems and data pipelines to meet both functional and non-functional requirements.
You will report to the Senior Engineering Manager based in Singapore and work onsite at Grab Vietnam office at Ho Chi Minh City.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Design, develop, and maintain high-quality, scalable software applications that meet business and non-functional requirements
Write clean, efficient, testable, and maintainable code to solve challenging problems in the Fintech domain
Collaborate with teams to define, design, and deliver new features
Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality
Troubleshoot and debug complex issues, providing fixes and implementing long-term sustainable solutions
Contribute to architectural decisions and the technical direction of projects
Ensure system reliability and availability through strong observability practices and drive continuous improvements in Operational Excellence; participate in On-Call rotations is mandatory
Provide DevOps support to the team to ensure system health and performance
Mentor junior engineers and interns, encouraging a culture of continuous learning and improvement
Stay current with latest industry trends and technologies; leverage Generative AI tools to enhance productivity and improve system capabilities

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering , or a related field
Strong Computer Science fundamentals in algorithms and data structures
5+ years of software development experience with proficiency in one or more major programming languages such as Golang (preferred), Java, or demonstrated ability to quickly acquire necessary skills
Proficient in English (both spoken and written)
Experience employing AI tools to improve project delivery
Understanding of clean architecture principles, data-driven application design, and large-scale data processing
Experience building large-scale distributed systems utilizing DBMS, caching solutions, NoSQL databases, and application servers (RESTful and gRPC) while ensuring data consistency
Hands-on experience with microservices architecture, cloud platforms (e.g., AWS) , and DevOps practices
Operational and compliance excellence with the ability to implement solutions that meet requirements for Observability, SLAs, Security, Data Governance, and Regulatory compliance
Ability to write efficient, extensible, and thoroughly tested code for complex projects, selecting appropriate abstractions that follow SOLID principles
Ability to write design documents and maintain up-to-date documentation (e.g., runbooks)
Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, Maven, GitLab

Join the FundsCore Platform team at Grab - a dynamic team building a reliable platform to address challenging problems in the Payments domain. We innovate and collaborate to solve one of the most challenging problems: ensuring accurate settlement to large numbers of merchants. This role prefers you have Payments domain expertise or demonstrate quick-learning skills.
Get to Know the Role
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Backend to join our growing engineering team in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. You'll take ownership of designing and developing scalable backend systems that power our core products. You'll work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to solve complex technical challenges, mentor junior engineers, and drive architectural innovations. If you're passionate about building robust, efficient systems and thrive in an inclusive environment, we'd love to hear from you.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Design, develop, and maintain high-quality, scalable backend applications using modern technologies and best practices
Build and optimize RESTful APIs and microservices that support multiple client applications
Collaborate with product managers, frontend engineers, and other stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions
Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code while adhering to SOLID principles and clean architecture patterns
Conduct code reviews to ensure code quality, share knowledge, and foster a culture of continuous improvement
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex technical issues with analytical rigor
Participate in system design discussions and contribute to architectural decisions that shape our technical direction
Implement and maintain automated testing practices, including unit and integration tests, to ensure reliability
Optimize database queries and system performance to handle growing scale and user demands
Participate in on-call rotations to ensure service reliability and respond to production incidents
Mentor junior team members and contribute to their professional growth and development

Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP , with knowledge in designing scalable, internet-scale microservices.

Experience leveraging AI tools to improve production engineering workflows, including incident investigation, root cause analysis, troubleshooting, and system design.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to know the team
The Anti-Abuse Engineering team is responsible for building services and applications to provide safety, security, and trust in the high-throughput systems and services of Grab and its partners. The team combats sophisticated fraud in real-time through distributed backend systems, composed of highly motivated engineers working across different technology domains.
Get to know the role
We are looking for an Entry-Level Software Engineer, Backend to join our Anti-Abuse Engineering team. You will work on building and maintaining backend services, APIs, and data systems that power fraud detection, abuse prevention, and risk management across Grab's platform. As an entry-level engineer, you will have the opportunity to learn from experienced engineers while contributing to systems that impact millions of users.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain backend services and APIs that support fraud detection and abuse prevention systems.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following established engineering standards and best practices.
Participate in code reviews and design discussions to learn from senior engineers and improve code quality.
Collaborate with backend engineers, data engineers, and SREs to understand system architecture and operational requirements.
Assist in troubleshooting and resolving issues in production systems with guidance from senior team members.
Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing within the team.
Work on assigned tasks and features with a focus on timely delivery and quality.
Participate in team meetings and sync-ups to stay aligned on project goals and priorities.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
You have 1-3 years of professional backend software development experience
You have proficiency in at least one backend programming language (Java, Python, Go, C++, or similar)
You have experience with RESTful API design and development principles
You have experience with relational and non-relational database systems
You have proficiency with version control systems (Git)
You have familiarity with AI tools and hands-on experience using them
You have Agile/Scrum development experience
You demonstrate strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn from experienced engineers
What Nice-to-Have Skills Will Help You Succeed
Familiarity with microservices architecture concepts
Basic experience with containerization technologies (Docker)
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and basic DevOps practices
Familiarity with message queue systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
Interest in security or fraud prevention systems

Get to know the team
The Anti-Abuse Engineering team is responsible for building services and applications to provide safety, security, and trust in the high-throughput systems and services of Grab and its partners. The team combats sophisticated fraud in real-time through distributed backend systems, composed of highly motivated engineers working across different technology domains.
Get to know the role
We are looking for an Entry-Level Software Engineer, Backend to join our Anti-Abuse Engineering team. You will work on building and maintaining backend services, APIs, and data systems that power fraud detection, abuse prevention, and risk management across Grab's platform. As an entry-level engineer, you will have the opportunity to learn from experienced engineers while contributing to systems that impact millions of users.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain backend services and APIs that support fraud detection and abuse prevention systems.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following established engineering standards and best practices.
Participate in code reviews and design discussions to learn from senior engineers and improve code quality.
Collaborate with backend engineers, data engineers, and SREs to understand system architecture and operational requirements.
Assist in troubleshooting and resolving issues in production systems with guidance from senior team members.
Contribute to technical documentation and knowledge sharing within the team.
Work on assigned tasks and features with a focus on timely delivery and quality.
Participate in team meetings and sync-ups to stay aligned on project goals and priorities.

What Essential Skills You Will Need
You have 1-3 years of professional backend software development experience
You have proficiency in at least one backend programming language (Java, Python, Go, C++, or similar)
You have experience with RESTful API design and development principles
You have experience with relational and non-relational database systems
You have proficiency with version control systems (Git)
You have familiarity with AI tools and hands-on experience using them
You have Agile/Scrum development experience
You demonstrate strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn from experienced engineers
What Nice-to-Have Skills Will Help You Succeed
Familiarity with microservices architecture concepts
Basic experience with containerization technologies (Docker)
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and basic DevOps practices
Familiarity with message queue systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
Interest in security or fraud prevention systems

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get To Know The Team
The Agent Experience PST owns and operates the internal platforms used by Grab's support agents to serve our entire ecosystem- across every vertical and use case. Because agents rely on these tools to resolve critical issues for users and partners, our systems are built for extremely high availability, reliability, and 100% data correctness.
When a user needs help with a transaction, they rely on our platform to ensure the agent has the right tools and data at the right time.
Get To Know The Role
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer in Vietnam to contribute to our internal tooling products used for our agents to serve Passengers, Drivers, and Merchants. You will report to the Engineering Manager, who is based in Singapore, and work in an on-site mode. This role is based in Vietnam.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Design and write with the cutting edge Go language to improve the availability, scalability, latency, and efficiency of Grab's range of services
Work with engineering team to explore and create new design / architectures geared towards scale and performance
Participate in code and design reviews to maintain our high development standards
Engage in service capacity and demand planning, software performance analysis, tuning and optimization
Collaborate with product and experience teams to define and prototype feature specifications
Work closely with infrastructure team in building and scaling back-end services as well as performing root cause analysis investigations
Design, build, analyze and fix large-scale systems
Pro-actively debug and solve production incidents during your on-call shift
Participate in interview loops to help Grab continue hiring top industry talent
Provide technical guidance, mentorship and knowledge sharing to peers.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering , Information Technology or related fields
5+ years of experience in software engineering in a distributed systems environment
Strong Computer Science fundamentals in algorithms and data structures
Familiarity with running large scale web services; understanding of systems internals and networking are a plus
Strong understanding of system performance and scaling
Proficient in English communication
You can be a good coder in any language (C++, C, Java, Scala, Rust, Haskell, OCaml, Erlang, Python, Ruby, PHP, Node.JS, C# etc.), but willing to work on Golang

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
GrabMart, Grab's online grocery and retail delivery platform, is looking for an Associate, Merchant Acquisition to join our team in Vietnam. In this role, you will support end-to-end merchant acquisition and onboarding while collaborating with internal teams to build a strong merchant base and enable sustainable growth.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform:
Merchant Acquisition and Prospecting
Support the identification of merchant gaps and priority categories to strengthen GrabMart's assortment and supply coverage.
Research, qualify, and maintain a pipeline of potential retail merchant partners.
Coordinate the end-to-end acquisition process, from prospecting and pitching to onboarding and contract signing.
Sales and Partnership Support
Prepare and deliver clear presentations that communicate GrabMart's value proposition to prospective merchants.
Support partnership discussions and negotiations to achieve mutually beneficial commercial terms.
Develop customised proposals based on each merchant's business needs and growth objectives.
Acquisition Operations and Optimisation
Follow and continuously improve merchant onboarding processes to ensure efficient and consistent activation.
Coordinate with internal teams and business partners to support smooth merchant activation and handover to daily account management.
Maintain accurate acquisition trackers and provide regular updates on pipeline progress, conversion, and activation performance.
Collaboration and Continuous Improvement
Work closely with relevant teams to align merchant acquisition activities with GrabMart's business priorities.
Support strategic projects and process improvements that enhance the merchant onboarding and partnership experience.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing or a related field
3+ years of experience in sales, business development, or merchant acquisition
Preferably strong understanding of Quick commerce or E-commerce landscape, O2O (offline-to online) or retail tech industry
Communication: both Vietnam and English
Experience to work as part of a team and dynamic culture.
Experience in e-commerce or food delivery industry
Team and people management
Knowledge of digital marketplaces and online grocery delivery services

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
Grab For Business is Grab's enterprise platform, helping companies across the region gain greater visibility and control over spending on employee rides, mobility, and meals.
The Grab For Business regional marketing team drives demand for Grab For Business across Southeast Asia. We collaborate with Commercial, Product, Performance Marketing, PR, and country teams, and we measure ourselves on marketing-sourced revenue pipeline and GMV growth.
Get to Know the Role
You will help build and run the regional marketing programmes that generate demand for Grab For Business across Southeast Asia.
You will build demand among small to medium size businesses, across the full funnel from awareness and acquisition through to conversion and activation. Your success will be measured by brand awareness, marketing-attributed pipeline, and conversion in the programmes you run.
This is a role for someone who wants regional scope and real ownership of execution, with a clear path towards owning strategy. You will report to the Regional Marketing Lead for Grab For Business, and work onsite at our HCMC, Vietnam office.
If you like getting campaigns live across six markets and connecting to what actually moves a business customer, we encourage you to apply.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Run regional campaigns: You will execute integrated demand generation campaigns across digital and offline channels — briefing creative, building assets, coordinating launch, and tracking delivery against targets.
Explore new growth routes: You will test new ways to reach business customers beyond our existing channels (e.g. co-marketing partnerships, platform and association tie-ups, referral and community plays) and make the case for the ones worth scaling.
Build the toolkits for use in-country: You will develop the campaign strategies, messaging frameworks, and modular assets to deploy across Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines, Vietnam, and Thailand.
Support go-to-market and produce content: You will contribute to go-to-market for new product launches and customer segments, and manage production of customer-facing content, such as case studies, thought leadership pieces, social media and web pages.
Measure and report on performance: You will build and maintain the campaign reporting, work directly in the numbers to show what each channel and market delivered, and bring recommendations on where to shift spend.
Coordinate across teams and vendors: You will work with PR, content, paid media, product marketing, events, and analytics, manage agency and content partners against a brief and budget, and use GenAI and other latest technologies to accelerate research, content production, and analysis.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
You have 5 or more years of relevant experience, such as in B2B marketing, including hands-on campaign delivery and demand generation.
You are comfortable working directly in the numbers and building the analysis that supports a recommendation.
You are good with content, able to write and shape B2B narratives and assets that hold up in front of a business customer.
You have experience engaging with AI tools and latest technologies to enhance productivity, improve workflows, support experimentation, and contribute new ideas.
You are fluent in English, and comfortable working with colleagues across Southeast Asian markets.
Good to have: Experience marketing SaaS or technology products to business customers, experience working across multiple Southeast Asian markets.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
The Growth, Insights & Planning (GIP) team drives the strategic direction for Grab Vietnam. We bridge data and business by uncovering actionable insights about our Food & Mart merchants and passengers. We move beyond raw data extraction, building robust frameworks to understand market dynamics, transaction economics, and user behavior that directly influence Grab's growth.
Get to Know the Role
You will act as a core analytical engine driving commercial growth. You will dive deep into merchant and consumer data to uncover growth levers for GrabFood and GrabMart, translating business challenges into structured, actionable insights. By applying solid problem-solving frameworks and critical thinking, you will partner closely with commercial and marketing teams to evaluate market dynamics, track transaction economics, and elevate the user experience.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Analyze business problems using structured, hypothesis-driven methods to identify growth opportunities and operational bottlenecks.
Work with cross-functional teams to understand their problem statements, convert into a data-driven question, and develop analysis frameworks
Partner with commercial and marketing stakeholders, translating raw data into easy-to-understand business narratives and actionable recommendations.
Utilize and optimize existing analytical frameworks (e.g., competitive positioning, merchant segmentation) to track category performance and market dynamics.
Conduct Root Cause Analyses (RCA) on performance fluctuations, isolating core business drivers from market noise.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
2+ years of experience in data analytics, commercial analysis, or business intelligence roles.
Structural thinking and analytical skills, including proficiency in SQL, Excel (can maintain complex spreadsheets), PowerBI
Intellectual curiosity to proactively identify high-impact growth levers, while maintaining an eagerness to master market dynamics, analytical frameworks, and emerging GenAI technologies.
Good business acumen with the ability to translate technical data into actionable commercial insights.
Strong written and verbal communication skills in both English and Vietnamese. Good to Have Experience building, automating, or managing end-to-end ETL data pipelines.
Familiarity with GenAI tools (e.g., LLMs, prompt engineering) to accelerate data analysis, query writing, and insight generation.
Experience using Python or R for advanced statistical analysis or predictive modeling.
Familiarity with the food delivery, online grocery, e-commerce, or broader O2O (Online-to-Offline) landscape in Vietnam.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
The Streaming Data team (aka "Coban") strives to enable seamless and secure real-time access to the continuous events or "streams", serving as Grab's unified, common access pattern for real-time data. We build the platform for writing, consuming, enriching and retrieving real-time data, and provide a cost-effective, fully managed "NoOps" service for all product teams to leverage.
Get to know the team
The functional areas this team covers are streaming (Kafka/AutoMQ), in-house streaming SDK, stream processing framework (Flink, Flink SQL, Kafka Connect), Change Data Capture, stream exploration (Zeppelin, Flink SQL Gateway), as well as an in-house control plane for tenancy and resource management.
Our customers are engineers, analysts, and data scientists at Grab (across all verticals like Transport, Deliveries, Geo, Ads, and various Fintech verticals), who leverage realtime data for state machines, pub/sub architectures, insights and reporting, forecasting and anomaly detection, as well as online feature engineering. The team is responsible for mission critical systems and clusters that ingest and process 10s of TB of data every hour and make streaming data simple, convenient and reliabily for engineers across Grab to use.
Get to Know the Role
Senior Engineers are expected to be significant and autonomous contributors to their team, trusted with designing, shipping, operating and monitoring software systems in a consistently high-quality manner. You would work on the Golang components of the team, such as our in-house streaming SDK, control planes, etc , considering the appropriate architectural patterns, code design, and infrastructure options, ensuring that you deliver a secure, reliable, testable, maintainable, extensible, and well-tested system.
You will report to the Engineering Manager II and will work onsite at CMC Creative Space, Tan Hung ward, HCMC
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Work with a team of cross functional engineers to make Data Streaming and Stream Processing easy and reliably across Grab, primarily via self-served capabilities baked in our control plane and streaming SDK.
Write go code that is well tested across the test pyramid/trophy (unit, integration, end-to-end) and can be maintained by a cross functional team.
Implement and drive large-scale technical initiatives, ensuring seamless platform evolution across the organization
Weigh in on design questions around platformization, infrastructure, observability and security, and work closely with (and build over the platforms provided by) our infrastructure team.
Participate in and evolve on-call and incident response procedures for the team.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
4+ years of experience in software engineering.
Hands-on proficiency with at least one programming language (preferably Golang)
Effective communication in written and spoken English.
You are excited to learn new programming languages and apply new technologies.
The Nice-to-haves
Experience with Kafka, MySQL, Spark, Temporal, Saga patterns.
Experience with Flink, Kafka Connect, Kubernetes, Gitlab CI, AWS, Terraform.

sections.text:
Get to know our Team
Join the FundsCore platform team at Grab - a dynamic and fast-paced team building a reliable platform to address challenging problems in the Payments domain. We are a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, product managers, business, and operations who innovate and collaborate to solve some of the most challenging problems - enabling reliable reconciliation with many financial partners and offering accurate and timely settlement to many merchants. This role prefers you have exceptional quick-learning skills.
Get to Know the Role
You will be responsible for owning test strategy planning, priorisation, execution, maintenance, and promoting automation and best practice in testing to ensure high product quality in FundsCore platforms.
You will be participating in our full software development life cycle, including contributions to our product or system design. And as a Software Engineer in Test (SET), you are expected to contribute to fixing bugs and driving our Operational Excellence, such as performing On-Call duties.
You will report to a Senior Engineering Manager and work onsite at Grab HCMC, Vietnam office.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Determine the test coverage and the types of tests required through an understanding of the user stories, the important aspects of a feature, its system design and its code, meeting system and product quality standards
Identify and classify critical test cases and implement them to safeguard our systems and products
Remove reliance on manual test cases through migration to more automated testing methods (e.g. UAT) or through automating the existing tests and retiring obsolete/non-useful tests cases for engineering excellence
Take necessary measures to ensure a team's test repertoire meets the balance mandated by the Testing Pyramid
Know what current best practice requires, and ensure the team is conforming to it
Advise the team for making decisions as to when to invest in refactoring existing test cases to conform to newer practices and technologies
Take the responsibility to design and review medium and large tests at an early (pre-development) stage
Build, extend, and customise the team's testing frameworks

sections.text:
Get to know our Team:
Chroma is a full-stack team within Grab's Web Platform group. We build the foundational tooling, frameworks, and infrastructure that accelerate web development across the entire company — from CI/CD pipelines and reusable component libraries to modern micro-frontend architecture that powers dozens of internal applications.
Beyond platform engineering, we design and maintain large-scale internal web portals serving teams across Data, AI, and Business domains — including a unified notification infrastructure that delivers timely, actionable information to users across all internal platforms.
We are also pioneering AI-powered developer automation — building intelligent agents that can autonomously implement features, fix bugs, resolve code review feedback, and deploy changes end-to-end from a natural language prompt. This is where platform engineering meets AI to fundamentally reshape how engineers ship software.
We are a group of passionate engineers who love to create beautiful and functional web applications that enhance the productivity and efficiency of Grab employees.
Get to know the Role:
As a Fullstack Engineer in the Chroma team, you'll be part of Grab's Web Platform group, responsible for building the core infrastructure and modern micro-frontend architecture that powers internal web applications across the company.
Your work will span three key areas:
1. Platform Engineering: Design and build CI/CD-ready frameworks, frontend infrastructure, and reusable UI components that enable other teams to efficiently develop high-quality web applications at scale.
2. Application Development: Build and maintain scalable, user-focused internal web portals and cross-platform systems — including notification infrastructure that surfaces critical information to users across all internal tools.
3. AI-Powered Developer Tooling: Contribute to building intelligent engineering agents — designing agentic workflows, tool integrations, and evaluation frameworks that enable autonomous code generation, review, and deployment across the web platform.
You'll be involved throughout the entire development lifecycle, from architecture and design to deployment and performance optimization, playing a key role in shaping the future of web development at Grab.
The Day-to-Day activities:
Design, develop, and maintain internal web portals, reusable UI components, and cross-platform notification systems.
Develop and maintain web platform tooling and frameworks used for building React applications at Grab.
Build micro-frontend architecture and integration patterns that enable teams to independently develop and deploy their applications.
Design and improve AI agent capabilities — building tool integrations, agentic workflows, and evaluation harnesses that enable autonomous software delivery.
Collect and analyze user feedback, identifying areas for improvement and prioritizing feature development accordingly.
Implement best practices for web development, ensuring high-quality code and adhering to performance, security, and accessibility standards.
Maintain thorough documentation of platform design, features, and functionality, effectively communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Continuously assess new technologies and techniques to enhance the engineering capabilities of the team.
Proactively identify and troubleshoot issues, implement fixes, and ensure platform stability and performance.
The Must-Haves:
At least 5 years of experience working with modern frontend frameworks such as ReactJS (preferred), Ant Design, Micro Frontends, and Webpack.
Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to effectively provide updates and resolutions to customers and cross-functional partners.
Solid experience in web development, along with a willingness to engage in continuous learning to stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies.
Familiarity with CI/CD processes and tools, with hands-on experience integrating frontend applications into automated build and deployment pipelines.
Comfortable working across the stack, with familiarity in building APIs, implementing Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) layers, and working with databases when needed to support frontend functionality.
Interest or experience in AI/LLM-powered developer tools, agentic systems, or developer productivity automation is a plus.
Tech stacks: Javascript, Typescript, React, Go, LLM/Agent frameworks

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

discovery:smartrecruiters:Grab:744000144.description:
Get to know our Team:
Chroma is a full-stack team within Grab's Web Platform group. We build the foundational tooling, frameworks, and infrastructure that accelerate web development across the entire company — from CI/CD pipelines and reusable component libraries to modern micro-frontend architecture that powers dozens of internal applications.
Beyond platform engineering, we design and maintain large-scale internal web portals serving teams across Data, AI, and Business domains — including a unified notification infrastructure that delivers timely, actionable information to users across all internal platforms.
We are also pioneering AI-powered developer automation — building intelligent agents that can autonomously implement features, fix bugs, resolve code review feedback, and deploy changes end-to-end from a natural language prompt. This is where platform engineering meets AI to fundamentally reshape how engineers ship software.
We are a group of passionate engineers who love to create beautiful and functional web applications that enhance the productivity and efficiency of Grab employees.
Get to know the Role:
As a Fullstack Engineer in the Chroma team, you'll be part of Grab's Web Platform group, responsible for building the core infrastructure and modern micro-frontend architecture that powers internal web applications across the company.
Your work will span three key areas:
1. Platform Engineering: Design and build CI/CD-ready frameworks, frontend infrastructure, and reusable UI components that enable other teams to efficiently develop high-quality web applications at scale.
2. Application Development: Build and maintain scalable, user-focused internal web portals and cross-platform systems — including notification infrastructure that surfaces critical information to users across all internal tools.
3. AI-Powered Developer Tooling: Contribute to building intelligent engineering agents — designing agentic workflows, tool integrations, and evaluation frameworks that enable autonomous code generation, review, and deployment across the web platform.
You'll be involved throughout the entire development lifecycle, from architecture and design to deployment and performance optimization, playing a key role in shaping the future of web development at Grab.
The Day-to-Day activities:
Design, develop, and maintain internal web portals, reusable UI components, and cross-platform notification systems.
Develop and maintain web platform tooling and frameworks used for building React applications at Grab.
Build micro-frontend architecture and integration patterns that enable teams to independently develop and deploy their applications.
Design and improve AI agent capabilities — building tool integrations, agentic workflows, and evaluation harnesses that enable autonomous software delivery.
Collect and analyze user feedback, identifying areas for improvement and prioritizing feature development accordingly.
Implement best practices for web development, ensuring high-quality code and adhering to performance, security, and accessibility standards.
Maintain thorough documentation of platform design, features, and functionality, effectively communicating with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Continuously assess new technologies and techniques to enhance the engineering capabilities of the team.
Proactively identify and troubleshoot issues, implement fixes, and ensure platform stability and performance.
The Must-Haves:
At least 5 years of experience working with modern frontend frameworks such as ReactJS (preferred), Ant Design, Micro Frontends, and Webpack.
Strong communication skills in English, with the ability to effectively provide updates and resolutions to customers and cross-functional partners.
Solid experience in web development, along with a willingness to engage in continuous learning to stay up to date with industry trends and emerging technologies.
Familiarity with CI/CD processes and tools, with hands-on experience integrating frontend applications into automated build and deployment pipelines.
Comfortable working across the stack, with familiarity in building APIs, implementing Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) layers, and working with databases when needed to support frontend functionality.
Interest or experience in AI/LLM-powered developer tools, agentic systems, or developer productivity automation is a plus.
Tech stacks: Javascript, Typescript, React, Go, LLM/Agent frameworks

Life at Grab
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave , and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to know the team :
The Agent Experience team owns and operates the mission-critical internal platforms that power the end-to-end customer support and engagement ecosystem for the entire Grab superapp. Our technology directly impacts millions of users across Southeast Asia by enabling teams to seamlessly serve Passengers , Merchants, Drivers, Finance partners, and internal business lines across every vertical for support experiences
Because the entire Grab ecosystem relies on our platforms to resolve critical support issues, handle complex transactions, and protect customer trust, we design and scale our platforms to be AI-first, ultra-high availability, correctness & reliability
Get to Know the Role
We are looking for a strategic and business-driven Software Engineering Manager to guide the technical roadmap and business execution for this massive horizontal platform. In this high-impact role, you will act as a leader managing a robust organization that includes fullstack, backend, senior, and lead engineers.
You will also serve as a mentor to your teammates to help them grow. You will work onsite at CMC Creative Space, district 7, HCMC and report to the Manager, who is based in Singapore.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Lead a team of engineers across different tech stacks. You'll participate in code and design reviews to maintain our high development standards.
Partner with cross functional leaders across product, design, analytics to build the product roadmap, set customer-focused metrics and experiment designs.
Lead the quarterly planning and build a smooth execution plan with the team for securing the delivery of product and engineering roadmap.
Set the engineering strategy and engineering key result targets for the team, consistently improve across testability, availability, security and code quality for your systems and modules.
Attract and retain senior engineering talent, actively mentor and develop engineering talent in the team and across Grab.
Keep your team staffing aligned with business needs and quickly pivot to changing needs
Growth & Coaching: Foster a high-performance engineering culture. Actively mentor, develop, and retain engineering talent at all levels, cultivating the next generation of technical leaders and managers at Grab.
Strategic Communication: Act as a functional expert and evangelist, successfully selling strategic product ideas to executive-level partners and bridging communication between technical teams and non-technical business stakeholders.
Scaling and Hiring: Keep your organization's staffing tightly aligned with evolving business needs, proactively attracting top-tier talent to sustain a complex, fast-growing engineering ecosystem.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
At least 10 years of engineering experience with
Organizational Scaling: Experience building and scaling complex engineering organizations.
Distributed Systems Expertise: Advanced expertise in distributed systems, specifically those focused on high availability, performance, and reliability.
Full Accountability: Experience managing platforms that serve diverse use cases and products simultaneously.
Cross-Vertical Support: Strategic Context: Ability to bring business context into technical decisions and benchmark performance against industry standards.
People Management : Experience managing a large team of junior to lead engineers/managers
Minimum 5+ Years of experience leading people
Exposure to AI-assisted or agentic development tooling
Strategic Authority: Ability to define the technology direction for a department and propose new ideas to bring organizational strategy.
Expertise and Collaboration: skills in coordinating across a vast landscape of partners to ensure seamless support for the ecosystem.
Cultural Understanding: A leader guided by "The Grab Way" principles: Heart, Hunger, Honour, and Humility.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Role
The Team Lead, Partner Social Engagement will own and drive the strategy and execution for Grab's Driver Partner social engagement. This role uniquely combines strategic sentiment management, creative multimedia content production, community engagement, and data analytics to strengthen driver retention, brand loyalty, and a positive community narrative across social platforms (Meta, TikTok, Threads, forums).
Co-located in Ho Chi Minh City with key stakeholders, this high-ownership role steers narrative direction, supervises seeding efforts, leads driver engagement projects, and translates social listening data into actionable strategic solutions.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
1. Strategic Community & Sentiment Leadership
Own the overarching narrative direction and execution strategy for the driver social seeding team to shape positive, transparent, and constructive conversations across driver communities.
Proactively monitor, protect, and enhance Driver Community Sentiment by identifying emerging risks, sensitive topics, and operational discussions on social media early.
Develop strategic initiatives to improve driver behaviors, digital etiquette, and brand advocacy across social channels.
Align closely with regional teams and key HCM-based stakeholders to facilitate rapid decision-making, strong alignment with local partners.
2. Data Analytics, Social Listening & Strategic Insights
Partner with regional teams and key stakeholders to develop, optimize, and leverage Social Listening Tools to track driver sentiment, viral trends, and feedback metrics.
Conduct deep-dive quantitative and qualitative analyses into community sentiment data to pinpoint root causes of driver pain points and derive actionable solutions.
Deliver regular sentiment reporting, performance dashboards, and insights to guide strategic planning and senior leadership decision-making.
3. Content Creation, Campaign Planning & Trend Execution
Plan, script, shoot, and edit engaging multimedia content tailored for key social platforms (Meta, TikTok, Threads) to educate, engage, and inspire driver partners.
Lead and execute core driver engagement campaigns and Business-As-Usual (BAU) programs, including GrabTalks initiatives and Driver Creator / KOL growth projects.
Act as an active trend-watcher to adapt viral social media formats and trends into relatable driver-facing content and community campaigns.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
Requirements & Experience
Experience: 4+ years of hands-on experience in Social Media Management, Community Engagement, Content Strategy, or Digital Communications (preferably in tech platforms, gig-economy, agency, or fast-paced digital environments). Experience can be as a senior individual contributor (IC) or team lead.
Core Competencies:
High Ownership: Complete end-to-end accountability from concept generation and strategic planning to execution and data-driven evaluation.
Data & Analytical Skills: Strong ability to analyze social metrics and qualitative data to generate clear business insights and creative solutions.
Strategic Planning & Creativity: Proven track record of structuring long-term engagement plans while staying creative and trend-savvy.
Content & Social Mastery:
Deep understanding of major platforms (Facebook/Meta, TikTok, Threads, YouTube) including their algorithms, trends, and user behaviors.
Direct hands-on production skills: ability to shoot/film, script, edit, and write compelling digital content in natural Vietnamese.
Language Skills: Professional proficiency in English and native-level fluency in natural, conversational Vietnamese.
Desired Mindset & Attributes
Outgoing & Active: Articulate, energetic, and comfortable connecting with diverse driver communities.
Proactive & Resilient: Empathetic towards driver partners, and skilled at handling sensitive online situations with tact and judgment.
Nice-to-Have (Bonus Points)
Active Content Creator / Vlogger with personal social media channels or a proven online audience.
Experience participating in or managing large online driver/transportation communities.
Proficiency with mobile video editing and design tools (e.g., CapCut, Premiere, Canva).
Why You'll Love Working Here
High-Impact Ownership: Direct strategic responsibility for engagement initiatives that impact thousands of driver partners daily.
Creative Freedom: Ample room to test innovative content formats, launch creator programs, and shape positive brand sentiment across top digital platforms.
Collaborative Environment: Work directly alongside regional teams and key stakeholders in a prime Ho Chi Minh City office location.

sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
GrabFood, a food delivery platform in Southeast Asia, is looking for an Account Management Specialist to join our team in Thua Thien Hue, Vietnam.
Get to Know the Role
You will manage our merchant partners, ensuring their success on the GrabFood platform.
You will report to Manager, Key Account Management - Expansion
You will work onsite at Da Nang city.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
You will manage a portfolio of important merchants with a focus on building lasting relationships and increasing profitability/revenue.
You will communicate with important merchants for merchant-funded promo programs, partnerships, new products, and new features.
You will identify bottlenecks and potential issues related to merchant operations and provide solutions to these issues.
You will improve growth of important accounts by analyzing data and developing plans to increase profitability/revenues aligned with country targets.
You will implement business improvement projects to create value for both merchants and Grab.
You will evaluate strategic and partnership opportunities, performing a broad range of quantitative and qualitative analyses.
You will work across departments to tailor merchant-specific needs, such as customized reporting, marketing support, and integrations, and lead by collaborating with merchants and operations teams.
You will stay updated on industry trends, new technologies and changing consumer preferences in F&B.
You will always gather feedback and look for ways to improve skills and performance in the role.
You will coordinate with the merchant and departments to further develop services within the Grab ecosystem, including omnichannel, GrabMart,..

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field
You have 2 years' experience in account management, business development, partnerships, or an equivalent role.
Experience with the food delivery industry and e-commerce market trends
Experience establishing communication and engagement with prospects

sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
The Vietnam Operations team oversees, shapes and grows the business in Grab Vietnam. We develop and execute business strategies to achieve our vision in providing everyday services that matter most to consumers in Vietnam. Omnicommerce is a fast-growing vertical within Grab. Omnicommerce works with a wide range of food merchants on Deals, Reservation, Loyalty,... As part of the Commercial team, you will play a key role in shaping the strategy, building partnerships, and driving execution to grow Grab's presence and impact across Southeast Asia.
Get to Know the Role
This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the future of Grab's Omnicommerce strategy. You will be at the forefront of driving growth for our "Online-to-Offline" (O2O) initiatives, including Dine Out Deals, Reservations, and Loyalty Programs and many more.
We are looking for a strategic hunter and a data-driven grower. You will not only acquire top-tier F&B Chains and strategic POS (Point of Sale) Partners but also act as a consultant to incubate their performance, ensuring they maximize their revenue potential within the Grab ecosystem.
From ideation to execution, you will be empowered to build new growth engines. We value ambition, curiosity, and collaboration as we pioneer the next phase of Grab's transformation.
You will report to the Head, GrabMart & Omnicommerce and work onsite at Mapletree Business Centre office.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
1. Merchant Incubation & Performance
End-to-End Sales: Drive the entire sales cycle for large F&B Key Accounts, from lead generation and tailored pitching to contract negotiation.
O2O Growth: Secure high-value merchants for Omnicommerce solutions (DineOut Deals, Reservations and Omni services) by structuring mutually beneficial commercial deals.
2. Merchant Incubation & Performance
Incubation Ownership: Manage the early lifecycle of new merchants to drive immediate GMV and adoption.
Consultative Optimization: Analyze data to advise merchants on menu engineering, pricing, and marketing, turning new sign-ups into "power users."

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
Experience & Background:
Minimum 2-4 years of experience in Business Development, Enterprise Sales, or Key Account Management.
Industry Context: Proven track record in the F&B industry or SaaS/Tech Sales targeting the hospitality sector. Experience working with POS systems or food aggregators is a massive plus.
Network: Existing network within local F&B chains or retail technology providers is highly advantageous.
Skills & Competencies:
Commercial Acumen: Strong ability to understand P&L, negotiate commercial terms, and structure complex deals.
Strategic Planning: Ability to move from high-level strategy (ecosystem building) to execution (closing the deal).
Experience researching and generating leads: Comfortable using data to diagnose merchant performance issues and propose solutions.
Experience establishing communication and engagement with stakeholders; capable of influencing executives at big chains and internal cross-functional teams.
Attributes:
Ambitious & Resilient: A result-driven who thrives in a fast-grow environment and is not afraid of bold targets.
Entrepreneurial: A passion for innovation and "building things from scratch."
Results-Oriented: Focused on delivering measurable impact (Revenue, GMV, Lead Conversion).

Get to Know the Team
The Vietnam Operations team oversees, shapes and grows the business in Grab Vietnam. We develop and execute business strategies to achieve our vision in providing everyday services that matter most to consumers in Vietnam. Omni-commerce is a fast-growing vertical within Grab. Omni-commerce works with a wide range of food merchants on Deals, Loyalty, Reservation... As part of the Commercial team, you will play a key role in shaping the strategy, building partnerships, and driving execution to grow Grab's presence and impact across Southeast Asia.
Get to Know the Role
This role offers a high-impact, senior commercial opportunity to independently drive and scale Grab Vietnam's Omni-commerce business, managing a high-leverage portfolio.
As a Manager, you will operate as an autonomous commercial manager. You will take full end-to-end ownership of new commercial Joint Business Planning (JBP) projects to unlock major growth engines (Dine Out Deals, Reservations, CRM, and loyalty programs). Reporting to Head of the department, you will lead, coach, and elevate a team of Operations, Planner, Account Managers (AMs) and Business Development (BD) specialists, combining deep F&B industry expertise with elite commercial execution to expand Grab's O2O market leadership.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Joint Business Planning (JBP) & Commercial Expansion: Structure, negotiate, and execute strategic, multi-million-dollar Joint Business Plans (JBPs) with top-tier national F&B chains and enterprise brand groups.
Independently identify, pitch, and close high-value commercial deals, designing creative co-investment and promotional models that maximize mutual GMV and Revenue.
Independent Business Steering & Portfolio Ownership: Autonomously steer the Vietnam Omni-commerce commercial roadmap, translating high-level country goals into actionable BD, pitching, and account growth strategies.
Own overall business health, tracking weekly performance, analyzing drivers, and proactively executing course corrections to hit GMV and monetization targets.
People Leadership & Team Coaching: Directly manage, coach, and upskill a commercial squad across Business Development (BD) and Account Management (AM) lines.
Build a culture of commercial excellence, mentoring junior team members on strategic pitching, complex account negotiation.
0-to-1 Operational & GTM Architecture: Design seamless cross-functional SOPs connecting local sales teams, OneGrab cross-vertical squads, and regional product teams into a unified commercial engine.
Orchestrate multiple, high-speed Go-To-Market (GTM) product rollouts in parallel

sections.text:

Experience: 7+ years of commercial experience in Business Development, Key Account Management, or Commercial Strategy within the F&B, Retail, E-Commerce, or O2O tech sectors.
Proven track record of independently structuring and closing complex Joint Business Plans (JBPs) or enterprise commercial partnerships.
F&B Domain Mastery & Business Ownership: Deep, nuanced understanding of the Vietnam F&B landscape, restaurant operating economics, and enterprise brand dynamics.
Proven capability to run a business line independently, demonstrating strong financial acumen (P&L, take rates, margin optimization);
Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Drive, coach, and elevate commercial teams, transitioning from individual contribution to multiplying impact through others.
Exceptional C-level negotiation, executive presentation, and matrix stakeholder management skills (aligning local operations, legal/compliance, and regional product teams).

People Leadership & Team Coaching: Directly manage, coach, and upskill a commercial squad across Business Development (BD) and Account Management (AM) lines.
Build a culture of commercial excellence, mentoring junior team members on strategic pitching, complex account negotiation.
0-to-1 Operational & GTM Architecture: Design seamless cross-functional SOPs connecting local sales teams, OneGrab cross-vertical squads, and regional product teams into a unified commercial engine.
Orchestrate multiple, high-speed Go-To-Market (GTM) product rollouts in parallel

Experience: 7+ years of commercial experience in Business Development, Key Account Management, or Commercial Strategy within the F&B, Retail, E-Commerce, or O2O tech sectors.
Proven track record of independently structuring and closing complex Joint Business Plans (JBPs) or enterprise commercial partnerships.
F&B Domain Mastery & Business Ownership: Deep, nuanced understanding of the Vietnam F&B landscape, restaurant operating economics, and enterprise brand dynamics.
Proven capability to run a business line independently, demonstrating strong financial acumen (P&L, take rates, margin optimization);
Leadership & Stakeholder Management: Drive, coach, and elevate commercial teams, transitioning from individual contribution to multiplying impact through others.
Exceptional C-level negotiation, executive presentation, and matrix stakeholder management skills (aligning local operations, legal/compliance, and regional product teams).

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
The Streaming Data team (a.k.a. Coban) ensures seamless and secure real-time access to continuous events or streams, serving as Grab's unified access pattern for real-time data. We build the infrastructure and platform for writing and consuming real-time data, and provide a cost-effective, managed NoOps service for product and data teams across Grab. We partner closely with sister teams in DataTech to provide integrated data platforms that unlock big data innovation every day.
Some examples of the team's work are shared publicly on the Grab Engineering blog:
Building a self-serve streaming platform for Kafka topics, Flink, CDC pipelines, Kafka Connect, and notebooks ( An elegant platform ).
Making Flink deployments safer through platform guardrails and production deployment patterns ( Safer deployment of streaming applications ).
Enabling FlinkSQL exploration and productionisation so users can move faster from streaming ideas to running pipelines ( The complete stream processing journey on FlinkSQL ).
Improving Flink release confidence with shadow testing ( Enhancing Flink deployment with shadow testing ).
Strengthening real-time Kafka data quality with syntactic and semantic stream contracts ( Real-time data quality monitoring ).
These are examples of the platform thinking this role will continue to advance: taking complex real-time infrastructure problems and turning them into reliable, self-service capabilities for Grab teams.
Grab needs a manager to scale real-time data platforms
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
The team turns streaming complexity into self-service platforms
The Streaming Data team, also known as Coban, owns Grab's real-time data platform. We build and operate the infrastructure that helps Grab teams write, process, govern, and consume continuous event streams safely at scale. Our platform brings together Kafka, Apache Flink, change data capture, Kafka Connect, notebooks, deployment guardrails, observability, and data quality capabilities so product and data teams can ship real-time pipelines with confidence.
The team partners closely with Kafka, data lake, metrics, governance, experimentation, and business-facing data teams across Data Engineering Platforms. We care deeply about platform leverage: making complex distributed systems reliable, efficient, secure, and easy enough for many internal users to adopt without creating operational toil.
The role owns people, platform direction, and production outcomes
As Engineering Manager II, Flink Platform, you will build, grow, and lead a Vietnam-based engineering team responsible for the evolution and operation of Grab's stream processing platform. You will guide the team roadmap, coach engineers, raise engineering standards, and partner with stakeholders across Grab to make Apache Flink a safer and more productive compute layer for real-time data.
You will work onsite at Grab Vietnam office in HCMC and report into Data Engineering Platforms leadership. This is a hands-on engineering management role. You are expected to stay close to technical design, reliability trade-offs, incident learning, and platform execution while scaling impact through your team.
This platform unlocks the real-time signals Grab needs next
Apache Flink is a critical compute layer for real-time signals, automation, data products, and decision-making across Grab.
A stronger Flink platform helps internal teams move from streaming ideas to production pipelines faster, with better guardrails and less operational risk.
A small platform team must support many production workloads, so the manager will multiply impact through self-service workflows, reusable abstractions, and clear ownership models.
As Grab accelerates AI-assisted and agentic engineering, high-quality real-time data becomes an even more important foundation for reliable automation.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
You will lead delivery, reliability, and team growth
Lead a team of Flink platform engineers in Vietnam, including hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, and career development.
Own quarterly planning, team objectives, prioritization, and delivery of the Flink platform roadmap in partnership with Data Engineering Platforms leaders and internal users.
Set high engineering standards across system design, code quality, testing, documentation, operational readiness, security, and cost efficiency.
Guide technical design for self-service Flink capabilities, deployment safety, production guardrails, observability, platform automation, and reusable libraries or modules.
Drive operational excellence through on-call readiness, incident response, post-incident learning, service level objectives, capacity planning, and continuous reliability improvement.
Partner with Kafka, data lake, metrics, governance, SRE, security, and product engineering teams to make real-time pipelines reliable across Grab's broader data ecosystem.
Represent the team with clear communication to technical and non-technical stakeholders, turning ambiguous platform needs into practical execution plans.
Strong candidates combine platform depth with management craft
8+ years of professional software engineering, data engineering, or platform engineering experience, with 3+ years managing engineers or leading engineering teams.
Experience building, operating, or managing distributed systems, data platforms, stream processing platforms, or other high-scale backend infrastructure in production.
Hands-on technical depth in Apache Flink, Spark Streaming, Kafka, or comparable large-scale data processing technologies.
Strong understanding of reliability engineering, production operations, observability, incident response, capacity planning, and security practices for critical platforms.
Proven ability to set roadmap, make prioritization calls under ambiguity, lead execution, and deliver measurable outcomes through a team.
Experience coaching engineers, growing technical leaders, hiring strong talent, and building a collaborative team culture across seniority levels.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs and align multiple teams around platform direction.
Additional experience can help the team move faster
Production experience with Apache Flink internals, high availability, checkpointing, state management, job upgrades, shadow testing, and safe deployment patterns.
Experience with Kubernetes, AWS, Terraform, GitLab CI, Go, Java, Scala, or infrastructure-as-code workflows.
Experience building platform abstractions, SDKs, deployment tooling, control planes, self-service workflows, or managed NoOps services.
Experience with data lake or warehouse technologies such as Spark, Parquet, Iceberg, Delta, Hudi, Trino, or Presto.
Exposure to data governance, data quality, stream contracts, platform cost management, or multi-tenant data infrastructure.
Curiosity about AI-assisted engineering and how high-quality real-time data can power safer automation across the company.

sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
Product Strategy team serves as the strategic central planning to drive Food and Express growth in Vietnam. We solve complex operational challenges across driver supply reliability and merchant enterprise growth by uniting commercial planning, product strategy, and AI-driven analytics. Joining us means building scalable GTM strategies and marketplace innovations that directly impact millions of consumers, driver-partners, and merchant partners nationwide.
Get to Know the Role
We're looking for an Associate, Product Strategy (Deliveries) to join our team in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. You will play an important part in shaping the strategic direction of our Deliveries operations and driving product experiments innovation. The team drives problem solving on a broad product portfolio within Deliveries sector (Food, Express) , Drivers experience, and strategic Go-To-Market motions for supply balance and demand creation.
You will report to the Lead, GE and Commercial, Special Projects.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Lead strategic creation of Grab Vietnam Deliveries product roadmaps targeting our Driver-partners with impact analysis.
Fixate roadmap, requirements, specifications with guided business OKRs. Your utmost advantage in this role is to be at the intersection of business and product technology, driving decisions with data-fluent GTM strategies.
Design and deploy impactful experiments (A/B testing, geo-rollouts) to rigorously measure the incremental impact of product features and GTM strategies.
Collaborate with country and regional Product, Strategy teams for roadmap agreement and deployment.
Non-stop incorporate, pivot and iterate in context of changing market trends, competitor moves and Grab strategic visions.
Develop quantitative frameworks to monitor competitive marketplace intelligence and recommend strategic portfolio pivots and GTM sequence adjustments.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
Minimum 3 years of experience with product and business records, preferably in the tech or delivery sector.
Collaborator with will-do and can-do spirit, able to work with multiple departments and country- regional stakeholders . Absolute accountability with owned problem spaces.
Elite data fluency and is natural with SQL, Python, Sheets , and automated analytical tools.
Familiarity with agentic analytics tools and agentic models, such as Claude, GPT, and MCPs, is also present. Additionally, applied economics expertise, particularly in platform and pricing dynamics, is possessed.
The ability to use data to drive decisions, measure product performance, and communicate impact is essential. This skill also involves getting buy-in from senior executives.
Fluent in English and Vietnamese.
Experience with product technical sides to communicate business needs with our engineering team.
Just be so excited about what you do , show that you care about our product, our users, and our business as the future of technology.

sections.text:
Get to know the Team
Grabber Technology Solutions (GTS) aims to be a technology leader that provides predictive and seamless experiences to all Grab employees (Grabbers). We are a diverse team of technology practitioners committed to delivering positive, personalized, and reliable IT experiences that help Grabbers do their best work.
Get to know the Role
The EUC Specialist is a role responsible for owning defined end-user computing (EUC) operational outcomes and improving workplace technology experiences for Grabbers. This role is expected to independently manage scoped operational workstreams, identify recurring user pain points, and drive service improvements through data, documentation, automation, and close collaboration with internal teams and managed service partners. You will report to the Senior Country IT Manager. This is an onsite role based in Ho Chi Minh city.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Own day-to-day EUC operations for the assigned site or country, ensuring reliable support and service quality.
Manage vendor escalations, monitor performance, and ensure timely corrective actions.
Create and improve SOPs, user guides, records, and knowledge-base content.
Collaborate with GTS teams and stakeholders to resolve issues and improve end-user services.
Support compliance and operational improvement initiatives through accurate asset management, automation, reporting, AI tools, and process standardisation.

3+ years of experience in IT operations, service desk, workplace technology, or a related field.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills .

Role is a balance of data analysis, financial planning and stakeholder management:
Develop frameworks to analyze business problems, develop hypotheses, mine data, deliver recommendations, and assess the impact of proposed solutions.
Partner closely with all business stakeholders across different functions to set and implement the strategy.
To perform this role well the candidate will need to have an excellent team player mindset & passionate with innovation

Monitor & manage day-to-day marketplace growth metrics, investigate short-term anomalies and troubleshoot with the relevant team as needed.

Set up campaigns on the system. Monitor and adjust campaign performance on a daily basis.
Conduct preliminary analysis to drive insight on effectiveness and impact of the campaign to revenue and demand growth

sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
The Vietnam Central Operations team helps build a reliable and sustainable driver supply ecosystem. Working closely with driver acquisition, operations, commercial, finance, legal and product teams, we design practical partnerships that improve growth, engagement and operating performance across Vietnam.
Get to Know the Role
As Lead Commercial Partnerships, you will develop and commercialize cooperative partnerships that support sustainable four-wheel driver growth in Vietnam. You will own the day-to-day execution of the Cooperative Tiering strategy, strengthen partner engagement and translate partnership opportunities into measurable business outcomes.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
You will report directly to the Head of Central Operations, Vietnam and work in close partnership with the Acquisition Manager and cross-functional teams. This role is based in Ho Chi Minh City and follows Grab's local working arrangement. It offers the opportunity to shape a new commercial capability and grow into broader strategic partnership ownership.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
You will have 5 or more years of experience in commercial partnerships, business development, sales, account management or a related field, with evidence of delivering partner or business outcomes.
You will have practical experience in commercial negotiation, proposal development and partnership lifecycle management, from opportunity assessment through execution and review.
You will be able to translate ambiguous business opportunities into structured plans, measurable targets across multiple teams.
You will use data and financial reasoning to evaluate opportunities, monitor performance and make commercially sound recommendations.
You will be engaging senior external partners and internal stakeholders, with strong written and verbal communication in Vietnamese and English.
You will be comfortable operating independently, prioritizing competing workstreams and solving problems.
You have experience engaging with AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, improve workflows and contribute new ideas.Good to Have Experience working with cooperatives, fleet operators, transport associations or other partner-based mobility ecosystems.
Experience in driver acquisition, marketplace operations, mobility, logistics or platform businesses.
Experience designing partner segmentation, tiering, loyalty or incentive programs.
Experience working across Vietnam's major cities and understanding local mobility or workforce dynamics.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
Join the FundsCore Platform team at Grab - a dynamic team building a reliable platform to address challenging problems in the Payments domain. We are a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, product managers, and operations. We innovate and collaborate to solve one of the most challenging problems: enabling accurate settlement to large numbers of merchants. This role prefers you have certain Payments domain expertise or demonstrate quick-learning skills.
Get to Know the Role
You will be responsible for designing, building and maintaining one of our Payments Core (FundsCore) platforms which includes complex backend systems and data pipelines to meet both functional and non-functional requirements.
You will contribute to our Operational Excellence and mentoring juniors in the team.
You will report to an Engineering Manager and work onsite at Grab Vietnam office at Ho Chi Minh City.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Design, develop, and maintain high-quality, scalable software applications that meet business and non-functional requirements
Write clean, efficient, testable, and maintainable code to solve challenging problems in the Fintech domain
Collaborate with other teams to define, design, and deliver new features
Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality, ensure proper technical documentation, and facilitate knowledge sharing
Troubleshoot and debug complex issues, providing fixes and implementing long-term sustainable solutions
Contribute to architectural decisions and the technical direction of projects
Ensure system reliability through observability practices and drive continuous improvements in Operational Excellence; participate in On-Call rotations is mandatory
Provide DevOps support to the team to ensure system health and performance
Mentor junior engineers and interns, encouraging a culture of learning and improvement
Stay current with latest industry trends and technologies; leverage Generative AI tools to improve productivity and convert to outcomes

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering , or a related field
5+ years of relevant software development experience with proficiency in one or more major programming languages such as Golang (preferred), Java, or demonstrated ability to quickly acquire necessary skills
Good Computer Science fundamentals in algorithms and data structures, and know when and how to apply them effectively
Fluent in English (verbal and written)
The ability to address not only happy path scenarios but also handle edge cases and unhappy paths
Experience employing AI tools to significantly improve project delivery
Solid understanding of clean architecture principles, data-driven application design, and large-scale data processing
Proven experience building large-scale distributed systems utilizing DBMS, caching solutions, NoSQL databases, and application servers (RESTful and gRPC) while ensuring data consistency
Hands-on experience with microservices architecture, cloud platforms (e.g., AWS), and DevOps practices
Operational and compliance excellence – proven ability to implement solutions that meet requirements for Observability, SLAs, Security, Data Governance, and Regulatory compliance
Ability to write efficient, extensible, and thoroughly tested code for complex projects, selecting appropriate abstractions that adhere to SOLID principles
Ability to write effective design documents and maintain up-to-date documentation (e.g., runbooks)
Proven experience or solid knowledge about Fintech and Payments is preferred. Working knowledge about Settlement and Reconciliation is a bonus.
