sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
The Central Operations team is a key part of Grab Vietnam's country operations. The team supports the smooth and efficient running of Grab's marketplace operations, with a strong focus on driver-partners, merchant-partners, operational quality, and business performance.
Get to Know the Role
We are seeking a and professional Specialist, Driver Enforcement to join our team in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. In this role, you will be responsible for enforcing driver compliance standards, conducting investigations, and maintaining comprehensive documentation to ensure adherence to traffic regulations and organizational policies, reporting to an Assistant Manager, Driver Enforcement. You will play a critical role in promoting road safety and maintaining the integrity of our driver management program through fair enforcement practices.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Conduct in-depth investigations into driver violations by gathering evidence and documenting findings in comprehensive reports.
Review driver records and safety data to identify patterns and ensure strict compliance with traffic laws and Grab's policies.
Interview drivers and witnesses objectively to obtain critical statements for enforcement cases.
Make sound, data-driven decisions regarding enforcement actions based on violation severity and regulatory guidelines.
Prepare accurate case documentation and maintain organized records of all enforcement activities.
Partner with regional management teams to deploy and execute initiatives focused on elevating the service quality of Grab driver-partners.
Communicate enforcement outcomes and rationale to drivers, internal management, and relevant stakeholders.
Track driver compliance metrics and analyze enforcement data to spot trends and drive continuous improvement.
Maintain the highest level of confidentiality and objectivity in all enforcement proceedings.
Stay abreast of current Vietnamese regulations and changes in company policies.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
Experience & Knowledge: 3+ years proven experience in driver enforcement, compliance, or regulatory roles. Strong grasp of traffic laws and a foundational knowledge of legal principles to apply enforcement procedures effectively.
Planning & Execution: Strong with the proven ability to connect cross-functional teams and drive the end-to-end execution of operational plans.
Present information clearly and effectively to stakeholders.
Investigation & Analytics: Demonstrated ability to conduct investigations, analyze evidence objectively in enforcement matters.
Administration: proficiency in report writing.
Technical Proficiency: Proficient in navigating internal databases, basic skills in using Google Sheets and Google Slides.
Preferred Qualifications:
Language: proficiency in English language
Specialized Training: Certification in conflict resolution or communication.
Industry Background: Experience working with transportation or fleet management organizations.
Software Skills: Experience with case management software, data analysis. Solid knowledge and practical experience in operating and managing data automation workflows.

The platform supports observability, real-time personalization, and business analytics by processing tens of billions of events per hour at petabyte scale.
Customer Data Platform (CDP) enables Grab Teams to onboard and register Grab's customer data and make it available for Online Serving, ML Models, Segmentation, and Real Time targeting to power personalization use cases across the company. Our platform is used across many mission-critical Grab services such as app personalization, experimentation, ads serving, and marketing.
Get to Know the Role
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer for either the Scribe or CDP team that that has multiple different technical stacks:
Programming Languages : Python, Go, Scala
Data Streaming & Processing : Kafka, Apache Flink, Apache Spark
Data Infrastructure & Tooling : Event gateways, Schema validation tools, Instrumentation testing frameworks
The role will report to Engineering Manager in Singapore and work onsite at HCMC, VN
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Design and improve clickstream data pipelines—from event ingestion to insight delivery—and contribute to services/tools for understanding user behavior.
Build scalable platform capabilities for user data onboarding, online serving, and real-time data pipelines/architecture.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
The Observability team at Grab is a dynamic group of engineers dedicated to enhancing system visibility and performance. We foster a collaborative environment where innovation thrives, and team members are encouraged to share ideas and solutions. Our diverse backgrounds and expertise allow us to solve complex challenges and drive impactful results.
Get to Know the Role
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Observability Team. You will be reporting to the Engineering Manager. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining robust observability solutions that ensure the reliability and performance of our systems.
This is an onsite role based in HCMC, Vietnam.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Build and enhance tools, frameworks, and pipelines for monitoring, logging and tracing across Grab's systems.
Integrate new technologies to meeting the needs of users.
Join with the team to define and implement observability standards (e.g., SLIs, SLOs, monitors, alerts, dashboards) that ensure high availability and performance.
Work with other stakeholders to integrate observability best practices into the development lifecycle and improve overall system resilience.
Contribute to on-call rotations and improve post-incident analysis through enhanced observability capabilities.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
5+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 1 year focused on platform engineering, observability, or site reliability engineering (SRE).
Proficiency in a programming languages (Go, Python, Java, or similar)
Hands-on experience with observability / monitoring tools like DataDog, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Jaeger, or OpenTelemetry.
Strong knowledge of distributed systems, microservices architecture, and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools like Terraform, and orchestration languages like Ansible.
Experience with Linux systems and writing scripts to facilitate operation.
Ability to debug complex systems and design solutions that scale with high traffic and data volumes.
Proven track record of working effectively with cross-functional teams.
Excellent ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Good fluency in English (both written & verbal)
Your Advantage
Background in DevOps or infrastructure engineering is an advantage, as it provides valuable context for designing observability solutions that seamlessly integrate with deployment pipelines, monitoring infrastructure, and incident response workflows.

Join our Transaction Platform team — a dynamic group at the core of a critical division focused on ensuring seamless transaction processing across key verticals like Mobility, Food, and Mart. You'll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams spanning Data Science, Analytics, Design, and Operations, in an environment that values both innovation and teamwork.
Get to Know the Role
As a Lead Product Manager for the Transaction Platform Infrastructure space, you'll be at the forefront of building scalable and reliable platform solutions that enables Businesses, Consumers, and Driver partners.
You will work onsite in Grab HCMC Office (CMC Creative Space).

Build reusable platform solutions that unblock multiple verticals and markets.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
Join the team that serves the very core of Grab — the Sentry team. Our systems handle billions of network messages daily for Grab's users, while our service orchestration and discovery platforms ensure the reliability of hundreds of Grab services. Collaborating with infrastructure, security, and product teams, we are looking for experienced engineers to strengthen our platform team.
Get to Know the Role
As part of our team, you will build high-performing solutions that Just Work. Your work will provide the stability and efficiency necessary for millions of daily users. This role is based in Vietnam and hybrid. You will report directly to Engineering Manager, who is based in Singapore.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
You will operate in a multi-cloud environment, designing scalable, zero-downtime network traffic routing and analytics solutions for Grab's "public edge."
You will improve and shape new design architectures with a focus on scalability and performance.
You will collaborate with our infrastructure team to build back-end services. Your joint efforts will be evaluated based on the scalability of the back-end services built and their support for our diverse range of products.
You will be responsible for designing, building, analyzing, and troubleshooting large-scale systems.
You will debug and make necessary modifications to our production software which caters to millions of users across Southeast Asia.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
You need to have solid software engineering and coding skills. Specifically, we're looking for you to have at least 2 years of experience in a backend language Go, Scala, Java or C++.
You understand building microservices architecture and have a good grasp of distributed systems, RESTful APIs, and message queuing systems to develop our back-end services.
Experience with relational databases, such as MySQL, is important.
You have knowledge of software development best practices including version control (specifically Git), unit testing, and continuous integration/deployment (CI/CD) pipelines.
Strong understanding of TCP/IP, HTTP, and the internet.
Experience deploying code in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud environments

sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
At Grab, Talent Acquisition is a strategic partner to the business. We help shape Grab's future workforce by combining market intelligence, strong stakeholder partnership, and disciplined hiring execution to attract high-capability talent. In Vietnam, the TA team plays a key role in helping the business scale with speed, quality, and the right talent density.
Get to Know the Role
We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Team Lead to lead hiring delivery team in Vietnam. You will coach and enable a team of Talent Acquisition Business Partners, partner with business and People leaders, and drive a more strategic, data-informed, and efficient hiring approach. This role is suited for someone who can balance hands-on recruitment leadership with team management, stakeholder influence, and continuous improvement.
You will report to the Country Head of People Operations, Vietnam, based in Ho Chi Minh.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Lead and develop the Vietnam TA team, building capability, engagement, and performance across hiring delivery.
Partner closely with business leaders to translate priorities into actionable hiring strategies, role prioritization, and workforce plans.
Utilize market intelligence, hiring metrics, and candidate funnel insights to provide high-conviction talent advisory and inform equitable decisions.
Drive strong hiring outcomes across speed, quality, candidate experience, and stakeholder experience.
Coach team members to move beyond reactive hiring and build stronger proactive sourcing and pipeline strategies.
Review team performance regularly, identify bottlenecks, and implement improvements to hiring workflows, stakeholder engagement, and operational discipline.
Manage portfolio planning and resource allocation across the Vietnam team to ensure balanced workloads and support business priorities.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders including People Operations, Rewards, Employer Branding, Talent Sourcing, and hiring leaders to deliver a seamless hiring experience.
Champion the use of tools, automation, and AI-enabled ways of working to reduce friction and improve recruiter productivity.
Step into selected hands-on hiring situations when needed to unblock critical roles, coach the team, and stay close to market realities.

10+ years of Talent Acquisition experience , with a proven track record of managing end-to-end recruitment strategies across diverse business functions.

Capability to partner with business leaders, evaluate talent needs, and turn strategic priorities into concrete hiring plans and recruitment actions.
Demonstrated operational discipline in managing recruitment workflows, optimizing candidate funnel health, and using hiring metrics to drive predictable outcomes.
Identify recruitment bottlenecks, remove process friction, and implement continuous improvements that enhance recruiter efficiency, candidate experience, and overall hiring velocity.
Proficiency communicating in English and Vietnamese, with a ability to work across culturally diverse local and regional teams
A collaborative, coaching-oriented leadership style with a focus on raising team capability and performance.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
The Grab Agent Experience team, part of Grab Support Tech Family, builds the systems that power Grab's support journey for consumers, drivers, and merchants. We are transforming support experience through automations, AI-powered solutions and platforms help users & Agents find more relevant information, resolve issues through self-service, and receive faster, more accurate assistance when they need help.
Our team is made up of multiple teams across product, engineering, design, data science, analytics, and business. We are looking for experienced individuals who are user-centric and data-driven, able to think holistically and creatively, communicate well, and are great team players. We like creative team members, people who can think outside the box, influence, and get stuff done even if it seems impossible. We work fast, push the boundaries, and try new things. Sometimes they don't work, so we embrace learning from failures and a culture of lifelong learning.
Get to Know the Role
As a Senior Software Engineer, Fullstack, you will design, build, and operate full-stack systems for Grab Support Tech Family. You will work on Ruby on rails, React, frontend applications, Golang backend services, APIs, microservices, and support workflows that power Help Centre and related support platforms.
You will lead technical designs independently, break down ambiguous problems, align stakeholders, and deliver reliable solutions end to end. You will also own production quality through monitoring, incident response, operational excellence, and continuous improvement of system health.
You will report to the Senior Software Engineering Manager and work onsite at Grab Vietnam office, CMC Creative Space.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Design, build, and maintain full-stack features using Ruby on rails, Golang, and Grab's internal platform tooling.
Lead technical design and implementation for support journeys across Help Centre, support workflows, backend APIs, and internal platforms.
Build scalable, reliable, and observable microservices that integrate with downstream systems and support business-critical operations.
Develop clean, accessible, and maintainable frontend experiences for users, agents, and internal support teams.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, data scientists, QA/SET, and other engineering teams to define requirements and deliver high-quality solutions.
Own production readiness, including monitoring, alerting, dashboards, operational runbooks, and release quality.
Participate in on-call support, incident handling, OPI/OSI follow-ups, root cause analysis, and prevention work.
Use tools such as Datadog, Kibana, logs, metrics, and traces to debug production issues and improve system reliability.
Improve testing practices across unit, integration, UAT, and end-to-end layers, and contribute to GSTF quality metrics.
Review code and technical designs, mentor other engineers, and raise the engineering quality bar across the team.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
4+ years of experience, with strong full-stack development experience.
Hands-on experience with Ruby on rails, React, building production frontend applications, and Golang for backend services, APIs, and microservices.
Good understanding of distributed systems, service design, API design, data modelling, and reliability trade-offs.
Experience leading technical design and delivering projects independently from requirements to production rollout.
Good familiarity with AI-assisted software development and modern AI engineering practices, including effective use of coding agents and LLM APIs in daily development workflows.
Experience building maintainable, testable code with strong unit, integration, and/or end-to-end testing practices.
Strong debugging skills across frontend, backend, logs, metrics, and production systems.
Strong ownership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Mentor engineers, give clear code review feedback, and improve team engineering practices.
The Nice-to-Haves
Experience with Temporal or other workflow orchestration systems.
Experience building AI-powered user experiences, support automation, agent-assist tools, chatbot flows, or intelligent self-service products.
Experience with ticketing systems, Help Centre, CRM, or customer support platforms.

sections.text:
Get to Know the Role:
You'll be a champion of Grab's culture and values, partnering with our business leaders to help them build their organizations and ensure rigorous, clear, and transparent people decisions. Whether coaching our leaders on how to lead their teams, resolving employee relations issues, or managing programs that develop our Grabbers, you stay exceptionally focused on putting them first.
You will manage the day-to-day People Operations, encompassing hiring, onboarding, employee relations, governance, compensation and benefits, retention, performance management, engagement, and learning & development. This role will report to the Regional Head of People Operations and collaborate closely with the People Experience team for optimal Grabbers’ experiences.
The Critical Tasks You will Perform:
You will provide advanced support and internal consulting to the country management team on all people-related matters, designing and monitoring people policies and processes.
You will ensure responsive people services, identify scalable process improvements, and drive people-related projects with relevant stakeholders.
You will act as an advisor and change agent, facilitating collaborative conversations and driving workforce planning, engagement, and development initiatives.
You will establish People metrics, identify necessary policy changes, and execute actions to strengthen culture and performance.
You will oversee the Talent Acquisition strategy, ensuring alignment with business priorities and delivery through Talent Acquisition Business Partners.

HR Leadership Experience : At least 15 years of experience managing multidisciplinary HR teams, with deep expertise in HR audit, compensation and benefits design, and policy setting/redesign.

Stakeholder Management and Multitasking : Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to multitask and complete numerous tasks within deadlines. A proactive and "Can Do" attitude is critical.
Heart, Hunger, Honour, and Humility:
Embrace Grab’s core values and thrive in a dynamic environment.

sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
The Tech PMO sits at the intersection of Engineering, Finance, and Tech Strategy. Our mission is to bring structure, visibility, and scalable operating systems to how Grab Tech plans and executes its technology investments - enabling leadership to make clearer, data-driven decisions as we scale.
Get to Know the Role
We're hiring a Senior Program Manager who operates and automates how Grab Tech plans, governs, and gains visibility into its technology investments.
You'll own real operational outcomes - tech budgeting, vendor governance, portfolio visibility - and you'll build the systems and automations that make those outcomes scalable. This is not a pure PM role and not a pure engineering role. You will run the process and rebuild it as you run it.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Own Tech budgeting and forecasting cycles end-to-end (OPEX, CAPEX, headcount, vendors, infra) - and progressively automate them
Build internal tools, dashboards, and AI-powered workflows that replace manual spreadsheet and reporting work
Drive vendor contract negotiations alongside Procurement and business stakeholders to land favorable commercial outcomes
Improve forecast accuracy and variance transparency through better systems, not more meetings
Build portfolio-level visibility into Tech investment allocation; support scenario modeling and trade-off analysis
Partner with Engineering, Finance, and Tech Strategy to align governance with strategic priorities

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
5–8+ years in BizOps, Strategy, Tech Operations, FP&A, or Consulting, with hands-on operational ownership (not advisory-only)
Demonstrable AI builder skills: scripting, prompt engineering, agentic workflow design, automation tooling (no-code/low-code or code)
Familiarity with procurement processes (RFP, contract negotiation, vendor management) and internal budgeting cycles
Financial fluency (budgeting, forecasting, modeling)
Systems thinker who rebuilds the process as they run it - not someone who chooses between operating and building
Comfortable with senior technical and finance stakeholders

sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
The Group Marketplace team manages Grab's marketplaces across Southeast Asia. You will work with team members across multiple departments by marketplace levers such as pricing, incentives, and allocation. The team also generates business insights and proposes data-driven strategic plans to grow the business across both transport and deliveries.
Get to Know the Role
You will use data-driven insights to create a sustainable, reliable and efficient marketplace for Grab's transport business. We are looking for you to have (a) familiarity with large datasets and experience piecing together data to form insights and (b) ability to work with many different teams including Product and Country Operations. Reporting to Marketplace Manager (Mobility). This position is based at Grab's Mapletree Business Centre, D7, HCMC.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
You will lead projects involving teams to improve metrics on all sides of the marketplace
You will propose new experiments and own end-to-end experimentation process including experiment design, rollout and analysis of results
You will monitor daily marketplace metrics, investigate short-term anomalies and troubleshoot with the product team
You will develop daily tactical solutions and longer-term strategic plans to improve marketplace dynamics
You will work with different teams and departments to support goals and projects of Grab as a whole

You have 4 years+ of relevant working experience with a focus on data analysis and project management
You have graduated bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Economics or a relevant fields
You can perform complex functions in Excel with exposure to SQL or Python with the ability to provide data-driven recommendations
4+ years of experience delivering clear, engaging presentations with proficiency English
Experience applying and utilizing AI tools is a plus.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
The Streaming Data team (a.k.a. Coban) ensures seamless and secure real-time access to continuous events or streams, serving as Grab's unified access pattern for real-time data. We build the infrastructure and platform for writing and consuming real-time data, and provide a cost-effective, managed NoOps service for product and data teams across Grab. We partner closely with sister teams in DataTech to provide integrated data platforms that unlock big data innovation every day.
Some examples of the team's work are shared publicly on the Grab Engineering blog:
Building a self-serve streaming platform for Kafka topics, Flink, CDC pipelines, Kafka Connect, and notebooks ( An elegant platform ).
Making Flink deployments safer through platform guardrails and production deployment patterns ( Safer deployment of streaming applications ).
Enabling FlinkSQL exploration and productionisation so users can move faster from streaming ideas to running pipelines ( The complete stream processing journey on FlinkSQL ).
Improving Flink release confidence with shadow testing ( Enhancing Flink deployment with shadow testing ).
Strengthening real-time Kafka data quality with syntactic and semantic stream contracts ( Real-time data quality monitoring ).
These are examples of the platform thinking this role will continue to advance: taking complex real-time infrastructure problems and turning them into reliable, self-service capabilities for Grab teams.
Get to Know the Role
As a Lead Flink Platform Engineer, you will lead the design, evolution, and operation of Grab's stream processing platform, with Apache Flink as a core compute engine. You will drive medium to large projects across Data Engineering Platforms, mentor senior engineers, and be a technical go-to person for platform architecture, reliability, and production operations. The role is hands-on across Flink, Kafka, AWS cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, observability, and SRE practices. You will work onsite at Grab Singapore office, One North.
Why This Role Matters
In an agentic world, high-quality real-time signals are becoming even more critical to drive automation, decision-making, and measurable business impact.
Apache Flink is a critical real-time infrastructure layer for Grab. By making stream processing easier, safer, and more self-serve, this role helps unlock more real-time signals and turn data into business value across Grab. As Grab embraces agentic engineering, we welcome builders with strong data infrastructure experience and a passion for stream processing to join us.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Lead platform work that makes stream processing easy, reliable, efficient, and secure across Grab through self-serve capabilities built into the platform.
Design and build abstractions, modules, and libraries that lower the barrier to adopting Flink and reduce operational and security toil for users.
Improve automation and self-service workflows that allow a small platform team to support many production Flink pipelines at scale.
Drive technical design discussions, production readiness reviews, incident learning, and long-term architecture improvements.
Partner with Kafka, data lake, metrics, and data governance platform teams to make real-time data pipelines reliable across the broader Grab data ecosystem.
Mentor engineers through design reviews, debugging sessions, code reviews, and operational best practices.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
5+ years leading teams or projects in software engineering, data engineering, or platform engineering disciplines.
Experience building and operating stream processing pipelines in production, preferably with Apache Flink or Spark Streaming.
Strong hands-on engineering experience with Kafka and modern programming languages such as Scala or Java.
Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, scalable data processing, reliability engineering, and production operations.
Ability to lead technical design, mentor engineers, communicate trade-offs clearly, and drive projects from design to production.
Excitement to learn, apply new technologies, and improve platform reliability for many internal users.
The nice-to-haves:
Experience with Kafka Connect, Kubernetes, Go, GitLab CI, AWS, or Terraform.
Experience building reusable platform abstractions, SDKs, deployment tooling, or self-service workflows.
Experience operating Apache Flink in production, including high availability, checkpointing, safe deployments, and incident response.
Experience with a data warehouse or data lake ecosystem such as Spark, Parquet, Iceberg, Delta, or Hudi.

sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
The Grab Support Experience team, part of Grab Support Tech Family, builds the systems that power Grab's support journey for consumers, drivers, and merchants. We are transforming support through automation and AI-powered solutions that help users find more relevant information, resolve issues through self-service, and receive faster, more accurate assistance when they need help.
Get to Know the Role
As a Senior Software Engineer, Fullstack, you will develop full-stack systems for Grab Support Tech Family. You will work on desktop and in-app applications, services, APIs, and automation workflows that power Help Centre and related support platforms.
You will report to Software Engineering Manager II and work onsite at CMC Creative Space, HCMC, Vietnam.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Develop full-stack features using React, TypeScript, Golang, and Grab's internal platform tooling.
Lead technical design and implementation for support journeys across Help Centre, support workflows, backend APIs, and internal platforms.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, data scientists, QA/SET, and other engineering teams to define requirements and create high-quality solutions.
Oversee production readiness, including monitoring, alerting, dashboards, operational runbooks, and release quality.
Participate in on-call support, incident handling, OPI/OSI follow-ups, root cause analysis, and prevention work.
Improve testing practices across unit, integration, UAT, and end-to-end layers, and contribute to GSTF quality metrics.
Review code and technical designs, mentor other engineers, and raise the engineering quality bar across the team.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
4+ years of professional software engineering experience, with full-stack development experience.
Hands-on experience with React and TypeScript for building production frontend applications, and Golang for backend services, APIs, and microservices.
Experience with distributed systems, service design, API design, data modelling, and reliability trade-offs.
Experience leading technical design and delivering projects independently from requirements to production rollout.
Good familiarity with AI-assisted software development and modern AI engineering practices, including use of coding agents and LLM APIs in daily development workflows.
Experience building maintainable, testable code with unit, integration, and end-to-end testing practices.
Debugging skills across frontend, backend, logs, metrics, and production systems.
Experience with a non-relational / noSQL database such as Elasticsearch, MongoDB, or DynamoDB
Experience in version control tools (Git, Bitbucket, etc.)
Strong ownership and stakeholder management skills.
Communication
Ability to mentor engineers, give clear code review feedback, and improve team engineering practices.
The Nice-to-Haves
Experience with Temporal or other workflow orchestration systems.
Experience building AI-powered user experiences, support automation, agent-assist tools, chatbot flows, or intelligent self-service products.
Experience with ticketing systems, Help Centre, CRM, or customer support platforms.
Experience cloud solutions as in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud environments

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
The Growth Insights and Planning (GIP) team is a young, enthusiastic, and passionate team with an intellectual hunger to bring value to both business and society. We work closely with stakeholders across Grab Vietnam and Regional to drive business growth through data-driven insights and strategic initiatives. Our scope encompasses demand planning, growth optimization, vertical strategy development, and acting as the Project Management for key country strategic projects. The team is responsible for generating actionable insights, proposing strategic projects, and leading cross-functional initiatives to grow Grab's business across Mobility, Deliveries (GrabFood, GrabMart, GrabExpress) and Financial Services in Vietnam.
Get to Know the Role
GrabRentals (GR) Vietnam secures and enables vehicle supply for Grab's mobility marketplaces. We build and scale sustainable fleet partner programs that unlock income opportunities for driver-partners while delivering operational reliability and business impact for Grab.
You will be the go-to-market and operating owner for selected fleet partner programs in Vietnam. You will drive end-to-end readiness, launch, and ongoing performance—working across Legal, Tax, Finance, Compliance, Marketplace Operations, and Analytics—to de-risk rollouts, uphold regulatory and commercial integrity, and ensure partner needs and driver income outcomes are met alongside Grab's business goals.
You will report to Manager, IMS Growth, and work onsite at Grab office, Mapletree Business Centre, HCMC.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Insight-Led Stakeholder Orchestration: Translate analytical insights into actionable strategies with Marketplace and City Ops to dynamically optimize supply-demand levers, rental pricing models, SLA enforcement, and targeted incentive structures.
Fleet Performance Optimization & Strategic Analytics: Own the analytical ecosystem (dashboards, scorecards) to extract deep insights into partner health, utilization, and unit economics. Build robust forecasting models to tier partners by ROI, directly guiding invest/scale/exit decisions. Lead continuous experimentation and rigorous performance deep-dives to maximize fleet efficiency, balance partner profitability with company P&L, and drive structural optimizations across pricing, collections, and operational workflows.
GTM Strategy & Rollout: Design and launch fleet partner programs (commercials, finance, SOPs, compliance) rooted in rigorous pre-launch analysis and financial modeling. Establish data-backed, gated rollout plans and proactive risk mitigation strategies, defining quantitative acceptance criteria to ensure programs are optimized for scale and profitability from Day 1.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Skills you need
3-4 years of experience in GTM/operations/partnerships/program management, ideally in mobility, logistics, fintech, or marketplace environments.
Demonstrated success launching cross-functional initiatives with Legal/Tax/Finance and translating commercial strategy into executable SOPs.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets required. Experience with SQL/BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
Practical understanding of Vietnam regulatory and tax contexts relevant to partnerships, invoicing, and collections (or a strong willingness to learn fast).
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills—able to influence across functions and with external partners.
Bias to action, structured operator mindset, and comfort with ambiguity in a fast-moving, data-driven environment.
Language: fluent Vietnamese and strong business English.
Nice to Have
Experience in fleet, vehicle rental/subscription, or driver-partner ecosystems.
Exposure to credit/collections workflows or partner economics design (e.g., pricing, incentives).
Prior ownership of marketplace levers and experimentation frameworks.

You will drive end-to-end readiness, launch, and ongoing performance—working across Legal, Tax, Finance, Compliance, Marketplace Operations, and Analytics—to de-risk rollouts, uphold regulatory and commercial integrity, and ensure partner needs and driver income outcomes are met alongside Grab's business goals.
You will report to Manager, IMS Growth, and work onsite at Grab office, Mapletree Business Centre, HCMC.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Insight-Led Stakeholder Orchestration: Translate analytical insights into actionable strategies with Marketplace and City Ops to dynamically optimize supply-demand levers, rental pricing models, SLA enforcement, and targeted incentive structures.
Fleet Performance Optimization & Strategic Analytics: Own the analytical ecosystem (dashboards, scorecards) to extract deep insights into partner health, utilization, and unit economics. Build robust forecasting models to tier partners by ROI, directly guiding invest/scale/exit decisions. Lead continuous experimentation and rigorous performance deep-dives to maximize fleet efficiency, balance partner profitability with company P&L, and drive structural optimizations across pricing, collections, and operational workflows.
GTM Strategy & Rollout: Design and launch fleet partner programs (commercials, finance, SOPs, compliance) rooted in rigorous pre-launch analysis and financial modeling. Establish data-backed, gated rollout plans and proactive risk mitigation strategies, defining quantitative acceptance criteria to ensure programs are optimized for scale and profitability from Day 1.

Skills you need
3-4 years of experience in GTM/operations/partnerships/program management, ideally in mobility, logistics, fintech, or marketplace environments.
Demonstrated success launching cross-functional initiatives with Legal/Tax/Finance and translating commercial strategy into executable SOPs.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; proficiency with Excel/Google Sheets required. Experience with SQL/BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) is a plus.
Practical understanding of Vietnam regulatory and tax contexts relevant to partnerships, invoicing, and collections (or a strong willingness to learn fast).
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and negotiation skills—able to influence across functions and with external partners.
Bias to action, structured operator mindset, and comfort with ambiguity in a fast-moving, data-driven environment.
Language: fluent Vietnamese and strong business English.
Nice to Have
Experience in fleet, vehicle rental/subscription, or driver-partner ecosystems.
Exposure to credit/collections workflows or partner economics design (e.g., pricing, incentives).
Prior ownership of marketplace levers and experimentation frameworks.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
Grab is undergoing a major transformation in how customer and operational experiences are delivered across the ecosystem. As AI capabilities evolve, we are rethinking the future of automation, workflow orchestration, and intelligent operations to move beyond traditional processes toward more proactive and scalable experiences.
We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to join our Product team in Vietnam to help shape this next phase of transformation across internal platforms and operational experiences.
Get to Know the Role
As a Lead Product Manager, you will lead highly ambiguous and strategic product initiatives focused on AI-driven workflows, operational tooling, and platform experiences. You will work closely with engineering, operations, design, data science, and platform teams to define scalable solutions that improve efficiency, decision-making, and user experience across the organization.
This role requires a strong builder mindset, deep systems thinking, high execution velocity, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while driving alignment across multiple stakeholders. You will report to the Senior Product Leader and will be based onsite at the Grab Vietnam HCM Office.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Work closely with cross-functional teams to define and improve intelligent workflows, automation capabilities, and operational tooling across multiple business areas
Operate effectively in highly ambiguous problem spaces, rapidly iterating on product direction, operational models, and workflow design based on evolving business and platform needs
Use customer data, operational signals, and business metrics to identify root causes, separate signal from noise, and drive systemic improvements rather than symptom-level fixes
Lead large cross-functional initiatives involving engineering, operations, policy, analytics, design, and leadership stakeholders across multiple regions
Prototype, validate, and iterate quickly on new ideas and workflows, with a strong bias toward execution and experimentation
Stay ahead of industry trends in AI, automation, platform tooling, and customer experience, and apply these learnings pragmatically to evolve internal capabilities
Clearly communicate product strategy, trade-offs, execution risks, and business impact to senior leadership and stakeholders, grounding discussions in data and customer outcomes

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
At least 8 years of product experience, with mandatory hands-on experience shipping GenAI products across any domain.
Strong product intuition backed by data, with the ability to identify high-leverage problems and make sound trade-offs in ambiguous environments.
Proven experience driving complex, cross-functional initiatives from problem discovery through delivery at scale.
Ability to translate abstract strategy into clear product direction, roadmaps, and execution plans that teams can align around.
Senior-level judgment and leadership, with a track record of influencing stakeholders, mentoring PMs, and shaping product culture.

sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
Come join the Communications Engineering team! The Interactive Comms team at Grab revolutionizes how people connect and communicate on the Grab platform, spanning multiple Apps and Web. We are on an exciting mission to shape the future of communications as our platform evolves, weaving social interactions, groups and more.
Get to Know the Role
You will manage the Android engineering surface for Grab's Interactive Communications products — real-time chat, VoIP calling, and number masking. You'll work across the full mobile lifecycle: architecture decisions, feature delivery, SDK integrations, and production stability. You will report to the Engineering Manager
This is a senior IC role where you'll be expected to lead system design for Android, mentor mid-level engineers, and partner closely with product, design, QA, and backend teams to ship high-quality features that connect millions of passengers, drivers, and merchants daily. This role will be onsite in HCMC
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Design Android applications using Kotlin and Java, following best practices and architectural patterns
Implement user interfaces following Material Design principles and ensure user experience across several devices and screen sizes
Integrate RESTful APIs and backend services, ensuring efficient data communication and synchronization
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code with comprehensive unit and integration tests using frameworks such as JUnit, Espresso, and Mockito
Optimize application performance, identify bottlenecks, and implement solutions to enhance speed and efficiency
Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to team members, encouraging a culture of continuous improvement
Troubleshoot and debug complex issues, using analytical skills to identify causes and implement solutions
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to translate requirements into technical specifications
Stay current with Android ecosystem developments, new technologies, and industry best practices
Participate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to sprint planning, estimation, and retrospectives
Mentor junior developers and support their professional growth through guidance and knowledge sharing

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
5+ years of professional Android development experience with experience with shipping production applications
Advanced proficiency in Kotlin and Java programming languages
Experience with Android SDK, lifecycle management, and modern architecture components (MVVM, MVP, Clean Architecture)
Solid experience with RESTful API integration and backend service usage
Proficiency with version control systems, Git
Demonstrated expertise in implementing responsive UI/UX designs and Material Design principles
Experience with testing frameworks and a commitment to writing testable, maintainable code
Experience approaching a problem from different angles, analyzing pros and cons of different solutions w
Experience reviewing code to find and address potential issues and defects
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
Experience communicating updates and resolutions to customers and other partners with the ability to collaborate across team
Experience with Jetpack libraries and modern Android development frameworks
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automated testing practices
Familiarity with third-party libraries and dependency management tools
Understanding of mobile security best practices and secure coding principles
Contributions to open-source Android projects

sections.text:
Get to know our team:
The Communications team is responsible for telling the Grab story around the world. It will drive Grab’s growth by promoting and protecting its brand and reputation, ensuring its position as the leading online-to-offline mobile platform in Southeast Asia.
Whether it's speaking to media and online influencers, industry commentators, thought leaders or the wider community, the Communications team is the voice of Grab.
Get to know the role:
The Vietnam Communications Lead is passionate about Grab’s mission and will manage the company’s perception among the government stakeholders and the public in Vietnam. The role spans corporate and policy communications, and you will have experience developing communications strategies that are at the intersection of local regulatory policies, community issues, and the company’s business goals.
We are looking for someone who has a proven track record of working with senior country stakeholders from business, marketing and public affairs teams to create and execute creative, integrated campaigns, while leveraging our positive impact to develop the Grab story in Vietnam.
You will have a strong understanding of the media landscape in Vietnam and will build and maintain relationships with key contacts pivotal for the business. Experience with managing crises and issues is advantageous.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Develop and execute integrated comms plans to gain public influence, position Grab as a Vietnam’s leading super app, and to grow Grab’s core businesses
Lead comms for projects that span corporate actions, business partnerships, and regulatory advocacy
Provide strategic communications counsel to senior internal business leaders on announcements and internal policy changes
Understand the regulatory landscape, and pre-empt and manage the response to issues or crisis
Manage media and KOL programme, and build and maintain strong working relationships with them
Lead the communications team members in Vietnam to ensure the team achieves OKRs and manage their career development
Analyse metrics to determine the output and value of PR results and use the data as a critical planning tool

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
12-15 years experience: Corporate reputation management, policy communications, crisis management, media relations, integrated communications, data storytelling
Experience managing teams and diverse cross-functional stakeholder relations, including senior business leaders, in ambiguous environments
Self-starter who is motivated by hands-on, challenging work, and comfortable in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
Excellent writing in Vietnamese and English, strong project management, and result-oriented

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
Clickstream Intelligence Platform (Scribe) is Grab's in-house app instrumentation and insights platform that captures and analyzes user clickstream activity across all Grab apps. The platform supports observability, real-time personalization, and business analytics by processing tens of billions of events per hour at petabyte scale.
Customer Data Platform (CDP) enables Grab Teams to onboard and register Grab's customer data and make it available for Online Serving, ML Models, Segmentation, and Real-time targeting to power personalization use cases across the company. Our platform is leveraged across many mission-critical Grab services such as app personalization, experimentation, ads serving, and marketing.
Get to Know the Role
We are looking for a Technical Lead for either Scribe or CDP team that has a strong breadth of different technical stacks:
Web Portal: React.JS and Golang Backend.
Online Serving: AWS infrastructure, MySQL, Redis, AWS Dynamo DB, Scylla DB.
Data Processing / Storage: Apache Flink, Apache Spark, Trino, StarRocks, Hive, and Delta Lake.
Applied AI / ML: LLM, Python Backend, Vector DB.
You will report to Engineering Manager in Singapore and work onsite at Grab Vietnam office (District 7, HCMC).
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Build platform capabilities to facilitate scalable onboarding of user data that can be easily re-used across the company.
Improve the serving capabilities of CDP's user data.
Develop scalable real-time data pipelines and architecture that is cost efficient, while allowing non-technical teams to use these real-time capabilities.
Lead an engineering team with diverse technical stacks.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related undergraduate degree.
Minimum of 7+ years of experience in Software Engineering with experience leading an engineering team with diverse skillsets.
Proficient or willing to learn one of the following programing languages: Python, Go, or Scala
Experience developing large-scale backend systems and has good understanding of technical trade offs and evaluations needed to allow high load, low latency systems, while maintaining system reliability and cost efficiency.
Experience building APIs, working with OLTP DBs, and operating in a distributed systems environment.
Strong English communications with prior work experience in regional and global environment
(Optional) A big plus if you have:
Experience with Apache Flink (for real-time processing) and Apache Spark (for batch processing).
Proficiency in CI/CD tools, AWS, Terraform, and Kubernetes.

sections.text:
JOB PURPOSE: Lead EHS activities at the Bac Ninh site and support other sites when needed, ensuring compliance with Vietnamese regulations, Sika Group EHS Minimum Requirements, and ISO 14001/45001. Lead local EHS initiatives and represent the site in Regional and Corporate EHS engagements.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:
Implement and maintain the local EHS Plan, policies, objectives and targets in alignment with Sika Group and Regional standards; monitor legal changes and ensure compliance with applicable EHS licenses, permits and regulatory requirements.
Manage operational EHS activities, including inspections, Safety Walks/Talks, EHS tours, BBS, 6S audits, hazard identification and risk assessment, EHS KPI/data reporting, Permit-to-Work, chemical safety, contractor EHS supervision, and site EHS campaigns.
Coordinate internal/external audits and inspections, follow up CAPA, investigate incidents and near-misses, and support site emergency preparedness, resources and response scenarios.
Deliver EHS induction and refresher training, coordinate legally required/job-specific training, evaluate training effectiveness, maintain the training matrix, and lead Safety Committee/site EHS communication.
Maintain EHS records, reports and legal documentation; submit required reports to authorities and Regional/Corporate teams; liaise with authorities, fire departments and other external stakeholders.
Manage and monitor site Security Guards for compliance with safety and security protocols; support administrative tasks when necessary and perform other EHS-related duties assigned by the EHS & Admin Manager and/or Financial Controller.
Comply with all laws and Sika regulations, processes, and Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) minimum requirements. Adhere to occupational safety and hygiene measures as outlined in the workplace. Uphold all agreements on occupational safety and hygiene stipulated in the Labor Contract or collective bargaining agreement

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
JOB REQUIREMENTS:
Education background: Bachelor's degree in Environment, Safety, or a related field.
Experience: Minimum 5 years in EHS, preferably in a manufacturing or industrial environment.
Skills: Knowledge of ISO 14001/45001, EHS legal requirements (including EIA, chemical safety and fire protection), EHS KPI tracking and incident analysis; strong communication, reporting, incident investigation, risk assessment and coordination skills; English at intermediate level or higher; reliable, detail-oriented and proactive.

sections.title: Quyền lợi & thông tin bổ sung
sections.text: We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Sika is a specialty chemicals company with a globally leading position in the development and production of systems and products for bonding, sealing, damping, reinforcing, and protection in the building sector and industry. Sika has subsidiaries in 103 countries around the world, produces in over 400 factories, and develops innovative technologies for customers worldwide. In doing so, it plays a crucial role in enabling the transformation of the construction and transportation industries toward greater environmental compatibility. In 2025, Sika’s 33,700 employees generated annual sales of CHF 11.20 billion.
Sika has been serving in the Vietnam market since 1993 as a 100% foreign owned company, a subsidiary of Sika AG, Switzerland. Sika Vietnam offers products and solutions for most construction and industrial applications. We always put the need of local customers at the center of our business; therefore, we develop products that are tailored to meet local and global customers’ requirements. We are reliable partners of designers, consultants, owners and construction companies based on the quality of our products and our excellent technical service. As a leading supplier of specialty chemicals, Sika provides full solutions for most construction applications and projects.

sections.text:
JOB PURPOSE: Be in charge of developing and executing sales and technical service plans for Sika's Grinding Aid and cement additives portfolio within the assigned cement plant accounts. The role drives revenue growth by building strong relationships with cement manufacturers, delivering plant trial support and technical solutions that improve grinding efficiency and cement quality, and ensuring full alignment with Sika’s commercial and quality standards.
JOB RESPONSIBILITIES / NHIỆM VỤ CÔNG VIỆC
Sales Planning & Target Achievement: Develop and implement strategic sales plans for the Grinding Aid / cement additives business. Achieve short- and long-term sales targets for assigned cement plant accounts in line with regional and company objectives. Provide monthly status reports to the Area Manager.
Technical Support & Plant Trials: Plan and execute grinding aid trials directly at customer cement mills. Coordinate with plant technical and production teams to monitor production data (output rate, fineness, energy consumption) and cement quality results (strength development, workability, powder flowability). Translate trial results into a clear value proposition and optimize dosage recommendations to fit each plant's raw material and process conditions.
Market Intelligence: Gather and analyse market information on cement plant capacity, clinker factor targets, use of supplementary cementitious materials (SCM), and competitor grinding aid activity in the assigned area. Report market insights to the Sales Supervisor to support commercial decisions.
Cross-functional Coordination: Coordinate information and documentation between Sika Vietnam and external stakeholders (cement plant technical, production, and procurement teams). Liaise with internal departments – Sika’s global Cement Additives technical team, Pricing, Logistics, and Customer Service – to ensure trial support, quotations, contracts, deliveries, and after-sales services are aligned with Sika policies.
Compliance: Comply with all laws and Sika regulations, processes, and Environmental, Health, and Safety (EHS) minimum requirements. Adhere to occupational safety and hygiene measures as outlined in the workplace. Uphold all agreements on occupational safety and hygiene stipulated in the Labor Contract or collective bargaining agreement.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Education: Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Civil Engineering, or a related technical field; candidates with a cement or chemistry background are preferred.
Experience: Minimum 2-3 years' experience in the cement industry, building materials, or chemical additives business, with direct exposure to grinding aids or cement additives preferred.
Skills: Working knowledge of the cement grinding process (Ball Mill, Vertical Roller Mill, HoroMill) and cement quality parameters (Blaine fineness, strength development, powder flowability). Ability to interpret plant production and laboratory test data. Strong technical presentation and negotiation skills. Good organisational and communication skills. Able to work independently and travel frequently to cement plants nationwide. Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Working proficiency in English.

sections.text:
🎁 Q4 JOINING BONUS
Join BGSV by 31 December 2026 and receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.
As a Senior Test Engineer , you will play a key role in defining, implementing and improving testing solutions for automotive embedded software products. The position combines technical leadership, test strategy development, automation enablement and cross-functional coordination to ensure delivery quality for complex vehicle communication and embedded system projects.
You will work closely with SWSD, Function Developers, Architects, Project Managers and global stakeholders to establish efficient testing approaches across SIL, HIL and Continuous Testing environments while driving competency growth and quality excellence within the team. Inspired by current EPC ComTest and SIL transformation initiatives. (VW & STLA Account)
Key Responsibilities
Test Strategy & Quality Leadership
Define and maintain project test strategy aligned with project requirements and organizational quality standards.
Plan and coordinate testing activities across System Test, Software Qualification Test, SIL and HIL environments.
Ensure requirement-to-test traceability and coverage throughout the development lifecycle.
Review test specifications, test designs and test reports to ensure completeness and effectiveness.
Drive quality improvement initiatives, defect prevention and lesson-learned activities.
Test Design & Execution
Analyze requirements and clarify ambiguities with stakeholders.
Develop test cases, test specifications and test data for embedded software systems.
Automation & Continuous Testing
Develop and enhance automated testing solutions using Python or similar scripting languages.
Contribute to Continuous Testing (CT) and CI/CD integration for test execution.
Improve testing efficiency through automation, reusable test assets and tooling.
Support SIL-based validation and early defect detection strategies.
Drive test environment optimization and automation initiatives.
Technical Leadership
Mentor junior engineers and support competency development within the team.
Provide technical guidance on test methodologies, automotive communication and debugging.
Support onboarding, knowledge sharing and test process improvement initiatives.
Act as technical focal point for testing-related topics within projects.
Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with global teams, project managers, architects and customers.
Report test progress, risks and quality status to internal and external stakeholders.
Support audits, assessments and compliance activities (ASPICE, Functional Safety, Quality Gate Reviews).
Execute and monitor system-level and software-level validation activities.
Investigate defects, perform root-cause analysis and support issue resolution.
Generate test summary reports and communicate project quality status.

sections.text:
5+ years' experience in Embedded Software Testing or System Testing.
CI/CT or DevOps experience.
Knowledge of CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet communication protocols.
Experience with Vector tools (CANoe, CANalyzer, VT System).
Solid experience with Automotive Embedded Systems.
Experience in project-level testing coordination or technical leadership roles.
Hands-on experience with test automation development.
Nice to have
Python programming for automation framework development.
Automotive communication stack and gateway validation experience.
Knowledge of AUTOSAR architecture.
ASPICE process knowledge.
Functional Safety (ISO26262) awareness.
Experience establishing testing concepts for SIL Continuous Testing environments.
ISTQB Foundation or Advanced Certification.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. With technology that is “Invented for life,” Bosch wants to help improve quality of life and conserve natural resources.
The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 490 subsidiary and regional companies in over 60 countries. Including sales and service partners, Bosch’s global manufacturing, engineering, and sales network covers nearly every country in the world. Bosch’s innovative strength is key to the company’s further development.
Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.
Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region. With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.
BGSV currently operates from three offices located at the following addresses:
1. Etown Building – 364 Cong Hoa Street, Ward 13, Tan Binh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
2. OfficeHaus Building – 32 Tan Thang Street, Son Ky Ward, Tan Phu District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
3. Capital Place Building – 29 Lieu Giai Street, Ngoc Khanh Ward, Ba Dinh District, Hanoi, Vietnam

As a Senior Test Engineer , you will play a key role in defining, implementing and improving testing solutions for automotive embedded software products. The position combines technical leadership, test strategy development, automation enablement and cross-functional coordination to ensure delivery quality for complex vehicle communication and embedded system projects.
You will work closely with SWSD, Function Developers, Architects, Project Managers and global stakeholders to establish efficient testing approaches across SIL, HIL and Continuous Testing environments while driving competency growth and quality excellence within the team. Inspired by current EPC ComTest and SIL transformation initiatives. (VW & STLA Account)
Key Responsibilities
Test Strategy & Quality Leadership
Define and maintain project test strategy aligned with project requirements and organizational quality standards.
Plan and coordinate testing activities across System Test, Software Qualification Test, SIL and HIL environments.
Ensure requirement-to-test traceability and coverage throughout the development lifecycle.
Review test specifications, test designs and test reports to ensure completeness and effectiveness.
Drive quality improvement initiatives, defect prevention and lesson-learned activities.
Test Design & Execution
Analyze requirements and clarify ambiguities with stakeholders.
Develop test cases, test specifications and test data for embedded software systems.
Automation & Continuous Testing
Develop and enhance automated testing solutions using Python or similar scripting languages.
Contribute to Continuous Testing (CT) and CI/CD integration for test execution.
Improve testing efficiency through automation, reusable test assets and tooling.
Support SIL-based validation and early defect detection strategies.
Drive test environment optimization and automation initiatives.
Technical Leadership
Mentor junior engineers and support competency development within the team.
Provide technical guidance on test methodologies, automotive communication and debugging.
Support onboarding, knowledge sharing and test process improvement initiatives.
Act as technical focal point for testing-related topics within projects.

Collaborate with global teams, project managers, architects and customers.
Report test progress, risks and quality status to internal and external stakeholders.
Support audits, assessments and compliance activities (ASPICE, Functional Safety, Quality Gate Reviews).
Execute and monitor system-level and software-level validation activities.
Investigate defects, perform root-cause analysis and support issue resolution.
Generate test summary reports and communicate project quality status.

5+ years' experience in Embedded Software Testing or System Testing.
CI/CT or DevOps experience.
Knowledge of CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet communication protocols.
Experience with Vector tools (CANoe, CANalyzer, VT System).
Solid experience with Automotive Embedded Systems.
Experience in project-level testing coordination or technical leadership roles.
Hands-on experience with test automation development.

Python programming for automation framework development.
Automotive communication stack and gateway validation experience.
Knowledge of AUTOSAR architecture.
ASPICE process knowledge.
Functional Safety (ISO26262) awareness.
Experience establishing testing concepts for SIL Continuous Testing environments.
ISTQB Foundation or Advanced Certification.

sections.text:
🎁 Quarter 4 JOINING BONUS
Candidates with 4+ years of relevant experience who join BGSV by the end of 31 December 2026 can receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month’s gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.
ABOUT THE ROLE
The EPM department focuses on software tooling development to support embedded products in the XC which including Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS), Car Multimedia domain. We develop tools that streamline software and system development for technologies such as radar, video, HMI and ultrasonic sensors. Serving global teams across Japan, China, Europe, and Vietnam, we contribute to the advancement of secure, safe, and intelligent mobility solutions.
The SiL Integration Engineer/Expert is responsible for configuring, deploying, integrating, and maintaining ADAS SiL reference implementations in project-specific environments. The role ensures that customer project SiL variants are enabled efficiently, with maximum reuse from the platform, while supporting stakeholders with technical integration, issue resolution, and operational excellence.
Key Responsibilities
Configure, deploy, and integrate ADAS SiL reference implementations from the platform into project-specific ADAS SiL instances based on stakeholder requirements.
Maintain and continuously improve ADAS SiL instances to ensure quality, stability, and alignment with stakeholder needs.
Execute quality assurance measures for SiL environments and implementations.
Update and adapt SiL implementations according to project and customer requirements.
Provide training and user support for project teams using the ADAS SiL setup.
Act as the first-level support contact for issue analysis and resolution.
Collect and propagate requirements, feedback, and technical demands to relevant development teams.
Collaborate directly and on a daily basis with project developers and stakeholders.
Execute the defined ADAS SiL TDP integration and deployment processes.
Replicate SiL platform integrations into customer project variants and implement project-specific extensions where needed.
Maximize reuse of implementations from the platform integration approach, avoiding copy-paste solutions and ensuring that only project-specific interface differences are added on top.
Support the SiL takeover of TRIM / Parking platform capabilities into customer projects in a self-organized and solution-oriented manner.
Contribute to scalable and efficient workflows for parallel project execution together with platform and customer project teams.

Strong knowledge in SiL product deployment, configuration, and integration.

OpenSCENARIO DSL
OpenDRIVE
Lanelet2
Basic to junior-level programming skills in:

Git

Hands-on mindset for troubleshooting, integration adaptation, and project-specific technical support.
Preferred Competencies
Customer-oriented attitude with focus on successful integration and adoption.
Strong problem-solving mindset with practical implementation capability.
Ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams and parallel project setups.
Good communication skills to support users and clarify technical topics with stakeholders.
Structured and self-organized working style.
Expected Outcome
The role ensures that ADAS SiL solutions are technically integrated into customer projects, maintained with high quality, and extended in a scalable way with strong reuse from the platform baseline.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Bosch first started in Vietnam with a representative office in 1994. Bosch has its main office in Ho Chi Minh City, with branch offices in Hanoi and Da Nang, and a Powertrain Solutions plant in the Dong Nai province to manufacture pushbelt for continuously variable transmissions (CVT) in automobiles. In addition, Bosch operates a software and engineering R&D center (Robert Bosch Engineering and Business Solutions Vietnam Co., Ltd).
In July 2014, Bosch set up a new Automotive R&D Center, located in Ho Chi Minh City. The continuous growth of this Centre is in line with Bosch’s strategy in Vietnam, which aims at becoming a manufacturing and R&D hub in the Southeast Asian region. Currently four products are available: connectors, pushbelt, fuel supply, and diagnosis module (tank leakage).
For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn

• Arrange customer meetings and technical presentations.

o Temperature
o Humidity
o Differential Pressure
o CO₂
o VOC
o Particulate Matter
o Environmental Conditions

• Identify account expansion opportunities and cross-selling initiatives.
• Ensure timely response to customer inquiries and complaints.

sections.text:
We are looking for a Specialist to build a new technology capability in Technology & Innovation at Bosch Global Software Technologies Vietnam, from zero to first real deployments. This role is ideal for someone who wants to own a system end-to-end, work directly with real users, and shape how a small team engineers. You will work hands-on with latest-generation AI hardware platforms, from manipulation to mobile systems.
You will report directly to the Head of Technology & Innovation and work closely with a partner engineering team on cross-functional prototypes and pilots.
Key Responsibilities
Technical Ownership & Architecture
Own the architecture of systems combining AI, software and physical devices.
Make build, buy and reuse decisions, including technical assessments of vendors and platforms.
Set up the lab, toolchain and simulation environment for the team.
Delivery with Users & Partners
Turn validated user problems into working pilots and measure whether they are actually used.
Integrate edge devices with enterprise applications and data (e.g., identity, scheduling, visitor and facility systems).
Deliver within the security, safety and quality constraints of real environments.
Team & Knowledge Building
Guide and review the work of other engineers, including part-time contributors from partner teams.
Define engineering practices and quality gates for the team.
Capture reusable components, documented know-how and invention reports so each project speeds up the next.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Have owned a system design end-to-end and made the key technical decisions.
Have built something real users adopted, and can show the impact (users, pilot results or business outcomes).
Have made other engineers more effective through reviews, standards or mentoring.
Have delivered under real-world constraints such as security, safety, compliance or customer quality requirements.
Strong C++ and/or Python on Linux.
Hands-on experience with at least two of: ROS 2, computer vision, sensor fusion, real-time control, edge AI deployment.
Experience integrating with enterprise systems via APIs.
Good communication skills (English + Vietnamese).
3+ years of experience , but what you have done matters more than years.
Nice to Have
Simulation tools (e.g., Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Gazebo).
Experience with NVIDIA Jetson or similar edge platforms.
Automotive or safety-critical background (e.g., ASPICE, ISO 26262).
Patents, invention reports or published reusable components.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. With technology that is “Invented for life,” Bosch wants to help improve quality of life and conserve natural resources.
The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 490 subsidiary and regional companies in over 60 countries. Including sales and service partners, Bosch’s global manufacturing, engineering, and sales network covers nearly every country in the world. Bosch’s innovative strength is key to the company’s further development.

Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region. With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.
BGSV currently operates from three offices located at the following addresses:
1. Etown Building – 364 Cong Hoa Street, Ward 13, Tan Binh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
2. OfficeHaus Building – 32 Tan Thang Street, Son Ky Ward, Tan Phu District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
3. Capital Place Building – 29 Lieu Giai Street, Ngoc Khanh Ward, Ba Dinh District, Hanoi, Vietnam

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services, in the areas of automotive and industrial technology, consumer goods as well as building technology.
Bosch established its first representative office in Ho Chi Minh City in 1994. Since 2007, Bosch has expanded its footprint in Vietnam where it has branch offices in Hanoi and Da Nang, as well as a Powertrain Solutions plant in the Dong Nai province to manufacture pushbelts for continuously variable transmissions (CVT) in automobiles. In addition, Bosch operates Bosch Global Software Technologies Vietnam (BGSV) as well as an automotive R&D center for mobility solutions in Ho Chi Minh City. As of December 31 2023, Bosch employed approximately 6,300 associates in Vietnam. Bosch has diversified businesses in Vietnam. Today, all four Bosch business sectors, namely Mobility Solutions, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology have operations in the country. Bosch Vietnam is currently active with many business divisions: Mobility Aftermarket, Drive and Control Technology, Power Tools, Building Technology, Two-Wheeler and Powersports and Sales Original Equipment, AquaEasy, Home Appliances and Supply Chain Consulting.
Additional information is available online at: https://www.bosch.com.vn/ , https://www.linkedin.com/company/bosch-vietnam and https://www.facebook.com/OfficialBoschVietnam

sections.text:
Testing & Validation Activities
Support Testing Engineers in the preparation and execution of validation activities for automotive components and materials.
Prepare test samples, specimens, test setups, and measurement equipment before testing.
Perform different validation tests under the supervision of Testing Engineers, such as: Samples preparation , wires harness preparation
Mechanical force and strength testing
Electrical testing and measurement
Sealing and leakage testing
Environmental and component-level validation testing
Monitor test execution, identify abnormalities, and communicate issues to the responsible engineer.
Record, organize, and analyze test data according to defined test procedures.
Assist Senior Testing Engineers in component development and validation project.
Laboratory Equipment & Technical Support
Learn to understand and operate various laboratory and analytical equipment.
Support equipment setup, basic maintenance, laboratory organization, 5S, Inventory management.
Design or support the development of test jigs, fixtures, adapters, and simple mechanical setups for different validation activities.
