sections.text:
Undergraduate students majoring in technical field (e.g., mechanical, mechatronic or any relevant fields). International experience is a plus.
Ability to read and understand basic technical drawings.
Interest or experience in designing and building simple fixtures or mechanical test setups.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
Hands-on experience with laboratory, workshop, or fabrication tools is an advantage.
Hands-on and practical approach to engineering and problem-solving.
Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail.
Proactive, open-minded, and willing to take responsibility.
Quality-oriented with a strong willingness to learn.
Good command of English in speaking, listening, reading, and writing.

sections.text:

Currently four products are available: connectors, pushbelt, fuel supply, and diagnosis module (tank leakage).

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
General requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
Intermediate level of English proficiency, with good communication skills
3+ years of hands-on experience in software testing
Able to self-learn and quickly adapt to new technologies
Familiar with the Agile development methodologies
Good collaboration skills with a proven ability to work seamlessly with both customers and team members
Technical requirements:
Experience in software testing for web-based and mobile applications
Good domain knowledge of the software development process, especially the software testing process
Solid testing experiences (test approach, test plan, test techniques included black box, risk-based, exploratory, Non-UI testing, etc.)
Methodical and detail-oriented, with solid analytical skills and problem-solving ability
Strong dedication to quality and a positive, collaborative attitude and approach to testing
Experience using AI chat tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) for research, debugging, and learning
Familiarity with at least one AI coding assistant (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar)
Strong prompting skills to generate accurate code, tests, and documentation
Understanding of AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP)
Awareness of AI output limitations and responsible AI use (data privacy, handling of sensitive client data)
Nice to have:
Experience in creating and running automated tests using testing frameworks like Katalon/ Selenium/ Robotium/ UiAutomator/ XCTest/ XCUiTest, etc.
Hand-on experience in using test tools like TestNG/ Mocha/ Jasmine/ Nightwatch, etc.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Lab Technician to join our Chromatography Laboratory in Ho Chi Minh, Vietnam. As a key member of our team, you will be responsible for conducting various chromatographic analyses, maintaining laboratory equipment, and ensuring the accuracy and reliability of test results.
Receive and review testing orders, SOP’s and instruction before conducting testing
Perform tests in a professional and safe manner; ensure that tests are carried out in accordance with testing orders, SOP and clients' instruction; record all raw data.
Keep tools, chemicals and consumables in good conditions by storing at proper places.
Keep the work area tidy, clean and safe. All assigned equipments, environment conditions, reagents, worksheets,...must be recorded correctly.
Ensure day-to-day compliance in HSE & Quality management system (SOP, forms, guidelines, equipment calibration, ISO17025, etc.) and escalate potential operation risk.
Supervisor informed on daily basis or as required about the progress of the testing and report any problems identified when performing tests
Study and propose to his/her supervisors for improvement daily activities
Perform other tasks assigned by the Supervisor/Manager
Perform root cause analysis on complaints/ claims and provide results for Supervisor to have proper corrective actions.
Lead Technician team to prepare samples and/or perform tests and other assigned tasks
Keep his/her Supervisor informed timely any problems (abnormal results, error instruments, etc.) and/or improvement activities.
Keep his/her Supervisor informed timely any problems (abnormal results, error instruments, etc.) and/or improvement activities.

- Lead daily laboratory operations for organic chemical testing (Phthalates, PAHs, SCCP, MCCP, VOC, Azo dyes, PCP, Flame retardants, etc.)
- Operate and oversee analytical instruments including GC-MS, GC-MS-HS, LC-MS, LC-MSMS and sample preparation systems.
- Troubleshoot instrument and testing issues to ensure minimal downtime.
- Conduct laboratory tests, experiments, and evaluate the data results as per project or research requirements
Main Responsibilities – Details of the job
General duties
1. Laboratory Operations & Testing:
Lead daily laboratory operations for organic chemical testing (Phthalates, PAHs, SCCP, MCCP, VOC, Azo dyes, PCP, Flame retardants, etc.) .
Operate and oversee analytical instruments including GCMS, GCMS-HS, or LC-MS, LC-MSMS …
Troubleshoot instrument and testing issues to ensure minimal downtime .
Review, validate, and approve test results prior to reporting .
Ensure test accuracy, turnaround time, and compliance with internal and client requirements .
2. Technical Development & Accreditation :
Develop, optimize, and validate new test methods in line with ISO/IEC 17025 requirements.
Support laboratory accreditation activities (VILAS / BoA) and maintain compliance documentation.
Any other duties assigned by Superior’s time to time.
3. Collaboration :
Provide technical support to other team members and troubleshoot equipment or procedural issues .
Collaborate with other teams following sample login, test assignments, and issue report teams to ensure timely and accurate reporting of issues.
4. Resource Management :
Assist with the preparation of technical reports and presentations for internal or external stakeholders .
5. Quality Assurance :
Ensure that all technical developments meet Eurofins' quality standards and regulatory requirements .
Implement and maintain robust quality control processes for technical innovations .

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Eurofins Scientific through its subsidiaries is a world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences, and in agroscience Contract Research services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in genomics and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in BioPharma Contract Development and Manufacturing. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty esoteric and molecular clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA. With ca. 62,000 staff across a network of over 1,000 independent companies in 62 countries and operating over 900 laboratories, Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods for evaluating the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin and purity of biological substances and products, as well as for innovative clinical diagnostics. The objective of Eurofins companies is to provide their customers with high-quality services, accurate results on time and expert advice by their highly qualified staff.
Comprehensive services and unmatched expertise
Eurofins believes it is also a worldwide scientific leader in most of its fields of activity. Through research and development and acquisitions, the Group draws on the latest developments in the field of biotechnology and analytical chemistry to offer its clients unique analytical solutions and the most comprehensive range of testing methods.
A commitment to top quality
The Eurofins Group is committed to provide the highest quality services, accurate results in time and expert advice by its highly qualified staff. The reliability and accuracy of its data help customers make adequate decisions and meet their increasingly stringent quality and safety standards and the expanding demands of regulatory authorities around the world.
Permanent innovation and support by the market leader
Few testing laboratories can combine the level of expertise, technological leadership, attention to quality and customer service that have made Eurofins the global leader in many of the fields where it is active. Large investments in innovation, technology, IT and logistics and very large sample volumes ensure that customers enjoy high standards of quality at reasonable prices.
Eurofins started to provide the services in Vietnam since 2015. Our main services includes Food and Feed Testing, Consumer Product Testing, Environment Services, Agricultural sciences, Inspection and Audit, Certification, DNA testing, Genetic testing before prenancy, Covid test, HPV test, Decoding gen, etc. Current legal entities in Vietnam:
Eurofins Sac Ky Hai Dang
Eurofins Consumer Product Testing
Eurofins Assurance
Eurofins MTS
Eurofins Gentis
Eurofins ETM

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Trách nhiệm chung (General duties)
Phối hợp với nhân viên phòng thí nghiệm và cấp quản lý để tổng hợp kế hoạch, tiến hành các hoạt động chất lượng và giám sát hiệu quả của các hoạt động liên quan đến hệ thống chất lượng (nhân sự, thiết bị, hóa chất, điều kiện môi trường, đảm bảo chất lượng, ...)./ To work constructively with laboratory staff and senior management to summarize plan, conduct quality activities and monitor effectiveness of activities related to the quality system (personnel, equipment, chemicals, environmental conditions, ensuring quality, ...).
Chuẩn bị mẫu QC cho các phép thử hóa học/ QC sample Preparation for chemical tests.
Sử dụng kết quả QC và PT để xem xét cập nhật các phương pháp hóa học./ Use QC and PT result to review chemical methods.
Phối hợp với nhân viên phòng thí nghiệm điều tra sự không phù hợp và xác định tính hiệu quả của các hành động khắc phục./ Investigating non-conformances and identifying effective corrective actions in collaboration with the laboratory staff.
Hỗ trợ điều tra và giám sát việc giải quyết khiếu nại./ Supporting investigations and complaint treatment monitoring.
Xác định rủi ro, cải tiến và cơ hội nhằm mục đích cải thiện quy trình quản lý và phòng thí nghiệm/ Identifying risks, improvements and opportunities with an aim to improve laboratory and management processes.
Hỗ trợ cập nhật, phổ biến, đào tạo các quy trình, biểu mẫu chất lượng./ Support updating, disseminating and training quality processes and forms.
Quản lý và lưu giữ hồ sơ nhà cung cấp và nhà thầu phụ. Thực hiện đánh giá định kỳ./ Manage and maintain supplier and subcontractor record. Perform periodic assessments.
Lập kế hoạch và thực hiện chương trình đánh giá nội bộ./ Planning and executing the internal audit program.
Kiểm soát hồ sơ chất lượng/ Quality record control.
Thu thập, tổng hợp và báo cáo các chỉ số chất lượng định kỳ theo yêu cầu của Tập đoàn hoặc Công ty./ To collect, summerize and report quality metrics periodly as the requirement of Group or Company.
Hỗ trợ việc chuẩn bị và tham gia đánh giá công nhận và đánh giá của khách hàng./ To assist in the preparation for and taking part in accreditation assessments and customers’ audit.
Trách nhiệm HSE
Tuân thủ các quy định, chính sách HSE của Công ty.
Nhận diện và báo cáo các mối nguy, sự cố và điều kiện không an toàn.
Thực hiện đúng quy trình làm việc an toàn và sử dụng PPE theo yêu cầu.
Hỗ trợ công tác kiểm tra, đào tạo và khắc phục các vấn đề HSE.
HSE Responsibilities
Comply with company HSE policies and applicable regulations.
Identify and report hazards, incidents, and unsafe conditions.
Follow safe work practices and required PPE.
Support HSE inspections, training, and corrective actions.

Có ít nhất 02 năm kinh nghiệm làm kỹ thuật viên phòng thí nghiệm./ Have at least 02 years of experience as a technician in a laboratory & strong Chemical lab experience

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Eurofins Scientific through its subsidiaries is a world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences, and in agroscience Contract Research services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in genomics and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in BioPharma Contract Development and Manufacturing. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty esoteric and molecular clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA. With ca. 62,000 staff across a network of over 1,000 independent companies in 62 countries and operating over 900 laboratories, Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods for evaluating the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin and purity of biological substances and products, as well as for innovative clinical diagnostics. The objective of Eurofins companies is to provide their customers with high-quality services, accurate results on time and expert advice by their highly qualified staff.
Comprehensive services and unmatched expertise
Eurofins believes it is also a worldwide scientific leader in most of its fields of activity. Through research and development and acquisitions, the Group draws on the latest developments in the field of biotechnology and analytical chemistry to offer its clients unique analytical solutions and the most comprehensive range of testing methods.
A commitment to top quality
The Eurofins Group is committed to provide the highest quality services, accurate results in time and expert advice by its highly qualified staff. The reliability and accuracy of its data help customers make adequate decisions and meet their increasingly stringent quality and safety standards and the expanding demands of regulatory authorities around the world.
Permanent innovation and support by the market leader
Few testing laboratories can combine the level of expertise, technological leadership, attention to quality and customer service that have made Eurofins the global leader in many of the fields where it is active. Large investments in innovation, technology, IT and logistics and very large sample volumes ensure that customers enjoy high standards of quality at reasonable prices.
Eurofins started to provide the services in Vietnam since 2015. Our main services includes Food and Feed Testing, Consumer Product Testing, Environment Services, Agricultural sciences, Inspection and Audit, Certification, DNA testing, Genetic testing before prenancy, Covid test, HPV test, Decoding gen, etc. Current legal entities in Vietnam:
Eurofins Sac Ky Hai Dang
Eurofins Consumer Product Testing
Eurofins Assurance
Eurofins Gentis
Eurofins ETM

Tuân thủ các quy định, chính sách HSE của Công ty.
Nhận diện và báo cáo các mối nguy, sự cố và điều kiện không an toàn.
Thực hiện đúng quy trình làm việc an toàn và sử dụng PPE theo yêu cầu.
Hỗ trợ công tác kiểm tra, đào tạo và khắc phục các vấn đề HSE.

Comply with company HSE policies and applicable regulations.
Identify and report hazards, incidents, and unsafe conditions.
Follow safe work practices and required PPE.
Support HSE inspections, training, and corrective actions.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get To Know The Team
The Agent Experience PST owns and operates the internal platforms used by Grab's support agents to serve our entire ecosystem- across every vertical and use case. Because agents rely on these tools to resolve critical issues for users and partners, our systems are built for extremely high availability, reliability, and 100% data correctness.
When a user needs help with a transaction, they rely on our platform to ensure the agent has the right tools and data at the right time.
Get To Know The Role
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer in Vietnam to contribute to our internal tooling products used for our agents to serve Passengers, Drivers, and Merchants. You will report to the Engineering Manager, who is based in Singapore, and work in an on-site mode. This role is based in Vietnam.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Design and write with the cutting edge Go language to improve the availability, scalability, latency, and efficiency of Grab's range of services
Work with engineering team to explore and create new design / architectures geared towards scale and performance
Participate in code and design reviews to maintain our high development standards
Engage in service capacity and demand planning, software performance analysis, tuning and optimization
Collaborate with product and experience teams to define and prototype feature specifications
Work closely with infrastructure team in building and scaling back-end services as well as performing root cause analysis investigations
Design, build, analyze and fix large-scale systems
Pro-actively debug and solve production incidents during your oncall shift
Participate in interview loops to help Grab continue hiring top industry talent
Provide technical guidance, mentorship and knowledge sharing to peers.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering , Information Technology or related fields
5+ years of experience in software engineering in a distributed systems environment
Strong Computer Science fundamentals in algorithms and data structures
Familiarity with running large scale web services; understanding of systems internals and networking are a plus
Strong understanding of system performance and scaling
Proficient in English communication
You can be a good coder in any language (C++, C, Java, Scala, Rust, Haskell, OCaml, Erlang, Python, Ruby, PHP, Node.JS, C# etc.), but willing to work on Golang

sections.title: Quyền lợi & thông tin bổ sung
sections.text:
Life at Grab
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave , and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours
What We Stand For at Grab
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

sections.text:

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

sections.text:
Technical Support & Customer Service
Provide technical recommendations and solutions based on customer needs.
Conduct product demonstrations, testing, and customer training on proper application of Sika products.
Support customers and technicians in resolving technical issues at site.
Ensure timely and professional technical service to maintain customer satisfaction.
Customer Relationship & Market Support
Maintain regular contact with key customers and support business development activities.
Monitor market trends, competitor products, and customer feedback.
Report significant field issues, new opportunities, and competitive information to the line manager.
Team Support & Knowledge Sharing
Coordinate and support technicians during testing, trials, and project activities.
Provide technical guidance and ensure effective knowledge transfer to Technical and Sales teams.
Support cross-functional collaboration to ensure smooth project execution.
Reporting & Operational Responsibilities
Maintain accurate reports, technical records, and activity documentation.
Be accountable for assigned projects, activities, and proper use of company equipment.
Maintain confidentiality of company information and documentation.
Compliance, Safety & Other Duties
Comply with company regulations, legal requirements, and EHS standards.

sections.text:
The SAP Lead Developer (BTP, S/4HANA, R/3, Fiori, AI) will lead the design, development, and implementation of scalable SAP solutions that support complex business processes across the organization.
This role combines hands-on SAP development, technical leadership, and solution architecture . The successful candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and development teams to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions across SAP BTP, S/4HANA, SAP R/3, and SAP Fiori , including AI-enabled applications and integrations.
Key responsibilities include:
Lead the design, development, and implementation of SAP applications and technical solutions across SAP BTP, S/4HANA, R/3, and Fiori.
Translate business requirements and process needs into scalable and maintainable technical designs .
Provide technical leadership to development teams through solution guidance, code reviews, mentoring, and development standards .
Design and implement integrations between SAP and non-SAP systems using APIs, OData, REST services, event-driven architecture, and integration platforms.
Drive the modernization and optimization of existing SAP applications, including legacy solutions where applicable.
Ensure solutions meet requirements for performance, security, reliability, scalability, and maintainability .
Collaborate with business stakeholders, product teams, architects, and other technical teams throughout the solution lifecycle.
Contribute to SAP architecture, technology roadmap, engineering standards, and development best practices .
Explore and implement AI-enabled capabilities where they can improve business processes, user experience, or operational efficiency.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
At least 5–10 years of relevant experience in SAP software development, solution design, or enterprise application development.
Strong experience in SAP software development and solution architecture , ideally across SAP BTP, S/4HANA, SAP R/3, and SAP Fiori environments.
Strong understanding of business process analysis, process mapping, and optimization , with the ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
Advanced programming skills in one or more technologies such as ABAP, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, SAPUI5, and Node.js .
Hands-on experience with SAP BTP services, S/4HANA technologies, Fiori/SAPUI5 applications , and SAP integration technologies.
Solid experience in integrating SAP and non-SAP systems using APIs, OData, REST, middleware, and event-driven architectures .
Experience with AI/ML integration or AI-enabled enterprise applications is highly desirable.
Proven experience in providing technical leadership , including solution design, architecture guidance, code reviews, defining technical standards, and mentoring developers.
Familiarity with modern software engineering practices, including DevOps, CI/CD, Git/version control, automated deployment, testing, and secure coding practices .
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills , with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional and international teams.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills , with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering , or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Relevant SAP certifications, particularly in SAP BTP and/or S/4HANA , are considered an advantage.Experience working in large-scale enterprise, global, or manufacturing environments is a plus.

sections.text:
IT Procurement Interns support the IT Procurement & Asset Management team in keeping purchasing operations accurate and running smoothly. They work with software license data, procurement documents, invoices and vendor information, and prepare first drafts of reports and purchase recommendations for review. This is an onsite internship at our Ho Chi Minh City office, and we are looking for candidates who can start as soon as possible.
Key responsibilities
Work with the End-User Support team, colleagues who request purchases, and vendors
Perform the following under the coaching of your supervisor: Software licenses: Keep the license list up to date (renewal dates, owners, costs, number of users), remind owners to fill in missing information, and collect invoices for the monthly company card check
Documents: Organize and store contracts, purchase orders, quotations and invoices, scan signed originals, and track which documents are still waiting for signatures
Purchasing and assets: Create simple, low-value purchase orders; receive goods, hand them to the requester, and record device details (e.g. serial numbers) in the asset system
Invoices: Check that invoices match purchase orders, contracts and payments, collect VAT invoices from vendors, and follow up when an invoice is missing or incorrect
Vendors: Collect vendor information, ask vendors for quotations, and prepare draft purchase proposals using ready-made templates
Communication: Write routine emails to vendors, arrange vendor meetings, and take notes on meeting outcomes and next steps
Reporting: Prepare data in Excel/Google Sheets for monthly checks and draft regular reports for your supervisor to review

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Skills/knowledge you need to be successful
Final-year student in Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related major
Available at least 4 days/week (full-time preferred) - working onsite at our Ho Chi Minh City office, for 3–6 months
Intermediate level of English to work on internal emails and documents
Good at Excel or Google Sheets: filtering, sorting, VLOOKUP, pivot tables and basic formulas
Careful with details and comfortable with repetitive data tasks; able to notice when a number or record looks wrong
Organized and able to keep track of many small tasks without being reminder
Able to keep company and vendor information (e.g. bank details, tax codes) confidential
Nice to have
Experience in purchasing, accounting, admin or inventory work, including part-time jobs or school projects is a plus
Familiarity with business or asset management software
Interest in technology products and software tools
Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) to draft emails, summarize documents or write spreadsheet formulas, while keeping company data private

Operate and demonstrate a thorough understanding of laboratory testing equipment and machinery used in the Hardline Laboratory.
Perform daily inspections, preventive maintenance, and routine follow-up activities to ensure all equipment remains in good working condition.
Troubleshoot and repair equipment issues when possible, and coordinate with external suppliers or service providers for technical support and corrective actions when required.

Support laboratory operations by ensuring equipment availability, reliability, and compliance with applicable standards and procedures.
Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned by management.

sections.text:
Overview of duties - General overview of the job
- Lead daily laboratory operations for organic chemical testing (Phthalates, PAHs, SCCP, MCCP, VOC, Azo dyes, PCP, Flame retardants, etc.)
- Operate and oversee analytical instruments including GC-MS, GC-MS-HS, LC-MS, LC-MSMS and sample preparation systems.
- Troubleshoot instrument and testing issues to ensure minimal downtime.
- Conduct laboratory tests, experiments, and evaluate the data results as per project or research requirements
Main Responsibilities – Details of the job
General duties
1. Laboratory Operations & Testing:
Lead daily laboratory operations for organic chemical testing (Phthalates, PAHs, SCCP, MCCP, VOC, Azo dyes, PCP, Flame retardants, etc.) .
Operate and oversee analytical instruments including GCMS, GCMS-HS, or LC-MS, LC-MSMS …
Troubleshoot instrument and testing issues to ensure minimal downtime .
Review, validate, and approve test results prior to reporting .
Ensure test accuracy, turnaround time, and compliance with internal and client requirements .
2. Technical Development & Accreditation :
Develop, optimize, and validate new test methods in line with ISO/IEC 17025 requirements.
Support laboratory accreditation activities (VILAS / BoA) and maintain compliance documentation.
Any other duties assigned by Superior’s time to time.
3. Collaboration :
Provide technical support to other team members and troubleshoot equipment or procedural issues .
Collaborate with other teams following sample login, test assignments, and issue report teams to ensure timely and accurate reporting of issues.
4. Resource Management :
Assist with the preparation of technical reports and presentations for internal or external stakeholders .
5. Quality Assurance :
Ensure that all technical developments meet Eurofins' quality standards and regulatory requirements .
Implement and maintain robust quality control processes for technical innovations .

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Eurofins Scientific through its subsidiaries is a world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences, and in agroscience Contract Research services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in genomics and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in BioPharma Contract Development and Manufacturing. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty esoteric and molecular clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA. With ca. 62,000 staff across a network of over 1,000 independent companies in 62 countries and operating over 900 laboratories, Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods for evaluating the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin and purity of biological substances and products, as well as for innovative clinical diagnostics. The objective of Eurofins companies is to provide their customers with high-quality services, accurate results on time and expert advice by their highly qualified staff.
Comprehensive services and unmatched expertise
Eurofins believes it is also a worldwide scientific leader in most of its fields of activity. Through research and development and acquisitions, the Group draws on the latest developments in the field of biotechnology and analytical chemistry to offer its clients unique analytical solutions and the most comprehensive range of testing methods.
A commitment to top quality
The Eurofins Group is committed to provide the highest quality services, accurate results in time and expert advice by its highly qualified staff. The reliability and accuracy of its data help customers make adequate decisions and meet their increasingly stringent quality and safety standards and the expanding demands of regulatory authorities around the world.
Permanent innovation and support by the market leader
Few testing laboratories can combine the level of expertise, technological leadership, attention to quality and customer service that have made Eurofins the global leader in many of the fields where it is active. Large investments in innovation, technology, IT and logistics and very large sample volumes ensure that customers enjoy high standards of quality at reasonable prices.
Eurofins started to provide the services in Vietnam since 2015. Our main services includes Food and Feed Testing, Consumer Product Testing, Environment Services, Agricultural sciences, Inspection and Audit, Certification, DNA testing, Genetic testing before prenancy, Covid test, HPV test, Decoding gen, etc. Current legal entities in Vietnam:
Eurofins Sac Ky Hai Dang
Eurofins Consumer Product Testing
Eurofins Assurance
Eurofins MTS
Eurofins Gentis
Eurofins ETM

'EPC' is a department of BGSV company, belongs to Automotive Powertrain Solution domain. We develop embedded SW for ' Engine / Vehicle control unit ' which controls key vehicle engine functions (e.g., power performance, energy consumption efficiency, emissions, diagnosis, communication) and additional drive-ability features.
As a Fresher Embedded Software Engineer in In-Vehicle Network Communication for European projects , you will join the dynamic development team across multi countries to develop in-vehicle network for Engine/ Vehicle control units.
Main Roles and Responsibilities
Develop and maintain embedded software for in-vehicle network communication in automotive system
Handle and support the requirement engineering include impact analysis
Perform static and dynamic testing from System level down-to SW component level using HiL / SiL environment: System / System integration testing
SW / SW integration testing
SW component static analysis
Baseline & Variant management to ensure traceability between requirements, work products and test reports.
Participate in Problem identification & resolution (e.g., record anomaly found during testing, analyze, troubleshoot)
Report working status and escalate for barriers (to project manager)

sections.text:
🎁 Q4 JOINING BONUS
Join BGSV by 31 December 2026 and receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.
As a Senior Test Engineer , you will play a key role in defining, implementing and improving testing solutions for automotive embedded software products. The position combines technical leadership, test strategy development, automation enablement and cross-functional coordination to ensure delivery quality for complex vehicle communication and embedded system projects.
You will work closely with SWSD, Function Developers, Architects, Project Managers and global stakeholders to establish efficient testing approaches across SIL, HIL and Continuous Testing environments while driving competency growth and quality excellence within the team. Inspired by current EPC ComTest and SIL transformation initiatives. (VW & STLA Account)
Key Responsibilities
Test Strategy & Quality Leadership
Define and maintain project test strategy aligned with project requirements and organizational quality standards.
Plan and coordinate testing activities across System Test, Software Qualification Test, SIL and HIL environments.
Ensure requirement-to-test traceability and coverage throughout the development lifecycle.
Review test specifications, test designs and test reports to ensure completeness and effectiveness.
Drive quality improvement initiatives, defect prevention and lesson-learned activities.
Test Design & Execution
Analyze requirements and clarify ambiguities with stakeholders.
Develop test cases, test specifications and test data for embedded software systems.
Automation & Continuous Testing
Develop and enhance automated testing solutions using Python or similar scripting languages.
Contribute to Continuous Testing (CT) and CI/CD integration for test execution.
Improve testing efficiency through automation, reusable test assets and tooling.
Support SIL-based validation and early defect detection strategies.
Drive test environment optimization and automation initiatives.
Technical Leadership
Mentor junior engineers and support competency development within the team.
Provide technical guidance on test methodologies, automotive communication and debugging.
Support onboarding, knowledge sharing and test process improvement initiatives.
Act as technical focal point for testing-related topics within projects.
Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with global teams, project managers, architects and customers.
Report test progress, risks and quality status to internal and external stakeholders.
Support audits, assessments and compliance activities (ASPICE, Functional Safety, Quality Gate Reviews).
Execute and monitor system-level and software-level validation activities.
Investigate defects, perform root-cause analysis and support issue resolution.
Generate test summary reports and communicate project quality status.

sections.text:
As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer for Automotive Brake Systems (e.g. ABS, ESP, Automatic Emergency Brake (AEB), Electronic Parking Brake (EPB), Sensor Signal Processing, and vehicle dynamics control functions), you will participate in the development of embedded software functions throughout the software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and design to implementation, verification, and system validation.
Your main responsibilities include:
Analyze customer and system requirements; develop software requirements, designs, and technical documentation.
Design, implement, verify, and debug embedded software functions using model-based and/or code-based development approaches.
Develop test specifications, evaluate test results, and support software integration, calibration, and vehicle validation activities.
Investigate and resolve technical issues reported by project teams, customers, and other stakeholders.
Collaborate with global engineering teams to ensure successful project delivery, software quality, and continuous improvement.
More details will be discussed during interviews.

sections.text:
Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Automotive Engineering, Electrical/Electronics Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation Engineering, Computer Engineering, Telecommunications, or related fields.
Have experience in embedded software development.
Good programming skills in C/C++ and good understanding of embedded systems and microcontroller-based software development.
Experience in software development activities including design, implementation, debugging, verification, and technical documentation.
Familiarity with software development lifecycle, software engineering processes, and requirement-based development.
Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
Good English communication skills.

Experience in automotive software development, especially brake, chassis, or vehicle dynamics systems.
Experience with ASCET, MATLAB/Simulink, or similar development tools.
Knowledge of CAN communication protocols and related tools (CANoe, CANalyzer, CAPL).
Familiarity with AUTOSAR, Functional Safety (ISO 26262), ASPICE, V-Model, Agile development, or software review processes.
Experience in software integration, calibration, and vehicle testing activities.
Japanese language skills are a plus.

sections.text:
Bosch first started its operations in Vietnam in 1994 and registered a wholly-owned subsidiary in 2008. According to the business strategy of Bosch in Vietnam, from 1st July 2014 on all business entities were merged into Bosch Vietnam Co. Ltd. with its head office at Ho Chi Minh City plant (HcP) in Dong Nai Province.
HcP has started its belt assembly in a rented building on 1st August 2008 as the assembly plant of Tilburg Plant (TbP). On 14th April 2011, HcP celebrated the inauguration of the new plant (Lth101 with 17,000 sqm), which did not only allow to increase the production depth, but also to facilitate the push belt assembly of this high-tech product. On 3rd July 2012 HcP marked a big milestone by starting to produce the second component (loop-set) for its push belt. Since November 2012, HcP doubled the production floor space and increase the net total floor space up to 56.000 m², and have successfully increased its production capacity and realized a lot of new line SOP’s.
For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Machine Design (Factory Automation)
Design machines, mechanical systems, and automation equipment for factory automation projects.
Develop innovative mechanical concepts and transform them into practical design solutions.
Modify and optimize existing machine designs to meet customer requirements while ensuring quality, safety, and manufacturability.
Create detailed 3D models and 2D drawings using CAD tools.
Select standard components and prepare Bills of Materials (BOM).
Collaborate closely with Electrical, Software, and Manufacturing teams throughout the development process.
Support prototype assembly, testing, troubleshooting, and design improvements.
Mechanical Product Development
Analyze customer requirements and translate them into mechanical design specifications.
Develop mechanical products from concept through detailed design and release.
Create and maintain engineering documentation, including 3D models, 2D drawings, BOMs, Engineering Change Requests (ECR), and related technical documents.
Perform design verification and support product validation activities.
Ensure designs comply with applicable engineering standards, quality requirements, and manufacturing constraints.
Work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering , Mechatronics Engineering , or a related field.
0-3 years of experience in mechanical design, machine design, product development, internship, or academic projects.
Proficient in 3D and 2D CAD software (e.g., Creo, SolidWorks, Inventor, AutoCAD).
Basic understanding of: Machine design principles
Manufacturing and machining processes
Material selection
GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing)
Engineering drawings and BOM creation
Basic knowledge of factory automation systems and mechanical components is an advantage.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
Good communication skills in English.
Willingness to learn, self-motivated, and proactive.
Good teamwork and attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications
Internship, academic project, or practical experience related to machine design, product development, or factory automation.
Familiarity with standard mechanical components such as MISUMI, THK, SMC, HIWIN, Festo, or similar.
Knowledge of mechanism simulation, motion analysis, DFM, DFA, or FMEA is a plus.
Experience working with prototype assembly, testing, or troubleshooting is an advantage.
Ability to communicate in Japanese or Chinese is a plus.

sections.text:
ABOUT THE DEPARTMENT & THE ROLE
'EPC' is a department of BGSV company, belongs to Automotive Powertrain Solution domain. We develop embedded SW for ' Engine / Vehicle control unit ' which controls key vehicle engine functions (e.g., power performance, energy consumption efficiency, emissions, diagnosis, communication) and additional drive-ability features.
As a Fresher Embedded Software Engineer in In-Vehicle Network Communication for European projects , you will join the dynamic development team across multi countries to develop in-vehicle network for Engine/ Vehicle control units.
Main Roles and Responsibilities
Develop and maintain embedded software for in-vehicle network communication in automotive system
Handle and support the requirement engineering include impact analysis
Perform static and dynamic testing from System level down-to SW component level using HiL / SiL environment: System / System integration testing
SW / SW integration testing
SW component static analysis
Baseline & Variant management to ensure traceability between requirements, work products and test reports.
Participate in Problem identification & resolution (e.g., record anomaly found during testing, analyze, troubleshoot)
Report working status and escalate for barriers (to project manager)

sections.text:

Strong logical thinking, problem-solving mindset, and ability to learn new technologies quickly .

Candidates who are interested in developing their career in Automotive Embedded Software are encouraged to apply, even without prior Automotive experience.
Willingness to learn and openness to technical training , as on-the-job training will be provided.
Good communication and teamwork skills.

Handle and support the requirement engineering include impact analysis
Perform static and dynamic testing from System level down-to SW component level using HiL / SiL environment: System / System integration testing
SW / SW integration testing
SW component static analysis
Baseline & Variant management to ensure traceability between requirements, work products and test reports.
Participate in Problem identification & resolution (e.g., record anomaly found during testing, analyze, troubleshoot)
Report working status and escalate for barriers (to project manager)

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical & Electronics, Telecommunications, Mechatronics, Automation, Computer Engineering, Automotive Engineering , or related fields.
Fresh graduates are highly welcome.
Strong logical thinking, problem-solving mindset, and ability to learn new technologies quickly .
Basic understanding of Embedded Systems, Automotive systems, in-vehicle communication, or AUTOSAR is a plus, but not mandatory .
Candidates who are interested in developing their career in Automotive Embedded Software are encouraged to apply, even without prior Automotive experience.
Willingness to learn and openness to technical training , as on-the-job training will be provided.
Good communication and teamwork skills.

Why BOSCH?
Because we do not just follow trends, we create them. Together we turn ideas into reality, working every day to make the world of tomorrow a better place. Do you have high standards when it comes to your job? So do we. At Bosch, you will discover more than just work.
Benefits and Career Opportunities
Working in one of the Best Places to Work in Vietnam and Top 30 of the Most Innovative Companies all over the world
Join in a dynamic and fast-growing global company ( English-speaking environment), with opportunity to work in global projects and being a part of innovation team contributing initiative ideas to the hi-tech world
Onsite opportunities : short-term and long-term assignments in worldwide offices
Engage in our diverse training programs which surely help strengthen both your personal and professionalism
13th-month salary bonus + attractive performance bonus (you'll love it!) + annual performance appraisal
100% offered salary and mandatory social insurances in 2-month probation
15++ days of annual leave + 1-day of birthday leave
Premium health insurance for employee and 02 family members
Flexible working time and working model
Lunch and parking allowance
Good benefits of company activities such as: football, badminton, yoga, Aerobic, team building…
Location
Etown building, 364 Cong Hoa, Tan Binh ward, Ho Chi Minh city, Vietnam

Company Description
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Since the beginning of 2013, its operations have been divided into four business sectors: Automotive Technology, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology.
The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 360 subsidiaries and regional companies in some 50 countries. If its sales and service partners are included, then Bosch is represented in roughly 150 countries. This worldwide development, manufacturing, and sales network is the foundation for further growth.
Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) i s 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH - one of the world’s leading global suppliers of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.
Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region.
With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Bosch first started its operations in Vietnam in 1994 and registered a wholly-owned subsidiary in 2008. According to the business strategy of Bosch in Vietnam, from 1st July 2014 on all business entities were merged into Bosch Vietnam Co. Ltd. with its head office at Ho Chi Minh City plant (HcP) in Dong Nai Province.
HcP has started its belt assembly in a rented building on 1st August 2008 as the assembly plant of Tilburg Plant (TbP). On 14th April 2011, HcP celebrated the inauguration of the new plant (Lth101 with 17,000 sqm), which did not only allow to increase the production depth, but also to facilitate the push belt assembly of this high-tech product. On 3rd July 2012 HcP marked a big milestone by starting to produce the second component (loop-set) for its push belt. Since November 2012, HcP doubled the production floor space and increase the net total floor space up to 56.000 m², and have successfully increased its production capacity and realized a lot of new line SOP’s.
For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Role
You will plan and deploy brand partnership projects with a primary focus on F&B categories across OneGrab and GrabFood, owning the full lifecycle from proposal and package design through pitching, deployment, and campaign evaluation. Alongside this, you will help run partner events & workshops that build Grab Marketing Solutions' credential in the industry and recruit new brand partners. You will report to the Marketing Head, working closely with Commercial, Ads, and Creative teams, as well as external brand and agency partners. This role is based onsite in the Ho Chi Minh office, with growth paths toward broader category ownership and partnership strategy roles within Marketing Solutions.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
You will design brand partnership proposals and commercial packages for F&B brand partners across OneGrab and GrabFood, translating partner objectives into clear collaboration frameworks.
You will pitch and negotiate with brand partners and agencies to secure buy-in for co-marketing collaborations.
You will plan and deploy campaigns end-to-end — briefing creative and media teams, coordinating with Commercial and Ads, and ensuring on-time, in-full delivery.
You will track campaign performance and produce evaluation reports with clear insights and recommendations for future collaborations.
You will support the planning and execution of partner events such as Insight Ignite and workshops, helping attract and recruit new brand partners for GrabAds/Marketing Solutions.
You will use AI tools to speed up proposal drafting, data synthesis, and campaign reporting.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
You should have +1.5 years of experience in brand partnerships, integrated marketing, or account/campaign management, ideally with F&B or FMCG brand exposure.
You will have strong proposal crafting and package design skills, able to translate partner needs into structured frameworks and compelling selling story
You will have solid project management skills to deploy multi-stakeholder campaigns on time and in full.
You will have a data-driven mindset, able to analyze campaign performance and extract actionable insights.
You will have good knowledge of the media, digital, and e-commerce landscape in Vietnam.
You have experience engaging with AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, improve workflows, and contribute new ideas.
You will have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Vietnamese.
Good to Have
Experience organizing or supporting partner-facing events (workshops, summits, activations).
Prior exposure to F&B category marketing or quick-commerce partnerships.

sections.title: Quyền lợi & thông tin bổ sung
sections.text:
Life at Grab
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave , and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours
What We Stand For at Grab
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

You will report to the Marketing Head, working closely with Commercial, Ads, and Creative teams, as well as external brand and agency partners. This role is based onsite in the Ho Chi Minh office, with growth paths toward broader category ownership and partnership strategy roles within Marketing Solutions.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
You will design brand partnership proposals and commercial packages for F&B brand partners across OneGrab and GrabFood, translating partner objectives into clear collaboration frameworks.
You will pitch and negotiate with brand partners and agencies to secure buy-in for co-marketing collaborations.
You will plan and deploy campaigns end-to-end — briefing creative and media teams, coordinating with Commercial and Ads, and ensuring on-time, in-full delivery.
You will track campaign performance and produce evaluation reports with clear insights and recommendations for future collaborations.
You will support the planning and execution of partner events such as Insight Ignite and workshops, helping attract and recruit new brand partners for GrabAds/Marketing Solutions.
You will use AI tools to speed up proposal drafting, data synthesis, and campaign reporting.

What Essential Skills You Will Need
You should have +1.5 years of experience in brand partnerships, integrated marketing, or account/campaign management, ideally with F&B or FMCG brand exposure.
You will have strong proposal crafting and package design skills, able to translate partner needs into structured frameworks and compelling selling story
You will have solid project management skills to deploy multi-stakeholder campaigns on time and in full.
You will have a data-driven mindset, able to analyze campaign performance and extract actionable insights.
You will have good knowledge of the media, digital, and e-commerce landscape in Vietnam.
You have experience engaging with AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, improve workflows, and contribute new ideas.
You will have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Vietnamese.
Good to Have
Experience organizing or supporting partner-facing events (workshops, summits, activations).
Prior exposure to F&B category marketing or quick-commerce partnerships.

Life at Grab
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave , and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours
What We Stand For at Grab
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

About Grab and Our Workplace
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

Đề xuất ý tưởng mới và cải tiến quy trình để giúp đơn giản hóa các đầu mục công việc vận hàng hàng ngày.

Phân công khác theo chỉ đạo của Trưởng phòng.
Địa điểm làm việc : Số 19BT4, Khu Đô Thị Mới Cầu Bươu, phường Hoàng Liệt, Hà Nội

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Position Overview
The Assistant Director of Engineering / Chief Engineer supports the Director of Engineering in leading and managing the day-to-day operations of the Engineering Department. This role ensures the safe, efficient, and sustainable operation of all facilities, systems, and equipment across the resort.
You will play a critical role in facilities management, statutory compliance, health & safety, and operational excellence, while driving team performance, preventive maintenance, and service quality in alignment with Rixos brand standards and all-inclusive resort operations.
Key Responsibilities
Engineering Operations & Facilities Management
Support the Director of Engineering in overseeing the full Engineering operation across the resort.
Supervise and coordinate all Engineering Managers, Chiefs, and technical teams.
Ensure optimal performance, safety, and efficiency of all mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, refrigeration, water treatment, and life safety systems.
Oversee the establishment and execution of preventive maintenance programs for rooms, public areas, and back-of-house facilities.
Conduct regular inspections to assess building conditions and recommend repairs, renovations, or upgrades.
Budgeting & Cost Control
Assist in managing the Engineering department’s operating and capital expenditure budgets.
Control departmental costs while maintaining service quality and asset integrity.
Support procurement of equipment, spare parts, tools, and supplies in line with budget and brand standards.
Compliance, Safety & Sustainability
Ensure full compliance with Rixos policies, SOPs, and statutory regulations.
Enforce compliance with ISO Integrated Management Systems
(ISO 9001, 14001, 22000, 10002, LQA, Health & Safety, Risk Management) .
Actively support environmental sustainability initiatives including energy efficiency, water conservation, and pollution prevention.
Ensure all emergency systems are functional and that teams are fully trained in emergency response procedures.
Coordinate fire safety drills and training with Security and local authorities.
Guest Experience & Service Excellence
Handle engineering-related guest complaints professionally and effectively.
Support service recovery and ensure minimal disruption to guest experience.
Lead by example in guest focus, responsiveness, and service standards.
People Leadership & Development
Lead, motivate, and develop the Engineering team to achieve high performance.
Foster a positive, fair, and collaborative working environment.
Support recruitment, onboarding, training, performance evaluation, and disciplinary processes.
Ensure regular technical and safety training programs are implemented.
Encourage open communication, feedback, and continuous improvement within the team.
Planning, Reporting & Administration
Ensure accurate maintenance logs, records, and reports are maintained.
Assist in planning long-term maintenance strategies and capital projects.
Monitor attendance, leave balances, and manpower planning in coordination with People & Culture.
Participate in task force assignments and new hotel openings when required.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Education: Degree in Engineering or equivalent technical qualification.
Experience: Minimum 3–5 years in a similar role within a 4–5 star hotel or resort environment.
Technical Expertise: Strong knowledge of hotel engineering systems and facilities operations.
Skills: Strong leadership and people management skills
Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities
Computer literacy and reporting skills
Ability to work under pressure in a complex, large-scale resort environment
Core Competencies
Sincerity & Transparency
Act with integrity, professionalism, and accountability.
Demonstrate sound judgment and ownership in decision-making.
Reliability & Teamwork
Deliver on commitments and support cross-functional collaboration.
Maintain a positive, approachable, and solution-oriented mindset.
Excellence in Hospitality
Commitment to quality, financial responsibility, and Rixos standards.
Drive results while maintaining service and safety excellence.
Quality Management & Innovation
Continuously seek operational improvements and efficiencies.
Encourage innovation, feedback, and best practice sharing.

sections.text:
What awaits you...
The opportunity to join an international and innovative and fast-growing group, committed not only to building new hotels, but to creating a global brand.
The ability to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.
Be part of a team that is very passionate about creating great hospitality experiences and exploring new locations with every opportunity.
A competitive package and plenty of development opportunities.

Each Rixos property presents a unique experience inspired by local culture, global influences, and our Turkish heritage, all within a setting of unparalleled luxury.

Responsible for Flash Bootloader software development

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. With technology that is “Invented for life,” Bosch wants to help improve quality of life and conserve natural resources.
The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 490 subsidiary and regional companies in over 60 countries. Including sales and service partners, Bosch’s global manufacturing, engineering, and sales network covers nearly every country in the world. Bosch’s innovative strength is key to the company’s further development.
Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.
Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region. With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.
BGSV currently operates from three offices located at the following addresses:

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Eurofins Scientific through its subsidiaries is a world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences, and in agroscience Contract Research services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in genomics and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in BioPharma Contract Development and Manufacturing. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty esoteric and molecular clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA. With ca. 62,000 staff across a network of over 1,000 independent companies in 62 countries and operating over 900 laboratories, Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods for evaluating the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin and purity of biological substances and products, as well as for innovative clinical diagnostics. The objective of Eurofins companies is to provide their customers with high-quality services, accurate results on time and expert advice by their highly qualified staff.
Comprehensive services and unmatched expertise
Eurofins believes it is also a worldwide scientific leader in most of its fields of activity. Through research and development and acquisitions, the Group draws on the latest developments in the field of biotechnology and analytical chemistry to offer its clients unique analytical solutions and the most comprehensive range of testing methods.
A commitment to top quality
The Eurofins Group is committed to provide the highest quality services, accurate results in time and expert advice by its highly qualified staff. The reliability and accuracy of its data help customers make adequate decisions and meet their increasingly stringent quality and safety standards and the expanding demands of regulatory authorities around the world.
Permanent innovation and support by the market leader
Few testing laboratories can combine the level of expertise, technological leadership, attention to quality and customer service that have made Eurofins the global leader in many of the fields where it is active. Large investments in innovation, technology, IT and logistics and very large sample volumes ensure that customers enjoy high standards of quality at reasonable prices.
Eurofins started to provide the services in Vietnam since 2015. Our main services includes Food and Feed Testing, Consumer Product Testing, Environment Services, Agricultural sciences, Inspection and Audit, Certification, DNA testing, Genetic testing before prenancy, Covid test, HPV test, Decoding gen, etc. Current legal entities in Vietnam:
Eurofins Sac Ky Hai Dang
Eurofins Consumer Product Testing
Eurofins Assurance
Eurofins MTS
Eurofins Gentis
Eurofins ETM

sections.text:
Eurofins Scientific through its subsidiaries is a world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences, and in agroscience Contract Research services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in genomics and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in BioPharma Contract Development and Manufacturing. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty esoteric and molecular clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA. With ca. 62,000 staff across a network of over 1,000 independent companies in 62 countries and operating over 900 laboratories, Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods for evaluating the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin and purity of biological substances and products, as well as for innovative clinical diagnostics. The objective of Eurofins companies is to provide their customers with high-quality services, accurate results on time and expert advice by their highly qualified staff.
Comprehensive services and unmatched expertise
Eurofins believes it is also a worldwide scientific leader in most of its fields of activity. Through research and development and acquisitions, the Group draws on the latest developments in the field of biotechnology and analytical chemistry to offer its clients unique analytical solutions and the most comprehensive range of testing methods.
A commitment to top quality
The Eurofins Group is committed to provide the highest quality services, accurate results in time and expert advice by its highly qualified staff. The reliability and accuracy of its data help customers make adequate decisions and meet their increasingly stringent quality and safety standards and the expanding demands of regulatory authorities around the world.
Permanent innovation and support by the market leader
Few testing laboratories can combine the level of expertise, technological leadership, attention to quality and customer service that have made Eurofins the global leader in many of the fields where it is active. Large investments in innovation, technology, IT and logistics and very large sample volumes ensure that customers enjoy high standards of quality at reasonable prices.
Eurofins started to provide the services in Vietnam since 2015. Our main services includes Food and Feed Testing, Consumer Product Testing, Environment Services, Agricultural sciences, Inspection and Audit, Certification, DNA testing, Genetic testing before prenancy, Covid test, HPV test, Decoding gen, etc. Current legal entities in Vietnam:
Eurofins Sac Ky Hai Dang
Eurofins Consumer Product Testing
Eurofins Assurance
Eurofins MTS
Eurofins Gentis
Eurofins ETM

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Responsible for managing the end-to-end sample lifecycle—including receiving, processing, sorting, storing, and distributing testing samples to relevant laboratories—ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with company quality standards. / Chịu trách nhiệm thực hiện toàn bộ quy trình tiếp nhận, xử lý, phân loại, lưu trữ và bàn giao mẫu thử nghiệm cho các phòng thí nghiệm, đảm bảo tính chính xác, đúng hạn và tuân thủ các tiêu chuẩn quản lý chất lượng của công ty
Receive, manage, and sort incoming samples/ Tiếp nhận, quản lý mẫu và phân loại mẫu
Update and manage sample information in the eLims system to ensure completeness and accuracy / Cập nhật và quản lý thông tin mẫu trên hệ thống eLims đảm bảo đầy đủ và chính xác
Inspect and transfer samples to the appropriate testing team/ Kiểm tra và chuyển mẫu cho nhóm phân tích phù hợp
Organize, store, and preserve samples in accordance with company regulations and specific client requirements/ Tổ chức, lưu trữ và bảo quản mẫu theo đúng quy định và yêu cầu của từng khách hàng
Liaise with Customer Service regarding sample status, Test Request Forms (TRF), sample receipt, as well as receiving and forwarding client inquiries or complaints/ T rao đổi thông tin với bộ phận chăm sóc khách hàng: Các thông tin về mẫu, phiếu yêu cầu thử nghiệm, nhận mẫu, nhận và chuyển khiếu nại
Strictly comply with company regulations on document and sample management/ Thực hiện đúng quy định về quản lý tài liệu/mẫu của công ty
Adhere to safety, 5S, and sample preservation guidelines/ Tuân thủ quy định về an toàn, 5S và bảo quản mẫu
Perform other tasks as assigned by superiors/ Thực hiện các công việc khác theo sự chỉ định của cấp trên

sections.text:
Kinh nghiệm (Experiences) :
Fresh graduate or 6-month experience in a testing/laboratory environment is an advantage/ Mới tốt nghiệp hoặc có 6 tháng kinh nghiệm làm việc trong phòng thí nghiệm/lĩnh vực kiểm nghiệm là một lợi thế.

Khác (Others) :
Quick learner, meticulous, accurate, and highly responsible for sample management/ Nhanh nhẹn, cẩn thận, chính xác và có trách nhiệm cao trong quản lý mẫu.
Strong capability in logical sample arrangement and scientific storage/ Có khả năng sắp xếp và lưu trữ mẫu khoa học.
Proficient in using Excel or tracking logs for sample management/ Thành thạo Excel hoặc các công cụ theo dõi dữ liệu.
Able to work independently and under pressure; enthusiastic and reliable/ Khả năng nắm bắt công việc nhanh; chịu được áp lực, làm việc độc lập và có tinh thần trách nhiệm.

sections.text:
Get to know our Team
Join the FundsCore platform team at Grab - a dynamic and fast-paced team building a reliable platform to address challenging problems in the Payments domain. We are a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, product managers, business, and operations who innovate and collaborate to solve some of the most challenging problems - enabling reliable reconciliation with many financial partners and offering accurate and timely settlement to many merchants. This role prefers you have exceptional quick-learning skills.
Get to Know the Role
You will be responsible for owning test strategy planning, priorisation, execution, maintenance, and promoting automation and best practice in testing to ensure high product quality in FundsCore platforms.
You will be participating in our full software development life cycle, including contributions to our product or system design. And as a Software Engineer in Test (SET), you are expected to contribute to fixing bugs and driving our Operational Excellence, such as performing On-Call duties.
You will report to a Senior Engineering Manager and work onsite at Grab HCMC, Vietnam office.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Determine the test coverage and the types of tests required through an understanding of the user stories, the important aspects of a feature, its system design and its code, meeting system and product quality standards
Identify and classify critical test cases and implement them to safeguard our systems and products
Remove reliance on manual test cases through migration to more automated testing methods (e.g. UAT) or through automating the existing tests and retiring obsolete/non-useful tests cases for engineering excellence
Take necessary measures to ensure a team's test repertoire meets the balance mandated by the Testing Pyramid
Know what current best practice requires, and ensure the team is conforming to it
Advise the team for making decisions as to when to invest in refactoring existing test cases to conform to newer practices and technologies
Take the responsibility to design and review medium and large tests at an early (pre-development) stage
Build, extend, and customise the team's testing frameworks

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
We are looking for a Junior AI Automation Engineer who is passionate about technology, automation, Artificial Intelligence, and process improvement.
The role will work across the department to identify repetitive, manual, and time-consuming workflows and transform them into automated, data-driven, and AI-enabled processes .
You will work closely with engineering teams, project managers, technical leads, and department leadership to understand existing processes, identify improvement opportunities, develop automation solutions, and measure the business impact.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who wants to build practical experience in AI, automation, software engineering, data analytics, and digital transformation .
Key Responsibilities
1. Process Discovery & Automation
Identify repetitive and manual workflows across engineering and management functions.
Understand existing processes by working directly with process owners and engineering teams.
Analyze processes and identify opportunities for simplification and automation.
Create process maps and automation proposals.
Prioritize automation opportunities based on business value, effort, frequency, and feasibility.
2. Develop Automation Solutions
Develop automation solutions using tools such as: Microsoft Power Automate
Power Apps
Power BI
Python
APIs
Microsoft Teams / Microsoft 365
GitHub
AI/LLM-based tools
Integrate data from multiple systems and automate repetitive reporting activities.
Develop scripts and utilities to eliminate manual engineering activities.
Automate data collection, transformation, analysis, reporting, and notifications.
3. AI & GenAI Applications
Explore practical applications of Generative AI within engineering and business workflows.
Develop AI-assisted solutions for: Document summarization
Meeting/action-item processing
Report generation
Information extraction
Classification
Engineering data analysis
Knowledge retrieval
Issue/defect analysis
Evaluate emerging AI tools and identify opportunities to improve departmental productivity.
4. Dashboard & Data Automation
Automate collection and consolidation of project and engineering data.
Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards.
Create automated KPI and management reports.
Support engineering teams with data analysis and visualization.
Ensure automated reports are accurate, reliable, and easy to maintain.
5. Continuous Improvement
Measure the impact of automation initiatives.
Track metrics such as: Manual hours saved
Cycle-time reduction
Reduction in repetitive activities
Error reduction
Process adoption
Productivity improvement
Continuously identify additional opportunities for digitalization.
Examples of Potential Automation Projects
The successful candidate may work on projects such as:
Automated weekly/monthly management reporting
Project status consolidation
Automated KPI dashboards
Meeting minutes and action-item automation
Automated Teams notifications and reminders
Engineering milestone tracking
Defect/bug trend analysis
Test execution and quality reporting
Requirement-to-test traceability reporting
Training and certification tracking
Skill-matrix automation
Engineering data collection
Automated document analysis
AI-powered engineering knowledge assistants
Automated email/report generation
Cross-system data consolidation

sections.text:

Good programming skills in Python or other programming language
Solid foundation in software engineering principles.
Familiarity with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), or modern AI application development.

Analytical thinking, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
Excellent communication and teamwork abilities, with a proactive and growth-oriented mindset.
Passion for learning emerging technologies and applying AI to solve real-world engineering challenges.
Good English communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with global stakeholders.

Microsoft Power Automate

Python
SQL
REST APIs
Microsoft Teams / Microsoft 365
Git/GitHub
Azure
Generative AI / LLMs
Prompt Engineering
RPA
Data Analytics
Machine Learning
Success in This Role
Within the first 6–12 months, the successful candidate is expected to:
Build an automation opportunity pipeline for the department.
Identify high-value repetitive workflows.
Deliver multiple production-ready automation solutions.
Establish measurable productivity improvements.
Reduce manual reporting and administrative effort.
Introduce practical AI-enabled workflows.
Create reusable automation components and best practices.
Establish a foundation for a scalable Department AI & Automation capability .
