sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. With technology that is “Invented for life,” Bosch wants to help improve quality of life and conserve natural resources.
The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 490 subsidiary and regional companies in over 60 countries. Including sales and service partners, Bosch’s global manufacturing, engineering, and sales network covers nearly every country in the world. Bosch’s innovative strength is key to the company’s further development.
Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.
Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region. With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.
BGSV currently operates from three offices located at the following addresses:
1. Etown Building – 364 Cong Hoa Street, Ward 13, Tan Binh District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
2. OfficeHaus Building – 32 Tan Thang Street, Son Ky Ward, Tan Phu District, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
3. Capital Place Building – 29 Lieu Giai Street, Ngoc Khanh Ward, Ba Dinh District, Hanoi, Vietnam

sections.text:
🎁 Quarter 4 JOINING BONUS
Candidates with 4+ years of relevant experience who join BGSV by the end of 31 December 2026 can receive a Joining Bonus equivalent to 1 month’s gross salary , subject to program eligibility and terms & conditions.
Main Roles and Responsibilities
Work as part of Bosch’s global ADAS teams to develop and integrate AUTOSAR Classic BSW and diagnostics software for next‑generation driver assistance ECUs (radar, camera, sensor fusion, domain controllers).
Roles & Responsibilities
Develop and maintain embedded AUTOSAR Classic software (BSW and low‑level SW) for ADAS ECUs using C/C++.
Configure, integrate, and debug AUTOSAR BSW modules, with focus on: Diagnostics, CAN Communication, Failure management and PDM.
Collaborate closely with global system, hardware, and application teams to ensure end‑to‑end integration of BSW with ADAS applications (e.g., radar, camera, sensor fusion).
Participate in the complete software development lifecycle: requirements analysis, architecture & design, implementation, unit/integration testing, debug, and maintenance.
Optimize software performance and memory usage for resource-constrained embedded systems.
Conduct code reviews, ensure adherence to Bosch coding guidelines, MISRA rules (if applicable), and best practices.
Develop and execute unit tests and integration tests; support SIL/HIL testing and vehicle testing as needed.
Ensure compliance with ISO 26262 (functional safety) and Automotive SPICE processes contribute to work products and assessments.
Create and maintain software architecture, design, and interface documentation for global stakeholders.
Use tools such as CANoe, CANalyzer, debuggers, emulators, and simulators for development, analysis, and issue resolution.
Stay updated with the latest AUTOSAR specifications and implement compliant software solutions.
Contribute to the development of software architecture and design documents.
Collaborate with hardware engineers to ensure optimal software-hardware integration.
Participate in technical discussions in an international, distributed team; and actively provide innovative solutions to complex engineering challenges.
Work, design reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Strong Technical skills preferably in automotive domain & Good experience in programming in C, C++ for embedded systems.
Experience with AUTOSAR Classic architecture and BSW and ASPICE know-how.
Good understanding of microcontrollers, low‑level drivers, and embedded RTOS concepts.
Experience / Familiarity in: Vehicle diagnostics and fault management SW
AUTOSAR modules: Diagnostic Error Management (DEM), Diagnostic Communication Management (DCM), Communication Stack (CAN\Ethernet\LIN protocol)
Automotive protocols and standards: ISO 14229, ISO 15765, ISO 14230, ISO 26262.
Familiarity with CANoe, CANalyzer, and issue/requirement tracking tools (e.g., Jira, DOORS/ or similar).
Prior Experience with ADAS‑related ECUs (radar, camera, sensor fusion, braking/steering controllers) is a strong plus.
Soft Skills
Self‑driven, proactive, and able to take ownership of modules/features end‑to‑end.
Strong teamwork, interpersonal skills, and problem‑solving ability.
High degree of self-discipline, quality focus, and willingness to learn new technologies in ADAS and autonomous driving.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Bosch first started its operations in Vietnam in 1994 and registered a wholly-owned subsidiary in 2008. According to the business strategy of Bosch in Vietnam, from 1st July 2014 on all business entities were merged into Bosch Vietnam Co. Ltd. with its head office at Ho Chi Minh City plant (HcP) in Dong Nai Province.
HcP has started its belt assembly in a rented building on 1st August 2008 as the assembly plant of Tilburg Plant (TbP). On 14th April 2011, HcP celebrated the inauguration of the new plant (Lth101 with 17,000 sqm), which did not only allow to increase the production depth, but also to facilitate the push belt assembly of this high-tech product. On 3rd July 2012 HcP marked a big milestone by starting to produce the second component (loop-set) for its push belt. Since November 2012, HcP doubled the production floor space and increase the net total floor space up to 56.000 m², and have successfully increased its production capacity and realized a lot of new line SOP’s.
For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Build and grow our evergreen OneGrab brand platforms
Develop sharp consumer & cultural understanding through data insight: study audience behaviour, occasion relevance and category conversations to know which platforms and moments are worth owning.
Translate that insight into the brand platform plan: define the brand idea, the positioning angle, the occasion calendar and the go-to-market approach for each platform across the year.
Deploy the brand and marketing agenda behind the plan: lead complex, high-investment integrated campaigns as well as BAU always-on activity, from planning through to post-campaign readout.
Brief and land the creative and communication assets across touchpoints (in-app, digital, earned & offline), working closely with the in-house creative team, the vertical marketing teams and insights & analytics partners.
Drive brand building across our stakeholder and partner ecosystem
Co-develop the stakeholder brand agenda with Communications, PR and Public Affairs teams: shape how we build brand equity with our driver-partners, our consumers, the public and the wider industry.
Co-build the narrative and the winning campaign plan to bring partners in: design the corporate and platform narratives, the thought leadership agenda, and the award and recognition plan that strengthen our brand credentials in the market.
Pitch, align and activate with internal and external partners: work across all verticals and functions internally, and co-create with brand partners and external stakeholders to bring each agenda to life.
Monitor brand and campaign performance of every platform and campaign deployed, and make recommendations to optimise investment efficiency and brand impact.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor degree, preferably with a focus on Marketing, Communications, Business Administration or Economics, with strong written & verbal communication skills in English & Vietnamese.
4+ years of full-time experience in brand marketing or integrated brand communications is a must: hands-on experience building brand platforms end to end, from insight and idea through to multi-channel execution and measurement.
Proven experience in brand, integrated marketing communications or campaign management roles, with a track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder campaigns; experience across consumer brand, corporate brand, PR or social impact agendas is a plus.
Strong storytelling and narrative craft, with the ability to turn a business agenda into a brand idea that lands with consumers, partners and the public.
Experience planning and executing campaign mechanics at volume, from complex flagship campaigns to BAU always-on activity, with clear performance accountability.
Detail-oriented, consumer-centric & data-driven mindset to unlock and drive brand and business growth.
Seniority and maturity to bring big, diverse cross-functional teams along with you and to work directly with external partners, including public-sector and brand stakeholders.
Resourceful & fast learning ability in an ever-changing environment; flexibility & adaptability with business needs; ability to perform under pressure in a dynamic & fast-paced environment.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
GIP stands for Growth, Insights & Planning . In Vietnam, it operates as a central business team that partners with functions such as Mobility, Commercial, Marketing, Marketplace and other operational teams to identify growth opportunities, provide data-driven insights and support business planning.
Get to Know the Role
Role is a balance of data analysis, financial planning and stakeholder management:
Develop frameworks to analyze business problems, develop hypotheses, mine data, deliver recommendations, and assess the impact of proposed solutions.
Partner closely with all business stakeholders across different functions to set and implement the strategy.
To perform this role well the candidate will need to have an excellent team player mindset & passionate with innovation
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Monitor & manage day-to-day marketplace growth metrics, investigate short-term anomalies and troubleshoot with the relevant team as needed.
Developing day-to-day tactical initiatives to improve marketplace dynamics, using marketplace tools efficiently.
Coordinate cross teams to execute campaigns from end-to-end, to update system knowledge and troubleshoot system issues.
Perform demand planning such as forecast demand, come up with growth initiatives for weekly and monthly cycles.
Set up campaigns on the system. Monitor and adjust campaign performance on a daily basis.
Conduct preliminary analysis to drive insight on effectiveness and impact of the campaign to revenue and demand growth
Assist Marketplace Senior to conduct experiments for economics optimization.
Build presentations to influence senior stakeholders and enable data driven decision making.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
A degree from a decent university in any discipline, 2+ years of experience.
Familiarity with economics is a strong plus - fundamentally, this role is about matching supply and demand efficiently.
Good logical thinking and meticulousness.
Strong sense of curiosity in seeking impactful opportunities and learning about our economics.
Fluent in English and Vietnamese.
Good to have (not required):
Familiar with large datasets and a knack for piecing together data to form insights.
Working understanding of SQL and experience with a mobile CLM platform
Processing and analyzing complex data sets using SQL, Power BI, Advanced Excel (can maintain complex spreadsheets).

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Bosch first started its operations in Vietnam in 1994 and registered a wholly-owned subsidiary in 2008. According to the business strategy of Bosch in Vietnam, from 1st July 2014 on all business entities were merged into Bosch Vietnam Co. Ltd. with its head office at Ho Chi Minh City plant (HcP) in Dong Nai Province.
HcP has started its belt assembly in a rented building on 1st August 2008 as the assembly plant of Tilburg Plant (TbP). On 14th April 2011, HcP celebrated the inauguration of the new plant (Lth101 with 17,000 sqm), which did not only allow to increase the production depth, but also to facilitate the push belt assembly of this high-tech product. On 3rd July 2012 HcP marked a big milestone by starting to produce the second component (loop-set) for its push belt. Since November 2012, HcP doubled the production floor space and increase the net total floor space up to 56.000 m², and have successfully increased its production capacity and realized a lot of new line SOP’s.
For further information, please visit our website: www.bosch.com.vn

sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. It employs roughly 394,500 associates worldwide (as of December 31, 2020). According to preliminary figures, the company generated sales of 71.6 billion euros in 2020. Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility Solutions, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology.
The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 440 subsidiaries and regional companies in some 60 countries. If its sales and service partners are included, then Bosch is represented in roughly 126 locations. This worldwide development, manufacturing, and sales network is the foundation for further growth.
BGSV – Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (Previous name: RBVH - Robert Bosch Engineering and Business Solutions Vietnam Company Limited) is 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH.
BGSV has started its operations from 19th October, 2010 at E-Town2 in HCMC. This engineering development center will be engaged in developing embedded systems and software, mechanical design and simulation, and will provide IT (SAP Consulting, JAVA Development….) and Business Services (Finance and accounting, Economics, Purchasing, Logistics, Translations Japanese-English-Japanese, Information Security ) solutions to the Bosch group of companies globally.

sections.text:
IT Procurement Interns support the IT Procurement & Asset Management team in keeping purchasing operations accurate and running smoothly. They work with software license data, procurement documents, invoices and vendor information, and prepare first drafts of reports and purchase recommendations for review. This is an onsite internship at our Ho Chi Minh City office, and we are looking for candidates who can start as soon as possible.
Key responsibilities
Work with the End-User Support team, colleagues who request purchases, and vendors
Perform the following under the coaching of your supervisor: Software licenses: Keep the license list up to date (renewal dates, owners, costs, number of users), remind owners to fill in missing information, and collect invoices for the monthly company card check
Documents: Organize and store contracts, purchase orders, quotations and invoices, scan signed originals, and track which documents are still waiting for signatures
Purchasing and assets: Create simple, low-value purchase orders; receive goods, hand them to the requester, and record device details (e.g. serial numbers) in the asset system
Invoices: Check that invoices match purchase orders, contracts and payments, collect VAT invoices from vendors, and follow up when an invoice is missing or incorrect
Vendors: Collect vendor information, ask vendors for quotations, and prepare draft purchase proposals using ready-made templates
Communication: Write routine emails to vendors, arrange vendor meetings, and take notes on meeting outcomes and next steps
Reporting: Prepare data in Excel/Google Sheets for monthly checks and draft regular reports for your supervisor to review

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Skills/knowledge you need to be successful
Final-year student in Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, or a related major
Available at least 4 days/week (full-time preferred) - working onsite at our Ho Chi Minh City office, for 3–6 months
Intermediate level of English to work on internal emails and documents
Good at Excel or Google Sheets: filtering, sorting, VLOOKUP, pivot tables and basic formulas
Careful with details and comfortable with repetitive data tasks; able to notice when a number or record looks wrong
Organized and able to keep track of many small tasks without being reminder
Able to keep company and vendor information (e.g. bank details, tax codes) confidential
Nice to have
Experience in purchasing, accounting, admin or inventory work, including part-time jobs or school projects is a plus
Familiarity with business or asset management software
Interest in technology products and software tools
Experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) to draft emails, summarize documents or write spreadsheet formulas, while keeping company data private

Perform all testing activities to improve product quality, working closely with the team: test estimation, test planning, test case design, test execution, defect tracking, etc.
Apply AI tools throughout the testing lifecycle to increase speed and coverage: analyzing requirements and user stories, generating test scenarios and test data, drafting test plans and bug reports, and summarizing test results.
Review and validate all AI-generated output (test cases, scripts, analysis) for accuracy, completeness, and relevance before use.
Collect data and report testing status.
Show creativity and initiative to improve test coverage and effectiveness, including identifying new opportunities to apply AI tools and agents in the team's QA workflow.
Address test needs in a methodical, detail-oriented manner with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Participate in initiatives supporting product growth such as competitor research and customer troubleshooting, leveraging AI for research and root-cause investigation.
Participate in sprint planning and work closely with the Scrum team to analyze requirements and provide QA/test recommendations.
Follow responsible AI practices and company policies when handling client data, ensuring no sensitive or confidential information is exposed to unapproved AI tools.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
General requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
Intermediate level of English proficiency, with good communication skills
3+ years of hands-on experience in software testing
Able to self-learn and quickly adapt to new technologies
Familiar with the Agile development methodologies
Good collaboration skills with a proven ability to work seamlessly with both customers and team members
Technical requirements:
Experience testing web-based and mobile applications
Good domain knowledge of the software development process, especially the software testing process
Solid testing experience (test approach, test plan, test techniques including black-box, risk-based, exploratory, non-UI/API testing, etc.)
Methodical and detail-oriented, with solid analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong dedication to quality and a positive, collaborative attitude toward testing
Hands-on use of AI chat tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) in real testing work
Practical use of an AI coding assistant (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) for test scripts, API tests, or SQL
Strong prompting skills for accurate test cases, scripts, and docs
Understanding of AI agents and MCP
Awareness of AI limitations and responsible handling of sensitive client data
Able to share real examples of how AI improved your testing
Nice to have:
Experience in creating and running automated tests using testing frameworks like Katalon/ Selenium/ Robotium/ UiAutomator/ XCTest/ XCUiTest, etc.
Hand-on experience in using test tools like TestNG/ Mocha/ Jasmine/ Nightwatch, etc.

Get to Know the Team
The Central Operations, Risk & Compliance team is part of Grab Vietnam's Central Operations function. The team supports operational integrity by strengthening quality controls, monitoring compliance, identifying operational risks, and driving continuous improvement across Vietnam operations.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
QA & QC Management: Establish quality benchmarks, audit daily operational workflows, and conduct regular QC checks to maintain high service standards.
Risk Identification & Mitigation: Monitor operational processes to detect risks early, analyze root causes, and implement preventive measures.
Process Management: Design, update, and standardize Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and control frameworks for the Central Ops team.
Compliance & Monitoring: Ensure operational activities strictly align with company policies, industry regulations, and internal standards.

Experience: 1–3 years of experience in Operational Risk, Compliance, Quality Assurance, or Quality Control
Skills: Strong analytical thinking, process design capabilities, and high attention to detail.

Proficient English to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.

The Central Operations, Risk & Compliance team is part of Grab Vietnam's Central Operations function. The team supports operational integrity by strengthening quality controls, monitoring compliance, identifying operational risks, and driving continuous improvement across Vietnam operations.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
QA & QC Management: Establish quality benchmarks, audit daily operational workflows, and conduct regular QC checks to maintain high service standards.
Risk Identification & Mitigation: Monitor operational processes to detect risks early, analyze root causes, and implement preventive measures.
Process Management: Design, update, and standardize Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and control frameworks for the Central Ops team.
Compliance & Monitoring: Ensure operational activities strictly align with company policies, industry regulations, and internal standards.

What Essential Skills You Will Need
Experience: 1–3 years of experience in Operational Risk, Compliance, Quality Assurance, or Quality Control
Skills: Strong analytical thinking, process design capabilities, and high attention to detail.
Tools: Proficiency in data analysis tools (Excel, SQL, or BI tools is preferred) and flowchart/documentation software.
Proficient English to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.

Life at Grab
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
Grab is undergoing a major transformation in how customer and operational experiences are delivered across the ecosystem. As AI capabilities evolve, we are rethinking the future of automation, workflow orchestration, and intelligent operations to move beyond traditional processes toward more proactive and scalable experiences.
We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to join our Product team in Vietnam to help shape this next phase of transformation across internal platforms and operational experiences.
Get to Know the Role
As a Lead Product Manager, you will lead highly ambiguous and strategic product initiatives focused on AI-driven workflows, operational tooling, and platform experiences. You will work closely with engineering, operations, design, data science, and platform teams to define scalable solutions that improve efficiency, decision-making, and user experience across the organization.
This role requires a strong builder mindset, deep systems thinking, high execution velocity, and the ability to navigate ambiguity while driving alignment across multiple stakeholders. You will report to the Senior Product Leader and will be based onsite at the Grab Vietnam HCM Office.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Work closely with cross-functional teams to define and improve intelligent workflows, automation capabilities, and operational tooling across multiple business areas
Operate effectively in highly ambiguous problem spaces, rapidly iterating on product direction, operational models, and workflow design based on evolving business and platform needs
Use customer data, operational signals, and business metrics to identify root causes, separate signal from noise, and drive systemic improvements rather than symptom-level fixes
Lead large cross-functional initiatives involving engineering, operations, policy, analytics, design, and leadership stakeholders across multiple regions
Prototype, validate, and iterate quickly on new ideas and workflows, with a strong bias toward execution and experimentation
Stay ahead of industry trends in AI, automation, platform tooling, and customer experience, and apply these learnings pragmatically to evolve internal capabilities
Clearly communicate product strategy, trade-offs, execution risks, and business impact to senior leadership and stakeholders, grounding discussions in data and customer outcomes

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
At least 8 years of product experience, with mandatory hands-on experience shipping GenAI products across any domain.
Strong product intuition backed by data, with the ability to identify high-leverage problems and make sound trade-offs in ambiguous environments.
Proven experience driving complex, cross-functional initiatives from problem discovery through delivery at scale.
Ability to translate abstract strategy into clear product direction, roadmaps, and execution plans that teams can align around.
Senior-level judgment and leadership, with a track record of influencing stakeholders, mentoring PMs, and shaping product culture.

sections.text:
Why BOSCH?
Because we do not just follow trends, we create them. Together we turn ideas into reality, working every day to make the world of tomorrow a better place. Do you have high standards when it comes to your job? So do we. At Bosch, you will discover more than just work.
Benefits and Career Opportunities
Working in one of the Best Places to Work in Vietnam and Top 30 of the Most Innovative Companies all over the world
Join in a dynamic and fast-growing global company ( English-speaking environment), with opportunity to work in global projects and being a part of innovation team contributing initiative ideas to the hi-tech world
Onsite opportunities : short-term and long-term assignments in worldwide offices
Engage in our diverse training programs which surely help strengthen both your personal and professionalism
13th-month salary bonus + attractive performance bonus (you'll love it!) + annual performance appraisal
100% offered salary and mandatory social insurances in 2-month probation
15++ days of annual leave + 1-day of birthday leave
Premium health insurance for employee and 02 family members
Flexible working time and working model
Lunch and parking allowance
Good benefits of company activities such as: football, badminton, yoga, Aerobic, team building…

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Since the beginning of 2013, its operations have been divided into four business sectors: Automotive Technology, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology.
The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 360 subsidiaries and regional companies in some 50 countries. If its sales and service partners are included, then Bosch is represented in roughly 150 countries. This worldwide development, manufacturing, and sales network is the foundation for further growth.
Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) i s 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH - one of the world’s leading global suppliers of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.
Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region.
With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
An SAP Consultant Intern supports the implementation, configuration, and testing of SAP modules (e.g., FICO, SD, MM) by translating business requirements into technical solutions. Responsibilities include assisting with system upgrades, creating technical documentation, troubleshooting issues, and collaborating with functional teams on end-to-end projects.
Job Description & Responsibilities
System Configuration: Assist in configuring SAP modules to meet business requirements.
Testing & Troubleshooting: Participate in functional unit testing, integration testing, and debugging, including identifying and resolving system issues.
Documentation: Create and update technical documents, process flows, and user guides.
Data Management: Support master data cleansing, migration, or maintenance tasks.
Project Support: Work with the SAP Core team to support business processes and project milestones.
Support: Assist end-users with troubleshooting and resolving tickets (if any)

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Education: 3rd or final-year student in in Business Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or a related field.
Official university recommendation letter with stamp (mandatory)
Commitment: full-time or at least 4 days/week
Skills: Basic knowledge of business processes (e.g., Supply Chain, Finance) and experience with ERP systems is a plus.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint); SAP skills are preferred.
Soft Skills: Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Attributes: Quick learner, eager to work with new technology, and capable of working in teams.

Conceptualise, shoot and edit high-quality photo and video content for social media, campaigns and digital platforms.
Manage the full creative process from brief and shoot planning to production, editing and final delivery.
Proactively organise photo and video shoots across hotel departments, including rooms, F&B, lifestyle, spa, events and activations.
Capture hotel events, key moments and special activations as required.
Handle photography and videography setup, lighting, sound, editing, retouching and colour grading.
Create content adapted for Instagram Reels, Stories, social posts, websites and other marketing channels.
Ensure all content is visually compelling, on-brand and consistent in quality.
Organise and maintain the hotel’s complete photo and video asset library.
Stay updated with current social media, hospitality and content-production trends.
Manage multiple projects and deadlines while maintaining high creative standards.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
1–2 years of professional experience in photography, videography or content creation.
Hospitality, lifestyle, travel or F&B experience is preferred.
Hands-on experience with professional cameras, lighting and production equipment.
Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and Photoshop; knowledge of After Effects, Lightroom and Audition is an advantage.
Advanced video editing, colour grading and photo retouching skills.
Good understanding of social media content and short-form video.
Excellent visual sense, creativity and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects.
Flexible to support shoots, events and activations outside standard working hours when required.

sections.text:
The opportunity to join an international and innovative and fast-growing group, committed not only to building new hotels, but to creating a global brand.

A competitive package and plenty of development opportunities.

1. E - Procurement System:
To support Coupa (E-Procurement system) Deployment for new Eurofins entities.
To support training and provide guidance on Coupa system to all local purchasers and new acquired legal entities.
Coordinate with Eurofins Coupa Admin team to ensure all Eurofins companies using the system well.
Provide Purchasing reports from Coupa when needed
2. Sourcing
Proactively support for sourcing activities for both direct & indirect goods/service.
For key purchases (CAPEX), he/she proactively works with end-users to understand business requirements from the early stage of the sourcing. Then, source and negotiate with suppliers to achieve cost savings, payment terms and other commercial terms targets.
Formulate effective sourcing strategies that accomplish performance and savings goals.
Liaises with Eurofins’ global team such as GSC, NSC, Coupa to verify and ensure the commercial terms from suppliers align with Eurofins practices.
Cooperate with Eurofins global team to continuously update Group purchasing targets, strategies & activities.
Proactively Forecast and manage all the sourcing risks to advise for Business teams.
Other sourcing tasks if necessary
3. Operational Purchasing
Day to day supervise of the purchasing activities to ensure Eurofins policies and procedures are complied.
Develop and announce Service Level Agreement with all Eurofins Legal Entities in his/her scope.
Implement, monitor, and report on relevant key performance indicators to demonstrate improvements of purchasing activities for the whole Eurofins Group and to monitor the purchasing performance of each Legal Entity.
Coach, train and develop local purchasers among all Eurofins Legal Entities in his/her scope.
Research, develop and implement improved Coupa system and procurement procedures with documentation and training.
Maintain all purchasing report such as quarter spending report.
Other related tasks as assigned

Good communication both English and Vietnamese

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Eurofins Scientific through its subsidiaries is a world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences, and in agroscience Contract Research services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in genomics and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in BioPharma Contract Development and Manufacturing. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty esoteric and molecular clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA. With over 65,000 staff across a network of independent companies in 59 countries and operating over 950 laboratories, Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods for evaluating the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin and purity of biological substances and products, as well as for innovative clinical diagnostics. The objective of Eurofins companies is to provide their customers with high-quality services, accurate results on time and expert advice by their highly qualified staff.
Comprehensive services and unmatched expertise
Eurofins believes it is also a worldwide scientific leader in most of its fields of activity. Through research and development and acquisitions, the Group draws on the latest developments in the field of biotechnology and analytical chemistry to offer its clients unique analytical solutions and the most comprehensive range of testing methods.
A commitment to top quality
The Eurofins Group is committed to provide the highest quality services, accurate results in time and expert advice by its highly qualified staff. The reliability and accuracy of its data help customers make adequate decisions and meet their increasingly stringent quality and safety standards and the expanding demands of regulatory authorities around the world.
Permanent innovation and support by the market leader
Few testing laboratories can combine the level of expertise, technological leadership, attention to quality and customer service that have made Eurofins the global leader in many of the fields where it is active. Large investments in innovation, technology, IT and logistics and very large sample volumes ensure that customers enjoy high standards of quality at reasonable prices.

sections.text:
SUMMARY OF ROLE AND OBJECTIVES:
The Service Delivery Management crew actively participates in managing the delivery of the Security Services to internal service consumers.
The Information Security Analyst (Service Delivery Management is responsible for service management activities for assigned service consumer base, acting as the SPOC (Single Point of Contact) between the service consumers and the Eurofins Group Security, resulting in positive customer satisfaction.
From operational perspective, the Information Security Analyst is responsible for the health of security services for internal service consumers.
ROLE & OBJECTIVES :
Specific Assignments:
The main responsibilities of an Information Security Analyst (Service Delivery Management)
Role responsibilities:
Run all Service Delivery processes and ITSM processes in Security Operations as defined by the Group.
Manage and/or oversee the overall Security Services onboarding program for Zones and non-integrated ELEs, including but not limited to set deployment expectations, build project timeline, Onboarding resources management, stream communication across different stakeholders, monitor and report progress, and propose roadblock removal strategies so a compliance metric for a minimum of 99% of all Security Toolset coverage is achieved for all technologies in scope.
Ensure Security Services are fit for purpose, carrying out relevant reviews/propose modifications as necessary.
Conduct Monthly Security Service Review sessions with service consumers and stakeholders with special attention to Onboarding, Security Toolset compliance and Security Service Dashboards.
Cooperate with internal Security teams and other Security actors to further develop Security Operations.
Report SLA, KPI and performance metrics of Security Services, steer activities as per metrics defined in the Service card.
Make sure definition of improvement plans to meet SLA and KPI are in place.
Assess and report the level of compliance for each ELEs/ZONEs and ensure to have a defined plan to reach the target as defines in the TSFs.
Coordinate the work provided and service delivered by the security partners.
Prepare and publish the report to stakeholders including Local IT Management and Information Security Management.
Ensure that all Security documentation for Internal/External service consumers are available and updated.
Help in the development of processes and procedures required for the delivery of the Security Services.
Provide a clear and regular update to service consumers on action items, including proposed actions and dates to closure.
Receive and coordinate reporting requests, assisting with high level design of reports where required.
Provide Security Services expectations to align the stakeholders and service consumers.
Other Assignments:
Overall accountability for transition success building best practices for the service management community.
Build, manage and maintain a trusted relationship with all Security actors and service consumers both internally and externally.
Organizing and Leading Service Delivery sessions including incident review, problem resolution, etc.
Leverage the most effective and efficient service from the delivery teams for each assigned service consumer.
Receive and coordinate consumer reported bugs/issues with internal Security Team.
Support IT Directors and Security Managers in day-to-day activities.
Maintain/track service consumers contact and organization details.
Produce consistent, high-quality service reviews on a monthly basis that demonstrate quality and continuous improvement.
Escalation point for internal teams for unresponsive service consumers.
Provide feedback to the Service Owner
Supports the IT Security Coordinator and the associate Information Security Director in day-to-day activities.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Education and Certifications:
Bachelor’s degree in information security, Computer Science, IT, or a related field. (required)
Relevant certifications such as ITIL Foundation, CompTIA Security +, CISM, or similar credentials are preferred.
Professional Experience:
Minimum of 3+ years of experience in IT service delivery.
Demonstrated experience working in a security-focused organization or environment.
Proven track record in managing and improving service delivery processes, ensuring alignment with SLAs and business objectives.
Technical Skills:
Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, network security, and cybersecurity principles.
Proficiency in security frameworks such as ISO 27001, GPDR, HIPPA and other information security standards.
Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and their associated security services.
Communication:
Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to build relationships across teams and regions.
Strong conflict resolution ability.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey complex security concepts to non-technical audiences.
Problem-Solving and Strategic Thinking:
Expertise in identifying, analysing, and resolving complex service delivery issues in a timely manner.
Strong analytical and decision-making capabilities with the ability to plan and execute long-term strategies.
Other Requirements:
Ability to work in a high-pressure environment and manage multiple priorities.
Willingness to travel and support global teams when necessary.
Strong commitment to continuous learning and staying updated on evolving security threats and technologies.
Languages: fluent English.

sections.title: Quyền lợi & thông tin bổ sung
sections.text:
We support your development! Do you feel you don’t match 100% of the requirements? Don’t hesitate to apply anyway! Eurofins companies are committed to supporting your career development.
We embrace diversity! As an Equal Opportunity Employer, the Eurofins network of companies believes in strength and innovation through diversity. We prohibit discrimination against employees or applications based on gender identity and/or expression, race, nationality, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, and everything else that makes employees of Eurofins companies unique.
Sustainability matters to us! We are well on our way to achieving our objective of carbon neutrality by 2025, through a combination of emission reduction and compensation initiatives. We encourage our laboratory leaders to make sustainable changes at their local level, and in addition to their initiatives we count on our dedicated carbon reduction team to help us to achieve this goal!
Find out more on our Careers page: https://careers.eurofins.com/
Company description : Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate.
The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products.
In over 37 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to ca. 63,000 staff across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of more than 950 laboratories in over 1,000 companies across 60 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products.
In 2024, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR 6.95 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

sections.text:
Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate.
Eurofins is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across the entire network of Eurofins companies.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
The Test Automation Engineer ensures quality and reliability for ComLIMS-Quotation, the Eurofins Information Systems (EurIS) regional web-based Customer Commercial Agreement Management application used across Eurofins laboratories worldwide. This role is embedded in the ComLIMS-Quotation Development Team based in Ho Chi Minh City, comprising five local members alongside offshore team members, and is accountable for building and maintaining automated test suites covering functional and non-functional requirements across acceptance and deployment stages. The team delivers software using Agile/DevOps practices and robust modelling techniques such as Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Unified Modelling Language (UML), on a stack including C#, .NET, MSSQL Server, Angular, and DevOps tooling such as Docker, Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, and Octopus.
Key Responsibilities
You serve as the dedicated Test Automation Engineer within a Scrum team of six collocated Software Engineers and Quality Assurance (QA), ensuring test automation is integrated at every stage of feature development.
You contribute to test execution (acceptance, deployment, and more), build automation, and troubleshooting of selected functional and non-functional requirements for target software applications and services, maintaining an automation ratio of80%.
You perform exploratory testing in addition to automated UI tests to uncover usability issues, visual glitches, hidden defects and functionality gaps.
You adhere to Agile values and practices (Scrum and Kanban), participating in team meetings (stand-ups, backlog refinement acceptance criteria refinement) and performing incremental testing of the application.
You follow continuous delivery practices by ensuring ComLIMS-Quotation test suites are automated and system atically executed as part of the Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipeline at acceptance and deployment stages.
You apply test strategies and test plans to ensure high-quality product delivery, refining them when necessary.
You collaborate with Software Engineers, architects, development managers, and business analysts to achieve comprehensive test coverage and quality.
You communicate proactively with product owners, business analysts, development, and testing teams to resolve ambiguity and maintain alignment on test coverage and quality.
Other Assignments
You ensure regular follow-up with the Team Manager, providing updates as needed or upon request.
You quickly acquire working knowledge of Eurofins EurIS systems, starting with ComLIMS-Quotation, its underlying concepts, models, and the processes and practices of the team.
You continuously deepen knowledge of ComLIMS-Quotation concepts, models, and team practices, guided by the priorities of assigned functions.
You build effective working relationships with IT and non-IT stakeholders across Eurofins.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Required Skills and Qualifications
You hold a bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or have equivalent practical experience.
You have at least three years of experience in software testing, with a strong focus on automation and proven manual testing skills.
You have a thorough understanding of various types of testing and their purposes, including acceptance, regression, sanity and exploratory testing.
You have a thorough understanding of software applications at both functional and technical levels, with the ability to extend and refine acceptance criteria, including consideration of corner, edge, and boundary cases.
You have working knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and DevOps practices for effective integration of testing into the development process.
You are proficient in test automation using object-oriented languages (such as Java or C#).
You understand web service patterns using Representational State Transfer (REST) and Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) queuing patterns, and can test them with automation.
You have experience with UI automation testing using tools like Selenium or JavaScript frameworks such as WebdriverIO.
You are proficient in debugging code and troubleshooting issues across various layers of the application stack.
You perform root cause analysis on defects and performance issues.
You collaborate effectively with distributed teams across multiple countries.
You have hands-on experience with exploratory testing techniques to complement automated test coverage.
You are fluent in English (written and spoken).
You have conversational proficiency in Vietnamese to facilitate local communication.
Preferred Skills and Experience
You have initial experience with Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD) tools such as SpecFlow/Reqnroll, JBehave, orCucumber.js for writing test cases in a given/when/then format.
You have working knowledge of scripting languages like PowerShell, Shell, or Bash for automating tasks and writing test scripts.
You have experience testing backend services developed with a DDD approach.
You are familiar with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD tools such as Azure DevOps Pipelines and Jenkins.
You have experience in test automation with web frontend languages (JavaScript or TypeScript).
You have experience with tools like JMeter, LoadRunner, or Gatling for performance, load, and stress testing.
You can review and interpret performance test results and identify bottlenecks.
You have experience working with relational databases and working knowledge of Structured Query Language (SQL).
You have strong interpersonal communication skills to collaborate effectively with developers, product owners, and other stakeholders.
You have conversational proficiency in Mandarin or French to facilitate communication in a multilingual environment.

sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
At Grab, we build innovative solutions that help our partners and merchants grow. Our diverse and collaborative team works with partners across industries to unlock new business opportunities, drive sustainable growth, and create long-term value for merchants and customers.
Get to Know the Role
This is a multi-scope Associate Business Development role responsible for translating company strategy into growth opportunities across several key business areas. You will cover the following areas:
Dine Out Business Growth: Acquire new merchants and incubate existing partners to grow GMV, increase merchant-funded investment, and expand adoption of Grab's Dine Out services.
Travel and GrabCoins Partnerships: Explore partnership opportunities across Travel and GrabCoins and support their development to drive business adoption and create incremental value for Grab's ecosystem.
New Growth Projects: Help execute new projects and workstreams aligned with company strategy to explore growth opportunities and contribute to long-term business development.
You will report to the Business Development Manager and work on-site in Ho Chi Minh City.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Acquire new Dine Out merchants through targeted outreach, including cold-calling and direct engagement.
Build and nurture long-term relationships with existing and incubation merchants to drive GMV growth and expand service adoption.
Develop partnership initiatives across Travel and GrabCoins to drive business adoption and create incremental value for Grab.

sections.text:
In this role, you will manage map operations projects from planning through execution, quality monitoring, and outcome review. You will combine project management experience with map data knowledge to prioritize work, coordinate internal teams and partners, and turn real-world feedback into actionable improvements.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Plan and coordinate map operations projects from request intake and scope definition through timelines, resourcing, risk management, delivery, and close-out.
Monitor the quality and freshness of POI, road, route, geofence, venue, and navigation-related data, ensuring work follows approved processes and data sources.
Consolidate feedback from users, field activities, and internal stakeholders; validate and prioritize issues, then partner with Product, Engineering, or Data teams to drive resolution.
Coordinate field data collection and vendor operations, including operational readiness, guidance, quality checks, and follow-up on issues.
Track project progress, backlog, service levels, productivity, and quality control results; identify root causes and recommend actions to improve quality and efficiency.
Standardize SOPs and task-tracking processes; use AI tools and automation where appropriate to reduce repetitive work while protecting privacy and data quality.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
At least 2 years of experience in project or operations management, including at least 1 years working with map data, geospatial data, or field data collection.
Experience coordinating cross-functional projects and managing scope, timelines, resources, dependencies, and risks.
Ability to analyze operational data, monitor KPIs, and use Google Sheets or Excel to maintain trackers, report progress, and identify issues.
Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and partners; strong Vietnamese communication skills and working proficiency in English for regional collaboration.
Experience using AI tools and emerging technologies to improve productivity, streamline workflows, and contribute new ideas.
Experience coordinating vendors or field data collection programs.
Good to Have
Understanding of map data creation, updates, or quality review processes, such as those for POIs, roads, routes, venues, or geofences.
Exposure to road and navigation testing, map imagery, public transport, or indoor and venue mapping.
Experience developing SOPs, quality control processes, or operational automation.
Knowledge or certification in project management, GIS, geography, urban planning, or a related field.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
Clickstream Intelligence Platform (Scribe) is Grab's in-house app instrumentation and insights platform that captures and analyzes user clickstream activity across all Grab apps. The platform supports observability, real-time personalization, and business analytics by processing tens of billions of events per hour at petabyte scale.
Customer Data Platform (CDP) enables Grab Teams to onboard and register Grab's customer data and make it available for Online Serving, ML Models, Segmentation, and Real Time targeting to power personalization use cases across the company. Our platform is used across many mission-critical Grab services such as app personalization, experimentation, ads serving, and marketing.
Get to Know the Role
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer for either the Scribe or CDP team that that has multiple different technical stacks:
Programming Languages : Python, Go, Scala
Data Streaming & Processing : Kafka, Apache Flink, Apache Spark
Data Infrastructure & Tooling : Event gateways, Schema validation tools, Instrumentation testing frameworks
The role will report to Engineering Manager in Singapore and work onsite at HCMC, VN
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Design and improve clickstream data pipelines—from event ingestion to insight delivery—and contribute to services/tools for understanding user behavior.
Build scalable platform capabilities for user data onboarding, online serving, and real-time data pipelines/architecture.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related undergraduate degree.
Minimum of 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering .
Proficient in at least one of the following programming languages : Python, Go, or Scala
Experience developing large-scale backend or data systems and has good understanding of technical trade offs and evaluations needed to enable high load, low latency systems, while maintaining system reliability and cost efficiency.
Experience developing backend distributed systems, APIs, services, and working with OLTP databases.
Good English communications with prior work experience in regional & global environment
Nice To Have Experience
Experience engaging with AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, improve workflows, and contribute new ideas.
Experience with data processing technologies such as Apache Flink (for real time processing) and Apache Spark (for batch processing)
Experience with AWS, Terraform, and Kubernetes
Proficiency in CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab, etc.)
Experience building customer data platforms, clickstream platforms, or marketing / ads systems

sections.text:
Execute the classification of products and technologies according to national and international customs tariff schedules.
Collect and analyzing technical product information, including specifications and bills of materials, to determine correct tariff codes.
Maintain and updating a database of classified products with their corresponding Harmonized System (HS) codes and related documentation.
Apply the General Rules for the Interpretation (GRI) of the Harmonized System to ensure consistent and defensible classification decisions.
Research customs rulings, explanatory notes, and legal precedents to resolve complex classification issues under supervision.
Prepare documentation to support classification decisions for internal reviews and customs audits.
Collaborate with team members to process classification requests and ensure alignment with established procedures.
Contribute to the team's knowledge base by documenting classification rationales and research findings for future reference.
Ensure compliance with applicable industry standards, regulatory requirements, company policies, and quality frameworks applicable to the role and assigned projects.
Perform other tasks as assigned by Managers.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field, such as product engineeing background (mechanical, electrical, Software,...)
Advanced proficiency in English, specifically reading comprehension skill and the ability to understand international regulations, technical description of product e.g.
1 - 3 years of experience in international trade compliance or product engineering field.
Having knowledge of export control regulations or Tariff Code classification is an advance.
Excellent analytical and research skills, with the ability to interpret complex technical information.
Detail-oriented with a high level of accuracy in classification decisions.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams.
Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Familiarity with other international trade compliance areas, such as sanctions and customs regulations, is a plus.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Since the beginning of 2013, its operations have been divided into four business sectors: Automotive Technology, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology.
The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 360 subsidiaries and regional companies in some 50 countries. If its sales and service partners are included, then Bosch is represented in roughly 150 countries. This worldwide development, manufacturing, and sales network is the foundation for further growth.
Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) i s 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH - one of the world’s leading global suppliers of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.
Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region.
With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.

sections.text:
Translate technical documents from Japanese to English and vice versa Translate technical specifications, user manuals, software documentation, and other project-related documents from Japanese to English and vice-versa.
Ensure accuracy, linguistic quality, and consistency across all translated materials.
Maintain technical accuracy and appropriate terminology by utilizing glossaries, style guides, and translation memory tools.
Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and technical writers to clarify technical concepts and terminology.
Perform quality assurance reviews and proofreading of translated content.
Real-time Interpretation experience is highly preferred.
Import the content of specification in various formats (word, excel, pdf, matrix...) into Doors system, manage version, set attribute and layout as per customer requirement.
Be in charge of other activities such as system configuration management, baseline copy, tracking report...
Other tasks as assigned

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Language Proficiency: Fluent-level fluency in both spoken and written Japanese and English (JLPT N2 or above / IELTS / TOEIC high-advanced score level).
Experience: Minimum 3 years as a professional translator in a technical environment (software development, IT, or engineering preferred).
Technical Skills: Proficiency with Translation Memory tools (e.g., Trados, MemoQ, Memsource), terminology management systems, and MS Office applications .
Core Competencies: Strong attention to detail, critical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and capacity to quickly master new technical concepts and terminology.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Linguistics, Translation, or related technical field preferred. Professional certification in interpretation/translation is a significant asset.

sections.text:
Role Overview
Lead a technical team of around 5 members focusing on Digitalization and cross-service technical enablement.
The role combines hands-on technical contribution, team coordination, people development, and collaboration with WebApp, AI, Data, and other technical teams.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and coordinate a key technical team
Provide technical guidance for Digitalization, Automation, Integration, and related solution topics based on Digitalization Strategies of Department
Contribute hands-on to technical implementation, PoCs, and complex project topics when needed.
Plan team workload, assign tasks, and follow up progress, risks, and technical issues.
Coach and support team members in technical growth and competence development.
Work closely with WebApp, AI, Data, DevOps, and other teams to support cross-functional solutions.
Support knowledge sharing, reusable solutions, technical standards, and good engineering practices across teams.
Support requirement clarification, estimation, solution discussion, and technical workshops with project teams or customers.
Provide technical and competence-related input to management when discussing future capability needs or new technology topics.

sections.text:

Strong technical background in IT Software Development, Digitalization, Automation, or related areas.
Experience with Web Applications, APIs, system integration, databases, or automation solutions.
Good understanding of modern software architecture and cloud-based applications.
Basic to good understanding of AI and Data-related solutions is an advantage.
Experience mentoring, coordinating, or leading a small technical team.
Good communication, planning, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work across different technical teams and collaborate in a matrix organization.
Willingness to remain hands-on in technical work.
Main Focus
Technical contribution and solution support

Competence build-up and Innovation

Cross-team collaboration and technical enablement

We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Doctor to join our medical team in the beautiful island of Phu Quoc, Vietnam. As a key member of our healthcare facility, you will provide high-quality medical care to both local residents and international visitors in this tropical paradise.
Conduct comprehensive medical consultations and examinations for patients
Diagnose illnesses and prescribe appropriate treatments and medications
Perform minor surgical procedures as needed
Coordinate with local hospitals and specialists for patient referrals and follow-ups
Respond to medical emergencies promptly and efficiently
Develop and implement health and safety protocols for our facility
Provide health education and preventive care advice to patients
Maintain accurate and confidential medical records
Collaborate with the management team to ensure compliance with local healthcare regulations
Participate in continuing medical education to stay updated with the latest medical advancements
Adapt to the unique challenges of practising medicine in a remote island setting

Medical degree from an accredited institution

Proven ability to work in a fast-paced environment with limited resources
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Empathetic approach to patient care with a focus on cultural sensitivity
Willingness to work flexible hours and respond to emergencies as needed
Proficiency in using electronic medical record systems
Ability to adapt to and thrive in a tropical island environment

sections.text:
**We are looking for an AR Billing Accountant for a short-term assignment, offering full statutory social insurance coverage and paid leave benefits**
1. Revenue & AR booking
Record AR and revenue transactions accurately in NetSuite.
Ensure revenue is recognized in accordance with the company's applied accounting standards.
2. Invoicing & Billing
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to obtain sufficient data for monthly invoice issuance.
Generate from the system and send accurate and timely invoices to clients based on allocated resource efforts, client agreements and internal approvals.
3. Accounts Receivable management
Monitor weekly AR aging and track outstanding balances.
Follow up with clients on overdue invoices and resolve payment discrepancies.
Apply customer payments accurately in NetSuite.
Proactively manage collections to reduce DSO (Days Sales Outstanding).
Communicate professionally with clients regarding payment status.
Escalate complex collection issues when necessary.
4. Reporting
Prepare weekly AR reports and cash flow from AR forecasts.
Participate in month-end and year-end closing processes.
Support team members in completing other weekly and monthly reports.
Prepare ad-hoc AR related reports when requested.
Maintain accurate customer records and billing data.
5. Compliance & Controls
Ensure adherence to company policies and accounting standards.
Support internal and external audits related to AR.
Maintain proper documentation for all transactions.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
2–5 years of experience in AR accountant or general accounting.
Hands-on experience with AR modules in Oracle NetSuite or other ERP systems is preferred.
Strong understanding of revenue recognition principles under US GAAP is a plus.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to manage multiple tasks, tight deadlines with stakeholders in different time zones.
Proficiency in Excel is required.
Problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach.
Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and spoken, is a must.

Join Bosch Vietnam’s Global Product & Service organization to help shape next-generation workflow platforms used by 500,000+ users worldwide. sections.text:
🚀 Senior Automation Test Engineer
AI Global Product | AI-Native Workflow Platform | NCLC + Agentic AI | 500,000 Users Worldwide
🌍 Engineer Quality for Intelligent Workflows
Our Global Product & Service Team is building a next-generation workflow and approval platform serving nearly 500,000 users .
Built on NCLC and evolving through automation, and Agentic AI, the platform supports mission-critical processes across a global corporation.
This is not a short-term testing assignment. It is a long-term AI product transformation where quality, automation, reliability, and customer trust are critical.
We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Automation Test Engineer with deep hands-on expertise, strong product thinking, and the ambition to modernize testing through AI.
This is not only about finding defects. It is about engineering quality into a global AI product from requirements to production
✨ Why This Opportunity
You will help build the quality foundation of an AI-native enterprise product used by nearly half a million people.
Your work will directly influence:
Product reliability and production stability
Automation coverage and regression efficiency
Release confidence and delivery speed
Customer satisfaction and platform trust
AI adoption across the testing lifecycle.
If you want to move beyond traditional testing and build intelligent, scalable automation at global scale, this role is for you.
🎯 Your Mission
Design, build, and continuously improve automation solutions using Playwright and Python .
Working with Product, Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, and Operations, you will embed quality throughout the product lifecycle and enable faster, more reliable releases.
🧠 Key Responsibilities
1. Requirements and Test Design
Analyze requirements, designs, user stories, and acceptance criteria
Identify ambiguity, risks, dependencies, edge cases, and negative scenarios early
Design and review test scenarios, test cases, and automation scripts
Apply risk-based and shift-left testing to critical business journeys
Ensure traceability between requirements, tests, defects, and releases
2. Automation Engineering
Design and maintain scalable frameworks using Playwright with Python
Automate web applications, APIs, integrations, workflows, permissions, and approvals
Build reusable components and effective test-data solutions
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Improve test stability, maintainability, reporting, and execution speed
Eliminate flaky tests and automation bottlenecks
Perform exploratory and manual testing where it provides greater value
3. Integration and Performance Quality
Validate complex end-to-end workflows across multiple systems
Execute API, integration, performance, load, scalability, and resilience testing
Collaborate with Architecture, DevOps, Security, and Operations to validate non-functional requirements
Ensure platform reliability for mission-critical global operations
4. AI-Driven Quality Engineering
Apply AI to requirement analysis, test generation, test data, automation, defect analysis, and regression optimization
Explore Agentic AI for intelligent test execution, monitoring, and continuous improvement
Ensure human review, traceability, security, and governance for AI-generated assets
Measure AI impact through coverage, defect detection, productivity, and cycle-time improvements
5. Quality Reporting and Collaboration
Monitor test execution, defects, automation health, and release risks
Create clear dashboards and evidence-based quality reports
Convert findings into concrete recommendations and improvement actions
Support root-cause analysis and preventive measures
Share automation best practices and mentor other QA Engineers
Promote quality as a shared product responsibility
🌟 What You Will Gain
Engineer quality for a product serving nearly 500,000 users worldwide
Shape automation and AI-enabled testing for a long-term global transformation
Gain hands-on experience with NCLC, and Agentic AI
Solve complex enterprise challenges across workflows and integrations
Create measurable achievements in reliability, automation, and delivery efficiency
Grow into a future-ready AI-enabled Quality Engineer
🤝 Who Will Thrive Here
You will succeed if you:
Want to build scalable automation, not only execute tests
Challenge risks and unclear requirements early
Balance automation with exploratory and risk-based testing
Use data to improve quality decisions
Apply AI responsibly to real engineering challenges
Take long-term ownership and remain accountable through complexity
“I helped build the intelligent quality foundation of a global AI-native product used by nearly half a million people.”
🧩 Selection Challenge
Shortlisted candidates may complete a practical assignment covering:
Test strategy for a critical workflow
Playwright and Python automation design
API and integration testing
CI/CD execution and reporting
Flaky-test prevention and framework maintainability
Practical AI use cases in testing
We evaluate technical quality, test design, maintainability, product thinking, AI maturity, and communication.
📩 Ready to Engineer Quality at Global Scale?
If you want to go beyond traditional testing, apply AI to real engineering challenges, and influence a product serving nearly half a million users, this is your opportunity.
Join us and build the intelligent quality foundation for the future of global workflows.

AI Global Product | AI-Native Workflow Platform | NCLC + Agentic AI | 500,000 Users Worldwide
