Our Global Product & Service Team is building a next-generation workflow and approval platform serving nearly 500,000 users and approximately 1,000 internal customers worldwide .
Built on OutSystems Low-Code/No-Code and evolving into an AI-native platform powered by automation, GenAI, and Agentic AI, it supports mission-critical business processes across a global corporation.
This is not a short-term testing assignment. It is a long-term product transformation where quality engineering, intelligent automation, reliability, and customer trust are critical to success.
We are looking for a Senior Test Lead who combines:
Strong hands-on automation expertise
Strategic quality leadership
Team coaching and capability development
Product and customer mindset
Practical application of AI in testing
This is not only about finding defects.
It is about engineering quality into a global AI product from requirements to production.
✨ Why This Opportunity
Few testing roles offer the chance to shape a global enterprise product used by nearly half a million people.
You will influence:
Product quality, reliability, and production stability
Automation coverage and testing efficiency
Release confidence and delivery speed
Customer satisfaction and platform trust
AI-enabled Quality Engineering across global Agile teams
If you want to move beyond traditional QA and help define how an AI-native product is tested, released, and continuously improved, this role is for you.
🎯 Your Mission
Lead and continuously improve the end-to-end Quality Engineering strategy for our global workflow platform.
The role combines approximately:
70% hands-on quality engineering, automation, and test strategy
30% team leadership, coaching, and capability development
You will collaborate with Product Owners, Business Analysts, developers, architects, DevOps, operations, and global stakeholders to make quality a shared product responsibility.
🧠 Key Responsibilities
1. Quality Strategy and Ownership
Own and improve the end-to-end test and Quality Engineering strategy
Establish risk-based testing, quality gates, release criteria, and measurable quality standards
Ensure coverage across functional, API, integration, regression, performance, security, accessibility, and production validation
Drive shift-left and shift-right quality practices
Provide evidence-based release readiness and go/no-go recommendations
Track KPIs including automation coverage, defect leakage, regression duration, test stability, and release confidence
2. Hands-On Automation Engineering
Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Playwright with Python
Build reliable automated tests for web applications, APIs, integrations, workflows, and critical business journeys
Perform manual and exploratory testing where automation is insufficient
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Improve test reusability, reporting, data management, maintainability, and execution speed
Reduce flaky tests and establish automation coding and review standards
3. Requirements and Product Testability
Review requirements, designs, epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria
Challenge ambiguity and identify risks, dependencies, edge cases, and negative scenarios early
Improve testability, traceability, and Definition of Ready with Product Owners and Business Analysts
Promote quality-by-design rather than testing only at the end of delivery
4. Integration and Non-Functional Quality
Strengthen testing for APIs, integrations, business rules, permissions, and approval workflows
Plan and execute performance, load, stress, scalability, resilience, and recovery testing
Collaborate with Architecture, DevOps, Security, and Operations to ensure global platform reliability
5. AI-Driven Quality Engineering
Apply AI across requirement analysis, test design, test data, automation, defect analysis, and regression optimization
Explore Agentic AI for intelligent test generation, execution, monitoring, and continuous learning
Ensure human review, traceability, security, and governance of AI-generated testing assets
Measure AI value through improved coverage, productivity, defect detection, and cycle time
6. Team Leadership and Collaboration
Lead, mentor, and develop up to five QA Engineers
Build a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing Quality Engineering culture
Provide technical direction, coaching, feedback, and fair workload allocation
Develop team capabilities in automation, product knowledge, AI, and Quality Engineering
Partner with Product, Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, UX, Operations, and Support
Lead root-cause analysis and ensure systemic preventive action
7. Quality Monitoring and Reporting
Monitor test execution, defects, automation health, release risks, and production quality
Build clear dashboards and executive-ready reports
Convert quality data into concrete insights, actions, ownership, and recommendations
🌟 What You Will Gain
Lead Quality Engineering for a platform serving nearly 500,000 users worldwide
Shape the automation and AI-enabled testing strategy of a long-term global product
Gain hands-on experience with OutSystems, GenAI, and Agentic AI
Transform a QA team into a modern Quality Engineering capability
Deliver measurable improvements in reliability, efficiency, release speed, and customer trust
Build a significant career achievement in a global AI product transformation
🤝 Who Will Thrive Here
You will succeed if you:
Stay technically hands-on while leading and developing others
Treat quality as a product and engineering responsibility
Prevent defects by challenging risks and unclear requirements early
Use data and evidence to guide release decisions
Apply AI responsibly to solve real testing challenges
Seek long-term ownership and remain accountable through complexity
“I helped build the quality foundation of a global AI-native product and transformed how the team delivers software excellence.”
🧩 Selection Challenge
Shortlisted candidates may prepare a maximum 10-slide, six-month Quality Engineering improvement plan covering:
Current quality risks and priorities
Test strategy and coverage model
Automation framework and CI/CD approach
Integration, performance, and non-functional testing
AI testing use cases and governance
Team capability and coaching plan
Quality KPIs and reporting
Prioritized 30/60/90-day roadmap
Evaluation criteria: technical depth, leadership maturity, prioritization, measurable outcomes, and the ability to balance quality with delivery speed.

If you are a hands-on Test Lead who wants to build an AI-enabled Quality Engineering capability and influence a product used by nearly half a million people, this is your opportunity.
Join us and build the quality foundation for the future of intelligent workflows

sections.text:
Operational & Service Standards
Deliver courteous, professional, efficient, and flexible service at all times in line with Rixos Standards.
Perform assigned duties within the stewarding area and related workstations.
Maintain cleanliness and organization of all work areas, kitchens, storage, and back-of-house spaces.
Strictly follow opening and closing procedures of the department.
Ensure proper use and care of equipment, dishwashing machines, and cleaning chemicals.
Monitor operating supplies and minimize breakage, spoilage, and wastage.
Cleaning & Hygiene
Clean and wash dishes, pots, pans, kitchen utensils, and equipment according to performance standards.
Carry out general cleaning duties as assigned by the Stewarding Supervisor or Assistant Chief Steward.
Empty garbage bins in accordance with waste management schedules.
Fully understand and comply with HACCP and food safety procedures at all times.
Teamwork & Flexibility
Work collaboratively within the team and provide lateral service to other departments.
Demonstrate flexibility by rotating across different areas within F&B or other departments when required.
Undertake additional reasonable tasks as assigned to meet operational and business needs.
Guest & Employee Interaction
Handle guest and employee inquiries in a courteous and professional manner.
Report guest complaints or operational issues to supervisors promptly and ensure proper follow-up.
Training & Administration
Attend departmental meetings, hotel trainings, and briefings as scheduled.
Assist in monthly, quarterly, and annual inventory counts of operating equipment.
Comply with local laws, hotel policies, and safety regulations.
Grooming & Conduct
Report to duty on time, wearing the correct uniform and name badge.
Maintain high standards of personal hygiene and professional appearance.
Foster positive working relationships with colleagues and other departments.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Sincerity & Transparency
Act professionally with honesty and integrity.
Use sound judgment in challenging situations.
Take ownership of mistakes and share knowledge to prevent recurrence.
Maintain confidentiality of sensitive information.
Reliability & Loyalty
Follow through on commitments.
Work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
Maintain a positive, cooperative, and approachable attitude.
Support colleagues and contribute to a unified workplace culture.
Excellence in Hospitality
Demonstrate commitment to quality and operational excellence.
Uphold and comply with all Rixos policies and procedures.
Contribute responsibly to departmental efficiency and cost control.
Quality Mindset & Continuous Improvement
Strive to exceed expectations.
Avoid complacency and continuously seek improvement opportunities.
Provide constructive and positive feedback when appropriate.

sections.text:
Position Overview
The Roller Skater Supervisor is responsible for supervising, leading, and motivating the Roller Waiter team to deliver a dynamic, safe, and memorable food & beverage service experience. This role ensures service excellence, operational efficiency, safety compliance, and alignment with Rixos brand standards in a high-energy, entertainment-driven environment.
Key Responsibilities
Leadership & Team Supervision
Supervise daily operations of the Roller Waiter team during assigned shifts.
Lead by example in service attitude, skating skills, grooming, and guest engagement.
Coach, train, and mentor Roller Waiters to consistently meet Rixos service standards.
Ensure proper staffing, duty rosters, and task allocation based on operational needs.
Conduct daily briefings, performance feedback, and on-the-job training.
Guest Experience & Service Excellence
Ensure all guests receive friendly, professional, and engaging service in line with Rixos standards.
Proactively handle guest feedback, service recovery, and complaints, escalating when required.
Monitor service flow, order accuracy, delivery time, and guest satisfaction.
Support upselling initiatives and promotional activities to drive revenue.
Operational Control
Oversee opening and closing procedures for the Roller Service operation.
Ensure cleanliness, organization, and visual presentation of service areas at all times.
Monitor operating supplies, minimize wastage, and support inventory counts.
Ensure Roller Waiters have full knowledge of menus, promotions, and outlet concepts.
Coordinate closely with kitchen, bar, and other F&B outlets to ensure smooth operations.
Safety, Skating & Compliance
Ensure all Roller Waiters comply with skating safety procedures and approved skating routes.
Monitor floor conditions and immediately address safety hazards.
Ensure proper use and maintenance of roller skates/blades and protective equipment.
Enforce compliance with HACCP, food safety, hygiene, and sanitation standards.
Ensure adherence to Rixos policies, SOPs, and ISO Integrated Management Systems
(ISO 9001, 14001, 22000, 10002) .
Training & Pre-Opening Support
Support pre-opening activities including SOP testing, service rehearsals, and mock operations.
Participate in training development for roller service concepts and safety procedures.
Assist management in implementing new concepts, events, and service enhancements.
Administration & Communication
Prepare shift reports and communicate operational issues to management.
Ensure clear handovers between shifts.
Maintain professional confidentiality at all times.
Collaborate with other departments to support overall guest experience.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Diploma or degree in Hospitality or related field.
Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Food & Beverage service within a 4–5 star hotel or lifestyle resort within same level role.
Prior supervisory experience is preferred.
Strong roller skating ability is mandatory .
Experience in entertainment-driven, poolside, beach club, or lifestyle F&B concepts is an advantage.

The opportunity to join an international and innovative and fast-growing group, committed not only to building new hotels, but to creating a global brand.
The ability to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.

A competitive package and plenty of development opportunities.

sections.text:
Position Overview
The IRD Order Taker is responsible for handling all In-Room Dining orders efficiently and professionally, ensuring accurate communication between guests, kitchen, and service teams. The role aims to deliver a seamless, personalized, and luxury dining experience that reflects Rixos service standards and maximizes guest satisfaction.
Key Responsibilities
Order Taking & Guest Communication
Answer all In-Room Dining calls promptly and in accordance with Rixos brand standards.
Take food & beverage orders accurately, repeat orders for confirmation, and use guest names whenever appropriate.
Provide clear information on menu items, promotions, delivery times, and hotel facilities.
Apply effective upselling techniques to enhance guest experience and revenue.
Order Coordination & Accuracy
Input orders correctly into the POS system and open/close checks accurately.
Coordinate closely with Kitchen, IRD service staff, and relevant departments to ensure timely delivery.
Monitor order progress and proactively follow up on delays or special requests.
Follow standard procedures for long-stay guests and VIP preferences.
Service Excellence & Guest Satisfaction
Maintain a warm, professional, and courteous telephone manner at all times.
Handle guest concerns or complaints professionally and escalate when necessary.
Maintain confidentiality of all guest and company information.
Ensure all service interactions align with Rixos luxury service culture (“Rixellence”).
Operational & Administrative Support
Maintain cleanliness and organization of the IRD order taker station.
Attend daily briefings, training sessions, and departmental meetings as scheduled.
Stay informed about hotel events, banquets, promotions, and daily activities.
Assist with task force duties for new openings or special operations as assigned.
Carry out any other reasonable duties as requested by management.
Standards, Safety & Compliance
Ensure full compliance with HACCP and food safety standards.
Adhere to all Rixos policies, SOPs, and ISO Integrated Management Systems (ISO 9001, 14001, 22000, 10002).
Follow hotel health, safety, emergency, and data protection procedures at all times.
Actively support quality improvement, sustainability, and guest satisfaction initiatives

sections.text:

University degree or diploma in Hospitality, Tourism, or related field preferred.
Minimum 1 year of experience in a similar role, call center, telephone operator, or F&B service environment.

Excellent communication and telephone etiquette.
Strong attention to detail and multitasking ability.

Flexible to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays.

sections.text:
Position Overview
The Kitchen & Laundry Technician is responsible for the installation, maintenance, repair, and optimal operation of all kitchen and laundry equipment throughout the resort. Working under the guidance of the Engineering leadership, this role ensures that all related mechanical and electrical systems function efficiently, safely, and in accordance with Rixos brand standards, supporting seamless operations and an exceptional guest experience.
Key Responsibilities
Technical Operations & Maintenance
Execute all mechanical, electrical, and associated maintenance work for kitchen and laundry equipment to the highest professional standards.
Diagnose technical issues and respond promptly to equipment breakdowns or operational concerns.
Perform assigned tasks independently while ensuring full compliance with engineering procedures and safety standards.
Ensure timely completion of daily tasks and maintenance schedules.
Equipment, Inventory & Workshop Management
Monitor and control spare parts, tools, and consumables within the workshop.
Raise requisitions and ensure adequate stock levels for uninterrupted operations.
Maintain tools and equipment in good working condition at all times.
Operational Support & Coordination
Act immediately on issues and concerns related to kitchen and laundry operations.
Support guest requirements related to equipment functionality when required.
Work collaboratively with Engineering colleagues and other departments to ensure operational efficiency.
Assist with Task Force Teams during new openings or special operational projects.
Carry out any other reasonable duties as assigned by Engineering leadership.
Safety, Emergency & Compliance
Be fully familiar with the hotel’s emergency procedures and remain prepared to respond effectively to any emergency situations.
Ensure all work is carried out in compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations.
Adhere strictly to Rixos Engineering Policies & Procedures and Operational Standards Manuals.
ISO Integrated Management System (IMS) Compliance
Comply with all ISO Integrated Management System requirements, including: Quality Management (ISO 9001)
Environmental Management (ISO 14001)
Food Safety Management (ISO 22000)
Customer Complaint Handling (ISO 10002)
Actively participate in: Risk management and safety programs
Environmental impact assessments
Pollution prevention initiatives
Energy and water conservation efforts
Continuous improvement and guest satisfaction initiatives

sections.text:

Solid mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Provide constructive feedback to support team and operational development.

MAIN SCOPE OF THE JOB:
The Kids Club Animator is responsible for planning, organizing, and leading engaging and age-appropriate activities for children at the Rixy Club. The role aims to create a fun, interactive, and memorable experience while ensuring the safety and satisfaction of young guests.
MANDATORY (ISO IMS) COMPLIANCE
All employees must comply with the ISO Integrated Management System requirements, including Quality, Environment, Health & Safety, Food Safety, and Customer Complaint Handling systems (ISO 9001, 14001, 22000, 10002), hotel SOPs, and applicable legal regulations. Active contribution to risk management, sustainability, and guest satisfaction initiatives is expected.

Plan, organize, and conduct daily, weekly, and monthly activity programs as instructed
Lead creative activities such as arts & crafts, games, sports, storytelling, and educational play
Engage children enthusiastically and encourage participation in activities
Create a welcoming, energetic, and fun atmosphere in the Rixy Club
Ensure children follow safety rules and club guidelines during activities
Communicate effectively with parents regarding activities and children’s participation
Coordinate with Attendants and other departments to ensure smooth operations
Assist in setting up and dismantling activity areas and equipment
Collect feedback from children and parents to improve activity programs
Be prepared to handle emergencies and ensure incidents are documented and reported
Be fully knowledgeable about club schedules, facilities, promotions, and prices

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Rixos Phu Quoc is seeking a passionate and knowledgeable Sommelier to join our Food & Beverage team. This role is responsible for curating and managing the resort’s wine experience while supporting the delivery of exceptional dining moments for our guests. The Sommelier plays an important role in elevating the overall guest journey through expert wine recommendations, strong product knowledge, and attentive service.
The Sommelier is responsible for maintaining and developing the resort’s wine programme, ensuring the wine list reflects both international standards and the dining concepts within the resort. You will guide guests through the wine selection process, offering thoughtful recommendations that complement menu offerings and enhance the overall dining experience. Providing engaging wine service and sharing knowledge in an approachable and professional manner is a key part of the role.
Working closely with the Food & Beverage leadership team, the Sommelier will ensure proper storage, handling, and service of wines while maintaining the highest standards of presentation and quality. The role includes monitoring wine inventory, managing stock levels, and supporting purchasing decisions to ensure the wine cellar remains well balanced and aligned with guest preferences and dining concepts.
The Sommelier also supports the training and development of the restaurant team by sharing wine knowledge, service techniques, and pairing recommendations to help build confidence across the team. Staying informed about new wines, emerging regions, and industry trends is essential in maintaining a dynamic and engaging wine offering for guests.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text: The successful candidate will bring strong wine knowledge, a passion for hospitality, and the ability to create memorable guest experiences through thoughtful wine service. Professional presentation, strong communication skills, and the ability to collaborate with the wider Food & Beverage team are essential for success in this role at Rixos Phu Quoc.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Position Overview
The Painter is responsible for carrying out all painting and surface-finishing works across guest rooms, public areas, and back-of-house facilities. Under the guidance of the Engineering leadership, this role ensures that all painted surfaces are maintained to the highest aesthetic and quality standards, contributing to a flawless guest experience in line with Rixos luxury brand standards.
The role requires strong technical skills, attention to detail, safety awareness, and a collaborative, service-oriented mindset.
Key Responsibilities
Painting & Surface Preparation
Prepare surfaces by cleaning, sanding, filling, and patching to ensure smooth and even finishes.
Apply paint using appropriate techniques including brush, roller, and spray methods.
Mix paints accurately to achieve required colors and finishes; maintain proper records of color formulas when necessary.
Perform inspection and touch-ups to ensure consistently high-quality workmanship.
Protection, Equipment & Housekeeping
Protect furniture, fixtures, floors, and surrounding areas from paint splashes or damage.
Clean, maintain, and store painting tools and equipment properly to ensure operational readiness.
Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work environment at all times.
Preventive Maintenance & Coordination
Support preventive maintenance programs to maintain the overall appearance of the resort.
Respond promptly to maintenance requests and painting-related tasks to minimize guest disturbance.
Work closely with Engineering colleagues and other departments to ensure timely task completion.
Safety, Standards & Compliance
Comply fully with Rixos Engineering Policies & Procedures and operational standards.
Strictly follow all health, safety, and environmental regulations.
Adhere to the ISO Integrated Management System (IMS) , including: Quality Management (ISO 9001)
Environmental Management (ISO 14001)
Food Safety (ISO 22000)
Customer Complaint Handling (ISO 10002)
Actively participate in: Risk management and safety programs
Environmental impact reduction initiatives
Energy and water conservation efforts
Continuous improvement and guest satisfaction programs

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Education: Diploma or Certificate in Engineering, Painting, or a related technical field.
Experience: Minimum 2 years of experience in a similar role, preferably within a hotel, resort, or large commercial property.
Language: Basic working proficiency in English.
Skills & Competencies: Strong painting and finishing skills
Good eye for detail and quality
Ability to work independently and as part of a team
Strong safety awareness and discipline
Core Values & Behavioral Competencies
Sincerity & Transparency
Act with professionalism, honesty, and integrity.
Take ownership of tasks and responsibilities.
Learn from mistakes and share knowledge to prevent recurrence.
Reliability & Teamwork
Follow through on commitments and assigned duties.
Maintain a positive, cooperative attitude.
Build respectful working relationships with colleagues and guests.
Excellence in Hospitality
Demonstrate commitment to quality and visual excellence.
Support Rixos brand standards through craftsmanship and attitude.
Contribute positively to guest satisfaction and overall resort image.
Quality Management & Continuous Improvement
Never settle for mediocre workmanship.
Continuously seek opportunities to improve processes and results.
Provide constructive feedback and support innovation within the Engineering team.

sections.text:
We are seeking an experienced and innovative Head Baker to join our team in the beautiful island of Phu Quoc, Vietnam. As the Head Baker, you will lead our bakery department, creating delightful baked goods that blend international techniques with local flavours.
Oversee and manage the daily operations of the bakery department, ensuring smooth workflow and high-quality output
Develop and implement new recipes, considering local taste preferences and international baking trends
Ensure strict compliance with food safety and hygiene standards throughout the baking process
Train, mentor, and supervise junior bakers, fostering a culture of excellence and creativity
Manage inventory, including ordering supplies and minimising waste
Collaborate with other departments to meet production goals and maintain product quality
Implement and maintain rigorous quality control measures for all baked goods
Stay abreast of industry trends and incorporate innovative techniques into our baking processes
Adapt recipes and offerings to meet changing consumer trends and dietary requirements
Contribute to menu planning and pricing strategies to maximise profitability

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Minimum of 5-7 years of experience as a baker, with at least 2-3 years in a supervisory role
Associate's degree in Culinary Arts or Baking and Pastry Arts
Advanced knowledge of baking techniques, recipe development, and food science
Proven ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities
Strong leadership and team management skills
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
Proficiency in inventory management and cost control
Demonstrated ability to adapt to changing consumer trends and dietary requirements
Knowledge of local and international baking trends
Familiarity with Vietnamese cuisine and local taste preferences is highly desirable
Certification from a recognised culinary institution (e.g., City & Guilds) is a plus
Fluency in English; knowledge of Vietnamese is an advantage

sections.text:
Position Overview
The Kitchen & Laundry Technician is responsible for the installation, maintenance, repair, and optimal operation of all kitchen and laundry equipment throughout the resort. Working under the guidance of the Engineering leadership, this role ensures that all related mechanical and electrical systems function efficiently, safely, and in accordance with Rixos brand standards, supporting seamless operations and an exceptional guest experience.
Key Responsibilities
Technical Operations & Maintenance
Execute all mechanical, electrical, and associated maintenance work for kitchen and laundry equipment to the highest professional standards.
Diagnose technical issues and respond promptly to equipment breakdowns or operational concerns.
Perform assigned tasks independently while ensuring full compliance with engineering procedures and safety standards.
Ensure timely completion of daily tasks and maintenance schedules.
Equipment, Inventory & Workshop Management
Monitor and control spare parts, tools, and consumables within the workshop.
Raise requisitions and ensure adequate stock levels for uninterrupted operations.
Maintain tools and equipment in good working condition at all times.
Operational Support & Coordination
Act immediately on issues and concerns related to kitchen and laundry operations.
Support guest requirements related to equipment functionality when required.
Work collaboratively with Engineering colleagues and other departments to ensure operational efficiency.
Assist with Task Force Teams during new openings or special operational projects.
Carry out any other reasonable duties as assigned by Engineering leadership.
Safety, Emergency & Compliance
Be fully familiar with the hotel’s emergency procedures and remain prepared to respond effectively to any emergency situations.
Ensure all work is carried out in compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations.
Adhere strictly to Rixos Engineering Policies & Procedures and Operational Standards Manuals.
ISO Integrated Management System (IMS) Compliance
Comply with all ISO Integrated Management System requirements, including: Quality Management (ISO 9001)
Environmental Management (ISO 14001)
Food Safety Management (ISO 22000)
Customer Complaint Handling (ISO 10002)
Actively participate in: Risk management and safety programs
Environmental impact assessments

Energy and water conservation efforts
Continuous improvement and guest satisfaction initiatives

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
**We are looking for an AR Billing Accountant for a short-term assignment, offering full statutory social insurance coverage and paid leave benefits**
1. Revenue & AR booking
Record AR and revenue transactions accurately in NetSuite.
Ensure revenue is recognized in accordance with the company's applied accounting standards.
2. Invoicing & Billing
Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to obtain sufficient data for monthly invoice issuance.
Generate from the system and send accurate and timely invoices to clients based on allocated resource efforts, client agreements and internal approvals.
3. Accounts Receivable management
Monitor weekly AR aging and track outstanding balances.
Follow up with clients on overdue invoices and resolve payment discrepancies.
Apply customer payments accurately in NetSuite.
Proactively manage collections to reduce DSO (Days Sales Outstanding).
Communicate professionally with clients regarding payment status.
Escalate complex collection issues when necessary.
4. Reporting
Prepare weekly AR reports and cash flow from AR forecasts.
Participate in month-end and year-end closing processes.
Support team members in completing other weekly and monthly reports.
Prepare ad-hoc AR related reports when requested.
Maintain accurate customer records and billing data.
5. Compliance & Controls
Ensure adherence to company policies and accounting standards.
Support internal and external audits related to AR.
Maintain proper documentation for all transactions.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
2–5 years of experience in AR accountant or general accounting.
Hands-on experience with AR modules in Oracle NetSuite or other ERP systems is preferred.
Strong understanding of revenue recognition principles under US GAAP is a plus.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
Ability to manage multiple tasks, tight deadlines with stakeholders in different time zones.
Proficiency in Excel is required.
Problem-solving mindset with a proactive approach.
Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and spoken, is a must.

sections.text:
Eurofins Scientific through its subsidiaries is a world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences, and in agroscience Contract Research services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in genomics and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in BioPharma Contract Development and Manufacturing. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty esoteric and molecular clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA. With over 65,000 staff across a network of independent companies in 60 countries and operating over 950 laboratories, Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods for evaluating the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin and purity of biological substances and products, as well as for innovative clinical diagnostics. The objective of Eurofins companies is to provide their customers with high-quality services, accurate results on time and expert advice by their highly qualified staff.
Comprehensive services and unmatched expertise
Eurofins believes it is also a worldwide scientific leader in most of its fields of activity. Through research and development and acquisitions, the Group draws on the latest developments in the field of biotechnology and analytical chemistry to offer its clients unique analytical solutions and the most comprehensive range of testing methods.
A commitment to top quality
The Eurofins Group is committed to provide the highest quality services, accurate results in time and expert advice by its highly qualified staff. The reliability and accuracy of its data help customers make adequate decisions and meet their increasingly stringent quality and safety standards and the expanding demands of regulatory authorities around the world.
Permanent innovation and support by the market leader
Few testing laboratories can combine the level of expertise, technological leadership, attention to quality and customer service that have made Eurofins the global leader in many of the fields where it is active. Large investments in innovation, technology, IT and logistics and very large sample volumes ensure that customers enjoy high standards of quality at reasonable prices.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Position Summary
The O5 Country Quality Manager is responsible for leading the implementation, oversight, and continuous enhancement of the O5 Program Quality Control Framework within the assigned country. The role functions independently from day-to-day operational activities to ensure objectivity, integrity, and consistency across inspection processes, quality reporting, and compliance with O5 requirements.
The O5 Country Quality Manager acts as the primary liaison among Country Operations , the Country Team Leader , and O5 stakeholders , with responsibility for identifying risks, monitoring quality performance, conducting audits, and driving corrective and preventive actions. To preserve independence and impartiality, the O5 Country Quality Manager operates separately from the local O5 operations team and reports directly to the Global Quality & Integrity Manager and the Country Cluster Manager .
Key Responsibilities
1. O5 Program Quality Control & Audits
Inspection Audits (Announced & Unannounced)
Plan and conduct regular announced and unannounced audits of O5 inspection operations (e.g., Insitu & Crosscheck activities).
Perform independent reviews of inspection execution, inspection reports, and operational practices.
Assess compliance with: Customer requirements
O5 operational procedures
Quality and integrity standards
Regional and global quality policies
Document audit findings, identify risks, and areas for improvement, and issue audit reports.
Ensure timely follow-up, implementation, and closure of audit findings and corrective actions.
Crosschecks & Issue Management
Review the results of issue audits, crosschecks, and quality investigations.
Analyze recurring quality issues and identify root causes and trends.
Monitor the implementation and effectiveness of Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPAs).
Escalate significant quality, integrity, or compliance risks to the Global Quality & Integrity Manager and O5 Program Management at Eurofins, as appropriate.
Provide recommendations to prevent recurrence and strengthen quality performance.
2. KPI Monitoring and Quality Performance Management
KPI Analysis
Conduct monthly reviews of Country O5 KPI performance.
Monitor and analyze key quality performance indicators, including: Claim rates
Alert rates
Report quality metrics
Billing error rates
Insitu and Crosscheck audit performance
Identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement through data analysis.
Investigate significant KPI deviations and recommend corrective actions.
Provide regular quality performance reports and recommendations to country and global management.
Quality Review Meetings
Organize and facilitate regular quality review meetings with: Country Team Leaders
Technical Supervisors
O5 program technical management
Country cluster managers
Present and review quality performance results, audit outcomes, KPI trends, and ongoing improvement initiatives.
Discuss key quality risks, recurring issues, and corrective action progress.
Ensure accountability for agreed action plans, corrective actions, and quality improvement targets.
Monitor the timely implementation and effectiveness of action items arising from review meetings.
Escalate significant quality concerns, unresolved issues, or performance gaps to the appropriate management level when necessary.
3. Report Quality Control
Report Review Program
Develop, implement, fine-tuning and maintain a report review framework to ensure consistent report quality standards.
Conduct random audits of inspection reports reviewed & approved by Team Leaders.
Verify: Accuracy
Completeness
Consistency
Compliance with client requirements and O5 reporting standards.
Identify recurring reporting deficiencies, training needs, and process gaps.
Monitor the effectiveness of corrective actions related to report quality issues.
Provide feedback and recommendations to Team Leaders and QCs to improve report quality and consistency.
Documentation Compliance
Ensure the proper maintenance, retention, and accessibility of quality records, audit reports, and supporting documentation.
Verify that adequate evidence is maintained to support quality decisions, audit findings, and corrective actions.
Ensure documentation complies with O5 requirements, customer requirements, and applicable corporate policies.
Monitor adherence to document control and record management procedures.
4. Integrity and Compliance Controls
Integrity Protection Measures
Implement and monitor and continuously improve integrity and compliance controls within the country operation.
Oversee the deployment, completion, and compliance of: O5 Inspection Completion, Anti-Bribery & Integrity Declaration Form
QC Declarations
Quality and compliance records
Other integrity verification and monitoring mechanisms.
Verify the effectiveness of integrity controls and identify opportunities for enhancement.
Promote awareness of ethical conduct, professional standards, and integrity expectations across the country organization.
Risk Monitoring and Investigation
Identify potential quality, integrity, and compliance risks through data analysis, audits, crosschecks, and trend monitoring.
Conduct or support investigations into quality, integrity, compliance, or misconduct concerns.
Ensure investigations are properly documented, evidence-based, and concluded in a timely manner.
Monitor the implementation and effectiveness of corrective and preventive actions arising from investigations.
Escalate significant integrity breaches, compliance violations, or high-risk findings to the Global Quality & Integrity Manager and relevant management as appropriate.
Recommend and implement preventive measures to strengthen operational integrity and reduce recurring risks.
5. Quality Data Analytics & Dashboard Management
Drive Predictive Quality Management through Data Analysis
Utilize quality dashboard analytics to: Identify emerging quality risks and recurring issues.
Monitor quality KPIs and performance trends.
Predict potential quality deterioration.
Drive proactive investigations and corrective actions.
Provide data-driven insights to support continuous improvement and risk reduction.
6. Corrective and Preventive Action Management
Lead and oversee the CAPA process arising from audits, crosschecks, claims, alerts, customer complaints, and client feedback.
Ensure timely root cause analysis, implementation, and closure of corrective and preventive actions.
Verify CAPA effectiveness and monitor sustainability of improvements.
Escalate overdue, ineffective, or high-risk CAPAs to management.
Drive systemic improvements to eliminate recurring issues and strengthen quality performance.
Monitor CAPA trends and provide regular reports on status, effectiveness, and key risk areas.
7. Training and Quality Awareness
Lead the development and implementation of quality awareness, competency development and continuous improvement programs.
Collaborate closely with O5 Technical Management personnel to align quality standards, technical requirements, best practices, and customer expectations across all operations.
Identify training and development needs through analysis of audits, quality incidents, CAPA findings, crosschecks, and KPI trends.
Promote a culture of quality, compliance, accountability, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.
Evaluate training effectiveness and drive ongoing workforce competency development.
8. Authority
The O5 Country Quality Manager is authorized to:
Conduct announced and unannounced quality audits, crosschecks, and investigations across O5 operations.
Request information, records, evidence, and corrective action plans related to quality, integrity, and compliance matters.
Require Country Operations, Team Leaders, Technical Supervisors, and relevant stakeholders to implement corrective and preventive actions within agreed timelines.
Escalate significant quality, integrity, compliance, or customer risks directly to Global Quality & Integrity Management, Country Cluster Management, and O5 Program Management.
Recommend additional audits, crosschecks, training, process improvements, or operational controls where quality risks are identified.
Recommend suspension of inspectors, approval authorities, suppliers, or operational activities when serious quality or integrity concerns are identified, subject to management approval.
Escalate unresolved, overdue, or ineffective corrective actions to the appropriate management level.
Reporting Line
Direct Reporting:
Global Quality & Integrity Manager, Country Cluster Manager, and O5 Program Management
Functional Collaboration:
Country O5 Team Leaders
O5 Technical Management
Technical Supervisors
O5 QA/ QC
O5 Country Back Office Team
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
The O5 Country Quality Manager will be measured on:
Completion of planned audits (%)
Closure rate of audit findings and CAPAs
Reduction in claim and alert rates
Report accuracy and consistency levels
Crosscheck effectiveness
Integrity compliance rate
Timeliness of quality reporting
Dashboard utilization and risk detection effectiveness
Overall country quality performance improvement

Education
Bachelor's degree in Quality Management, Engineering, Business, Supply Chain, or related discipline.

Minimum 5 years of experience in quality management, auditing, inspection, or compliance functions.
Experience within inspection, testing, certification, sourcing, or manufacturing industries preferred.
Strong knowledge of quality assurance systems and audit methodologies.

Strong analytical and investigative skills

Root cause analysis and CAPA management
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
High level of integrity and professional ethics

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
Join the FundsCore Platform team at Grab - a dynamic team building a reliable platform to address challenging problems in the Payments domain. We are a team of engineers, designers, product managers, and operations. We innovate and collaborate to solve one of the most challenging problems: ensuring accurate settlement to large numbers of merchants. This role prefers you have certain Payments domain expertise or demonstrate quick-learning skills.
Get to Know the Role
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Backend to join our growing engineering team. In this role, you'll design, build, and operate backend services that power critical business applications at scale. You'll work collaboratively with product managers, designers, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality features while driving operational excellence and mentoring fellow engineers. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact by architecting innovative solutions in a supportive environment.
You will report to the Engineering Manager II based in Singapore and work onsite and CMC Creative Space office, HCMC.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Design and implement scalable, reliable backend services using modern programming languages and frameworks, with a focus on performance, cost-efficiency, and maintainability
Own delivery of features and projects, including requirements clarification, technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and post-launch monitoring
Lead and participate in technical discussions and design reviews, making thoughtful trade-offs between reliability, latency, throughput, and cost
Instrumenting services with comprehensive metrics, logs, and traces; define SLIs/SLOs; improve alerting strategies; and perform capacity planning and performance optimization
Collaborate with other teams to design end-to-end workflows that are secure, scalable, and user-centric
Contribute to engineering excellence by improving CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, documentation standards, and design practices within the team
Mentor other engineers through constructive code reviews, knowledge sharing, and best practice guidance in design, coding, and operational excellence
Participate in on-call rotations and handle production incidents
Support hiring initiatives by conducting technical interviews and helping refine interview processes and guidelines

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services, in the areas of automotive and industrial technology, consumer goods as well as building technology.
Bosch established its first representative office in Ho Chi Minh City in 1994. Since 2007, Bosch has expanded its footprint in Vietnam where it has branch offices in Hanoi and Da Nang, as well as a Powertrain Solutions plant in the Dong Nai province to manufacture pushbelts for continuously variable transmissions (CVT) in automobiles. In addition, Bosch operates Bosch Global Software Technologies Vietnam (BGSV) as well as an automotive R&D center for mobility solutions in Ho Chi Minh City. As of December 31 2023, Bosch employed approximately 6,300 associates in Vietnam. Bosch has diversified businesses in Vietnam. Today, all four Bosch business sectors, namely Mobility Solutions, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology have operations in the country. Bosch Vietnam is currently active with many business divisions: Mobility Aftermarket, Drive and Control Technology, Power Tools, Building Technology, Two-Wheeler and Powersports and Sales Original Equipment, AquaEasy, Home Appliances and Supply Chain Consulting.
Additional information is available online at: https://www.bosch.com.vn/ , https://www.linkedin.com/company/bosch-vietnam and https://www.facebook.com/OfficialBoschVietnam

sections.text:
MAIN PURPOSE OF THE ROLE
The Assistant Security Manager supports the Security Manager in ensuring the safety and security of guests, employees, and property at Rixos Phu Quoc Viet Nam. The role is responsible for assisting in the implementation of security strategies, emergency preparedness, loss prevention, fire & life safety, and compliance with hotel policies, operational standards, and legal requirements.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Security Operations & Risk Management
Assist in planning, implementing, and monitoring hotel security policies, procedures, and operational standards.
Supervise daily security operations including patrols, access control, CCTV monitoring, incident reporting, and loss prevention.
Ensure strict control of back-of-house access for contractors, suppliers, and visitors; issue and manage visitor passes.
Maintain confidentiality of all security-related records and investigations.
Review daily security logbooks and reports; escalate critical issues to the Security Manager promptly.
Emergency Preparedness & Safety
Ensure full readiness for all emergency situations in accordance with hotel procedures.
Coordinate closely with Engineering to conduct regular inspections and preventive maintenance of all safety and fire-fighting equipment.
Establish, review, and update emergency manuals, fire & safety procedures, and crisis management plans.
Conduct and coordinate regular fire drills, evacuation exercises, and emergency simulations.
Maintain strong working relationships with local Police, Fire Brigade, and relevant authorities; conduct regular courtesy visits.
Lifeguard & Pool/Beach Safety
Supervise pool and beach operations, ensuring full compliance with hotel safety standards.
Ensure lifeguards adhere strictly to policies, procedures, and service standards.
Coordinate and ensure frequent training and skills refreshment for lifeguards in cooperation with the Lifeguard Supervisor.
Training & Team Development
Train all employees on basic security awareness and emergency responsibilities.
Conduct specialized training for Security team members, including: Fire prevention & basic fire-fighting
Life-saving techniques
Crime scene preservation
Crisis response & report writing
Guest interaction, psychology, and public relations
Coordinate with Human Resources & L&D to plan and execute continuous technical and skills training programs.
People & Administration
Support workforce planning, duty rosters, leave tracking, and public holiday balance for the Security team.
Submit monthly consolidated leave and attendance reports to Director of People & Culture.
Foster a culture of professionalism, teamwork, discipline, and service excellence across the department.
ISO & COMPLIANCE RESPONSIBILITIES
Ensure full compliance with the Integrated Management System (IMS), including: Quality Management
Environmental Management
Occupational Health & Safety
Food Safety
Customer Complaint Handling
Actively participate in risk management, environmental protection, energy & water-saving initiatives, and continuous improvement programs.

sections.text:
Role's Objectives:
Develop and execute strategic sales plans to promote and grow SGS’s Hardline Technical Testing services—particularly Furniture Services—in the Central Region, ensuring achievement of assigned sales targets.
Lead onsite technical sales activities by engaging directly with furniture manufacturers and suppliers to communicate standards, testing requirements, and compliance pathways.
Provide onsite technical guidance, preliminary assessments, and customized testing solutions to strengthen SGS’s role as a trusted technical partner and drive revenue growth.
Act as a vital liaison between clients and SGS technical teams by capturing onsite requirements, identifying risks, and translating them into accurate and actionable testing proposals.
Manage all sales-related tasks—including sales activities, marketing initiatives, client relationship building, and service quality oversight—to support business expansion and deliver best-in-class customer experiences.
Specific Responsibilities:
Conduct onsite visits to furniture factories and suppliers to assess production processes, technical capabilities, and compliance risks.
Provide onsite technical guidance on relevant furniture standards, testing methods, and regulatory requirements.
Act as the primary technical contact during onsite meetings, audits, and factory walkthroughs.
Build and maintain strong client relationships to ensure satisfaction and support repeat business, contributing to revenue growth.
Plan and execute client visits or outreach via phone/email, including delivering product presentations and demonstrations.
Prepare proposals, including pricing and discount suggestions, for Sales Manager approval.
Develop marketing strategies and activities to expand market penetration across different segments.
Collect and analyze market and competitor information; prepare sales reports, forecasts, and recommendations.
Collaborate with internal teams—technical, project management, customer service—to ensure accurate project updates and resolve issues.
Coordinate with Customer Service and Operation Managers to manage client complaints and support debt collection.
Represent the company at industry events to promote services and expand the client base; work with marketing to create supporting materials.
Perform other duties as assigned.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Furniture Technology, Quality Management, or a related field.
At least 2 years of experience in sales of testing services, QA/QC solutions, or technical products—preferably in the furniture, hardline, or consumer goods industries.
Strong technical background combined with excellent sales, communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
Customer‑oriented mindset with strong relationship‑building abilities.
Good command of English (spoken and written).
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.
Male candidates are preferred.

Company Description
SGS is the world’s leading Testing, Inspection and Certification company — the global benchmark for quality and integrity.
With over 140 years of global expertise and a presence in Vietnam since 1989 , SGS Vietnam supports businesses in meeting international standards and achieving sustainable growth.
Today, we operate a nationwide network of 10+ offices and laboratories , supported by over 1,600 professionals delivering trusted solutions across diverse industries.
Our services and laboratories are aligned with internationally recognized standards and accreditations, ensuring compliance with both local and global requirements.
WHY JOIN SGS?
At SGS, you don’t just join a company — you join a global community of experts shaping a safer, smarter and more sustainable world.
Here’s what you can expect when you grow your career with us:
🌏 A truly global environment – collaborate with international teams and be part of SGS’s worldwide network;
⚖️ Work-life balance – enjoy 18 days of annual leave plus 1 day of sick leave per month (up to 12 days per year);
💰 Competitive rewards – including a 13th-month salary and year-end performance bonus;
🌱 Sustainability in action – contribute to a company where sustainability is embedded in our operations and client solutions;
🎓 Continuous learning & development – build your capabilities through structured learning programs and hands-on experience;
🚀 Career mobility – develop your career locally and explore opportunities across SGS’s global network;
💙 Well-being & employee benefits – access health and well-being programs, employee engagement activities and exclusive benefits available to SGS employees.
BRING YOUR WHOLE SELF TO WORK
At SGS Vietnam, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and drives stronger outcomes.
We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are respected, valued and empowered to succeed.
We welcome applications from individuals of all ages, abilities and communities, and we are dedicated to creating equal opportunities for everyone.
By embracing diversity and inclusion, we continue to foster a workplace that is collaborative, forward-thinking and truly representative of the communities we serve.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
SGS has been providing quality, reputable, independent, international services in Vietnam since 1989.
These services assist Vietnamese businesses access world markets, increasing their reputation as a quality supplier to world markets and ensuring that products purchased by International Buyers meet their customers’ requirements.
In September 1997, SGS became the first international, independent inspection company to be granted a 100% foreign owned company license in Vietnam.
SGS Vietnam Ltd now employs over 600 long-serving, specialised professionals based from offices in strategic locations across Vietnam. They are able to offer a high level of expertise in Inspection, Certification and Testing using some of the most sophisticated laboratory equipment available in Vietnam.
Client satisfaction is the ultimate benchmark of the SGS Group's performance. This we achieve through the development of close relationships with clients, allowing us to anticipate and respond to rapidly changing needs in today’s ever-changing global marketplace.

sections.title: Về doanh nghiệp
sections.text:
Eurofins Scientific through its subsidiaries is a world leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing, discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences, and in agroscience Contract Research services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in genomics and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in BioPharma Contract Development and Manufacturing. In addition, Eurofins is one of the key emerging players in specialty esoteric and molecular clinical diagnostic testing in Europe and the USA. With over 65,000 staff across a network of independent companies in 59 countries and operating over 950 laboratories, Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods for evaluating the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin and purity of biological substances and products, as well as for innovative clinical diagnostics. The objective of Eurofins companies is to provide their customers with high-quality services, accurate results on time and expert advice by their highly qualified staff.
Comprehensive services and unmatched expertise
Eurofins believes it is also a worldwide scientific leader in most of its fields of activity. Through research and development and acquisitions, the Group draws on the latest developments in the field of biotechnology and analytical chemistry to offer its clients unique analytical solutions and the most comprehensive range of testing methods.
A commitment to top quality
The Eurofins Group is committed to provide the highest quality services, accurate results in time and expert advice by its highly qualified staff. The reliability and accuracy of its data help customers make adequate decisions and meet their increasingly stringent quality and safety standards and the expanding demands of regulatory authorities around the world.
Permanent innovation and support by the market leader
Few testing laboratories can combine the level of expertise, technological leadership, attention to quality and customer service that have made Eurofins the global leader in many of the fields where it is active. Large investments in innovation, technology, IT and logistics and very large sample volumes ensure that customers enjoy high standards of quality at reasonable prices.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get to Know the Team
Join Grab's Red Team & Threat Intel team, which helps improve the security posture of Grab's products, platforms, cloud environments, AI systems, and enterprise technology across Southeast Asia.
The team partners with Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, IT, and business teams. This partnership enables the team to emulate real-world adversaries, identify the highest-impact risks, and help Grab strengthen its preventive, detective, and response capabilities. The Threat Intel function brings external incident trends, adversary behaviours, and internal improvement opportunities into Grab's security priorities. This helps the team plan intelligence-led Purple Team exercises, advise leadership, and support risk prioritisation with the Vulnerability Management team. We work with curiosity, technical depth, and responsibility, using offensive security techniques and threat intelligence to make Grab safer for our users, partners, and Grabbers.
Get to Know the Role
You will report to the Red Team & Threat Intel team leader and perform complex red team operations across cloud, CI/CD, endpoint, identity, application, and AI environments. You will design realistic attack simulations, develop offensive tooling, apply threat intelligence to Purple Team planning, and turn findings into practical improvements for engineering and security teams.
This role is based in HCMC. You will help shaping Grab's Red Team and Threat Intel capabilities, and influence how we use AI and automation to scale offensive security work responsibly. If you enjoy building tools, testing assumptions, and helping defenders get sharper, we will give you the platform to make a regional impact.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
You will lead end-to-end red team operations, and intelligence-led Purple Team exercises with the Blue Team. These exercises will emulate realistic adversary behaviour across multiple environments, including cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, identity systems, endpoints, and applications.
You will develop command-and-control tooling, implants, payload delivery mechanisms, and operator workflows for authorised security exercises.
You will red team AI systems, including internal copilots, agentic workflows, AI-assisted operational tools, and MLOps environments.
You will use AI tools to improve research, automation, payload development, reporting, operational planning, and analysis of defensive coverage.
You will translate red team findings and threat intelligence into clear engineering actions. You will partner with defenders, platform teams, and the Vulnerability Management team to improve detection, response, hardening, security architecture, and risk prioritisation.
You will work with other team members on offensive security tradecraft, tool development, operational safety, documentation, and responsible execution of adversary simulations.
You will contribute to the Red Team and Threat Intel roadmap. Your contributions will involve identifying the latest attack techniques and evaluating new tooling.
You will produce Threat Intel assessments from security incidents observed in the wild or improvement opportunities identified internally. Additionally, you will advise leadership on likely impact, priority, and next actions.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
You will have 5 or more years of experience in offensive security, red teaming, security engineering, exploit development, cloud security, or adjacent technical security roles.
You will have hands-on experience developing command-and-control tooling, implants, loaders, payloads, or offensive automation.
You will have practical experience assessing CI/CD systems, source control platforms, build pipelines, artefact repositories, secrets handling, and deployment workflows.
You will have firm knowledge of cloud environments, including identity, networking, logging, container platforms, and common privilege escalation paths.
You will have experience assessing AI-enabled products, internal AI platforms, or agentic systems in adversarial scenarios, and using AI tools to improve security research, workflows, and output quality.
You will have experience producing or using Threat Intel to connect external incident trends, adversary tradecraft, and internal security signals to practical security decisions.
Knowledge of the major 3 operating systems (Windows/Linux/macOS), endpoint internals, enterprise management, and defensive controls would be an added value

sections.text:
Life at Grab
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave , and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours
What We Stand For At Grab

discovery:smartrecruiters:Grab:744000154.description:
Get to Know the Team
Join Grab's Red Team & Threat Intel team, which helps improve the security posture of Grab's products, platforms, cloud environments, AI systems, and enterprise technology across Southeast Asia.
The team partners with Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, IT, and business teams. This partnership enables the team to emulate real-world adversaries, identify the highest-impact risks, and help Grab strengthen its preventive, detective, and response capabilities. The Threat Intel function brings external incident trends, adversary behaviours, and internal improvement opportunities into Grab's security priorities. This helps the team plan intelligence-led Purple Team exercises, advise leadership, and support risk prioritisation with the Vulnerability Management team. We work with curiosity, technical depth, and responsibility, using offensive security techniques and threat intelligence to make Grab safer for our users, partners, and Grabbers.
Get to Know the Role
You will report to the Red Team & Threat Intel team leader and perform complex red team operations across cloud, CI/CD, endpoint, identity, application, and AI environments. You will design realistic attack simulations, develop offensive tooling, apply threat intelligence to Purple Team planning, and turn findings into practical improvements for engineering and security teams.
This role is based in HCMC. You will help shaping Grab's Red Team and Threat Intel capabilities, and influence how we use AI and automation to scale offensive security work responsibly. If you enjoy building tools, testing assumptions, and helping defenders get sharper, we will give you the platform to make a regional impact.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
You will lead end-to-end red team operations, and intelligence-led Purple Team exercises with the Blue Team. These exercises will emulate realistic adversary behaviour across multiple environments, including cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, identity systems, endpoints, and applications.
You will develop command-and-control tooling, implants, payload delivery mechanisms, and operator workflows for authorised security exercises.
You will red team AI systems, including internal copilots, agentic workflows, AI-assisted operational tools, and MLOps environments.
You will use AI tools to improve research, automation, payload development, reporting, operational planning, and analysis of defensive coverage.
You will translate red team findings and threat intelligence into clear engineering actions. You will partner with defenders, platform teams, and the Vulnerability Management team to improve detection, response, hardening, security architecture, and risk prioritisation.
You will work with other team members on offensive security tradecraft, tool development, operational safety, documentation, and responsible execution of adversary simulations.
You will contribute to the Red Team and Threat Intel roadmap. Your contributions will involve identifying the latest attack techniques and evaluating new tooling.
You will produce Threat Intel assessments from security incidents observed in the wild or improvement opportunities identified internally. Additionally, you will advise leadership on likely impact, priority, and next actions.

What Essential Skills You Will Need
You will have 5 or more years of experience in offensive security, red teaming, security engineering, exploit development, cloud security, or adjacent technical security roles.
You will have hands-on experience developing command-and-control tooling, implants, loaders, payloads, or offensive automation.
You will have practical experience assessing CI/CD systems, source control platforms, build pipelines, artefact repositories, secrets handling, and deployment workflows.
You will have firm knowledge of cloud environments, including identity, networking, logging, container platforms, and common privilege escalation paths.
You will have experience assessing AI-enabled products, internal AI platforms, or agentic systems in adversarial scenarios, and using AI tools to improve security research, workflows, and output quality.
You will have experience producing or using Threat Intel to connect external incident trends, adversary tradecraft, and internal security signals to practical security decisions.
Knowledge of the major 3 operating systems (Windows/Linux/macOS), endpoint internals, enterprise management, and defensive controls would be an added value

Life at Grab

We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave , and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
The EPM department focuses on software tooling development to support embedded products in the XC which including Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS), Car Multimedia domain. We develop tools that streamline software and system development for technologies such as radar, video, HMI and ultrasonic sensors. Serving global teams across Japan, China, Europe, and Vietnam, we contribute to the advancement of secure, safe, and intelligent mobility solutions.
We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our growing engineering team and support the stability, scalability, and performance of our cloud and on-premises infrastructure. This is a hands-on role requiring strong problem-solving skills, deep coding experience, and the ability to diagnose and resolve complex production issues. Ideal candidates will be comfortable working in hybrid environments and have solid experience with cloud platforms, Kubernetes, and automation tools.
Responsibilities:
• Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve infrastructure and deployment issues across cloud and on-prem environments.
• Manage and optimize CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation using tools like Azure DevOps and Jenkins.
• Configure and maintain Kubernetes clusters, handle incident response and performance tuning.
• Design and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform and bash scripting for cloud provisioning.
• Support both on-premises infrastructure and cloud services (hybrid model).
• Maintain software configuration management tools and establish version control best practices.
• Collaborate with developers, QA, and other DevOps engineers to ensure high system reliability and streamlined release cycles.
• Develop and implement disaster recovery strategies and backup solutions.
• Develop architectural diagrams, technical documentation, and implementation plans for Azure and Jenkins solutions, incorporating backend technologies as needed.
• Develop cloud migration strategies, including planning, execution, and troubleshooting during the transition to cloud environments.
• Embed DevOps practices into CI/CD pipelines (security scanning, dependency checks).
• Ensure compliance with security policies, regulatory requirements, and internal standards.
• Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and scalability (FinOps awareness).
• Use tools like Ansible for configuration management and system automation.
• Maintain consistent configurations across cloud and on-prem systems.
• Implement end-to-end observability using Open Telemetry.
• Collect and correlate logs, metrics, and traces across:
o Azure resources
o GitHub Actions pipelines
o On-prem systems
• Build dashboards and alerting using tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, ELK.
• Define and track SLIs/SLOs to improve system reliability.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
• Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
• English communication fluently in both speaking and writing.
• 5+ years of experience as a DevOps engineer.
• Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, effective communicator, team player, and proactive in taking ownership and driving resolution in fast-paced environments.
• Proficient in troubleshooting and debugging complex systems.
• Strong hands-on experience with Azure cloud infrastructure, particularly in hybrid (on-premises and cloud) environments.
• Strong hands-on experience with Open Telemetry and other monitoring tools.
• Skilled in automation and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or ARM templates.
• Experience with Bitbucket, Jenkins, and GitHub APIs.
• Knowledgeable in containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes, as well as microservices architectures.
• Having Microsoft Azure Certificates (AZ-104/AZ-305/AZ400)
Nice to have:
• Experience with:
o Azure VM Scale Sets (VMSS)
o Azure networking (VNet, NSG, VPN, Private Endpoints)

sections.text:
PURPOSE OF THE ROLE
The Security Supervisor is responsible for assisting the Security Management team in ensuring the safety, security, and protection of guests, employees, assets, and resort property .
The role requires constant vigilance, strong leadership, operational discipline, and full compliance with Rixos standards, local regulations, and ISO Integrated Management Systems.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Security Operations & Supervision
Supervise day-to-day security operations across all assigned areas of the resort
Ensure continuous monitoring of hotel premises, including public areas, back-of-house, staff entrances, and CCTV operations
Control access of contractors, suppliers, and visitors; issue and monitor visitor passes
Supervise tanker operations and ensure proper registration and compliance

1. Administrative responsibilities
· Support Reservations department to develop skills relating to revenue management.
· To create revenue management culture among all revenue players (front office, reservation, sales)
2. Revenue Management
Collection
· Communicate the processes to follow in terms of booking quality and correct data input into the PMS, toward the reservation and front office team;
· Regularly checks the input and the quality of data (segmentation, denials tracking, etc);
· Update the event database (e.g. in RMS).
Analysis
· Analyze the hotel performance in the RMS as a basis for strategy decisions;
· Survey the market, the competitors in terms of pricing and closed dates as a basis for future pricing strategies;
· Analyze the contract performance (price, allotments, number of rooms sold, etc) before decisions on renewals are taken.
· Act as a support in the preparation of the annual revenue budget
Decision
· Provide proposals for the adaptation of the long-term and short-term hotel strategy (day types, ideal mix, RML ranking, price points, triggers, sales conditions, etc) on the basis of the analysis done previously;
· Calculate availability and minimum rate for the requests by using group quotation;
· Providing dynamic forecasts, compared to the strategy of the GM and budget.
Recommendation
· Consult and implement daily the recommendations in inventory and distribution tools;
· Implement and communicate on minimum stay, closed to arrival, up-selling;
· Make recommendation for strategy changes, in relation to day types, ideal mix, close limits, booking limits, to be able to react early to guest behavior changes (new events, etc);
· Optimize the distribution channels.
Evaluation
· Analyze on a monthly basis the results in terms of internal and external indicators (RevPAR and market share), in order to react in time;
· Check regularly the implementation of the defined strategies (brand, place, hotel).
Meeting
· Conduct weekly, monthly and yearly RevMax meeting
· Proactively conduct any meeting related to revenue management
Pricing
· Prepare annual rate grid consolidation for all segments
· Control and create group pricing grid
· Control and give recommendation for promotions and packages of all segments
· Recommend and create public promotions and packages
Report
· Prepare daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly and yearly reports
· Provide DOSM and sales team with monthly production report for main segments for account review
· Provide any reports requested by owner and Management
Annual budget
· Assist in annual revenue budget preparation
3. Reservation
· To contribute to overall operational efficiency by performing relevant duties as assigned
· To follow-up group wash down timely
· To give current update on reservation trends and forecasts for current &future dates.
· To report regularly on happenings of the section in the briefings
4. Commercial responsibilities
· To provide services and information to guests that is the most accurate and up to date possible, and is delivered to the guest in the most meaningful way.
· To maintain a good reputation for the hotel across online channels and assist to increase the overall profitability of the hotel
5. Human responsibilities
· To form good working relationship with all colleagues and employees of the hotel

sections.text:
Pullman Vung Tau stands apart as the first and only international five-star hotel and convention centre in Vung Tau. Bold in form and confident in spirit, its striking architecture rises above the coastline, home to 352 rooms and suites with sweeping views of the sea and the city skyline.
Perfectly positioned with two hours from Ho Chi Minh City’s center, Pullman Vung Tau is the closest international five-star seaside convention hotel on Vietnam’s southern coast – a destination where business, leisure and discovery converge.

From gala dinners and dance parties to high-impact conferences and exhibitions, everything comes together seamlessly under one roof.
