sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Support Business Units in implementing HSE activities across laboratories, field operations, and other workplaces; participate in internal inspections and cross-functional audits among business units and locations.
Collaborate with the HSE Manager to develop and implement HSE monitoring programs, ensuring compliance with applicable requirements and addressing safety issues arising in laboratories and field operations.
Organize and deliver HSE training programs for laboratory managers, field managers, and middle management personnel.
Develop Safety Talk materials tailored to specific job functions and collaborate with Operations teams to establish training matrices, ensuring risks are identified and controlled in a timely manner.
Identify workplace hazards, conduct risk assessments, and work closely with technical teams to integrate safety requirements into Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs); monitor implementation progress and provide periodic reports.
Assist in the development of emergency response plans and coordinate regular drills for occupational safety incidents, fire prevention and firefighting, first aid, and chemical spill response scenarios.
Develop and maintain databases related to best practices, unsafe acts, and unsafe conditions; analyze incidents and near-misses, and share lessons learned to prevent recurrence.
Analyze HSE and industrial hygiene data, monitor performance trends, and prepare periodic reports for local, regional, and global management as required.
Participate in incident investigations in laboratories and field operations; conduct root cause analysis and monitor the implementation of corrective and preventive actions to ensure long-term effectiveness.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Bachelor's degree in a relevant Engineering, Occupational Safety, Environmental, or Fire Safety discipline.
Minimum 2 years of experience in HSE/EHS or related roles.
Experience in HSE compliance, risk assessment, incident investigation, audits, emergency preparedness, and corrective/preventive action management.
Good understanding of HSE regulations and industry standards.
Strong analytical, reporting, communication, presentation, and training skills.
Proficient in Microsoft Office and safety data analysis.
Good command of written and spoken English.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Learn digital sub-system architectures, development processes, design standards, and verification methodologies under the guidance of experienced engineers.
Assist in analyzing requirements and detailed specifications for digital sub-system functions, including processor interfaces, platform control, safety, security, and debug functions.
Assist in developing or modifying synthesizable RTL modules using Verilog or SystemVerilog according to approved specifications and design guidelines.
Contribute to digital sub-system functions such as processor interfaces, interrupts, debug-related control, memory or bus interfaces, and sub-system integration, depending on project assignment.
Contribute to digital sub-system functions supporting platform safety, security, protection, error handling, access control, or system supervision, depending on project assignment.
Assist in preparing design descriptions, interface information, timing behavior, and traceability between requirements, specifications, RTL, and verification items.
Assist in subsystem integration, interface connectivity checking, compile checks, configuration management, and design-release activities.
Contribute to verification planning and the development of basic test cases, assertions, checkers, and regression tests for assigned functions.
Analyze simulation results and support the review of lint, CDC/RDC, synthesis, DFT, static timing, formal verification, coverage, or low-power verification results according to project assignment.
Investigate technical issues, reproduce failures, identify root causes with guidance, and document corrective actions, side-effect checks, and verification evidence.
Develop and maintain simple automation scripts using Python, Tcl, Perl, Shell, or similar languages to improve quality and productivity.
Maintain technical documents, review records, change records, verification reports, and lessons learned.
Collaborate with engineers in Vietnam, Japan, and other global locations, and participate in peer reviews, technical training, and knowledge sharing.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Automation and Control Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related discipline.
Basic understanding of digital electronics, computer architecture, programming, or semiconductor design.
Basic knowledge of RTL design or verification concepts using Verilog, SystemVerilog, or VHDL.
Basic programming or scripting experience in at least one language, such as Python, Tcl, Perl, Shell scripting, C, or C++.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn unfamiliar tools and technical concepts.
Good written and verbal communication skills, including working-level English.
Ability to work effectively in a team and collaborate with engineers from different locations.
Preferred Qualifications
The following experience is helpful but not mandatory:
Academic project, internship, or coursework related to processor architecture, computer architecture, functional safety, security, digital logic, ASIC/SoC design, or embedded systems.
Experience with RTL design or verification using Verilog, SystemVerilog, or VHDL.
Basic knowledge of processor buses, interrupts, debug functions, memory interfaces, platform safety and security mechanisms, protection functions, error handling, or sub-system integration.
Familiarity with UVM, assertion-based verification, formal verification, code coverage, or functional coverage.
Familiarity with Linux or Unix environments and version-control systems such as Git, GitLab, GitHub, or SVN.
Basic understanding of synthesis, static timing analysis and SDC, DFT, lint, CDC, RDC, low-power design, or RTL-to-gates flow.
Experience analyzing logs, debugging scripts, or automating repetitive engineering tasks.
Experience with engineering tools from Synopsys, Cadence, Siemens EDA, or equivalent vendors.
Professional Attributes
Curious and eager to learn semiconductor design and verification.
Careful and systematic when implementing, checking, and documenting engineering work.
Comfortable asking questions, receiving technical guidance, and sharing information with the team.
Responsible for assigned work and committed to completing agreed tasks with quality and traceability.
Interested in developing a long-term career in digital sub-system design, SoC/MCU development, verification, or design methodology.

Develop and maintain simple automation scripts using Python, Tcl, Perl, Shell, or similar languages to improve quality and productivity.

Collaborate with engineers in Vietnam, Japan, and other global locations, and participate in peer reviews, technical training, and knowledge sharing.

Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Automation and Control Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related discipline.
Basic understanding of digital electronics, computer architecture, programming, or semiconductor design.
Basic knowledge of RTL design or verification concepts using Verilog, SystemVerilog, or VHDL.
Basic programming or scripting experience in at least one language, such as Python, Tcl, Perl, Shell scripting, C, or C++.
Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to learn unfamiliar tools and technical concepts.
Good written and verbal communication skills, including working-level English.
Ability to work effectively in a team and collaborate with engineers from different locations.

Academic project, internship, or coursework related to processor architecture, computer architecture, functional safety, security, digital logic, ASIC/SoC design, or embedded systems.
Experience with RTL design or verification using Verilog, SystemVerilog, or VHDL.
Basic knowledge of processor buses, interrupts, debug functions, memory interfaces, platform safety and security mechanisms, protection functions, error handling, or sub-system integration.
Familiarity with UVM, assertion-based verification, formal verification, code coverage, or functional coverage.
Familiarity with Linux or Unix environments and version-control systems such as Git, GitLab, GitHub, or SVN.
Basic understanding of synthesis, static timing analysis and SDC, DFT, lint, CDC, RDC, low-power design, or RTL-to-gates flow.
Experience analyzing logs, debugging scripts, or automating repetitive engineering tasks.
Experience with engineering tools from Synopsys, Cadence, Siemens EDA, or equivalent vendors.

Curious and eager to learn semiconductor design and verification.
Careful and systematic when implementing, checking, and documenting engineering work.
Comfortable asking questions, receiving technical guidance, and sharing information with the team.
Responsible for assigned work and committed to completing agreed tasks with quality and traceability.
Interested in developing a long-term career in digital sub-system design, SoC/MCU development, verification, or design methodology.

sections.text:
Get to Know Our Team
Grab for Business provides corporate clients with solutions for employee mobility, deliveries, and meals. Our team partners with businesses to help their employees use these services effectively and make day-to-day operations easier.
Get to Know the Role
You will manage a portfolio of existing corporate clients in Ho Chi Minh City. Your focus is to grow the value of each account by increasing product adoption and usage, identifying expansion opportunities, and building lasting client relationships - not primarily acquiring new clients.
You will report to the Head of GFB KAM. This role is based onsite in Ho Chi Minh City.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Own account plans for assigned clients and drive growth in revenue, product usage, and adoption across your portfolio.
Build relationships with client decision-makers and understand their business priorities, employee needs, and opportunities to expand Grab for Business usage.
Identify and deliver cross-sell and upsell opportunities across relevant mobility, delivery, and food solutions.
Conduct regular business reviews, using account performance data to recommend actions that improve adoption and retention.
Work with product, operations, and support teams to resolve client issues and improve the client experience.
Maintain accurate account plans, growth forecasts, and opportunity records; track progress against portfolio targets.
Use data and AI tools where appropriate to research client opportunities, analyse usage trends, and work more efficiently.
What Essential Skills You Will Need
Experience managing B2B clients or corporate accounts, with evidence of growing existing relationships.
Ability to analyse account performance and turn usage or revenue trends into practical growth plans.
Experience working with client stakeholders, including presenting recommendations and managing commercial discussions.
Ability to coordinate across internal teams to resolve issues and deliver for clients.
Vietnamese and English communication skills for working with local clients and regional colleagues.
Experience engaging with AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, improve workflows, and contribute new ideas.

sections.text:
The EPM department focuses on software tooling development to support embedded products in the XC which including Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS), Car Multimedia domain. We develop tools that streamline software and system development for technologies such as radar, video, HMI and ultrasonic sensors. Serving global teams across Japan, China, Europe, and Vietnam, we contribute to the advancement of secure, safe, and intelligent mobility solutions.
We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our growing engineering team and support the stability, scalability, and performance of our cloud and on-premises infrastructure. This is a hands-on role requiring strong problem-solving skills, deep coding experience, and the ability to diagnose and resolve complex production issues. Ideal candidates will be comfortable working in hybrid environments and have solid experience with cloud platforms, Kubernetes, and automation tools.
Responsibilities:
• Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve infrastructure and deployment issues across cloud and on-prem environments.
• Manage and optimize CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation using tools like Azure DevOps and Jenkins.
• Configure and maintain Kubernetes clusters, handle incident response and performance tuning.
• Design and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform and bash scripting for cloud provisioning.
• Support both on-premises infrastructure and cloud services (hybrid model).
• Maintain software configuration management tools and establish version control best practices.
• Collaborate with developers, QA, and other DevOps engineers to ensure high system reliability and streamlined release cycles.
• Develop and implement disaster recovery strategies and backup solutions.
• Develop architectural diagrams, technical documentation, and implementation plans for Azure and Jenkins solutions, incorporating backend technologies as needed.
• Develop cloud migration strategies, including planning, execution, and troubleshooting during the transition to cloud environments.
• Embed DevOps practices into CI/CD pipelines (security scanning, dependency checks).
• Ensure compliance with security policies, regulatory requirements, and internal standards.
• Optimize infrastructure for cost, performance, and scalability (FinOps awareness).

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
The One Stop Sales is responsible for managing the entire sales and event journey from initial enquiry to post-event follow-up, acting as the single point of contact for the client throughout the customer journey.
The role requires strong ownership, attention to detail, commercial awareness, and excellent coordination skills. The One Stop Sales is expected to take ownership of all assigned business according to the level of responsibility and complexity assigned, ensuring seamless coordination across sales, event planning, operational execution, billing, and post-event customer care.
Key Responsibilities
Sales Enquiry & Proposal
Receive and respond to client enquiries in a timely and professional manner.
Understand client requirements, objectives, budget, and event expectations.
Prepare and send quotations, proposals, packages, and relevant supporting information.
All offers need to be entered into Delphi and any other required systems.
Follow up with clients to secure business and maximize conversion opportunities.
Maintain accurate records of all enquiries, follow-ups, and sales activities.
Identify and maximize revenue opportunities across guest rooms, meeting spaces, Food & Beverage, and other relevant hotel services throughout the sales and planning process.
End-to-End Sales Administration
Take full ownership of the business once the enquiry is received and ensure all required information is accurately captured.
Enter and maintain client, booking, event, and revenue information in the relevant hotel systems like Delphi.
Ensure all details are complete, accurate, and updated throughout the sales process.
Follow up with clients for contract confirmation, signatures, deposits, and other required documents.
Ensure all contractual terms and client requirements are clearly communicated and properly documented.
Event Planning & Internal Coordination
Develop and issue the final event program / function details (BEO) for the relevant departments to execute. Ensure any subsequent client changes are accurately updated in Delphi / BEOs and promptly communicated to all relevant departments.
Coordinate closely with Operations, Banquet, Front Office, Housekeeping, Finance, Culinary, and other relevant departments.
Ensure all departments receive accurate and timely information regarding the event, including guest requirements, timelines, menus, setups, special requests, billing instructions, and VIP arrangements.
Conduct internal briefings or coordination meetings when required.
Monitor preparation and ensure the agreed arrangements are ready before the event takes place.
Client & Event Management
Act as the single point of contact for the client from confirmation through event completion.
Be present and actively involved during the client's arrival and event execution when required.
Welcome and assist clients upon arrival and ensure that contractual commitments and agreed arrangements are delivered.
Handle client requests, changes, and operational issues promptly and professionally.
Coordinate with the relevant departments to resolve issues and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.
Maintain strong relationships with clients throughout the event and identify opportunities for repeat business and additional revenue.
Billing & Financial Follow-Up
Ensure billing instructions are clear, accurate, and communicated to Finance and relevant departments.
Review event charges and supporting documentation to ensure they are aligned with the agreed quotation and contract.
Coordinate the preparation and issuance of invoices.
Follow up with clients regarding outstanding payments and ensure payment terms are properly observed.
Resolve billing discrepancies promptly in coordination with Finance and the client.
Post-Event Follow-Up
Ensure all event details and financial matters are properly closed after the event.
Send a professional thank-you message to the client following the completion of the conference, wedding, or catering event.
Obtain client feedback and identify areas for improvement.
Maintain post-event communication and develop opportunities for repeat business, referrals, and future events.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Knowledge and Experience
Bachelor’s degree required
Relevant experience in hotel Sales, Events, Catering, or a similar commercial role, with the required experience level depending on the position level.
Excellent reading, writing and oral proficiency in English language
Proficient in MS Excel, Word, & PowerPoint
Competencies
Strong ownership and One Stop mindset
Commercial awareness with good negotiation and sales skills
A team player & builder
A motivator & self-starter
Well-presented and professionally groomed at all times

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
Get To Know The Team
The Agent Experience PST owns and operates the internal platforms used by Grab's support agents to serve our entire ecosystem- across every vertical and use case. Because agents rely on these tools to resolve critical issues for users and partners, our systems are built for extremely high availability, reliability, and 100% data correctness.
When a user needs help with a transaction, they rely on our platform to ensure the agent has the right tools and data at the right time.
Get To Know The Role
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer in Vietnam to contribute to our internal tooling products used for our agents to serve Passengers, Drivers, and Merchants. You will report to the Engineering Manager, who is based in Singapore, and work in an on-site mode. This role is based in Vietnam.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
Design and write with the cutting edge Go language to improve the availability, scalability, latency, and efficiency of Grab's range of services
Work with engineering team to explore and create new design / architectures geared towards scale and performance
Participate in code and design reviews to maintain our high development standards
Engage in service capacity and demand planning, software performance analysis, tuning and optimization
Collaborate with product and experience teams to define and prototype feature specifications
Work closely with infrastructure team in building and scaling back-end services as well as performing root cause analysis investigations
Design, build, analyze and fix large-scale systems
Pro-actively debug and solve production incidents during your on-call shift
Participate in interview loops to help Grab continue hiring top industry talent
Provide technical guidance, mentorship and knowledge sharing to peers.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
What Essential Skills You Will Need
A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering , Information Technology or related fields
5+ years of experience in software engineering in a distributed systems environment
Strong Computer Science fundamentals in algorithms and data structures
Familiarity with running large scale web services; understanding of systems internals and networking are a plus
Strong understanding of system performance and scaling
Proficient in English communication
You can be a good coder in any language (C++, C, Java, Scala, Rust, Haskell, OCaml, Erlang, Python, Ruby, PHP, Node.JS, C# etc.), but willing to work on Golang

sections.text:

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave , and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave

Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Since the beginning of 2013, its operations have been divided into four business sectors: Automotive Technology, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology.

With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.

sections.title: Mô tả công việc
sections.text:
1. The test engineer is responsible for executing comprehensive verification and validation (V&V) strategies and plans for multiple projects, ensuring alignment with overall quality objectives in collaboration with relevant stakeholders (if any). Key responsibilities include:
1.1. Review and analyze the test basis (e.g., specifications, requirements, technical documents) to ensure clarity, completeness, and testability, etc.
1.2. Develop detailed test specifications.
1.3. Verify readiness of the test infrastructure, including environments, tools, test data, and configurations. Utilize various testing platforms to simulate real‑world operating conditions and validate system performance, functionality, and reliability.
1.4. Develop & execute both automation and manual test cases. Implement, run, and maintain automated test scripts to enhance efficiency, coverage, and repeatability.
1.5. Analyze software and system defects, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective and preventive actions with development teams. Document defects clearly, accurately, and in a timely manner in defect tracking systems.
1.6. Analyze and summarize test results, identify potential risks, and report progress to engineering teams, stakeholders, and VnV Test Coordinators. Ensure proper archiving and maintenance of test artifacts (test cases, reports, logs, scripts, and test data).
2. Perform other tasks as assigned by VnV Test Coordinators and Managers.

sections.title: Yêu cầu tuyển dụng
sections.text:
Knowledge and Skills Required
Fluent in English, written and spoken
Major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field of study.
General knowledge of a test lifecycle
Knowledge of test design, specification methods and scripting languages.
The ability to review and use test design and specification methods
AUTOSAR BSW components : Foundation about BSW (Communication, Diagnostic, Failure Management).
Knowledge of CAN fundamentals and associated standards such as ISO-11898.
Diagnostic Protocols : Familiarity with UDS as defined by ISO-14229 and diagnostic communication over CAN (ISO-15765).
Good scripting skills in Python, CAPL (or C) for: Test automation
Test report analysis
ECU simulation and testing
Experience working in the CANoe environment is highly recommended.
Proven experience in embedded systems testing within the automotive industry. Formal software testing certification (e.g., ISTQB Certified Tester) is highly desirable.
Excellent troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and issue-resolution skills
Ability to work both collaboratively in teams and independently
Nice to have.
Automotive Systems: Proficient understanding of automotive software architecture, especially Basic Software (BSW)
ADAS Functionality Basic knowledge of Advanced Driver-Assistance Systems (ADAS) features and their real-world applications (e.g., ACC, AEB).
Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) & Debugging: Experience with testing on HIL setups and using hardware interfaces such as Vector CAN/CAN-FD interfaces and debugging tools such as Lauterbach.
Automotive Ethernet : Understanding of Ethernet fundamentals (OSI model, TCP/IP stack) and its application in automotive contexts.
Test Automation & Tools Experience using Vector tools like CANoe and vTESTstudio .
Able to analyze and debug with tools such as CANape.
Bash/Shell : Experience writing scripts to automate tasks in Linux/Unix systems.
Version Control & CI/CT: Experience using version control tools like Git or Bitbucket.\
Familiarity with CI tools such as Jenkins is a plus.
Project & Requirement Management : Experience using Jira for issue tracking and project management. Familiarity with configuration and requirement management tools (e.g., DOORS, RQM).

sections.text:

Because we do not just follow trends, we create them. Together we turn ideas into reality, working every day to make the world of tomorrow a better place. Do you have high standards when it comes to your job? So do we. At Bosch, you will discover more than just work.

Working in one of the Best Places to Work in Vietnam and Top 30 of the Most Innovative Companies all over the world

13th-month salary bonus + attractive performance bonus (you'll love it!) + annual performance appraisal

The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Since the beginning of 2013, its operations have been divided into four business sectors: Automotive Technology, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology.
The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 360 subsidiaries and regional companies in some 50 countries. If its sales and service partners are included, then Bosch is represented in roughly 150 countries. This worldwide development, manufacturing, and sales network is the foundation for further growth.
Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) i s 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH - one of the world’s leading global suppliers of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions.
Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region.
With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes.
